chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Sleep Poison and Bait - summary
The party finished the ambush at Harvey's tea shop against invisible skulks and drow assassins. Sir Raf's critical arcane burst, Eddie's guiding bolts and Monarch's chill touch ended the fight, while Lucia and Portia were put to sleep by drow poison. After a short rest with healing teas and a split of the assassins' platinum, the party retreated to the Groves of Belenus, where Portia learned about drow poison and the group debated how to draw out Valkrath. They settled on a bait plan, briefed Colonel Lara, and then bribed the corrupt Colonel Kreetz in Trimarket, hoping to leak their whereabouts at the Golden Leaf Tavern.
Cliffhanger: The party heads to the Golden Leaf Tavern to play bait for Valkrath, having tipped Colonel Kreetz about where they are. Whether the leak draws more assassins or Valkrath himself remains to be seen.

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Ambush in the Hallway
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - scene 1: Ambush in the Hallway
- Kyle recaps the party sweeping the room, finding invisible skulks, and cloaked crossbow assassins arriving.
- Monarch lights a charnel candle with Druidcraft, revealing the skulks as translucent forms.
- Sir Raf rolls a natural 20 and an arcane burst blows the front assassin's head off for 22 force damage.
- Lucia fails her Constitution save against drow poison and falls unconscious.
- Portia casts Entangle and restrains an assassin.
- Portia is shot and also falls unconscious.
- A skulk drops Eddie to 0 hit points, but he recovers to 1 HP.
- Monarch rolls a natural 20 on Perception and spots a disguise self illusion on the shooters.
- Eddie's guiding bolt knocks out an assassin.
- Eddie's bolt burns another assassin to ash.
- Monarch's chill touch kills the last assassin; Sir Raf had stepped out and readied a shot with nothing to aim at.

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Poison, Tea and Loot
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - scene 2: Poison, Tea and Loot
- The GM identifies the poison as classic drow sleep poison, with no antidote and about an hour of sleep.
- Harvey says the assassins only ever ordered plain black tea and sends up healing teas.
- The party finds four vials of drow poison and 20 platinum on each assassin.
- Monarch splits the platinum at 13 each, including Seraphine, and gives the remainder to Harvey.
- Sir Raf carefully removes a drow's hand.

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Planning and the Groves
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - scene 3: Planning and the Groves
- Monarch names Valkrath as the biggest lead, a House Querid operative and Iron Shadow.
- The party reaches the Groves of Belenus and takes a long rest.
- Monarch jokes that drow poison must be applied with the word 'tippy toe'.
- Portia asks the Green Apothecary about drow poison and learns it is brewed in darkness with Underdark fungi, spider venom and a sleep spell.
- Kyle notes Valkrath's bounty and a House Mazaali favor.

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Monarch and Sir Raf Compare Notes
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - scene 4: Monarch and Sir Raf Compare Notes
- Monarch shares a pipe with Sir Raf and asks how House Telks hired his team.
- The GM, as Sir Raf's counterpart, names Zyra the Silent as House Querid's spymaster.
- Monarch theorizes that handling the package could let someone divine or find them.
- The GM calls for an arcana check and says divination requiring familiarity with an object could explain it.

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Choosing the Bait Plan
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - scene 5: Choosing the Bait Plan
- Monarch lays out the passive bait plan of defeating each wave until Valkrath comes himself.
- Sir Raf proposes giving Colonel Lara the latest information.
- Kyle explains the rumor of Zyra's acid-glyph tattoos.
- Portia becomes a horse and Monarch disguises herself as a tiefling child to leave the Grove.

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Colonel Lara and Colonel Kreetz
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - scene 6: Colonel Lara and Colonel Kreetz
- Sir Raf gives Colonel Lara what the party learned and she offers patrols at their lodgings.
- Laura explains Valkrath killed House Mazaali nobles, prompting the blood price.
- The party realizes Colonel Kreetz of Trimarket is for sale and may leak where they stay, which fits their bait plan.
- Portia tips the desk soldier gold to get in to see Kreetz.
- Monarch slips Kreetz a platinum piece and warns him about Valkrath; he quotes a 6,500 bounty.

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Wrapping Up
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - scene 7: Wrapping Up
- The party heads to the Golden Leaf.
- Matt says the next game is November 3.
- The GM awards 20% of a milestone, putting them at level 2.5.

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Key Moment: Two Tens: Head Explodes
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Key Moment: Two Tens: Head Explodes
Sir Raf, standing behind Lucia, snakes a critical arcane burst over her shoulder and rolls two tens on the d10s. It deals 22 force damage and removes the front assassin's head. The table calls it a one-in-2,000 shot.
Quote: "Yeah. One in 2,000 shot because she had to get the crit first." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Key Moment: Eddie Clings to One HP
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Key Moment: Eddie Clings to One HP
Eddie was dropped by the skulk's claws, then rolled a natural 20 on his death save to pop back up at 1 hit point. He then fought on with toll the dead and healed himself, and later finished an assassin with a guiding bolt.
Quote: "well, obviously, God is on my side." - Eddie (Steve)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Key Moment: Easiest Fight Ever: Nap
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Key Moment: Easiest Fight Ever: Nap
Lucia dropped from drow poison in the first round and slept through the whole ambush. The table riffed on it, with the GM calling it her easiest fight ever and Monarch joking about 4AM constitution training.
Quote: "Easiest fight ever. Nap." - Lucia (Andy)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Key Moment: Why Do They Want Us Dead?
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Key Moment: Why Do They Want Us Dead?
Monarch sat down with Sir Raf over pipes and compared notes on the package. The two swapped intel on the courier Nayak, Jimmy Slips and the Iron Shadows' preparations. They arrived at a theory that anyone who touched the package could be tracked by divination.
Spotlight: Monarch, Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Key Moment: Bribing Colonel Kreetz
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Key Moment: Bribing Colonel Kreetz
Having learned Colonel Kreetz is legendarily corrupt, the party deliberately walked into Trimarket to leak where they will be staying. Portia fed gold pieces to the clerk to get an audience, and Monarch palmed a platinum piece to him in a handshake as part of the bait plan.
Quote: "Alright. I think that worked." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch, Portia

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-20: Loose Ends Part 4 - memorable quotes
- "Sir Rafine snakes it right over your shoulder and square into his face, which disintegrates." - GM (Kyle)
- "Easiest fight ever for Lucia. First round, nap." - GM (Kyle)
- "Every time they wanted tea, they just wanted plain black tea. Nobody comes to Harvey's and orders that." - Harvey (Kyle)
- "If you say tippy toe while you apply the poison, then that's how you get it to work." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Not like this guy just had vats of acid in his office that he drops people into." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Maybe it's all bullshit, but it's amazing bullshit if it is." - GM (Kyle)
- "I've never seen anyone sleep so good." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - The Siege of the Golden Leaf - summary
After talking with the Sword Quarter and Trimarket watch, the party spent a full day at the Golden Leaf Tavern as bait, watched by a suspicious watchman detail and guarded by the former hired killers they had once sheltered. Warned by Fickle's silent signal and the sounds of an intruder, they sprang the trap at night against Valkrath and his darkling skulks. A brutal fight left Lucia, Monarch and Portia repeatedly down, but Eddie's arrow felled Valkrath as he fled disguised as a watchman. His Zyra glyph exploded in acid, killing a dozen or so Trimarket bystanders and Thor's fairy dragon Fickle, but the party collected a 6,500 gold bounty, 170 platinum, and a House Mazaali favor.
Cliffhanger: Valkrath is dead and the party is rich, but a dozen Trimarket civilians and Thor's beloved Fickle died in the acid blast, and the party still has to prove the kill and decide what to do with the House Mazaali favor, all while House Querid and Zyra the Silent remain out there.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Planning the Day
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - scene 1: Planning the Day
- Kyle asked whether the party would rest at the estate or go straight to the Golden Leaf; Monarch said she wasn't planning on the estate.
- Monarch recalled the party had slept in the tea house and then at the Grove, and Lucia agreed they had hidden out at the Grove.
- Monarch spent two sorcery points to regain a spell slot, and the party headed to the Golden Leaf.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Bait at the Tavern
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - scene 2: Bait at the Tavern
- Kyle introduced Thor, his fairy dragon Fickle, and the staff Raylana and Morton.
- The party chose to sit at the outdoor table to minimize damage and keep watch; Sir Raf ordered a pitcher of mead and five mugs.
- A group of watchmen walked into the Golden Leaf and settled in, claiming they were there on their watch commander's orders.
- The five watchmen marched off to 'report in', making a show of saying so, which Monarch and Eddie found suspicious.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Noises at the Door
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - scene 3: Noises at the Door
- Eddie heard snapping wood, cast Shield of Faith and crept toward the closed side door.
- Portia opened the front door and the party saw a man Monarch recognized as one of the hired killers they had sheltered.
- Monarch used Message to invite him in; he replied he was supposed to watch the door.
- Eddie opened the side door on another former hired killer, read that he believed he was only guarding the door, and apologized.
- Drik's crew said they were keeping people out because heavy hitters, maybe their old boss, were coming for the party.
- Monarch had water brought out to the guards with Mage Hand.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Warning Thor
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - scene 4: Warning Thor
- Monarch gave Thor 5 gold to make it a good night and told him the party's enemies knew they were there.
- Thor sent Raylana and Morton home.
- Monarch told Fickle in Silent to protect Thor and not the party.
- Fickle made a thieves' cant gesture for 'invisible' aimed at Monarch, who missed it.
- Lucia whispered that Fickle had been trying to message about something invisible, and Monarch set her last Charnel Candle on the table.
- Thor armed himself with a chain shirt, longsword and light crossbow.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Night Falls
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - scene 5: Night Falls
- Dusk came with the evening stroll crowds, then a quiet private supper and a show from Thor and Fickle.
- Around nine or ten at night Monarch, Portia and Eddie heard a muffled crack and thump.
- Portia sculpted the fireplace fire into a watching eye and signaled someone was in Thor's room.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - The Ambush Springs
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - scene 6: The Ambush Springs
- Sir Raf opened the bedroom door and a hobgoblin fist in a troll mask hit him for 7 bludgeoning.
- Eddie hit Valkrath with Guiding Bolt and Valkrath went invisible; invisible skulks attacked Portia and Sir Raf.
- Lucia hit Valkrath with a sneak attack and a dagger crit, but Valkrath's flurry dropped her and he teleported out.
- Something entered the Charnel Candle's light, showing how it revealed the skulks.
- Sir Raf, Lucia and Eddie recalled the tale of the darklings: fey cursed by the Summer Queen, who explode in light when they die.
- Thor shot one skulk dead with his crossbow.
- Portia cast Entangle to restrain the two dark ones.
- Sir Raf shot both restrained dark ones; they exploded in light and Lucia was blinded.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - The Chase
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - scene 7: The Chase
- Valkrath came back, hurled darts and fled, downing Monarch outside the window.
- Valkrath dropped Lucia again, then teleported away.
- Monarch saw Valkrath disguise himself as a Trimarket watchman and shadow step away.
- Valkrath's flurry knocked Portia out of jackal shape and she went down.
- Eddie shot Valkrath with a poisoned arrow for 6 and he collapsed dead, revealed as a hobgoblin.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Aftermath
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - scene 8: Aftermath
- Valkrath's Zyra glyph exploded in a 30-foot acid burst, killing roughly a dozen bystanders and leaving no body.
- Fickle died in the explosion and Thor was devastated.
- Kyle explained that Zyra the Silent puts the glyph on his top agents, and Valkrath was both an iron shadow and one of them.
- The party collected a 6,500 gold bounty, 170 platinum, a House Mazaali favor, and Valkrath's mask as proof.
- The session earned 25% of a milestone, putting the party at level 2.75.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Bait Team Meets Old Friends
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Bait Team Meets Old Friends
Portia opens the door on a figure lurking outside, and Monarch recognizes him as one of the hired killers the party once sheltered. Instead of attacking, he says Drik told him to guard the door, and Drik soon admits they came to repay the party quietly.
Quote: "Figured we owed you for what you did for us" - Drik (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch, Portia

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Flaming Eye Signal
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Flaming Eye Signal
Portia spots a figure moving past the fireplace and shapes the fire into a watching eye as a signal. Monarch messages Drik, and the party springs the ambush on the intruder in Thor's room.
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Valkrath Springs the Door
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Valkrath Springs the Door
Raf opens the door to Thor's room and a troll-masked Valkrath, waiting for it, punches him in the face and starts the fight with darklings. The party's ambush is turned on them, and the brawl leaves Lucia, Monarch and Portia down repeatedly.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Darklings Explode in Light
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Darklings Explode in Light
Lucia, Raf and Eddie all roll high on history and recall the Feywild tale that darklings burst with absorbed light when they die. Raf then shoots two restrained darklings, and the first blast blinds Lucia.
Quote: "Nonlethal blows, everybody." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Lucia, Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Eddie's Arrow Fells Valkrath
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Eddie's Arrow Fells Valkrath
Valkrath flees disguised as a Trimarket watchman. Eddie uses Monarch's spotting and a poisoned arrow to drop him in the street, and the illusion fades to reveal a dead hobgoblin.
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Acid Glyph Kills Bystanders and Fickle
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Key Moment: Acid Glyph Kills Bystanders and Fickle
Valkrath's Zyra glyph erupts in a 30-foot acid blast before he hits the ground. It kills a dozen or so Trimarket bystanders and the invisible Fickle, who was trailing him, leaving Thor devastated.
Quote: "Fickle does not return." - GM (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-03: Loose Ends Part 5 - memorable quotes
- "I would like to face the danger." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Who has the cards against humanity deck? We're gonna be here a while." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Well, the 20 sides and the dice can make it work." - Eddie (Steve)
- "Like, I take that fucking hit, and I'm like, god. The things I do for this party." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I mean, if anything's a potion fight, it's this one." - Monarch (Matt)
- "He shadow stepped, and he looks like a watchman." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I guess we're not getting that bounty." - Sir Raf (Jim)

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - The Fist of the Butterfly Takes Flight - summary
After splitting the loot and shopping for magic items, each member of the party followed a separate lead. Portia learned from Simona Querid Ventre of a Senate measure that threatens the independence of the Groves of Belenus. Eddie received a cryptic dragon drawing from a dead friend. Raf, Lucia and Monarch gathered letters of recommendation and a lead on the sealed box, which Azuriel traced to a shipyard in Greka. The party regrouped at the Golden Leaf, registered with Colonel Kaelix as the Fist of the Butterfly, and took a guard job from Jingle Shimmerstone at Brim's AutoKeg in Greka. There Jimmy Slips turned out to be sitting at the client's table.
Cliffhanger: At Brim's AutoKeg in Greka, the party has just taken Jingle Shimmerstone's guard job, but the other person at his table is Jimmy Slips, whom Monarch charmed and abandoned in Greka. His eyes narrow as he recognizes her.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Splitting the Spoils and Shopping
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - scene 1: Splitting the Spoils and Shopping
- Monarch reminded everyone to add the 1,500 gold each from the split; Eddie chose to take his as 150 platinum.
- Kyle explained that in Roma common and uncommon magic items sell at listed value, uncommon at 400 gold, while rarer items are scarcer and dearer.
- Monarch picked a pipe of smoke monsters and an unspelled staff of Shield, and Portia took a weapon of warning and nature's mantle.
- Eddie chose a guardian emblem and a cloak of Elvenkind, and later a +1 short sword.
- Raf bought a sentinel shield and bracers of archery.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - The Groves of Belenus
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - scene 2: The Groves of Belenus
- Portia met Simona Querid Ventre, patron of the Green Apothecary, and asked her to find out whether House Querid still holds a grudge.
- Simona revealed a Senate measure to put the Groves under the Roman consul, sponsored by Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad, with the vote at least three moons away.
- Kyle explained that the Groves make healing potions on a large scale, which is why they are cheap in Roma.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - A Letter from the Dead
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - scene 3: A Letter from the Dead
- Father Georg of the Temple of Hades gave Eddie a letter from a dead friend.
- The letter held a dragon drawing marked 'Mythic Isles?' and Qul'drik; Eddie's checks told him nothing.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Raf and Lady Gracia
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - scene 4: Raf and Lady Gracia
- Lady Gracia gave Raf political advice about choosing employers carefully.
- She asked Raf to get closer to Azuriel, chief of staff at the Sultan Estate, and report anything suspicious.
- She referred him to Sir Sarovar, who gave Raf a sealed letter of recommendation to Colonel Kaelix and asked him to watch Lady Gracia, who has been ignoring him.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Monarch, Octavio and Azuriel
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - scene 5: Monarch, Octavio and Azuriel
- Monarch reported the whole affair to Octavio Libram.
- Octavio advised sitting on the favor House Mazaali owes the party.
- Octavio had nothing for Monarch yet and sent her to Azuriel.
- Azuriel said the box was bound for a Shimmerstone shipyard in Greka, and she suggested Jimmy Slips as an ally.
- Azuriel said she was very interested in conjunctions, which sent a chill down Monarch's spine.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Lucia's Father
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - scene 6: Lucia's Father
- The coachman Fordham secretly took Lucia to her father's estate.
- Her father gave her a letter of introduction to Colonel Kaelix and said House Mazaali would reinstate her engagement if she denounced Maximus.
- Lucia said she could not denounce Maximus.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Comparing Notes at the Golden Leaf
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - scene 7: Comparing Notes at the Golden Leaf
- Portia relayed news of the Groves measure.
- Kyle revealed that Qul'drik is Giant for 'great citadel' and names the ruins House Mazaali is exploring.
- Raf's roll of 20 let him recognize the drawing as resembling the legendary blue dragon mask.
- Monarch and Raf compared notes on Azuriel, and the party agreed to visit Colonel Kaelix together.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - The Mercenary Hall
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - scene 8: The Mercenary Hall
- The party presented the letters, and Colonel Kaelix burned Lucia's without flinching.
- After some banter the party settled on the name Fist of the Butterfly, Monarch as leader, and the Golden Leaf as contact.
- Kaelix explained how the hall works: he handles no money and records only who hired whom.
- The party found two jobs: a months-long caravan guard to the Dawnrealm, and a guard job in Greka for Jingle Shimmerstone.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Greka and Brim's AutoKeg
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - scene 9: Greka and Brim's AutoKeg
- The party stepped through the autumn portal into sunny, warm Greka.
- A local sent them to Brim's AutoKeg with a sly insult.
- Autognome staff served drinks from a huge controlless brass keg.
- Jingle Shimmerstone hired all five for the swing shift.
- Jimmy Slips turned around at the table, recognized Monarch, and narrowed his eyes.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Wrap-Up
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - scene 10: Wrap-Up
- Kyle awarded XP for a 15 percent night, putting the party at about level 2.9.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: The Fight to Keep the Groves Free
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: The Fight to Keep the Groves Free
Simona Querid Ventre tells Portia that a Senate measure would put the Groves of Belenus under the consul's control, shifting influence from House Ventre to House Marvad. Its sponsor is Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad, and Portia promises to watch for leverage against him, which gives the party about three moons.
Quote: "This is the fight of our time to keep the Groves independent." - Simona Querid Ventre (Kyle)
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: Lucia's Father Offers a Price
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: Lucia's Father Offers a Price
Lucia's father secretly gives her a letter of introduction to Colonel Kaelix. He tells her House Mazaali would reinstate her engagement if she publicly denounced Maximus. Lucia says she doesn't think she could do that.
Quote: "I don't know if I could denounce Maximus. It just doesn't feel right." - Lucia (Andy)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: The Dragon Drawing Is a Mask
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: The Dragon Drawing Is a Mask
Eddie shows the party the cryptic dragon drawing from his dead friend, and Raf's roll recognizes it as a representation of the legendary blue dragon mask. Kyle explains the dragon-mask lore, and the Qul'drik name turns out to match the ruins Lucia's ex is exploring near Xi'an Palace.
Spotlight: Eddie, Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: Azuriel Wants the Shipment
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: Azuriel Wants the Shipment
Monarch learns that Azuriel is still pursuing what was in the sealed box, which was likely sent to a Greka shipyard. She has also lined up Jimmy Slips to help. Raf was separately asked by Lady Gracia to watch Azuriel, so the party sees the tension between those two requests.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: Fist of the Butterfly
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: Fist of the Butterfly
Registering at the mercenary hall, the party hastily picks a unit name after Monarch jokes about it. Fist of the Butterfly sticks, with Monarch as leader and the Golden Leaf as the contact address.
Quote: "you're gonna be named, like, you know, the fist of the butterfly if you leave it up to me." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: Jimmy Slips Is the Client's Guest
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Key Moment: Jimmy Slips Is the Client's Guest
The party takes the Shimmerstone guard job at Brim's AutoKeg in Greka, and the swing shift is theirs. The gnome turns away from the table, and it is Jimmy Slips, who narrows his eyes at Monarch.
Quote: "Son of a bitch. Alright." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-17: A Real Shipshow Part 1 - memorable quotes
- "Those who have engaged in corruption with their personal funds." - GM (Kyle)
- "Son of a bitch. Alright." - Monarch (Matt)
- "At least we're all within 30 feet of Portia." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Because you're gonna be named, like, you know, the fist of the butterfly if you leave it up to me." - Monarch (Matt)
- "You're standing outside the Home Depot of mercenaries." - GM (Kyle)
- "Whatever you do, don't break the auto the auto keg." - GM (Kyle)
- "It's not every day that my boss tells me to go talk to their boss." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - The Glass Door and the Dark Dry Dock - summary
At Brim's AutoKeg in Greka the party found Jingle Shimmerstone mid-pitch with Jimmy Slips, and Monarch played it cool. Jimmy later met her at the Clockwork Tiger disguised as a dwarf and offered to feed Jingle a flattering report while collecting thanks from Azuriel. The party scouted Shimmerstone Shipworks, drank with disgruntled workers at the Glass Door, befriended the warlock Eryndra, and researched spelljammers in Greka's library, where they learned about Eberron dragon shards. After interviews, Jingle hired them as lethal-force guards for the workshops, and Jimmy revealed he needs to break into one on their watch.
Cliffhanger: The party is hired as lethal-force guards of the Shimmerstone workshops, starting tomorrow night, while Jimmy Slips plans to break into one on their watch and may hold proof that could expose them.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Awkward Meeting at the AutoKeg
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - scene 1: Awkward Meeting at the AutoKeg
- Approaching Jingle Shimmerstone's table at Brim's AutoKeg, the party finds him with Jimmy Slips, who has only met Monarch.
- Monarch holds back to see if Jimmy recognizes her and rolls insight with advantage, getting a 25; she sees his pause is intentional.
- Eddie also reads the situation well, and Portia and Lucia sense Jimmy is running a con on Jingle.
- Monarch says she was told to find Jingle and offers to wait; Jingle brushes the group off to finish his meeting.
- Eddie leads the party to another table, whispers that the man is swindling their contact, and asks whether to intervene.
- Monarch identifies him as Jimmy Slips and says she does not want to interrupt, since Jimmy can be valuable.
- Jimmy leaves after a handshake and signals in thieves' cant to talk outside later; Lucia answers it.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - The Interview and the Job
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - scene 2: The Interview and the Job
- Jingle asks for references; Monarch names Colonel Lara, Thor, the necromancer Serafine, and Azuriel for House Ventre.
- Jingle explains the job is discretion against prying eyes, warns that major houses are curious, and tells them to return to the Shipworks in two days.
- He gives pay tiers and says money will follow the interview.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Jimmy at the Clockwork Tiger
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - scene 3: Jimmy at the Clockwork Tiger
- A voice from thin air tells Monarch to come to the Clockwork Tiger.
- A red-bearded dwarf waves them over and turns out to be Jimmy, disguised.
- Jimmy says he is now Jingle's private investigator and can help the party while collecting thanks from Azuriel; both agree not to reveal they know each other.
- He describes the Shipworks: three dry docks, one in magical darkness, four outbuildings and construct guards.
- The party feeds him background details for his report; Eddie spells out his lizardfolk name and Lucia gives her Ventre lineage.
- Jimmy gives the thieves' cant sign for snake to show when he is in disguise.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Casing the Shipworks
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - scene 4: Casing the Shipworks
- Raf rolls 15 on perception and Lucia 20 on investigation; they see the 10-foot wall, a cloud giant supervisor and a gas-bag airship superstructure.
- Lucia deduces the darkened dock is worked by blindsight-trained workers, warlocks and eyeless autognomes.
- Monarch and Portia go to the Glass Door tavern and hear disgruntled gnome engineers blame the new cloud giant partner for enchanted airships.
- Eddie scouts the Greka mercenary hall, rolling 14, and learns Shimmerstone rarely hires mercenaries and relies on automata.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Warlock Chat and Library Research
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - scene 5: Warlock Chat and Library Research
- Watching the shift end, Eddie reasons the loner warlocks are recent hires.
- Lucia, aided by Portia, poses as a fan of a Great Old One patron and rolls persuasion 22 on the tiefling warlock Eryndra Kalastov, who is saving for a petrified tentacle relic and works in the dark.
- Monarch, aided by Raf, researches spelljammers at the Greka library and learns of Eberron dragon shards that bind elementals for fast airships and are forbidden to export.
- The party theorizes the box held a component such as a spyglass or orrery and decides to hide their pursuit from Jimmy.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Interviews at the Cafeteria
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - scene 6: Interviews at the Cafeteria
- Jingle questions Monarch, who uses heroic inspiration on a deception check and tells him to retrain unhappy workers; he orders re-education.
- Lucia says social engineering is the weakness; Jingle orders every blindsight employee tracked day and night.
- After Portia mentions shapeshifters and wild shape, Jingle orders all beasts on the premises eradicated and a scout runs off to kill something.
- Raf sees Jimmy blanch at the lethal-force term.
- Jingle hires them for a week at 100 gp a day with a 300 gp bonus, requires a promise of lethal force, and posts them to the workshops.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Jimmy's Tour
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - scene 7: Jimmy's Tour
- Jimmy tells the party he must get into a workshop during their shift and says he holds proof they work for House Ventre.
- The tour shows the first workshop has a locking storeroom that Jimmy studies.
- The party levels up to third level; the GM reveals Jingle is Papa Shimmerstone's great-grandson.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Awkward Meeting at the AutoKeg
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Awkward Meeting at the AutoKeg
The party walks up to Jingle's table and finds Jimmy Slips mid-pitch. Monarch hands him the social ball and holds off, and Jimmy leaves the same opening, so both play it cool. Eddie quietly pulls everyone to another table to decide whether to intervene.
Quote: "Jimmy can be valuable." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch, Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Jimmy's Side Deal Revealed
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Jimmy's Side Deal Revealed
Jimmy, disguised as a red-bearded dwarf at the Clockwork Tiger, admits he just closed a deal to be Jingle's private investigator. That lets him help the party and collect thank-you money from Azuriel, and he asks that nobody mention they know each other.
Quote: "Probably helpful if neither of us mentions that we knew each other." - Jimmy Slips (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Glass Door Gossip About the Cloud Giant
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Glass Door Gossip About the Cloud Giant
At the Glass Door, Portia's persuasion and Monarch's investigation get grumbling gnome engineers talking. They resent the cloud giant partner and the magic-powered airships hidden in the darkened dry dock, and the party learns she joined recently as political cover.
Spotlight: Portia, Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Eryndra's Tentacle Quest
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Eryndra's Tentacle Quest
Lucia, aided by Portia, pretends to be a would-be warlock and befriends Eryndra Kalastov, a Great Old One warlock working in the dark dry dock. A 22 persuasion draws out her plan to save gold for a petrified tentacle relic, though she keeps the project confidential.
Spotlight: Lucia, Portia

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Hired to Kill Intruders
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Hired to Kill Intruders
After the interviews, Jingle hires the party as workshop guards and requires a promise of lethal force, no prisoners. Raf's 20 insight catches Jimmy blanching at the news before he recovers.
Quote: "Prisoners can escape. Corpses still can, but it's harder." - Jingle Shimmerstone (Kyle)
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Jimmy's Dead Man's Switch
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Key Moment: Jimmy's Dead Man's Switch
Jimmy tells the party he needs to break into a workshop on their watch. He says he will arrange for word to reach Jingle if they kill him, and Eddie admits he was tempted to kill him in the first workshop.
Quote: "I was really tempted to kill Jimmy Smith in that first... Slips in that first warehouse and just be like he's a spy." - Eddie (Steve)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-01: A Real Shipshow Part 2 - memorable quotes
- "His name's Craig." - Monarch (Matt)
- "S h I s l I k r I n k t h r o s h I s r a k. Just like it sounds." - Eddie (Steve)
- "The sign over, it says the glass door." - GM (Kyle)
- "Reeducate the employees who have a problem with the change in focus." - Jingle Shimmerstone (Kyle)
- "Eradicate all beasts on the premises. Repeat daily." - Jingle Shimmerstone (Kyle)
- "Prisoners can escape. Corpses still can, but it's harder." - Jingle Shimmerstone (Kyle)
- "We're all gonna die." - Eddie (Steve)

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - The Pit, the Jar, and the Bubble - summary
Hired for the swing shift at Shimmerstone Shipworks, the party spent their first night probing the guards' defenses, with Sir Raf scouting through his new bat familiar Diego. They learned about the Bay 3 'pit', its two bosses, its automaton sentries and the masked cloud giant, and Monarch's Eberron research pointed to a kyber shard as the box's contents. Locate object from outside the property narrowed the shard to Bay 3. On the second night, Portia's bat swarm let Diego slip close to the pit, where Raf glimpsed two shards and heard the jar-bound 'great Zulk'. Then Jimmy Slips's payroll heist went wrong when a detention sentry trapped him in a force bubble, and the party's plan to free him ended with Monarch casting Vortex Warp on an enraged sentry.
Cliffhanger: With Jimmy trapped and the silence still in place, Monarch's Vortex Warp is mid-cast as the enraged detention sentry crouches to fight her, and next session opens with the spell's resolution and then initiative.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Hit Points and Heist Planning
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - scene 1: Hit Points and Heist Planning
- Monarch rolled hit points at level-up, got a 4, used the DM reroll and ended up with a 3; Kyle noted the other result would never be known.
- Kyle recapped that the party was assigned to the workshops, that Jimmy wants into the far-right workshop on their watch, and that Azuriel wants verification of the box's contents.
- The party discussed Eryndra Kalastov, the Great Old One warlock, as a possible source on the magical darkness.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Bats, Scrolls and Clockwork Guards
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - scene 2: Bats, Scrolls and Clockwork Guards
- Kyle explained familiars and blindsight, and Sir Raf decided to use his wizard's find familiar to get a bat.
- Monarch bought a scroll of daylight as a backup plan; Kyle ruled it costs 300 gp and Monarch agreed to pay.
- Kyle described clockwork observers, which shriek and report telepathically to their creators, and burrowing bronze scouts.
- Sir Raf and Portia, rolling history with advantage for speaking Giant, learned that masked cloud giants are called smiling ones, part diplomat and part assassin.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - First Night on the Line
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - scene 3: First Night on the Line
- Sir Raf's bat familiar was named Diego, and Raf planned to send it on patrol circuits.
- Portia and Monarch overheard that Bay 3 is called 'the pit' and that two voices, one whiny and one commanding, give orders there.
- Through Diego, Raf spotted automaton sentries, a duergar in a power suit, and a ring-shaped ship unlike any airship he had seen; the work chief's name is Wizen.
- Lucia heard heavy metallic movement in the locked room, peeked in, and identified a detention sentry that can bubble one prisoner.
- The duergar and hooded night crew left before the day shift arrived, while the sentries stayed.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Kyber Theories and Locate Object
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - scene 4: Kyber Theories and Locate Object
- Monarch connected the ring-shaped ship to Eberron airships powered by elementals bound with a kyber dragon shard.
- Monarch noted that the box was likely anti-scrying and lead lined, so locate object would only work if the shard had been removed.
- Portia cast locate object for a kyber crystal and sensed one inside Shimmerstone Shipworks.
- Triangulation by Portia and Eddie, with Raf's help, narrowed it to Bay 3, the pit.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Payroll Day and the Bat Swarm
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - scene 5: Payroll Day and the Bat Swarm
- An armored wagon with short-folk and automata guards headed for the Shipworks, so the party figured Jimmy was waiting for payroll day.
- Kyle explained Jimmy could steal two thirds of the month's pay by hitting the swing shift, so the party expected him on their shift.
- Portia persuaded a druid at the Groves of Belenus who knew the Greka area and learned of a bat island.
- Portia swam out as a fish, made an Animal Handling check, and drew a steady flow of curious bats to the Shipworks.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - The Second Night
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - scene 6: The Second Night
- Workers headed for the taverns with their pay while city predators trailed them.
- Sir Raf rolled a natural 20 and noticed an auto gnome with a less mechanical gait that winked at him and went to a Bay 1 crane.
- Diego blended in with the bats, and Raf learned the whiny voice comes from a glass jar calling itself the great Zulk.
- Raf saw two crystal shards in a box; the Zulk ordered Serge to bring the smaller, darker one.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Jimmy in the Bubble
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - scene 7: Jimmy in the Bubble
- The Bay 1 crane operator took a break and walked into the windowless building, and magical silence fell around it.
- Lucia found the observer destroyed and the auto gnome, who was Jimmy, trapped in the sentry's force bubble.
- Kyle explained the bubble can only be broken by dispel magic or by destroying the drone, and that teleportation cannot pass through it.
- Eddie, drawing on his arcana check, said a sentry would release its bubble only if it were persuaded, destroyed, or given a bigger threat to bubble instead.
- Kyle ruled that magical silence blocks the Message spell, and Raf's pantomime to the sentry failed.
- Lucia's psychic negotiation, boosted by heroic inspiration, won the party 30% of Jimmy's take.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Vortex Warp
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - scene 8: Vortex Warp
- Monarch spent a sorcery point on Subtle Spell and began casting Vortex Warp on the sentry.
- The sentry deployed blades and a tower shield, glowed with magma-like fire, and crouched to fight Monarch.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: The Branch Closed to Us
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: The Branch Closed to Us
Monarch rerolled a HP roll, took the three instead of keeping the four, and chose not to use the last reroll. The table, the GM included, relished the pain, and no one will ever know what the other roll would have been.
Quote: "That branch of the timeline is closed to us now." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: Locate Object Points to the Pit
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: Locate Object Points to the Pit
Portia and Eddie each cast locate object from different spots and triangulated with Raf's help. They eliminated the workshops, the other bays and the water, so the only overlap was Bay 3 (the pit). It confirmed a kyber shard is inside the darkness.
Spotlight: Portia, Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: The Winking Auto Gnome
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: The Winking Auto Gnome
Raf rolled a natural 20 on perception. He and his shield spotted one auto gnome with an oddly natural gait, and it winked at him alone before heading to a crane in Bay 1. It was the first sign that Jimmy had slipped in disguised.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: The Great Zulk's Shard
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: The Great Zulk's Shard
Looking through Diego's senses, Raf identified the whiny voice as coming from a glass jar. The Great Zulk, who thinks highly of himself, made Serge pass over the larger of two shards and bring the smaller, darker one. This gave the party eyes on two shards in a box like the shipment's.
Quote: "I command you as the great zulk. You must put it over there." - The Great Zulk (Kyle)
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: Jimmy Caught in the Bubble
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: Jimmy Caught in the Bubble
Lucia circled a silenced building and found the observer smashed and the disguised auto gnome trapped in the detention sentry's force bubble. Jimmy's heist had collapsed, and the party had no good way to cover for it without exposing themselves.
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: Vortex Warp Meets an Angry Sentry
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Key Moment: Vortex Warp Meets an Angry Sentry
After a long debate, the party settled on a plan and agreed to a 30% cut with Jimmy. Monarch began a subtle Vortex Warp on the sentry. It deployed a tower shield and blades, glowed with magma-like fire and crouched to fight, which left the session on a cliffhanger.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-15: A Real Shipshow Part 3 - memorable quotes
- "We took the three. We're done." - Monarch (Matt)
- "She's a goo warlock, whatever that means. Great old one. That's what it means." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Right wing." - Monarch (Matt)
- "No. X is 10. I know Roman numerals. We're from Roma for God's sake." - GM (Kyle)
- "Who knew the adventure would come down to pantomime?" - GM (Kyle)
- "Classic heist, Your job went fine. The other guy's job is the problem." - GM (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - The Longest, Clumsiest Heist - summary
The party picked up mid-fight at Shimmerstone Shipworks, battling a detention sentry behind a cage door with Jimmy Slips trapped in its bubble and his silence spell muffling the building. After a long grind of misses, Faerie Fire and Eddie's magic short sword, the sentry exploded, revealing a fire spirit and shattered crystal fragments. The party hid the evidence, let Jimmy slip away with the cache box, and convinced Jingle Shimmerstone they were merely incompetent guards, getting fired but staying clear of suspicion. Jimmy later paid them 2,400 gp in laundered trade bars, and Azuriel learned the shipment was likely a dragon shard, explained Monarch's wild-magic birth, and asked for more answers. The session closed with downtime, crafting plans, and the hunt for a job exploring House Mazaali's ruins.
Cliffhanger: With their reputation tarnished, Jimmy's payment in hand and a week of downtime ahead, the party must choose between chasing the shard mystery, stopping the Groves measure, or finding a job to explore House Mazaali's ruins.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Recap and Initiative
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - scene 1: Recap and Initiative
- Kyle recaps the night: Jimmy Slips is trapped in the cage room, holding silence, and Monarch's Vortex Warp was mid-cast.
- Portia rolls initiative with advantage thanks to her dagger of warning and gets 23.
- The sentry rolls a 17 and resists Vortex Warp, going into aggressive combat mode.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Fighting Through the Cage Door
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - scene 2: Fighting Through the Cage Door
- Lucia picks the cage door lock, then is stabbed for 12 damage as she retreats.
- Raf uses the outward-swinging door to Entangle the sentry's blade, and Portia's bat Dora fails to land Shocking Grasp.
- Monarch casts Faerie Fire from outside the silence, giving the party advantage.
- Monarch lands a long-range crossbow shot while the observers drift around the yard.
- Portia uses Druidcraft to make woodchuck sounds in the woodpile, distracting an observer and a bronze scout.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - The Sentry Explodes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - scene 3: The Sentry Explodes
- Eddie's final stab makes the sentry burst; Raf and Eddie take fire damage and the bubble drops.
- Raf and Eddie find shattered blue-violet crystal fragments and armor plates among the wreckage.
- Jimmy takes the cache box off-site in a bag of holding and leaves as an autognome.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Covering the Tracks
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - scene 4: Covering the Tracks
- Kyle explains the cleanup requires bagging the big pieces, mending damage and prestidigitation for small stuff.
- Lucia suggests removing fire damage and blood so Raf and Eddie do not look like they were caught in the blast; the party leaves the room one by one.
- Jingle arrives with thugs and a sentry, finds the damage, and seals the shipyard.
- The party's group Deception roll comes up 18, Jingle's Insight is a natural 1, and he fires them as incompetents.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Auto Keg and Payday
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - scene 5: Auto Keg and Payday
- The party retreats to Brim's AutoKeg, and Jimmy winks at them while being chewed out by Jingle.
- At the Golden Leaf, Jimmy delivers laundered trade bars worth 2,400 gp, 480 each.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Azuriel's Revelations
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - scene 6: Azuriel's Revelations
- Monarch reports the box was likely a Syberis dragon shard for an elemental-bound airship.
- Azuriel asks, as a personal favor, why such a ship is needed and where the shards come from.
- Azuriel explains Monarch's birth convergence and warns her about high-circle magic.
- Portia senses Azuriel was holding back about her own lineage.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Loose Threads and Downtime
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - scene 7: Loose Threads and Downtime
- Kyle values the sentry's armor plates at 500 gp toward plate mail, and the party stashes them.
- Kyle reminds the party of Simona's offer to reach Zyra, the Groves Senate motion and the House Mazaali ruins.
- Players plan purchases: goggles of night, a magic rapier, and Portia brews seven healing potions.
- Kyle sets a four-session downtime clock for tool and language proficiencies.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: Monarch the Crossbow Sniper
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: Monarch the Crossbow Sniper
Monarch's wild magic kept misfiring, so she stepped back and shot the sentry with a light crossbow and advantage. The shot did twice her cold damage, and the table crowned her the new sniper.
Quote: "Monarch's new role sniper." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: Lucia's Big Shot
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: Lucia's Big Shot
After a long run of misses, Lucia finally hit the sentry with a sneak attack from the short bow for 15 damage. It took a big chunk out of the construct, about as much as Raf had managed.
Quote: "One day, I will hit it. That might be today." - Lucia (Andy)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: The Sentry Goes Boom
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: The Sentry Goes Boom
After more than an hour of misses, Eddie's magic short sword finally lands the blow that cracks the sentry. It explodes in a silent fireball that burns Raf and Eddie, and the fire spirit inside is ejected from the plane. Jimmy is lucky to be counted in the bubble as it drops.
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: Fired for Incompetence, Cleared of Suspicion
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: Fired for Incompetence, Cleared of Suspicion
The party's group deception roll came out at 18 and Jingle, who rolled a natural 1 on insight, bought the story. He fired them for basic incompetence and docked their back-end pay, never suspecting they were in on the theft. They lost their reputation but kept their cover.
Quote: "Whatever you're selling, he's buying." - Jingle Shimmerstone (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch, Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: Jimmy Gets Chewed Out, Winks
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: Jimmy Gets Chewed Out, Winks
As the party leaves, Jingle rips into Jimmy for recommending the idiot guards, and Jimmy slips them a wink on his way past. Days later he pays them 2,400 gp in laundered trade bars, 30% of the 8,000 gp take.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: Azuriel Explains the Convergence
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Key Moment: Azuriel Explains the Convergence
Azuriel tells Monarch that the astral convergence of her birth came from a thwarted attempt to rewrite reality. The chaos of the reverted timeline went into those born that day, which she believes makes Monarch a prism for many timelines. She urges Monarch to seek out dragons and, with a laugh, not to cast wish.
Quote: "You're a chaos engine. Please don't cast wish." - Azuriel (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-05: A Real Shipshow Part 4 - memorable quotes
- "It attacked me twice. It must be part of the criminal conspiracy." - GM (Kyle)
- "It's the longest, clumsiest heist ever." - GM (Kyle)
- "Monarch's new role sniper." - GM (Kyle)
- "This is what I get for hiring mercenaries. Son of a gun. You're all fired." - Jingle Shimmerstone (Kyle)
- "You're a chaos engine. Please don't cast wish." - Azuriel (Kyle)
- "It was one guy. We rolled initiative within five minutes of the session start, and it took us over two hours to take it down." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - The Philosopher's Shadow and the Sprint East - summary
Hunting for jobs that lead east toward the Ruins of Qul'drik, the party sorted through Mercenary Hall postings and met the guarded Sir Saravar Antosi at Popinjay's Tea Shoppe. Lucia followed him invisibly to the Corona Domini, Monarch learned from Azuriel that his name belongs to a long-dead philosopher, and in the end he released them by Sending. The party signed on with Harriet's six-wagon caravan bound for Sun Dragon and picked up rumors of Khan unrest and Dawnrealm infiltration. The session ends mid-sprint across the steppe, with a land shark overturning a wagon and an ankheg charging the line.
Cliffhanger: Six days out on the Imperial Road, a land shark has toppled the second wagon and an ankheg is charging the line; the wagon master has ordered Eddie, Lucia, Monarch, Portia and Sir Raf to ride out and stop it before it reaches the wagons.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Looking East
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - scene 1: Looking East
- Kyle explained the Khanates, House Mazaali, Xi'an Palace, the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Thundering Citadel.
- The party recalled that Mercenary Hall postings offered caravan guard work heading east.
- Kyle presented two promising jobs: a 5,000 gp small foot escort to Xi'an Palace, and a larger caravan to the Eastern Mountains.
- The party registered with the mercenary captain as the Fist of the Butterfly for the Xi'an job.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Shopping
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - scene 2: Shopping
- Eddie bought a Quiver of Ehlonna at 400 gp.
- Sir Raf decided Goggles of Night were a good investment.
- Lucia bought Gloves of Thievery through an anonymous proxy for 500 gp.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Tea with Sir Saravar
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - scene 3: Tea with Sir Saravar
- Sir Saravar poured six cups of tea in silence at Popinjay's.
- He quizzed them on war ogres and their deadliest foe, and Raf and Portia recalled what they knew.
- He approved of the party's discretion about the iron shadow.
- Raf succeeded on a Persuasion check, and Saravar said he would decide in seven days.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Digging Into the Client
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - scene 4: Digging Into the Client
- Monarch cast invisibility on Lucia, who followed Saravar over the rooftops.
- Saravar showed something small to a stone giant and a cloud giant and entered the Corona Domini's public gate.
- Raf's contacts at House Kenegal did not know the name.
- Azuriel told Monarch the name is that of a philosopher dead three hundred years.
- Azuriel warned of the dangers of walking the steppe and noted teleport circles cost thousands of gold.
- Azuriel declined to invent a commendation for the party but said their name was not ruined.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Research and Options
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - scene 5: Research and Options
- Portia's Nature check of 8 turned up the Imperial Road from Archafinalis and steppe predators.
- Eddie's search for a ranger led only to House Mazaali or the border cities.
- The party considered a ranger as a sixth member to split the pay and left word at the Golden Leaf.
- Lucia met Harriet and Fred at the Mercenary Hall and weighed her caravan as a backup.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Released by Sending
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - scene 6: Released by Sending
- Monarch's letter was answered by a Sending from Sir Saravar releasing them.
- Monarch got an 11 on Insight and concluded that the Sending showed how the powerful communicate.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Signing On with Harriet
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - scene 7: Signing On with Harriet
- Fred explained Harriet's trade in clockwork and forged goods for horses and silks.
- The party signed on, leaving open whether to enter the Dawnrealm.
- Harriet's rules: stay close, never stop to fight, and sleep beside your horse.
- Raf obtained a letter from Sir Saravar vouching for him to imperial military units.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - On the Road
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - scene 8: On the Road
- The six-wagon caravan left Roma by the Via Lupo, with the party on wagon four.
- Portia heard that steppe creatures were strangely quiet.
- Lucia heard that some Khans may sympathize with the Dawnrealm.
- Monarch heard wagon masters worry about stowaways.
- Raf learned the army might conscript mercenaries.
- They reached Archafinalis, which was being reinforced.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - The Sprint East
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - scene 9: The Sprint East
- Lucia and Monarch spotted a huge creature moving underground with a fin showing.
- The group Survival check of 18 found a safe camp, so no exhaustion.
- At Torg Khan's camp, Lucia heard his clan resents being kept out of the war.
- Monarch won over Anya Redwind with a Persuasion check.
- Kyle described the clan's people as toughened by hard lives, and Raf judged it useful information to pass along.
- A land shark overturned the second wagon, and an ankheg charged from the south.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Key Moment: Invisible Tail to the Corona
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Key Moment: Invisible Tail to the Corona
Lucia, made invisible by Monarch, flew over the rooftops after Sir Saravar and watched him flash something small at the giant guards of the Corona Domini. He walked straight through the one public gate, and Lucia decided not to try sneaking past giants.
Quote: "Well, obviously, I'm not gonna try to sneak in there. So I'm, yeah, not going to deal with giants." - Lucia (Andy)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Key Moment: Sir Saravar Is a Dead Philosopher
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Key Moment: Sir Saravar Is a Dead Philosopher
Monarch asked Azuriel about the client. Azuriel recognized the name as a brilliant philosopher dead three hundred years, so the elf's name is likely a pseudonym or a test. Azuriel also warned the foot route is dangerous and that his 5,000 gold could buy a teleport circle passage.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Key Moment: Released by Sending
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Key Moment: Released by Sending
After Monarch wrote him a letter, Sir Saravar replied with a Sending, releasing the party and saying he would keep them in mind. The GM noted that answering a letter with a spell was itself a message about power.
Quote: "consider yourselves released. You have potential. I will keep you in mind for future appropriate opportunities." - Sir Saravar (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Key Moment: Khan Clan Itching for War
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Key Moment: Khan Clan Itching for War
Lucia picked up that Torg Khan's clan resents being kept out of the war with the Dawnrealm, and Eddie corroborated it. Monarch befriended Anya Redwind with weather prediction, and the party heard Dawnrealm infiltration rumors.
Spotlight: Lucia, Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Key Moment: Land Shark and Ankheg Ambush
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Key Moment: Land Shark and Ankheg Ambush
A land shark overturned the second wagon, then an ankheg burst from the ground charging the line. The wagon master ordered the party to stop it, and they rode out as the session ended.
Quote: "if that thing gets its asset out, all our tax screwed. Stop it. Don't let it get here. Go." - GM (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-19: One Giant Steppe, Part 1 - memorable quotes
- "That's all stuff you all know without talking to anybody. That's just sort of background." - GM (Kyle)
- "Anything you see on the ground, and I cannot stress this enough. Run. Just right away from it." - Harriet (Kyle)
- "If you stop to fight it, you're by yourself because we're gone." - Harriet (Kyle)
- "So, sit next to your horse is what I'm saying." - Harriet (Kyle)
- "I didn't need an insight check to figure that out. As soon as I got a Sending, I'm like, okay. He's at least a fifth level spell caster." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Jaws meets Tremors." - GM (Kyle)
- "Stop it. Don't let it get here. Go." - GM (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Acid, Axes, and the Siege of Sun Dragon - summary
Sent out as the caravan's designated expendables, the party killed two acid-spitting ankhegs and looted their dung-walled nest, finding coins, gems and a vial the GM's rulings made a potion of fire giant strength. Harriet's caravan reached Sokha Khan's Red Wargs, where Sir Raf, buffed by his friends, won a single combat against the orcish champion Grock and earned fresh horses and hospitality. At Sun Dragon the caravan found the town besieged; the party waited out the fight, were paid off, and the imperials retook the town. Heading north, the party turned west off their route toward a cloud giant's battlefield, followed a blood trail to a gully, and were charged by a starving troll with a spiked chain.
Cliffhanger: A starving troll with scraps of torso armor, brand-new legs and a spiked, weighted chain has climbed out of the gully and is charging the party, who backed off 60 feet and have a mind link set up.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Intercepting the Ankhegs
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - scene 1: Intercepting the Ankhegs
- Kyle recaps that the party was sent to intercept an incoming ankheg while the caravan dealt with a land shark.
- Sir Raf learns from caravan guards that the acid spray reaches 30 feet and that goading it into spraying early buys time.
- Eddie opens with guiding bolt, hitting for 16 radiant and bloodying the first ankheg.
- The ankheg sprays acid at Eddie but only reaches Sir Raf, who saves with an 18 and takes half damage.
- Lucia rerolls with advantage from guiding bolt and kills the first ankheg with her psychic blade.
- The second ankheg bursts up, bites Sir Raf for 12 slashing plus 5 acid and grapples him.
- Portia casts sleep, leaving the second ankheg incapacitated.
- Sir Raf kills the second ankheg with a rapier hit for 10, freeing himself.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Harvest and the Dung-Walled Nest
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - scene 2: Harvest and the Dung-Walled Nest
- Eddie heals Sir Raf and later gives him a vigilant blessing.
- Harvesting the carcasses yields one vial of acid and ankheg plates for heavy nonmetal armor or two shields.
- Sir Raf and Monarch find ankheg sleeping chambers reinforced with dried dung and glittering with loot.
- They collect 180 silver, 170 gold, two platinum and nine gems worth about 50 gp each.
- Monarch tastes a flickering-flame vial and an Arcana check suggests a potion of fire giant strength, which goes to Sir Raf.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - The Red Wargs and the Single Combat
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - scene 3: The Red Wargs and the Single Combat
- Harriet explains that Sokha Khan demands a single-combat challenge before dealing, with 100 gold hazard pay.
- Sir Raf volunteers as champion, and his friends prepare buffs.
- Raf crits Grock for 16, bloodying him.
- Grock yields after Raf shrugs off his turn, and Harriet pays Raf 10 platinum.
- Monarch pitches Raf to Harriet and she gambles on him.
- The Red Wargs share their view of the Dawnrealm and the Imperium.
- Harriet strikes a fair horse trade using manufactured goods.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Cloud Giant and the Siege
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - scene 4: Cloud Giant and the Siege
- The caravan sees a cloud giant drop from the clouds far to the north, with booms and low lightning.
- Sun Dragon is found under siege by thousands.
- Harriet offers pay if they stay for Sun Dragon; the party instead takes its pay and waits as friends.
- After a few days, imperial troops and giants have retaken the town.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - North Toward the Gully
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - scene 5: North Toward the Gully
- Monarch announces the split: 408 gold, a 50 gp gem and 140 gold contract pay each.
- Heading north, the party spots the cloud giant's battlefield far to the west and turns their horses toward it.
- Portia's critical Survival result lets her follow the blood trail to a gully.
- A starving troll with a spiked chain climbs out and charges.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: Guiding Bolt Sets Up the Kill
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: Guiding Bolt Sets Up the Kill
Eddie's 16-point guiding bolt gave Lucia advantage on a reroll. Her psychic blade then ripped open the first ankheg's chest and dropped it, a clean two-person combo.
Quote: "Thank you for the guided bolt. I will attack again with the advantage" - Lucia (Andy)
Spotlight: Lucia, Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: Raf Stabs Free of the Grapple
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: Raf Stabs Free of the Grapple
Grappled and acid-burned by the second ankheg, Sir Raf stabbed his captor with his rapier. Portia's sleep spell had left it incapacitated, and the kill freed him.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: Dung-Walled Nest Jackpot
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: Dung-Walled Nest Jackpot
Raf and Monarch pried coins, nine gems and a crystal vial with a flickering flame out of the bug-dung chambers. Monarch later tasted the sulfurous liquid and the group concluded it was a potion of fire giant strength, which went to Raf.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: Raf Beats Grock
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: Raf Beats Grock
The whole party buffed Sir Raf. Blade ward and a timely shield spell turned aside Grock's great axe blows. A critical hit bloodied the Red Wargs champion, who stuck his axe in the ground and yielded. Harriet paid Raf 10 platinum.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: Giants Visiting House Mazaali
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: Giants Visiting House Mazaali
Monarch's checks turned up that Dagha Durok's clan has grown suspiciously wealthy and that House Mazaali has been getting more giant visitors. Even the Red Wargs had a cloud giant's "ceremonial" visit that nobody dares question.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: The Troll Charges From the Gully
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Key Moment: The Troll Charges From the Gully
Following Portia's critical-success tracking, the party found a blood trail leading to a gully. Lucia scouted it invisibly, and a starving troll with a spiked chain climbed out and charged as the session ended.
Spotlight: Portia, Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 2 - memorable quotes
- "As the designated hired expendables, you were expended." - GM (Kyle)
- "I tend to vomit in those situations as well." - Monarch (Matt)
- "It's great and awful at the same time. Yay, wild magic." - GM (Kyle)
- "And we're open at a theme park here, and they can dig through the shit and find copper coins." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I have backseat drivers." - Sir Raf (Jim)
- "Yield." - Grock (Kyle)
- "So I cast invisibility, and then I turn into a potted plant." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - The Chain, the Storm, and the Golden Dome - summary
The party faced a starving, spiked-chain-wielding troll in the gully north of Sun Dragon and killed it, with Sir Raf beheading it and Monarch's fire cauterizing the stump so it could not regrow. They pressed north across the Khanates, were taken in by the wealthy, Dawnrealm-trading Stormgale clan, and heard a great deal of lore about the Khanates and the Ruins of Qul'drik. At Xi'an Palace they got a cold welcome from Chimeg and a warm one from the historian Tomar, who spoke of the Ghost Roads beneath the ruins. Three of the party shared an ominous dream, and the morning ended with Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan's invitation for Lucia and her people to dine at the palace.
Cliffhanger: Rattled by a shared dream of something vast stirring beneath the earth, the party holds Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan's invitation to dine at Xi'an Palace that evening, with a day of shopping for finery ahead of them.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Setting the Battlefield
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - scene 1: Setting the Battlefield
- Kyle set up the map and the party's positions along the blood trail, and reminded them they had horses.
- Initiative was rolled, with Eddie under his own horse in the grass, and the troll charged in swinging a long spiked chain.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Troll in the Gully
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - scene 2: Troll in the Gully
- Eddie cast Bless on Monarch, Lucia, Rafael and Portia.
- The troll's chain struck Portia for 10 and grappled her; Monarch used Vortex Warp to teleport her free and rolled a wild magic surge that gave her a 20-foot bonus-action teleport.
- Eddie used Twilight Sanctuary to hand out temporary hit points to allies and horses; Sir Raf poked the troll and drew its attention.
- Monarch's and Sir Raf's horses bolted, with the troll's opportunity attack hitting Monarch's horse, Charlie.
- Eddie's guiding bolt hit for 22 radiant damage.
- Kyle called for an Animal Handling check because Eddie's horse was spooking, and Eddie kept it from bolting.
- Lucia used Eddie's guiding bolt for advantage and a sneak attack for 10 that bloodied the troll.
- Portia cast Burning Hands for 10 fire damage, and the troll grappled her again and reeled her closer.
- Monarch's wild sorcerer burst set the troll alight.
- Sir Raf rolled a natural 20 and beheaded the troll.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Rounding Up and Troll Lore
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - scene 3: Rounding Up and Troll Lore
- Portia, with advantage from speaking with animals, and Lucia rounded up the two escaped horses.
- Kyle ruled the fire had cauterized the stump, so the troll could not regenerate.
- Eddie healed Portia and the party took a short rest.
- Kyle explained how trolls regenerate from large fragments and that the party had dealt no slashing damage; the troll's cleft lair and its chain were examined, and the chain was kept as a trophy.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - The Stormgale Camp
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - scene 4: The Stormgale Camp
- Outriders met the party near a large camp whose banners looked gray and black with silver highlights, though the emblems could not be made out.
- Kyle explained the clan, Dagha's Azure Sky people, and Xi'an Palace, and the party camped after a persuasion check.
- Old Jargal Khan received them briefly and doubted they would get into the Ruins of Qul'drik.
- Lucia gathered gossip that the clan is wealthy, takes Dawnrealm bribes and has no preference between the Imperium and the Dawnrealm.
- The party bartered with the clan, with Monarch trading her Scroll of Daylight and Sir Raf trading toward a breastplate.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Road to Xi'an Palace
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - scene 5: Road to Xi'an Palace
- A group Perception check let the party avoid Landshark activity, and Kyle shared Landshark lore.
- They saw the sparkle of the golden dome, and Lucia reflected on Dagha and her status.
- Xi'an Palace and its outsized stonework came into view, and Sir Raf recalled old imperial military records of failed attempts to seize the ruins.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - A Cold Welcome and a Warm One
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - scene 6: A Cold Welcome and a Warm One
- Lucia introduced herself hesitantly as Lucia Tertia of House Ventre to the Azure Sky honor guard.
- Chimeg told them they could come to the palace tomorrow and camp where they liked.
- The tiefling historian Tomar offered them a glade campsite and a proper welcome.
- Tomar told them the Khan prizes knowledge and spoke of the Ghost Roads beneath the ruins.
- Sir Raf explained that Eddie's letter might connect to the ruins, and Tomar mentioned notes about the face of the dragon.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - The Shared Dream and the Invitation
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - scene 7: The Shared Dream and the Invitation
- Sir Raf, Lucia and Monarch failed wisdom saves, while Portia and Eddie slept well.
- The three dreamed of shadows gathering while something enormous stirred beneath the earth, and the dream stayed like a memory as Monarch took notes.
- A rider delivered Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan's sealed invitation to dinner for Lucia and her people that evening.
- Kyle announced a level-up before the dinner party and asked the table what flavor of play they want next.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: Eddie Calms the Spooked Horse
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: Eddie Calms the Spooked Horse
After Eddie's guiding bolt dealt 22 radiant damage to the troll, his horse panicked. Eddie passed the animal handling check against a target of 10 and talked it into backing up a little instead of bolting.
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: Sir Raf Takes the Troll's Head
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: Sir Raf Takes the Troll's Head
With the troll on its last legs, Sir Raf rolled an 18 and chose to chop its head off with a slash across the throat and a kick. The GM ruled that Monarch's fire burst had cauterized the wounds, so the stump could not regrow and the troll stayed dead.
Quote: "We will, I don't know, chop his head off." - Sir Raf (Jim)
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: Lucia's Ex Is the Azure Sky Khan
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: Lucia's Ex Is the Azure Sky Khan
