The GM revealed that Lucia's former betrothed leads the People of the Azure Sky, who built Xi'an Palace and control the Ruins of Qul'drik. This set up the whole northern journey as a reunion Lucia had been avoiding.
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: A Cold Welcome at Xi'an
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: A Cold Welcome at Xi'an
Chimeg, the champion of the Azure Sky, greeted the party stiffly and told Lucia to camp wherever they liked. Lucia's insight check showed her that Chimeg had avoided saying the ritual offer of help and was under orders to welcome them while personally not doing so. Sir Raf found the greeting odd for an invited guest.
Quote: "You are known to us. Khan welcomes you, and so you are welcome." - Chimeg (Kyle)
Spotlight: Lucia, Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: Tomar and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: Tomar and the Ghost Roads
The tiefling historian Tomar gave the party a warmer welcome and pointed Eddie's letter and dragon mask toward the ruins. He also told them of the Ghost Roads, which may be a road beneath Qul'drik where the ruins' builders vanished and which only giants forget. The ruins may be central to the party's coming levels.
Quote: "Let me tell you, those ruins are a veritable fountain of arcane bullshit." - Tomar (Kyle)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: Three Share the Same Dream
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Key Moment: Three Share the Same Dream
Sir Raf, Lucia and Monarch failed wisdom saves and dreamed of something enormous stirring beneath the ground. Their dreams turned out identical, and the details grew clearer the more they discussed them.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 3 - memorable quotes
- "All my horses are named Charlie." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Let me tell you, those ruins are a veritable fountain of arcane bullshit." - Tomar (Kyle)
- "Well, I, for one, happen to love arcane bullshit." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I think Raf will see if he can exchange or barter away his studded leather for a breastplate" - Sir Raf (Jim)
- "You traveled into the part of the map that said, here there be exposition." - GM (Kyle)
- "Just fucking chew through all my spell slots in role play." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - The Honor Feast at Xi'an Palace - summary
The party dressed for dinner with Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan at Xi'an Palace and took their places at a horseshoe table of his honor council. Over the feast, each member worked a different guest: Lucia sought a ruins escort, Monarch drew out Oyun and Tsetsen, Portia and Eddie were approached by Urag Bayarmaa, and Sir Raf talked horses and war with Jochi and the general. Sir Raf's report of Sun Dragon raised the party's standing, and Chimeg announced a three-day Storm's Challenge. The night ended with Tsetsen, disguised as an old woman, warning of a plot against Chimeg's life.
Cliffhanger: Tsetsen has warned that an attempt will be made on Chimeg's life under cover of the Warrior's Challenge, and the Storm's Challenge begins next session.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Dressing for the Khan
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - scene 1: Dressing for the Khan
- Kyle reminded the party they were invited to dinner at Xi'an Palace with the Khan.
- Insight checks taught the party the local dress code: silks, light furs and sky blue mark status, and outlanders may dress their best from home.
- Lucia, through a good persuasion check, found a tailor and aimed for roughly 71 of 100 on the social scale, in deep blue fine clothes.
- Lucia used her mind link on Eddie and Monarch for five hours.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - The Honor Feast Begins
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - scene 2: The Honor Feast Begins
- The party was ushered into the palace and the feast hall.
- Kyle described Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan and his honor council: his mother, the general, a mystic, the lord of horse, an orcish tinker, Chimeg, the spymaster Tsetsen and the storyteller Tomor.
- Dagha welcomed the room, greeted Lucia warmly, and had her introduce her friends.
- Lucia asked for a tour of the ruins. Dagha allowed it with an escort, to be arranged with Chimeg.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Rounds of Conversation
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - scene 3: Rounds of Conversation
- Tomor asked the party to talk with him before entering the ruins, which vary from boring to challenging.
- Tsetsen probed Lucia and Monarch about what interested them in the ruins.
- Dagha recommended confining themselves to the upper ruins and warned that deeper levels are very dangerous.
- Urag Bayarmaa spoke Sylvan and then Elvish to Portia and Eddie, and Portia cast comprehend languages.
- Sir Raf talked horses and falconry with Jochi, who said his falcons see intruders in the ruins that no one believes in.
- Monarch sat beside Oyun, who spoke of a sky artifact deep in the ruins connected to the elemental plane of air.
- Eddie invited Oyun... to speak further, and Urag Bayarmaa moved to sit between him and Portia.
- The council asked about the Dawnrealm. Sir Raf reported on Sun Dragon (performance 17), raising the party's standing.
- The council revealed a captured Dawnrealm noble whose entourage was killed.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Whispers and Warnings
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - scene 4: Whispers and Warnings
- Lucia asked the general and Jochi about the thieves and the clan's ruin security.
- Tomor theorized giants built the ruins and forget them on leaving, suggesting a curse.
- Tsetsen murmured to Monarch in person, asking whether the party were mercenaries for hire.
- Tomor relayed by message that the Stormgale clan is backed by the Dawnrealm and could control the ruins by year's end unless the alliance is sabotaged.
- Urag Bayarmaa told a saga of a sleeping colossus that awakens and destroys the world, which matched the party's dream.
- Portia offered Jochi wild-shape scouting to corroborate his falcon sightings.
- Monarch played up a flirtation with Oyun as cover while Oyun played along awkwardly.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - The Storm's Challenge
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - scene 5: The Storm's Challenge
- Chimeg announced a three-day warriors contest.
- Kyle laid out the events: riding, shooting, battle magic, close fighting, siege and an all-events overall.
- Monarch left with Oyun, who confessed that a blade he forged for Chimeg whispers to her at night.
- Back at camp the party worked out that honorary clan membership lets them take things from the ruins. Eddie said not everyone must compete, only some.
- Tsetsen, disguised as an old woman, warned Monarch and Lucia of a plot to kill Chimeg during the contest.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: Fresh News From Sun Dragon
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: Fresh News From Sun Dragon
Sir Raf reports the Sun Dragon battle to the Khan's military table, with Monarch filling in details. The party beat other messengers there, and the clan's regard for them rises, even Chimeg's for a moment.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: The Captured Dawnrealm Noble
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: The Captured Dawnrealm Noble
Sets'en reveals that a Dawnrealm noble was caught extracting items from the ruins and is now a prisoner. Her entourage was killed. Sets'en says the fall of Sun Dragon's pass means more infiltrators are likely.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: A Quiet Mercenary Offer
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: A Quiet Mercenary Offer
Sets'en murmurs to Monarch, asking whether the party is a mercenary band for hire. He asks them to sabotage the Stormgale Clan's Dawnrealm backing, warning that the clan could hold the ruins by year's end.
Quote: "You're a mercenary band. Yes? Available for hire?" - Sets'en (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: The Sleeping Colossus Saga
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: The Sleeping Colossus Saga
Urag Bayarmaa recites a cryptic saga to Portia and Eddie about a sleeping colossus that wakes and destroys the world. All their insight checks succeed, and it matches their earlier dream: something may slumber beneath the ruins.
Spotlight: Portia, Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: Monarch Plays the Amorous Mage
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: Monarch Plays the Amorous Mage
Monarch messages Oyun Temur to play along with her flirtation so they can leave together. She spreads her wings to block Chimeg's view. Mom watches with professional disgust at the amateur play.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: Chimeg's Whispering Blade
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Key Moment: Chimeg's Whispering Blade
In private, Oyun Temur confesses that the blade he forged for Chimeg, from steel taken from the ruins, now whispers to her at night and may have something living in it. He asks Monarch to find a way to help.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-02: One Giant Steppe, Part 4 - memorable quotes
- "It will likely not be fatal. To the eventual victors." - Chimeg (Kyle)
- "Do you Falcon at all?" - Jochi (Kyle)
- "Trifles for the storm." - Urag Bayarmaa (Kyle)
- "I think I might have made a mistake." - Oyun Temur (Kyle)
- "Keep your eyes sharp and your blades sharper." - Tsetsen (Kyle)
- "Does Raf go over the part where I turned into a potted plant?" - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Quarter Asked, Quarter Given - summary
The Storm's Challenge began with Kyle laying out the rules, then day one's riding and shooting events. Monarch won riding with 68 and Lucia won shooting with 67, and every PC became an honorary Azure Sky clansman by succeeding at riding. Day two opened with battle magic: Sir Raf outlasted a hedge wizard and then a priest of Tyr to take first, while Monarch was blasted down by a Dawnrealm-robed mage and Portia was beaten by the priest. Chimeg tackled a contestant who refused to give quarter and afterwards looked ill, and the party suspects the assassination plot Tsetsen warned of.
Cliffhanger: Chimeg looks poisoned or weakened and has promised to personally ensure the party earns their place in tomorrow's duels to quarter, with the contestant who refused quarter gone.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - The Letter
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - scene 1: The Letter
- Eddie describes the letter his friends sent out, knowing they probably would not return, with a picture of what he believes is a blue dragon mask.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Rules of the Warrior's Challenge
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - scene 2: Rules of the Warrior's Challenge
- Kyle explains the challenge runs three days with palisades and rope lines marking northern riding grounds, a central siege ground and southern close combat and ranged areas.
- The overall champion must succeed at all five events and win more events than other all-five entrants.
- Duels run to quarter and are scored by percentage of hit points remaining, while heats score the best roll.
- Renown with the Azure Sky is on offer for event wins, beating challengers, and being champion.
- Portia asks about local wildlife for wild shape, and Kyle lists horses, lions, raptors, snakes, rodents and yak.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Signing Up
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - scene 3: Signing Up
- Eddie, Sir Raf, Monarch and Portia sign up for all five; Lucia skips the battle magic event.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Riding Event
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - scene 4: Riding Event
- Lucia opens with a boosted 21 on animal handling, and Dagha watches with surprise and appreciation.
- Portia, speaking with her horse, rolls 23 and Eddie, using Enhance Ability, rolls 22.
- Sir Raf scrapes a 10 using Tactical Mind and inspiration.
- Monarch's wild magic surge poisons an innocent bystander's horse.
- Monarch hits a dummy with chill touch for 29 points and takes the lead.
- Monarch wins riding with 68 and earns one Renown; all five party members succeed and become honorary clan members.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Shooting Event
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - scene 5: Shooting Event
- Monarch subtly casts faerie fire, and onlookers notice the interference.
- Lucia fires six rapid-fire attacks for a 24 average.
- Lucia wins shooting with 67, with Sir Raf second at 64; she cannot be champion, so the win will not count for the overall.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Battle Magic Duels
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - scene 6: Battle Magic Duels
- Eddie takes the demonstration route and scores 60, then casts Aid and warding bond on the duelists.
- The mystic dispels Sir Raf's Aid before his duel, leaving him his false life.
- Sir Raf fights a hedge wizard who repeatedly casts Hold Person and shocking grasp, and Raf finally grants quarter.
- Monarch's Dawnrealm-robed opponent drops her with a lightning bolt, winning by about four hit points.
- Portia faces a priest of Tyr who beats her to 1 HP with radiant flame, then heals her after she asks quarter.
- Sir Raf beats the priest in a tiebreak duel and takes first.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Trouble for Chimeg
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - scene 7: Trouble for Chimeg
- Chimeg looks under the weather, and Eddie's medicine check finds no diagnosis.
- A contestant refuses to give quarter, and Chimeg tackles him; he is ejected and vanishes.
- Lucia's check suggests a low-dose poison, and Chimeg waves off her warning, promising to make the party earn tomorrow's duels.
- Kyle awards 15% XP, with a bigger bonus promised for finishing the challenge.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Key Moment: Psychic Skill Boost Nails the Ride
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Key Moment: Psychic Skill Boost Nails the Ride
Lucia asked for the d6 boost on her first animal handling roll and turned it into a 21 that made her the early leader. The crowd of professional horse people was impressed, and the Khan's surprised look showed he hadn't expected her to ride that well.
Quote: "Alright. You bob and weave right through there. You don't even touch any of the any of the pointy bits." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Key Moment: Lucia Wins the Shooting Contest
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Key Moment: Lucia Wins the Shooting Contest
Lucia rolled six attacks instead of aiming with Elven Accuracy and kept a 26, 24 and 21 for an average of 24. That won the shooting event with 67, though it can't count toward the overall title.
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Key Moment: Monarch Blasted Down by Lightning Bolt
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Key Moment: Monarch Blasted Down by Lightning Bolt
Monarch's Dawnrealm-robed mage opponent traded weak scorching rays for a lightning bolt that dealt 27 damage to Monarch's 26 HP, and she failed the save even with Tides of Chaos. The party rushed in to stabilize her, and the crowd and Portia and Lucia noticed the mage looking angry at himself for it.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Key Moment: Sir Raf Outlasts the Priest of Tyr
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Key Moment: Sir Raf Outlasts the Priest of Tyr
Sir Raf, already worn down by the hedge wizard duel, faced the Priest of Tyr in a tiebreaker. He used Blade Ward, Booming Blade and Mind Sliver, and the priest asked for quarter to give Sir Raf the event win.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Key Moment: Chimeg Tackles Cheater, Then Looks Ill
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Key Moment: Chimeg Tackles Cheater, Then Looks Ill
A contestant refused to give quarter and Chimeg ran onto the field and tackled him. Afterward she looked unwell, the contestant had vanished, and Eddie and Lucia found no clear diagnosis beyond a possible low-dose poison. Chimeg then vowed to fight one of them personally, and Monarch lamented that they knew about the assassination threat and dropped the ball.
Quote: "Because we knew there was gonna be the assassination attempt on her, and we all fucking dropped the ball." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Eddie, Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-16: One Giant Steppe, Part 5 - memorable quotes
- "I will trust in the tides of chaos to take me through this." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Well, good thing I went out to a middle of an empty field." - Monarch (Matt)
- "The real treasure is the hooking up we won from after the competition." - Lucia (Andy)
- "The thing that really irritates me is that it showed a 20 and rolled off onto a two." - Sir Raf (Jim)
- "He is gonna continue the wizard equivalent of two exhausted fighters hanging on each other in the ring with cantrip versus cantrip." - GM (Kyle)
- "We knew there was gonna be the assassination attempt on her, and we all fucking dropped the ball." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - summary
On the final day of the Azure Sky Warrior's Challenge, Eddie breached his archer's fort with moonbeam and guiding bolt, and Monarch teleported, charmed and chill-touched a Khanate warrior into a staged surrender. Lucia and Portia kept watch on the Easterling mage and found signs of a Stormgale agent. During Sir Raf's run against Chimeg, an invisible stalker crept into the tower and attacked her. Monarch's Faerie Fire made it visible, and Raf and Chimeg fought it side by side until the clan destroyed it. Eddie fought the Stormgale clansman, and the party was cleared of cheating, though questions remain and Chimeg wants a rematch tomorrow.
Cliffhanger: The stalker is destroyed and the party is cleared of cheating, but whoever summoned it is still unknown. The captured Stormgale clansman and the Easterling mage are unresolved, and Chimeg demands a rematch with Raf tomorrow.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Prep and Eddie's Run
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - scene 1: Prep and Eddie's Run
- Eddie offered his vigilant blessing for advantage on initiative, and Raf noted his Sentinel Shield already gives him similar benefits.
- Kyle set the order: Eddie, Ardeg, Monarch and Raf. Lucia and Portia sat out to watch the crowd and the Easterling mage.
- Eddie hid in the tall grass behind a Stealth 24 helped by his cloak of Elvenkind.
- He cast moonbeam on the archer's tower, and she shot back at him.
- A guiding bolt cracked the gate, and moonbeam damaged the archer through a gap in the palisade.
- After the archer surrendered, Eddie healed himself and burned the gate down to win on round five at 30 of 35 HP.
- Kyle adjudicated Ardeg's run: she won in about eight rounds at about half HP, behind Eddie.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Watching the Mage
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - scene 2: Watching the Mage
- Portia told Lucia the mage had lost interest during Ardeg's fight, and they set up a mental link.
- Lucia borrowed an Azure Sky cloak and disguised herself to get near the mage.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Monarch and the Khanate Warrior
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - scene 3: Monarch and the Khanate Warrior
- Monarch drew a Khanate warrior and borrowed healing potions from Portia.
- She cast invisibility, hid and flew, then used heightened vortex warp to teleport him 90 feet away.
- The warrior repeatedly failed to climb the palisade.
- Monarch charmed him, and he offered to stage a convincing fight.
- Chill touch bloodied him and he surrendered after one last swing; Monarch sneaked a potion and later admitted it.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Raf Against Chimeg
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - scene 4: Raf Against Chimeg
- Raf prepared false life, Blade Ward and a stealth approach.
- Lucia and Portia saw the mage cast what looked like a sending as Chimeg walked to the tower.
- Lucia spotted a Stormgale clansman walking back from a patch of flattened, swirled grass.
- Chimeg fired a heavy crossbow at Raf, who avoided the shots with Blade Ward and Shield.
- Eddie, with see invisibility, saw an air creature cross the fence into the fort.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Chaos at the Fort
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - scene 5: Chaos at the Fort
- Portia sent Chimeg a message warning of an invisible creature in the tower.
- Monarch flew over the field and cast faerie fire, which angered the crowd.
- A heightened faerie fire lit up the stalker, and Monarch hid in the grass with a natural 20.
- Eddie hit the Stormgale clansman with a guiding bolt for 16.
- The stalker attacked Chimeg, and Raf and Chimeg fought it together.
- The stalker's vortex grappled Chimeg and Raf, and Chimeg was left bloodied.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Aftermath
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - scene 6: Aftermath
- The clan's arrows and the shaman's fire destroyed the stalker.
- The crowd joined Eddie against the Stormgale clansman, who was defeated.
- The shaman identified an invisible stalker, which does not normally glow, clearing Monarch.
- Chimeg told Raf they would redo their match tomorrow.
- Raf offered Chimeg a healing potion, and she accepted it as a gift without drinking it.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Key Moment: The Friendly Khanate Warrior
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Key Moment: The Friendly Khanate Warrior
After Monarch's heightened charm person lands, the Khanate warrior treats her as a trusted friend and refuses to surrender uninjured because it would look like cheating. He proposes they fight out of sight, make it look good, and Monarch must bloody him. It leads to a fifteen-round fight of chill touches and dodges.
Quote: "Why don't you just give quarter here, and we can both go get a drink afterwards." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Key Moment: Eddie Spots the Invisible Stalker
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Key Moment: Eddie Spots the Invisible Stalker
With see invisibility running, Eddie alone notices a swirling air creature crossing the fence into the fort's northeast corner, after Lucia spotted a flattened circle of grass and a casually walking Stormgale figure. The party can only relay the news by mind link and cannot reach it in time.
Spotlight: Eddie, Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Key Moment: Fairy Fire Lights the Assassin
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Key Moment: Fairy Fire Lights the Assassin
Portia's idea to light up the unseen creature pays off when Monarch, flying over the arena against crowd hostility, casts fairy fire. She then drops to the grass and hides with a natural 20 to keep concentrating, and the stalker becomes visible to Raf and Chimeg.
Spotlight: Monarch, Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Key Moment: Raf and Chimeg Fight Side by Side
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Key Moment: Raf and Chimeg Fight Side by Side
Sir Raf points out the glowing creature is not his friends' doing, and Chimeg tells him to prove it by killing it. Raf shoots and stabs it, and Chimeg fights next to him while it grapples them both. The crowd had assumed the party summoned it.
Quote: "Well, then kill it. Prove it." - Chimeg (Kyle)
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Key Moment: The Clan Destroys the Stalker
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Key Moment: The Clan Destroys the Stalker
Arrows from the crowd and fire from the shaman bring down the vortex, and the clan sides with Eddie against the Stormgale clansman. Urag Bayarmaa identifies it as an invisible stalker, which clears the party of cheating. Chimeg demands a rematch with Raf tomorrow.
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-20: The Storm in the Tower - memorable quotes
- "But that would be dishonorable. Neither of us is even injured. It would look like we were cheating." - Khanate warrior (Kyle)
- "Death by a thousand chill touches." - Monarch (Matt)
- "We wanted politics and intrigue." - Monarch (Matt)
- "No shield. Who needs it?" - GM (Kyle)
- "See, look what you have to look forward to when it's time to actually fight Chimeg." - GM (Kyle)
- "I like to think that she was pointing straight down and the bolt just fell out the top." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - summary
Sir Raf's rescheduled final bout against Chimeg ended with her asking quarter, making him ultimate champion while every PC won an event. At the celebration Sets'en showed Monarch a freshly made brass Cult of the Dragon amulet dropped by the fled Easterling mage, and Monarch's history lore tied it to Tiamat and a dragon mask. The Khan prepared war on Stormgale and sent the party with Chimeg to the Ruins of Qul'drik, after a briefing on spirits, runes, griffins and haze. On the first night in the foothills a land shark attacked the camp and was killed by Chimeg, with no horses lost.
Cliffhanger: The party and Chimeg wait out a cold, misty dawn in the foothills, one day from the Ruins of Qul'drik, where the Cult of the Dragon and a lightning-throwing mage may already be hunting a mask.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - The Rescheduled Final
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - scene 1: The Rescheduled Final
- The Khan invited the party to new VIP seating, built overnight after the previous day's interference.
- Portia druidcrafted flowers for the matriarch, who tucked them into her chair.
- Monarch smoked her pipe and made smoke monsters to commentate.
- Sir Raf hid with a stealth roll that only a Perception of 17 could beat.
- Sir Raf dashed to the palisade as Chimeg's crossbow shots missed; he cast shield and later climbed the tower.
- Chimeg spent both attacks killing Diego, Raf's distraction.
- Raf hit Chimeg from the ladder for 11, then 8, 9 and 13, bloodying her.
- Monarch rolled a natural 20 on a smoke-Diego performance and drew a crowd.
- Chimeg cooled her rage and asked quarter.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Champions and Council Hints
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - scene 2: Champions and Council Hints
- Each PC won an event; Raf was the only one to qualify in all, making him ultimate champion.
- Event winners earned renown with the clan; Raf received two.
- Lucia asked the Khan to let the party join the response, and he said another response suited them and mentioned an incursion into the ruins.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - The Cult of the Dragon Amulet
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - scene 3: The Cult of the Dragon Amulet
- Sets'en, in disguise, showed Monarch a brass amulet found at the Easterling mage's abandoned camp.
- Monarch's history check identified it as the symbol of the Cult of the Dragon, tied to Tiamat.
- Monarch offered the theory of a dragon mask in the ruins.
- Eddie sketched the amulet, and Monarch practiced forging a facsimile.
- The party received prize purses; Raf was given the war horse Redhoof and 1,000 gp.
- The Khan offered Raf two potions of hill giant strength.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - War Council and Briefings
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - scene 4: War Council and Briefings
- Dagha declared Stormgale must be punished while a small group goes to the ruins.
- Chimeg advised hidden rest sites, gray cloaks, and staying quiet around spirits.
- The shaman warned that the giants of old store their power in runes and writing.
- Batu advised riding in haze and watching for griffins, a chimera and a manticore.
- Oyun spoke of a sky artifact and Tomor of passages leading to the Underdark.
- The party gathered gear and the clan gave them gray blankets and cloaks.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Night of the Land Shark
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - scene 5: Night of the Land Shark
- The party rode out with Chimeg and camped on a raised hilltop.
- A chitin-armored land shark leapt onto the hill after the dagger woke the party.
- The shark bit Raf for 15 and then 20 and 14, dropping him, while Portia calmed the horses.
- Chimeg's greatsword hits of 9 and 12 killed the land shark.
- The party will begin next session at level five on day two of the march.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: Poor Diego, Mighty Decoy
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: Poor Diego, Mighty Decoy
Sir Raf sent his owl Diego to distract Chimeg, and she spent both of her attacks on it. The second swing was dead on and took Diego out, but the decoy drew her whole attack.
Quote: "I don't think she can fail to take him out. So... Poor Diego." - Sir Raf (Jim)
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: Chimeg Asks Quarter
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: Chimeg Asks Quarter
After Sir Raf scaled the ladder and kept stabbing, Chimeg went into a blood rage but could not bring him down. Sir Raf's false life temporary hit points cushioned her blows, and she cooled her rage and asked quarter.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: Sir Raf, Ultimate Champion
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: Sir Raf, Ultimate Champion
Every PC won an event, but only Sir Raf qualified in all of them, which made him ultimate champion. The Khan rewarded him with a war horse, Redhoof, and a thousand gold.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: Monarch Explains the Dragon Cult
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: Monarch Explains the Dragon Cult
Sets'en showed Monarch a freshly made brass amulet. Monarch's history knowledge tied it to Tiamat and the Cult of the Dragon, and she steered around the mask Eddie is seeking before volunteering it. Sets'en saw through the dodge.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: War on Stormgale, Ruins for the Party
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: War on Stormgale, Ruins for the Party
At the council the Khan declared that the main force would go to war with the Stormgale Clan while the party and Chimeg went to the ruins to counter the cult. Chimeg was told to keep them alive.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: Chimeg Finishes the Land Shark
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-04: The Ultimate Champion and the Brass Fangs - Key Moment: Chimeg Finishes the Land Shark

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - The Tower of Storms - summary
Chimeg guided the party into the Ruins of Qul'drik under Portia's pass without trace, and Eddie's search for the dragon mask led them onto fresh tracks of horses and a clawed, running biped. They followed the hacked trail, disarmed trip lines, and fought a red half dragon, four cultists and a fanatic, who all seemed to be Dawnrealmers. The fanatic's notes pointed to the basement of the Tower of Storms. Down there the party read a mural about giants binding Tiamat and an amorphous horror, passed a lightning guardian, and studied a prison room of drained immortals. One door acted like a solid wall and had abjuration sigils on it, and the party then opened another door into a vine-choked library.
Cliffhanger: The door to the overgrown library has scraped the vines awake. Tendrils crawl toward the party while something larger stirs in the shadows at the back.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Into the Ruins
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - scene 1: Into the Ruins
- Kyle opened with the party having survived the night attack and ready to ride on toward the ruins.
- Portia cast pass without trace, and the group stealth result of 27 kept the sky hunters from seeing them.
- Eddie told Chimeg they were looking for a mask, probably underground, and Kyle described the giant-built entry hall and its enormous stones.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Tracks and Trip Lines
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - scene 2: Tracks and Trip Lines
- The party found recent hoofprints, which they thought might be Dawnrealm infiltrators.
- Portia, helped by Monarch, read a clawed, running biped print as drake- or dragon-kin, and Kyle explained that chromatic dragons create half dragons.
- Lucia disarmed a trip line with a 20 on Sleight of Hand and then a second, which Kyle judged to be an alarm.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - The Half Dragon Ambush
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - scene 3: The Half Dragon Ambush
- Monarch turned invisible, flew up to scout and spotted hidden horses under the trees.
- A half dragon, four cultists and a fanatic burst from a stairwell and the party rolled initiative.
- Sir Raf shot the half dragon as it landed and it breathed fire on him, and Monarch saved against the edge of the cone for 26 fire damage.
- The fanatic held Chimeg until Lucia's hits broke its concentration.
- Monarch killed the half dragon with a poison burst.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Searching the Dead
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - scene 4: Searching the Dead
- The fanatic's cult symbol and purple rank mark were found, and the daggers' flames had died with their owners.
- Her map and notes named the Tower of Storms and expected clues to the mask in its basement.
- The party rested briefly before heading down.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - The Basement Corridor
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - scene 5: The Basement Corridor
- Kyle described a circular corridor with giant stone doors.
- A mural told of giants binding Tiamat, forging five masks as keys to her prison and entombing an amorphous horror under the city.
- The first door held five giant chests and a 10-foot lightning guardian that did not attack, and the party closed the door.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - The Prison of Immortals
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - scene 6: The Prison of Immortals
- Monarch found a hidden real lock under a false lock, and Lucia picked it by touch with a 26.
- The room held four manacle stations over glowing circles with the bones of a fiend, a celestial, a giant and a blue dragon.
- Sir Raf found the rune-covered adamantine-mithril manacles and judged them a power-draining apparatus.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Doors and the Vine Library
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - scene 7: Doors and the Vine Library
- The next door's latch worked but the door did not move, as if it were a wall, and Sir Raf's investigation found abjuration sigils on it.
- The party left that door and moved to the next one.
- The next door opened onto an overgrown library, where vines surged toward the party and something larger lurked at the back.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Key Moment: Half Dragon Leaps and Breathes Fire

Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Key Moment: Half Dragon Leaps and Breathes Fire
The red half dragon vaults 30 feet over the giant stones and lands with a roar and a 30-foot cone of flame. Raf, who had readied a shot, hits it and draws its breath onto himself, then takes the fire for the party.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Key Moment: Lucia's Critical Sneak Attack Kills Fanatic

Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Key Moment: Lucia's Critical Sneak Attack Kills Fanatic

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Key Moment: Monarch's Poison Burst Ends the Half Dragon

Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Key Moment: Monarch's Poison Burst Ends the Half Dragon

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Key Moment: Murals Reveal the Mask Prison
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Key Moment: Murals Reveal the Mask Prison
The corridor murals tell of giants binding an amorphous city-sized horror and Tiamat, forging five masks as keys, and entombing one mask with the monster under the city. Towers linked by lines of power anchor the binding, which reframes the party's mask hunt.

Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Key Moment: Monarch Finds the Hidden Lock

Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Key Moment: Raf Reads the Giants' Power Drain

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-18: Beneath the Ruins: Murals, Manacles, and Monsters - Memorable Quotes

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - The Thumping Chest and the Whispering Mirror - summary
In the Tower of Storms basement the party fought a vine-choked library full of blights and a shambling mound, with Portia's Burning Hands finishing the mound. Monarch pulled a crackling giant rune stone from the wreckage, and Eddie and Sir Raf found giant books on enchanted structures and teleportation circles. After a night in Leomund's tiny hut, with Lucia spotting a stone construct in the woods, the party beat the lightning guardian and then opened a trapped giant chest, where Lucia nearly died from the glyph. They found giant coins, diamonds, a crackling giant-sized ring and a cloth-wrapped mirror, and when Lucia unwrapped the mirror she heard whispers and collapsed.
Cliffhanger: Lucia unwrapped the cloth-wrapped mirror, heard whispers only she could hear, and collapsed unconscious. Monarch holds the crackling giant ring, the party is richer in giant coins and diamonds, and the thumping chest and the other locked doors remain unopened.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - The Library of Vines
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - scene 1: The Library of Vines
- Lumps of plant matter coalesced from the vines and surged forward, and initiative was rolled.
- Lucia hid beyond the blights' blindsight range and landed a sneak-attack crit that blasted a blight apart; Chimeg shot two more.
- A huge central mass wrapped around rune stones and book pages, crackling with lightning, shambled forward, and a needle blight crit Sir Raf in the doorway.
- Portia's Nature check identified a shambling mound, immune to lightning and resistant to fire, so she and Monarch had to watch their spells.
- Portia's Burning Hands collapsed the shambling mound and the remaining blights went inert.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Books, Runes and Clairvoyance
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - scene 2: Books, Runes and Clairvoyance
- Chimeg, Enlarged by Monarch, tore vines off the shelves while the party searched.
- Eddie found a mostly intact giant book on the runic system for teleportation circles.
- Monarch pulled a light, crackling rune stone from the vines; her Investigation showed it was a container with a seam.
- Monarch's Clairvoyance showed a giant-scale study behind one door, with a thumping stone-and-metal chest.
- A second clairvoyance showed a shattered magic circle, an orrery, and a sarcophagus ringed by three glowing orbs.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - A Night in the Tiny Hut
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - scene 3: A Night in the Tiny Hut
- The party set up Leomund's tiny hut and a corral for the horses, and divided the night into watches.
- On watch, Lucia heard something large moving through the brush to the northwest.
- Lucia crept out and saw a 15-20 foot construct of runed stones that glanced her way and kept walking.
- In the morning Chimeg called it a stonewalker, implacable and best outrun.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - The Lightning Guardian
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - scene 4: The Lightning Guardian
- Eddie cast Aid on himself, Chimeg and Monarch, and the party swapped spells after learning some were banned.
- Sir Raf crossed the threshold and the lightning creature lunged, so initiative was rolled.
- The creature's lightning bolt hit Sir Raf and Eddie hard, and it teleported next to the party.
- The creature crit Chimeg for 50 damage, but Eddie's temporary hit points softened the blow.
- Portia's second Burning Hands blasted it out of existence in a crackle of thunder.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - The Trapped Chest
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - scene 5: The Trapped Chest
- The first chest proved empty; the second, ornate one had a hinge-wire mechanical trap and a glyph of warding.
- Lucia tied off all four hinge wires after fifteen tense minutes.
- Enlarged, Lucia pried the lid open, setting off the glyph with a thunderous blast of thunder and necrotic damage that left her deaf.
- Inside were four ceramic canisters that never released, a mostly emptied chest and a cloth-wrapped slab.
- Raf and Monarch solved a sliding block puzzle in the inlays, revealing giant coins and four diamonds.
- The rune stone held a giant-sized ring crackling with lightning.
- Lucia unwrapped the slab, saw a mirror, heard whispers only she could hear, and passed out.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Key Moment: Lucia's Opening Sneak Attack
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Key Moment: Lucia's Opening Sneak Attack
Lucia hid outside the blights' sensing range, crept back and landed a critical sneak attack. The GM described the blight as blasted to negative 28, five times its hit points, shattering the bookshelf it was entwined in.
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Key Moment: Burning Hands Fells the Mound
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Key Moment: Burning Hands Fells the Mound
After Portia's fireball and several rounds of radiant and psychic damage barely scratched it, her Burning Hands finally dropped the shambling mound. The vine blights all went inert with it, so the mound was holding the whole fight together.
Quote: "Load bearing shambling mound." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Key Moment: Lightning Guardian Crits Chimeg
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Key Moment: Lightning Guardian Crits Chimeg
The lightning guardian rolled a critical hit on Chimeg for 50 damage between lightning and bludgeoning, and the party feared they had lost their guide. Seven temporary hit points helped, and she stayed standing, bloodied. Portia's second Burning Hands then made the guardian vanish in a thunderclap.
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Key Moment: Lucia Triggers the Glyph
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Key Moment: Lucia Triggers the Glyph
Lucia spent fifteen minutes tying off four hinge wires to disarm the mechanical trap, enlarged herself and pried the lid open alone, setting off the glyph of warding. A thunder and necrotic blast hit her for 32 and left her deaf for ten minutes. Her temporary hit points from Eddie carried her through.
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Key Moment: The Mirror Whispers
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-01: The Shambling Library - Key Moment: The Mirror Whispers
Lucia unwrapped the cloth-wrapped mirror and heard whispers that nobody else could hear. Her eyes rolled back and she passed out, leaving the session on a cliffhanger.
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - The Bells of the Giants' Study - summary
Lucia recovered from her mirror vision, which showed a giant city, a negotiation with an aspect of Tiamat, and a rhyme about two prisons and a faceless lord. The party then worked through the study rooms of the Tower of Storms basement. Eddie's knock set off a force blast from the warded chest holding a devil. Monarch and Lucia then solved and picked the puzzle-box chest, which held a library of dragon lore. Portia and Eddie worked out the orrery and its three resonant spheres, and striking them in the right order dimmed the warding circles. The party loaded the books onto pack horses and took a long rest, during which the ring was identified as lightning resistance and the mirror as a mirror of the past.
Cliffhanger: The party camps in the forest with five pack animals loaded with giant lore and crafting materials. They must choose between heading back to Roma and gambling on finding the other towers of the binding circle.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Visions in the Mirror
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - scene 1: Visions in the Mirror
- Lucia saw a high-magic city of giants, with cloud and fire giants and visiting dragons.
- A scene resembling the Tiamat mural looked like a negotiation in which she allowed one scale of each color to be removed.
- The shapeless mass destroyed much of the city before it was bound, and the towers were built for that binding.
- Lucia spoke with a giant-ish accent and said about every fifth word backwards, which the GM judged a temporary hangover.
- After an 18 on her Intelligence check, Lucia recited the rhyme in Giant about the two prisons and the faceless lord.
- The GM explained that the faceless lord is the demon lord Jubilex, and the party discussed Tiamat's prison in the hells.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - The Warded Chest
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - scene 2: The Warded Chest
- Eddie ritually cast Detect Magic, and the door to the study no longer read as magic.
- The door opened onto a giant desk, a chest of writing materials and an ornate chest that kept banging.
- Eddie knocked shave and a haircut on the chest, and a force blast hit everyone nearby.
- Portia and Monarch each took 17 force damage and were knocked back; Eddie and Lucia took 8 after saving, and Portia was out of range.
- Monarch's Clairvoyance showed a thorned, tailed devil holding a ball of fire inside the chest.
- Through Message the devil said it had been betrayed and sought only to return home.
- The party left the devil in the chest to deal with later.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - The Second Door and the Orrery
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - scene 3: The Second Door and the Orrery
- Eddie's Dispel Magic, helped by inspiration, removed the heavy seal from the second door.
- Lucia picked the large DC 30 lock with a 35 after Sir Raf aided her.
- The room held a shattered summoning circle, an orrery, a puzzle-box chest in warding circles with three floating spheres, and a desk of crafting materials.
- Portia moved the orrery and found each position matches a moment in history.
- Cycling forward showed the orrery was set about 700 years ago, with a coming double eclipse of Obsidius.
- Portia judged the spheres might be bells.
- Ringing a sphere with her pan flute out of alignment gave Portia a thunder blast.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Striking the Chord
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - scene 4: Striking the Chord
- Eddie shot the spheres in the right order and they rang a chord.
- Eddie's arrow on the largest sphere out of order caused a huge thunder wave that wrecked the desk.
- The red glow of the warding circles died away.
- Monarch solved the puzzle box with Lucia's help, and Lucia picked both locks with rolls of 25 and 26.
- Inside was a library of 40 to 50 books, scrolls and tablets on Tiamat, Bahamut, Kyber and Siberys.
- The party locked the chest and set the orrery to a random earlier date, which relit the circles.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Loot, Scouting and Rest
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - scene 5: Loot, Scouting and Rest
- Monarch chose not to speak to the devil again so it would think she died in the blast.
- The party reasoned two more towers would let them triangulate the binding site.
- Monarch scouted from the air and learned the ring of towers lies in the middle of an oblong city.
- After Eddie's survival roll of 11, the party camped away from the trail and loaded the pack horses.
- Monarch identified the ring as lightning resistance, and the GM ruled the mirror a mirror of the past.
- The Tiamat books confirmed the dragon masks are the keys to her prison, and scholars split on seeking them.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Key Moment: The Rhyme of Two Prisons
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Key Moment: The Rhyme of Two Prisons
After Lucia's mirror vision, she rattles off a memorized Giant/Common rhyme warning that both great prisons could be broken and the faceless lord reawoken. The GM links the Faceless Lord to the demon lord Jubilex and the vision of a negotiation with Tiamat overturns the party's reading of the murals.
Quote: "Lest both great prisons be broken and faceless lord reawoken." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Key Moment: Shave and a Haircut
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Key Moment: Shave and a Haircut

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Key Moment: The Devil Who Keeps His Word
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Key Moment: The Devil Who Keeps His Word
Monarch uses clairvoyance and message to talk to the thorny devil in the chest. It says it was betrayed and only wants to go home, never promising to be harmless. The party leaves it locked in.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Key Moment: Lucia Beats the Giant Lock

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Key Moment: Striking the Chord

Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Key Moment: Striking the Chord
Working out that the orrery's date and the resonant spheres form a combination lock, Portia nearly gets blasted playing her pan flute. Eddie then fires arrows at the spheres in the right order and the warding circles go dark.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-15: The Devil, The Dragon, and The Demon Lord - Key Moment: Let Him Think I'm Dead

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - summary
The party left the Tower of Dreams and crept through thick undergrowth toward the Tower of Runes, a floating spiral of shifting rune-stones. Lucia scouted a Dawnrealm-equipped dragonborn and lizardfolk group climbing it with the help of a runestone guardian. A Pass without Trace ambush broke the fanatic controlling the guardian, but the freed construct turned on friend and foe alike, dropping Sir Raf and Eddie and slowing the party. The group cracked it, took a long rest in nearby rocks, and learned from a captured Giant book how rune guardians are controlled.
Cliffhanger: The guardian is cracked and the Tower of Runes is quiet, but the party has only recovered a small bit of its strength. The party rests in the rocks while the black crystal on the spiral's last stone looms above.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Atop the Tower of Dreams
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - scene 1: Atop the Tower of Dreams
- Kyle explained the Tower of Dreams exists in both the astral and prime planes, and Portia read the canopy for likely fallen-stone building sites.
- Portia, Monarch and Sir Raf spotted something rising above the trees about a mile away, farther than the Tower of Storms was from the Tower of Dreams, suggesting the ring of towers may be oblong.
- The party descended without dream challenges and saw spirit giants sleeping and tended.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Through the Undergrowth
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - scene 2: Through the Undergrowth
- They followed the old road line with their horses, and Portia's owl helped watch the tower.
- A group Survival check left a misleading trail, with a middle score of 21.
- Portia's owl revealed the Tower of Runes, a spiral of floating, rune-covered, shifting stones.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Rest and Reconnaissance
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - scene 3: Rest and Reconnaissance
- During a short rest, Sir Raf heard faint humanoid shouts in the direction of the tower.
- Portia's owl, which rolled a 20 on stealth, reported many people and a large rocky thing, with some climbers falling or burned.
- Monarch cast Invisibility on Lucia, who linked Eddie, Portia and Raf by mind link.
- Lucia saw about ten Dawnrealm-equipped dragonborn and lizardfolk using a runestone construct as a lift, with a concentrating fanatic and a leader in purple.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - The Ambush
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - scene 4: The Ambush
- With Pass without Trace the party sneaked in from the west, and Kyle moved to a map.
- Sir Raf's Magic Missile did 11 damage to the fanatic, who kept her concentration.
- Eddie's readied Guiding Bolt did 14 radiant damage, and she held on again.
- Portia's fireball killed three of four cultists.
- Monarch's critical wild magic psychic blast blew up a cultist's head.
- The Speaker of Storms charmed Lucia, who failed her save despite advantage and rerolls.
- Chimeg's crossbow bolt broke the fanatic's concentration and the cultists broke and fled.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - The Guardian Unleashed
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - scene 5: The Guardian Unleashed
- The freed guardian struck the Speaker of Storms for 23 damage, leaving the Speaker badly hurt, panicking, and still alive.
- Sir Raf's Giant command to hunt the cultists did not work, and Chimeg warned they are unstoppable murder that can only be outrun.
- The guardian slowed Chimeg, Portia and Eddie.
- It dropped Sir Raf with a 34 and 26 damage round, and later knocked Eddie unconscious.
- Lucia's critical sneak attack tripped the guardian, though it is immune to psychic damage.
- Cracks spread in the guardian as the party kept hitting it with thunder and bolts.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - The Control Book and the Long Rest
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - scene 6: The Control Book and the Long Rest
- Sir Raf learned from the Giant book that a runic formula links telepathically to rune guardians, costs a third-level slot, and has a 30-foot range.
- Monarch claimed the surviving scout resisted charm because of elven heritage, and Portia did not believe her.
- The party found a defensible cluster of rocks to the southeast for a long rest.
- A cracked black crystal threaded with adamant was seen on the last stone of the spiral.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: Fireball Clears the Glade
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: Fireball Clears the Glade
Portia's fireball lands on the cultists and the Speaker of Storms; GM rules full damage on two cultists and three of four cultists go down. The whole party had set up the ambush with Pass without Trace, and this was its payoff.
Quote: "that was a well used fireball." - Sir Raf (Jim)
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: Charmed by the Speaker of Storms
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: Charmed by the Speaker of Storms
Lucia fails her wisdom save three times, using inspiration to reroll, and is charmed. Her new best friend the Speaker of Storms tells her to take cover behind the guardian.
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: Crossbow Breaks the Fanatic's Concentration
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: Crossbow Breaks the Fanatic's Concentration
After many failed attempts to break her concentration, Chimeg's crossbow bolt finally makes the fanatic fail her check. The Runestone Guardian lowers its arms and the fanatic screams 'Run. It's broken.' The cult scatters as the construct is freed.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: Raf Drops to the Guardian
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: Raf Drops to the Guardian
The freed Runestone Guardian hits Sir Raf with a 34-damage first attack and another 26, taking him down. He had been trying to talk to it in Giant and stood toe to toe with it after drinking a Potion of Fire Giant Strength.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: Lucia Trips the Colossus
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: Lucia Trips the Colossus
Lucia crits with a sneak attack and trip on the guardian, learning that it is immune to psychic damage but can be knocked prone.
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: The Rune Guardian Control Formula
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Key Moment: The Rune Guardian Control Formula
After the guardian falls, Sir Raf studies the book Lucia looted from the fanatic and the GM explains it holds a third-level rune formula that links to and commands rune guardians, with a saving throw and a 30-foot range. Raf notes he could copy it using comprehend languages.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-13: The Spiral That Would Not Stand Still - memorable quotes
- "If you're not in the group chat, you don't know." - GM (Kyle)
- "The cinematic version of this fight shows Monarch just popping heads." - GM (Kyle)
- "Don't waste your breath. They are unstoppable murder." - Chimeg (Kyle)
- "Because, you know, it's never been defeated before. So gotta give myself every chance I can." - Sir Raf (Jim)
- "I can't argue with a fanatic. All I can do is try and charm you." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I think he had an elven heritage and had advantage on all those saves." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - summary
The party rested beneath the Tower of Runes, then climbed its shifting spiral of stones as a skill challenge, taking falls, force blasts and a deafening thunder blast along the way. Monarch shrank into the singing crystal and bagged the Graven Lexus of Binding while Portia's countersong held the crystal open. Arcana study of the tablet suggested the dragon mask is a power source for the prison, so the party chose to seek a replacement legendary item, and Chimeg pointed them to the Hall of Blades. There, past a field of hacked-up bodies, a voice demanded worthy truths: Eddie earned a necrotic rapier, Monarch earned a warning, and the session ended as Chimeg's greatsword began to smoke with shadow flame.
Cliffhanger: Chimeg stands before the pedestal in the Hall of Blades as a shadow-smoking blade drifts toward her and her own greatsword bursts into flickering shadow flame, with Lucia, Portia and Sir Raf yet to offer truths.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Rest and Riddles at the Tower of Runes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - scene 1: Rest and Riddles at the Tower of Runes
- The GM revealed a cultist's note fragment confirming the Lexus is atop the Tower of Runes and explained that a lexus is a catalog of a language, valuable like a Rosetta Stone.
- Monarch had the dead climbers examined; the injuries showed falling, force, thunder and electrical damage.
- Lucia and Eddie spotted a stone tablet inside the obsidian and adamant crystal at the top, whose chant opens and closes in cycles.
- Monarch put Misty Step in the ring of spell storing and planned two hours to attune, while Portia cast protection from energy for thunder.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - A Failed Flight and the Skill Challenge
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - scene 2: A Failed Flight and the Skill Challenge
- Monarch cast Misty Step across the barrier; a wild surge made butterflies appear and the spell dropped her at the tower's base, where she could hover but not climb.
- The party studied the tower with group analysis rolls and learned of keystones, tracks, sigils and counter-song options.
- The GM laid out the challenge: a concentration check, then four successes per tier, with each skill usable once per tier.
- Lucia's acrobatics and Portia's survival opened the first tier, but Sir Raf's failed investigation dropped everyone 10 feet to the ground.
- Lucia's sleight of hand locked the first tier's stones in place.
- Raf's Arcana calmed the second tier, and a 26 on investigation showed the top tier's DC is 18.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Falls, Blasts and a Living Rune
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - scene 3: Falls, Blasts and a Living Rune
- After Lucia's acrobatics failed by five, Sir Raf cast his prepared Feather Fall and Lucia's flying boots stopped her fall; Portia could not use Feather Fall.
- Lucia rolled a natural 20 on sleight of hand for 10 extra feet.
- A failed Arcana check set off a force blast that knocked Portia off, and Eddie healed her for 29 hit points.
- Touching a living vine rune, Portia learned the Rune of Grasping.
- Raf's failed investigation by five caused another fall.
- Monarch and Eddie climbed a parallel route; Monarch crit on investigation, then Portia's failed performance triggered a thunder blast that deafened the first group.
- Lucia recognized an ancient giant rune on a stone as the simplified sigil from the cloth in her house's secure room called the well.
- Eddie's Survival check found the one unmarked stable stone and locked the final tier.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Taking the Tablet
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - scene 4: Taking the Tablet
- Monarch's countersong held the crystal gap open long enough for her to shrink and slip inside.
- Monarch returned to normal size and slid the tablet into her bag of holding.
- Portia's performance, aided by Monarch from inside, held the crystal open for a full round, and Monarch Misty Stepped out.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - A Lexus of Binding and a Way Forward
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - scene 5: A Lexus of Binding and a Way Forward
- During a short rest the tablet proved to be a Graven Lexus of binding runes giving plus five to Arcana checks on such runes.
- Portia's natural 20 on survival, with the three towers, placed the prison slightly off to one side of the central building.
- Arcana study suggested the Dragon Mask is a power source, so the party wants a replacement legendary item instead of taking it.
- Chimeg said her people stay on the surface and favored the Hall of Blades; Monarch's Insight found no deception.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - The Chopped Clearing
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - scene 6: The Chopped Clearing
- The party found a huge circle of chopped-up trees about two weeks old.
- Lucia scouted ahead and found dismembered bodies and a buried giant-sized doorway in a low hill.
- Eddie's locate object found a symbol and a letter among the bodies, and the letter was read by ritual.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - The Hall of Blades
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - scene 7: The Hall of Blades
- Inside, the party saw rows of hanging blades and a pedestal of living runes.
- A voice demanded the party prove its honesty and warned that unworthy answers will be punished.
- Eddie confessed the source of his scar from Tiamat's claw, was judged worthy, and chose a blade.
- A cloud giant spirit handed Eddie a blood iron and adamantine rapier holding necrotic energy.
- Monarch confessed she took the summer queen's crown knowingly and was given a warning about power from outside the lands.
- Chimeg walked to the pedestal, and a smoking fire giant spirit carried a shadow-flamed blade toward it as her greatsword began to smoke.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Wild Surge Sends Monarch Down
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Wild Surge Sends Monarch Down
Monarch cast Misty Step to jump the sound barrier and rolled a wild surge. The GM ruled the teleport redirected her laterally exactly where she wanted, then all the way to the base of the tower, revealing that spells moving you upward fail here.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Portia Touches the Living Rune
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Portia Touches the Living Rune
While climbing the first tier, Portia brushed a vine and received visions of ancient firbolg giants growing living runes. The GM gave her a new bonus-action rune, the Rune of Grasping, which boosts binding and restraining spells.
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Lucia's House Sigil Is Ancient
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Lucia's House Sigil Is Ancient
After the thunder blast left the group deaf, Lucia spotted a rune on the stones that matches a simplified version of her family's sigil. She had seen it woven into a cloth in her house's secret room called the well, so the symbol predates her house and raises many questions.
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Duet to Free the Trapped Monarch
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Duet to Free the Trapped Monarch
Monarch, shrunk inside the crystal with the tablet, was stuck when Portia's countersong failed at first. Monarch aided Portia's performance from inside, her second roll succeeded, and the gap held open for one round so Monarch could Misty Step out.
Spotlight: Portia, Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Eddie Confesses the Scar
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Eddie Confesses the Scar
At the Hall of Blades, Eddie's first confession about his lizardfolk origins let him live but earned nothing. He then admitted the source of his scar, Tiamat's claw after he chose Hades in a dream, and was judged worthy to receive a blade: a cloud giant spirit handed him a necrotic blood iron and adamantine rapier.
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Monarch Admits Her Hunger for Power
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Key Moment: Monarch Admits Her Hunger for Power
Standing at the pedestal, Monarch confessed she took the Summer queen's crown even after seeing it was faceless, and that she would not choose differently. The hall judged it worthy and gave her a warning that power from below pulls below, and that she should seek power from her own lands.
Quote: "In being honest, no. I would not choose differently. My desire for power is insatiable." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-27: The Hall That Demands Truth - memorable quotes
- "All the hall demands is truth." - Hall of Blades voice (Kyle)
- "Touched as you are by her." - GM (Kyle)
- "In being honest, no. I would not choose differently. My desire for power is insatiable." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Power from below always pulls below." - Hall of Blades voice (Kyle)
- "Hey. I'm happy with the first step." - Eddie (Steve)
- "Well, that makes me feel great. This is perfectly safe. Who wants to go first?" - Eddie (Steve)
- "And that is where we will say to be continued." - GM (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - summary
In the Hall of Blades, Sir Raf and Portia each answered the pedestal's demand for a truth and were judged adequate, just as a ghostly fire-giant keeper carried a shadow-flame blade toward Chimeg. The party recognized it as Black Razor, a soul-eating artifact, and fought the keeper while its swords swarmed those who became enemies; Chimeg fell, was healed, and Sir Raf finally destroyed the keeper. Chimeg's shouted 'stand down' stopped the swords, and Monarch bagged Black Razor with Eddie's protection from evil and good shielding her from its will. After a long rest and identifying the loot, Eddie's offering of a plus one short sword won the answer that the thorn betrayer took the blue dragon mask through the Gate of Dragons into the Hall of Scales. On the road south the party found chimneys of the buried Hall of Feasts, and the familiars Dora and Diego found a hidden door and an eerily self-tidying feast hall.
Cliffhanger: Beneath the chimneys of the Hall of Feasts, the familiars Dora and Diego have found a hidden door behind a mosaic and a cavernous hall whose place settings quietly keep tidying themselves.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Planning and Preparations
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - scene 1: Planning and Preparations
- The party recapped the towers visited and Eddie wondered whether to make a full circuit, while Monarch noted they need the mask plus an artifact to put in its place.
- Eddie asked whether to use Twilight Sanctuary in combat, and Monarch urged him to do so in every fight.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - The Pedestal Demands a Truth
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - scene 2: The Pedestal Demands a Truth
- Kyle described Chimeg walking to the pedestal as a ghostly giant carried a shadow-flame greatsword toward her.
- Sir Raf's first offering about the mission was ruled not a valuable truth.
- Raf revealed his oath to Lady Gracia of House Ventra even though he is of House Kenegal, and the voice judged it adequate.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Black Razor Revealed
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - scene 3: Black Razor Revealed
- History checks showed Raf, Portia and Eddie that the blade was Black Razor, a soul-eating artifact thought entombed elsewhere.
- Monarch's Investigation found it was no illusion but incomplete, and recalled the smith who forged Chimeg's blade from found steel.
- Raf chose to wait and see rather than intervene on Chimeg's behalf.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Battle Among the Blades
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - scene 4: Battle Among the Blades
- Eddie used Channel Divinity for Twilight Sanctuary.
- Monarch's heightened Lightning Bolt hit the keeper and two swords.
- Eddie's Guardian Emblem turned a crit on Chimeg into a normal hit, though she was still bloodied.
- During the fight Portia answered the pedestal with her resentment of the courts' control and of being tasked with watching Monarch; it was judged adequate.
- Chimeg fell unconscious and the keeper took her blade.
- The keeper reforged Black Razor whole, and Eddie, Raf and Portia watched Chimeg get healed.
- Raf's Booming Blade finished the keeper.
- Chimeg picked up the sword and shouted 'stand down', halting the swords, then dropped it after a natural 20 on her save.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Bagging the Artifact and Resting
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - scene 5: Bagging the Artifact and Resting
- Monarch picked up Black Razor, heard 'now we will slay', and put it in her bag of holding, protected from charm by Eddie's protection from evil and good.
- Identification showed a plus one greatsword, the adamantine longsword Shatterspike, a slumbering blue dragon's wrath scimitar, and Eddie's rapier as a sword of wounding.
- Kyle reread the flame keeper note about the thorn betrayer.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Where the Mask Went
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - scene 6: Where the Mask Went
- Eddie rolled a natural 20 on Arcana and learned the pedestal is for offerings, then offered a plus one short sword.
- The voice told him the thorn betrayer carried the mask through the Gate of Dragons into the Hall of Scales.
- The party agreed to head for the Hall of Scales, with Raf taking Shatterspike.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - The Hall of Feasts
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - scene 7: The Hall of Feasts
- Portia's familiar saw a rune guardian walking the road between the Hall of Blades and the Tower of Ruins.
- Portia recognized chimney tops poking from the ground, and Kyle explained giant feast halls are also city hall and battle arena.
- Dora and Diego flew down the roasting pit into a vast feast hall.
- They found a hidden door behind a mosaic and noticed the tables magically tidying themselves.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Raf Confesses His Secret Oath
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Raf Confesses His Secret Oath
After his first answer was rejected as not valuable, Sir Raf revealed that he is sworn to Lady Gracia and to the ascendancy of House Ventre, working chiefly for her house despite coming from another. The pedestal judged the truth adequate and the blades stayed still.
Quote: "I have sworn an oath to my lady love." - Sir Raf (Jim)
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Portia's Resentful Truth
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Portia's Resentful Truth
Offering her truth in the middle of combat, Portia admitted she resents being tasked with watching over Monarch and still feels bound by fey court rules. The pedestal judged it adequate, and Monarch joked about the scowl and the secret she'd been spared.
Quote: "For now, do what is best for the team to solve the problems at hand. In the future, we may need to part ways." - Portia (Diane)
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Raf Ends the Keeper
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Raf Ends the Keeper
