After the keeper reforged Black Razor and hasted itself, Sir Raf cast booming blade and rerolled a poor attack with heroic inspiration. His hit finished the ghostly fire giant and left the smoking greatsword at his feet.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Chimeg Shouts Stand Down
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Chimeg Shouts Stand Down
Working out that the swords obeyed whoever held the keeper's blade, Chimeg grabbed Black Razor and shouted for the swords to stand down. They stopped, and she rolled a natural 20 on her save to drop it immediately.
Quote: "stand down. These are all friends." - Chimeg (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Protected from Black Razor's Will
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Protected from Black Razor's Will
Monarch lifted Black Razor and heard it demand 'now we will slay'. Her charisma save failed even after heroic inspiration. Eddie's protection from evil and good blocked the charm, so she bagged the artifact.
Quote: "It might be a while before I am fully prepared." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch, Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Eddie's Offering Reveals the Mask
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Key Moment: Eddie's Offering Reveals the Mask
Eddie placed his plus one short sword on the pedestal, and the Hall of Blades voice answered that the thorn betrayer carried the mask through the Gate of Dragons into the Hall of Scales.
Quote: "The question we're dying to know the answer to, where is the blue dragon mask?" - Eddie (Steve)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-10: The Blade That Ate Empires - memorable quotes
- "Monarch loves the charmed condition, just, you know, not on her." - Sir Raf (Jim)
- "Man, part of me wants to see how this plays out, the other part of me doesn't." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I said this is the way Portia can revivify me when 19 fucking swords come and stab the fairy to death." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I will point out to everyone the irony that the sword that can only do slashing and bludgeoning is called spike, which is piercing." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Remember what my secret was, and then he just gave me a fucking legendary artifact." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I knew we're gonna end up the Hall of scales." - Monarch (Matt)
- "We're never getting back to Roma, are we?" - Portia (Diane)

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Puddings, Guardians and the Challenger's Chalice - summary
The party dropped down the roasting-pit chimney into the Hall of Feasts to chase a secret door seen by their familiars. They studied the mosaics and statues, then fought a black pudding and psychic gray oozes in the kitchen. Eddie's dispel magic removed the glyph on a stone door, Raf smashed it with Shatterspike, and Monarch took control of a finely made rune guardian. In the Chamber of Trials a ghostly giant challenger spoke of a chalice and was defeated with the controlled guardian's help, leaving a bronze tablet. The secret door and the brewery of leaking magical drafts remain unsolved.
Cliffhanger: The challenger is gone and left a bronze tablet etched in giant runes at Raf's feet, still unexamined. The mosaic secret door stays sealed, the brewery goo lurks, the party still seeks the chalice, and Monarch's hour with the rune guardian is running out.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Detour to the Feast Hall
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - scene 1: Detour to the Feast Hall
- Monarch explained that the Prison of the Faceless Lord is believed to lie below ground, with its entrance through the Hall of Scales.
- Monarch agreed to explore the Hall of Feasts after Raf argued they were already there, and then playfully shoved Raf toward the chimney.
- After the rope descent, Kyle described the vast banquet hall with its faded mosaics and three levels.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Mosaics, Statues and the Sealed Seam
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - scene 2: Mosaics, Statues and the Sealed Seam
- The mosaic showed the high table surrounded by guests, with a silver dragon reclining along it, and a seam in the tiles.
- Eddie read the Giant inscription and learned the statue represented the keeper of the seal.
- Raf's detect magic showed unseen-servant effects on the table and abjuration glowing on the seam.
- Monarch's Nature check identified the floating purple fruit as cloud giant sky fruit.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - The Kitchen and the Black Pudding
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - scene 3: The Kitchen and the Black Pudding
- Eddie shoved the stuck door open to reveal a kitchen with magical pantry shelves.
- Kyle called initiative as the sticky patch became a hungry black pudding.
- Raf's slashing hit split the pudding, just after Monarch warned about lightning and slashing.
- A pudding critically hit Raf with 25 acid damage.
- Monarch identified the oozes as old gray oozes with psychic abilities.
- The party killed the last of the oozes and the kitchen went quiet.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Study, Dispel and a Stubborn Wall
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - scene 4: Study, Dispel and a Stubborn Wall
- Raf and Eddie forced open a study whose shelves held only ancient common literature.
- Eddie's dispel magic ended the abjuration on the seam, but the wall still did not move.
- Raf's crowbar snapped a few tiles but moved nothing.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - The Sculptor's Workshop
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - scene 5: The Sculptor's Workshop
- Raf's Arcana check revealed an arcane lock and a defensive glyph on the stone door.
- After Eddie dispelled the glyph, Raf shattered the door with Shatterspike.
- Monarch cast the control ritual with a heightened spell and took control of the rune guardian.
- Eddie's history/religion check suggested the moss-covered stone giant in the corner clung to undeath to finish its stonework.
- Eddie spotted five 50 gp gem fragments, which Monarch noted.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Chamber of Trials and the Brewery
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - scene 6: Chamber of Trials and the Brewery
- Spectral echoes of giant and dragon battles filled the Chamber of Trials.
- A voice lamented 'none survive' and spoke of victory and the chalice, and a ghostly giant appeared.
- Raf and Eddie opened the brewery door, revealing two huge casks and leaking goo.
- Diego scouted the brewery room but found no chalice.
- Portia's owl was hit by a fire blast from the goo and saved for half damage.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - The Challenger Falls
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - scene 7: The Challenger Falls
- Raf saluted the challenger and it saluted back before the fight began.
- The challenger's howling wind pulled Raf in and dealt cold damage.
- With Monarch's very fire spell, the rune guardian hit the challenger for 61 damage.
- Raf finished the challenger, which knelt, left a bronze tablet of giant runes and vanished.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: Raf Shoved Down the Chimney
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: Raf Shoved Down the Chimney
Monarch declares that she pushes Raf into the chimney like an unwilling Santa Claus. The table runs with the image, and Raf then climbs down by rope as Monarch jokes it was a scene for the trailer.
Quote: "I was just making a scene for the trailer." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch, Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: Critical Acid Hit on Raf
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: Critical Acid Hit on Raf
In the kitchen, the tiny split black puddings prove small but mighty: one crits Sir Raf for 25 acid damage, and the acid also degrades his non-magical armor.
Quote: "Well, that's gonna be 25 acid damage." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: Dispel, Then Shatterspike Smashes the Door
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: Dispel, Then Shatterspike Smashes the Door
Eddie dispels the glyph on the rune-carved stone door, then Raf uses Shatterspike with auto-crits against objects and hacks it apart. Beyond it lies the sculptor's workshop with a finely made rune guardian.
Spotlight: Eddie, Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: Monarch Takes the Rune Guardian
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: Monarch Takes the Rune Guardian
Monarch conducts the ritual with a heightened spell, and the guardian fails its save. She names it Andy Rooney and rides it around, which causes confusion with the player Andy.
Quote: "I've named the room guardian Andy. It's for Andy Andy Rooney." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: Brewery Goo Torches the Owl
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: Brewery Goo Torches the Owl
Portia sends her owl into the brewery and a goo creature blasts it with fire. The party decides to take on the challenge in the Chamber of Trials anyway.
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: The Challenger Yields a Tablet
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Key Moment: The Challenger Yields a Tablet
Raf lands the final blow after the party and rune guardian whittle the ghostly challenger down. It kneels, lays a bronze tablet etched in giant runes at his feet, and vanishes.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-24: A Sticky Situation in the Giant Kitchen - memorable quotes
- "Like an unwilling Santa Claus." - GM (Kyle)
- "It was so dramatic, though. Was only one way to find out, and I push you in." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Infinite stocked pantries. Take notes. See if we can price some of these out for our bastions later." - Monarch (Matt)
- "It is the solution to all problems, guys." - Eddie (Steve)
- "The rune golem who I have named Andy Rooney." - Monarch (Matt)
- "If Kyle didn't want us breaking down every door, he would not have given us this item." - Monarch (Matt)
- "We can't look bad in front of the dead giants." - Lucia (Andy)

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - The Feast, the Chalice and the Living Potions - summary
The party recovered the Bronze Challenger's Tablet, rested in the Hall of Feasts kitchen, and had Raf mend the broken banquet table. They laid out the mosaic's feast, which revealed the Chalice of Accord and a spectral vision of giants and dragons quarreling. They then destroyed the living potion oozes in the brewery, siphoned the remaining potions, and set out overland for the Hall of Scales. There Diego and Dora found a Cult of the Dragon base in a cave, led by the Dreamcaster and two half dragons and guarded by a sleeping wyvern, and the party plans to long rest and strategize.
Cliffhanger: A cult war party with a saddled wyvern guards the cave to the archway, and the party must long rest and find a way to split them up.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Housekeeping and the Tablets
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - scene 1: Housekeeping and the Tablets
- Kyle confirms the party has the bronze tablet, and Matt moves items into the Roma campaign's shared inventory, including Black Razor.
- Sir Raf asks about the Graven Lexus; Kyle explains it is the stone tablet from the Tower of Runes, useful for abjuration rune rooms.
- Monarch walks the rune guardian back to its charging station.
- Eddie casts a second-level Cure Wounds for 25, lifting the bloodied Sir Raf to 45 of 53.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Long Rest in the Kitchen
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - scene 2: Long Rest in the Kitchen
- Monarch casts Clairvoyance beyond the secret door and sees a small enclosure holding an enormous crystal chalice.
- Eddie casts Detect Magic as a ritual; only the barrels and pantries are magical, conjuring ingredients.
- Sir Raf ritually casts audible alarms on the kitchen doors, covering a 20-foot cube outside.
- Nothing disturbs the long rest, and the pantries are full of food by morning.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Cooking the Giants' Feast
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - scene 3: Cooking the Giants' Feast
- Sir Raf mends the broken banquet table over a few castings.
- Sir Raf and Monarch work out the recipes; Portia and Eddie cook with assistance.
- With the last mead jar and steak knife placed, the mosaic glimmers and a panel slides aside, revealing the chalice.
- Spectral giants and metallic dragons quarrel, and a silver dragon declares that none shall pass the Gate of Dragons save by the chalice of accord raised in truth and proper form.
- Monarch rolls two natural 20s on her disadvantage Insight roll and understands the argument: giants demanded submission, dragons wanted partnership.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Studying the Tablets
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - scene 4: Studying the Tablets
- The bronze tablet details the chalice of accord ritual, an offering of humility before dragons; even plain water works, better liquids work better.
- The Graven Lexus lets the party alter the prison's rune enchantment to swap in Black Razor for the Blue Dragon mask.
- Eddie recognizes rare giant wasp honey mead and fills a waterskin.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - The Living Potions
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - scene 5: The Living Potions
- The brewery goo coalesces into giant living potions of healing, fire breath and poison.
- Monarch's lightning bolt splits two of the oozes instead of damaging them.
- Chimeg's crossbow fire finishes one split ooze.
- Monarch opens fire for 24 damage and kills the last fire breath ooze, and it explodes, burning her.
- Eddie rigs a siphon and recovers six fire breath and six greater healing potions, ruled to turn into poison if mixed.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Cross-Country to the Hall of Scales
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - scene 6: Cross-Country to the Hall of Scales
- Lucia mind-links and scouts ahead while Eddie navigates by a crude map.
- They spot medium humanoids at a cave in a rocky outcropping.
- Diego sees about 20 cultists, a blue and a white half dragon, and the Dreamcaster, plus an archway with six dragon heads.
- Dora spots a saddled, sleeping wyvern atop the outcropping.
- The party agrees to long rest before acting.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - The Mirror of the Past
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - scene 7: The Mirror of the Past
- The mirror shows the Dreamcaster in the Tower of Dreams, directing cultists from this cave, and meeting a hooded figure in Roma.
- The last vision shows him flying a wyvern beside a red dragonborn and a tiefling.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: Giants' Feast, Questionable Seasoning
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: Giants' Feast, Questionable Seasoning
Portia served as head chef and Eddie as prep cook, each helped by an assistant with advantage. The GM said the dishes looked right but did not smell or taste appetizing, and the party later agreed the giants must have different palates.
Spotlight: Portia, Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: The Feast Opens the Alcove
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: The Feast Opens the Alcove
After mending the table and laying out the mosaic's meal, the last mead jar and steak knife lock into place. The alcove opens on a giant gemstone chalice, and spectral giants and metallic dragons replay their quarrel, ending with the silver dragon's warning about the chalice of accord.
Quote: "None shall pass the gate of dragons, save by the chalice of accord, raised in truth in proper form." - GM (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: Double Twenty Without a Word
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: Double Twenty Without a Word
Monarch speaks neither giant nor draconic and rolled insight with disadvantage, yet got two natural 20s. The GM ruled that the body language made everything obvious to her, and the table reacted with shock.
Quote: "Oh, I did roll two twenties." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: Lightning Bolt Splits the Potions
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: Lightning Bolt Splits the Potions
Monarch's lightning bolt did no damage to the two living potions. They absorbed it and split in two, making the fight longer. Monarch also hit Eddie for 10 with friendly fire, and the table joked about it.
Quote: "I just wanted us to get more XP." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: Cultist Base Under the Outcropping
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: Cultist Base Under the Outcropping
Diego scouted the cave and found about 20 Dragon cultists led by a blue half dragon, a white half dragon and the Dreamcaster. Dora spotted a saddled sleeping wyvern on the rock above, and the party decided to long rest and replan.
Spotlight: Sir Raf, Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: The Mirror Shows the Dreamcaster's Past
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Key Moment: The Mirror Shows the Dreamcaster's Past
The mirror showed the Dreamcaster organizing cultist parties from this same cavern and meeting a hooded figure on the streets of Roma. It also showed him riding a wyvern beside a red dragonborn and a tiefling. The party concluded this cave is likely their command center.
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-21: Giant Feasts and Living Brews - memorable quotes
- "Coming down here was the right call. I'm glad I made it." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I'm a genius." - GM (Kyle)
- "No one thought this is gonna be a baking show challenge." - GM (Kyle)
- "It's the perfect prepper shelter." - GM (Kyle)
- "Somehow not understanding a word they're saying, it's super obvious to you what's going on." - GM (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - summary
After a long rest outside the Hall of Scales, the party lured the cult's saddled wyvern into an ambush. Portia played bait as a horse and then a jackal, Monarch grounded it with Earthbind, Eddie silenced it, and Eddie finished it with a critical rapier stab. They picked off two cultist minders, hid the corpse under Monarch's illusion, and Portia opened the cave assault with a fireball. The half blue and half white dragons and the fanatics were killed, but the Dreamcaster trapped Lucia in the wedding dream and cast mass suggestion on Monarch, Chimeg and Raf.
Cliffhanger: Monarch is fleeing toward the horses under the Dreamcaster's mass suggestion, Sir Raf and Chimeg are charmed too, Lucia is trapped in the wedding dream, and only Eddie and Portia face the unhurt Dreamcaster.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Planning the Wyvern Ambush
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - scene 1: Planning the Wyvern Ambush
- Monarch said her whole plan for the wyvern fight was to cast Earthbind and then hide.
- Kyle confirmed the party's level-up meant they had completed a long rest outside the Hall of Scales.
- Sir Raf explained the plan: draw the wyvern out so they could bushwhack it away from the cultists.
- Kyle put up a map and the party set up opposite the cave entrance in thick brush.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Portia the Bait
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - scene 2: Portia the Bait
- Lucia set up the Psychic Friends Network for everyone except Monarch, who volunteered to be left out.
- Portia, as a wounded riding horse, made a convincing performance, but the wyvern only watched her.
- Kyle reasoned the saddled wyvern had been raised from a hatchling and was probably trained not to eat horses.
- Portia switched to a jackal and the wyvern began to crouch.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - The Wyvern Fight
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - scene 3: The Wyvern Fight
- Eddie's readied longbow shot hit the wyvern and slowed it.
- The wyvern critically stung Portia the jackal for 13 piercing and 25 poison, but she survived on wild shape hit points.
- Monarch's heightened Earthbind grounded the wyvern after it rolled a 12 on its save.
- Eddie's Silence stopped the wyvern's roar and also muted Raf's booming blade thunder.
- Monarch's fire spell crit and bloodied the wyvern, which began attacking recklessly.
- Eddie landed a critical rapier hit for 33 total damage and killed the wyvern in a fountain of blood.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Rest and Bushwhack
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - scene 4: Rest and Bushwhack
- The party took a short rest so Portia could recover resources.
- Two cultist minders led horses out of the cave to graze.
- Eddie's longbow dropped the first cultist with a single shot.
- Lucia's longbow shot felled the second cultist at the cave front.
- Monarch cast Major Image to disguise the wyvern corpse as a grassy mound.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Into the Cave
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - scene 5: Into the Cave
- Portia charged to the cave mouth and saw twelve to twenty cultists and the arcane glow of the dragon gate.
- After a break, Portia threw a fireball at the back table next to the Dreamcaster, and most of the cultists failed their saves.
- The surviving cultists charged out with ritual sickles after Portia.
- Lucia killed a cultist with a 24-damage shot.
- Monarch's lightning bolt hit three cultists and a horse, and the horse survived by saving.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Half Dragons and Fanatics
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - scene 6: Half Dragons and Fanatics
- The half blue dragon charged out, threw a javelin at Monarch, and the half white dragon leaped in and clawed Monarch down for 31 total.
- Eddie healed Monarch with Cure Wounds for 24 and Lucia dragged her away.
- A fanatic cast hold person at Sir Raf and then Eddie, and both resisted.
- The half blue dragon breathed lightning on Eddie and Monarch for 18, and Eddie took 9 thanks to his lightning resistance.
- Chimeg's shots and Lucia's attack killed the half blue dragon.
- A fanatic's Halt command failed against Monarch, who made her save.
- The half white dragon breathed a frost cone for 24 cold, wiping out the remaining cultists.
- Eddie used the Guardian Emblem to turn a critical hit on Sir Raf into a normal hit.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - The Dreamcaster Strikes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - scene 7: The Dreamcaster Strikes
- Lucia vanished into the wedding dream, and Kyle said she must pass an Investigation check each turn to escape.
- Eddie's critical rapier hit killed the half white dragon.
- Lucia failed and stayed to enjoy the cake and wine.
- Chimeg took down the second fanatic.
- The Dreamcaster cast mass suggestion, and Monarch, Chimeg and Sir Raf failed their saves.
- Monarch fled ninety feet and jumped on a horse, and the session ended there.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Key Moment: Jackal Survives the Wyvern Sting
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Key Moment: Jackal Survives the Wyvern Sting
Portia, wild shaped as a jackal for bait, is hit by the wyvern's sting for 13 piercing and 25 poison but survives on temporary hit points. The wyvern bites at open air, and the party's ambush starts.
Quote: "Thank god for wild shaped temporary hippos." - Portia (Diane)
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Key Moment: Wyvern Dies in a Blood Fountain
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Key Moment: Wyvern Dies in a Blood Fountain
Eddie crits with the blood iron and adamantine rapier, passing through the Sleeping wyvern's scales to its heart for 33 damage. The GM describes a massive blood spray, and the party is amazed the plan worked so well.
Quote: "Nobody will have any misunderstandings about where the Wyvern died." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Key Moment: Fireball Opens the Cave Assault
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Key Moment: Fireball Opens the Cave Assault
After the party's bushwhack of the cultist minders goes unnoticed, Portia steps into the cave mouth and hurls a long-range fireball at the cultists and fanatic around the table. The cultists mostly fail their saves.
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Key Moment: Lucia Pulled Into the Wedding Dream
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Key Moment: Lucia Pulled Into the Wedding Dream
As the fight turns, the Dreamcaster, invisible, casts a spell and Lucia vanishes into the wedding dream. She must pass intelligence checks each turn to escape, and chooses to enjoy the cake while the fight goes on without her.
Quote: "Cake seems real. It's not a lie." - Lucia (Andy)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Key Moment: Mass Suggestion Sends Allies Fleeing
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Key Moment: Mass Suggestion Sends Allies Fleeing
The Dreamcaster misty steps into the open and casts mass suggestion. Monarch, Chimeg and Raf fail their saves and are ordered to leave and return to the con, while Portia and Eddie resist. Monarch dashes off and ends the session mounting a horse.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-05: The Wyvern, the Cave, and the Con Call - memorable quotes
- "My whole plan for the Wyvern fight is to cast Earthbind and then hide." - Monarch (Matt)
- "You do a great job of looking like a horse that should be put down." - GM (Kyle)
- "There is a massive blood spray pattern. So CSI will have a field day with this." - GM (Kyle)
- "I think it might be a good time to have a fireball show up in the middle of their plan." - Eddie (Steve)
- "I think it's a Leroy Jenkins." - Portia (Diane)
- "You have skewered one fairy." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I'm gonna eat cake and drink wine." - Lucia (Andy)

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - summary
Eddie dispelled the Dreamcaster's mass suggestion from Chimeg, while Monarch's Earthbind grounded the fleeing cult leader. After a psychic blast that killed horses, Chimeg and Portia brought him down for good, and the party looted his gems, obsidian coins and magical pouch of sand. Following a long rest, Monarch performed the Chalice of Accord ritual to open the portal. The party faced the silver and blue dragon apparitions' question of wisdom or power, crossed a slime-filled crevasse on Eddie's new dragon wings, and reached the blue dragon mask over the Faceless Lord's pit. They planned the Black Razor swap and stopped before executing it.
Cliffhanger: Standing before the pit of the Faceless Lord with the blue dragon mask floating over it, the party has a plan to swap in Black Razor but chose to wait, ideally for Lucia.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Breaking the Suggestion
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - scene 1: Breaking the Suggestion
- Eddie cast Dispel Magic to wake Chimeg from the Dreamcaster's mass suggestion; his check failed, so he spent heroic inspiration on a reroll.
- Chimeg shook her head and nodded in acknowledgment that the spell had made a difference.
- Raf began gathering the cultists' horses by their leads and asked Portia to help.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - The Dreamcaster Flees
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - scene 2: The Dreamcaster Flees
- The Dreamcaster used Misty Step, then cast Fly and took off over the trees; Lucia returned from her dream because Fly requires concentration.
- Monarch cast Earthbind (DC 16) from above the canopy; he failed the save and sank to the ground.
- Enraged, he unleashed psychic energy that forced Intelligence saves; Eddie failed and was left with muddled thoughts, while Portia and Chimeg saved.
- Horses that failed their saves dropped dead; the two that rolled twenties survived bloodied.
- Chimeg's crossbow bolts, following Portia's Fire Bolt, felled the Dreamcaster.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Loot and Rest
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - scene 3: Loot and Rest
- Portia looted the Dreamcaster's amulet, 14 gems worth 500 gp each, coins, three obsidian coins and a pouch of sand.
- Eddie confirmed suggestion counts as charmed and used Twilight Sanctuary to free the others.
- The Dreamcaster's notes showed the cult had no answer to the portal and did not know the mask was part of anything else.
- Monarch examined Black Razor during her rest, then took 6 necrotic damage putting it away.
- Raf's History check linked the five-headed dragon coins to Tiamat and to favors owed by the cult.
- The party finished a long rest; Eddie dreamed of leading an army of skeletons.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - The Chalice of Accord
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - scene 4: The Chalice of Accord
- Monarch performed the ritual with Guidance and Tides of Chaos, rolling a 22.
- The wasp mead boiled into steam that split into six tendrils into the dragon heads; the purple energy vanished and a dark tunnel opened.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Scales and Dragons
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - scene 5: Scales and Dragons
- The party walked down a 30-foot tunnel of non-living, multicolored scales pulsing silver and blue.
- Eddie learned fragments of the great debate between metallic and chromatic dragons over whether giants should wield draconic power.
- Silver and blue dragon apparitions formed, frightening Portia and Monarch.
- The dragons asked: wisdom that binds or power that dominates?
- After all answered wisdom, the blue dragon's thunder faded, the silver dragon healed the party for 35 and a passage opened.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - The Slime Crevasse
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - scene 6: The Slime Crevasse
- The scales gave way to slimy stone, and the Faceless Lord's nature was recalled.
- A 60-foot crevasse of ooze with drifting bones blocked the passage.
- Portia sensed the ooze as a pained, hungry, trapped colony and calmed it with empathy.
- Tiamat's dream voice offered passage on her wings; Eddie spoke her name and sprouted dragon wings while Hades watched.
- Monarch enlarged Eddie, who carried everyone across.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - The Prison Pit
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - scene 7: The Prison Pit
- The party reached a cavern of ten dragon statues around a pit of ooze under a web of runes, with the blue dragon mask floating in the center.
- A gurgling voice offered Monarch power in chaos; she refused.
- Raf's Arcana 27 revealed the swap needs three simultaneous Arcana checks, twice.
- Eddie's augury read swapping Black Razor for the mask as wheel and adding it while leaving the mask as wheel then woe.
- The party made a plan but chose to leave the swap for next session.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: Dispel Magic Frees Chimeg
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: Dispel Magic Frees Chimeg
Eddie cast dispel magic on Chimeg after a spent heroic inspiration to avoid a repeat of last time's double ones. The roll was enough to dispel the Dreamcaster's suggestion, and Chimeg nodded in acknowledgment. Monarch later crowned him the fight's MVP.
Quote: "The MVP of that fight was fucking Eddie, by the way, with the dispel magic with the dispel magic on Chimeg." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: The Dreamcaster Falls
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: The Dreamcaster Falls
Chimeg's crossbow bolts, following Portia's Fire Bolt, hit the fleeing Dreamcaster in the back and then the front, and he dropped. This ended the pursuit after his psychic blasts killed horses and nearly dropped Portia.
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: Twilight Sanctuary Breaks the Suggestion
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: Twilight Sanctuary Breaks the Suggestion
Eddie realized his Twilight Sanctuary could end charm effects. Since suggestion imposes the charmed condition, the GM ruled it lifted the suggestion from the party. Monarch joked that his MVP status was revoked for not thinking of it sooner.
Quote: "You could have done that the whole time? MVP revoked." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: Monarch Opens the Dragon Gate
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: Monarch Opens the Dragon Gate
Monarch performed the Chalice of Accord ritual. With Eddie's guidance and Tides of Chaos advantage she rolled 22. The mead boiled into steam that flowed into the six dragon heads, and the portal opened onto a tunnel.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: Eddie Speaks Tiamat's Name
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: Eddie Speaks Tiamat's Name
A voice in Eddie's head offered to convey the marked and chosen on Tiamat's wings if he spoke her name, while Hades watched. Eddie said "Tiamat" and grew dragon wings, then ferried the party across the crevasse. The mark on his back now glowed blue, and he felt disappointment and disconnection.
Quote: "I chose unwisely." - Eddie (Steve)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: Augury Names Tiamat's Voice
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Key Moment: Augury Names Tiamat's Voice
Eddie used augury on the mask swap, and the omens were wheel then woe for adding Black Razor and leaving the mask. His wisdom check revealed the entity answering was the same one who gave him the wings, which the party deferred to a later long rest.
Quote: "That's tomorrow me problem." - Eddie (Steve)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-19: Wheel Then Woe - memorable quotes
- "Does not like me. Hey. Do I have a heroic inspiration?" - Eddie (Steve)
- "You could have done that the whole time? MVP revoked." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Diane's casting wall of horse flesh." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Hey, guys. I'm gonna speak the name and get conveyed on somebody's wings." - Eddie (Steve)
- "I chose unwisely." - Eddie (Steve)
- "It's a terrible plan, but it just might work." - Eddie (Steve)
- "It's the best plan." - Eddie (Steve)

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - A Warden with a Will of Its Own - summary
The party finished the Prison of the Faceless Lord. Sir Raf, using the Graven Lexus, installed Black Razor in the rune web and Monarch pulled out the blue dragon mask, after a long series of Arcana checks, and then the group fled the ruins. Back at the Azure Sky camp, Simona asked Portia for help against the Senate vote on the Groves of Belenus. After identifying the mask and saying goodbye to the Khan, they returned to Roma, which is full of soldiers and giants. The session ended with Monarch, disguised as Myla Brightfellow, hired by Senator Valeria, who is pushing the Grove measure as part of a drive to regulate wild magic.
Cliffhanger: Monarch, disguised as Myla Brightfellow, now works for Senator Valeria, who is orchestrating the Grove measure as part of a campaign to tightly constrain druidic and wild magic, with about three weeks until the vote.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Planning the Swap
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - scene 1: Planning the Swap
- Monarch asked whether the Graven Lexus's +5 Arcana bonus could be shared; the GM ruled it could be passed around but not used by two people at once.
- The GM explained the stakes: if the swapper fails the mask stays bound or Black Razor goes uninstalled, but if the web-holders fail after the mask is out, the prism could break.
- Monarch proposed installing Black Razor first and then extracting the mask to minimize the risk.
- Sir Raf volunteered to do the swap since he had done the math. Eddie prepared guidance for Portia and Raf cast Protection from Evil and Good.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - The Rune Web
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - scene 2: The Rune Web
- A gold dragon spirit appeared and warned that Black Razor would turn the prison into a warden with a will of its own, stronger but not passive.
- After rerolls, heroic inspiration and Monarch's bend luck, Black Razor was installed, but the web began unraveling and the party fought through many rounds of Arcana checks.
- The web stabilized, turned black and pressed the chaos back into the pit, and the party felt a sudden hunger.
- The mask was pulled free; two natural 20s closed the final contact points, and Raf dropped the mask into Monarch's Bag of Holding.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Fleeing the Dark
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - scene 3: Fleeing the Dark
- A pseudopod lashed Monarch for 19 acid damage, leaving a festering mark, and Eddie cast cure wounds.
- Portia wild-shaped into a horse and ferried Lucia and Eddie across the narrowed chasm.
- Eddie wrote a warning in Common, Draconic and Giant above the portal: through it lies death.
- The party led the captured horses out through the forest, where the land was softening into a dark bog.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Hunger, Dreams and Atonement
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - scene 4: Hunger, Dreams and Atonement
- The group ate far more than usual; Monarch needed four times as much.
- Eddie prepared Remove Curse and Animate Dead and planned an atonement to Hades.
- Monarch dreamed of a featureless face and the words 'Chaos is power', which the GM framed as an offer of patronage; Remove Curse did not change her mark.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Report to the Khan and the Mask
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - scene 5: Report to the Khan and the Mask
- Back at the Azure Sky camp, the party gave the Khan their report and showed the cult coin.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Simona's Plea
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - scene 6: Simona's Plea
- Simona laid out three avenues against the Senate vote on the Groves: corrupt senators, poison-hungry guilds, and discrediting Magnus Marvad.
- She said a fragment of the world tree's root lies beneath the Grove, with mining nearby.
- Sir Raf cast Identify on the blue dragon mask and the GM listed its powers; the party decided to keep it hidden.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - News and Farewells
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - scene 7: News and Farewells
- Raf learned of increased militarization of Roma over a Norge raid threat.
- Lucia's mirror showed the Khan arguing with House Mazaali members and losing a Colosseum duel to a House Marvad woman.
- Lucia said farewell to the Khan, who said he would look her up in Roma regardless.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Return to Roma
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - scene 8: Return to Roma
- The party returned to Roma by ship with Simona, finding roughly double the soldiers and triple the giants.
- The Grove alchemists showed a potion that turns a liar's tongue black.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - The Wreath & Lion
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - scene 9: The Wreath & Lion
- The party chose the Wreath & Lion tavern near the Senate as the place to gather information.
- Monarch, disguised as Myla Brightfellow, impressed Senator Valeria and was hired as her assistant.
- Monarch learned Valeria is orchestrating the Grove measure as part of a campaign to restrict druidic and wild magic.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: Warden With a Will
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: Warden With a Will
As the group offers Black Razor, the Golden Dragon Spirit warns the swap will turn the unthinking prison into a warden with a will of its own, stronger but not passive. It says it cannot intervene and fades, and the party goes ahead anyway.
Quote: "Make this unthinking prison into a warden with a will of its own. It will be stronger, but not passive." - Golden Dragon Spirit (Kyle)
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: Two Nat 20s Seal the Web
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: Two Nat 20s Seal the Web
After many rounds of failing and recovering Arcana checks, two critical successes from the party close the rune web around the removed mask. Black Razor's darkness spreads through the prison and the group suddenly feels ravenously hungry.
Quote: "With two critical successes, like, barely holding it together, the last round of the guidance, you finally connect the dots" - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Sir Raf, Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: Eddie's Disappointed God
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: Eddie's Disappointed God
Eddie names Tiamat instead of the intended dragon deity in the dark, and Hades responds with deep disappointment rather than abandonment. Eddie still receives his prepared spells and resolves he will need to atone.
Quote: "I'm thinking I should do an atonement." - Eddie (Steve)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: Monarch's Offer of Patronage
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: Monarch's Offer of Patronage
Jubilex's pseudopod left a strange, still-sticky mark on Monarch's leg. During the long rest she dreamed of a featureless face and followed by oozes in the Feywild halls, hearing 'Chaos is power.' Kyle framed it as an offer of patronage, and Eddie's remove curse changed nothing about the mark.
Quote: "Chaos is power. When you wear the crown of every ambition unfulfilled, none can stand before you." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: The Blue Dragon Mask Revealed
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: The Blue Dragon Mask Revealed
Raf's identify shows the mask grants lightning resistance, legendary resistance, and more, and history says each is made from a scale of Tiamat. Dragon Cultists and nations would covet it, so the party decides to keep it hidden in a bag of holding.
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: Monarch Joins Senator Valeria
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Key Moment: Monarch Joins Senator Valeria
Monarch, disguised via alter self, slides into an argument and rescues Senator Valeria in front of a rival, impressing her into hiring 'Myla Brightfellow.' She learns Valeria is driving the Groves measure as part of a campaign to tighten regulation of wild magic.
Quote: "My name is Myla Brightfellow. Hi, Valeria. Happy to be assistance to you in this moment and in the future." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-02: The Hunger and the Halls of Power - memorable quotes
- "Destroying the world." - Monarch (Matt)
- "I have absolute faith that we are gonna pull this off first try." - Monarch (Matt)
- "maybe a strict warden who wants to eat you, but a warden nonetheless." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Through this portal lies death. Just, you know, to warn the next guy." - Eddie (Steve)
- "It was the land shark. Exactly. Yeah. Just don't tell them we lost them." - Monarch (Matt)
- "We started out the session grieving an artifact from the prison of a world destroying entity, and we end arguing over how pages dressed in the senate." - GM (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - summary
With the Groves annexation bill leading by 25 votes, the party split up to learn why each giant senator backs it. Sir Raf got a perimeter job at the Palace of Fire, Eddie joined a squad at the Palace of Frost, and Portia, as a spider, slipped into the Senate archives after Monarch distracted the clerk. Armed with the senators' motives, the party struck conditional deals with the hill giant Rogrun, who gets monthly Groves meals, and the stone giant Lapis, who may restore the Great Henge, both only if they vote no. As they left the Stone Palace, a frost giant muscle squad headed straight for Eddie.
Cliffhanger: Leaving the Stone Palace, Eddie spots one of the frost giant's muscle squads making a beeline for the party, and nobody knows what they want.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Previously on: Game of Votes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - scene 1: Previously on: Game of Votes
- Kyle recaps that Monarch is now junior assistant to Senator Valeria Calvus, and she rolls Insight 17 to size up the vote.
- The bill is winning by 25 votes; eleven persuadable senators hold 22 votes, and a flipped vote counts double.
- The six giant senators carry 2 to 4 votes each by size, and none of them sponsored the bill.
- Raf's History 18 reveals the giant senators' reputations: Brontus, Kaldrina, Borluss, Vaelthira, Rogrun and Azirah.
- Kyle explains that the sponsor Magnus is of House Marvad, and his bloc usually carries every vote, so a narrow margin means real resistance.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Planning the Heists
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - scene 2: Planning the Heists
- Kyle reminds Lucia that Magnus's son was in the carriage with her, so Magnus or his people would recognize her.
- Raf plans to use his Kenegal connections to get hired at a giant's estate.
- The party debates a forged missive in illusory script, and Kyle rules the forger needs the sender's style and a scribe's hand.
- Portia's Wild Shape forms are rat and frog, and she hopes to swap one for a spider so she can sneak into the archives.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Job Interviews at the Giant Palaces
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - scene 3: Job Interviews at the Giant Palaces
- Raf, advised over the psychic link, passes the culture-fit check and takes 14 on his deception roll.
- Raf's Chromatic Orb blasts through the Palace of Fire interviewer's heavy armor, and he then dodges a fire giant's swings and banks the other off his Sentinel Shield.
- Hired as a perimeter guard, Raf learns Kaldrina fears the Groves as an avenue for invasion.
- Eddie lands a bow shot, a Guiding Bolt and a Cure Wounds at the Palace of Frost and gets hired.
- Eddie learns that Senator Vaelthira wants senate backing to petition the emperor for a war on Norge, and Magnus supports it but has stalled it.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - The Spider in the Library
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - scene 4: The Spider in the Library
- Monarch, rolling Deception 12, draws the archive clerk's suspicion while Portia the spider rolls a 20 on Stealth and slips in.
- Portia finds the earlier drafts of the bill, now stripped to one line putting the Groves under the consul.
- Portia reports each senator's motives, including Valeria Calvus, Cerro, Volpus, Octavia, Brontus, Kaldrina, Borluss, Rogrun and Azirah.
- Portia also finds samples of Magnus's handwriting and writing style for the forgery plan.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Strategy: Henge, Academy, and Meals
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - scene 5: Strategy: Henge, Academy, and Meals
- Portia proposes restoring the Great Henge and a druidic academy as an alternative to annexation.
- The Groves approve the henge idea.
- Kyle rules Simona can write letters of introduction to any senator.
- The party plans a monthly Groves of Belenus meal box for the hill giant.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - The Palace of the Hills
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - scene 6: The Palace of the Hills
- Ogres guard the hole-in-the-hill palace and settle who escorts the party by rock-paper-scissors.
- Monarch pitches Rogrun a monthly meal of Groves delicacies if he votes against.
- Portia pours the giant wasp wine toast, which grants advantage on the persuasion check.
- Rogrun will only sign a conditional paper, but Insight shows he intends to vote no.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - The Silent Stone Palace
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - scene 7: The Silent Stone Palace
- A talking boulder checks Portia's papers and the stone doors open.
- Simona's name admits them to the silent hall of giants.
- Monarch offers Senator Lapis the henge restoration if he votes no, after using Tides of Chaos on her roll.
- After a long silence, Lapis agrees, signs the contract and says nothing more.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Trouble on the Street
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - scene 8: Trouble on the Street
- Leaving the estate, Eddie recognizes one of the frost giant's muscle groups heading straight toward the party.
- Kyle ends the session on that note.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: Weighing Giants: Votes by Size
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: Weighing Giants: Votes by Size
Kyle laid out the vote math: the Annexation bill leads by 25, the six giant senators carry two to four votes each by size, and flipping one vote counts double. The table realized they had to turn giants, and Monarch noted that no one flips unless giants do.
Quote: "We have to flip some Giants" - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: Raf Fireballs His Way Onto the Fence
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: Raf Fireballs His Way Onto the Fence
Sir Raf, coached over Lucia's psychic link, passed the Palace of Fire interview. He spent heroic inspiration to land a chromatic orb through a fire giant's armor and dodged and shield-blocked its punches. He got only perimeter duty, and from it learned Kaldrina sees the Groves as a security risk.
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: Eddie Joins the Frost Giant's Dirty Squad
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: Eddie Joins the Frost Giant's Dirty Squad
Eddie impressed the Palace of Frost with arrow, guiding bolt and healing, then was placed on a patrol that sabotages Vaelthira's rivals. He learned she cares nothing for the Groves and wants Magnus's backing for a petition to invade Norge.
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: The Spider in the Library
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: The Spider in the Library
Monarch's weird behavior and uneaten muffin drew the clerk's eye while Portia, as a spider, slipped past on a natural 20. Portia stayed until night and read the senate debates, learning every giant senator's motive and finding Magnus's handwriting samples.
Spotlight: Portia, Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: Hill Giant Takes the Wine Deal
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: Hill Giant Takes the Wine Deal
At the Palace of the Hills the party toasted with giant wasp wine. Monarch pitched a monthly Groves meal, and Rogrun signed only a conditional promise on paper, binding nothing unless he votes no. Insight checks suggested he intends to vote against anyway.
Quote: "vote means paper you have to obey. No vote means no paper you have to obey." - Senator Rogrun (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: Silent Stone Giant Signs Henge Deal
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Key Moment: Silent Stone Giant Signs Henge Deal
In the eerily silent Palace of Stone, Monarch rerolled a failed persuasion with tides of chaos and offered Lapis the chance to restore the Great Henge if he votes no. After minutes of silence he agreed, signing the contract wordlessly.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-16: Votes, Spiders, and Hill Giant Dinners - memorable quotes
- "Nobody voted for that seat. This is the imperium. This is the democracy." - GM (Kyle)
- "It is expressly a vote by weight system." - GM (Kyle)
- "All we gotta do is kidnap 23 senators and hold them past the vote." - GM (Kyle)
- "Real halfling would have just left the wrapper." - GM (Kyle)
- "It's the druid meal of the month club. Yes. Absolutely." - Monarch (Matt)
- "And then they turn to each other, and they go one, two, three, and then they either punch, stab, or kick each other. You know, it's rock, paper, scissors." - GM (Kyle)
- "No vote means no paper you have to obey." - Rogrun (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - The Devil in a Toga - summary
Eddie and Monarch talked their way past Senator Vaelthira's frost giant thugs, then the party split up to work out why the frost giant senator backs the Groves bill. They learned she only wants Magnus to bring her Norge war petition to the floor, and Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus, who opposes that petition, agreed to make Magnus pull it. The Green Apothecary offered binding oaths that lapse if the Groves are annexed, and Portia used them to win over the frost giant, the fire giant Kaldrina, Octavia and Calvus. The party now expects to win the vote by one, but the day ends with Northern sails sighted in the harbor.
Cliffhanger: With the Groves vote two days away and the party counting a one-vote win, runners announce Northern sails in the Northern Harbor.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Thugs in the Plaza
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - scene 1: Thugs in the Plaza
- Eddie recognized Julia the glacier's frost giant squad by face and went to say hello.
- Krug did not recognize Eddie, and Gillygully's roll of 11 gave no sign of recognition or extra aggression.
- Monarch subtly cast Charm Person on Julia while Sir Raf stepped up beside Eddie to share the risk and mask her casting.
- Monarch flipped Julia a gold piece for drinks, and the squad let the party go.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - What the Frost Giant Wants
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - scene 2: What the Frost Giant Wants
- The GM explained that Senator Vaelthira wants the Norge petition brought to the floor and only backs the Groves bill because Magnus promised to do that.
- The party split in two: Monarch and Portia went to Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus, while Eddie, Raf and Lucia went to the frost giant.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Calvus Speaks Her Mind
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - scene 3: Calvus Speaks Her Mind
- Disguised as a halfling, Monarch learned that Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus thinks the Norge petition is a waste and dangerous to the empire.
- Portia rolled a 19 on Insight and read Calvus as sincere, so she does not want the petition on the floor at all.
- Calvus gave Monarch sealed missives to deliver to two senators.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - The Hall of Frost
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - scene 4: The Hall of Frost
- The party found the Hall of Frost full of siege weapons, war maps and a camp of troops, and overheard plans for forced conscription.
- Eddie apologized in Giant, and Lucia said Magnus was tricking the senator, but she demanded proof.
- The senator allowed them leave to visit other senators, though she would punish any who flipped their votes.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Planning at the Tea Shop
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - scene 5: Planning at the Tea Shop
- The GM laid out what each senator wants, including Kaldrina's security worries.
- They settled on three approaches: address concerns, drive a wedge, and find evidence of Magnus's betrayal.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Oaths of the Green Apothecary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - scene 6: Oaths of the Green Apothecary
- The Green Apothecary proposed binding oaths such as guarded teleports, an open exchange area and monthly reports of magic above third rank.
- The oaths were made conditional, lapsing if the Groves are annexed.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Driving the Wedge
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - scene 7: Driving the Wedge
- Eddie told Calvus that Magnus was bringing the petition, and she decided to make him withdraw it.
- Monarch saw Calvus's note 'Magnus to pull petition', crossed off.
- The frost giant senator said she would abstain, and the Hall of Frost's war planning had cooled.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Votes Flipped
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - scene 8: Votes Flipped
- The druids offered to open tree-doors to Norge for the frost giant's spies in exchange for independence.
- Portia presented the oath, and the frost giant senator agreed to vote against annexation.
- Raf's pitch got Portia an audience, and Kaldrina agreed to vote no after one extra oath on teleport law.
- Portia flipped Octavia and Calvus, leaving the party expecting to win by one.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Sails on the Horizon
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - scene 9: Sails on the Horizon
- At the Golden Leaf, runners announced Northern sails sighted in the Northern Harbor.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Charmed Goliath Sends Thugs to a Tavern
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Charmed Goliath Sends Thugs to a Tavern
Monarch used a subtle charm person on Julia the Glacier and talked her into a later pickup, while Julia pointedly warned her giants to ignore it. Monarch flipped her a gold piece for drinks, and Julia pointed the squad at a tavern that owed protection money.
Quote: "I'm gonna flip a gold piece towards her and say, the drinks are on me." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Lucia Bluffs the Frost Giant
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Lucia Bluffs the Frost Giant
With Eddie's enhance ability on her charisma, Lucia claimed they had overheard Magnus break his promises, and boosted her deception with a psychic die. Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu didn't demand blood, but wanted proof, and the party got leave to keep visiting senators.
Quote: "We don't like to advertise our not so glorious ways of gathering information." - Lucia (Andy)
Spotlight: Lucia, Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Druids Offer Binding Oaths
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Druids Offer Binding Oaths
Instead of accepting giant oversight, the Green Apothecary proposed magically binding oaths on teleport access and reporting of high-level magic. The oaths lapse if the Groves are annexed, so the senators' votes become a choice.
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Calvus Makes Magnus Pull the Petition
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Calvus Makes Magnus Pull the Petition
Eddie, covered by Monarch's introduction, told Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus that Magnus was bringing Vaelthira's war petition to the floor, and she resolved to make him drop it. Monarch later spotted a crossed-off note reading Magnus to pull petition, and Vaelthira soon said she would abstain.
Spotlight: Eddie, Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Frost Giant Takes the Oath
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Frost Giant Takes the Oath
Portia, in her finest silks and with Eddie's enhance ability, offered Vaelthira the druids' tree-door service for spying on Norge in exchange for independence. Vaelthira accepted the oath and promised to vote against annexation, with agents coming three days after the vote.
Quote: "This is fair. You have my word. In exchange for this oath, I will vote against the annexation." - Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu (Kyle)
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Northern Sails in the Harbor
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Key Moment: Northern Sails in the Harbor
Just as the party celebrated a one-vote lead at the Golden Leaf Tavern, runners shouted that Northern sails had been sighted in the harbor. The cliffhanger left the vote and the Norge threat colliding.
Quote: "Sails. Northern sails. They've been seen in the Northern Harbor." - GM (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-30: A Web of Senators and Sudden Sails - memorable quotes
- "But it's monarch. Monarch's always up to something." - Sir Raf (Jim)
- "You might need the constitution later, but charisma on Lucia." - Eddie (Steve)

- "Three survived audiences with the Frost Giant. Whoo." - GM (Kyle)
- "Oh, don't start thinking like a frost giant." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - summary
With Nord sails sighted in Emperor's Bay and the Groves vote still looming, the party split its efforts: Portia won grudging terms from the visiting druid Tessa Oakmere for moving scouts through the trees, and Eddie, Lucia and Sir Raf offered themselves to Vaelthira as freelance scouts. Vaelthira accepted without giving orders and pointed them to her spymaster Rowan, whose lead about a bronze dragon led the party to a House Ventre teleport to White Crown. There Mirel Kellenor hired them to rescue her friend Debbie, shipwrecked on Najik. The party sailed aboard the Wave Mount and, at dawn, a bronze dragon burst from the sea and dove at the ship.
Cliffhanger: At dawn on a strangely calm Emperor's Bay, a bronze dragon bursts from the water and dives straight at the Wave Mount, with the bribe still below decks.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - The Threat in the Bay
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - scene 1: The Threat in the Bay
- Kyle lays out the geography of Emperor's Bay, Northreach Citadel and White Crown, and why the dredged bay and the Great Canal are the real worry.
- Reports say Nord sails have been seen in Emperor's Bay, with the Senate vote only a couple of days off.
- The party realizes why the fire giant senator feared transport through plants: an army in the forest could vanish and reappear outside Roma.
- Monarch proposes a two-pronged plan: druids for transport, and Vaelthira for a strike team.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - The Druid Under the Elder Tree
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - scene 2: The Druid Under the Elder Tree
- Kyle reveals the only druid who knows the spell is the visiting Tessa Oakmere, who is not part of the elders' council.
- Tessa finishes helping a newly awakened elder tree and turns to the party.
- Tessa prefers the fight on the coast, since nature will suffer wherever the battles take place.
- Tessa agrees to move scouts and forward observers, but no pyrotechnics, powerful casters or large forces.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Vaelthira's War Room
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - scene 3: Vaelthira's War Room
- Eddie's Enhance Ability gets the party past the guards, since the DC is only 10, but they must wait.
- Sir Raf, with a natural 20, sees that every plan on the tables is offensive: ambushes, hammer-and-anvil in the farmland, naval and canal battles.
- Lucia pitches the Groves as an asset and the party as scouts; she rolls 22 and Vaelthira accepts.
- Vaelthira makes them unpaid freelancers and sends their sendings to her spymaster Rowan.
- Rowan wants ship counts and types and any landings made, and notes Northreach is oddly not reporting.
- Rowan mentions a possible bronze dragon in the bay and Mirel Kellenor's search for help.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Preparations in Roma
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - scene 4: Preparations in Roma
- Monarch checks the vote: it is on track, business is undisturbed, and it is a day and a half away.
- Monarch researches Norge ships with a 21 and learns of longships, knarrs and shore boats.
- Sir Raf is turned away from Senator Kaldrina's palace despite Enhance Ability.
- Azuriel arranges a House Ventre teleport to White Crown and a way back.
- Sir Raf says he will look for a mariner's breastplate while the table settles magic item prices.
- Monarch says she is buying a ring of swimming.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - White Crown and the Smiling Fish
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - scene 5: White Crown and the Smiling Fish
- The party arrives in White Crown's cold teleportation room and learns Mirel Kellenor works from the Smiling Fish.
- Kyle describes the austere, martial port city under dark clouds.
- Mirel receives them on the mezzanine with grilled fish and wine.
- She asks them to rescue her friend Debbie from Najik, where a bronze dragon sank her ship, for 2,000 gp plus 250 per sailor.
- She also offers a 10 percent finder's fee on recovered cargo worth nearly 100,000 gold.
- The history check reveals Golcondra's anger perpetuates the Sea of Storms, which explains the cold.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Aboard the Wave Mount
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - scene 6: Aboard the Wave Mount
- Monarch hails Captain Orso and the party boards.
- Orso reports 20 to 40 lightly loaded Norge longships and keeps a gold bribe ready for the dragon.
- Portia casts Water Breathing as a ritual.
- The party wakes to an unnaturally calm sea, and Eddie spots the white cliffs of Najik.
- A bronze dragon erupts from the water and dives at the ship.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: Tessa's Terms: Scouts Yes, Pyrotechnics No
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: Tessa's Terms: Scouts Yes, Pyrotechnics No
Portia pleaded the party's case to the visiting druid Tessa Oakmere, who weighed the forest against the giants' firepower. She agreed to move small scout groups but drew a hard line at artillery, flamethrowers and arcane pyrotechnics, and wanted the fight kept on the shore.
Quote: "I would draw the line at weapons of war that include pyrotechnics, powerful arcane spellcasters, those sorts." - Tessa Oakmere (Kyle)
Spotlight: Portia

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: Raf Reads the War Room
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: Raf Reads the War Room
With a natural 20, Sir Raf studied the frost giants' planning tables and saw that every plan was an offensive ambush, with no static defenses at all. Eddie's persuasion check got the party past the guards and into the camp.
Quote: "Best defense is a good offense seems to be their line of thinking." - Sir Raf (Jim)
Spotlight: Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: Freelancers Below the Coffee Guy
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: Freelancers Below the Coffee Guy
Vaelthira accepted the party's offer of scouting, but only as unpaid freelancers who take no orders and are tied to Rowan, a spymaster only just above the coffee guy. Eddie's and Raf's insight reads showed how little credit she was giving them, and the party joked about it.
Quote: "We'll give you no orders so we don't have to count on you." - Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu (Kyle)
Spotlight: Eddie, Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: Rowan's Bronze Dragon Gamble
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: Rowan's Bronze Dragon Gamble
Rowan privately pointed the party toward Mirel Kellenor's search for help involving a bronze dragon. A small team could delay the Norge fleet and win the shore fight Tessa wanted, a long shot Vaelthira would not fund.
Quote: "you're a small bet for a possibly very large payoff." - Rowan (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: The Job: Rescue Debbie from Najik
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: The Job: Rescue Debbie from Najik
At the Smiling Fish, Merrill hired the party to bring home her friend Debbie, a priest shipwrecked on Najik by a bronze dragon. She offered 2,000 gold, bonuses per sailor and a chest of gold to bribe the dragon. Monarch asked about the cargo and the party took the job.
Spotlight: Monarch, Sir Raf

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: The Dragon Bursts From the Sea
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Key Moment: The Dragon Bursts From the Sea
After Eddie's sharp-eyed spyglass check spotted Najik through the fog, the calm sea erupted and a bronze dragon rose, circled the Wave Mount and dove straight at the ship. The session ended on that cliffhanger.
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-14: The Dragon Over Emperor's Bay - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:

- "The British are coming. The British are coming." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - summary
The party's sea trip to Najik turned into a running fight when a bronze dragon exploded out of the water. It blasted the Wave Mount with lightning and shoved everyone overboard with a force roar. Despite Lucia, Portia, Monarch and Sir Raf all trying to talk it down, the dragon would not listen, so the party wounded it with Earthbind, Mind Whip and a flurry of attacks until it fled into the deep. They rowed lifeboats to the Najik monastery, where the monks asked for help removing a wanted murderer, Ronnom, and the party found Debbie and the other survivors. After deciding to rest and then arrest Ronnom, they crept down to the lower level and found his bodyguards, the twins Eko and Mok, playing cards, and Monarch cast Charm Person.
Cliffhanger: In a lower-level bedroom of the Najik monastery, Monarch has just cast Charm Person on the unarmed twin bodyguards Eko and Mok, who laugh it off as immune to charm, while Ronnom and the dangerous Veen are somewhere nearby.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - The Dragon Rises
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - scene 1: The Dragon Rises
- Portia considers Tidal Wave to push the ship away but finds it only affects creatures and does nothing for the boat.
- Portia casts Call Lightning as a warning shot into the water between the ship and the dragon.
- Lucia pleads with the great bronze dragon to talk first, and the dragon shouts 'be gone from this place'.
- The dragon's force roar knocks everyone except Lucia and Portia overboard, along with Captain Orso and the sailors.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Overboard and Under Fire
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - scene 2: Overboard and Under Fire
- Sir Raf relies on his mariner's armor to swim, checks on Captain Orso and casts Blade Ward.
- Monarch casts major image of the tribute box so the dragon can see treasure.
- Lucia releases the anchor chain to stop the ship.
- The dragon lightning-blasts the ship for 50 damage.
- Monarch casts Earthbind on the dragon and drops it into the water.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Fighting Beneath the Waves
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - scene 3: Fighting Beneath the Waves
- The dragon rams and claws the ship below the waterline.
- Monarch sends Message and the dragon replies 'I do not fear your kind'.
- Portia hits the dragon with Ray of Frost.
- Lucia sneaks to the railing and strikes for 19.
- The dragon blasts the hull with 45 lightning damage.
- A breath weapon launches Eddie, Raf and Monarch out of the water.
- Lucia offers herself as a hostage but the dragon says it is done with them all and dives out of sight.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Patching the Ship

Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - scene 4: Patching the Ship

- Lucia stows the 45-pound tribute chest in her Bag of Holding.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - The Monastery of Goats

Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - scene 5: The Monastery of Goats

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - The Survivors

Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - scene 6: The Survivors

Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - scene 7: Serving the Warrant

- They find a storeroom with a silver-tipped spear.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Key Moment: Warning Shot Lightning
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Key Moment: Warning Shot Lightning
Portia called lightning to crash into the water between the ship and the dragon as an intimidation tactic. The GM admitted feeling bad, since bronze dragons love lightning, and the table joked that she'd learned a lesson.
