chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Key Moment: Be Gone: The Dragon's Roar
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Key Moment: Be Gone: The Dragon's Roar
After the party's persuasion attempts, the bronze dragon swooped down and its shouted 'be gone' became a force roar. It shoved nearly everyone, including Captain Orso, into the sea without dealing damage.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Key Moment: Lucia Offers Herself as Hostage
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Key Moment: Lucia Offers Herself as Hostage
Diving after the fleeing dragon, Lucia offered to go with it as a hostage or be killed in its lair if it would only stop the fighting. The dragon answered that it was done with all of them and disappeared into the depths.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Key Moment: Sir Raf Claims the Warrant
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Key Moment: Sir Raf Claims the Warrant

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Key Moment: The Coin in the Door

Session 2026-01-11: Be Gone From This Place - Key Moment: The Coin in the Door

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - summary
The session opened with a flashback vignette in the Feywild. Monarch played Mona, a pre-level 1 younger version of her own character, a teenage fey student exiled by Queen Titania after a necrotic accident, while Portia proved to be a reflection of the archfey Aurelia. Lucia and Eddie played the fairy dragon Lord Ballyhooligan and the boggle Grimblytoes, who found a fomorian spreading a blight through the Whisperwood, and Sir Raf played Olifin, the soldier sent to escort Mona out. Mona won Aurelia's welcome, and the party then returned to the monastery cellar. There Monarch's Charm Person exposed Ronnom's bodyguards as doppelgangers, and a jade-eyed woman in Dawnrealm-style clothing joined the fight. The session ended with Lucia felled and revived, a sketchy bodyguard stabbed to death, and a dragon's roar from the south of the flooded cave.
Cliffhanger: A dragon's roar echoes from the south of the flooded cave. The party has no ballista ship and no long rest, the jade-eyed woman is loose, and Ronnom is still unaccounted for.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Vignette: The Seelie Court
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - scene 1: Vignette: The Seelie Court
- Kyle announces a flashback vignette before the main story resumes.
- Monarch describes Mona, a red-haired teenage fey student with caterpillar markings.
- Mona raises her hand politely and asks about the astral conjunction at her birth; the court erupts in argument.
- Titania rules Mona a danger, exiles her to the Prime Material, and orders Olifin to escort her.
- Titania says Portia the satyr will meet them on the other side.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Farewells and the Fairy Ring
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - scene 2: Farewells and the Fairy Ring
- Mona writes a farewell letter and gives it to Olifin to deliver to her family.
- Portia takes Mona to forage mushrooms in a glade and offers her flask.
- Everyone gives the fairy-ring mushrooms a drink and the circle shifts them elsewhere in the Feywild, onto a huge branch.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - The Blight in the Whisperwood
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - scene 3: The Blight in the Whisperwood
- Lord Ballyhooligan and Grimblytoes, scouting the blight, spot Mona and Portia at the ring.
- Portia casts Detect Poison and Disease and finds a spreading magical contagion.
- Monarch collects blight samples in an emptied ink vial.
- Olifin, following their trail, uses the circle of drunkards with the family's whiskey and tracks them with a natural 20.
- Lord Ballyhooligan flies in invisible and sees a fomorian deepening the blight.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Aurelia's Court
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - scene 4: Aurelia's Court
- The party meets Aurelia, the mother of mirrors, in her court of singing golden serpents.
- Mona casts Silent Image to show the tearing reality she unleashed.
- Aurelia embraces and reabsorbs Portia, revealing her as a reflection.
- Aurelia keeps a mirror reflection of Mona and says Mona may visit the Whisperwood without angering Titania.
- The group returns to the present day.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Doppelgangers in the Cellar
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - scene 5: Doppelgangers in the Cellar
- Monarch's Charm Person reveals the twin bodyguards as doppelgangers, and a Wild Magic surge gives her damage resistance.
- Eddie opens with Moonbeam on both doppelgangers.
- A doppelganger frightens Lucia and attacks Sir Raf.
- A jade-eyed woman in Dawnrealm-style clothing appears mid-strike behind Eddie.
- Sir Raf's chromatic orb burns up a fake Raf doppelganger and bounces onto the jade-eyed woman.
- The jade-eyed woman vanishes, and later escapes as invisible mist.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - The Flooded Cave
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - scene 6: The Flooded Cave
- Lucia finds the sketchy bodyguard in the flooded cave and he drops her unconscious into the water.
- Portia heals Lucia with Healing Word and bloodies the sketchy guy with Ray of Frost.
- Lucia stabs the sketchy guy to death with a critical hit for 33.
- A dragon's roar echoes from the south of the cave.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Feywild Cosmology Wrap-Up
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - scene 7: Feywild Cosmology Wrap-Up
- Kyle explains the queen of air and darkness has no name, and that Titania holds the power over Oberon.
- Kyle invites Monarch to fold the vignette into her backstory, including sending to Aurelia.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: Nodding Gets Mona Exiled
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: Nodding Gets Mona Exiled
Mona nods along with Queen Titania's claim that the accident was out of her control and rolls terribly on persuasion. The nod lands as crude as shouting, and Titania exiles her to the prime material with Olifin as escort.
Quote: "I'm sorry you died in your flashback, Matt." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: Lord Ballyhooligan Spots the Fomorian
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: Lord Ballyhooligan Spots the Fomorian
Lord Ballyhooligan turns invisible and scouts the blight, finding a twisted fomorian deepening the blight with its hands. Lucia flies back gleeful at the secret, and the group hurries toward Aurelia.
Quote: "There's a formori, and it's spreading the blight." - Lucia (Andy)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: Portia Was Aurelia's Reflection
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: Portia Was Aurelia's Reflection
Aurelia embraces the satyr Portia, who fades into the queen, revealing she was only a reflection. Aurelia then makes a mirror copy of Mona to stay at court, and invites the real Monarch to visit the Whisperwood without angering Titania.
Quote: "She was me. The original Portia awaits you on the prime material." - Aurelia (Kyle)
Spotlight: Portia, Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: The Jade-Eyed Woman Strikes
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: The Jade-Eyed Woman Strikes
In the cellar brawl, an invisible, jade-eyed woman in Dawnrealm clothes appears mid-strike behind Eddie, landing heavy hits and shouting for the bodyguards to run. She keeps vanishing and dodging, and she is the toughest foe in the fight.
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: Lucia Stabs the Sketchy Guy
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: Lucia Stabs the Sketchy Guy
After going down and nearly drowning in the flooded cave, Lucia revives to find the sketchy bodyguard beside her. She gambles on a crit-fish roll and a big sneak attack and kills him with a 33-point hit.
Quote: "The gamble wins for once, guys." - Lucia (Andy)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: The Dragon's Roar
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Key Moment: The Dragon's Roar
With the bodyguard dead, a dragon's roar echoes from the south of the flooded cave. The party has no ballista ship and no spell slots to spare this time.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-25: Mirrors, Blight and Doppelgangers - memorable quotes
- "And this is where Mona becomes a lush." - Sir Raf (Jim)

chunks.title: Session 2026-02-08: The Jade Tigris and the Brother's Bargain - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-02-08: The Jade Tigris and the Brother's Bargain - summary
Picking up in the flooded sea cave beneath Najik Monastery, the party hunted the invisible, gaseous jade-eyed woman while warily skirting the dragon's lair. Portia was lightning-bolted by the dragon, and Monarch's plea won a promise to talk the next day. The jade-eyed woman was caught looting her dresser, stunned Eddie and Lucia, dropped Eddie unconscious, and escaped swimming toward the dragon. After a long rest, Raf's history check revealed her to be Veen, the jade Tigris, and the party met the dragon Skalanthas by the goats. When the evidence plan failed, Monarch proposed a deception, and Veen volunteered to stand in for Ronnom, which the dragon happily accepted.
Cliffhanger: The party sails for their ship in the jolly boats with the shipwreck survivors and Veen, a shapeshifter and spy, wearing Ronnom's face in manacles, while Ronnom stays under the dragon's protection.

chunks.title: Session 2026-02-08: The Jade Tigris and the Brother's Bargain - Deeper Water
chunks.text:
Session 2026-02-08: The Jade Tigris and the Brother's Bargain - scene 1: Deeper Water

- Lucia and Portia heard a single large splash ahead, in the same direction as the dragon's earlier roar.

chunks.title: Session 2026-02-08: The Jade Tigris and the Brother's Bargain - Hunting an Invisible Foe and Nearing the Dragon
chunks.text:

- The dragon's voice shouted a warning to flee, saying it did not wish to harm them but would if they came closer.
- Raf called out that he was chasing a murderer, and the dragon replied that this was its place and he could not enter whatever lies he told.
- Monarch pleaded at the top of her lungs; her persuasion check was 16 and the dragon said to choose a better time and place.
- Portia messaged the dragon and was hit by a lightning bolt from the submerged dragon; her save halved the 40 damage. The dragon answered: tomorrow by the goats.

chunks.text:
Session 2026-02-08: The Jade Tigris and the Brother's Bargain - scene 3: Moonbeam and Wet Footprints

chunks.text:
Session 2026-02-08: The Jade Tigris and the Brother's Bargain - scene 5: Flying Kicks and Darkness
- The jade-eyed woman came around with a flying kick, stunned Eddie and broke his Moonbeam concentration.
- Eddie used the Guardian Emblem to turn a crit into a normal hit.
- Lucia hid and sneak-attacked with advantage; the woman deflected most of it.
- On her next turn she hit Eddie again; he used the Emblem again but still dropped unconscious.
- Portia's Land's Aid hurt the woman and healed Eddie for 9.
- She cast magical darkness over the fighters, evening out advantage.
- She stunned Lucia, struck her, then slipped away through the water toward the dragon's lair, and the party gave up the chase.

chunks.title: Session 2026-02-22: The Pyre, the Pass, and the Pack - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-02-22: The Pyre, the Pass, and the Pack - summary
Returning to White Crown by ship with their prisoner, Veen (the Jade-Eyed Woman), disguised as Ronnom so the world would believe Ronnom had been captured and turned in, the party returned the bribery chest to Captain Orso and collected their 2,500 gold from Merrill at the Smiling Fish. Wary of Magistrate Goliath Ahn, the pyre of justice, they went straight to Roma, where the Sword Quarter paid a 5,000 gold bounty and the party filed an attempted-murder complaint against Ronnom. After a quick shopping trip for cold-weather and climbing gear, they scouted Emperor's Bay, found that the generals' maps ignored Dragonfjord, and headed for its mountains. They spent a night with a hermit and his winter wolf Useless, learned of the fjord's dragons and a safe pass, and were then stalked by five winter wolves, so combat began.
Cliffhanger: Five winter wolves, frost forming on their muzzles, advance across the snow toward the party as combat begins.

chunks.title: Session 2026-03-08: Wolves, Wild Magic, and the Wreck Under the Rubble - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-03-08: Wolves, Wild Magic, and the Wreck Under the Rubble - summary
The party finished off a pack of five horse-sized winter wolves with fireballs, lightning bolts and arrows, then skinned them and camped. Kyle fed them lore about yetis, and the pass over the mountains brought them down toward Dragonfjord. That night two stealthy yetis tracked them to camp, and a wild magic surge from Monarch's mage armor made it messier: her bedroll burst into flame, a unicorn appeared, and she was flung to the Astral Plane. Portia's wall of fire and a few well-aimed shots killed both yetis. The next day the party dug out a wagon of long-dead House Querid cartographers and recovered treasure, an annotated Dragonfjord map and a sending stone.
Cliffhanger: The party has dug out the House Querid wagon and holds an annotated map of Dragonfjord with five dragons marked, while the ruined bay settlement where the Norge might land still lies ahead, and more yetis may be on their trail.

- Monarch's lightning bolt downed wolf d, and Lucia's sneak attacks, Eddie's guiding bolts and Sir Raf's booming blade whittled the pack.
- The pack tore into Sir Raf for 36 piercing damage and knocked him prone; he stood and fought on with Second Wind and Action Surge.
- Monarch's second-level magic missile finished the last wolf.

chunks.title: Session 2026-04-05: Fog, Fear and the White Dragon's Tribute - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-04-05: Fog, Fear and the White Dragon's Tribute - summary
The party left the wagon wreck in the rockfall area, followed the river to the shore of Dragonfjord and crept north to the ruins of Drakholm. They spotted a Norge longship and cargo ships near a rocky island, and Eddie sent word to Rowan the spymaster, while a sending stone from the wreck produced a curt order from House Querid. Eddie, Lucia and Portia swam out to the island and found a fear-wreathed longship with a Fenrir figurehead, a Goliath crew of about thirty, and a masked Goliath woman wearing a white dragon mask. The party agreed to hide the mask from the Imperium and to try to stop the second tribute, then watched the crew beach the ship and camp until a dragon dove at their fires by night.
Cliffhanger: A dragon dove roaring at the Cherek camp's fire-lit mist while the party hid under Monarch's illusion, unsure whether the white dragon's deal had been struck.

chunks.title: Session 2026-04-19: The Roar Beneath the Ice - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-04-19: The Roar Beneath the Ice - summary
Watching the Cherek camp from afar, the party saw a white dragon strike it and fly off smoking. Monarch scouted the fog-shrouded camp invisibly and overheard that the Cherek are waiting for their treasure ship. The party then found a frozen dwarf from the Mithril Peaks clan, learned through Speak with Dead that the dwarves had escaped the dragon Rimescar, and sent word to Rowan. Following the dwarves' trail into a crevice beside a frozen waterfall, they fought ice trolls until a dragon's roar frightened Monarch and Portia. A silver dragon then pulled Monarch, Portia and Lucia into an astral library.
Cliffhanger: Monarch, Portia and Lucia stand in the astral library of the silver dragon, while their bodies freeze in the ice-troll fight with Raf and Eddie, as the great white dragon's roar echoes through the halls.

Session 2026-05-17: Hearts of Ice, Iron in the Hoard - summary
Mid-fight with the second ice troll, Monarch, Portia and Lucia snapped back from an astral-library excursion, then the party killed the troll with Portia's blight and cut out both ice trolls' hearts. They shared what the library taught them: the dragon masks free Tiamat and can be destroyed only by an ancient dragon's wish, and the silver dragon Lunae lies in an iron flask in Rimescar's hoard. Enslaved Mithril Peaks dwarves warned them off and linked minds with Lucia, and the party hid in mining tunnels to long rest, scrying the lair with Lucia's mirror, locate object, Diego and clairvoyance. When Rimescar left through the waterfall, Eddie and Sir Raf ate the troll hearts and the party flew in, only to meet charging yetis.
Cliffhanger: With Rimescar gone through the waterfall and the hearts eaten, the party flies in toward the hoard, but as they round a corner yetis charge them, roaring with rage and frost.

chunks.title: Session 2026-06-14: The Silver Dragon Unbottled - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-06-14: The Silver Dragon Unbottled - summary
The party cleared out a pack of yeti, then Sir Raf, enlarged by Monarch, smashed through fifteen feet of ice with Shatterspike to reach Rimescar's hoard. After beating the living cold breath guardians and putting a newly hatched warmling to sleep, they grabbed what treasure they could and Portia freed the silver dragon Lunae from the iron flask. Lunae planned an ambush with the Mithril Peaks dwarves, and Rimescar was paralyzed and shot dead by dwarf crossbows. Afterward the party feasted on dragon flesh and scouted the Norge camp, where Lunae identified a Sundered Sky subclan serving frost giants and saw her hoard about to be replenished.

chunks.title: Session 2026-07-12: Weekend at Bernie's: The Dragon Puppet Gambit - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-07-12: Weekend at Bernie's: The Dragon Puppet Gambit - summary
With the Cherek tribute convoy approaching Rimescar's waterfall lair, the party debated how to hide the dragon's death and get close to the white dragon mask without a fight they might lose. Lunae, voiced by the GM, said she wants to prevent the invasion, not join the war. Portia scouted the convoy and camp as a wolf, and Monarch attuned to the blue dragon mask. Next day Monarch's permanent Major Image of Rimescar, backed by a Performance check of 24, fooled Vigdis Foe Shatter into handing over three wagons of tribute and marching away. The wagons held a fortune and two caged Maulring dragon slayers, Sorcha and Ashvale, whom Portia freed.
Cliffhanger: The Cherek convoy left believing Rimescar lives, and the party holds all three wagons of tribute plus two freed Maulring dragon slayers, while Vigdis still wears the white dragon mask.

chunks.title: Session 2026-07-26: The Yoke and the Longship - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-07-26: The Yoke and the Longship - summary
Back in the cave with Lunae, the Mithril Peaks dwarves and the freed Maulring captives Sorcha and Ashvale, the party planned to hunt the next white dragon to the south. Sorcha's remark about Icevein led Lucia to use the Mirror of the Past, and its visions showed an ancient, vengeful dragon that hates frost giants and that the party cannot fight. The party dropped the dragon hunt and decided to find hard evidence tying the Cherek fleet to the frost giants, so Icevein would turn on them. Eddie sent Sendings to Rowan, who replied that they should extract soonest and keep Rimescar's fall from Icevein. Monarch's clairvoyance at the Fenrir camp overheard Vigdis snarl a threat at a Goliath, and the rune master then warn her about 'hunter's favor'. The session ended with the party creeping toward the Fenrir by night while Vigdis and the rune master were away.
Cliffhanger: With Vigdis and the rune master away, the party creeps toward the Fenrir at nightfall to hunt for proof linking the Cherek to the frost giants.

chunks.title: Session 2026-08-09: The Fast and the Fenrir - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-08-09: The Fast and the Fenrir - summary
Portia, Monarch, Sir Raf and Eddie crept toward the Cherek camp by water, air and spider-silk to find proof of who directs the tribute run. Clairvoyance failed against a Private Sanctum ward, and Portia found only soldier's kit in the commander's pack and bedroll. When the party boarded the living longship Fenrir, its lightning, frost breath and howl woke the whole camp. Monarch charmed the bearsark and the hunter, ran an illusory white dragon decoy, and the party slipped away. Back in a tiny hut they planned a bolder heist: charm the guards and attune to the ship itself, with Lucia absent and the plan shelved until she returns.
Cliffhanger: The party has slipped away to rest and now sketches a heist: charm the camp's guards, open the warded hatches, and attune to the living Fenrir. They are holding off until Andy, and Lucia, returns.

chunks.title: Session 2026-09-06: Charm Offensive on the Fenrir - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-09-06: Charm Offensive on the Fenrir - summary
Eddie, Monarch and Portia returned to the Cherek camp with Raf and Lucia absent, planning to charm the Fenrir's guards into sailing their own ship away. Eddie's clairvoyance showed the camp still on high alert, and the trio struck: Monarch charmed the four deck guards, Eddie dropped silence on the figurehead, and Portia's charm monster drew the guard at the front, so initiative began. The charmed crew raised the sail and dragged the Fenrir off the shore, but the uncharmed crew, the Goliath bearsark and a raging commander turned the hold into a brawl, and Monarch was bitten and then felled. After Monarch's attack for 10 damage, the commander fell unconscious. At the end of the session Raf and Lucia arrived.
Cliffhanger: The Fenrir is adrift with charmed and uncharmed crew brawling aboard, the commander lies unconscious below decks, Monarch has barely resisted the werebear curse, and Raf and Lucia have just arrived.

chunks.title: Session 2026-09-20: Lightning, Lycanthropy, and the Stolen Longship - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-09-20: Lightning, Lycanthropy, and the Stolen Longship - summary
Sir Raf and Lucia swam through the icy fjord to the Fenrir as it drifted out from shore amid a Cherek brawl. They boarded through the open hatch, with Raf taking chain lightning on the way, and joined a savage fight below decks against Goliath bearsarks, in which Monarch, Portia and Eddie took bites that threaten lycanthropy. The party talked its charmed crewmen into rowing the ship north, put them ashore with the unconscious, and Portia attuned to the Fenrir. After sailing into the middle of the fjord and a long rest, Eddie's dispel magic stripped away some of the ship's wards. The next morning, opening the rune-stone cabin unleashed an armored fire elemental and an air elemental, and Portia and Monarch charmed them both.
Cliffhanger: The party holds the Fenrir in the middle of the fjord, with a fire elemental and an air elemental charmed only temporarily. Four runestones, a forward cabin yet to explore, and the threat of lycanthropy for Monarch and Portia remain, while Cherek pursuers search the shore.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - summary
Aboard the stolen longship Fenrir, the party recapped their dispel and the two elementals Portia and Monarch had charmed, then sent the charmed air elemental, El Nino, north and attuned to the fire and air rune stones. Monarch layered her own charm on the armored fire elemental, so it stayed friendly when Portia's charm lapsed, and Kyle ruled that attuned stones summon elementals until killed or dismissed. In the last guarded cabin Lucia, aided by Eddie's guidance and Hades' favor, beat a trap on a captain's trunk, revealing letters and logbooks addressed to Vigdis, which showed that Norge's invasion fleet is bound for Roma under a mysterious 'winter favored', plus a fortune in coin and gems. With the ship underway on elemental power, Eddie's sendings drew replies from Lunae, who offered to ferry her dwarf clan aboard, and Azuriel, who ordered the Fenrir returned to Roma or destroyed.
Cliffhanger: The Fenrir sails north on elemental power, carrying proof of a Norge invasion of Roma and a bearskin-covered object that reads divination and conjuration, while Lunae prepares to bring her dwarf clan aboard and the party must escape Dragonfjord with a ship Azuriel wants returned or destroyed.

chunks.text:

- The letters were all addressed to Vigdis and written in Common or Giant.
- Supply levels in the letters suggested an invasion fleet, not a raiding party, aimed at Roma.
- The logbooks referred to 'the winter favored' as the one giving orders.
- The logs also mentioned binding 'terms' limiting contact with the clans; Portia's insight suggested information was compartmentalized to suppress discontent.

- Sir Raf's detect magic showed the gem was evocation and the bearskin-covered object was divination and conjuration.

- Kyle explained that air and water elementals each add 60 feet of movement, up to 120 feet with both.
- Monarch attuned to the wind stone during the first hour.
- Monarch summoned a new air elemental from the air stone (not El Nino), ordered it to guard the deck, and began attuning to the water stone.
- Sir Raf re-attuned to Shatterspike and Eddie to his Cloak of Elvenkind.
- The party agreed to leave the bearskin-covered object alone until the ship reached safe harbor.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Sendings
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - scene 7: Sendings
- Eddie sent Azuriel news of the Norge fleet and the Cherek deal with the ancient white dragon; she answered that it was serious news if verified and asked for details.
- Lunae replied that she would come to see if the ship could carry 40 and ferry her clan aboard.
- Kyle noted the clan are mountain dwarves, no better at sailing than the party but able to row.
- Azuriel's second reply called the Fenrir a critical asset to be returned to Roma or destroyed, with a personal guarantee of a revival attempt for any fallen.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Key Moment: Double-Charmed Fire Knight
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Key Moment: Double-Charmed Fire Knight
Monarch layers her own heightened charm monster on the armored fire elemental, with disadvantage on its save. It fails, so when Portia's charm lapses it stays friendly and no one gets burned.
Quote: "Made a friend. We should call him Beavis." - Eddie (Steve)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Key Moment: Hades Helps Lucia Beat the Trap
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Key Moment: Hades Helps Lucia Beat the Trap
Lucia, with Eddie's guidance and Hades' favor, picks the captain's trunk with a roll of 40. She pulls the gem from the trap mechanism, and the hammerheads just tink together instead of setting it off.
Quote: "the nuclear bomb does not go off." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Key Moment: It's an Invasion Fleet
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Key Moment: It's an Invasion Fleet
Eddie reads Vigdis's letters and learns that the supply amounts match an army of tens of thousands, aimed at Roma. The logbooks, which Portia studies, name an unnamed 'winter favored' as the one giving orders, and mention the mysterious 'terms'. Portia's insight suggests discontent kept in check by compartmentalization.
Quote: "They are an invasion fleet meant to actually decapitate the empire." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Eddie, Portia

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Key Moment: A Fortune in the Burn Box
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Key Moment: A Fortune in the Burn Box
Under the logbook trays, Lucia finds the emergency funds: 1,000 platinum, 5,000 gold and 20 trade gems, about 17,000 gold in all, untouched. She packs it into her bag of holding, and the table teases her about skimming.
Quote: "I'm not gonna skim off the top." - Lucia (Andy)
Spotlight: Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Key Moment: Return the Fenrir or Destroy It
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Key Moment: Return the Fenrir or Destroy It
After Eddie's sendings, Lunae offers to ferry her clan aboard if the ship can carry 40. Azuriel calls the Fenrir a critical asset, orders it returned to Roma or destroyed at all costs, and promises revival attempts for any fallen.
Quote: "Fenrir is critical asset. Return to Roma or destroy at all costs. You have my personal guarantee of revival attempt for any fallen." - Azuriel (Kyle)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-04: The Burn Box and the Borrowed Storm - memorable quotes
- "Well, I'm naming my air elemental El Nino. So I'm a fairy. Everything has a name." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Names are a moral construct. We don't obey those. You delude yourselves with individualism." - GM (Kyle)
- "Hey. We should start skimming these things and see if we can find our evidence." - Eddie (Steve)
- "I'm not gonna skim off the top." - Lucia (Andy)
- "I have never messed with a sale in real life." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Well, why would we? Because we were planning on being in an urban adventure." - Sir Raf (Jim)
- "Fenrir is critical asset. Return to Roma or destroy at all costs." - Azuriel (Kyle)

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Wave Alone to the Wyrm's Mouth - summary
The party sailed the stolen Fenrir north up Dragonfjord, failed to dispel its persistent fear effect, and learned it is a modified antipathy/sympathy spell. Merrows and the ancient white dragon Icevein shadowed them while Lunae arranged to ferry her dwarf clan to a river mouth. Eddie's divination to Hades told them to ride to the bear star and return to the wyrm's mouth by night, by wave alone, and a freezing unnatural storm nearly claimed Monarch's air elemental. After collecting the dwarves, they ran the Norge blockade at the mouth of Emperor's Bay with a forged signal reply. Lunae came aboard, and the session ended as two imperial spell jammers aimed their ballistas at the Fenrir.
Cliffhanger: With Lunae and the dwarves aboard, the Fenrir flies imperial colors in Emperor's Bay while two imperial spell jammers train their ballistas on it.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Recap and Where to Sail
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - scene 1: Recap and Where to Sail
- Monarch recapped the Fenrir heist, the letters revealing the Norge invasion fleet, Lunae's offer and Azuriel's demand.
- Kyle confirmed it was no longer night, so the sails stayed down for the party's visibility.
- Sir Raf noted their instructions were to bring the ship to Roma or destroy it; Portia said they might destroy it depending on politics.
- Monarch suggested going north around the western edge of the island; Sir Raf proposed scouting first.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - The Fear Spell
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - scene 2: The Fear Spell
- Eddie tried dispel magic on the Fenrir's persistent fear effect.
- Sir Raf rolled 22 on arcana and Monarch 18, and Kyle ruled it an antipathy sympathy spell, modified to affect a whole ship.
- Kyle said the hull is covered in thousands of runes that would take days to decipher.
- Eddie's dispel failed, and Portia's attempt later failed too, so the spell persisted.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Sending to Lunae and the Merrows
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - scene 3: Sending to Lunae and the Merrows
- Eddie sent Lunae word that the longship can hold 40.
- Lunae replied she would move her clan to the river mouth and would not overfly the fjord because Icevein nearly killed her.
- Large shapes swam beneath the ship; three ogre-sized, shark-featured merrows kept pace.
- Eddie's guiding bolt of 14 missed, and the merrows lost interest after he cast toll the dead.
- Raf and Eddie spotted creatures moving along the ground far to the south, south to north.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Icevein Tails the Ship
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - scene 4: Icevein Tails the Ship
- The giant white dragon was seen flying about four miles away.
- Sails went up and Monarch's elementals drove the ship to 12 miles an hour, pulling away from the dragon.
- Lunae replied by sending that Icevein has only greed and hate and might be used.
- Lucia and Eddie judged Icevein was tailing the party like a scout.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Hades Answers
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - scene 5: Hades Answers
- Eddie cast divination asking how to take advantage of Icevein's greed to the fleet's detriment.
- Hades replied that nine hundred mortals are due him, to ride to the bear star before the dawn star falls, return to the wyrm's mouth by night, and sail by wave alone.
- Eddie rolled 24 on survival with Portia's help and found the bear star's heading.
- Icevein dashed past the ship as a cold, unnatural storm built to the north.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - The Storm and the Air Elemental
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - scene 6: The Storm and the Air Elemental
- Monarch sent her summoned air elemental to follow the dragon and told it not to die.
- It returned badly damaged, saying it could not see and it was too cold.
- The party fled south from the storm and sailed to the river mouth in darkness.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Dwarves, Lunae and the Blockade
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - scene 7: Dwarves, Lunae and the Blockade
- The party reached the river mouth to pick up the dwarves.
- Perception checks revealed a Norge fleet blockading the mouth of Emperor's Bay.
- With 24 oarsmen and two elementals the Fenrir raced through at 24 miles an hour.
- Monarch used the code book to answer the command frigate's challenge, and Lucia sent it with dancing lights, giving bribery as the mission and ordering the fleet northeast to protect the treasure ships.
- Lunae dropped onto the deck as an elven woman and said 'that was interesting.'

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Spell Jammers
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - scene 8: Spell Jammers
- Two imperial spell jammers raced toward the Fenrir from the south.
- Monarch burned slots and cast permanent major image so the sails flew imperial colors.
- Portia kept only the lightning boarding ward active.
- The spell jammers angled down and their crews aimed ballistas at the ship.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Key Moment: Merrows Race the Fear Ship
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Key Moment: Merrows Race the Fear Ship
Passing the merrow-infested waters, the party's unremovable fear aura drives off most of the swimmers, but three ogre-sized shark-featured merrows keep dashing alongside and under the hull. The GM notes they would have boarded if the Fenrir were any slower, and Eddie's guiding bolt can't pierce their hides.
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Key Moment: Hades Names Nine Hundred Mortals
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Key Moment: Hades Names Nine Hundred Mortals
Eddie's ritual divination to Hades answers that nine hundred mortals are due, and the party must ride wind and wave to the bear star and return to the wyrm's mouth by night, by wave alone. Eddie and Portia pool their rolls to navigate the bear star.
Quote: "Hades, nine hundred mortals are due me, and you will guide them home. Ride wind and wave to the bear star before the dawn star falls." - Hades (Kyle)
Spotlight: Eddie

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Key Moment: Monarch's Air Elemental Returns Frostbitten
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Key Moment: Monarch's Air Elemental Returns Frostbitten
Monarch sends the air elemental she summoned from the air rune stone to follow the dragon and report, adding 'don't die' to the orders. It returns shredded and frosty, reporting it could not see, too cold, and was going to die, which proves the storm is unnatural.
Quote: "could not see. Too cold. Was going to die." - GM (Kyle)
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Key Moment: Bluffing the Norge Blockade
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Key Moment: Bluffing the Norge Blockade
Facing a command frigate's signal demanding authentication and orders, Monarch decodes the code book. The party answers with the Fenrir and bribery codes, then orders the Northern fleet to sail northeast and protect the treasure fleet, sending them toward the dragon. Lucia fetched the book at speed and cast dancing lights.
Quote: "Sail real fast. That's plan a. Bullshit is plan b." - Monarch (Matt)
Spotlight: Monarch, Lucia

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Key Moment: Roman Colors Under Ballista Aim
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Key Moment: Roman Colors Under Ballista Aim
After Lunae drops aboard, two imperial spell jammers close in. Monarch burns slots for a permanent major image of Roman colors on the sail and stops the ship, and the spell jammers tilt down to aim their ballistas at the Fenrir as the session ends.
Spotlight: Monarch

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-18: Drive It Like You Stole It - memorable quotes
- "It's almost like they didn't want anyone taking this boat." - Monarch (Matt)
- "Sail real fast. That's plan a. Bullshit is plan b." - Monarch (Matt)

chunks.title: Colonel Lara
chunks.text:
NPC: Colonel Lara (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2026-02-22)
Role: chief of the city watch in the Sword Quarter
Attitude to party: cooperative
- (2024-12-01) Monarch named her as a reference. Kyle noted she paid the party's bounty on the iron shadow they took out.
- (2026-02-22) Eddie contacted Colonel Lara by sending; she sent a city watch detachment to escort the party and prisoner to the Magistrate's Office in the Sword Quarter.
- (2024-10-20) Sir Raf gave her information on the skulks and drow assassins; she had no new leads but offered extra patrols at the party's lodgings and said she would message her Trimarket counterpart.
- (2024-10-20) She is deeply interested in Valkrath's capture.

chunks.title: Simona Querid Ventre
chunks.text:
NPC: Simona Querid Ventre (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Simona, Simona Carried Ventre
Role: Noble patron able to give letters of introduction
Faction: House Ventre
Location: Groves of Belenus
Attitude to party: friendly, seeks Portia's help
Status: alive
- (2024-11-17) Simona met Portia at the Groves of Belenus. She is rarely there in person but happened to be present, and was glad the party was all right.
- (2024-11-17) She offered to carry a message to her contacts in House Querid. Portia and Monarch asked her to find out whether the party is still hunted and whether the feud can be resolved. She promised to make the inquiries and assurances.
- (2024-11-17) Simona revealed a Senate measure to place the Groves of Belenus under the direct oversight of the Roman consul, effectively making it part of the city. She opposes it. Its sponsor is Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad. The vote is delayed and not expected before the full senate for at least three moons.
- (2024-11-17) Simona asked Portia to pass on any information or leverage against the sponsor. She said nobody at the Green Apothecary feels the party owes them anything, though they would welcome the usual help with ceremonies, tending the groves and alchemical projects.
- (2024-11-17) Simona was originally from House Querid and later joined House Ventre, so she still has contacts there.
- (2025-01-05) As patron of the Green Apothecary she offered to be the party's go-between to Zyra the Silent.

chunks.title: Simona Querid Ventre (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Simona Querid Ventre (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-11-30)
- (2025-11-02) Simona came from Roma to the Azure Sky camp in person to find Portia, with a dozen-strong imperial entourage under a House Ventre banner.
- (2025-11-02) She told Portia the Senate vote on the Groves is about a month away and proposed three avenues: finding which senators are corrupt, persuading shadowy guilds seeking poisons to withdraw pressure, and discrediting Senator Magnus Opulus Marvad.
- (2025-11-02) She suspects mining operations near the Grove want the root-of-the-world-tree fragment beneath it.
- (2025-11-02) She bankrolled the party's trip back, covering horse changes, and traveled on her family ship from Archipelanes to Roma.
- (2025-11-02) She had alchemists at the Grove's apothecary show Portia a nectar potion that turns a liar's tongue black while they lie.
- (2025-11-16) The GM ruled she can write letters of introduction getting the party an audience with any senator; her name opened the Stone Palace.
- (2025-11-30) Simona is patron of the Green Apothecary, a fae noble who married into House Ventre from House Querid; she shelters the Groves with family and Fae court connections.
- (2024-10-20) She is the daughter of a marriage between Houses Querid and Ventre and acts as patron to the Green Apothecary; Portia has seldom spoken with her.

chunks.title: Jimmy Slips
chunks.text:
NPC: Jimmy Slips (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-01-05)
Role: forger and illusionist; private investigator hired by Jingle, secretly working with the party and Azuriel
Attitude to party: cooperative; winked at them as he was chewed out
Location: locked room of the far-right workshop, Shimmerstone Shipworks
Status: alive
- (2024-11-17) He is good with disguises, forgeries and illusions, and was willing to help find out what was in the box for gold.
- (2024-11-17) He was at Brim's AutoKeg in Greka with Jingle Shimmerstone. When Monarch's group sat down he turned, recognized Monarch, and his eyes narrowed.
- (2024-12-01) At Brim's AutoKeg he was in the middle of a con on Jingle when the party arrived. He and Monarch both paused and left each other room to speak, and he did not give Monarch away.
- (2024-12-01) He signaled in thieves' cant for the party to talk outside after their meeting. Lucia understood and answered, and he noted that she did. Later he spoke to Monarch from thin air and sent her to the Clockwork Tiger.
- (2024-12-01) He met the party at the Clockwork Tiger disguised as a dwarf with a big red braided beard. He said he had just closed a deal to be Jingle's private investigator, which let him help the party and collect thank-you money from Azuriel. He asked that neither side mention they know each other.
- (2024-12-01) He asked what Monarch's group sold the box for. Monarch said they were paid far less than it was worth and that it was heavily and deadly trapped. Monarch said the interested parties were settled and she wanted the package behind them.

chunks.title: Jimmy Slips (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Jimmy Slips (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2024-12-01) He offered to add cover stories and to push for the access the party wants in his report on them. The party asked him to argue for all-access. He will use a thieves' cant snake sign if he is disguised and look like himself if he is there as the investigator.
- (2024-12-01) Monarch set a hard line: Jimmy must not learn that the party is still pursuing the box's contents.
- (2024-12-01) At the interviews he appeared in his natural form. When Jingle announced a mandatory lethal-force contract, Raf (rolled a 20 on Insight) saw Jimmy blanch for a moment before he recovered.
- (2024-12-01) He gave Lucia a hand signal that they needed to talk, then led the party on a tour of the workshops. He said he needs to get into one of the workshops while the party is on duty, which would be when the money arrives. He can prove the party is working for House Ventre but would rather not. He asked them not to kill him on duty and said that if they kill him word would get to Jingle. He paid close attention to the small locked storeroom in the first workshop.
- (2024-12-01) The party suspects he has a dead man's trigger that would expose them if he dies. The GM noted he works with Azuriel of House Ventre and could give them up by giving himself up.
- (2024-12-15) Jimmy was waiting for a shipment of payroll; the GM said he could not say what night he would come. An armored wagon with short-folk and automata guards then arrived at the Shipworks in the morning.

chunks.title: Jimmy Slips (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Jimmy Slips (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2024-12-15) Jimmy was already inside the locked room when the party looked; he was caught in a detention bubble of force by the sentry. He was disguised as an auto gnome, which Lucia and Monarch had expected.
- (2024-12-15) Jimmy's pitch was that he does not care what the party is there for as long as they do not care what he is there for. The GM said he holds blackmail that would reveal the party was sent by House Ventre against the shipyards.
- (2024-12-15) Lucia contacted Jimmy telepathically through the bubble. After a persuasion roll with a rerolled heroic inspiration, he offered the party 30% of the take if they got him out.
- (2024-12-15) The GM noted Azuriel referred Jimmy to the party, so betraying them would burn his relationship with her.
- (2025-01-05) Jimmy, disguised as an autognome, had been held in the detention sentry's force bubble and maintained the silence spell while concentrating. He readied an action to drop it when asked.
- (2025-01-05) Because the sentry's first move is to capture only one target, Jimmy was prisoner number one and came out unscathed. When the sentry exploded, the bubble vanished.
- (2025-01-05) After the sentry died, Jimmy opened the cache box, said he would crack it off-site, shoved it into a bag of holding, and left disguised as an autognome.
- (2025-01-05) Jingle summoned Jimmy, his security consultant who had advised hiring the party, and berated him as the party left. Jimmy winked at them as he passed and promised by message to meet them at the Auto Keg.

chunks.title: Jimmy Slips (part 4)
chunks.text:
NPC: Jimmy Slips (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2025-01-05) About an hour and a half later Jimmy met the party at Brim's AutoKeg. A couple of days later at the Golden Leaf he delivered laundered trade bars: 30% of an 8,000 gold take, which is 2,400 gold, split five ways.
- (2024-10-20) He took the package out of its outer crate; Monarch charmed him and abandoned him in Greka.

chunks.title: Zyra the Silent
chunks.text:
NPC: Zyra the Silent (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: Zyra, Zyro, Ira the silent
Role: spymaster of House Querid
Faction: House Querid
- (2024-11-03) The GM clarified that Zyra the Silent, the spymaster, puts the explosive glyphs on his top agents; not every iron shadow carries one.
- (2024-11-03) Valkrath worked for Zyra the Silent and bore the glyph tattoo.
- (2024-11-17) The GM noted the business with Zyra the Silent is not yet settled, so the party should not tip off House Querid about inquiries into the package.
- (2024-12-01) Kyle explained that high-ranking agents of Zyra's organization get an exploding tattoo. That, not being an iron shadow, caused Valkrath to explode.
- (2025-01-05) The GM recalled Zyra as the person who sent the Iron Fist to kill the party; Simona knows her.
- (2024-10-20) Kyle names Zyra the Silent as the spymaster of House Querid, and Valkrath works for Zyra.
- (2024-10-20) Rumor says Zyra puts glyph tattoos on key agents that explode in acid when the agent drops to 0 hit points, deterring capture. The party has never seen one.
- (2024-10-20) Sir Raf recounts that Zyra modifies tactics depending on who they are dealing with, and treats House Telx members more harshly.

chunks.title: Thor
chunks.text:
NPC: Thor (first seen 2024-11-03, last seen 2024-12-01)
Also known as: Thoradin, Thornton, Thoradan
Role: owner of the Golden Leaf Tavern, former performer
Location: Golden Leaf Tavern, Trimarket
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2024-11-03) Thor owns and lives in the Golden Leaf, and usually carries a fighting knife. After Monarch warned him of enemies, he sent his staff home, donned a chain shirt and kept a longsword and light crossbow behind the bar.
- (2024-11-03) Monarch gave Thor 5 gold to make a normal night a good one. Thor normally takes in about 4 gold.
- (2024-11-03) Thor cast Healing Word on Monarch for 8 and Heroism on Portia, and shot a hobgoblin skulk dead with his crossbow for 7.
- (2024-11-03) Thor was devastated by Fickle's death.
- (2024-12-01) Monarch named him as a reference for the party, as owner of the Golden Leaf Tavern in Roma.

chunks.title: Fickle
chunks.text:
NPC: Fickle (first seen 2024-11-03, last seen 2024-11-03)
Role: Thor's fairy dragon companion
Status: dead
- (2024-11-03) Fickle spoke Silent and warned Monarch about invisible enemies. During the fight it followed Valkrath telepathically.
- (2024-11-03) Fickle was killed by the acid explosion from Valkrath's glyph.

chunks.title: Raylana
chunks.text:
NPC: Raylana (first seen 2024-11-03, last seen 2024-11-03)
Also known as: Ralanus, Rilana, Raylan
Role: bartender and stand-up comedian at the Golden Leaf
Status: alive
- (2024-11-03) Raylana serves drinks and does stand-up with vicious mockery. Thor sent her home before the attack.

chunks.title: Darklings
chunks.text:
NPC: Darklings (first seen 2024-11-03, last seen 2024-11-03)
Also known as: dark ones, skulks
Role: invisible shadow assassins serving Valkrath
Status: dead
- (2024-11-03) Party history checks of 18, 19 and 19 recalled that the darklings were fey cursed by the Summer Queen. They absorb light and release it as a blinding burst when they die.
- (2024-11-03) Both darkling skulks died: Monarch burned one with Fire Bolt, and Thor shot one. Raf later shot two restrained dark ones, which exploded in blinding light. Lucia failed her Constitution save and was blinded.

chunks.title: Morton
chunks.text:
NPC: Morton (first seen 2024-11-03, last seen 2024-11-03)
Role: sous chef and bouncer at the Golden Leaf
Faction: Golden Leaf Tavern
- (2024-11-03) Morton is protective of Thor but obeyed when he was told to go home.

chunks.title: Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Magnus Opulus Marvad, Magnus Opulos Marvad, Senator Magnus Opulus Marvad, Magnus Marvad, Magnus
Role: Senator, gatekeeper who can bring items to the floor
Faction: House Marvad
Attitude to party: unknown; opposed to the Groves' independence
- (2024-11-17) He is an extremely savvy and experienced senator, very hard to pin anything on or damage politically.
- (2024-11-17) The GM said he is Maximus' father.
- (2025-01-05) He proposed the Senate motion to put the Groves under the Roman consul. It is likely to pass unless its proponents are weakened. He is the father of the person tied to Lucia's broken engagement, and Lucia dislikes him.
- (2025-11-02) Magnus is the sponsor of the Groves measure, and the buzz is that he has the votes.
- (2025-11-16) He is of the Opulus family in House Marvad. He was once in line to be emperor by bloodline before the deal with the Giants, and has a block of senators who always vote with him.
- (2025-11-16) This bill has one of the narrowest margins of any bill he has sponsored; it leads by 25 votes.
- (2025-11-16) He supports Senator Vaelthira's petition to the emperor to make war on Norge, but it has been pending longer than the Groves bill without a vote.
- (2025-11-16) Lucia's earlier carriage encounter involved his son, so he or his people would recognize her.

chunks.title: Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-30)
- (2025-11-30) Magnus promised the frost giant senator Vaelthira to bring her Norge petition to the floor but, per Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus, does not intend it to pass; the party deduced he plays both sides.
- (2025-11-30) After Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus intervened, he pulled the petition. Calvus said the Groves bill has a 20-vote cushion without Vaelthira's votes.

chunks.title: Father Georg
chunks.text:
NPC: Father Georg (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2024-11-17)
Also known as: Father Greg, Father Garrett
Role: head of the Temple of Hades in Roma
Faction: Temple of Hades
Attitude to party: quietly approving of Eddie
- (2024-11-17) He took Eddie's vows when Eddie joined the temple of Hades. He is very sparing with words.
- (2024-11-17) He summoned Eddie and gave him a letter from a dead friend, sent by a slow route. The letter held a drawing of a dragon with 'Mythic Isles?' and Qul'drik written on it. Father Georg shrugged that it was a mystery to him and told Eddie he was doing good work.

chunks.title: Lady Gracia
chunks.text:
NPC: Lady Gracia (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2024-11-17)
Also known as: Lady Grassia
Role: powerful member of House Ventre; Raf's patron
Faction: House Ventre
Attitude to party: supportive but wary of overreach
- (2024-11-17) She gave Sir Raf an audience. She said the party is effective but still unproven, that their low notoriety is an asset, and that each early employer will fix how others see their allegiances.
- (2024-11-17) She asked Sir Raf to get closer to the chief of staff Azuriel and report suspicious activity. She doubts Azuriel's disloyalty but worries about her personal motives, and she referred him to Sir Sarovar.
- (2024-11-17) She influences men such as Sir Sarovar by seeming available to those attracted to her.
- (2024-11-17) Sir Sarovar said he could not get an audience with her or answers to his notes lately.

chunks.title: Octavio Libram
chunks.text:
NPC: Octavio Libram (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: Octavio
Role: spymaster who likes to do things quietly
Faction: House Ventre
Location: Sultan Estate
Attitude to party: approving
- (2024-11-17) Monarch reported everything to him. He called the shipment business finished and said he has nothing for Monarch for a while so the iron can cool, but said Azuriel may have work.
- (2024-11-17) He advised using scapegoats and distraction instead of stealth, and noted the party's notoriety can be social leverage. He said the Mazaali favor is a good card to sit on.
- (2024-11-17) He had looked up Jimmy Slips and sounded him out with gold, and offered to arrange a meeting.
- (2025-01-05) Azuriel says he likes to do things quietly and does not want to be seated next to Lady Antress. She said she would tell him of the party's findings, and recommended him as Raf's wizard mentor.

chunks.title: Sir Saravar
chunks.text:
NPC: Sir Saravar (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-19)
Also known as: Sir Sarivar, Caesar Sarovar, Sir Sarovar, Sir Saravar Antosi, Sir Saravar Antasi
Role: client hiring a small foot-escort to Xi'an Palace; uses the name of a philosopher dead three hundred years
Faction: another house, not House Ventre
Location: Sarovar Estate, Sword Quarter
Attitude to party: sharp, tight-lipped; released the party after weighing them
Status: alive
- (2024-11-17) He praised Raf's handling of the fight but was torn about it happening in the street. He gave Raf a sealed letter of recommendation for Colonel Kaelix.
- (2025-01-19) He met the party at Popinjay's Tea Shoppe, poured six cups of tea in silence and offered a 5,000 gp, three-week job escorting a small, highly valuable shipment on foot from the Thundering Citadel to Xi'an Palace.
- (2025-01-19) He probed the party about war ogres and their deadliest opponent (the iron shadow), noticed what they left out and approved of their discretion, and said he would decide in seven days.
- (2025-01-19) After Monarch wrote to him, he answered with a Sending: consider yourselves released, they have potential, and he will keep them in mind for future opportunities. The Sending itself was a message about how powerful people communicate.
- (2025-01-19) He walked from the tea house to the public south gate of the Corona Domini, showed the giant guards (a stone giant and a cloud giant) something small in his hand and was admitted.
- (2025-01-19) He offered Raf a letter vouching for him to imperial military units near the Dawnrealm border.

chunks.title: Sir Saravar (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Sir Saravar (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-19)
- (2025-01-19) Azuriel knew the name only as a long-dead philosopher whose works deal with truth, information and the senses.

chunks.title: Colonel Kaelix
chunks.text:
NPC: Colonel Kaelix (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-19)
Role: mercenary hall captain who registers mercenary units and records who hired whom
Faction: House Kenegal
Location: Mercenary Coordination Hall, Roma
Attitude to party: neutral, impressed by recommendations
- (2024-11-17) Raf's letter from Sarovar and Lucia's letter from her father each recommended him. He read Lucia's, then burned it as instructed, holding it burning without flinching.
- (2024-11-17) He had hired the party for the road closure earlier. He registered them and the party gave the unit name Fist of the Butterfly, with Monarch as leader and the Golden Leaf as contact.
- (2024-11-17) He explained he only records who hired whom and success or failure, not payment guarantees. House Kenegal pays his salary and can see his records, but he is bound not to favor it.
- (2024-12-01) Monarch said he hired the party and can't really speak to them as a reference. Eddie found that the Greka mercenary hall operates like Kaelix's and is also called the hall of mercenaries.
- (2025-01-19) He took the party's registration as the Fist of the Butterfly, offered to pass on their word, and agreed to send any interested rangers to the Golden Leaf.

chunks.title: Fordham
chunks.text:
NPC: Fordham (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2024-11-17)
Role: coachman and messenger for Lucia's father
Attitude to party: friendly to Lucia
- (2024-11-17) He drove Lucia secretly to her father's estate.

chunks.title: Jingle Shimmerstone
chunks.text:
NPC: Jingle Shimmerstone (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: Jingle
Role: gnome owner of Shimmerstone Shipworks hiring extra security
Faction: Shimmerstones
Location: Shimmerstone Shipworks, Greka
Attitude to party: hostile; fired them as incompetent
- (2024-11-17) Jingle posted a notice at the mercenary hall seeking extra guards for the shipworks in Greka for a limited time. He met the party at Brim's AutoKeg, hired all five for the swing shift that night, and was with Jimmy Slips.
- (2024-12-01) He is a great-grandson of Papa Shimmerstone, founder of Shimmerstone Shipworks. The GM called him stupid and said he is wrecking everything.
- (2024-12-01) He met Monarch's group at Brim's AutoKeg while Jimmy Slips was pitching him. He told the party to wait and said he would call them over, then spoke to a clockwork beetle in his pocket before signaling them.
- (2024-12-01) He interviewed the party and asked for references. Monarch named Colonel Lara and Thor of the Golden Leaf Tavern. Monarch also named Serafine, a necromancer in Spellspire. He said he would run his own investigator on them.
- (2024-12-01) He said the job is confidentiality for a high-security project and that the risk is moderately high. He said multiple major houses are curious about it. He said he scales pay to the firepower he hires: 10 to 50 gp a day at first tier, ten times that at second tier.

chunks.title: Jingle Shimmerstone (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Jingle Shimmerstone (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2024-12-01) He spoke to the beetle in his pocket during interviews, apparently ordering the clockwork staff around. He ordered notes like reeducating employees who dislike the change, upgrading observers for invisibility, and eradicating all beasts on the premises daily. A bronze scout was then seen running off.
- (2024-12-01) He said the cloud giant is a silent investor who gets the best prices, clients and political cover. He said her investment let them take bigger jobs and automate more.
- (2024-12-01) After the interviews he decided to hire the party. The contract is security for the three workshops for one week and requires them to promise lethal force and kill any intruders. Pay is 100 gp per day for the week (700) plus a 300 gp bonus if all intrusions are prevented or intruders killed. They must not enter the dry docks except in pursuit of intruders and are to be on duty tomorrow night.
- (2024-12-01) He said mercenaries tend to police spies among themselves and that corpses cannot talk. He said prisoners can escape.
- (2024-12-15) The GM said Jingle is not popular with the work staff, but he invests heavily in automation, so clockwork builders may stay loyal for the money. The party considered clearing a bat familiar with him but judged it risky because he is smart.
- (2025-01-05) About twenty minutes after the fight, Jingle arrived at night with two thugs and a sentry in standard mode. He found the sentry down and the cache box gone, then raised a general alarm and sealed the gates.

chunks.title: Jingle Shimmerstone (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Jingle Shimmerstone (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2025-01-05) He questioned everyone as a group and did not suspect an inside job. The workers from the darkened dry dock were not questioned.
- (2025-01-05) He bought the party's story of incompetence after a group Deception check (middle roll 18) against his natural 1 Insight. He fired them without back pay and wrote them off as idiots.
- (2025-01-05) He focused on the autognome who walked off site.

chunks.title: Drik
chunks.text:
NPC: Drik (first seen 2024-11-03, last seen 2024-11-17)
Role: leader of the group of killers the party turned against Valkrath
Attitude to party: helpful
- Leader of the group of killers the party turned against Valkrath.
- (2024-11-03) Drik's crew guarded the Golden Leaf's doors and windows to keep people out. They said they owed the party and had heard heavy hitters were coming.
- (2024-11-03) Drik and his crew joined the fight against Valkrath and kept onlookers away afterward.
- (2024-11-17) Monarch suggested that the name on Eddie's letter might refer to Drik, a mercenary who helped them, possibly as a nickname.

chunks.title: Azuriel
chunks.text:
NPC: Azuriel (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-10-04)
Also known as: Azure, Ziria, Israel
Location: Sultan Estate
Attitude to party: supportive
Role: chief of staff of the Sultan Estate; sorceress
- (2024-11-17) Lady Gracia asked Sir Raf to get closer to Azure/Azuriel, the chief of staff at the Sultan Estate, and watch her; she suspects Azuriel's personal motives but does not think she is disloyal to the house.
- (2024-11-17) She met Monarch at the estate gates, had a bowl of ashton pipe weed brought, and took him to an unoccupied office. She deduced the package went to a shipyard in Greka (Shimmerstone Shipworks) and wants to learn what is in it, although Octavio considers the business over.
- (2024-11-17) She said she was very interested in conjunctions, which sent a chill down Monarch's spine, and proposed a longer conversation later.
- (2024-11-17) She had arranged for Jimmy Slips to be willing to help the party find what was in the box.
- (2024-11-17) Monarch's later references to 'Ariel' and 'Israel' are garbles of her name; she is the one who pointed the party to Shimmerstone Shipworks.
- (2024-11-17) She runs logistics, security and accommodations at the Sultan Estate. She is a powerful sorceress, possibly of a draconic bloodline, and her magic is not subtle; lightning bolts were used in incursions on the estate.
- (2024-12-01) She had told Jimmy Slips to help the party with disguises and false work papers to get on-site at the shipyard. Her mission for the party is to find out what was in the box. She did not tell Jimmy exactly what she needed.

chunks.title: Azuriel (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Azuriel (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-10-04)
- (2024-12-01) Monarch listed Azuriel (or Octavio) as the person to vouch for the party's work with House Ventre, and chose Azuriel.
- (2024-12-15) The GM reminded the party that Azuriel wants verification of what was in the box and that Jimmy was referred to the party by her.
- (2025-01-05) Monarch and Portia reported that the box probably held a Saberus dragon shard for building an elemental-bound airship. Azuriel was puzzled why such a fast ship was needed, and offered personal gratitude if they learn why, and where the shards came from, since no Eberron spelljammers have docked in months.
- (2025-01-05) She said House Querid has many airships and arcanists but none of that sort, and that she and others including Octavio will be pleased by the news.
- (2025-01-05) She explained Monarch's birth convergence. An attempt to change reality was thwarted, and the chaos of its reversal went into beings born that day, so Monarch is a prism for many timelines. She warned Monarch about high-circle magic and said 'Please don't cast wish.'
- (2025-01-05) She has draconic blood with a lightning affinity, probably bronze or blue lineage. She advised Monarch to seek dragons and recommended Octavio as a mentor for Raf. Portia sensed she was withholding things about her lineage.
- (2025-01-05) She was signing documents and preparing a seating plan that kept Octavio away from Lady Antress.

chunks.title: Azuriel (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Azuriel (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-10-04)
- (2025-01-19) Monarch consulted her about Sir Saravar; she knew his name only as a dead philosopher, warned that crossing the steppe on foot is very dangerous, and explained that teleport circles cost thousands of gold and are run by rulers.
- (2025-01-19) She declined to invent a commendation for the party, saying it would smell false and would tie her house to their reputation; she judged their name not ruined, since they defeated an iron shadow and the grateful house they protected contacted her.
- (2025-12-14) Azuriel said House Ventre can send the party to its White Crown circle, that its manor wizards can bring them back, and that sending intel to Azuriel will reach the right people; she doesn't know Mirel personally and couldn't vouch.
- (2026-10-04) Eddie sent Azuriel two sendings about Norge sending hundreds of ships carrying tens of thousands, the Cherek deal with an ancient white dragon, the swiped Fenrir longship, the letters and logbooks, Icevein accepting tribute, and Rimescar's defeat.
- (2026-10-04) Azuriel first replied 'serious news if verified, big if true' and asked for the source of intel, the dragon's name, the nature of the deal and what aid is needed.
- (2026-10-04) Azuriel's second reply: Fenrir is a critical asset; return it to Roma or destroy it at all costs, with a personal guarantee of a revival attempt for any fallen.

chunks.title: Cloud Giant (Shimmerstone Shipworks partner)
chunks.text:
NPC: Cloud Giant (Shimmerstone Shipworks partner) (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2024-12-15)
Also known as: the cloud giant, smiling one
Role: masked partner/investor at Shimmerstone Shipworks
Faction: Shimmerstone Shipworks
Location: Shimmerstone Shipworks, Greka
Status: alive
- Unknown whether this is the same cloud giant as the Cloud giant of Sun Dragon — they were dressed differently, one was masked, and the other was observed at a significant distance.
- (2024-12-01) Raf and Lucia saw a cloud giant in a supervisory role at the Shipworks. The Shipworks builds airships, and cloud giants are known for flying.
- (2024-12-01) The workers do not know her name. She wears a creepy two-sided mask and joined as a partner in the last couple of months. They believe she is there to provide political cover under the Pax Titanicus.
- (2024-12-01) Jingle said she ensures good clients, good pay and no political interference. She also supplied investment capital and is discreet. Monarch saw her outside the cafeteria still wearing the two-sided mask, so her face was not seen.
- (2024-12-15) Raf and Portia, rolling history with advantage for speaking Giant, learned that masked cloud giants are called smiling ones: part diplomat, part ninja or assassin, who never show their true face and are hidden by at least two layers, a physical mask and an illusion.
- (2024-12-15) The party judged a fight with the giant unsurvivable. The GM said the giant never strayed more than about 20 feet from the darkened dry dock and did not seem to want to stay long on-site.

chunks.title: Serafine
chunks.text:
NPC: Serafine (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2024-12-01)
Role: necromancer named as a reference
Location: Spellspire, Roma
- (2024-12-01) Monarch named her to Jingle as a Spellspire necromancer who can vouch for the party's abilities.

chunks.title: Papa Shimmerstone
chunks.text:
NPC: Papa Shimmerstone (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2024-12-01)
Also known as: Fingle Shimmerstone
Role: founder of Shimmerstone Shipworks, a retired former player character
- (2024-12-01) Kyle revealed he was a former player character from the first party. In his retirement story he went off to build an airship to sail the world, then settled in Greka and started a shipbuilding business for gnomes. His great-grandson Jingle now runs it.

chunks.title: Wizen
chunks.text:
NPC: Wizen (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2024-12-15)
Also known as: Wisen, work chief
Role: work chief in Bay 3 (the pit) giving commanding orders
Faction: night shift of Bay 3
Location: northeast corner of Bay 3, Shimmerstone Shipworks
- (2024-12-15) Wizen has the firm, commanding voice among the two that give orders in Bay 3, and shouts orders to the hammer and the crane operators. He stays put in the northeast corner.
- (2024-12-15) Wizen and the night-shift workers leave the worksite before the day shift arrives.

chunks.title: Serge
chunks.text:
NPC: Serge (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2024-12-15)
Also known as: the hammer, duergar hammer
Role: duergar fused into an industrial power suit, doing heavy construction in Bay 3
Location: Bay 3 (the pit), Shimmerstone Shipworks
- (2024-12-15) Serge is a duergar in a power suit doing heavy work in the pit. In the second night's observation he fetched a crystal shard on the great Zulk's order.

chunks.title: The Great Zulk
chunks.text:
NPC: The Great Zulk (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2024-12-15)
Also known as: great Zoe
Role: whiny, grandiose voice co-directing work in Bay 3
Location: glass jar in the pit, Bay 3
- (2024-12-15) The needy voice in Bay 3 comes from something inside a glass jar that calls itself the great Zulk and commands Serge. It works alongside Wizen without conflict.
- (2024-12-15) The great Zulk told Serge to bring the smaller, darker of two crystal shards rather than the larger one, and used it for work beside him.

chunks.title: Diego
chunks.text:
NPC: Diego (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2026-10-18)
Role: Sir Raf's owl-form scout
Attitude to party: obedient to Raf
Status: dead
- (2024-12-15) Sir Raf summoned a bat familiar named Diego by spending 10 gp of incense. Raf sees through its senses, including blindsight, to scout the Shipworks.
- (2024-12-15) Diego has perception +1 (passive 11) and Wisdom 12. Clockwork observers tracked it but did not sound an alarm.
- (2024-12-15) On the second night, Diego blended in with a crowd of bats Portia had drawn, slipped near the pit, and let Raf spot the shards.
- (2025-03-16) Diego, Sir Raf's familiar, acts on his own initiative (15) in the duel with the Tyr priest; Valkyries from the priest's spell were expected to take him out.
- (2025-05-04) Diego distracted Chimeg, who took two swings and killed him with 7 damage; Kyle said Raf can summon him again tomorrow.
- (2025-08-10) Diego scouted the Hall of Feast. A strong perception roll made him certain there is a seam in the wall hiding a door disguised by a mosaic, though he cannot see color.
- (2025-08-24) Raf sent Diego to circle the brewery room, flying high. He noticed little (rolled 7) and could not pick out a chalice, since he relies on blindsight.
- (2025-09-21) Sir Raf sent Diego into the cave mouth of the rocky outcropping. Diego found about 20 dragon cultists, an archway with six dragon heads, and humanoid remains; Raf then parked him at the cave ceiling and withdrew his senses.
- (2026-02-22) Sir Raf sent Diego out in owl form to scout the mountain pass alongside Portia's owl; it rolled a 9 on perception.

chunks.title: Diego (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Diego (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-05-17) Sir Raf sent Diego (bat form) to scout Rimescar's lair within 100 feet of Monarch's clairvoyance. Rimescar saw him and breathed on him, and the sight went dark.
- (2026-07-12) Sir Raf considered sending Diego to scout the camp but decided a lone bat could be suspicious, so Portia scouted as a wolf instead.
- (2026-10-18) Sir Raf sent Diego out as an eagle to scout for the ancient white, the Cherek fleet and the silver dragon, and later as an owl at night (perception 21).

chunks.title: Detention Sentry
chunks.text:
NPC: Detention Sentry (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: sentry, detention drone, animated armor sentry
Role: automaton guard that projects a force bubble imprisoning one target
Location: locked caged room, far-right workshop, Shimmerstone Shipworks
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead; destroyed
- (2024-12-15) The sentry holds one prisoner at a time in a bubble that only dispel magic or destroying it can break; teleport and planar travel cannot pass through it. It does not react to Raf's pantomime.
- (2024-12-15) When Monarch cast Vortex Warp on it, it deployed blades, a tower shield and a magma-like fire glow, and crouched to fight Monarch.
- (2025-01-05) Monarch's Vortex Warp failed against it: it rolled a 17 on its Constitution save, and it has advantage on saves against spells. It turned aggressive, with an extensible blade and a crossbow on one arm.
- (2025-01-05) It did not open the cage door and was blocked in the doorway by Jimmy's bubble. Heavily armored, it deflected many attacks, and fire burst from Eddie's magic short sword hits.
- (2025-01-05) It hit Lucia for the max damage of 12 when she retreated, and hit Raf and Eddie for up to 10 and 12.
- (2025-01-05) Monarch's Faerie Fire gave the party advantage against it. Eddie's final hit made it explode in a fire burst: DC 14 Dexterity save, 8 fire damage. The flaming spirit that animated it left the plane.

chunks.title: Detention Sentry (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Detention Sentry (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2025-01-05) Among its fragments lay shattered pieces of a violet-blue crystal, probably a Kyber shard now useless. Its plates are worth 500 gold toward a suit of plate mail, or 250 gold if sold.

chunks.title: Winking Auto Gnome
chunks.text:
NPC: Winking Auto Gnome (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: auto gnome crane operator
Role: Bay 1 crane operator with an unusually natural walk
Location: Shimmerstone Shipworks
Attitude to party: friendly; winked at Raf
- (2024-12-15) One auto gnome with a less mechanical gait winked at Raf, who rolled a natural 20; the GM marked it as the eastern Bay 1 crane operator.
- (2024-12-15) On a later shift this auto gnome stopped its crane for a five-minute break and went into the windowless building. Silence surrounded the building; Lucia saw an electrical flash, and the auto gnome was later trapped inside the sentry's bubble.
- (2025-01-05) Autognomes helping from the dark dry dock were gathered for questioning.

chunks.title: Lady Antress
chunks.text:
NPC: Lady Antress (first seen 2025-01-05, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: Lady Entry's, Lady Antre's
Role: gossip hub of the two cities
Faction: House Ventre
Location: Greka
- (2025-01-05) Monarch (history 20) knew she is from House Ventre and lives in Greka, a hub of gossip nicknamed 'the news' whose stories spread across both cities with her spin. Octavio does not want to sit next to her.

chunks.title: Rilfael
chunks.text:
NPC: Rilfael (first seen 2025-01-05, last seen 2025-01-05)
Role: captain of the Starfallen; Kyber shard lore master
Status: alive; ship has left port
- (2025-01-05) Monarch met Rilfael, captain of the independent spelljammer Starfallen that brought the box, and could contact him later; Sending is still two levels away.

chunks.title: Dora
chunks.text:
NPC: Dora (first seen 2025-01-05, last seen 2026-02-22)
Role: Portia's owl familiar
Attitude to party: loyal
Status: alive
- (2025-01-05) Portia's bat familiar tried to deliver Shocking Grasp to the sentry. It rolled 18 and missed, got batted away by the sentry's shield, and was stabbed as it left but fled alive.
- (2025-08-10) Dora was scouted down a chimney into the Hall of Feast, where she worked out that one of the tables matches the table depicted in a mosaic covering a hidden door.
- (2025-08-24) Portia sent her owl familiar into the brewery room. A fire blast shot at it from the goo; it made a Dex save, and the GM said the 13 fire damage was halved by the save and was enough to hit it hard, since the owl has about 1 hit point.
- (2025-09-21) Dora surveyed outside the cave rather than going in, and with a 19 on Perception spotted a saddled, sleeping wyvern atop the outcropping.
- (2026-02-22) Portia sent her owl familiar Dora aloft; seeing through its eyes revealed ships offshore and, later, five winter wolves following the party. Portia kept Dora nearby to report on the wolves.

chunks.title: Clockwork Observers
chunks.text:
NPC: Clockwork Observers (first seen 2025-01-05, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: Clockwork observer, clockwork bronze scouts
