Role: drifting clockwork guards; bronze scouts are burrowing rodent-control bots
Faction: Shimmerstone Shipworks
- (2025-01-05) Observers drift randomly and have a +6 perception bonus. Portia lured them with a Druidcraft woodchuck sound, and a bronze scout burrowed to the woodpile.
- (2025-01-05) One observer was destroyed earlier by Jimmy.

chunks.title: Harriet
chunks.text:
NPC: Harriet (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-02-02)
Role: caravan master
Attitude to party: friendly, pleased with Raf
Status: alive
- (2025-01-19) She runs a six-wagon caravan to Sun Dragon, hiring about 50 mercenaries at 10 gold a day with food, travel and horse changes covered, and bonuses or profit-sharing possible.
- (2025-01-19) The party signed on as her five of fifty mercenaries; she leaves open whether they go on into the Dawnrealm, and tells them to stay close, never stop to fight, and sleep beside their horses.
- (2025-01-19) Her caravan holds special permits from the Imperium and the Dawnrealm to trade across the border; she will keep her mercenaries together and her wagon masters speak with her authority.
- (2025-02-02) Harriet gathered the commanders and said the next camp was Sokha Khan's clan, who was difficult. The caravan needed fresh horses, and Sokha Khan demanded proof of prowess through a single-combat challenge. Harriet offered 100 gold hazard pay to the volunteer.
- (2025-02-02) Harriet chose Sir Raf as champion over a rival fighter from a group that had traveled with her before, calling it a gamble. After he won she handed him 10 platinum.
- (2025-02-02) Harriet traded manufactured goods for fresh horses, with advantage on her negotiation because Raf was present, and struck a fair bargain.

chunks.title: Harriet (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Harriet (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-02-02)
- (2025-02-02) At Sun Dragon, under siege, Harriet offered to pay the party for every day they waited and went in with her; otherwise their contract ended on the last day. The party chose to wait as friends without pay, and she paid out 14 days at 140 gold each.
- (2025-02-02) After the siege broke she thanked the party. Her caravan holds a license to trade in the Dawnrealm, her first time using it, and she has traded with Dawnrealmers before.

chunks.title: Fred
chunks.text:
NPC: Fred (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-01-19)
Role: Harriet's mid-teen nephew, animal handler learning the business
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2025-01-19) He is Harriet's nephew, usually tends the animals, and is going on the trip to the Dawnrealm, nervous and excited.

chunks.title: Torg Khan
chunks.text:
NPC: Torg Khan (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-01-19)
Also known as: Torg al Khan
Role: Khan of a clan camped on the steppe
Faction: Khanates
- (2025-01-19) His clan is itching to fight the Dawnrealm and resents that the giants running the Imperium keep them out of the war.

chunks.title: Anya Redwind
chunks.text:
NPC: Anya Redwind (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-01-19)
Also known as: Ania, Anya
Role: diplomat and chief merchant of Torg Khan's clan
Faction: Torg Khan's clan, Khanates
Attitude to party: friendly; appreciates Monarch
Status: alive
- (2025-01-19) The GM spelled her name as 'Anya, a n i a, Redwind'; the GM later says 'Ania' for the same woman Monarch connected with, so Anya and Ania are the same individual.
- (2025-01-19) She handles the clan's dealings with outsiders: negotiating horse trades, speaking to imperials and to Dawnrealm individuals passing through.
- (2025-01-19) Monarch's persuasion roll (after spending Tides of Chaos) won her over; she valued having a tiny invisible magic user on their side because she understands the value of subtlety.
- (2025-01-19) She told Monarch that magic is rare among the Khanates: no wizards, a few druids, priests and occasional sorcerers, and very few spellcasters in this clan.
- (2025-01-19) Monarch gave her a druidcraft flower blossom as a keepsake and a 24-hour weather forecast; the GM ruled it would be more rain, wind and damp, the same as that day.

chunks.title: Sokha Khan
chunks.text:
NPC: Sokha Khan (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-02-02)
Role: Khan of the Red Wargs clan
Faction: Red Wargs clan, Khanates
Attitude to party: gracious hostess after the duel
Status: alive
- (2025-02-02) Sokha Khan is respected but difficult. She required a single-combat challenge before dealing for horses, to prove to her people that she deals only with the best.
- (2025-02-02) After Raf won, she let the caravan camp within her clan's perimeter and invited them to eat at their campfires.
- (2025-02-02) Her clan called a cloud giant visit purely ceremonial. Nobody questions her word on it.

chunks.title: Grock
chunks.text:
NPC: Grock (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-02-02)
Role: orcish champion of the Red Wargs
Faction: Red Wargs clan
Attitude to party: respectful after losing
Status: alive
- (2025-02-02) Grock is an orcish fighter in plate under his furs, wielding a great axe and blessed by clan shamans. He fought Raf in single combat and was bloodied by Raf's 16-damage crit.
- (2025-02-02) Grock yielded after Raf shrugged off his full turn, since the rule was to the bloodied unless both were bloodied. He praised Raf as a wily fighter.

chunks.title: Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan
chunks.text:
NPC: Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: the Khan
Role: Khan and leader of the People of the Azure Sky
Faction: People of the Azure Sky, House Mazaali
Location: Xi'an Palace
Attitude to party: friendly; gives gifts and requests their help in the ruins
Status: alive
- Leader of the People of the Azure Sky; Erden Batu, their warleader, answers to him.
- A significant figure in House Mazaali.
- Former fiancé to Lucia.
- (2025-02-02) Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan's clan has become noticeably wealthier. It is rumored to be taking payola from the Dawnrealm, to have found a secret cache in its ruins and to be secretly raiding into the Dawnrealm. It is also said to be a lapdog to Roma.
- (2025-02-16) Dagha's clan is the Tengrue Ovaag, people of the Azure Sky, who built Xi'an Palace; past great Khans came from it. Dagha is measured, steady and polite, and after the engagement was called off he invited Lucia to visit anytime.
- (2025-02-16) Dagha sent Lucia a sealed written invitation for her and her people to dine with him at Xi'an Palace that evening.
- (2025-03-02) Hosted the honor feast at Xi'an Palace; he speaks few words and silences the room with a firm welcome.
- (2025-03-02) Greeted Lucia warmly, asked what brought her, and had her introduce her friends.
- (2025-03-02) Said anyone may enter the ruins but nothing may be taken, with an escort; told Lucia to arrange the escort with Chimeg rather than ordering it himself.

chunks.title: Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-03-02) Introduced his honor council: Erden Batu, Urag Bayarmaa, Jochi, his mother, Oyun Temur, Chimeg, Tsetsen and Tomor.
- (2025-03-16) Dagha watched Lucia's first riding heat and showed surprise and appreciation, as if he had not thought she could ride.
- (2025-05-04) He invited the party into the VIP section and seemed to track Sir Raf in the tall grass when others lost sight of him.
- (2025-05-04) He gave Sir Raf a war horse and 1,000 gp as champion, and offered a gift from armaments; Raf received two potions of hill giant strength.
- (2025-05-04) He declared war on Stormgale over the attempt on Chimeg's life and the disrupted rites, to remind them who runs things, and sent the party to the ruins against the likely incursion.
- (2025-05-04) He told Lucia to come back alive; Portia and Raf read that he would be extremely sad.
- (2025-11-02) Lucia bade the Khan farewell; he said he will look her up in Roma regardless of her wishes.
- (2025-11-02) The GM described him as a duty-bound man whose nomadic sense of honor is tempered by pragmatism.
- (2025-11-02) Lucia's mirror showed him arguing with House Mazaali members from Roma at the camp, and in the Colosseum at the Ludum Imperium being backhanded by a House Marvad woman who then raised a whirlwind of dust.
- (2025-11-02) He is one of the Khans of House Mazaali, an association of Khans, and is the law where the party is camped.

chunks.title: Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-11-02) The party's report to the Khan was candid about the prison swap; he was pleased the cultists were destroyed and will watch for Dragon Cultists, given the coin drawing.

chunks.title: Ankheg
chunks.text:
NPC: Ankheg (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-02-02)
Also known as: Ankig
Role: burrowing acid-spitting monsters
Status: two killed
- (2025-02-02) Two ankhegs attacked while the party intercepted them. Eddie's guiding bolt hit for 16, Lucia's psychic blade with advantage killed the first, and Raf, grappled and bitten for 12 slashing plus 5 acid, killed the second with his rapier for 10.
- (2025-02-02) The first ankheg sprayed acid at Eddie, hitting Raf, who made a Dex save of 18 and took half of 13. Their burrows led to a nest in dung-reinforced caverns holding coins, gems and a potion.

chunks.title: Cloud giant of Sun Dragon
chunks.text:
NPC: Cloud giant of Sun Dragon (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-02-02)
Also known as: cloud giant
Role: imperial giant raiding the Dawnrealm
Location: flew back into the clouds
- Unknown whether this is the same cloud giant as the Cloud Giant (Shimmerstone Shipworks partner) — they were dressed differently, one was masked, and the other was observed at a significant distance.
- (2025-02-02) The party saw a cloud giant descend on a cloud far to the north, with booms and low lightning, then fly back up an hour later. Its landing site showed a dead battlefield of about half a dozen well-equipped ogres, a giant's footprints and lightning damage.

chunks.title: Wounded troll
chunks.text:
NPC: Wounded troll (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-02-16)
Also known as: war troll
Role: starving regenerating troll with chain weapon
Location: gully north of Sun Dragon
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-02-02) The party tracked a blood trail to a gully and found a rock blocking a hole. A starving troll with torso armor scraps and brand-new legs climbed out wielding a spiked chain with a weight, and charged them as the session ended.
- (2025-02-16) The troll charged the party with a long spiked chain, attacking with claws, bite and chain; it chained and grappled Portia twice (10 damage the first time, 5 the second) and slashed Monarch's, Sir Raf's and Portia's horses.
- (2025-02-16) The party killed it: Portia's fire bolt and burning hands, Eddie's guiding bolt (22 radiant), Lucia's sneak attack, Monarch's wild sorcerer burst of fire and Sir Raf's rapier hits; Sir Raf beheaded it. The fire cauterized its wounds so it could not regenerate.
- (2025-02-16) The GM judged it a straggler from the Dawnrealm group wiped out earlier; it had regrown itself in a cleft in the gully rocks, where it lurked and hunted. It carried no loot except its spiked chain, which the party took as a trophy.

chunks.title: Tomar
chunks.text:
NPC: Tomar (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: Tomor
Role: storyteller/bard of the Khan's council
Faction: people of the Azure Sky
Location: Xi'an Palace
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2025-02-16) Tomar had been preparing a biography of Lucia. He led the party to a campground glade with a spring and told them the Khan prizes knowledge. He said Qul'drik was built by giants yet giants forget it, and that writings tell of Ghost Roads beneath the ruins through the ethereal realm, which the people of Qul'drik walked away on.
- (2025-02-16) He mentioned a friend, the Khan's chief engineer, who found notes of adventurers about the face of the dragon artifact in Qul'drik.
- (2025-02-16) He said entry to the ruins needs the Khan's permission.
- (2025-03-02) Asked the party to consult him before entering the ruins, which vary from boring to challenging.
- (2025-03-02) Theorizes the ruins were built by giants, who forget them upon leaving, suggesting a curse; the ruins may date from the time of Anam, the Allfather who created giants. He also described a passage in the ruins to the ethereal plane.
- (2025-05-04) He recorded the match intently for his stories, and told that the Cult of the Dragon was formed to return Tiamat from the Hells and hinges on masks; old tales say passages beneath the city lead to the Underdark.

chunks.title: Jargal Khan
chunks.text:
NPC: Jargal Khan (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-03-02)
Also known as: Jargal
Faction: Stormgale Clan
Attitude to party: cordial
Status: alive
Role: Khan and leader of the Stormgale Clan
- Leads the Stormgale Clan.
- (2025-02-16) Jargal Khan (Kyle dropped the spelling of his name in chat when Monarch asked) received the party briefly as a formality when they were brought before him in camp. He is old but strong and healthy.
- (2025-02-16) His clan is wealthy, with gold, gems and silks in a Dawnrealm style, matching rumors that it trades with the Dawnrealm.
- (2025-02-16) He doubted the party would be given access to the Ruins of Qul'drik, which the people of the Azure Sky control, and asked whether they had western or Elven wines. He then turned back to the person he had been talking to.
- (2025-02-16) Locals said he always treats even important talks as trivial chats, as a tactic to put the other party on the back foot.
- (2025-03-02) Tsetsen said the Stormgale clan is backed by the Dawnrealm and may be after the ruins.

chunks.title: Khan Sir Saravio
chunks.text:
NPC: Khan Sir Saravio (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: the matriarch, mom, the Khan's mother
Role: matriarch of the Azure Sky council
Faction: People of the Azure Sky
Location: Xi'an Palace
Attitude to party: watchful; approving of the mercenary bounty talk
- (2025-03-02) Sits at the Khan's right (Lucia's left), whispers to him constantly and monitors every conversation; she wears astounding gem-work bracelets hidden under her sleeves, making her the richest in the room.
- (2025-03-02) She was the one who spoke with Lucia's family about ending the engagement; she is very sharp and takes the long view of the clan.
- (2025-03-02) She smiled when Batu offered spot bounties to mercenaries who extract interlopers, and seemed to have prompted Tsetsen's talk with Monarch. She was mildly, professionally disgusted by Monarch's flirtation with Oyun.
- (2025-05-04) Portia druidcrafted flowers and gave them to the matriarch, who accepted them and tucked them into the armor of her chair as a sprig, nodding.
- (2025-05-04) Lucia read her with an insight check of 6: she sat so motionless that Lucia wondered if she was asleep, her eyes narrowed to slits, unclear whether drowsy or hiding where she was looking.
- (2025-05-04) She sat with the Khan's council at the evening meeting.

chunks.title: Urag Bayarmaa
chunks.text:
NPC: Urag Bayarmaa (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: the shamaness, the sky speaker, the mystic, the shaman
Role: shamanic priestess and seer of the People of the Azure Sky
Faction: People of the Azure Sky
Status: alive
- The shamanic priestess and seer of the People of the Azure Sky.
- Warned of something awakening beneath Qul'drik.
- (2025-03-02) Speaks to the sky and conveys its messages; she speaks rarely and watches the whole room.
- (2025-03-02) Spoke Sylvan then Elvish to Portia and Eddie; Portia messaged her and she replied briefly. She told a saga of a sleeping colossus that awakens and destroys the world, implying something enormously powerful slumbers beneath the ruins and must not be woken, and advised being careful what you awaken.
- (2025-03-02) Moved to sit between Portia and Eddie; the table noted her connection to the Platinum Dragon.
- (2025-03-16) Before Sir Raf's spell duel, the mystic from the dinner waved a wand over him and dispelled spells of third level or lower, ending his earlier Aid.
- (2025-04-20) As the shaman, hurled fire at the invisible vortex during the clan's assault, helping destroy it.
- (2025-04-20) The shaman Urag identified the creature as an invisible stalker, an evil air elemental summoned for assassination and murder that does not normally glow. Her testimony convinced the clan that Monarch had not summoned it.

chunks.title: Urag Bayarmaa (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Urag Bayarmaa (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
- (2025-05-04) She had a hawk she spoke to and sent into the sky before the match, then closed her eyes as if elsewhere; when Eddie asked to cast invisibility she returned to herself, watched him cast it, and resumed focusing on the bird.
- (2025-05-04) The shaman has no one at her beck and call but her advice is important to the Khan.
- (2025-05-04) She warned the party that the giants of the ruins are the giants of old, children of Aman the Allfather and creators of rune magic; today's giants are fallen, and the party should be careful of anything written because the old giants stored their power in runes and words.
- (2025-05-04) She felt something old and immense stirring beneath the city, possibly a remnant of what lived there before, and hopes it can be stopped from waking or put back to sleep.

chunks.title: Jochi
chunks.text:
NPC: Jochi (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-03-02)
Also known as: Joshi, Joe Chi, Jocci, lord of horse
Role: lord of horse; falconer
Faction: people of the Azure Sky
Attitude to party: friendly, grateful for help
- (2025-03-02) Young, cheerful, boisterous horse expert who advised Sir Raf on horses and falconry; he can talk to his falcons.
- (2025-03-02) His falcons report humanoid groups of four to six skulking in the upper ruins, but riders sent out find nobody and no one believes him.
- (2025-03-02) Accepted Portia's offer to wild shape and corroborate falcon sightings.

chunks.title: Oyun Temur
chunks.text:
NPC: Oyun Temur (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: Oyun, the tinker
Role: orc artificer and decipherer of the ruins
Faction: people of the Azure Sky
Attitude to party: friendly, awkward
- (2025-03-02) Orc fidgeter wearing gadget accessories; he makes inventions and studies items from the ruins, and doesn't travel.
- (2025-03-02) Said writings indicate an artifact in the deep ruins connecting to the elemental plane of air, a ladder to the sky for commanding air creatures; he wants it found before others take it.
- (2025-03-02) Played along clumsily with Monarch's flirtation cover, then privately told her he forged a blade for Chimeg from true steel brought from below; it whispers to her at night and he fears something lives in it.
- (2025-05-04) He believes a powerful artifact tied to the power of the sky lies in the city, and his blade has begun whispering.

chunks.title: Sets'en
chunks.text:
NPC: Sets'en (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: Setson, spymaster, Tsetsen
Role: spymaster of the Khan's council
Faction: House Mazaali, people of the Azure Sky
Attitude to party: cooperative
- (2025-03-02) Presents as whatever gender fits; tonight appears as a man, and is an expert at disguise; a legitimate diplomat and legitimate spymaster.
- (2025-03-02) Asked Monarch whether the party were mercenaries, and said the Stormgale clan, backed by the Dawnrealm, may seize the ruins by year's end unless the alliance is sabotaged. The party concluded he wants Stormgale's Dawnrealm link severed, covertly, as some Azure Sky members may be on the Dawnrealm payroll.
- (2025-03-02) Holds a captured Dawnrealm noblewoman prisoner to trade later; her escort was killed.
- (2025-03-02) Visited the party's camp disguised as an old woman and warned that an attempt will be made on Chimeg's life during the contest.
- (2025-05-04) He slipped away from the stands during the match.
- (2025-05-04) In disguise he showed Monarch a brass amulet of the Cult of the Dragon found at the Easterling mage's abandoned campsite, perceived Monarch dancing around something, and shared the amulet with the party.
- (2025-05-04) He reported that up to 10 people had stayed at the campsite, though only a couple were seen.

chunks.title: Chimeg
chunks.text:
NPC: Chimeg (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-11-02)
Role: champion of the Azure Sky; party guide
Faction: people of the Azure Sky
Attitude to party: cooperative
Status: alive
Location: Hall of Feasts
- (2025-02-16) She greeted the party on the Khan's behalf, saying they were known and could come to the palace tomorrow and camp anywhere. She is a scarred battlefield warrior used to giving orders, and seemed to welcome them only under orders.
- (2025-03-02) Sarcastic to everyone, and has entered the ruins over a dozen times and returned.
- (2025-03-02) Gained a flicker of respect for the party after Sir Raf's report of Sun Dragon, then snark returned; she tested his troll claim with questions.
- (2025-03-02) Announced the Storm's Challenge, a three-day warriors contest, and is running it.
- (2025-03-02) Equated by the table with Chimeg, the sharp-tongued woman at the feast.
- (2025-03-02) Tsetsen believes an attempt will be made on her life under cover of the contest.
- (2025-03-16) Chimeg ran onto the field herself and tackled a contestant who refused to give quarter when asked during the battle magic duels; he surrendered at once and was dragged off and ejected.
- (2025-03-16) After the tackle she looked under the weather, tired and sitting down a lot, with no obvious diagnosis; Eddie's medicine check found nothing clear and Lucia's check (15) suggested a possible low-dose poison meant to leave her weakened for later.

chunks.title: Chimeg (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Chimeg (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-03-16) Lucia warned her that this was no accident, and Chimeg brushed it off, saying she would personally make sure the party earns it in tomorrow's duels to quarter, implying she intends to fight at least one of them.
- (2025-04-20) Entered the tower in half-plate armor with a huge curved greatsword and a heavy crossbow, no shield; fired the crossbow twice per turn at Sir Raf, who evaded with Shield and Blade Ward.
- (2025-04-20) Portia sent her a Message warning of an invisible creature in the tower; Chimeg reflexively glanced around but did not reply.
- (2025-04-20) The invisible stalker attacked her for 13 and 6 piercing (19 total), later grappled her with its vortex for 10 thunder, and left her bloodied.
- (2025-04-20) Used her reaction to hit the vortex with her greatsword (a crit, 18 damage, then 14) and fought it side by side with Sir Raf once he attacked it.
- (2025-04-20) Told Sir Raf they will need to do their challenge again tomorrow; she accepted his healing potion as a gift per protocol but did not drink it.
- (2025-05-04) In the rescheduled final match she opened with a readied heavy crossbow shot and fired through the palisade gaps, hitting AC 16 and 15 and missing Sir Raf; she climbed into the tower, killed Diego with two swings (7 damage) and was bloodied by Sir Raf's attacks.
- (2025-05-04) She used her action surge and a blood rage with advantage but never connected for real damage on Sir Raf, then cooled her rage and asked quarter.

chunks.title: Chimeg (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Chimeg (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-05-04) Kyle explained she participated in the first challenge, has presided over the last four, and entered this time due to the party's unusual nature; she generally leads expeditions into the ruins.
- (2025-05-04) She told Sir Raf his tactics are not how she would do it but are undeniably effective, and warned that ruin hazards do not bend to trickery.
- (2025-05-04) She briefed the party on ruin survival: hide and protect rest sites, use gray stone cloaks and blankets, stay quiet, avoid staring at spirits; she has never seen the dragon mask and never brings an extra horse.
- (2025-05-04) She guides the party toward the Ruins of Qul'drik, camped on a hilltop she had used, and killed the land shark with two greatsword hits (9 and 12).
- (2025-05-18) Chimeg led the party across open ground toward the Ruins of Qul'drik; Portia cast pass without trace and the group stealth result was 27, so nothing from the sky saw them.
- (2025-05-18) Chimeg said she hadn't seen any masks in the ruins, and was willing to help chase out the intruders, saying the party had earned the right to look for their mask.
- (2025-05-18) In the fight with the half dragon, Chimeg charged with her greatsword and was held by the fanatic's hold person; the hold ended when Lucia's hits broke the fanatic's concentration. She took 23 from the half dragon's fire breath, killed a cultist, and hit the half dragon repeatedly. She was down about 24 hit points, and Eddie's aura of vitality healed 12.

chunks.title: Chimeg (part 4)
chunks.text:
NPC: Chimeg (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-06-01) Chimeg stepped into the library with her greatsword readied, took two crossbow shots at the twig blights (A and E), killing both, and fought the shambling mound with her readied attacks and greatsword.
- (2025-06-01) Monarch cast Enlarge on Chimeg, which made her Large and added an extra d4 weapon damage; she hit the shambling mound for 24 across two swings and then 26 on a crit, and later tore vines off the bookshelves.
- (2025-06-01) The lightning creature crit Chimeg for 50 damage (43 after Eddie's temporary hit points) and bloodied her; Eddie healed her with Cure Wounds for 24, leaving her about 19 down.
- (2025-06-01) Chimeg called the giant stone constructs stonewalkers: purely destructive, no reasoning, no way known to calm or defeat them; the best response is to outrun them, which is why poachers lose their horses. They have no concept of friend or foe, are tireless, and move at a single speed.
- (2025-06-15) Chimeg waited in the hall leaning on her greatsword while the party worked the Orrery room. She said the People of the Azure Sky has no clear map of the ruins, having only mined the intact buildings, and that clans never clear wide roads as the cult did, partly because of griffins.
- (2025-07-27) Chimeg said the party has never retrieved a legendary item from the ruins, because her people stay on the surface and avoid the deep inside, where truly dangerous things are. Those who said they would go deeper were never seen again.

chunks.title: Chimeg (part 5)
chunks.text:
NPC: Chimeg (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-07-27) Chimeg favored the Hall of Blades as the place to look for a legendary item. Monarch's Insight check (11) found no deception in her. Her hand rested on her greatsword while she spoke of the hall.
- (2025-07-27) In the Hall of Blades Chimeg walked to the pedestal to offer her own truth, and nobody stopped her. A shadow-smoking longsword, borne by a smoking fire giant spirit, drifted toward the pedestal while the other blades parted before it. Her greatsword began smoking and flickering with shadow flames in answer.
- (2025-08-10) As Chimeg approached the pedestal in the Hall of Blades, a ghostly giant keeper carried a shadow-flame greatsword toward her, and her own greatsword began flickering with matching shadowy flame.
- (2025-08-10) The keeper hit Chimeg for 28 (Eddie's Guardian Emblem turned a crit into a normal hit) plus 18, leaving her bloodied. A later hit dropped her unconscious. Raf fed her a Potion of Healing (rolled 2+2 = 4), and Eddie healed her with Cure Wounds (12 and 15) and gave temporary hit points.
- (2025-08-10) After the keeper was destroyed, Chimeg said her mind was clearer and that the sword had grown on her. She did not want it and said she would keep a close eye on anyone carrying it.
- (2025-08-10) To stop the swords attacking the party, Chimeg picked up Black Razor and shouted 'stand down, these are all friends'; the swords stopped. She rolled a natural 20 on her Charisma save and dropped the sword at once.

chunks.title: Chimeg (part 6)
chunks.text:
NPC: Chimeg (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-08-24) Chimeg stayed up top at first and came down later. In the black pudding fight she climbed a barrel and hit an ooze twice for 11 each (22 total), bloodying it, then missed twice on a later turn. Against the challenger she fired a crossbow, and the ghost resisted the damage.
- (2025-08-24) Monarch's Wild Magic effect gave vulnerability to piercing damage to everyone within 30 feet of her, Chimeg included.
- (2025-09-21) Chimeg scowled when asked about cooking. In the potion ooze fight she fired a crossbow repeatedly, hitting for 11 and 12 and then 24, and 18 on later rounds, and helped finish the oozes.
- (2025-10-05) Chimeg had been watching from the sidelines, joined the cave fight with her crossbow and greatsword and downed a fanatic, but failed her save against the Dreamcaster's mass suggestion.
- (2025-10-19) Eddie's Dispel Magic made Chimeg shake off the suggestion; she nodded acknowledgment and said it had felt really important to get back to the con.
- (2025-10-19) Chimeg fired her crossbow at the Dreamcaster (7 damage in melee; shots of 22 with advantage) and landed the fatal bolts.
- (2025-10-19) She saved against the psychic blast (17) and did not answer the dragons' question.
- (2025-11-02) Chimeg witnessed the Black Razor swap, kept her own counsel, and said she will send scouts to the ruins.

chunks.title: Hedge wizard
chunks.text:
NPC: Hedge wizard (first seen 2025-03-16, last seen 2025-03-16)
Also known as: local mage
Role: spell duel opponent of Sir Raf
Faction: People of the Azure Sky locals
- (2025-03-16) Sir Raf's local hedge wizard opponent in the battle magic duel cast Hold Person repeatedly and shocking grasp (critical hits on the paralyzed Raf, 10 and 6 damage), mage armor, shield and magic missile. He ran out of spell slots and asked for quarter, which Raf granted.

chunks.title: Dawnrealm-robed mage
chunks.text:
NPC: Dawnrealm-robed mage (first seen 2025-03-16, last seen 2025-03-16)
Also known as: red-robed mage
Role: spell duel opponent of Monarch
- (2025-03-16) Monarch's opponent wore ornate red robes in the Dawnrealm style. He cast scorching ray, which Monarch's Shield blocked, and then lightning bolt, which dropped Monarch (26 HP) with 27 damage, so he won by about four hit points.
- (2025-03-16) After winning he looked full of self-recrimination, as if he really did not want to do that, before composing himself.

chunks.title: Priest of Tyr
chunks.text:
NPC: Priest of Tyr (first seen 2025-03-16, last seen 2025-03-16)
Also known as: tier priest
Role: spell duel opponent of Portia, then Sir Raf
Faction: northern priest of Tyr, god of law
- (2025-03-16) Portia identified him as a priest of the Norse law god Tyr, from the North.
- (2025-03-16) He beat Portia down to 1 HP with radiant flame, then healed her for 25 after she asked quarter and ended with 100% hit points, forcing a tiebreak bonus duel with Sir Raf.
- (2025-03-16) In the tiebreak he cast Spirit Guardians-like Valkyries (8 radiant to Raf), healed himself, and cast Hold Person once. Raf cast mind sliver and he asked for quarter, so Raf won first place.

chunks.title: Gogo
chunks.text:
NPC: Gogo (first seen 2025-03-16, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: Gorgo, Gorgol
Role: rival contestant in the all-five event
Status: alive
- (2025-03-16) Gogo scored 39 after two riding heats and was named a competitive contender for the overall.
- (2025-03-16) In the riding event he rolled 21, 18 and 24 for a total of 63, losing the event to Monarch, who scored 68; he came second.
- (2025-03-16) In the shooting event he performed badly, was weak at archery, and was out of the overall contention (the GM described him as a good horseman but not as good an archer).
- (2025-05-04) He still hung around Eddie and could take a seat as his plus one.

chunks.title: Invisible Stalker
chunks.text:
NPC: Invisible Stalker (first seen 2025-04-20, last seen 2025-04-20)
Also known as: vortex, glowing demon, air daemon
Role: invisible stalker summoned to assassinate Chimeg during the Warrior's Challenge
Status: destroyed
- (2025-04-20) A creature of swirling air and sharp claws entered the arena corner naturally invisible; Eddie, with See Invisibility, spotted it crossing the fence.
- (2025-04-20) Monarch's Faerie Fire lit it up so everyone could see it; it then attacked Chimeg, mimicking piercing weapons, and Sir Raf shot it for 8 and 13 and stabbed it for 15 and 13.
- (2025-04-20) The crowd, shamans and leaders loosed arrows and spells and destroyed it; seven of ten arrows hit.
- (2025-04-20) The shaman Urag identified it as an invisible stalker, an air elemental summoned for assassination that normally does not glow, which cleared Monarch of having summoned it.

chunks.title: Stormgale clan agent
chunks.text:
NPC: Stormgale clan agent (first seen 2025-04-20, last seen 2025-04-20)
Also known as: Stormgale clan member
Faction: Stormgale clan
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: defeated; captured or left to the outsiders
- (2025-04-20) A Stormgale clansman walked casually back toward the crowd from a spot with flattened swirled grass, apparently having summoned the stalker; Eddie hit him with Guiding Bolt for 16 and he held concentration with a 20.
- (2025-04-20) He hauled out a greataxe, attacked Eddie for 7 slashing, and was defeated by Eddie with the crowd's help.
- (2025-04-20) The clan ruled the fight an outsiders' matter and let Eddie handle him.

chunks.title: Easterling mage
chunks.text:
NPC: Easterling mage (first seen 2025-04-20, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: mage in the corner, Dawnrealm mage, east wing mage
Attitude to party: unknown; watched closely
Status: gone; fled in a hurry
Faction: Dawnrealm forces
- (2025-04-20) Watched Eddie's and Monarch's fights intently with hands in his sleeves, was seen casting a Sending-like spell before Raf's match, and looked vexed when the plan went wrong but did not intervene.
- (2025-05-04) He disappeared overnight and was not seen at the match; Sets'en found the amulet he dropped.
- (2025-05-04) A Dawnrealm agent tied to the Cult of the Dragon: the Khan said he was from the Dawnrealm and may have been playing the Stormgale clan for his own ends, and a Cult of the Dragon amulet was found at his abandoned camp.

chunks.title: Ardeg
chunks.text:
NPC: Ardeg (first seen 2025-03-16, last seen 2025-05-04)
Role: all-round competitor in the Azure Sky's Warrior's Challenge
Status: alive
- The all-round competitor the party faced in the Azure Sky's Warrior's Challenge.
- Placed third behind Raf and Eddie for the championship; those three were the only ones who qualified for that title.
- Used no magic, only physical skill and cunning.
- Ardeg is a woman (she/her).
- (2025-03-16) Ardeg scored 44 after two heats of the riding event; the GM called her one of the competitive contestants going for the all-round.
- (2025-03-16) In the riding event's final heat she rolled a regular attack of 12; the GM said it was disappointing but still passed the event.
- (2025-03-16) In the shooting event she did poorly after her strong riding showing; she scored 14 in the long-range heat.
- (2025-03-16) In the shooting rapid-fire heat she totaled exactly 40, which kept her in the event for the overall.
- (2025-04-20) No longer a championship contender but entered the final event for glory; won her run in about eight rounds ending at about half hit points, placing behind Eddie.
- (2025-05-04) She was the closest to qualifying in all events but lost to Sir Raf in close-quarters combat.

chunks.title: Khanate warrior
chunks.text:
NPC: Khanate warrior (first seen 2025-04-20, last seen 2025-04-20)
Role: defender, Monarch's opponent
Attitude to party: friendly after being charmed
- (2025-04-20) Failed repeatedly to climb the palisade, was charmed by Monarch, and agreed to stage a believable fight; Monarch bloodied him with Chill Touch and he surrendered after one last swing.

chunks.title: Erden Batu
chunks.text:
NPC: Erden Batu (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: Batu, war leader, general Batu
Role: warleader of the People of the Azure Sky
Faction: People of the Azure Sky
Attitude to party: open to help, practical
- Warleader for the People of the Azure Sky, the clan that controls access to the ruins of Qul'drik; he answers to Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan.
- (2025-03-02) Loud-voiced, scarred general who talks logistics and cavalry; sits at the Khan's shield hand.
- (2025-03-02) The Khan introduced him as the general of his armies who has led many victories.
- (2025-03-02) Will not detach a force on a falcon's word alone and wants solid scouted details; the ruins' defense is patrolling the open ground so nothing leaves unseen.
- (2025-03-02) Said he would pay spot bounties to mercenaries who extract interlopers from the ruins.
- (2025-05-04) He will lead the response against Stormgale and advised traveling in haze and mist, moving quickly, and watching for griffins, a chimera and a manticore.

chunks.title: Land Shark
chunks.text:
NPC: Land Shark (first seen 2025-05-04, last seen 2025-05-04)
Role: chitinous burrowing predator
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-05-04) It leapt onto the campsite hill at night, bit Sir Raf for 20 and 14 and 15 damage, and was killed by Chimeg's greatsword hits of 9 and 12.

chunks.title: Half dragon
chunks.text:
NPC: Half dragon (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-05-18)
Also known as: red half dragon, scaly biped
Role: cult servitor leading the cult party
Faction: Dragon cult
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-05-18) A large red-scaled biped with a dragon's head, smoke from its nostrils and a fire breath cone. It leapt about 30 feet to land and breathed fire at Sir Raf, hitting Monarch's space with the cone's edge. Monarch made her save against the 26 fire damage, and later Sir Raf, Chimeg and Eddie were hit with another breath.
- (2025-05-18) It was bloodied after about 55 damage and was resistant or immune to fire. Monarch's wild sorcerer's burst killed it with 9 poison damage. It carried nothing.
- (2025-05-18) Kyle described it as the product of a ritual by which chromatic dragons infuse followers with their essence, making half dragons; it spoke Turkana-like language, and its tracks were seen in the outskirts of the ruins.

chunks.title: Dragon cult fanatic
chunks.text:
NPC: Dragon cult fanatic (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-10-05)
Also known as: fanatic, cult spellcaster, cultist fanatic
Role: leader of cult squad; caster with purple rank mark
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-05-18) The fanatic cast hold person on Chimeg and split its fiery dagger into a floating flaming dagger; Lucia hit it with psychic blade attacks and a 32 sneak-attack crit, killing it.
- (2025-05-18) The fanatic carried an explorer's pack, a Cult of the Dragon symbol, and a hand-drawn map labeled Tower of Storms; her notes said she expected clues to the dragon mask's location in the basement. The writing was in a Dawnrealm script, and she carried Dawnrealm coins with holes.
- (2025-10-05) Fanatics used hold person (Raf and Eddie resisted), a Halt command on Raf, spiritual weapons and necrotic blades; one fell to Monarch's 26-damage lightning bolt and the other to Chimeg.

chunks.title: Dragon cultists
names: Dawnrealm-equipped dragonborn and lizardfolk cult group
chunks.text:
NPC: Dragon cultists (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: cultists, Dawnrealm cultists, Dawnrealm-equipped dragonborn and lizardfolk cult group, scale tooth, scouts, lizard folk
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: mostly dead
Role: about ten climbers, cultists, lizardfolk, and archer scouts trying to ascend the Tower of Runes
Location: cave under the rocky outcropping near the Hall of Scales
- (2025-05-18) Four cultists in light armor with flame-shaped, fire-crackling daggers ran up behind the half dragon; the daggers stopped flaming when they died. Eddie's moonbeam killed two, and the others attacked Monarch's displacer beast illusion. They seem to be Dawnrealmers by clothing and writing.
- (2025-07-13) The group used a runestone guardian as a lift to reach the Tower of Runes' lowest stone, 10 feet off the ground, and several fell or were scorched dead.
- (2025-07-13) Portia's fireball (DC 14) killed three of four cultists and the group's casters fell in the fight; Monarch killed a cultist with a critical wild magic psychic hit (24 damage).
- (2025-07-13) Hidden scouts shot at Eddie and Chimeg and then fled. One was bloodied and eluded Monarch's faerie fire. The other escaped; Monarch told the party he resisted charm.
- (2025-09-21) About 20 cultists are camped in the cave with horses; they are organized, take orders, and look like imperials rather than Dawnrealm operatives. They are apparently trying to get through the ornate archway at the back.

chunks.title: Dragon cultists (part 2)
names: Dawnrealm-equipped dragonborn and lizardfolk cult group
chunks.text:
NPC: Dragon cultists (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-09-21) The GM said the Cult of the Dragon is not exclusively a Dawnrealm operation: some cultists, like the earlier group, came from the Dawnrealm, while the cave group look like imperials.
- (2025-10-05) Two cultist minders led horses out of the cave to graze; Eddie's longbow shot dropped one (13 damage) and Lucia's longbow dropped the other (24 damage).
- (2025-10-05) Portia's fireball (DC 14) into the cave killed or hurt most of the cultists at the back table; surviving cultists charged out with ritual sickles and many were killed by Lucia, Monarch's lightning bolt and the half white dragon's frost breath.
- (2025-10-19) The cultists carried only mundane adventuring gear; the cave held about half a dozen more bedrolls than bodies, so stragglers might return.

chunks.title: Lightning guardian
chunks.text:
NPC: Lightning guardian (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-06-01)
Also known as: storm guardian, 10-foot lightning creature, lightning creature
Location: first room off the circular corridor in the Tower of Storms basement
Attitude to party: hostile
Role: guardian in the first room off the circular corridor, Tower of Storms basement
Status: missing
- (2025-05-18) A 10-foot bipedal creature made of lightning stands in a room with five giant chests. Kyle said it was oriented toward the party and intensified, but it said nothing and did not attack. Sir Raf hailed it and the party closed the door.
- (2025-06-01) It lunged at Sir Raf the moment he crossed the threshold and initiative was rolled. Lucia's quick hand let her act first, and her psychic blades did damage.
- (2025-06-01) It is immune to prone, resistant to rapier damage, took no damage from Sir Raf's thunder or lightning from Booming Blade, and is affected by psychic, fire and radiant damage.
- (2025-06-01) Its turns included a lightning bolt (Sir Raf and Eddie failed their Dex saves, Monarch made hers, 26 damage), a bonus-action teleport next to the party in a burst of lightning, and slam attacks on Portia (14 bludgeoning plus 16 lightning, resisted) and Chimeg (crit for 50).
- (2025-06-01) Monarch's Tasha's Mind Whip hit it twice, once for 11 and once for half of 17, removing its reactions. Sir Raf's Mind Sliver did 8 psychic. Eddie's Guiding Bolt did 18 radiant.

chunks.title: Lightning guardian (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Lightning guardian (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-06-01)
- (2025-06-01) Portia's upcast burning hands blasted it and it vanished with a crackle of lightning and a thunderclap; it was gone rather than shown dead.

chunks.title: Vine mass in the library
chunks.text:
NPC: Vine mass in the library (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-05-18)
Also known as: roots and vines
Location: overgrown library in the Tower of Storms basement
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-05-18) Opening the door scraped some tendrils; vines surged toward the party, and something larger lurked in the back. The session ended on this.

chunks.title: Shambling mound
chunks.text:
NPC: Shambling mound (first seen 2025-06-01, last seen 2025-06-01)
Also known as: big ugly, shambling mount, large central mass
Role: arcane-charged plant monster in the Tower of Storms library
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-06-01) A huge central mass of vines infused with arcane energy, wrapped around rune stones and book pages and crackling with electricity, surged out of the vine pile. Portia's Nature check identified it as a shambling mound.
- (2025-06-01) It is immune to lightning and grows stronger from it, and resists fire and cold. Portia's fireball did 24 half-damage, which it largely shrugged off.
- (2025-06-01) It makes three attacks with a 10-foot reach, dealing 9 bludgeoning plus 5 lightning and pulling Medium or smaller targets 5 feet toward itself. It hit Sir Raf through his Shield spell at 24 but did not grapple him.
- (2025-06-01) Portia's burning hands finished it. The remaining vine blights then collapsed and went inert.

chunks.title: Twig, needle and vine blights
chunks.text:
NPC: Twig, needle and vine blights (first seen 2025-06-01, last seen 2025-06-01)
Also known as: blights, twig blights, needle blights, vine blights
Role: plant minions in the Tower of Storms library
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-06-01) The overgrown library was full of blights: small spindly twig blights, thicker vine blights, and needle blights covered in thorns. They have no eyes but blindsight 60 feet, and they are vulnerable to fire.
- (2025-06-01) A needle blight shot thorns at Sir Raf in the doorway for 13 damage on a crit, absorbed by his temporary hit points; Sir Raf killed that blight with a longbow shot for 11.
- (2025-06-01) Lucia's sneak attack crit did 5 times a blight's hit points, destroying one. All the blights died or went inert once the shambling mound fell.

chunks.title: Stone construct
chunks.text:
NPC: Stone construct (first seen 2025-06-01, last seen 2025-06-01)
Also known as: stonewalker, giant stone thing
Role: roaming construct in the ruins
Location: forest northwest of the Tower of Storms
Attitude to party: hostile (indifferent so far)
Status: alive
- (2025-06-01) During the night watch Lucia heard heavy footfalls and trees snapping to the northwest. She sneaked out and saw a 15-20 foot humanoid made of huge construction stones with glowing runes, shoving trees over. It seemed to glance her way for a moment but went on walking.
- (2025-06-01) Chimeg identified such creatures as stonewalkers.

chunks.title: Tiamat
chunks.text:
NPC: Tiamat (first seen 2025-06-15, last seen 2026-07-12)
Also known as: Tiamat's aspect, dread mother
Role: five-headed chromatic dragon deity, imprisoned in Avernus, first of the nine hells
Status: imprisoned
Attitude to party: offering to carry Eddie
- (2025-06-15) Lucia's mirror vision showed what looked like a negotiation between giants and an aspect of Tiamat in the city, with shows of force. Tiamat permitted the giants to remove one scale of each color.
- (2025-06-15) Books recovered from the giants' chest say Tiamat is imprisoned on Avernus. The dragon masks were part of the binding and are the keys to freeing her, perhaps just a couple or all five. A blue mask gives influence over blue dragons.
- (2025-06-15) Sources disagree on whether she is a true god or an Asmodeus-level being. Some equate her with Kyber, and the imprisoned dragon may be an aspect of a primal force.
- (2025-07-27) Eddie's dream scar came from Tiamat, who called him 'born of my breath, born to bring death' and clawed him when he chose Hades over her.
- (2025-07-27) Raf stated the party's aim as preventing Tiamat's return. Arcana study suggested the Dragon Mask is a power source for the prison. Removing it without a replacement could be very detrimental.
- (2025-10-19) While Eddie helped Raf climb, Tiamat's dream-voice offered 'speak my name marked and chosen, and you shall be conveyed on my wings'. Eddie said her name and sprouted dragon wings with a 30 ft fly speed for ten minutes and bluish scales; he felt disappointment and disconnection, and Hades' eyes were upon him.

chunks.title: Tiamat (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Tiamat (first seen 2025-06-15, last seen 2026-07-12)
- (2025-10-19) The mark on Eddie's shoulder blade glowed dim blue after this. Augury revealed the otherworldly entity answering was the same one who gave him wings.
- (2025-11-02) The GM said the dragon masks are said to each be made from a single scale of Tiamat; they are sought by Dragon Cultists.
- (2026-05-17) Monarch learned in the library that the dragon masks are used in a ritual to free Tiamat from her planar prison, that only two masks are needed, and that each mask is destroyed when an ancient dragon of its color willingly casts wish to destroy it. Monarch was nearly killed by Tiamat's breath weapon there.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae said Tiamat's return would begin the reign of dragons, and most dragons would be strengthened by it.
- (2026-07-12) Dragon cultists seal deals with 'in the name of the dread mother' answered by 'by the blood of the dread mother'; Monarch knew this from Dragon Cult research and a religion check, and it binds both parties to Tiamat.
- (2026-07-12) Monarch said she saw an aspect of Tiamat that downed her in one breath weapon, and a mushroom man saved her.

chunks.title: Imprisoned Devil in the Chest
chunks.text:
NPC: Imprisoned Devil in the Chest (first seen 2025-06-15, last seen 2025-06-15)
Also known as: devil in the box, box guy, the devil inside
Role: common, low-ranking kind of devil trapped in a giant's ornate chest in the wizard's study
Location: ornate chest in the wizard's study, Tower of Storms basement
Attitude to party: guarded; promised nothing
Status: alive, still locked in the chest
- (2025-06-15) The chest banged incessantly. Monarch's clairvoyance showed a wiry, long-limbed, tailed biped studded with thorns and shards of glass and metal, crouched amid broken vials and ash. It held a ball of fire between its hands and watched the lid.
- (2025-06-15) Monarch judged it to look like the devilish figure in the mural handing a mask to the giants. The GM said that figure was a common line-trooper type of devil, so this is that category, not necessarily the same individual.
- (2025-06-15) Through Monarch's Message spell it said it was betrayed and seeks only to return. Asked whether it could be freed from outside, it answered 'It is no spell. It is my nature. I will leave and return home.' Monarch noted it promised nothing, and devils exploit loopholes.
- (2025-06-15) Asked about the masks, it said some are missing and were stolen, perhaps by one like it, but not by it: 'I keep my word.'
- (2025-06-15) The party left it locked in. Monarch chose not to speak to it again, wanting it to believe she died in the orb explosion, to avoid earning its enmity.

chunks.title: Shmuck
chunks.text:
NPC: Shmuck (first seen 2025-06-15, last seen 2025-06-15)
Role: Monarch's joking nickname for the sharp-edged devil in the chest
- (2025-06-15) Monarch jokingly called the sharp-edged devil in the chest 'shmuck' and said they would leave Shmuck behind; the GM echoed the word. It is a nickname for the chest devil, not a separate being.

chunks.title: Jubilex
chunks.text:
NPC: Jubilex (first seen 2025-06-15, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: Faceless Lord, Juplex, Duplex
Role: as giant
Status: imprisoned
Location: prison below the Hall of Scales portal
- (2025-06-15) The GM said the shifting shapeless mass the giants fought and bound could be Jubilex or an aspect of it. In the mirror vision it shifted between liquid, gel and solid and expressed acid, lightning and fire.
- (2025-06-15) Lucia recited the poem from the vision: 'The rhyme must never be spoken. Her minions must not find the token, lest both great prisons be broken and faceless lord reawoken.'
- (2025-06-15) The GM said 'faceless lord' is another way to refer to the demon lord Jubilex (transcribed Duoblex), who rules half of a layer of the abyss shared with Zuggtmoy. It is shapeless and generally viewed as incomprehensible, but has motives, minions and worshipers.
- (2025-07-27) The party reasoned that taking the dragon mask without a replacement could release the Faceless Lord. Raf told the Hall of Blades they want a replacement that keeps both Tiamat and the Faceless Lord imprisoned.
- (2025-07-27) Monarch recalled that the summer queen who offered her a crown in her dream turned faceless, a mark of the Faceless Lord's followers.
- (2025-10-19) The GM said the Faceless Lord, sometimes called Duplex, is god or demon lord of oozes and slimes. Slime weeps from the walls of the descent; a pit of ooze breathes below, and a gurgling voice told Monarch to 'surrender your face and gain ultimate power in chaos'. Monarch refused.

chunks.title: Jubilex (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Jubilex (first seen 2025-06-15, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-10-19) The slime colony beneath is a communal psychic organism in pain, hungry, trapped and desperate; Portia calmed it with empathy and it formed humanoid shapes mirroring the party. It understands only simple emotions, and Good Berries thrown in were consumed without effect.
- (2025-11-02) A pseudopod lashed through the web at Monarch, dealing 19 acid damage and leaving a festering mark on her leg; the party took it to be Jubilex's touch.
- (2025-11-02) Monarch dreamed of a featureless face, following oozes and the words 'Chaos is power', which the GM framed as an offer of patronage; Eddie's Remove Curse did not change the mark.

chunks.title: Speaker of Storms
chunks.text:
NPC: Speaker of Storms (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2025-07-13)
Also known as: the speaker
Role: authoritative leader of the Dawnrealm-equipped dragonborn group at the Tower of Runes; blue dragonborn
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
Location: Tower of Runes, south side
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-07-13) Wore flashes of purple, was a blue dragonborn, and acted as the group's leader; he was not concentrating on anything.
- (2025-07-13) Shouted a single word in Draconic that made the whole group turn on the party, then cast thunder bolts that missed Portia and were repelled by Sir Raf's Shield spell.
- (2025-07-13) Charmed Lucia (she failed her Wisdom save despite advantage and a reroll, 8 with advantage) and told her to take cover behind the runestone guardian.
- (2025-07-13) Appeared resistant to spells; Portia's fireball save was made. The guardian hit him for 23, then a second hit pounded him into the ground, killing him.

chunks.title: Fanatic of the Tower of Runes group
names: Fanatic of the Tower of Runes group
chunks.text:
NPC: Fanatic of the Tower of Runes group (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2025-07-13)
Also known as: the fanatic, the fanatic spellcaster, concentrating caster
Role: combat-trained spellcaster concentrating on the control of the runestone guardian
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
Location: Tower of Runes
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, captured? no; fled then charm attempts failed
- (2025-07-13) Had a flash of purple and was the one concentrating to control the runestone guardian; she is combat trained and made concentration saves against Raf's magic missile (11 damage) and Eddie's guiding bolt (14 damage).
- (2025-07-13) Chimeg's crossbow bolt (15 damage) broke her concentration, whereupon she screamed 'Run, it's broken' and fled.
- (2025-07-13) Monarch's Charm Person failed against her twice; she said she would join Tiamat's army when she died.

chunks.title: Runestone Guardian
chunks.text:
NPC: Runestone Guardian (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2025-07-13)
Also known as: runestone creature, rune guardian, stone guardian, ruins storm guardian
Role: colossal bipedal construct of rune stones; ignores difficult terrain but cannot dash
Location: Tower of Runes glade
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, cracked and heavily damaged
- (2025-07-13) Raf's Giant command to hunt dragon worshipers did not work; Chimeg said these constructs are unstoppable murder and can only be outrun.
- (2025-07-13) Its force bolt blasts hit Raf for 14 and 22, then 34 and 26 in a later round (dropping him), and it cast a slowing effect on Chimeg, Portia and Eddie that halved speed and limited actions.
- (2025-07-13) It is immune to psychic damage but can be knocked prone; Lucia's crit sneak attack and trip made it prone. It knocked Eddie unconscious, and Portia's Land's Aid necrotic damage cracked it.
- (2025-07-13) It could not take control from a book formula without a saving throw; it resists control by non-creators.

chunks.title: Hall of Blades voice
chunks.text:
NPC: Hall of Blades voice (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-08-10)
Also known as: the voice, the hall, the pedestal
Role: guardian voice of the Hall of Blades; judges the honesty of visitors
Location: Hall of Blades
Attitude to party: demands truth
- (2025-07-27) It spoke telepathically in Giant to those inside the hall. It said those who come must prove their honesty and asked why they had come, and warned that unworthy answers will be punished.
- (2025-07-27) It demands weighty truths, meaning secret, important or painful ones, and offers a truth or a blade. Truths that are merely worthy to the speaker but meaningless to the hall earn no reward. A worthy truth that matters may earn compensation. A false or unworthy one is punished.
- (2025-07-27) It answered Eddie with 'Of course you do. Marked as you are by her', referring to his Tiamat scar. It judged his confession of the scar's source worthy and gave him the choice of a truth or a blade.
- (2025-07-27) It judged Monarch's truth worthy and gave her the saying: 'Power from below always pulls below. Seek your power from the lands in which you dwell and the lands from which you come. Powers from outside these lands will destroy you.'
- (2025-08-10) The voice demanded a secret or a truth of value from Raf and Portia the moment they stepped into the room, with no time limit. It can speak to several people at once.

chunks.title: Hall of Blades voice (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Hall of Blades voice (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-08-10)
- (2025-08-10) The GM said it wants a truth with weight, such as one that could change history or give someone power over you. It judged Raf's oath to Lady Gracia of House Ventra, while he is of House Kenegal, adequate. It judged Portia's truth about resenting the courts' control and being tasked with watching Monarch adequate.
- (2025-08-10) Eddie placed his plus one short sword on the pedestal as an offering; a spirit took it, and the voice called it an acceptable offer.
- (2025-08-10) Asked where the blue dragon mask is, the voice said it was beyond their knowledge, but many blades saw the thorn betrayer carry the mask deep into the city, through the Gate of Dragons into the Hall of Scales.

chunks.title: Cloud giant spirit of the Hall of Blades
names: Cloud giant spirit of the Hall of Blades
chunks.text:
NPC: Cloud giant spirit of the Hall of Blades (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-07-27)
Also known as: spirit carrying the rapier
Role: spirit bearer of the blood iron and adamantine rapier
Location: Hall of Blades
Attitude to party: gave Eddie the rapier
- (2025-07-27) It was the spirit carrying the rapier of blood iron and adamantine that came to Eddie. It shrank to human size with the blade and wordlessly handed the rapier to Eddie, which held substantial necrotic energy and seemed to require attunement.

chunks.title: Fire giant spirit with the shadow-flame longsword
names: Fire giant spirit with the shadow-flame longsword
chunks.text:
NPC: Fire giant spirit with the shadow-flame longsword (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-07-27)
Also known as: smoking black spirit
Role: spirit bearer of a black-smoking blade
Location: Hall of Blades
Attitude to party: unknown
- (2025-07-27) When Chimeg stood before the pedestal, a fire-giant-shaped spirit shrouded in flickering black smoke carried a shadow-flamed greatsword (it looked like a longsword in giant hands) toward the pedestal. The other blades actively parted before it, unlike the ones that came to Eddie.

chunks.title: Summer queen
chunks.text:
NPC: Summer queen (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-07-27)
Also known as: faceless queen
Role: figure in Monarch's dream who bestowed a crown
Attitude to party: unknown
- (2025-07-27) In Monarch's dream in the Tower of Dreams, the summer queen offered her a crown and turned faceless as she gave it. Monarch took it knowingly and says she can still feel it on her head.

chunks.title: Hades
chunks.text:
NPC: Hades (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2026-10-18)
Role: god Eddie serves as a priest
Attitude to party: watching Eddie
- Hades' answer to Eddie's Divination: "Nine hundred mortals are due me / and you will guide them home // Ride wind and wave to the bear star / Before the dawn star falls // By night return to the wyrm's mouth / You sail by wave alone"
- (2025-07-27) In Eddie's dream, Hades and Tiamat each offered him a blade. Eddie chose Hades and says it was not his time to die.
- (2025-10-19) Eddie dreamed of leading an army of skeletons in a damp subterranean place; the GM explained Hades permits animating dead with reverence and purpose, but opposes wild undead and perpetual use, and calling back spirits is dicey. Eddie chose not to prepare Animate Dead absent a nudge.
- (2025-10-19) Eddie felt Hades' eyes upon him when Tiamat's voice spoke; Hades has no wings.
- (2025-11-02) Eddie felt deep disappointment from Hades after saying Tiamat's name, and the GM suggested atonement will be needed.
- (2026-05-17) Eddie's augury on casting locate object on the iron flask returned woe, so he declined. A later augury for Portia casting it came back well, and one with the flask image gave a mixed result Eddie read as a generous interpretation of his question.
- (2026-10-18) Answering Eddie's divination about exploiting Icevein's greed to the Norge fleet's detriment, Hades said: nine hundred mortals are due him and the party will guide them home; ride wind and wave to the bear star before the dawn star falls; by night return to the wyrm's mouth; sail by wave alone.

chunks.title: Flame Keeper
chunks.text:
NPC: Flame Keeper (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-07-27)
Also known as: esteemed flame keeper
Role: addressee of a letter found with a dead cultist's remains
Faction: Cult of the Dragon (implied by the letter's scaled devotion sign-off)
- (2025-07-27) A letter found among the dead cultists' remains near the Hall of Blades was addressed to 'esteemed flame keeper'. It says the Hall of Blades guards the echoes of oaths tied to the mask's last bearer, the betrayer; the swords remember who took the mask and where they went, and with the right rites they will speak; the path to the blue dragon mask begins there. It was signed 'in scaled devotion'.

chunks.title: Keeper of Black Razor
names: Challenger of the Chamber of Trials
chunks.text:
NPC: Keeper of Black Razor (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: the keeper, ghostly fire giant, ghost giant, Challenger of the Chamber of Trials, dead giant, challenger
Role: spirit keeper of the black greatsword Black Razor
Location: Chamber of Trials, Hall of Feasts
Attitude to party: duelist; saluted Raf, no threat until challenged
Status: defeated
- (2025-08-10) A ghostly giant carried a shadow-flamed black greatsword toward Chimeg. Kyle's history rolls identified the blade as Black Razor, a soul-eating greatsword that has brought down and made empires.
- (2025-08-10) The blade it carried was broken. It attacked Chimeg after Monarch's lightning bolt hit it (32 damage; GM ruled it a wash on the Dex save, it rolled 18).
- (2025-08-10) It took Chimeg's greatsword and fused it with its own. The reforged Black Razor pulsed with necrotic runes, and it cast Haste. Its swings did 23 against Eddie.
- (2025-08-10) Raf finished it with Booming Blade (24 to hit) and it dissipated with a howl, leaving the black greatsword on the floor.
- (2025-08-24) A voice in Giant lamented that none survive and that a chance remains through victory and the chalice, and a ghostly armored giant appeared at parade rest in the chamber.
- (2025-08-24) Raf saluted and the challenger saluted back, then fought him. It flies at 40 and howls to pull targets 20 feet and deal half of 16 cold damage. It makes three spectral blade attacks and hit Raf for 20 force, bloodying him. It resisted nonmagical damage and not psychic.

chunks.title: Keeper of Black Razor (part 2)
names: Challenger of the Chamber of Trials
chunks.text:
NPC: Keeper of Black Razor (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-09-21)
- (2025-08-24) Monarch's very fire spell let the rune guardian hit for 61 damage, and Raf then dropped it. It knelt, left a bronze tablet etched in giant runes at his feet and vanished.
- (2025-09-21) After the challenger was defeated, the bronze tablet it left behind details the chalice of accord ritual, a gesture of humility before dragons.

chunks.title: Flying swords of the Hall of Blades
names: Flying swords of the Hall of Blades
chunks.text:
NPC: Flying swords of the Hall of Blades (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-08-10)
Also known as: floating swords, spirit keepers, dancing blades
Role: spirit-held guardian blades
Location: Hall of Blades
Attitude to party: hostile to those marked as enemies
- (2025-08-10) About four swords near an enemy attack, with a base fly speed of 50. The room acts as if a person becomes an enemy by attacking one of the swords or the keeper, and swords chase enemies until some resolution.
- (2025-08-10) Three swords were destroyed in the fight and fell: a plus one greatsword, Shatterspike (a plus one adamantine longsword whose damage is slashing or bludgeoning), and a scimitar of slumbering blue dragon's wrath. The GM said every blade in the hall has something special about it.

chunks.title: Black puddings of the Hall of Feasts kitchen
names: Black puddings of the Hall of Feasts kitchen
chunks.text:
NPC: Black puddings of the Hall of Feasts kitchen (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-08-24)
Also known as: puddings, ooze d, oozes
Location: Hall of Feasts kitchen
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-08-24) A sticky dark patch on the kitchen floor coalesced into a hungry black pudding when the party got close. Raf's slashing Shatterspike hit split it, and Monarch warned against lightning and slashing. It split repeatedly into small puddings, each with a fraction of its hit points.
- (2025-08-24) A 25 acid crit from a pudding hit Raf and degraded his nonmagical armor by 1 AC.
- (2025-08-24) The party killed all the puddings with firebolt, sneak attacks, sword burst, two strike, toll the dead and Chimeg's greatsword.

chunks.title: Rune guardian controlled by Monarch
chunks.text:
NPC: Rune guardian controlled by Monarch (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: Andy Rooney, room guardian, rune golem
Location: charging station in the Giant Sculptor's Workshop
Attitude to party: controlled by Monarch
Status: alive
- (2025-08-24) A finished rune guardian stood in the sculpting workshop. Monarch used the giant ritual notes with a third-level slot and heightened the spell; the guardian failed its DC 15 Wisdom save on a 10 and was controlled for one hour.
- (2025-08-24) Monarch named it Andy Rooney. It could not open or fix the table, and followed orders to wait in the room. In the challenge fight it hit with a ranged force attack.
- (2025-08-24) With Eddie's Twilight Sanctuary, Eddie gave it 10 temporary hit points.
- (2025-09-21) Monarch walked the rune guardian back to its charging station. The party decided against re-controlling it for the potion room, since the spell costs a third-level slot and 2 sorcery points, and it cannot fit up the chimney.

chunks.title: Stone giant sculptor undead
chunks.text:
NPC: Stone giant sculptor undead (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-08-24)
Also known as: thing in the corner, pile of raw materials giant
Location: Hall of Feasts sculpting workshop
Attitude to party: indifferent
Status: alive
- (2025-08-24) A moss-covered stone giant, probably undead, sat up from the raw material pile and watched the rune guardian. Eddie's history/religion check (13) suggested it clings to undeath to finish its stonework.
- (2025-08-24) It nodded when Eddie asked whether it made the guardian and whether it was protecting it, but it ignored the request to take materials.

chunks.title: Brewery room goo creatures
chunks.text:
NPC: Brewery room goo creatures (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: potion room goo, puddles from the casks, living potions, potion oozes
Location: Hall of Feasts brewery room
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-08-24) Two huge casks in the brewery room leaked magical drafts that congealed into goo with a mind of its own. Portia's owl saw at least three centers of motion, and one puddle shot fire at the owl.
- (2025-09-21) The goo resolved into giant-sized living potion oozes: potion of healing, potion of fire breath and potion of poison (a mix of fire breath and healing). Each looked like its potion.
- (2025-09-21) Healing ooze regained hit points at the start of its turn. The poison ooze was venom-slick and the fire breath oozes shot targeted streams of fire. Fire breath oozes exploded in fire in a roughly 10-foot radius when killed (12 fire damage to Monarch).
- (2025-09-21) They were immune to lightning, and Monarch's lightning bolt split two of them into smaller creatures that did not keep faerie fire. Ray of frost slowed them; the oozes could not be knocked prone.
- (2025-09-21) The party defeated all of them. Eddie then siphoned six potions of fire breath and six greater healing potions from the barrels. Greater healing mixed with fire breath turns into poison.

chunks.title: The Dreamcaster
chunks.text:
NPC: The Dreamcaster (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: dream guy, mustache twirling guy, Dreammaster
Role: purple-robed Cult of the Dragon leader, wears a dragon symbol
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
Location: forest near the Dragon Cultist Cavern
Status: dead
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-09-21) The man who tried to kill the party with dreams in the Tower of Dreams and fled was seen again in the cultist cave, conferring with a blue and a white half dragon.
- (2025-09-21) The Mirror of the Past showed him moving through the Tower of Dreams, organizing cultist parties from this cave, speaking with a hooded figure in Roma near the Wizards District, sailing a sky-landing ship in the north, and flying a wyvern beside a red male dragonborn and a female tiefling.
- (2025-10-05) He cast an unseen spell that sent Lucia into the wedding dream, requiring an Investigation check each turn to escape; Lucia failed and stayed.
- (2025-10-05) He used Misty Step as an ability, stepped into the open and cast mass suggestion (spell save DC 16) to leave and return to the con; Monarch, Chimeg and Raf failed and were charmed for 24 hours, Eddie and Portia saved.
- (2025-10-05) He was caught in Portia's first fireball but did not look bloodied.
- (2025-10-19) His mass suggestion (24-hour duration, not concentration) persisted after Eddie cast Dispel Magic on Chimeg and failed his check at first; Eddie spent heroic inspiration on a reroll that ended it for her.

chunks.title: The Dreamcaster (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: The Dreamcaster (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-10-19) He used Misty Step, then cast Fly and escaped over the trees; Lucia returned from her dream because Fly requires concentration.
- (2025-10-19) Monarch's Earthbind (DC 16 Strength save) grounded him; he failed and descended safely, then turned enraged and hurled a psychic blast forcing Intelligence saves. Eddie failed (muddled thoughts, -d6 to attacks and checks), Portia and Chimeg saved; two horses that saved survived bloodied, others died (22 psychic).
- (2025-10-19) He fled into the trees, blasted Portia for 21 psychic and Chimeg for 10 psychic, and was killed by Chimeg's crossbow bolts following Portia's Fire Bolt.
- (2025-10-19) His body held purple belted robes, a well-crafted Cult of the Dragon amulet, 14 trade gems worth 500 gp each, 26 platinum, 15 gold and 38 silver, and a hidden pouch with three identical hand-carved obsidian coins with a five-headed dragon on each side. He also carried a magical (enchantment) pouch of sand that Lucia found not physically trapped; his AC came from mage armor.
- (2025-10-19) His handwritten notes on Qul'drik were incomplete; he had no answer to the portal and did not know the Dragon mask was part of anything else, only that it lay beneath Qul'drik.
- (2025-10-19) The party kept his body separate from the others to possibly use Speak with Dead, and Eddie planned to sever the head to hinder raise dead.
- (2025-10-19) His bedroll was very comfortable; Raf called dibs.

chunks.title: Blue half dragon and white half dragon
names: Blue half dragon and white half dragon
chunks.text:
NPC: Blue half dragon and white half dragon (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2025-10-05)
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
Location: cave under the rocky outcropping
Status: dead
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-09-21) A blue half dragon and a white half dragon lead the cultists in the cave with the Dreamcaster.
- (2025-10-05) The half blue dragon, dressed like a pit fighter with lightning spine fins, threw javelins and breathed a lightning line (DC 14 Dex, 18 damage to Eddie and Monarch); it was killed by Lucia after Chimeg's shots.
- (2025-10-05) The half white dragon fought with claws and fangs, was very fast, leaped 30 feet to hit Monarch twice for 31 total (5 slashing + 9 cold, 7 slashing + 10 cold), breathed a 24 cold cone, and fell to Eddie's critical rapier hit.

chunks.title: Sleeping wyvern
chunks.text:
NPC: Sleeping wyvern (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: wyvern
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
Location: atop the rocky outcropping above the cave
Status: dead
Attitude to party: hostile once lured
- (2025-09-21) A saddled wyvern, camouflaged against the rocks, sleeps about 100 feet above the cave mouth. Monarch's Nature check (26) revealed wyverns prefer unaware medium prey, are aggressive but not brave, and have a deadly poison stinger.
- (2025-10-05) The saddled wyvern watched Portia as a wounded horse but did not attack; the GM reasoned it was trained not to eat horses, and it was a saddled mount raised from a hatchling.
- (2025-10-05) Portia as a jackal drew its attack: it hit with a critical sting for 13 piercing and 25 poison (Portia poisoned until its next turn), then its bite missed as Portia dodged.
- (2025-10-05) Monarch's Earthbind (heightened, DC 16) failed its save (12), grounding it; Lucia repeatedly tripped it; Eddie's Silence stopped its roar; it went reckless when bloodied and Eddie killed it with a critical rapier hit for 33 total damage.
- (2025-10-19) The party considered dragging the cultist corpses to the dead wyvern.

chunks.title: Silver and blue dragon apparitions
chunks.text:
NPC: Silver and blue dragon apparitions (first seen 2025-10-19, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: Silver Dragon, Blue Dragon shape, two dragons
Role: guardian spirits of the draconic amphitheater
Location: amphitheater past the Gate of Dragons
Attitude to party: testing
- (2025-10-19) Two gargantuan dragon shapes, silver ice and crackling azure, formed in the amphitheater and forced wisdom saves; Portia, Monarch failed and were frightened (Raf rerolled with inspiration), Eddie saved.
- (2025-10-19) They asked in unison 'which truth do you serve: wisdom that binds or power that dominates?' The blue dragon roared for 6 thunder damage after mixed answers, then 15 thunder and 14 lightning after all answered wisdom; the silver dragon healed the party for 35 and said 'then you had best show wisdom', and a passage opened.

chunks.title: Golden Dragon Spirit
chunks.text:
NPC: Golden Dragon Spirit (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: gold dragon spirit
Role: guardian spirit of the prison's rune web
Location: Prison of the Faceless Lord
- (2025-11-02) A vast gold dragon spirit appeared at the first rune and warned that Black Razor would turn the prison into a warden with a will of its own, stronger but not passive; it said the path did not violate their pact, it could not intervene, and faded.

chunks.title: Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Valeria, Senator Valeria Calvus, Calvus
Role: Monarch's employer, senator
Faction: House Calvus
Location: Corona Domini
Attitude to party: unaware of Monarch's disguise; friendly
- Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus: her full name and title.
- (2025-11-02) Valeria, a veteran senator known for baiting on the floor and a sharp tongue, hired Monarch (disguised as Myla Brightfellow) after Monarch impressed her at the Wreath & Lion.
- (2025-11-02) She is orchestrating the push to take control of the Groves as part of measures tightening regulation of magic, specifically druidic and wild magic.
- (2025-11-02) Her house is known for prominent artificers and magical constructions.
- (2025-11-16) Monarch, disguised as a halfling, works as her junior assistant; the first day gave Monarch the vote picture (Insight 17).
- (2025-11-16) She supports the Groves annexation because she distrusts wild and druidic magic, which she sees as uncontrolled; the senate archives confirmed this.
- (2025-11-30) She is strongly against the Norge war petition: an offensive war would be a waste and play into the Dawnrealm's hands; she opposes even bringing it to the floor. She has Monarch deliver sealed missives to senators outside the Groves matter.

chunks.title: Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2025-11-30)
- (2025-11-30) When Eddie told her Magnus meant to bring the petition, she resolved to get Magnus to withdraw it; she says Vaelthira (frost giant) never lies but is not the same as honest. Calvus's note 'Magnus to pull petition' was crossed off. She likes the tea order Monarch brings.
- (2025-11-30) Her own position on the Groves is wanting wild and druidic magic regulated; she dislikes the Norge petition and her Groves bill has a 20-vote cushion.

chunks.title: Senator Brontus Aurumbrand Tempesta
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Brontus Aurumbrand Tempesta (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Brontus
Role: storm giant senator of Roma
Attitude to party: not yet approached
Faction: Imperial Senate
- A storm giant politician in Roma.
- Holds tremendous power over the Imperial Senate.
- (2025-11-16) Reputation: strict, distrusts small folk, calm like rolling thunder but flies into a rage when things are out of place; he can clear the floor by clearing his throat.
- (2025-11-16) He supports the bill because the Groves are not under giant leadership and he thinks humanoids will mismanage them.
- (2025-11-30) His concerns resemble Magnus's: the Groves are an unregulated source of power with no giant oversight, run by humanoids.
- (2025-11-30) He is the last unflipped target; the party has not spoken to him and is unsure the oaths address his worry that tiny humanoids mismanage the Groves.

chunks.title: Senator Kaldrina
chunks.text:
