NPC: Senator Kaldrina (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: Kaldrina Amberworth Ignis, Ignis
Role: Fire giant senator
Location: Palace of Fire
Attitude to party: suspicious but accepted the oath
- (2025-11-16) Known for siege engineering, craftsmanship and security; her palace is the most locked down.
- (2025-11-16) Sir Raf was hired as a perimeter guard at her palace and learned she sees the Groves as a security risk and an avenue for invasion; druids can walk tree to tree and portals to the Feywild are rumored.
- (2025-11-30) The GM named her Kaldrina Amberworth Ignis; she believes the Groves are a huge security risk, a way for an invading force to arrive unannounced, but does not strongly need annexation if the concern is addressed.
- (2025-11-30) Raf got Portia an audience at the Palace of Fire by pitching that the druids heard her concerns (Persuasion with advantage, 16); fire giant guards escorted them through three doors, two with giant runes, the last a warded face that spoke.
- (2025-11-30) The fire giant, in black plate armor at a kiln, checked the oath with a gem, accepted it, asked one extra oath that the Groves obey Roman law on incoming teleports, said the city may visit and patrol the Groves, and agreed to vote against annexation.
- (2025-12-14) Sir Raf was turned away from her palace as she was too busy for them, despite Enhance Ability (Raf's rolls 8 and 4).

chunks.title: Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: Vaelthira
Role: frost giant senator of Roma; her Hall of Frost camp plans the war against Norge
Location: Palace of Frost / Hall of Frost
Attitude to party: accepting but dismissive; gives them little credit
Faction: Imperial Senate, Imperial frost giants
- Frost giant senator of Roma; the ogre Krug is one of her enforcers, working under the direction of Julia the Glacier.
- (2025-11-16) She agitates for war on Norge and the Dawnrealm and seeks senate backing for a petition to the emperor. She competes and cheats; her squads disrupt rival senators. Eddie got hired and joined one.
- (2025-11-16) She cares nothing about the Groves, so her vote may be a political trade.
- (2025-11-30) Her only reason to back the Groves annexation bill is a deal with Magnus to bring her Norge war petition to the senate floor; she needs senate support to get an audience with the emperor.
- (2025-11-30) She is building an army at the Hall of Frost: a fortress of ice-cold enchanted stone, a camp of a few hundred troops, siege weapons, and war rooms with Sea of Storms charts; staff include ogres, frost giants, ettins, orcs, orogs and Goliaths. Her security is 'responsive'.
- (2025-11-30) She had officers planning forced conscription outside the city.

chunks.title: Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2025-11-30) Lucia (with Eddie's enhance ability on charisma) told her Magnus would not bring the petition to the floor; the GM ruled Lucia's Deception (with inspiration, advantage and psychic die) convinced her they overheard it, but she demanded proof and said she does not lie and keeps promises. She lifted the strike teams for visits to senators, but will punish them if senators she was visited flip votes.
- (2025-11-30) Eddie learned that Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus convinced Magnus to withdraw the petition; Vaelthira afterward lost urgency (fewer tents, theoretical planning, conscription contracts recalled) and said Magnus was not getting votes from her, so she abstains. She needs better intelligence about Norge.
- (2025-11-30) Portia, with Eddie's enhance ability, offered an oath from the Green Apothecary: druids would open tree doors for her spies to Norge in exchange for independence. She read the oath, said it was fair, and promised to vote against annexation, with her agents to arrive three days after the vote.
- (2025-12-14) Eddie called her Vaelthira, the Frost Giant who definitely wants to beat up the Norge folks; the party discussed taking the Norge news to her.
- (2025-12-14) After a wait, she met Eddie, Lucia and Sir Raf in her war room, mapping the Emperor's Bay region with cloud giant, storm giant and humanoid advisers; she mocked their small size.

chunks.title: Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2025-12-14) Her war planning is entirely offensive: ambushes, hammer-and-anvil in the farmlands, naval, mountain, canal and forest battles, with no static defenses.
- (2025-12-14) After the persuasion checks (Lucia 22) she accepted the party's offer to scout as unpaid freelance volunteers, giving no orders so she need not rely on them; she prefers fighting on the shores and will send her own scouts.
- (2025-12-14) Lucia addressed her as 'Sarah' in the audience, most likely a garble of her name.
- (2026-02-22) Eddie sought a general from Vaelthira's forces; the party was given time in a planning map room showing Emperor's Bay landing points, which omitted Dragonfjord.

chunks.title: Consul of Roma
chunks.text:
NPC: Consul of Roma (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: the consul
Role: Appointed ruler of the city of Roma; cloud giant
- (2025-11-16) The consul is appointed by the emperor and is a cloud giant, half sister of Senator Azaira. The bill would put the Groves under the consul's control.

chunks.title: Senator Culdrick Cerro
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Culdrick Cerro (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Quintus Cerro, Cerro
Role: Senator of House Cerro
- (2025-11-16) Gave a long speech from nostalgia for the old Imperium, arguing places of power should be controlled by the Imperium.
- (2025-11-30) The GM called him Quintus Cerro, nostalgic for the old Imperium and swayable by nostalgia-based arguments rather than a deal.

chunks.title: Senator Calvad Volpus
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Calvad Volpus (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Senator Valerius
Role: Senator, former priestess of Apollo
- (2025-11-16) Holds that sacred spaces must answer to divine order and that the consul is rightly chosen under heaven.
- (2025-11-30) The former sun priest believes the Groves should be under the Temple of Apollo and may need concession.

chunks.title: Senator Octavia Calvad
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Octavia Calvad (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Octavia
Role: Senator representing schools of magic
Attitude to party: delighted to switch
- (2025-11-16) Wants the Groves' rare herbs and alchemical knowledge opened to magic schools, without harming the Green Apothecary.
- (2025-11-30) Portia talked shop with this alchemist senator and, with a persuasion roll with advantage, got her to switch her vote against annexation; she had not expected the Groves would accept such oaths.

chunks.title: Senator Darius Calvus
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Darius Calvus (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
Role: Senator of House Calvus
- (2025-11-16) Repeatedly asks in debate about timber rights.
- (2025-11-30) The GM said he is interested in timber rights, possibly satisfied by a sustainable harvest deal.

chunks.title: Senator Borluss Flintmantle Lapis
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Borluss Flintmantle Lapis (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: Lapis, Senator Lapis
Role: stone giant senator of Roma
Faction: Imperial Senate
Attitude to party: cooperative after the henge offer
- A stone giant politician in Roma.
- (2025-11-16) Monarch addressed the stone giant senator as 'Senator Lapis' when pitching the henge restoration deal.
- (2025-11-16) Known for stillness and silence, and a strong historical and artistic sense; he rebuilt his palace stone for stone at double scale.
- (2025-11-16) He wants the Great Henge in the Groves of Belenus restored.
- (2025-11-16) After Monarch's persuasion (rolled with Tides of Chaos) he agreed that stone giants will restore the henge and signed the contract in silence; the party counts his vote as swung.

chunks.title: Senator Rogrun
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Rogrun (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: Rog Run, Ragrun, Rogran
Role: Hill giant senator and gourmand
Faction: Roman Senate (hill giants)
Attitude to party: agreed to a conditional deal
- (2025-11-16) A gourmand who uses his political power to get food; he wants to eat the Groves' delicacies.
- (2025-11-16) He agreed to a conditional written deal: monthly meals of Groves foods for him alone if he votes against; he promises nothing himself and the party judged by Insight that he intends to vote no. The giant wasp wine was toasted.
- (2025-11-16) He is smart (Int 11) and wears a toga; his palace is a hole dug into a hill with ogres and trolls loose inside.

chunks.title: Rolling Bones
chunks.text:
NPC: Rolling Bones (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: Old Rolling Bones
Role: Nickname used by the GM near Senator Rogrun's name (hill giant senator)
- (2025-11-16) The GM said 'Senator Rogrun Rolling Bones' and 'Old Rolling Bones' while describing the hill giant's wish to eat the Groves' delicacies; no line explicitly states it is a separate individual.

chunks.title: Senator Azirah
chunks.text:
NPC: Senator Azirah (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Azaira, Azira, Azara
Role: Cloud giant senator
Faction: Roman Senate (cloud giants)
- (2025-11-16) Loves spectacle and emceeing events such as parades and coliseum shows; reputedly holds power through gossip and whisper campaigns.
- (2025-11-16) She speaks often in the debates without substance and wants to turn the Groves into a walled garden for the elite.
- (2025-11-30) The cloud giant senator has her own personal interest in the Groves bill, which the party had no alternative to; Portia says she cannot deal with the cloud giant.

chunks.title: Ezra
chunks.text:
NPC: Ezra (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Role: Name Andy (Lucia) offers while trying to recall the cloud giant senator
- (2025-11-16) Andy suggested 'Ezra' as a possible name when the party discussed giant leadership of an academy at the Groves, apparently garbling Azirah.

chunks.title: Julia the Glacier
chunks.text:
NPC: Julia the Glacier (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Julia
Role: goliath with frost giant heritage; directs the enforcer squad of Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu
Faction: Julia the Glacier's squad
Attitude to party: friendly to Eddie but follows orders
Status: alive
- A goliath with frost giant heritage; Krug, Gillygully, Hanak and Shiver Grundy work under her direction for Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu.
- (2025-11-30) Julia, a Goliath who leads the frost giant enforcer squad, was hit by Monarch's subtle charm person (Wisdom save of 17 assumed to work on a Goliath); she stayed friendly but said she must follow orders against the party speaking to senators.
- (2025-11-30) She accepted a gold piece from Monarch for drinks and passed it to Krug; later she told Eddie that Monarch was a tricky one and that it would have been a fight if the charm had failed.

chunks.title: Shiver Grundy
chunks.text:
NPC: Shiver Grundy (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Role: frost sorcerer in Julia the Glacier's squad
Faction: Julia the Glacier's squad
- Shiver Grundy the frost sorcerer works with Krug under the direction of Julia the Glacier.
- (2025-11-30) Shiver Grundy is a one-eyed frost spellcaster with perpetual icicles from the empty socket, who travels with Julia's group.

chunks.title: Hanak
chunks.text:
NPC: Hanak (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Role: orog thug in Julia the Glacier's squad
Faction: Julia the Glacier's squad
- Hanak the orog thug works with Krug under the direction of Julia the Glacier.
- (2025-11-30) Hanak and Bolak are brother and sister orogs, ordinary mercenaries loyal to whoever pays, who travel with Julia's squad.

chunks.title: Gillygully
chunks.text:
NPC: Gillygully (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Role: ettin enforcer in Julia the Glacier's squad
Faction: Julia the Glacier's squad
Attitude to party: threatening
- The ettin Gillygully works with Krug under the direction of Julia the Glacier.
- (2025-11-30) Gillygully, the ettin, hustled to keep up with Krug; the two heads argued with each other, one perhaps recognizing Eddie. The GM rolled an 11 for it (advantage, two brains), so it gave no sign of recognition or added aggression.
- (2025-11-30) Gillygully said to tell Eddie's friends so they would not have to eat one, and argued within itself over whether to eat one of the party.

chunks.title: Emperor Galus Cirrus Marvad Titanicus
chunks.text:
NPC: Emperor Galus Cirrus Marvad Titanicus (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Emperor Titanicus, Emperor
Role: Giant ruler of the Imperium
- Emperor Galus Cirrus Marvad Titanicus is the current Emperor, a former general in the War of Emperors.
- (2025-11-16) The emperor is said to be a storm giant, though persistent rumors say he is a titan.
- (2025-11-30) The GM explained that only the emperor can launch the imperial military and that he grants audiences only through channels such as a Senate petition; the Frost Giant Senator Vaelthira wants an audience with him.

chunks.title: Rowan
chunks.text:
NPC: Rowan (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-07-26)
Also known as: Ron, Rohan, Roman
Role: spy master in the frost giant camp
Faction: Roman frost giants
Attitude to party: directive
Status: alive
- (2025-12-14) Vaelthira named him the contact for the party's sendings; he is high among the humanoids but low in the giants' room.
- (2025-12-14) He sends no one with the party and links them to none of his spies, so they can reveal nothing if captured.
- (2025-12-14) He wants to know how many ships and of what type are in the bay, what landings the Norge fleet has made, and whether advance people are ashore; Northreach is oddly not reporting.
- (2025-12-14) He pointed the party to Mirel Kellenor in White Crown, who seeks help involving a bronze dragon, possibly the ancient bronze dragon of Emperor's Bay; Vaelthira would not commit resources. He and Eddie became acquainted enough to cast Sending.
- (2026-04-05) Eddie sent a Sending to Rowan, the spymaster, reporting one Cherek longship and three to six galleon-style ships anchored by the island, no troops on the eastern shore, and a huge white dragon. Rowan replied: determine origin and mission of ships; report immediately if engaged by dragon; subtext, report before you die.
- (2026-04-05) After Eddie reported that the Cherek had made a deal with an ancient white dragon and were about to do so with another dragon, Rowan replied: probably a second tribute; prevent its arrival if possible; determine force composition of the Cherek contingent; do not engage until prepared for a last-minute report.

chunks.title: Rowan (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Rowan (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-07-26)
- (2026-04-05) The party withheld the white dragon mask detail from Rowan's report because they want the mask and do not want the Imperium to have it.
- (2026-04-19) Eddie sent a message to Rowan reporting the escaped Mithril Peaks prisoners and the dragon awaiting Norge payment; Rowan replied that the clan was silent for years, the silver dragon also silent, and that they would inquire and try to locate and co-opt the silver dragon.
- (2026-05-17) Portia recalled Rowan's last instructions: prevent the arrival of the galleons and the bribe, determine the force composition of the Cherek contingent, and do not engage. Rowan's divination about finding Lunae foretold 'falls become rise, wall becomes water, an iron prison in hand, a moon rises in the east.'
- (2026-07-26) Eddie sent Rowan a 25-word message that Lunae was released, Rimescar was defeated and a huge Norge fleet is inbound. Rowan replied asking for verification of the fleet size and a report on the dragons' stance toward the conflict.
- (2026-07-26) Rowan later replied: extract soonest; Icevein is extremely dangerous and generationally vengeful; do not let him discover the Imperial Hand and Rimescar's fall or he will aid the invasion.

chunks.title: Tessa Oakmere
chunks.text:
NPC: Tessa Oakmere (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: Tessa
Role: visiting druid who knows transport via plants
Location: Groves of Belenus
Attitude to party: friendly but cautious
Status: alive
- (2025-12-14) An aldrin in her summer phase from a home grove in Eyre, visiting the Groves; the only druid there who knows the spell. She was helping a newly awakened elder tree.
- (2025-12-14) She would transport scouts and small groups but not pyrotechnics, arcane casters or large forces, and wants the fighting kept on the shore rather than in the forest.

chunks.title: Debbie
chunks.text:
NPC: Debbie (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-01-11)
Also known as: Debbie Talzar
Role: priest of a god of stars and wanderers
Location: Najik monastery guest quarters
Status: alive
Attitude to party: grateful, hopeful
- (2025-12-14) Shipwrecked after a bronze dragon sank her ship, she survived with at least two crew by swimming to Najik and reports via a sending stone; she sheltered at a friendly monastery whose monks know the dragon.
- (2026-01-11) Debbie Talzar, a middle-aged human, was found with Ashlyn Moranta and Treif Lemir among the survivors of the second shipwreck. She used her sending stone to confirm the party's names with Mirel and learned they could be trusted.
- (2026-01-11) She asked how the party would get past the dragon. She was told they would leave in the morning after resting, and she accepted the day's delay.

chunks.title: Captain Orso
chunks.text:
NPC: Captain Orso (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: Captain Norso, Captain Norton
Role: captain of the Wave Mount ship; tiefling woman
Faction: House Kellenor
Attitude to party: cooperative but wary of the dragon
Status: alive
Location: Wave Mount, anchored in a fog bank off Najik
- (2025-12-14) He sails the party toward Najik by a circuitous night route in fog, to bribe the dragon if it appears; he reported 20 to 40 lightly loaded Norge longships as vanguard.
- (2026-01-11) Captain Orso is a woman. She was pushed into the sea by the dragon's force roar but swam back and climbed aboard the ship.
- (2026-01-11) She had the tribute box brought up and ordered the crews to ready the ballistas and lifeboats. She joined the ballista crew and hedged by readying the rowboats too.
- (2026-01-11) After the fight she refused to take the ship closer to Najik, lent the party two boats (comfortably four people each, six if overloaded) and said she would hide at anchor in the fog bank. She had the chest of coins taken back below.
- (2026-02-22) Kyle confirmed Captain Orso is a woman and believed to be a tiefling; the party agreed to return the bribery chest of gold to her, since the person who hired them had entrusted it to her to bribe the dragon.
- (2026-02-22) Captain Orso said her ship took heavy damage in the first dragon attack, that she charged extra for the trip, and that she would report exactly that the dragon could not be negotiated with; she does not expect to return to the island.

chunks.title: Golcondra
chunks.text:
NPC: Golcondra (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: Glaciundra
Role: great dragon turtle, mother of storms
Status: awake and still angry
- (2025-12-14) Someone put her to sleep generations ago; she woke angry and perpetuates constant storms across the Sea of Storms and Kingdom of the West's coast. A spawn of hers may sleep on the bottom of Emperor's Bay.
- (2025-12-14) Raf said 'Okundra' while the GM spoke of her; this is a garble of her name.

chunks.title: Mirel Kellenor
chunks.text:
NPC: Mirel Kellenor (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-01-11)
Also known as: Yrel Kellenor, Yula Kellenor, Errol Kellenor, Ralph Kellenor
Role: master
Faction: House Kellenor
Location: Smiling Fish tavern, White Crown
Attitude to party: friendly, hospitable
- (2025-12-14) Rowan said Mirel Kellenor of House Kellenor, an agricultural house, ships agricultural goods and was seeking help with something involving a bronze dragon.
- (2025-12-14) An older working woman who receives guests at her office on the Smiling Fish's mezzanine; she fed the party grilled fish and wine.
- (2025-12-14) She asked them to bring home her friend Debbie, shipwrecked on the island of Najik after a bronze dragon sank her ship, offering 2,000 gp plus 250 gp per rescued sailor, and a 10 percent finder's fee on recovered cargo of about 100,000 gp.
- (2025-12-14) She provides the ship Wave Mount and gave its captain a chest of gold to bribe the dragon.
- (2026-01-11) Mirel is the person who sent the party to rescue Debbie. She knows Debbie is alive through a sending stone that lets them reach each other once a day.

chunks.title: Merrill
chunks.text:
NPC: Merrill (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-02-22)
Faction: House Kellenor
Location: Smiling Fish tavern, White Crown
Attitude to party: friendly, hospitable
Role: contact in White Crown who hired the party; hosts them at the Smiling Fish
- (2025-12-14) Azuriel described her as head of shipping for House Kellenor, moving goods along the Great Canal and out of White Crown, with an extensive shipping empire; Azuriel does not know her personally.
- (2026-02-22) At the Smiling Fish in White Crown, Merrill hugged the rescued shipwreck survivors, who are her friends, and paid the party 2,500 gold as agreed, in 100 gp platinum trade bars and 100 gp gems.
- (2026-02-22) Merrill said she was surprised the dragon would shelter such a terrible person and was glad the gift was not needed; Monarch told her that terms were reached by spells and swords, and that she could divert northern boats toward the dragon's island. Kyle answered for her that she has little say over where the Northern fleet goes.
- (2026-02-22) As thanks, Merrill gave each party member a writ of passage granting free passage on any House Kellenor ship; the party cannot choose the ship's destination.

chunks.title: Anish
chunks.text:
NPC: Anish (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: Anish the hierarch, head monk, hierarch
Role: leader of the monastery on Najik (elder aasimar monk, hierarch)
Faction: Najik lay monastic order
Location: Najik monastery
Attitude to party: welcoming, asks for help
Status: alive
- (2026-01-11) Anish is an old celestial-looking asimar who leans on a snake-headed cane. He welcomed the party ('enter in peace, friends') in a ceremonial room with four goat statues and 12 robed monks.
- (2026-01-11) The order is a lay, philosophical monastic order using the goat as a totem of wisdom. Its sanctuary only means they will not throw someone out; they will not fight or force Ronnom to leave, though they have asked him to go.
- (2026-01-11) He asked the party to help convince Ronnom to leave and gave them the key to the one locking cell downstairs. He said the monks will not lie but will not volunteer the party's presence.
- (2026-01-11) He apologized for the dragon's behavior and said it changed after Ronnom arrived. He promised an escort to the survivors and the lower level.
- (2026-02-08) When told what happened below, the head monk said he had not known the jade-eyed woman was so dangerous.
- (2026-02-08) The monks said the Najik falcons they used for mainland messages all fell ill and died recently. Monarch's investigation (natural 20) showed the vials held a weak poison, drunk rather than injected, that is easy to make on the island and enough to kill a falcon.

chunks.title: Anish (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Anish (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-08)
- (2026-02-08) The monks feel safe because the dragon protects them, and they cannot compel Ronnom to leave.

chunks.title: Veen
chunks.text:
NPC: Veen (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: Jade-eyed Dawnrealm woman, jade eyed woman, Our lady of fists, invisible monk, Jade Tigris, Jade-Eyed Woman
Role: Monk-style fighter; warned the doppelgangers' people to flee and ambushed the party
Location: Flooded cave beneath Najik Monastery
Attitude to party: cooperating with the ruse
Status: alive; shapeshifted into Ronnom Kenegal's form and held prisoner by the party
Faction: Dawnrealm (her clothing looks Dawnrealm, not imperial)
- Eko and Mok were the doppelgangers working with Veen and Ronnom.
- (2026-01-11) Veen leads Ronnom's three bodyguards. The monk Anish judges her the most dangerous of them: sharp-eyed, wiser than Ronnom, and seen giving him advice.
- (2026-01-25) She appeared out of thin air behind Eddie mid-strike with a flurry of blows, hitting for 12 and 17 damage; Eddie passed his Constitution save against stunning with a 17 after using heroic inspiration.
- (2026-01-25) She deflected Lucia's psychic blade attack, and she passed the poison Constitution saves with a 19 and later higher.
- (2026-01-25) She became invisible with a bonus action, took thunder damage from Sir Raf's Booming Blade when she moved, and later became invisible mist after a spell.
- (2026-01-25) Monarch cast Reduce on her; Portia's Hold Person did not affect her.
- (2026-01-25) She regenerates some injuries, and she was hurt but not bloodied after Sir Raf, Monarch and Portia hit her.
- (2026-02-08) The head monk named Veen as his friend and bodyguard, the one he never saw apart from Ronnom.

chunks.title: Veen (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Veen (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2026-02-08) Kyle named the bodyguard Veen at the monastery, and when recapping Ronnom's three bodyguards he listed 'Veen, the jade Tigris', equating her with the jade-eyed woman.
- (2026-02-08) She was turned gaseous and invisible and fled. She regenerated fast and was looting a dresser in her room when the party returned.
- (2026-02-08) She attacked Eddie with a flying kick for 14 force damage. Eddie spent his Guardian Emblem reaction to turn a crit into a normal hit, then fell unconscious from a 12-damage hit. She stunned Lucia with a Constitution save effect.
- (2026-02-08) Lucia's psychic sneak attack was deflected for 10 and the poison did not take hold the first time. A later poison landed, though she kept failing to shake it. She cast darkness over the fighters, then fled by swimming toward the dragon's lair.
- (2026-02-08) The monks call her Ronnom's friend and bodyguard. Her fighting is trained, while her spellcasting looks innate, like a sorcerer's. Eddie's locate object on her bandolier pointed southeast and down, toward the dragon's lair.
- (2026-02-08) At the final parley she appeared, shapeshifted into the sketchy guy and offered to stand trial in Ronnom's place. The dragon loved the plan and the party accepted. She left with the party as a prisoner in manacles.

chunks.title: Veen (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Veen (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2026-02-08) Raf's History check (27) showed she is known as the jade tigris. She is a freelance top-tier spy hired by great houses, with Dawnrealm ties but working for the Imperium. She is believed to be a shape-shifter who works with doppelgangers, and nothing has been heard of her for about ten years.
- (2026-02-22) Veen, still in Ronnom's form, was brought as the party's prisoner to White Crown and Roma. She asked privately for a death sentence by hanging, said it would be best if she were killed and recovered, then resumed acting like Ronnom.
- (2026-02-22) After days in her company, the party was convinced her transformation is a true physical shape shift, not an illusion.
- (2026-02-22) The bounty on Ronnom was 2,500 dead or 5,000 alive; the Magistrate's Office paid the party 5,000 gold and revealed more than a dozen murder cases and unsanctioned assassinations against him, some involving noble families.

chunks.title: Ashlyn Moranta
chunks.text:
NPC: Ashlyn Moranta (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: Ashlyn
Role: shipwreck survivor, sea elf with gills
Location: Najik monastery guest quarters
Attitude to party: friendly, wants revenge
Status: alive
- (2026-01-11) Ashlyn is an elf with pale blue skin and gills. She was close, possibly romantically, to the late captain of the Nayad, a Lemir family member; the Nayad was the ship that sank.
- (2026-01-11) She and Treif are highly motivated to see revenge but show some fear of Ronnom.
- (2026-02-08) Monarch's player wondered about a possible link between the shadow monk Veen and Ashlyn's background, but dropped the idea.

chunks.title: Ronnom Kenegal
chunks.text:
NPC: Ronnom Kenegal (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: Ronnom
Role: wanted murderer, black sheep of House Kenegal
Location: Najik monastery, lower level
Attitude to party: unknown; not yet aware of them
Status: wanted for more than a dozen murders; the party delivered Veen in his guise as him
Faction: House Kenegal
- Ronnom Kenegal of House Kenegal: the Port Authority record-keeper the party dealt with in Roma and the fugitive they later arrested at Najik Monastery (see Arrest Ronnom Kenegal) are the same man.
- The "black sheep" half-brother to the bronze dragon Skalanthas on the isle of Najik.
- (2024-11-17) Sir Raf recalled him as the port master who dealt with the sky ships; Monarch found his name in her notes, listed only as Port Authority, and the GM described him as a cheerful goliath who keeps very good notes in his logbook.
- (2026-01-11) Ronnom Kenegal arrived at Najik after a shipwreck with three bodyguards and took sanctuary with the monks, who did not know he was wanted. The monks believe he spoke to the dragon and changed its behavior.
- (2026-01-11) He is wanted on an arrest warrant (to stand trial, not a kill warrant) for several counts of murder, with a 2,500 gp bounty. Sir Raf, from House Kenegal, said he felt responsible for bringing him to justice.
- (2026-01-11) He and his bodyguards will not leave and will not let others leave. Ashlyn and Treif both show fear of him, and he is staying downstairs.

chunks.title: Ronnom Kenegal (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Ronnom Kenegal (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2026-01-11) His mother Ehlonna was a knight of House Kenegal called the dragon knight, who raised a dragon from a hatchling and has since died.
- (2026-01-11) Kyle asked the party to help convince Ronnom to leave the monastery, and later Kyle mentioned Ronnom in connection with the other survivors' fear of him.
- (2026-01-11) Monarch said neutralizing Ronnom could be the negotiating tactic for the dragon, since his arrival changed the dragon's attitude.
- (2026-02-08) Kyle gave his name as Ronnom Kenegal, a member of House Kenegal; the table's garbled forms of the name all refer to him in context.
- (2026-02-08) He is the son of Ehlonna Kenegal, a famous knight who died about fifteen years ago while he was a child. He arrived by ship about six months ago with three bodyguards, and his small sailing boat later vanished.
- (2026-02-08) He is wanted for paid assassinations, not just murder. The monks know this only as rumor, and the party has no details of the crimes.
- (2026-02-08) The dragon trusts him and treats him as family, allowing him into its lair. He remains with the dragon. The party has no evidence it could present against him.
- (2026-02-22) Monarch described to Kyle a pitch that Ronnom killed Lucia by strangulation with rope, costing a 300 gp gem to bring her back. The party filed a complaint of attempted murder and Monarch registered as representative.

chunks.title: Ehlonna
chunks.text:
NPC: Ehlonna (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-01-11)
Also known as: the dragon knight
Role: knight of House Kenegal, mother of Ronnom
Status: dead
- (2026-01-11) Ehlonna was a noble knight of valor, called the dragon knight because she raised a dragon from a hatchling. She died long ago, and nobody knew where the dragon went afterward.

chunks.title: Ehlischelia
chunks.text:
NPC: Ehlischelia (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-01-11)
Role: the knight whose dragon the monks say Ronnom's mother commanded; the transcript does not explicitly equate this name with Ehlonna
Status: dead
- (2026-01-11) The monk Anish said the dragon was beholden to Ronnom as it was to his mother, a noble knight of valor. Ehlischelia is long since gone.

chunks.title: Treif Lemir
chunks.text:
NPC: Treif Lemir (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-01-11)
Also known as: Trif, Treif
Role: shipwreck survivor, teenage noble of the Lemir banking family
Location: Najik monastery
Attitude to party: friendly, wants Ronnom dealt with
Status: alive
- (2026-01-11) Treif is a 14 or 15 year old noble from the Lemir banking family. He told the party he thinks Ronnom set the dragon on them and hinted that Ronnom should be 'properly dealt with' and that the family could be grateful.
- (2026-01-11) The Lemir banking family funded the Nayad, and its captain was a family member. They are successful, known for betting on overseas shipping ventures, but are not a major house.

chunks.title: Queen Titania
chunks.text:
NPC: Queen Titania (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Also known as: Titania
Role: Queen of the Seelie (summer) fey, married to Oberon
Location: Seelie Court, Feywild
Attitude to party: ruled Mona a danger and exiled her from the Feywild
Status: alive
- (2026-01-25) In the vignette, Titania ruled that Mona is a danger who must go to the Prime Material and may return only on the court's invitation once the danger is proven passed or cured.
- (2026-01-25) Titania ordered Olifin to escort Mona to the Prime Material and told them Portia the satyr would meet them on the other side.
- (2026-01-25) She believed Mona's power was out of Mona's control, and that this was the problem.
- (2026-01-25) Kyle said that within the Whisperwood, Titania would lose out to Aurelia, since an archfey is supreme in their own domain.

chunks.title: King Oberon
chunks.text:
NPC: King Oberon (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Also known as: Oberon
Role: King of the Seelie fey, husband of Titania; the queen holds the real power
Location: Seelie Court, Feywild
- (2026-01-25) Kyle said Oberon is Titania's husband and a 'lowercase k' king; Titania is the one with the power.

chunks.title: Fomorian
chunks.text:
NPC: Fomorian (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Also known as: fomori, blight giant
Role: Cursed giant spreading the blight in the Whisperwood
Location: Blighted lower branch of the Whisperwood
Attitude to party: unknown; not aware of Lucia's scouting
- (2026-01-25) Lord Ballyhooligan flew in invisible and saw a hulking ogre-like giant with a head sunk into its shoulders, arms of different lengths and a twisted frame, its skin blighted in several ways. Kyle identified it as a fomorian.
- (2026-01-25) Its outstretched hand deepens the blight, turning plants darker and twisting them further.

chunks.title: Queen of Air and Darkness
chunks.text:
NPC: Queen of Air and Darkness (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Also known as: Unseelie queen
Role: Nameless queen of the Unseelie Court, banished to the Feydark
Faction: Unseelie Court
- (2026-01-25) Kyle said she has no name, since it was taken from her when she was banished to the Feydark; she keeps only her office.
- (2026-01-25) Aurelia suggested the queen of air and darkness is behind the blight after Aurelia refused to join her court.

chunks.title: Sketchy guy
chunks.text:
NPC: Sketchy guy (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: running guy, skate guy, shark creature
Role: Fled bodyguard; a glass cannon who downed Lucia in the flooded cave
Location: Flooded cave
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead, stabbed by Lucia
- (2026-01-25) He fled the cellar when the jade-eyed woman shouted that the party looked dangerous, hid in the flooded cave and hit Lucia with a short sword for 5 piercing and 21 poison, dropping her unconscious into the water.
- (2026-01-25) He later appeared as a bipedal shark. Portia's Ray of Frost hit for 11 cold and bloodied him, and Lucia killed him with a crit for 33.
- (2026-02-08) He fled south toward where the dragon roared. Kyle did not label him in the fight because the party had not got a good look, and the monks later confirmed that the description matched Ronnom.
- (2026-02-08) The party suspected he was Ronnom Kenegal, but Kyle said they could not be sure because he was cloaked and moving fast. No line states they are the same individual.
- (2026-02-08) Veen later shapeshifted into his appearance to stand in for Ronnom.

chunks.title: Dragon in the cave
chunks.text:
NPC: Dragon in the cave (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Also known as: roaring dragon
Location: South part of the flooded cave
Attitude to party: presumably hostile
- (2026-01-25) At the end of the round a familiar dragon's roar echoed from the south of the cave; the party has no ballista-armed ship this time and no long rest.

chunks.title: Lord Ballyhooligan's companion Grimblytoes
chunks.text:
NPC: Lord Ballyhooligan's companion Grimblytoes (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Also known as: Grimbly Toes, boggle
Role: Boggle scout of the Whisperwood (vignette character)
Location: Whisperwood
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2026-01-25) Grimblytoes the boggle and the fairy dragon Lord Ballyhooligan were out scouting the blight and met Mona and Portia at the fairy ring.

chunks.title: Aurelia
chunks.text:
NPC: Aurelia (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-06-14)
Also known as: mother of mirrors, queen of a thousand years, queen of the Whisperwood, Queen of the Thousand Years
Role: Archfey ruler of the Whisperwood; independent of both the Seelie and Unseelie courts
Location: Whisperwood, Feywild
Attitude to party: welcoming, curious about Mona
Status: alive
- (2026-01-25) Kyle introduced Aurelia as an archfey who rules the domain of the Whisperwood; Mona (Monarch) recognized the name with a history check of 10.
- (2026-01-25) Aurelia appears as a golden winged serpent hovering with a bouquet of golden flowers. Her court is made up of reflections of herself, so it is hard to tell whether one is speaking to her or to a reflection.
- (2026-01-25) Portia was herself a reflection of Aurelia on a secret mission. Aurelia embraced her and reabsorbed her, saying the original Portia awaits on the Prime Material.
- (2026-01-25) Aurelia asked Mona for permission to keep a mirror reflection of her at court to talk about her experiences. Monarch agreed, and the reflection stepped out of a mirror as a complete left-handed reversal that knows all Mona knew at that moment.
- (2026-01-25) Aurelia told Mona she is welcome in the Whisperwood and may visit it when it comes to the Prime Material, without angering Titania.
- (2026-01-25) Aurelia said she will deal with the blight, and that the queen of air and darkness had overstepped herself. The queen of air and darkness had asked her to join her court and was refused.

chunks.title: Aurelia (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Aurelia (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-06-14)
- (2026-01-25) The Whisperwood is an information economy where information is shared like food, which may have shaped Monarch's investigative interests.
- (2026-01-25) Kyle said a reflection can only be made of a willing person.
- (2026-06-14) Portia's Root of Whisperwood is a living root from Whisperwood, domain of Aurelia, Queen of the Thousand Years and Mother of Mirrors, and has a charge-based power to send a message to her.

chunks.title: Norillia
chunks.text:
NPC: Norillia (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Role: Name Kyle gave for the queen of the Whisperwood in the vignette; the transcript line may be a garble
- (2026-01-25) Kyle described the hovering golden serpent as 'the mother of mirrors herself, queen Norillia of Whisperwood'. This was said while Aurelia's court was being described.

chunks.title: Eko
chunks.text:
NPC: Eko (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-08)
Role: doppelganger working with Veen and Ronnom Kenegal
Faction: Ronnom Kenegal's bodyguards
Location: Najik Monastery, lower level
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- Eko and Mok were the doppelgangers working with Veen and Ronnom.
- (2026-01-11) Eko and his twin brother Mok, slender humans guarding Ronnom Kenegal, were found unarmed and unarmored playing Three Dragon Ante in a bedroom on the lower level of the Najik monastery.
- (2026-01-11) Monarch cast Charm Person at third level on Eko and Mok (DC 17 Wisdom save); the result was not stated that session.
- (2026-01-25) Monarch's Charm Person drove the two bodyguards into doppelganger claw form, which triggered initiative and a Wild Magic surge giving Monarch resistance to all damage for a minute.
- (2026-01-25) Eko used his reaction opportunity attack on Raf, then mimicked Raf's appearance with a bonus action and attacked Monarch, hitting for 8 bludgeoning.
- (2026-01-25) Eddie's Moonbeam hit both doppelgangers; one failed the save and one succeeded.
- (2026-01-25) A doppelganger frightened Lucia with a Wisdom save effect; she failed with a 4.
- (2026-01-25) A doppelganger disguised as Raf hit Portia for 16 and 14 damage.
- (2026-01-25) A doppelganger transformed into an aquatic creature, disengaged and fled.
- (2026-02-08) The GM recapped that Eko and Mok, the two doppelganger bodyguards, were killed by the party.

chunks.title: Mok
chunks.text:
NPC: Mok (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-08)
Role: doppelganger working with Veen and Ronnom Kenegal
Faction: Ronnom Kenegal's bodyguards
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
Location: Najik Monastery, lower level
- Eko and Mok were the doppelgangers working with Veen and Ronnom.
- (2026-01-11) Mok and his twin brother Eko, slender humans guarding Ronnom Kenegal, were found unarmed and unarmored playing Three Dragon Ante in a bedroom on the lower level of the Najik monastery.
- (2026-01-11) Monarch cast Charm Person at third level on Eko and Mok (DC 17 Wisdom save); the result was not stated that session.
- (2026-01-25) A doppelganger disguised as Sir Raf was hit by Raf's chromatic orb for 25 fire damage; it burned up, fell screaming and reverted to doppelganger form, and the orb bounced onto the jade-eyed woman for 11.
- (2026-02-08) Kyle recapped him as one of the two doppelganger bodyguards, 'Eko and Mok', whom the party killed.

chunks.title: Skalanthas
chunks.text:
NPC: Skalanthas (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: dragon in the cave, roaring dragon, bronze scale dragon, storm dragon, Bronze dragon of Emperor's Bay
Role: bronze dragon of Najik, guardian of the sea caves
Location: sea caves below Najik Monastery
Attitude to party: wary, then cooperative
Status: alive
- The one the monastery leader Anish was apologizing for.
- Half-brother of Ronnom Kenegal, on the isle of Najik.
- (2025-12-14) It has sunk Debbie's ship and at least one more since, and is known to the monks of Najik.
- (2025-12-14) At dawn it burst from the water and dove at the Wave Mount.
- (2026-01-11) The dragon shouted 'be gone from this place' in Common and said the island was forbidden to the party. It answered Monarch's Message with 'I do not fear your kind'.
- (2026-01-11) It used a force roar that pushed everyone in the cone 40 feet and knocked them prone into the sea (Strength save DC 15). Lucia and Portia saved. It also breathed lightning on the ship for 50 and 45 damage and rammed and clawed the hull, for about 120 damage to the ship in total.
- (2026-01-11) Monarch cast Earthbind on it. It was hit by ballista bolts for 10 and 18, Portia's Ray of Frost for 10, and Lucia's attacks for 19 and 17+5. It bled and dived deep to flee.
- (2026-01-11) Monarch's Message prompted the reply 'I will defend me and mine'. After the fight it told Lucia 'I am done with you, all of you', and it left the area.

chunks.title: Skalanthas (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Skalanthas (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-02-08)
- (2026-01-11) Raf's Insight showed it was fleeing, not repositioning, saying in effect 'it's my home, not yours'. The monks and party believe it is beholden to Ronnom Kenegal, possibly as it was to his mother Ehlonna, and it is about the right age to be her dragon.
- (2026-01-11) Anish apologized for how Skalanthas had treated the party, saying he had not been himself since the recent arrivals.
- (2026-02-08) The dragon lay submerged near the corner and hit Portia with a lightning bolt for 40 (halved on her save) when she tried to message it. It then answered that they should meet tomorrow by the goats.
- (2026-02-08) It shouted a warning to flee and said it did not wish to harm them. It told Raf this was its place and he could not enter whatever lies he told. Monarch's persuasion (16) got it to say it would discuss matters at a better time and place.
- (2026-02-08) The GM named the dragon Skalanthas. It came to Najik about fifteen years ago after Ehlonna's death; she raised it from an egg. It considers Ronnom its half-brother and blood relative, and it became territorial and began sinking ships about six months ago, when Ronnom arrived.
- (2026-02-08) It refused to take the party's word or any evidence on trust. It said it would not sink more ships if none came, and invited the party to stay on the island.

chunks.title: Skalanthas (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Skalanthas (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-02-08)
- (2026-02-08) It accepted the plan in which Veen poses as Ronnom and stands trial in his place. It let the party and the shipwreck survivors leave. It said it would be grateful and discuss other needs once Ronnom's safety is proven. The party has not recruited it, but the GM said it has been persuaded to help.

chunks.title: Magistrate Falora
chunks.text:
NPC: Magistrate Falora (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: The Sword of Surtur
Role: fire giant magistrate of Roma's Sword Quarter; handles giant cases and bounties
Location: Sword Quarter, Roma
- Magistrate Falora is a fire giant woman known as "The Sword of Surtur". She sits in Roma's Sword Quarter, handles giant cases and bounties, and is thoughtful but brutal.
- (2026-02-22) She is the first giant among Roma's magistrates, most of whom are legacy non-giant magistrates; she judges giants who break the law and handles bounty cases brought by mercenaries.
- (2026-02-22) She is reputedly thoughtful, careful and brutal, passing harsh judgment she cannot be moved from, and is called the sword of Surtur; she always believes a giant's word over a smaller folk's in testimony disputes.
- (2026-02-22) The party took Ronnom, still disguised, to her Magistrate's Office; Monarch planned to push poetic justice and a hanging, and Eddie argued against lying to a giant magistrate. The party did not stand before her this session.

chunks.title: Magistrate Goliath Ahn
chunks.text:
NPC: Magistrate Goliath Ahn (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: pyre of justice
Role: chief magistrate of White Crown
Location: White Crown
- (2026-02-22) Known as the pyre of justice; he prefers burning for death sentences and dislikes delaying justice. The party, fearing he would take the prisoner and execute him swiftly, chose not to report the prisoner to him and went to Roma instead.

chunks.title: Hermit of Dragonfjord
chunks.text:
NPC: Hermit of Dragonfjord (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-04-05)
Also known as: the hermit
Role: human hermit living in a hand-built hut near the foothills of Dragonfjord
Location: hut at the edge of the forest in the foothills south of Dragonfjord
Attitude to party: reluctant, uninterested in company but gave help
Status: alive
- (2026-02-22) An older fur-clad human with long gray braids, living in a one-room hut with a winter wolf. He let the party in grudgingly, offered no food, and gave them no chairs.
- (2026-02-22) He said at least five dragons live in the fjord: Sven the oldest patriarch, Vorrel or snow mother, Rhymescar, Sheerkess (also called cold wake because she likes to swim) and the younger Isildrax, described as tricky.
- (2026-02-22) He told the party a pass is a little north; partway it drops into a bad crevasse, so go up through the forked two-topped peak instead of the apparently easy way, and warned that his people, the dragons and yeti will hunt them if they get too high, so they need stealth.
- (2026-02-22) Monarch gave him a potion of greater healing as thanks and Sir Raf gave a Good Berry; he put both on a shelf. Eddie noticed old intricate scarification on his forearm; Lucia and Portia sensed he hides another side of himself.
- (2026-04-05) The party recalled that the hermit gave their info on five dragons: one ancient, a couple adult, one younger, and a fifth unknown age.

chunks.title: Useless
chunks.text:
NPC: Useless (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: the hermit's winter wolf
Role: winter wolf companion of the hermit
Location: hermit's hut
Status: alive
- (2026-02-22) The hermit's wolf is a large winter wolf, about ten feet nose to tail with a shoulder height of three or four feet; its breath is colder than the room. 'Useless' is the sound the hermit makes to get its attention. Portia spoke to it with speak with animals.
- (2026-02-22) The wolf barely slept and watched the party all night; Kyle said a winter wolf being kind to a person suggests something significant happened between them. It seems to understand only certain sounds in Common.

chunks.title: Winter wolf pack
chunks.text:
NPC: Winter wolf pack (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-03-08)
Also known as: five winter wolves
Role: stalking predators following the party's trail in the mountains
Location: Dragonfjord foothill pass
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-02-22) Through Portia's owl, the party saw five winter wolves stalking their trail with a group stealth check of 15. The party chose to fight rather than lose them.
- (2026-02-22) In combat, Eddie's longbow shot at 150 feet missed (12); Sir Raf's fire bolt hit for 11 fire damage; Lucia hit a wolf for 27, bloodied it, and frost formed on all five wolves' muzzles as they advanced. The session ended there.
- (2026-03-08) Five horse-sized winter wolves attacked the party; Portia's conjured wolf spirits and fireballs (25 fire to those who failed saves), Monarch's lightning bolts (32 damage) and the others' attacks killed all five. Their breath dealt 21 cold to Eddie and 18 cold to Portia and Sir Raf.
- (2026-03-08) The wolves' bites knocked Sir Raf prone; the pack hit him for 16, 11 and 9 piercing, 36 total, mostly soaked by temporary hit points.
- (2026-03-08) The wolves' pelts were skinned and packed; the party has five pelts, and Kyle noted they need curing within about a week.

chunks.title: Yeti
chunks.text:
NPC: Yeti (first seen 2026-03-08, last seen 2026-06-14)
Also known as: yetis, jetty
Location: Rimescar's lair
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-03-08) Kyle gave the party lore: yeti are somewhat intelligent, work together, can freeze a creature with their gaze, hurl ice, trigger avalanches, and keep frozen larders. Abominable yeti, expressions of a demon lord of ice, rival frost giants. Yeti can be dominated by frost giants or white and silver dragons.
- (2026-03-08) Two yeti tracked the party's trail to its camp. Wall of fire from Portia, Lucia's psychic damage, Eddie's guiding bolt, Monarch's sorcerer's burst (18 fire) and Sir Raf's fire bolt (11) killed them. One's gaze forced Eddie to save (13, succeeded) and it threw ice, a critical hit, for 6 bludgeoning and 5 cold.
- (2026-03-08) Four sets of long-strided tracks and signs of an old cleared wagon road led off uphill, suggesting a yeti den, possibly an old mine.
- (2026-05-17) Four yeti ran past Monarch's clairvoyance sensor with fresh blood on their teeth and claws, then fed on carcasses while Rimescar watched. They speak Yeti. At the session's end a yeti charged the party roaring with frost as they rounded a corner.
- (2026-06-14) Four yeti attacked the party at the start of the session. Portia's fireball (31 fire) bloodied them. Monarch's lightning bolt (29) killed two, Lucia killed one, and Portia's firebolt finished another. Their chilling gaze forced Con saves (DC 13), which Eddie and Raf made.

chunks.title: Yeti (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Yeti (first seen 2026-03-08, last seen 2026-06-14)
- (2026-06-14) Yeti have disadvantage after being hit by fire. In the final fight, the yeti used freezing gaze, which Lunae ignored. The dwarves killed one, and Monarch's lightning bolt (33) killed the last.

chunks.title: Cherek longship crew
chunks.text:
NPC: Cherek longship crew (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-08-09)
Also known as: Norge warriors, Goliath crew, Fenrir's ship crew
Role: Norge raiders and warriors, mostly Goliaths, aboard the Fenrir-prowed longship
Faction: Cherek
Location: Cherek camp beside the Fenrir
Attitude to party: hostile if discovered
Status: alive
- (2026-04-05) The longship is crewed by about 30 oars of big Goliath warriors with some archers, swapping war stories in Common with a Norge inflection. Its hull is painted white and pale blue with a Fenrir figurehead, and it carries a chilly, light-dimming fog and a magical fear aura (Wisdom save; Portia and Lucia failed, Eddie succeeded).
- (2026-04-05) The ship resisted Eddie's clairvoyance. It rowed at base speed 50 east and landed at an inlet south of the party's shore, where the crew of 32 beached it and made camp and fires in mist, with no one splitting off.
- (2026-04-05) The party believes the Cherek are negotiating with dragons and expecting a second tribute fleet of galleons.
- (2026-04-19) The crew set up a camp suggesting a long stay, about 30 to 32 elite, older Cherek warriors in six small tents and one large pavilion near the shore, with mixed plundered gear, wrapped in a 500-foot-across dark fog that resembles Private Sanctum.
- (2026-04-19) After the dragon attack the camp showed no damage, no injured, no collapsed tents and no frost patches.

chunks.title: Cherek longship crew (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Cherek longship crew (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-08-09)
- (2026-04-19) When Monarch's light revealed her presence, a hulking Cherek burst through the pavilion and was blinded, and the camp shouted to get her; the ship's guards readied bows but could not find a target.
- (2026-04-19) The Cherek are waiting for the treasure ship to arrive before dealing with the dragon.
- (2026-04-19) Their longship is carved with many runes and has a Fenrir figurehead, and may be the source of the powerful fog spell.
- (2026-07-12) The negotiating party was about a dozen Goliaths with three heavy wagons pulled by Northern draft horses. They included two ogre-sized giants with a cold blue cast, probably frost giants, a scarred old Goliath who gave the orders, and a tattooed rune caster. Vigdis led them.
- (2026-07-12) The Cherek camped about two thirds of the way from the shore to the planned meeting spot. Pickets saw Portia in wolf form and ignored her.
- (2026-07-12) The Cherek party fended off Rimescar's attack at the beach earlier by some kind of barrier blocking his breath. A moving invisible circle around the group, centered on the rune caster, was seen crossing the snow.
- (2026-07-12) The tribute wagons held one wagon with 50,000 silver, 10,000 gold and 24 gems worth 100-1,000 each, and one wagon with a longsword, longbow, greataxe, shield, arrows, crown, necklace, five rings and chain mail. Of these, the sword, bow, axe, shield, one ring, chain mail and arrows were magic. The third wagon held two caged prisoners.

chunks.title: Cherek longship crew (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Cherek longship crew (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-08-09)
- (2026-08-09) The camp, left behind while the tribute wagon group went to the next dragon, held about 30 Cherek: berserkers, Goliaths, a few bearsarks and giant kin, under one commander who sleeps in armor in the pavilion on a fur-trimmed bedroll.
- (2026-08-09) The camp is spread into main and satellite camps against dragon breath, with one watch per fire. The wagon group is a handpicked subset of the toughest.
- (2026-08-09) A previous dragon breath attack on their camp was blocked by an invisible barrier; the dragon left.
- (2026-08-09) Their pavilion is under private sanctum, which blocked Eddie's clairvoyance. Portia searched the commander's pack and bedroll as a spider and found no documents.
- (2026-08-09) Monarch's charm person on the Goliath bearsark and the Cherek hunter worked (bearsark rolled 7, hunter 11 against DC 19). Both then urged her to leave the ship, did not know of any 'documents', and said the ship would kill her.
- (2026-08-09) Bearsarks can become bears in battle; bearskins are a status mark. Their wisdom saves are low.

chunks.title: Cherek rune-elder
names: old man with the rune staff
chunks.text:
NPC: Cherek rune-elder (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-08-09)
Also known as: old Goliath with the staff, fate waver, communicating guy, rune caster, tattooed rune caster, rune master, room master, old man with the rune staff
Role: rune master and negotiator; protection from dragons caster for the escort party
Faction: Cherek
Status: alive
- (2026-04-05) An older Goliath with a big gray beard walks with a rune-carved staff he needs to walk, and wears a necklace of 50 or 60 small stone tablets. He ignores no one but no one speaks to him. He seemed to concentrate on arcane activity when the masked woman asked him to send word for the next ships.
- (2026-04-05) The party considers him the priority target because he is the communicator.
- (2026-06-14) The Cherek expedition also had an old rune master with a staff, whose name the party never learned.
- (2026-07-12) The tattooed rune caster is covered in rune tattoos and carries a runed staff and a bag of rune stones. He walked the camp perimeter concentrating on something, wore heavy furs, and stayed at the center of the group, maintaining the moving barrier, during the negotiation.
- (2026-07-26) The GM, correcting Raf's 'rune master', named him as the rune master 'Hoskolder' (earlier spoken as 'Hoskildur'), one of the negotiators with Vigdis who operate from the Fenrir. This line equates the rune master with the name Hoskolder, but the exact spelling is uncertain.

chunks.title: Cherek rune-elder (part 2)
names: old man with the rune staff
chunks.text:
NPC: Cherek rune-elder (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-08-09)
- (2026-07-26) In the mirror vision Icevein stared silently at the old man with the rune staff before flying off; the party thinks Icevein respects or is wary of him. Monarch called him extremely powerful.
- (2026-07-26) Monarch's clairvoyance saw him walk over to Vigdis after she dressed down a frost-giant-kin Goliath and warn her to be careful with those who have 'hunter's favor': 'you know what he will do'. Portia read the two as uneasy coworkers, not friends or enemies.
- (2026-07-26) He traveled out with the escort of the tribute wagon, among eight people including Vigdis.
- (2026-08-09) The Fenrir's enchantments were left behind by the rune master; the camp has no other rune master or spellcaster to refresh them. His quarters are in the stern below decks, and elementals are somewhere near them.
- (2026-08-09) The rune master is not at the camp; the party saw no rune master among the troops.

chunks.title: Icevein
names: Ancient white dragon of the island
chunks.text:
NPC: Icevein (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: huge white dragon, white dragon, ancient white, Ancient white dragon of the island
Role: in general
Location: rocky island in Dragonfjord
Attitude to party: unaware of the party; would be very dangerous if angered
Status: alive
- Lunae (by Sending) on Icevein: "Icevein too dangerous" to overfly the fjord in natural form; "Consider why Icevein is following. He has no curiosity. Only greed and hate. You may be able to use him."
- (2026-04-05) A huge dragon circled the island and watched the party from about 20 miles, then dove away north toward the fjord opening. The island's frigid water, fog and ice-coated rocks are hallmarks of an adult or ancient white dragon's lair, and the party suspects the Cherek made a deal with it.
- (2026-04-05) At night a dragon shape roared overhead from east to west and dove toward the Cherek camp's mist.
- (2026-04-19) The party watched an adult white dragon dive from the east onto the Cherek camp from about five miles away and breathe into it. It flew back east trailing smoke that burned out, and its head tracked Eddie's group for a minute without changing course.
- (2026-04-19) Later the party saw a dragon from six or seven miles away dive on a group of dwarves and fly north into the mountains. Frozen remains were left, including one face-down dwarf.

chunks.title: Icevein (part 2)
names: Ancient white dragon of the island
chunks.text:
NPC: Icevein (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-04-19) Kyle told the party that white dragons are the least cunning chromatic dragons and rule through fear and strength. They need to be hit back before they will listen. They freeze prey for later and have blindsight in their lairs.
- (2026-05-17) The party recalled this dragon made a deal with the Norge and has stopped attacking them. It is the ancient dragon needed to wish the white dragon mask destroyed.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae suspects the ancient white dragon on the island is Icevein, the patriarch she fought before her imprisonment.
- (2026-07-12) The GM said the Cherek were known to have negotiated successfully with the ancient white. The party debated whether it will merely stay neutral or actively aid the Cherek, and judged neutrality more likely.
- (2026-07-26) Kyle (GM) and Lunae's account treat every name the table used for the ancient white dragon as one dragon, Icevein. Kyle said the hermit's list of dragon names is where the party got the name, and Lunae confirms that dragon is Icevein and moved in about thirty years ago.
- (2026-07-26) Sorcha said the ancient white dragon Icevein is lord of Hvítfjall, the Great White Mountain in Norge, so his presence here is news. Ancients do not normally move once settled; the GM said he probably still regards his northern lair as home and this place as a campsite, and it is too warm here for a white dragon year round.
- (2026-07-26) Icevein is a patriarch and sire, not a matriarch; the other white dragons are full adult offspring, not young.

chunks.title: Icevein (part 3)
names: Ancient white dragon of the island
chunks.text:
NPC: Icevein (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-07-26) Lucia's Mirror of the Past visions showed Icevein as enormous: he froze the sea and ice-bound the Fenrir, landed before Vigdis and the rune master, stared silently at the rune master, then flew off.
- (2026-07-26) A vision showed Icevein facing a crowned frost giant with frost giants and Goliaths behind him; the giant gestured and Icevein stayed utterly still, and the giant turned away. Another showed a younger Icevein pinning a frost giant under a claw.
- (2026-07-26) A vision showed Icevein breathing frost elementals out of a hole torn to the para-elemental plane of ice, destroying seven of a dozen giant-built ships in one pass and leaving, more a demonstration than a battle.
- (2026-07-26) A vision showed Icevein instructing three young white dragons, one of them a young Rimescar.
- (2026-07-26) None of Icevein's visions with frost giants were friendly; the GM said that if the party could prove the Cherek effort serves the frost giants he would likely flip the table, but it would need hard evidence.
- (2026-07-26) Lunae said the fight with Icevein ended when she was pulled into the iron flask; she suspects he gave Rimescar her lair out of cruelty and to protect Rimescar. She warned that Icevein will eventually learn Rimescar's fate and come for the party unless the way he finds out points elsewhere.

chunks.title: Icevein (part 4)
names: Ancient white dragon of the island
chunks.text:
NPC: Icevein (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-07-26) Rowan answered the party's sending that Icevein is extremely dangerous and generationally vengeful, and warned them not to let him discover the Imperial Hand's involvement or Rimescar's fall, or he will aid the invasion.
- (2026-10-18) The GM said Icevein is a he; the ancient dragon is a he.
- (2026-10-18) Lunae said she will not overfly the fjord in natural form because Icevein is too dangerous; the GM said he nearly killed her once. Her lair is compromised by its proximity to Icevein.
- (2026-10-18) He was seen flying near his island, then tailed the Fenrir north at about 80 speed without dashing. Lucia and Eddie judged his behavior as tailing or scouting to see what they were up to.
- (2026-10-18) Lunae replied by Sending that Icevein has only greed and hate and that the party may be able to use him.
- (2026-10-18) Near sunset, he dashed, overtook the Fenrir and flew on past it toward the north.

chunks.title: Vigdis Foe Shatter
chunks.text:
NPC: Vigdis Foe Shatter (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-04)
Also known as: Vigdis, white dragon mask wearer, Goliath woman with paired weapons, Foe Shatter
Role: Cherek war leader
Faction: Cherek
Status: alive
Attitude to party: unaware of them
Location: Fenrir, sailing south along the Dragonfjord shore
- (2026-04-05) A clean-shaven tattooed Goliath woman in heavy armor and furs, with all weapons in pairs (two bastard swords, two hand axes, two javelin quivers, multiple daggers in each boot), came down from the island path and waded into the icy water. She wears a stylized white dragon mask similar to Eddie's mask in a different color, and ordered the ship east.
- (2026-04-05) The party plans to take her mask and kill or ambush her so no negotiation or payoff reaches the dragon.
- (2026-04-19) Monarch overheard a woman telling Foe Shatter 'No. Without treasure, we have nothing. Let him come again.'
- (2026-04-19) The GM said Foe Shatter is a Cherek moniker implying something striking in the person's past, but nobody in the party recognized the name.
- (2026-06-14) Kyle (as the GM) described Vigdis Foe Shatter as the war leader and head of the expedition, speaking in the same exchange in which Monarch tried to recall the name Foe Shatter. The names are treated as the one individual.
- (2026-06-14) Monarch tried to give Lunae the name, remembering it as a very good name. Lunae did not know which Cherek clan was involved and said she needed more information.

chunks.title: Vigdis Foe Shatter (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Vigdis Foe Shatter (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-04)
- (2026-07-12) Vigdis is a powerfully built woman with many pouches and belts, wearing the white dragon mask. She sat apart watching the waterfalls with the mask in her lap, and took a knee when the false Rimescar landed, followed by her whole entourage.
- (2026-07-12) Vigdis introduced herself in Draconic as Vigdis Foe Shatter of the North. She said she treated with Rimescar's father, the great Icevein, master of the fjord, and that the gifts were tailored to Rimescar's needs.
- (2026-07-12) Vigdis asked the dragon to keep to its lair and hoard while the Cherek pass through to pillage the Imperium, and offered Imperial treasures if it would lead them in battle. She sealed the deal with 'in the name of the dread mother' and Monarch answered 'by the blood of the dread mother'.
- (2026-07-12) Vigdis left the tribute wagons and marched away with her party, not noticing the illusion.
- (2026-07-26) Vigdis wore the white dragon mask when dealing with dragons and is very powerful; the mask is still with her on the Fenrir's ship.
- (2026-07-26) Monarch's clairvoyance showed Vigdis fidgeting wistfully with a locket around her neck while looking north over the fjord.
- (2026-07-26) Monarch watched Vigdis dress down a frost-giant-kin Goliath; she snarled that he doesn't have to return alive for this to succeed.

chunks.title: Vigdis Foe Shatter (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Vigdis Foe Shatter (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-04)
- (2026-07-26) The rune master then approached her, pointed at her and warned 'be careful with those who have hunter's favor. You know what he will do'; she did not answer. The GM said there is tension between them and she seems to act inside a power structure she doesn't control or like.
- (2026-07-26) Vigdis and the rune master traveled with a six-person escort and a single wagon of tribute toward the southern dragon's lair, expected to take all day each way.
- (2026-08-09) The party presumes Foe Shatter has quarters below decks on the Fenrir, as the rune master does; they did not learn where.
- (2026-09-06) The party expect to confront her eventually; Monarch expects to be target number one because the crew would know she charmed them.
- (2026-10-04) The letters in the chest in the guarded cabin were all addressed to Vigdis; the bound logbooks were in one unsigned hand, so the GM said it was not certain they were hers.
- (2026-10-04) The logbook entries refer to her orders coming from 'the winter favored' and to constraining 'terms'.

chunks.title: Dwarf survivors of Mithril Peaks clan
names: Dwarf survivors of Mithril Peaks clan
chunks.text:
NPC: Dwarf survivors of Mithril Peaks clan (first seen 2026-05-17, last seen 2026-06-14)
Faction: Mithril Peaks clan
Status: alive
Location: mining tunnels and cavern confined area in Rimescar's lair
Attitude to party: grateful
- (2026-05-17) Dwarves with spiked boots and Mithril Peaks clan markings met the party and whispered that they must flee because the dragon would kill them. They are survivors and descendants of Rimescar's attack and forced to mine mithril. They cannot leave and are confined to their part of the cavern.
- (2026-05-17) They do not know where the hoard is. The dragon rests beyond the frozen river, 50 or 60 feet past where they met the party along the left-hand wall. Via Lucia's telepathic link (1 hour) they offered to signal the party when the dragon leaves.
- (2026-05-17) Their leader, Grodel Deepdelver, said in the one-hour psychic link that his brother Bodgel had tried to escape; the party told them they had found him dead. The dwarves hustled the troll corpses away to the dragon.
- (2026-05-17) Eddie's Sending reached a Goliath-named dwarf who replied that he fetches Skullrender's tribe in twos, four are here, and the party should listen for his exit at the falls, giving them an hour.
- (2026-06-14) The dwarves shouted 'no fire, you fools, you'll summon it' after Portia's fireball, and warned Eddie of an ice creature that hunts heat and is almost as dangerous as the dragon.
- (2026-06-14) The dwarves were formerly the silver dragon's entourage. They cheered Lunae's return and numbered about 20, ambushing and killing Rimescar with crossbows.

chunks.title: Ice trolls
chunks.text:
NPC: Ice trolls (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-05-17)
Also known as: ice troll A, frost trolls
Location: icy halls above the crevice near the white dragon's lair
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-04-19) A gray-white ice troll attacked the party; it radiates life-sapping cold within 10 feet and regenerates unless hit by fire or acid. Monarch learned the hearts of ice trolls hold lingering magic.
- (2026-04-19) The first ice troll fell after fire bolt, burning hands, spiritual weapon and Eddie's rapier of wounding, which stopped its regeneration. A second troll arrived and a third was glimpsed, and the fight was unfinished.
- (2026-05-17) The second ice troll attacked Sir Raf with a cold aura (7, 11 and 16 cold damage over several turns, halved by Raf's resistance); the party killed it. Portia's blight finished it after fire bolts, Raf's booming blade, Monarch's magic missile and fire damage, and Eddie's spiritual weapon.
- (2026-05-17) Both ice trolls' hearts were cut out (Eddie rolled a natural 20 on the excision). Monarch learned a heart keeps its magic for 24 hours and can be eaten for troll-like regeneration (fire or acid interrupts it), buried to summon a day-long blizzard, used in a hag ritual for brown mold, or made into a potion of cold resistance with an alchemist's kit.
- (2026-05-17) The dwarves said Rimescar left the two trolls to keep them in line and eat escapees or intruders, and that there are no other trolls.

chunks.title: Ice trolls (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Ice trolls (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-05-17)
- (2026-05-17) Eddie and Sir Raf ate the two hearts and gained 5 hit points of regeneration per round for 24 hours, which fire or acid interrupts.

chunks.title: Rimescar
chunks.text:
NPC: Rimescar (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-07-26)
Also known as: Rheimscar, Rhymescar, Rimesgar, Ruinscar, Rune Scar, Ruinskar, Rime Scar, Rimescarg
Role: dragon named on the party's map whose lair the dwarves escaped from
Location: lair beneath the ice and frozen river cavern, Dragonfjord mountains
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-04-19) The speak with dead answers were 'Escape Rimescar', given when Eddie asked where the dwarf group came from and why they were going to the coast. 25 others are still there. Kyle said Rimescar is one of the five dragon names on the party's map.
- (2026-04-19) The party followed the dwarves' trail to a crevice beside a frozen waterfall near where the map places the dragon's lair. The cold deepened within a mile of it, and a roar later echoed through the halls.
- (2026-04-19) The roar forced Wisdom saves, and Monarch and Portia failed, dropped their staves and became frightened. The party is not explicitly told the roar came from Rimescar.
- (2026-05-17) Rimescar roared 'What is the meaning of this? You bring the trolls to me' when the party's rest was interrupted. Portia's nature check of 24 told her the dragon is at least adult, huge, CR 13 in metagame terms.
- (2026-05-17) Portia recalled that white dragons are immune to cold and have no weaknesses; they have poor Intelligence and Charisma but strong Wisdom saves and legendary resistance and actions. They have blindsight and keen senses and cannot see through illusions.

chunks.title: Rimescar (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Rimescar (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-07-26)
- (2026-05-17) The Mirror of the Past showed Rimescar badly wounded with ballista bolts, fleeing Maulring dragon hunters, and fighting alongside a gargantuan white dragon against a gargantuan silver dragon in the fjord. It also showed him landing in a cavern of yeti and meeting an enormous yeti.
- (2026-05-17) Diego scouted the lair and Rimescar breathed on him at once, killing him. Monarch's later clairvoyance showed Rimescar watching yeti feed on carcasses before he dived into the water and swam under the ice and out via the waterfall. A Sending reply from a dwarf said he fetches Skullrender's tribe.
- (2026-06-14) Rimescar returned bursting out of the water carrying two yeti, roared 'who dare?' and breathed cold on the disguised Lunae, who was unharmed. Raf made a Dex save of 21 and took 13 after resistance, with a base of 53.
- (2026-06-14) He burned through three legendary resistances. He resisted Monarch's earthbind (Str DC 18) but not hold monster (Wis DC 19, he rolled an 8), and was held and paralyzed. Raf's mind sliver gave him a d4 penalty to his next save and dealt 8 psychic damage.
- (2026-06-14) The Mithril Peaks dwarves volleyed crossbows with advantage at the paralyzed dragon and killed him, a total of 79. Lunae intends to eat him; the party took scales and a tooth.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae named Rimescar's siblings: Icevein, Voorhl (his new partner, from far north), Rimescar and Isildrax. Isildrax is perhaps younger than the others.

chunks.title: Rimescar (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Rimescar (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-07-26)
- (2026-07-12) The party's plan was to hide that Rimescar is dead. Monarch used a permanent major image of Rimescar as a puppet, with Cherek-believed continuity, to receive the Cherek tribute. The GM noted nobody outside the party knows he is dead.
- (2026-07-12) Rimescar's hoard was smaller than expected for an adult white, suggesting he had lost a previous hoard.
- (2026-07-12) Rimescar had immunity to cold damage, and the party is resistant to cold from the hero's feast of eating him.
- (2026-07-26) The mirror showed Rimescar as a young white dragon among three being instructed by Icevein; Rimescar was one of Icevein's offspring.
- (2026-07-26) Diane suggested dropping Rimescar's skull on the Fenrir's ship to frame the Cherek; Monarch asked whether the skull fits in a bag of holding.

chunks.title: Lunae
chunks.text:
NPC: Lunae (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-10-18)
Status: alive
Role: silver dragon
Location: aboard the Fenrir
Attitude to party: friendly
- The DM's map of Dragonfjord marks a lair labeled "Lunae Dragon" in the mountains north-east of the fjord.
- Party Sending to Lunae: "OK, the Longship can hold the 40. We are heading north about 4 miles offshore. The sail is down." Lunae replied: "Won't overfly fjord in natural form. Icevein too dangerous. Will move clan to river mouth at northeast side of fjord mouth."
- Eddie's Sending to Lunae (4:57 PM): "We will pass the river mouth in 15 minutes. Pick up those present. Icevein about 45 minutes behind. Hide. We can double back for more." Lunae replied: "Will observe as eagle. Consider why Icevein is following. He has no curiosity. Only greed and hate. You may be able to use him."
- (2026-04-19) A sending told the party: 'divination on finding Lunae. Falls become rise, wall becomes water, an iron prison in hand, a moon rises in the east.'
- (2026-04-19) A kindly silver dragon spirit pulled Monarch, Portia and Lucia into the astral plane. She said 'I am only somewhat trapped. There is more you need to know to find me', and opened a door to a vast library.
- (2026-04-19) Rowan's reply to the party's Sending said the Mithril Peaks clan and the silver dragon patron Lunae have been silent for years, and that Rowan's side would inquire and try to locate and co-opt the silver dragon.

chunks.title: Lunae (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Lunae (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-05-17) Portia's reading of her library answer says the silver dragon (rendered 'Lunae', i.e. Lunae) languished in a legendary iron flask buried behind thick ice in Rimescar's hoard, requiring only to be found and opened. Portia concluded the party must go deeper into the cave.
- (2026-05-17) The GM, voicing a Mithril Peaks dwarf, said the clan was allied with Lunae (rendered 'Lunae'), who then disappeared, and Rimescar was upon them almost immediately afterward. The dwarf said Rimescar could not defeat her in direct combat.
- (2026-05-17) The Mirror of the Past showed a white dragonborn among the white dragon's followers drawing an iron flask during a battle between a gargantuan silver dragon and a gargantuan white dragon, with Rimescar also present.
- (2026-06-14) Portia opened the iron flask and Lunae emerged as an enormous silver dragon, bound to obey the party for one hour. She said she was in better shape than she expected.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae called out to the dwarves of the Mithril Peaks, who cheered and came running. She took command of their defense and planned to hold Rimescar in place with her paralyzing breath and hold monster.
