- (2026-06-14) She disguised herself as a dwarf for the ambush. She cowered before Rimescar, then took her true form and breathed paralyzing breath twice to burn his legendary resistances. She cast hold monster (DC 19) at the end of Monarch's turn to hold him.

chunks.title: Lunae (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Lunae (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-06-14) Lunae was imprisoned while fighting Icevein. She knew of Icevein plus three offspring, and named Rheinscar, Chircus and Isildrax among the dragons she knew.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae deduced the heat-hunter in the ice is a frost salamander, which can be bargained with. She said she can feel it distantly.
- (2026-06-14) She asked to keep the flask to lock up other dragons and reestablish control of the fjord, and the party agreed. She intends to eat Rimescar, and invited the party to join the ritual dragon feast.
- (2026-06-14) She said she is no friend of the Imperium, calling the party friends but their government much less so. Some of her kind have close ties with the Norge, but some Norge clans have fallen under white dragons and frost giants.
- (2026-06-14) She identified the camp's symbols as those of the Sundered Sky clan's subclans, one being Odin's Blind Eye. Their ship Fenrir's is an old magic ship, probably sentient. They are likely in service to frost giants.
- (2026-06-14) She says the party's chance to get an ancient chromatic dragon to willingly wish a dragon mask destroyed is slim. Most dragons would be strengthened by Tiamat's return, and some metallic dragons would not oppose it. She suggested time magic experts and a dragon from after Tiamat's return.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae cannot shapeshift into other dragons. She smelled no difference from missing hoard treasure, and said Icevein probably took the best of it.

chunks.title: Lunae (part 4)
chunks.text:
NPC: Lunae (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-06-14) Lunae's own breath weapons are not the Living Cold Breath guardians; those were Rimescar's.
- (2026-07-12) Lunae, voiced by the GM, said she wants to prevent the Norge invasion rather than enter the war, and would reveal herself if that would stop it; she dislikes the Imperium but not the Cherek of the North.
- (2026-07-12) Lunae said she could defeat any one white dragon except the ancient, but fears all of them coming for her at once; she is mostly concerned for the dwarves she wants to protect.
- (2026-07-12) Lunae said the majority of her hoard is under the control of the ancient white dragon, and she expects it will take a handful of decades to reclaim the area.
- (2026-07-12) Lunae is the same size Rimescar was, so probably an adult. The GM noted chromatics are weaker pound for pound than metallics by 5-10%.
- (2026-07-12) Lunae still holds the iron flask; it was given to her.
- (2026-07-26) Lunae knows of a cave to the south she once scouted as a lair but rejected as too accessible; she says a dragon there might make the easy entrance an obvious death trap.
- (2026-07-26) As an adult silver she can beat one adult white easily, but two is dicey and an ancient plus adults means flight; the fight with Icevein ended when she was pulled into the iron flask.
- (2026-07-26) Lunae plans to take her charges, the clan, to safety and find a new home. She learned from the dwarves there is a remorhaz near her lair and decided the lair is no good.

chunks.title: Lunae (part 5)
chunks.text:
NPC: Lunae (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-07-26) The party told Eddie's sending that Lunae is neutral.
- (2026-10-04) Eddie sent Lunae a message that the party swiped the Fenrir longship, Norge sends tens of thousands, and they are heading to White Crown, asking whether she wants to join.
- (2026-10-04) Lunae replied she will come to see if the ship can carry 40 and, if so, ferry her clan to it, since they need a temporary home until she can secure Dragonfjord.
- (2026-10-04) The GM noted her clan are mountain dwarves, no more skilled at handling a ship than the party but able to row.
- (2026-10-18) Replied to Eddie's Sending that she won't overfly the fjord in natural form because Icevein nearly killed her once, and that she will move her clan to the river mouth on the northeast side of the fjord mouth.
- (2026-10-18) Replied to a second Sending that she will observe as an eagle, and said Icevein follows out of greed and hate and the party may be able to use him.
- (2026-10-18) Her lair is compromised by its proximity to Icevein; she is lining up other accommodations and will not return to Dragonfjord for decades.
- (2026-10-18) The GM estimated she can ferry only four to eight dwarves per flight. She flies at speed 80, slower than the Fenrir under oars and elementals. She said she needs another trip to her lair to gather her valuables.
- (2026-10-18) Lunae knew of the permanent illusion of the dead white dragon in the waterfall lake and said it doesn't matter to her. Monarch could not dismiss it, since the spell lasts until dispelled.

chunks.title: Lunae (part 6)
chunks.text:
NPC: Lunae (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-10-18) After the party ran the northern fleet blockade, she dove from the rocky island as an eagle, landed on the Fenrir's deck as an Elven woman, looked north and said 'that was interesting'.

chunks.title: Bangler
chunks.text:
NPC: Bangler (first seen 2026-05-17, last seen 2026-05-17)
Also known as: Mangler, Bangalore
Role: fungal dwarf or hill giant met in the astral library's future section
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2026-05-17) Monarch went through the library's future section with Bangler, who was impulsive and thrust his hand into burning books until Monarch pulled his book out with mage hand.

chunks.title: Maulring dragon hunters
chunks.text:
NPC: Maulring dragon hunters (first seen 2026-05-17, last seen 2026-07-12)
Also known as: Maulringers
Faction: Duchy of Maulring
Status: seen only in a vision of the past
- (2026-05-17) Lucia's history check of 20 identified the armored fliers pursuing a wounded Rimescar in the mirror vision as Maulringers from the Duchy of Maulring, a small dragon-hunting principality in the mountains between the Kingdom of the West and the Imperium. They ride carpets, pegasi and griffins, and many are Warforged holding fallen soldiers' spirits.
- (2026-07-12) The GM said the Duchy of Maulring is west of the fjord and opposes all dragonkind. Maulringers earn skull marks for dragon kills, and Maulring pioneered or rediscovered warforged creation.
- (2026-07-12) These two Maulringers cared little for politics beyond hunting dragons.

chunks.title: White dragonborn with the iron flask
names: White dragonborn with the iron flask
chunks.text:
NPC: White dragonborn with the iron flask (first seen 2026-05-17, last seen 2026-05-17)
Faction: entourage of the ancient white dragon
Status: seen only in a vision of the past
- (2026-05-17) In the mirror vision a white dragonborn among the ancient white dragon's followers drew a concealed iron flask and slowly smiled during the fjord battle.

chunks.title: Grodel Deepdelver
chunks.text:
NPC: Grodel Deepdelver (first seen 2026-05-17, last seen 2026-05-17)
Also known as: Grodel
Role: dwarf of the Mithril Peaks clan held in Rimescar's mine
Faction: Mithril Peaks clan
Location: mining tunnels in Rimescar's lair
- Grodel Deepdelver is the brother of Bodgel Deepdelver, the dwarf the party found dead outside and spoke with.
- (2026-05-17) In the psychic network he told the party that the Mithril Peaks survivors and their descendants work Rimescar's mine and cannot escape, and that his brother Bodgel had tried.

chunks.title: Living Cold Breath
chunks.text:
NPC: Living Cold Breath (first seen 2026-06-14, last seen 2026-06-14)
Also known as: living breath, cold breaths, frosty air masses
Role: guardians of the white dragon's hoard
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-06-14) Three intelligent masses of frosty air guarded the hoard chamber behind the ice wall and attacked Raf as soon as it was broken through. Their attacks dealt bludgeoning plus cold (e.g. 13 and 15; 17 and 28), and Raf resisted the cold.
- (2026-06-14) The party killed all three. The warmling's tiny cold breath healed one of them for 31. Lucia's psychic and sneak attack damage did most of the killing.
- (2026-06-14) Rimescar made these guardians, and Lunae says creating them takes a long time and great power.

chunks.title: White dragon warmling
chunks.text:
NPC: White dragon warmling (first seen 2026-06-14, last seen 2026-06-14)
Also known as: Warmling, baby dragon, baby white dragon
Role: newly hatched offspring in Rimescar's hoard
Status: dead
- (2026-06-14) Portia's call lightning cracked open the dragon egg and a warmling hatched. Its small cold breath healed a living cold breath for 31.
- (2026-06-14) The party decided to subdue it nonlethally. Eddie put it to sleep with the sleep spell (Wis DC 14), and they left it asleep while looting.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae walked through Monarch's illusion and ate it ('Chomp').

chunks.title: Frost salamander
chunks.text:
NPC: Frost salamander (first seen 2026-06-14, last seen 2026-06-14)
Also known as: heat-hunting creature in the ice, salamander
Role: possible heat-hunter beneath the ice
Location: distant under the ice near Rimescar's lair
Status: alive
- (2026-06-14) Portia's nature check narrowed the heat-hunting creature to a frost salamander or a remorhaz; the lack of destruction nearby suggested the salamander. Lunae agreed it is a frost salamander, which can be bargained with.
- (2026-06-14) It senses heat by distance: fireball-level heat now, then campfires, torches and body heat as it nears. Fire attracts it.

chunks.title: Sorcha
chunks.text:
NPC: Sorcha (first seen 2026-07-12, last seen 2026-07-26)
Role: Maulring dragon slayer
Faction: Duchy of Maulring
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2026-07-12) Sorcha is a human woman held caged in the Cherek tribute wagon. She bears two dragon-skull marks, the Maulring sign of having helped slay dragons. The note on her cage said she helped slay Rimescar's mate.
- (2026-07-12) Sorcha said she was captured while hunting dragons and held bound for weeks. She was freed, will join the party in dragon slaying, and accepted Lunae's help on an enemy-of-my-enemy basis after Portia's persuasion.
- (2026-07-26) Sorcha is talkative and asked clarifying questions. She noted Vigdis called the ancient dragon Icevein, but Icevein is lord of Hvítfjall in Norge, so his presence here is news.
- (2026-07-26) The Maulringers are unreasonable about dragons only within the Duchy of Maulring and pragmatic elsewhere; they are not thrilled by Lunae but accepted working with her.
- (2026-07-26) She and Ashvale said while captive they heard the Norge fleet is very large: hundreds of ships, tens of thousands of warriors.

chunks.title: Ashvale
chunks.text:
NPC: Ashvale (first seen 2026-07-12, last seen 2026-07-26)
Also known as: Ashville
Role: warforged Maulring dragon slayer
Faction: Duchy of Maulring
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2026-07-12) Ashvale is a male-appearing warforged with three dragon skulls on his chest plate, custom forearm manacles, an arm blade and a repeating crossbow. The note said he was among those who slew Rimescar's young. He needs a long rest to make more bolts.
- (2026-07-12) Ashvale and Sorcha worked together before and are on board for any dragon slaying the party does.
- (2026-07-26) Ashvale is mostly quiet, speaking only when necessary, which seems natural to him.
- (2026-07-26) Eddie's sending named Sorcha and Ashvale as the freed captives who overheard fleet information.

chunks.title: Thrym
chunks.text:
NPC: Thrym (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-07-26)
Also known as: Trim
Role: god of the frost giants; bestows the Yoke of Thrym
Status: alive
- (2026-07-26) Thrym, god of the frost giants, bestows the legendary crown called the Yoke of Thrym on a once-in-a-generation frost giant talent; it vanishes on the bearer's death. It gives Thrym control over its wearer and the wearer control over other frost giants, and its appearance often leads to frost giant empires forming.

chunks.title: Great Jarl of Norge
chunks.text:
NPC: Great Jarl of Norge (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-07-26)
Also known as: great Yarl
Role: ruler of the Norge clans
Faction: Norge
- (2026-07-26) About thirty years ago the great Jarl gained significant power, becoming more like a king with the clans like vassals. Since then Norge has had fewer internal raids and more raids on the Imperium and elsewhere. The frost giants then consolidated their own territories.

chunks.title: Hundar
chunks.text:
NPC: Hundar (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-07-26)
Faction: frost giants of Norge
- (2026-07-26) The party suspects Hundar is the crowned frost giant in the mirror vision who wore the Yoke of Thrym and faced Icevein, and that the name links the Cherek to the frost giants.

chunks.title: Hunter
chunks.text:
NPC: Hunter (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-07-26)
Role: experienced dragon
Faction: frost giants of Norge
- (2026-07-26) After the rune master's warning about 'hunter's favor', Sir Raf's history check recognized the name Hundar as the great Jarl of the Frost Giants in Norge. The GM said Hundar is also sometimes called winter favorite. Among frost giants, great Jarl means the toughest of the Jarls.

chunks.title: Cherek longship crew (hostile)
chunks.text:
NPC: Cherek longship crew (hostile) (first seen 2026-08-09, last seen 2026-09-20)
Also known as: Cherek guards, bearsarks, Goliath bearsark, Cherek hunters, giantkin, bearsark
Location: aboard the Fenrir, then marched north
Attitude to party: charmed ones friendly, others hostile
Status: brawl aboard ended; unconscious members marched off by charmed allies
Faction: Cherek
- (2026-08-09) The camp woke in about two to three rounds. The Cherek hunter shot Eddie with a longbow, hitting for 16 damage. Monarch's illusory white dragon drew bearsarks, who realized it was a trick after touching it, and the Goliath bearsark in bear-hybrid form chased Eddie into the water but would not leave the camp perimeter.
- (2026-09-06) Clairvoyance showed the whole camp still on alert an hour after the first fight. Three guards stood on the shore at the ship and four were on deck, with more bearsarks on the shore and a mix of giantkin, berserkers and hunters on deck, the hunters watching the water.
- (2026-09-06) Guards checked in on each other about twice in ten minutes, by backing off about 20 feet to get line of sight up at the deck.
- (2026-09-06) Monarch cast fourth-level charm person (Wisdom save DC 19) on the four on deck; all four failed their saves. The charmed crew began raising the sail, and four took the oars and dragged the Fenrir off the shore. Charmed giantkin and Goliath crew also argued with and blocked uncharmed crewmates, so the ship made little progress.

chunks.title: Cherek longship crew (hostile) (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Cherek longship crew (hostile) (first seen 2026-08-09, last seen 2026-09-20)
- (2026-09-06) The bearsark at the front saw Portia the moment she became visible and shouted, but the silence meant no sound came out. This started combat.
- (2026-09-06) Monarch's charm person on the Goliath bearsark failed because the GM ruled its creature type is monstrosity, not humanoid. Portia charmed one other with charm monster (DC 14).
- (2026-09-06) Two to four of the crew below decks stood guard at compartment doors. Reinforcements were sent for from the outlying camps by Goliath c, who ran to fetch help.
- (2026-09-06) Monarch's lightning bolt hit bearsark c, the Goliath bearsark and the Cherek commander for 34 each (Goliath saved for half, 17), 85 total.
- (2026-09-06) The Goliath bearsark, vulnerable to fire only in bear form, took double damage from Portia's burning hands. It bit Monarch repeatedly and forced Constitution saves.
- (2026-09-20) The Cherek crew brawled among themselves on deck while Monarch's and Portia's charmed crewmen tried to row the Fenrir. An uncharmed hunter at the rudder carried a longbow. Hunters shot and knifed upstairs until the uncharmed crew collapsed.
- (2026-09-20) With the charmed crew sent ashore 4.5 miles north to walk to the ruins of Drakholm, the party took the ship. The unconscious crew went with them and would wake within about an hour, with 1 hit point each.
- (2026-09-20) Kyle ruled the crew left their rations and personal effects at the camp, so the ship's crew compartments are empty.

chunks.title: Cherek longship crew (hostile) (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Cherek longship crew (hostile) (first seen 2026-08-09, last seen 2026-09-20)
- (2026-09-20) Aboard the Fenrir the Goliath bearsark was charmed in part and berserk in part. It bit Eddie for 11 and Portia for 10, forcing Constitution saves. Portia felt the bite was deep enough to risk lycanthropy.
- (2026-09-20) Its bite hit Monarch repeatedly, with a dying-bite second chomp for 20; Kyle counted 39 damage in one round on her.
- (2026-09-20) Sir Raf's booming blade and Lucia's sneak attacks injured the Goliath bearsark, and Monarch's true strike with nonlethal damage left it at 1 hit point unconscious.
- (2026-09-20) Kyle said these bearsarks are lifelong weir-bears who fully control their transformations.

chunks.title: Cherek commander
chunks.text:
NPC: Cherek commander (first seen 2026-09-06, last seen 2026-09-20)
Role: commander of the Cherek camp guard
Faction: Cherek
Location: below decks on the Fenrir
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: unconscious
- (2026-09-06) The commander came out of the camp with a 24 initiative, ordered the ship brought back and Portia captured, and guessed the crew were charmed.
- (2026-09-06) Eddie hit him with a fourth-level guiding bolt for 28 damage. Later a third-level guiding bolt for 23 bloodied him.
- (2026-09-06) Monarch's charm person on him failed because he was in a raging fury. He wielded a thunder-cracking greataxe and hurled barbed javelins, one of which hit Monarch for 17 damage and cut her speed by 5.
- (2026-09-06) He hit Monarch with the axe for 26 total, dropping her. He hit Eddie for 27 and 23, 50 total.
- (2026-09-06) Monarch knocked him unconscious with a true strike staff attack for 10 damage.
- (2026-09-20) Lucia and Sir Raf saw the commander unconscious, or perhaps dead, on the floor below decks; he stayed inert through the fight.
- (2026-09-20) Eddie took the commander's and the bearsarks' weapons and put them in his Quiver of Ehlonna.

chunks.title: Armored flame figure of the rune stones
names: Armored flame figure of the rune stones
tall armored figure in black plate
chunks.text:
NPC: Armored flame figure of the rune stones (first seen 2026-09-06, last seen 2026-10-04)
Also known as: tall armored figure in black plate, fire elemental in plate, armored fire elemental, fire knight, fire elemental myrmidon
Location: Fenrir
Attitude to party: friendly while charmed
Status: vanished when Monarch and Eddie's attunement finished
- (2026-09-06) When Portia entered the forward room, a tall figure in heavy black plate, flame showing through the cracks, rose from the glowing rune stones. Portia backed out and shut the door.
- (2026-09-20) When Sir Raf opened the door the armored fire elemental, a suit of blackened armor with roaring flame in its cracks, rose from the rear stone. It drew a flaming blade and swung three times at Sir Raf, who was dodging and had blade ward up, and missed with all.
- (2026-09-20) Portia charmed it with charm monster after it failed its Wisdom save and persuaded it to stop attacking. It saved against Monarch's faerie fire with an 18.
- (2026-10-04) The party had it charmed (by Portia) within the hour; it could not leave the ship because the longship has no boat and it cannot fly or swim, so the GM ruled it would refuse to be told to go into the ocean.
- (2026-10-04) The GM ruled it can only be dismissed by its master, not by the party.
- (2026-10-04) Monarch cast charm monster on it at fourth level with heightened spell (disadvantage); it remained her friend as well as Portia's.

chunks.title: Armored flame figure of the rune stones (part 2)
names: Armored flame figure of the rune stones
tall armored figure in black plate
chunks.text:
NPC: Armored flame figure of the rune stones (first seen 2026-09-06, last seen 2026-10-04)
- (2026-10-04) When Portia's charm lapsed it was briefly no longer Portia's friend, but Monarch's charm kept it from setting fire to everyone; then the attunement finished and it vanished.

chunks.title: The Winter Favored
chunks.text:
NPC: The Winter Favored (first seen 2026-10-04, last seen 2026-10-04)
Also known as: the winter favorite
Role: unnamed leader issuing orders to the Norge invasion forces
Faction: Norge
- (2026-10-04) The logbooks refer to this person by title only, with orders from the winter favored superseding other plans; the writer avoids the real name.
- (2026-10-04) Eddie guessed the winter favored is a giant.

chunks.title: Colonel Kreetz
chunks.text:
NPC: Colonel Kreetz (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2026-02-22)
Role: city watch colonel of the Trimarket district
Faction: city watch
Location: Trimarket, Roma
Attitude to party: friendly to bribes; will sell guards
- (2024-10-20) The city watch is commanded district by district: Colonel Kreetz (the GM spelled it k-r-e-e-t-z) oversees the Trimarket, while Colonel Lara oversees the Sword Quarter.
- (2024-10-20) The GM described him as legendarily corrupt and 100% for sale, though not evil.
- (2024-10-20) He wears full armor and smokes an enormous cigar behind a lavish, ornate desk.
- (2024-10-20) After Monarch slipped him a platinum piece he agreed to send guards to the Golden Leaf, billed to the party as revenue-neutral coverage, and he knew Valkrath's 6,500 gp bounty at once.
- (2024-10-20) Kyle says Colonel Kreetz is legendarily corrupt and 100% for sale, not evil, and oversees the Trimarket district watch.
- (2024-10-20) Portia bribed the receptionist with gold pieces and Monarch slipped him a platinum piece while shaking his hand; he received the party in his lavish office, smoking a huge cigar.
- (2024-10-20) He immediately knew Valkrath's bounty (6,500) and agreed to check his roster for guards for the Golden Leaf, for a fee.
- (2026-02-22) Kyle described Colonel Kreetz as the super corrupt Trimarket guard captain, easy to control; he was not the contact Eddie had messaged.

chunks.title: Bodgel Deepdelver
chunks.text:
NPC: Bodgel Deepdelver (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-04-19)
Also known as: frozen dwarf
Status: dead
Faction: Mithril Peaks clan
Role: dwarf of the Mithril Peaks clan who escaped Rimescar's mine and died on the way to the coast
- Bodgel Deepdelver is Grodel Deepdelver's brother: the dwarf the party found dead outside and spoke with.
- (2026-04-19) Portia found the frozen remains of about five dwarves in makeshift gear, killed by the white dragon; only one face-down body was intact.
- (2026-04-19) Eddie cast speak with dead; the corpse said they escaped Rimescar, 25 others remain there, and they were heading to the coast to escape.
- (2026-04-19) The belt buckle bore a silver-filigree mountain peaks symbol. Sir Raf recalled it from mithril bars bought from the Mithril Peaks clan, a supplier of mithril to Roma with ties to a silver dragon.

chunks.title: Valkrath
chunks.text:
NPC: Valkrath (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-11-03)
Role: iron shadow operative and assassin; hires skulks and drow assassins
Faction: Iron Shadows
Status: alive, location unknown; wanted
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2024-10-20) Monarch's notes say he is House Querid's operative, a member of the hobgoblin seal team called the iron shadows, and works for the house spymaster.
- (2024-10-20) He has a big bounty on his head, 6,500 per Colonel Kreetz, and another house is offering a favor for him. House Mazaali put a blood price on him after he killed several of its nobles in the Sword Quarter.
- (2024-10-20) He personally handles the hardest jobs using unarmed close-quarters combat and surprise strikes from the shadows, a style trained in the Shadowfell.
- (2024-10-20) He fled Roma after the earlier bounties and Colonel Lara was surprised to learn he was back and active in the city.
- (2024-10-20) The party suspects he sent the skulks and drow assassins that attacked them and Sir Raf; they plan to bait him at the Golden Leaf with a PR campaign and leaked protection plans.
- (2024-11-03) Valkrath ambushed the party at the Golden Leaf in a troll mask, then used teleporting flurries of fists, knees and elbows and a bandolier of about 30 darts; he downed Lucia and Portia and put Monarch down.
- (2024-11-03) Valkrath cast a spell to look like a Trimarket watchman and shadow-stepped away. Eddie shot him with a poisoned arrow, and he dropped dead in the street.

chunks.title: Valkrath (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Valkrath (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-11-03)
- (2024-11-03) On death his glyph exploded in a 30-foot acid blast that killed about a dozen civilians and Fickle, and utterly destroyed him with 38 acid damage.
- (2024-11-03) Valkrath's mask survived as proof of his death. The party collects his 6,500 gp bounty, 170 platinum, and one favor from House Mazaali.
- (2024-11-03) An Iron Shadow hired by House Querid: he worked for the house spymaster Zyra the Silent, and the GM said he was both an Iron Shadow and one of Zyra's agents.

chunks.title: Harvey
chunks.text:
NPC: Harvey (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-10-20)
Role: tea shop owner/bartender
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2024-10-20) Portia sent him a message about unexpected visitors upstairs; he was disoriented by it.
- (2024-10-20) He came up after the fight, said the assassins only ever ordered plain black tea, and had food and healing teas sent up that grant 2d4+2 healing over a short rest.
- (2024-10-20) Monarch paid him a platinum piece to deal with the bodies; a patron was seen talking to him about the bodies.

chunks.title: Lyra
chunks.text:
NPC: Lyra (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-10-20)
Location: cabaret
Attitude to party: allied
- (2024-10-20) She did not go to the Groves because she felt safe at her cabaret with nobility and security staff.

chunks.title: Nayak
chunks.text:
NPC: Nayak (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-10-20)
Role: courier
Status: did not survive
- (2024-10-20) A decoy courier who knew he had the fake shipment, thanks to informants in House Querid, and who did not make it.

chunks.title: Zarya
chunks.text:
NPC: Zarya (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-10-20)
- (2024-10-20) Monarch's offhand "Zarya of the Silent" is a garble of the spymaster's name, and he corrects himself to "Zarya or Zyra"; no separate individual is established.

chunks.title: Psychic gray oozes of the Hall of Feasts kitchen
names: Psychic gray oozes of the Hall of Feasts kitchen
chunks.text:
NPC: Psychic gray oozes of the Hall of Feasts kitchen (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-08-24)
Also known as: ooze b, gray slime
Location: Hall of Feasts kitchen
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-08-24) Gray slime coated the magical pantry shelves and then slid onto the barrels and under a table to fight. Monarch's Nature check of 24 identified them as old gray oozes that developed psychic abilities. They resist psychic, cold, fire and acid, and cannot be blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, grappled or restrained.
- (2025-08-24) The oozes lashed out with pseudopods and mind-crushing psychic attacks at Eddie, Portia and Monarch, and all were killed by the party.
- (2025-08-24) Their mind-crushing attack forced Intelligence saves: Eddie's and Portia's minds resisted, Raf failed and took 8 psychic damage.

chunks.title: Dansi of Edgewood
chunks.text:
NPC: Dansi of Edgewood (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: Dansi
Role: wildshaping druid
Location: Groves of Belenus
Status: alive
- Wildshaping druid the party first tangled with as a giant octopus in the canals of Roma.
- Later befriended when the party protected them from Valkrath when he was 'tying up loose ends.'
- Now lives at the Groves of Belenus.
- Dansi uses they/them pronouns.
- (2025-11-02) Dansi is a druid from the group the party tangled with in the early days, the one wild shaper who turned into an octopus in the river.
- (2025-11-02) Dansi has settled at the Groves as a contributing member; the party had brought them there for protection and it became an ongoing arrangement.
- (2025-11-02) Dansi said they are concerned about how things may turn out, think the Groves are united in their beliefs, but do not know what can be done and are not part of the discussions about it.

chunks.title: Eryndra Kalastov
chunks.text:
NPC: Eryndra Kalastov (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2024-12-01)
Also known as: Eryndra
Role: warlock of the Great Old One working at the darkened dry dock
Faction: Shimmerstone Shipworks workers
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- The warlock Lucia talked to.
- (2024-12-01) Lucia (with Portia aiding) approached her on the street as an interested fanboy of warlock patrons and made a persuasion roll of 22. The patron she described is the Great Old One. She believes the world should be erased and remade.
- (2024-12-01) She is amassing gold to buy a bound wand, built around a piece of petrified tentacle from one of the Great Old One's original temples found in the deeps, to connect her to her patron. She is paid well to work in the dark on the secret project at Shimmerstone, doing some enchanting and manual labor. She will not say what the project is because she is paid for confidentiality.
- (2024-12-01) The GM gave her name as Eryndra Kalastov. Lucia tried to befriend her so she could be contacted later. Monarch later suggested using her to confirm what is being built, possibly for gold.

chunks.title: Krug
chunks.text:
NPC: Krug (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Role: ogre enforcer for Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu
Faction: Julia the Glacier's squad
Attitude to party: threatening but did not attack
- Ogre enforcer for the frost giant Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu of Roma. Seen working with the ettin Gillygully alongside Hanak the orog thug and Shiver Grundy the frost sorcerer, under the direction of Julia the Glacier, a goliath with frost giant heritage.
- (2025-11-30) Krug, the ogre, vies with Gillygully for who thinks they are in charge of Julia's squad.
- (2025-11-30) Krug moved toward Eddie first; he did not recognize Eddie and showed no further aggression.
- (2025-11-30) Krug warned Eddie not to talk to senators, struggling for the word 'senators'; he took the gold piece Monarch flicked and the squad later praised him.

chunks.title: Bolak
chunks.text:
NPC: Bolak (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Role: orog mercenary in Julia the Glacier's squad; Hanak's sister
Faction: Julia the Glacier's squad
- (2025-11-30) Hanak and Bolak are brother and sister orogs, run-of-the-mill mercenaries with no particular loyalty to the frost giants beyond their pay; they travel with Julia the Glacier's squad.

chunks.title: Olifin
chunks.text:
NPC: Olifin (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Role: ranger from Titania's court assigned to escort Mona
Faction: Seelie Court
Status: alive
- The ranger from Titania's court assigned to escort Mona.
- (2026-01-25) Olifin stood in Titania's court as a rank-and-file soldier. Titania ordered him to escort Mona to the Prime Material, and he agreed.
- (2026-01-25) He delivered Mona's goodbye letter to her family, who thanked him and gave him a flask of whiskey.
- (2026-01-25) He opened the Circle of Drunkards fairy ring by giving each mushroom a shot of whiskey, then tracked Mona and Portia with a natural 20 survival roll, finding boggle oil and fairy dust.
- (2026-01-25) He found them in audience with Aurelia, and Mona was returned to his care.

chunks.title: Lamorna
chunks.text:
NPC: Lamorna (first seen 2026-03-08, last seen 2026-03-08)
Also known as: unicorn
Role: unicorn summoned by Monarch
Location: Hither
Attitude to party: helpful
Status: alive; vanished after a minute
- She arrived from, and returned to, a place she called Hither in the Feywild.
- (2026-03-08) A unicorn appeared after Monarch's wild magic surge, and the GM placed it 20 feet northeast of Monarch. It looked at her quizzically and then walked into the camp illusion.
- (2026-03-08) The unicorn introduced herself telepathically to Portia: 'My name is Lamorna. I am from a place called Hither', a domain in the Feywild.
- (2026-03-08) She touched Portia with her horn, giving her 11 temporary hit points and +2 AC until the temporary hit points are gone.
- (2026-03-08) She fired a beam of bright light from her horn at the yeti, hitting for 9 radiant damage. She told Monarch that if she needed to get away she could take her to safety, but only if Monarch was touching her.
- (2026-03-08) Monarch asked how many people she could teleport. She said she could bring up to five people with her back to her home, and that they would have to find their own way back. The party declined.
- (2026-03-08) She cured Monarch's poison with lesser restoration (Unicorn's blessing). She wondered aloud why she keeps being drawn to Monarch, suggesting a fate connection, and then vanished when the minute ran out.

chunks.title: Merrow pack
chunks.text:
NPC: Merrow pack (first seen 2026-10-18, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: merrows, ogre-sized merfolk with shark features
Location: waters of Dragonfjord
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
- (2026-10-18) Three ogre-sized merfolk with shark-like features, serrated weapons and tough hides followed the Fenrir at 60 ft speed, dashing to keep up. Eddie's guiding bolt of 14 missed. They lost interest after Eddie cast toll the dead; the GM said they could have boarded had the ship been slower.

chunks.title: Northern fleet
chunks.text:
NPC: Northern fleet (first seen 2026-10-18, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: Norge fleet, northern ships
Faction: Norge
Location: mouth of Emperor's Bay
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2026-10-18) The northern fleet is blockading the mouth of Emperor's Bay to stop imperial ships flanking its ships sieging Northreach Citadel. The party's Fenrir raced through at 24 mph; Monarch authenticated as the Fenrir on a bribery mission and ordered them to sail northeast to protect the treasure fleet.

chunks.title: Imperial spelljammer interceptors
chunks.text:
NPC: Imperial spelljammer interceptors (first seen 2026-10-18, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: imperial interceptors, spell jammers
Faction: Imperial Senate
Location: Emperor's Bay
Attitude to party: unknown, aiming ballistas
- (2026-10-18) Two flying imperial gunships of about 100 feet approached the Fenrir from the south; as they angled their noses down their ballista crews carefully aimed at the Fenrir, whose sails Monarch had changed to imperial colors.

chunks.title: Monarch's Air Elemental
chunks.text:
NPC: Monarch's Air Elemental (first seen 2026-10-04, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: summoned air elemental
Location: aboard the Fenrir
Attitude to party: obeys Monarch's commands (summoned, not charmed)
Status: bloodied: badly damaged by the unnatural freezing storm, left at 37 of 90 hit points
Role: air elemental summoned by Monarch via the air rune stone
- (2026-10-04) After attuning the air stone, Monarch spent a fourth-level slot to summon an air elemental and ordered it to stay on deck to defend against borders.
- (2026-10-18) Monarch's summoned air elemental, sent to follow Icevein, returned badly damaged and frost-laced, reporting 'could not see. Too cold. Was going to die'; it was left with 37 hit points of 90.

chunks.title: El Nino
names: Air elemental of the Fenrir rune stone
chunks.text:
NPC: El Nino (first seen 2026-09-20, last seen 2026-10-04)
Also known as: Air elemental of the Fenrir rune stone, disturbed air, howling wind
Role: air elemental of the Fenrir's air rune stone; charmed by Monarch and named El Nino
Status: vanished far out over the sea when the air-stone attunement finished (2026-10-04)
Location: sent north from the Fenrir to disable Norge ships; vanished out over the water
Attitude to party: friendly while charmed by Monarch
- (2026-09-20) An invisible air elemental came out of the rune-stone room. Eddie's see invisibility revealed it. It buffeted Portia for 15 thunder damage (halved to 7 with absorb elements) and went for Monarch, hitting once for 13 thunder damage.
- (2026-09-20) It resisted spells: it saved against Portia's charm monster and Eddie's banishment, which failed with a minus 2 Charisma save roll. Monarch's charm monster with 2 sorcery points finally charmed it after it failed a Wisdom save against DC 19.
- (2026-09-20) Lucia hit it for 21 with sneak attack, and Eddie bit it after faerie fire lit it up.
- (2026-10-04) Monarch named the charmed air elemental El Nino and ordered it north to disable any Norge ships; it flew off.
- (2026-10-04) The GM said it had flown away for fifty-nine minutes and vanished far from the boat when the attunement finished.
- (2026-10-04) The GM said elementals do not have individual identities.
- (2026-10-04) The GM ruled the air elemental is weak and cannot lift the armored fire elemental.

chunks.title: Popinjay's Tea Shoppe
chunks.text:
Location: Popinjay's Tea Shoppe (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: tea shop, the tea place, Harvey's tea shop, the tea house, the tea shop
Type: tea shop
Description: Run by Harvey. Patrons are relied on for security in the public area, but nothing protects the upstairs.
Parent: Spellspire
- Tea shop in Roma's Spellspire district (Roma city map)
- (2024-11-03) The party slept in a bed at the tea house after the assassin ambush before going to the Grove; a cup of tea there costs one silver.
- (2025-01-19) Sir Saravar met the party here at a table set with six cups of tea.
- (2025-11-16) While Raf and Eddie interviewed, the rest of the party sat in a tea shop in Corona Domini and fed them advice over the telepathic link.
- (2025-11-30) The party discussed strategy for the Grove vote at the tea shop; Senator Valeria Calvus always sends someone across the district to the tea shop for her specific tea order.
- (2024-10-20) Assassins attacked the party in the upstairs rooms and hallway: invisible skulks plus drow assassins, two of them disguised as wizard patrons downstairs. Sir Raf's room and the adjoining room were the battleground.
- (2024-10-20) The upstairs hallway was left bloody and the party now holds two rooms there, since someone else had already bought the adjoining one.
- (2024-10-20) Harvey sent up food and healing teas about twenty minutes later; consumed over a short rest they heal 2d4+2 for each person.

chunks.title: Popinjay's Tea Shoppe (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Popinjay's Tea Shoppe (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-11-30)
- (2024-10-20) Patrons from downstairs responded quickly and came up to look. Monarch gave Harvey about a platinum piece to deal with the bodies, and a patron was seen talking with Harvey and pointing at them.
- (2024-10-20) The GM says the shop relies on patrons for security, which is fine in the public area but not upstairs.

chunks.title: Groves of Belenus
chunks.text:
Location: Groves of Belenus (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: The Grove, the groves, Drud Grove
Type: druid grove
Description: Independent druid sanctuary managed by the Green Apothecary, threatened by a Senate measure to place it under the Roman consul.
Parent: Roma
- On the DM's map the Groves of Belenus lie on Roma's western edge, between the hills of Leones and Ursa.
- (2024-11-03) The party spent the previous night at the Grove after sleeping the first night at the tea house.
- (2024-11-17) Simona told Portia that a Senate measure would bring the Groves under the direct oversight of the Roman consul, effectively making it part of the city; the vote is not expected before the full senate for at least three moons.
- (2024-11-17) The Groves do a fair business in healing potions and large-scale herb farming, which is why healing potions are cheap in Roma.
- (2024-11-17) The Groves stay independent under the Green Apothecary, which House Ventre sponsors; moving them under the city would shift influence from House Ventre to House Marvad.
- (2024-11-17) Members said nothing happened at the Groves during the earlier trouble, nobody feels the party owes a debt, and the usual needs are time tending the groves, ceremonies and alchemical projects.
- (2024-12-15) Portia persuaded a Greka-born druid at the Groves who knew the Greka area to tell her where bats live.
- (2025-01-05) The Senate motion to place the Groves under the Roman consul is likely to pass unless its proponents are weakened; the Grove does not want it.

chunks.title: Groves of Belenus (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Groves of Belenus (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2025-11-02) The Groves are not part of Roma; a Senate vote would put them under the consul, the mayor of Roma. It is a distributed community with no single leader and the residents are worried.
- (2025-11-02) A fragment of the world tree's root lies beneath the Groves, and mining operations near Ursa may tunnel toward it.
- (2025-11-02) The Grove alchemists made a nectar that turns a liar's tongue black while the lie is told.
- (2025-11-16) The Great Henge, a druid-built stone circle in the Groves, has some stones fallen and left lying by the druids as natural decay; the druids would welcome its restoration, and Senator Borluss Flintmantle Lapis wants to rebuild it. A druid security force already guards against invaders from the trees.
- (2025-11-16) The Groves have many trees close to Roma and many druids, and druids can step from tree to tree, so Kaldrina fears mass infiltration. There are rumored portals to the Feywild. The annexation bill's earlier drafts covered mineral rights and access to herbs and alchemical ingredients.
- (2025-11-30) The party gathered the Green Apothecary at the standing stones in the Groves, which took about a day, and the druids hashed out a set of binding oaths over an afternoon.
- (2025-11-30) The Groves contain fairy circles that lead to the Feywild and are a favorite destination of powerful druids.

chunks.title: Groves of Belenus (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Groves of Belenus (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2025-11-30) The proposed oaths: teleport and tree-travel limited to guarded areas, an open exchange area for city scholars, monthly reports of wild or druidic magic above third rank, and obeying Roman law on incoming teleports; they hold only while the Groves are not annexed. The Groves would also open tree-doors for Vaelthira's spies into Norge.
- (2025-11-30) The Senate vote on annexation is scheduled in two days, with the party expecting to win by one.
- (2025-12-14) The groves have no singular leader but a council of elders; the visiting druid Tessa Oakmere, from a grove in Eyre, knows transport via plants and was awakening one of the grove's elder trees.
- (2026-02-22) Out of gratitude for stopping the measure to annex the grove, the druids will take the party through their trees on request, as long as it is not abused. They arranged transport from the grove to White Crown's druid link and back, and to the northern edge of the forest.
- (2026-02-22) The druids can reach the western edge of the forest at the foot of the mountains and the eastern edge of the mountains west of Dragonfjord, but know no ancient trees inside Dragonfjord.
- (2024-10-20) The party traveled there without incident and took a long rest.
- (2024-10-20) It is a hard place to assassinate someone because only people vouched for by druids get in. Lyra is the only one of Sir Raf's group who did not go there.
- (2024-10-20) Portia declared there will be no killing in the groves.

chunks.title: Groves of Belenus (part 4)
chunks.text:
Location: Groves of Belenus (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2024-10-20) The Green Apothecary operates from the groves and is a group Portia belongs to.
- (2024-10-20) The party had been staying at the groves at times and it is one of the places they can be found.

chunks.title: Golden Leaf Tavern
chunks.text:
Location: Golden Leaf Tavern (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Golden Leaf, the golden leaf, Gold Leaf
Type: tavern
Parent: Trimarket
Description: Tavern, not an inn, with no sleeping quarters; outdoor courtyard seating, a bar, kitchen, fireplace shared with Thor's bedroom, and a corner booth.
- On the DM's map the Golden Leaf Tavern stands in Trimarket beside the Autumn Portal.
- (2024-11-03) The Golden Leaf is owned and operated by Thor, a former performer who lives in a room off to the side with his fairy dragon Fickle; staff are Ralanus (performer/bartender) and Morton (sous chef/bouncer).
- (2024-11-03) Prices: a pitcher of ale costs 2 copper, mead 3 copper, a lunch for five 5 copper; food is free with drinks. Thor takes in about 4 gold on a normal weeknight (30-40 customers at a silver each); Monarch paid 5 gold to cover a good night.
- (2024-11-03) Five Trimarket watchmen camped in the tavern for the day, claiming a watch commander's order to guard against out-of-town troublemakers; they marched off at midday, making a show of announcing they were reporting in.
- (2024-11-03) Drik's crew of hired killers the party had once sheltered guarded the doors and windows to keep patrons out; at night Valkrath's skulks (darklings) broke in through the back bedroom window.
- (2024-11-03) The party withstood the siege of the Golden Leaf; Fickle died in the aftermath and Thor was devastated.

chunks.title: Golden Leaf Tavern (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Golden Leaf Tavern (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-11-30)
- (2024-11-17) The party met in the lounge at the Golden Leaf to compare news, and chose it as the contact location for their mercenary registration because it is not tied to any house, unlike the Sultan Estate.
- (2025-01-05) A couple of days after the job, Jimmy Slips delivered the party's share to the Golden Leaf as laundered trade bars: 30% of an 8,000 gp take, 2,400 gp.
- (2025-01-19) The party left the Golden Leaf as their contact location for the mercenary captain to refer rangers.
- (2025-11-16) Kyle says the party has a yarn board at its favorite booth in the Golden Leaf.
- (2025-11-30) The party agreed to meet at the Golden Leaf after splitting up, and celebrated there when runners announced Northern sails sighted in the Northern Harbor.
- (2024-10-20) The party decided to spend their days there as bait for Valkrath's assassins. They stay sober, may sit in the outside seating area, and publicly talk down Valkrath.
- (2024-10-20) The party told Colonel Lara and Colonel Kreetz they were staying there, to draw extra watch patrols. Kreetz said he would send word about the cost of the coverage.
- (2024-10-20) The Golden Leaf, the Sultan Estate and the Groves of Belenus are the three places people have been able to find the party. The party's last session had a fight map made of it.
- (2024-10-20) The next session picks up with the party relaxing there.

chunks.title: Sultan Estate
chunks.text:
Location: Sultan Estate (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: Salton Estate
Type: estate
Parent: Roma
Description: Estate where the party has quarters, protected by House Ventre.
- (2024-11-17) Azuriel is chief of staff of the estate, in charge of logistics, security and accommodations; she was seen at the front gates overseeing a work crew building a double gate.
- (2024-11-17) Raf stores unneeded gear in a steamer trunk at the Sultan Estate.
- (2025-01-05) The party slept at the estate after the job, then Monarch and Portia reported to Azuriel there.
- (2025-11-02) The Sultan Estate sits at the Groves.
- (2024-10-20) The party has quarters at the Sultan Estate. The GM notes House Ventre can protect them if they stay there, and it is one of three places people can find them.

chunks.title: Sword Quarter
chunks.text:
Location: Sword Quarter (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2026-02-22)
Type: district
Parent: Roma
Description: City district overseen by Colonel Lara of the city watch.
- On the DM's map the Sword Quarter lies north of the inner city, outside the Canalis Ambiente.
- (2024-11-03) The party visited the guardhouse in the Sword Quarter before the Golden Leaf.
- (2024-11-17) Sir Sarovar's keep-like estate with training grounds stands in the Sword Quarter, and a town square there is a mustering place for mercenaries with a big meeting hall.
- (2026-02-22) The party delivered Ronnom Kenegal to the Magistrate's Office in the Sword Quarter, escorted by a city watch detachment sent by Colonel Lara. The office paid the bounty of 5,000 gold for him alive (2,500 dead).
- (2026-02-22) The Sword Quarter is the mercenary quarter, where bounty hunters are hired and bounty prisoners are brought.
- (2024-10-20) Colonel Lara is chief of the city watch in the Sword Quarter. The party gave her more information on Valkrath, and she agreed to message her counterpart in Trimarket about patrols.
- (2024-10-20) Valkrath killed several House Mazaali members in the Sword Quarter earlier. House Mazaali put a blood price on him, and Laura thought he had fled the city.

chunks.title: Trimarket
chunks.text:
Location: Trimarket (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-11-03)
Type: city district
Parent: Roma
Description: Bustling trade district where much money changes hands; its city watch is corrupt.
- On the DM's map Trimarket lies west of the inner city, between the Spring Portal and the Autumn Portal; the Golden Leaf Tavern stands there.
- (2024-11-03) The party spoke with the guardhouses in the Sword Quarter and Trimarket, including Colonel Kreetz, before heading to the Golden Leaf.
- (2024-11-03) An acid explosion from Valkrath's glyph went off in a busy Trimarket street, leaving about 5-6 survivors and roughly twice as many casualties.
- (2024-10-20) Colonel Kreetz, watch commander of Trimarket, is legendarily corrupt and for sale; the district's watch is generally corrupt.
- (2024-10-20) The watch commander's office is in the middle of the bustling market. Kreetz has an ornate bank-like desk, animated wall paintings and an enormous cigar, and Monarch slipped him a platinum piece. He quoted Valkrath's bounty as 6,500.

chunks.title: Roma
chunks.text:
Location: Roma (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: Rome, the Imperium
Type: city
Description: Big dangerous city ruled by the Imperium and House Titanicus.
Parent: Imperium Titanicus
- The city of Roma is also the capital city of the province of Roma, which is one of the original two provinces (along with Greka) that formed the First Imperium.
- Roma is paired with Greka through many scores of magical portals which make the cities effectively one: the Tigresses.
- The DM's map "Roma and the Nine Hills": the walled inner city Corona Domini, ringed by the Canalis Ambiente, with Steelspire, Frostgate, Windspire, Seagate, Sunspire, Houndsgate, Spellspire, Godspire, Lionsgate and the Gate of the Bear; around it the Sword Quarter, Trimarket, Crossroads and Lacus Vigilia; the hills and outer districts Dragon's Claw, Taurus Iratus, Twin Serpents, Leones, Ursa, Aquila Sola and The Wolves; Ludum Imperium, the Groves of Belenus, Eaglehold and the Kingdoms Below; the Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter and Colossea portals; Via Drago, Via Balteus, Via Ursa, Via Lacus, Via Lupo, Via Taurus and Via Domini; Mare Medietas to the east; the Golden Leaf Tavern (Trimarket), the Fox & Jackal (Crossroads) and the Wreath & Lion (Corona Domini).
- (2024-11-17) Roma is a cornucopia of goods in a high-magic setting: common and uncommon magic items sell at listed value (uncommon 400 gp, common 100 gp), while very rare and above cost more and are scarce.
- (2024-11-17) The Imperium is run by giants, so giant is commonly spoken in Roma.

chunks.title: Roma (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Roma (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-12-14)
- (2024-11-17) Roma is linked to Greka by four portals (spring, summer, winter, autumn); the autumn portal is the southwest one.
- (2024-11-17) Roma is cold and gray compared to Greka, and people there do not smile and wave.
- (2024-11-17) The Roman consul is a member of House Marvad.
- (2024-12-01) Roma is on the shore of an inland sea, and the party can gate back from Greka.
- (2025-01-19) The caravan assembled in the Crossroads District outside Roma and left down the Via Lupo, through the Wolves hills.
- (2025-11-02) Roma now has roughly double the usual armed soldiers and three times the usual giants (mercenaries and overseers) in its streets; the claim is a threat of Norge raiders via the bay, Great Canal and Mare Medietas.
- (2025-11-16) Roma's Senate has no fixed number of senators. Seats are gifts from the emperor and weighted by votes, with giants getting 2-4 each. Six giant senators sit for Roma, and the consul is a cloud giant and the half-sister of the cloud giant senator.
- (2025-12-14) Business and the scheduled Senate vote in Roma continued undisturbed by the Norge fleet; the vote was a day and a half away.
- (2024-10-20) The Imperium, run by House Titanicus, makes and enforces the law, values success over method, and only intervenes in house conflicts that threaten the Imperium. The GM calls Rome a big dangerous city.
- (2024-10-20) The city watch is commanded district by district, each by a colonel.

chunks.title: Roma (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Roma (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-12-14)
- (2024-10-20) Houses spy on each other; House Querid is a house of explorers, cartographers and information brokers.

chunks.title: Imperium Titanicus
chunks.text:
Location: Imperium Titanicus (first seen ?, last seen ?)
Also known as: Fourth Imperium, Imperium
Type: empire
- The DM's world map is titled "Known Lands of the Fourth Imperium, as drawn by House Querid of Roma".
- The provinces of Roma and Greka formed the First Imperium. Their capitals, the Tigresses, together were the capital of the Imperium through the First, Second, and Third Imperiums.
- Colossea, the great city of the giants in the south, was recently added as a third Tigress. This cemented the rise of the Pax Titanicus and the integration of giants into the ruling houses of the Imperium following their victory in the War of Emperors.
- On House Querid's map the Imperium Titanicus holds Roma, Greka, Colossea, the Harrowlands, the Imperial Khanates, Emperor's Bay and the Dragonfjord; Norge lies north across the Sea of Storms, Eire and the Kingdom of the West to the west, the Dawnrealm to the east, the Dragon Sea to the south-west, the Sea of Dawn and the Mythic Isles to the south-east, and The Southlands to the south.

chunks.title: The Tigresses
chunks.text:
Location: The Tigresses (first seen ?, last seen ?)
Also known as: Tigresses
Type: twin capitals
Parent: Imperium Titanicus
- Roma is paired with Greka (the capital city of that province) through many scores of magical portals which make the cities effectively one. The Tigresses, as they are called, together were the capital of the Imperium through the First, Second, and Third Imperiums.
- Recently, a third Tigress was added: Colossea, the great city of the giants in the south.

chunks.title: Colossea
chunks.text:
Location: Colossea (first seen ?, last seen ?)
Type: city
Parent: Imperium Titanicus
- Colossea is the great city of the giants in the south, recently added as the third Tigress beside Roma and Greka. This cemented the rise of the Pax Titanicus.
- Roma's Colossea Portal stands on the city's south-west side, below Trimarket (DM's map of Roma).

chunks.title: Harrowlands
chunks.text:
Location: Harrowlands (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Occident province, Occident
Type: region of city-states
Parent: Imperium Titanicus
- The Harrowlands, once known as the Occident province, is now a collection of loyal city-states under the rule of the Imperium. No provincial government has been successfully established due to the power and influence of these individual city-states.
- (2025-11-30) The Harrowlands is once again called the Occident; with Roma and Greka it is one of the three remaining provinces, each with a governor who can get an audience with the emperor.

chunks.title: Sea of Storms
chunks.text:
Location: Sea of Storms (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-10-18)
Type: sea
- On House Querid's map the Sea of Storms lies between Norge and the Imperium's northern coast; the Dragonfjord opens onto it.
- (2025-12-14) The Sea of Storms is perpetually stormy because the great dragon turtle Golcondra, put to sleep a couple of generations ago, woke angry; crossing it generally requires magic, hinting Norge had an ace up its sleeve.
- (2026-10-18) To the north the party met a freezing, unnatural storm like the ones of Norge. A summoned air elemental sent into it came back badly damaged (37 hit points left of 90), saying it could not see and it was too cold. The storm lessened toward the south, so it was not natural.

chunks.title: Kingdom of the West
chunks.text:
Location: Kingdom of the West (first seen 2025-05-04, last seen 2025-05-04)
Type: realm
Description: Small peninsula kingdom west of the Imperium
- On House Querid's map the Kingdom of the West lies on the western coast beyond the Harrowlands, facing Eire.
- (2025-05-04) The kingdom persists through a pact with metallic and chromatic dragons. Its monarch must defeat a dragon in single combat. A mountain range full of dragons lies between it and the Imperium, which is why the Imperium never took it over.
- (2025-05-04) Centuries ago a faction sought to usurp its throne through the favor of the chromatic dragons only. It was the Cult of the Dragon, linked to Tiamat.

chunks.title: Mythic Isles
chunks.text:
Location: Mythic Isles (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2024-11-17)
Type: islands
- On House Querid's map the Mythic Isles are a misty island group south-east of the Imperium.
- (2024-11-17) The Mythic Isles are far south on the world map, near the southern coastline where another campaign world is set.
- (2024-11-17) The note in Eddie's letter read 'Mythic Isles?'.

chunks.title: Mare Medietas
chunks.text:
Location: Mare Medietas (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-19)
Type: sea
Parent: Roma
- On the DM's map Mare Medietas is the water on Roma's eastern side, beyond Lacus Vigilia.
- (2024-11-17) Mare Medietas is a giant inland sea like the Baltic, connected to the ocean by a giant-built canal.
- (2025-01-19) It is the large inland sea east of Roma; the caravan traveled down its western coast.

chunks.title: Prison of the Faceless Lord
chunks.text:
Location: Prison of the Faceless Lord (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-11-02)
Type: prison
Parent: Ancient Giant City Ruins
- The DM's map shows the Prison of the Faceless Lord at the heart of a binding circle: seven towers on the ring (the Towers of Storms, Crowns, Stars, Chains, Wells, Runes and Dreams) joined by paths to five halls (the Halls of Blades, Songs, Feasts, Scales and Cradles).
- (2025-08-10) The party knows its geographic location but not how to enter, as it lies under the city.
- (2025-11-02) Raf installed Black Razor into the prison's rune web first, then pulled out the blue dragon mask; a golden dragon spirit warned that this makes the prison a warden with a will of its own, stronger but not passive.
- (2025-11-02) The web turned from silvery glow to inky black binding runes that press down on the chaos; the walls sweat black oily darkness and the ground softens. A pseudopod lashed Monarch for 19 acid damage as the party left.
- (2025-11-02) The party mostly left the rope web behind and found the chasm narrowed, with earthquakes as they fled.

chunks.title: Tower of Dreams
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Dreams (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2025-07-13)
Type: tower
Parent: Ancient Giant City Ruins
Description: Giant tower existing in both the astral and prime material planes; its top room gave a view over the ruined city.
- The Tower of Dreams is one of the seven towers of the binding circle around the Prison of the Faceless Lord (DM's map).
- (2025-07-13) Kyle explained the Tower of Dreams exists in both the astral and prime material planes at once, so its upper floor is real on the astral plane but not on the prime. It focuses dreams and makes the dream version of the tower real in the astral plane, but that power does not extend to the rest of the city.
- (2025-07-13) From the top of the tower, tree growth, fallen buildings, erosion and landslides hide most of the ancient city. Portia read the canopy for likely building sites and spotted another structure a mile or so away, farther than the Tower of Dreams is from the Tower of Storms.
- (2025-07-13) Descending the tower, the party met no dream challenges and again saw sleeping spirit giants tended by spirit giant attendants.

chunks.title: Tower of Runes
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Runes (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2025-07-27)
Also known as: Tower Of Ruins
Type: tower
Parent: Ancient Giant City Ruins
Description: Floating spiral of constantly shifting stones, some not real, three 20-foot tiers about 60 feet high, topped by a singing obsidian-and-adamant crystal.
- The Tower of Runes is one of the seven towers of the binding circle around the Prison of the Faceless Lord (DM's map).
- (2025-07-13) The Tower of Runes lies about a mile from the Tower of Dreams, farther than the Tower of Dreams is from the Tower of Storms, so the circle of towers may be oblong, which could make finding the center trickier.
- (2025-07-13) It is a great floating spiral of massive rune-covered stones that shift and rotate, changing the spiral's turn and angle. The stones are cracked and scorched yet still crackle with magic. Giant animated glyphs crawl across them, vines cling only to the lower reaches, and light bends near the top. Kyle compared it to a big stone curly fry.
- (2025-07-13) The lowest stone of the spiral hangs 10 feet above the ground. Gravity shifts from stone to stone, and at times stones lock tight together so one can walk from one to another before they separate again.
- (2025-07-13) A circle of glowing runes hovers just above the ground marking the tower's circumference. The spiral's stones are contained within it, and standing inside the circle puts a creature under the tower.

chunks.title: Tower of Runes (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Runes (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2025-07-27)
- (2025-07-13) At the last stone of the spiral sits a crystal structure, black with threads of adamant that look like runes and a crack in it. It stays attached to the stone even when the stone turns upside down.
- (2025-07-13) Standing near the tower gives a rhythmic, chant-like vibration that is felt rather than heard and does not interfere with the senses.
- (2025-07-13) A dragonborn and lizardfolk group in Dawnrealm gear, led by a fanatic and the Speaker of Storms, was trying to climb the spiral. A runestone guardian lifted them onto the first stones, and some had fallen or been scorched on the stones. After the fight, a fleeing cultist's smoking body fell out of the tower and no cultists remained on the spiral.
- (2025-07-27) The stones turn, shift and pass through each other; a cracked obsidian and adamant crystal at the top gives off a broken chant. A cultist note fragment said the Lexus is atop the Tower of Runes.
- (2025-07-27) The bodies of fallen climbers showed falling, force, thunder and electrical injuries. Gravity is variable within the tower, and flying and teleporting upward fail: Monarch's Misty Step across the barrier landed her at the tower's base, and she could hover and move laterally but not climb.

chunks.title: Tower of Runes (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Runes (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2025-07-27)
- (2025-07-27) The party climbed it as a skill challenge: concentration check DC 10, four successes per tier, each skill usable once per tier. The final tier's DC is 18. Failures caused falls, a 7 force damage blast with a push, and an 8 thunder damage blast that deafened the group for about 10 minutes.
- (2025-07-27) The party stabilized the tiers and Monarch, reduced to tiny, entered the crystal and took the stone tablet (a graven Lexus of binding runes) into her bag of holding. Portia's countersong held the crystal open and Monarch Misty Stepped out. The tower's defenses are now disabled.
- (2025-07-27) Portia touched a living vine rune on the lower stones and learned the rune of grasping. Lucia saw an ancient giant rune on a stone matching a simplified symbol woven into cloth in the well room of her house's estate.

chunks.title: Spellspire
chunks.text:
Location: Spellspire (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-01-19)
Type: district
Parent: Roma
- A district of Roma, one of the spires on the ring around Corona Domini (Roma city map); home to Popinjay's Tea Shoppe.
- (2025-01-19) Its streets are busy and built-up, like Manhattan.

chunks.title: Greka
chunks.text:
Location: Greka (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2024-12-01)
Type: city
Parent: Imperium Titanicus
Description: Warm coastal sister city of Roma in the south, with Greek-style architecture and a smiling but passive-aggressive populace.
- Greka is the capital city of the province of Greka, one of the original two provinces (with Roma) that formed the First Imperium; many scores of magical portals make Roma and Greka effectively one city (the Tigresses).
- (2024-11-17) Greka has columned buildings with peaked roofs, fewer domes, and spreads outward rather than tall; it is much warmer, with sparkling blue sea, like Berlin to Sicily.
- (2024-11-17) Friendly-seeming Greka residents hide a sneaky veneer of insults; a local told the party they would have a great time at Brim's AutoKeg.
- (2024-11-17) The Shimmerstones' shipyard in Greka was the destination of the box the party handled.
- (2024-11-17) The party traveled to Greka through the autumn portal to take a guard job for Jingle Shimmerstone.
- (2024-12-01) Greka sits on the open sea, unlike Roma on an inland sea. It has a big shipbuilding and maritime industry with docks as a huge part of the city. A handful of large walled shipworks, including Shimmerstone Shipworks, stand among many privately owned dry docks.
- (2024-12-01) The neighborhood near Brim's AutoKeg is scaled for small and short folk (halflings, dwarves, gnomes, goblins, kobolds) and is called Smallville by the GM, with good food.

chunks.title: Greka (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Greka (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2024-12-01)
- (2024-12-01) It has a local Mercenary Hall, run like Colonel Kaelix's in Roma, with more ship and naval jobs. It carries a posting for the Shimmerstone security job.

chunks.title: Brim's AutoKeg
chunks.text:
Location: Brim's AutoKeg (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: Brim's Auto Keg, Auto Keg
Type: tavern
Parent: Greka
Description: Gadget-themed tavern near the autumn portal, staffed by free-willed autognomes and served from a huge brass auto keg.
- (2024-11-17) It stands in a neighborhood of smaller buildings and smaller folk (gnomes, halflings, dwarves), with a keg pouring beer into a mug over the sign and doors about five and a half feet high.
- (2024-11-17) Its staff are free-willed autognomes, and the centerpiece is an enormous brass keg with no controls that pours any drink spoken to it; the table's drinks cost 9 copper through a coin slot.
- (2024-11-17) Jingle Shimmerstone meets clients here; Jingle hired the party for the swing shift, and the other person at the table was Jimmy Slips.
- (2024-12-01) The party met Jingle Shimmerstone at a table there and found him with Jimmy Slips, who was pitching him a con; both Jimmy and Monarch paused and gave each other space to speak.
- (2024-12-01) It is very popular, with no empty tables. It is built for smaller folk, so seating is short and close together, and the Auto Keg is as amazing as expected.
- (2024-12-01) There are rooms to rent upstairs above the Auto Keg.
- (2025-01-05) After being dismissed, the party relaxed at the Auto Keg, and Jimmy Slips joined them about an hour and a half later.

chunks.title: Shimmerstone Shipworks
chunks.text:
Location: Shimmerstone Shipworks (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: Shimmerstone shipyard, shimmer stones' shipyard
Type: shipyard
Parent: Greka
Description: Shipyard with three workshops and three dry docks (Bay 1, Bay 2, Bay 3), guarded by clockwork constructs and run with automaton labor.
- (2024-11-17) Azuriel said the box was headed to a shipyard in Greka run by the Shimmerstones, eccentric gnomes; the contents are probably being installed in a ship.
- (2024-11-17) Jingle Shimmerstone posted a notice seeking extra guards for a place of business in Greka, which is Shimmerstone Shipworks.
- (2024-12-01) The compound is walled by a 10-foot wall with two access gates, one at each end. Inside are three dry docks side by side with a row of four buildings behind them: three workshops and a cafeteria.
- (2024-12-01) One dry dock (Dry Dock 3) is under a confidentiality agreement and covered in magical darkness, to defeat scrying. Only workers who can see in darkness may enter it. One dry dock was just finished and is mostly empty. One has active construction with a gas-bag airship superstructure and no veil.
- (2024-12-01) Twenty-four-hour staff are constructs: a handful of autognomes, clockwork observers that fly around and sound alarms, and bronze scouts hiding underground with periscopes or tremorsense. The day shift goes home at night.

chunks.title: Shimmerstone Shipworks (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Shimmerstone Shipworks (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2024-12-01) Workers in the dark dry dock appear to be tieflings and dwarves, some trained in blindsight, plus warlocks with devil's sight and eyeless autognomes built for darkness. Hired mercenaries and spellcasters check in at the gates for the night shift.
- (2024-12-01) A cloud giant partner wearing a two-sided mask recently joined as a silent investor, not a Shimmerstone family member. Gnome engineers believe she provides political cover and drives the shift from clockwork and gas to enchanted airships. The Shipworks also builds gas-bag airships.
- (2024-12-01) Jingle hired the party as mercenaries for a week at 100 gp per day (700 gp) plus a 300 gp bonus, on a lethal-force contract to guard the three workshops. They may enter the dry docks only in pursuit of intruders. Offices are off-site.
- (2024-12-01) The three workshops are multipurpose and serve the dry docks. The far-left one serves Dry Dock 3, the big central one serves docks 1 and 2, and the small end one serves Dry Dock 1 and has a locking storeroom that Jimmy Slips noticed.
- (2024-12-01) Jingle's clockwork beetle relays his spoken orders to the constructs. He ordered an upgraded invisibility for observers and to eradicate all beasts on the premises.
- (2024-12-01) It was founded by Papa Shimmerstone, who retired from play as an adventurer and settled in Greka. His great-grandson Jingle now runs it.

chunks.title: Shimmerstone Shipworks (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Shimmerstone Shipworks (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2024-12-15) The party works the night swing shift guarding the workshops, which no one else wants; the day shift leaves before the night crew arrives.
- (2024-12-15) The dry docks are open-topped, sunken about 20 feet below street level, and built to launch naval vessels and airships alike.
- (2024-12-15) Bay 3, called 'the pit', is covered by a magical darkness 50 feet top to bottom (20 feet below and 30 feet above street level) and is about 50 feet across; the Cloud Giant never strayed more than 20 feet from it.
- (2024-12-15) Bay 1 held the bones of a conventional naval vessel worked at night in natural darkness by hooded dwarves and autognomes; Bay 2 was empty.
- (2024-12-15) The workshops sit on a map; the far-right workshop, which the party had not seen inside, is the one Jimmy Slips wants to enter, and it has no windows and a barred, locked cage room.
- (2024-12-15) The paymaster wagon, an armored wagon guarded by short folk and automata, arrived at the Shipworks in the morning; monthly payroll is on-site for one day, and Jimmy's best window is the swing shift.
- (2024-12-15) Locate object triangulation by Portia and Eddie pointed to a kyber crystal inside Bay 3, the pit, ruling out the workshops and Bay 1.
- (2024-12-15) Most day-shift workers head toward the Tavern District on payday while city predators follow them.

chunks.title: Shimmerstone Shipworks (part 4)
chunks.text:
Location: Shimmerstone Shipworks (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2025-01-05) The party fought the detention sentry in the cage room guarding the payroll cache box; it was destroyed, and the party hid the evidence and left the box to Jimmy Slips.
- (2025-01-05) Jingle Shimmerstone arrived about twenty minutes after the party left the building and found the sentry destroyed and the cache box gone. A general alarm went up, the gates slammed shut and all work stopped at the dry docks.
- (2025-01-05) The workers from the darkened dry dock were not asked to join the questioning, but the auto gnomes helping them from outside were gathered.
- (2025-01-05) Jingle questioned the party as a group, believed their story of incompetence, fired them without the back half of their pay, and had them escorted off the premises.
- (2025-01-05) Clockwork observers drift randomly each round (d8 direction, d4 distance in five-foot squares); bronze scouts burrow and hunt rodents.

chunks.title: Temple of Hades
chunks.text:
Location: Temple of Hades (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2024-11-17)
Type: temple
Parent: Roma
Description: Temple in Roma run by Father Georg, where Eddie took his vows.
- (2024-11-17) Eddie was called to the temple, where Father Georg gave him a letter from a dead comrade containing a dragon drawing and the words 'Mythic Isles?' and Qul'drik.

chunks.title: Ruins of Qul'drik
chunks.text:
Location: Ruins of Qul'drik (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: Qul'drik, Ancient Giant City Ruins
Type: ruins
Description: Fallen giant city, now overgrown; a ring of towers once bound a shapeless horror at its heart.
Parent: Khanates
- The DM's map of the ancient giant city is titled "Prison of the Faceless Lord": its towers and halls form the binding circle around the prison at its heart.
- Urag Bayarmaa, the shaman of the People of the Azure Sky, warned of something awakening beneath Qul'drik.
- (2024-11-17) Qul'drik means 'great citadel' in giant and names ruins near Xeon Palace that House Mazaali is exploring.
- (2025-01-19) House Mazaali controls the ruins and is actively scavenging them, carefully because they are dangerous; they have yielded amazing finds.
- (2025-02-16) The ruins are thought to be built by giants, yet imperial giants show no interest, and giants who visit forget the ruins the moment they leave.
- (2025-02-16) The People of the Azure Sky controls them, relies on them for wealth and power, and lets almost no one in; they appear to be an endless source of loot and magical artifacts.
- (2025-02-16) Past imperial efforts to seize them failed: Khanate clans rallied to fight, and units vanished inside amid curses and giant shapes in the darkness.
- (2025-02-16) Tomar says writings describe the Ghost Roads, a network beneath the ruins passing into the ethereal realm and other worlds, along which Qul'drik's people may have left.

chunks.title: Ruins of Qul'drik (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Ruins of Qul'drik (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-02-16) Entry requires the Khan's permission; normally only clan members enter, though bargains have been struck before.
- (2025-02-16) The notes from the clan's chief engineer mention the 'face of the dragon' artifact in the ruins, possibly linked to Eddie's dragon mask letter.
- (2025-02-16) Raf, Lucia and Monarch dreamed of something enormous stirring beneath the ground and gathering shadows, the night they camped near Xi'an Palace.
- (2025-03-02) The ruins lie between Xi'an Palace and the mountains, in the foothills, and cannot be seen from the palace.
- (2025-03-02) Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan said anyone may enter to explore but nothing may be taken out; he provides an escort, arranged through Chimeg.
- (2025-03-02) The upper ruins are low risk, while deeper levels are very dangerous and much remains unexplored.
- (2025-03-02) Security consists of patrols of the open ground around the ruins so that no one can leave unseen; no guards are posted inside because the broken stone structures suit ambushes.
- (2025-03-02) Jochi's falcons report small groups of four to six humanoid interlopers skulking in the upper ruins, but riders find no one.
- (2025-03-02) Tomor theorizes giants built the ruins, and that giants who visit forget them, suggesting a spell or curse; the ruins may date to the time of Anam, father of giants.
- (2025-03-02) Oyun's deciphered writings point to a deep artifact connecting to the elemental plane of air, a ladder to the sky for commanding air creatures.

chunks.title: Ruins of Qul'drik (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Ruins of Qul'drik (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-03-02) Tomor says writings describe a passage inside the ruins that allows walking to the ethereal plane.
- (2025-03-02) Urag Bayarmaa told a saga of a sleeping colossus, hinting that something enormously powerful slumbers beneath the ruins and meddling could awaken it.
- (2025-03-02) Stormgale clan, backed by the Dawnrealm, may seek control of the ruins by year's end.
- (2025-03-02) A captured Dawnrealm noble was caught trying to extract items from the ruins; her entourage was killed.
- (2025-05-04) The Khan believes the Easterling mage's attack was cover for an incursion into the ruins. He decided a small powerful group (the party with Chimeg) would go to the ruins while the clan's main force marches on Stormgale.
- (2025-05-04) The ruins are a giant city that fell at the peak of its glory and was never evacuated, now partly buried. It is an above- and below-ground mix of buildings, some collapsed or buried by landslides, and it extends far off the edge of the map. Only a very small part has been explored, so valuables remain. Chimeg likens expeditions to archaeology rather than a dungeon crawl.

chunks.title: Ruins of Qul'drik (part 4)
chunks.text:
Location: Ruins of Qul'drik (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-05-04) The ruins have spirit activity: ethereal creatures that seem to ignore the living unless the living stare at them. The shaman Urag warned that the giants of old, creators of rune magic, store their power in runes and written words, so anything written is dangerous. The shaman senses something old and immense stirring beneath the city. Oyun believes a powerful sky-related artifact lies there. Tomor says old tales speak of passages beneath the city leading to the Underdark.
- (2025-05-04) Chimeg usually leads expeditions into the ruins. She has never seen anything like the dragon mask and knows which buildings have been excavated.
- (2025-05-04) The ruins are reached through foothills and mountains, a typical two-day ride with one overnight. Griffins hunt horses on the way, with at least one chimera and one manticore seen.
