Haze and mist are the best conditions because they hide travelers from the peaks. The ancient grand entry hall is the start of the city, and the rest lies deeper in the hills and mountains.
- (2025-05-18) The party rode in under pass without trace, rolling a group stealth of 27 so nothing from the sky spotted them.
- (2025-05-18) The city's gate area is a giant campground inside the walls but outside the front gate, with stone blocks about 10 by 5 feet, now tumbled and ruined.

chunks.title: Ruins of Qul'drik (part 5)
chunks.text:
Location: Ruins of Qul'drik (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-05-18) Fresh hoofprints and a clawed, draconic biped print, less than a week old, led through the entry hall and right along the outskirts. The group that made them had hacked a trail and strung two vine trip lines, which Lucia disarmed (sleight of hand, 20).
- (2025-05-18) Monarch found five riding horses hidden under trees off the trail to the north. A Dawnrealm-looking cult party with a red half-dragon attacked from the stairwell, and the party killed them all.
- (2025-05-18) The cult fanatic's notes name the site the Tower of Storms and say clues to the dragon mask's location should be in its basement.
- (2025-06-15) The mirror's visions showed the ruined city at its height, with giants walking on air, working with fire and speaking with chromatic and metallic dragons. The towers around the city were built, some beforehand on prophecy and some rapidly by magic, as part of the binding of a shapeless creature that destroyed much of the city.
- (2025-06-15) From the air the collapsed towers are hidden by canopy, but Monarch's scouting suggests the city is an oblong running northwest to southeast, with the ring of towers in its middle section and the Tower of Storms near the ring's southern edge. The People of the Azure Sky has not mapped the towers.
- (2025-06-15) Trees knocked down in places around the ruins match the huge rock creature seen earlier; the cultists' cleared path leads back to the party's position.

chunks.title: Ruins of Qul'drik (part 6)
chunks.text:
Location: Ruins of Qul'drik (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-07-13) The city was built in a valley that has since eroded. Overgrowth, collapsed buildings, landslides and earth falls have buried much of it, and the underbrush is thick everywhere around the Tower of Runes: five feet high, lightly obscuring and difficult terrain.
- (2025-07-13) A possible road line can be traced through the forest by dips in the terrain, with fewer trees but no real easing of the undergrowth. The party spent about two hours moving between the Tower of Dreams and the Tower of Runes, roughly two miles apart, without leaving an obvious trail.
- (2025-07-13) The party found a good long-rest site in a cluster of rocks at the southeast corner of the battle area. It has good cover and limited access routes, and shelters firelight and dissipates smoke.
- (2025-07-27) Using the Tower of Storms, Tower of Dreams and Tower of Runes, the party triangulated the prison's location: slightly off to one side of the central building, not directly under it. Bushwhacking cross-country took most of a day for almost a mile.
- (2025-11-02) After the swap, trees drew darkness into their roots and the ground became boggy with black ooze and sinking ruins; the change was localized to the valley and the daylight returned to normal outside it.
- (2025-11-02) Chimeg plans to send scouts back to see what is happening in the ruins.

chunks.title: Xi'an Palace
chunks.text:
Location: Xi'an Palace (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: Zion Palace, Xi'an, Xeon Palace, Ziyan Palace, Azyun Palace, Xeon
Type: palace and surrounding city
Description: Seat of the People of the Azure Sky, whose Warrior's Challenge grounds were built around it.
Parent: Khanates
- (2024-11-17) Xeon Palace is House Mazaali's seat of power in the north, where Lucia's former betrothed rules; House Mazaali has another seat in the south.
- (2025-01-19) Xi'an Palace is a city and palace under one of the major houses (House Mazaali), near the Ruins of Qul'drik.
- (2025-01-19) Sir Saravar's job paid 5,000 gold for a three-week trip on foot there, with a boat across the sea first.
- (2025-01-19) An Imperial Road runs from Archafinalis to Xi'an Palace; there is no road from the Thundering Citadel.
- (2025-02-16) Its golden dome sparkles from far away; the land in front has been leveled so the palace is visible from a distance, with nearby water that may be a reflecting pool or oasis.
- (2025-02-16) The people of the Azure Sky (Tengrue Ovaag) built it, since the Ruins of Qul'drik demanded a permanent presence; it is now the seat of their power.
- (2025-02-16) The buildings are made of enormous stone blocks, some with six-foot iron rings or foot-high carved letters, apparently hauled from the ruins; there are no quarries nearby.
- (2025-02-16) It has no walls; attackers would have to cross two days of lands full of clan horse-raiders. Land sharks and similar threats seem eradicated or absent nearby.

chunks.title: Xi'an Palace (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Xi'an Palace (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-02-16) The surrounding settlement has bustling commerce, smithies, taverns and markets, and cultivated ornamental shade trees.
- (2025-02-16) An open green with a natural spring serves as a communal campground where the party camped; the Khan's honor guard blessed their camping anywhere.
- (2025-02-16) The party was invited to dinner at the palace by Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan for the evening after their first night there.
- (2025-03-02) The party was invited to an honor feast at the palace with Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan; the palace guards stood outside only observing and admitted invited guests.
- (2025-03-02) The palace is ringed by a city of huge stone-block buildings and elaborate permanent tents and yurts; status is shown by closeness to the palace.
- (2025-03-02) About 100 yards of clear space surrounds the palace, and the springs lie on the side opposite the ruins and mountains.
- (2025-03-02) No buildings or tents stand between the palace and the ruins, giving the palace a clear line of sight to the ruins.
- (2025-03-02) The feast hall has low tables and cushions, with food eaten by hand, spoon and bowl; family members serve rather than servants.
- (2025-03-02) The dinner was an honor feast, held for the Khan's circle of honor of about nine senior advisers; the table was arranged as a horseshoe with the Khan at the head and guests at the open ends.
- (2025-03-02) The Khan's mother, the matriarch, closely monitored all conversations at the feast.

chunks.title: Xi'an Palace (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Xi'an Palace (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-03-02) Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan announced the Storm's Challenge at the feast; Chimeg runs it over three days.
- (2025-03-16) The Storm's Challenge grounds hold wooden palisades and rope lines built over the past year: northern grounds for the horse riding events, a central ground for the siege, and a southern area for close combat and ranged events.
- (2025-03-16) The central siege ground has a tower on a platform with a ladder and a gate; the open gate is 200 feet from the tower. Half that ground is thick grass that offers cover, the other half is trampled flat. The tower sits inside a 20 foot high palisade.
- (2025-03-16) The close quarters ring in the south is about 20 feet across and surrounded by inward-pointing sharp stakes.
- (2025-03-16) The Southern Shooting Range has shooting strips at different distances from the targets.
- (2025-04-20) The People of the Azure Sky's final Warrior's Challenge event was held on a fortress field near the palace: a 20-foot log palisade with a gate (entered from the Western Gate) and a roofed watchtower in one corner, surrounded by tall grass on the steppe.
- (2025-04-20) The palisade is solid cover: anyone adjacent to it can see and shoot through its gaps, but anyone five feet or more away cannot. It is slippery to climb, and the watchtower roof gives three-quarters cover (+5 AC and Dex saves).

chunks.title: Xi'an Palace (part 4)
chunks.text:
Location: Xi'an Palace (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-04-20) Clan leadership, including the Khan, his matriarch and war leader Erden Batu, watched from near the open gate, the best viewpoint. They charged through the gate with their bodyguards when the vortex attacked Chimeg.
- (2025-04-20) The challenge ground was packed with clan members, families and onlookers, with food stalls and wagers. When the crowd turned hostile to Rafael's friends, squares within about 30 feet of the wall became difficult terrain.
- (2025-05-04) The Warrior's Challenge finale was held at the challenge field by the palisade and towers, with new raised VIP viewing seats for the Khan, his council and the party. The seats were built overnight in reaction to the previous day's interference. They overlook the 20-foot palisade.
- (2025-05-04) Raf's rescheduled match against Chimeg took place at a wooden tower on the palisade. The tower floor is 5 feet below the top of the 20-foot palisade, and the understructure of logs is too dense to occupy.
- (2025-05-04) The clan began putting itself on a war footing after the finale to answer Stormgale, and people were mounting up. The post-contest council met that evening with the Khan, matriarch, war leader, shaman, horse master, smith, Chimeg, Setsen and Tomor.
- (2025-11-02) The party returned to the People of the Azure Sky here, gave the Khan their report and said goodbye; Simona waited in a camp of imperial tents with a House Ventre banner.

chunks.title: Khanates
chunks.text:
Location: Khanates (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: Imperial Khanates
Type: region
Description: Steppe of nomadic clans; strong, constant wind through tall grass.
Parent: Imperium Titanicus
- The eastern portion of the Roma province is inhabited by the nomadic peoples of the Khanates, who owe allegiance to the Imperium but refuse to establish cities. They also serve as a powerful deterrent to Dawnrealm incursions.
- (2024-11-17) The open plains of the Khanates are unsettled and dangerous, with raiding clans and monsters, and serve as a buffer between the Imperium and the Dawnrealm.
- (2025-01-05) The Khanates form a buffer zone of open plains between the Imperium and the Dawnrealm, held by House Mazaali. Anyone traveling to Roma or Greka must cross them.
- (2025-01-05) House Mazaali controls partly explored ancient ruins in the Khanates, dangerous to explore, which the party wants to be hired to explore.
- (2025-01-19) The Khanates are independent chiefs and kings who owe fealty to a great Khan, currently of House Mazaali for generations; anyone can become great Khan by defeating him.
- (2025-01-19) Few fixed cities exist; clans make tent cities and move on. Xi'an Palace and the Thundering Citadel are the two places known enough to be on maps.
- (2025-01-19) The great Khan pays fealty to Titanicus because he is mighty, and may change his mind if Titanicus shows weakness.
- (2025-01-19) Rumor on the caravan says some Khans quietly favor the Dawnrealm, and the Dawnrealm may try to turn the Khanates against the Imperium.

chunks.title: Khanates (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Khanates (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-01-19) The Khanates' predators have become less active lately for unknown reasons; underdark theories are floated.
- (2025-01-19) Magic is rare among the Khanates: some sorcerers, druids and priests, no wizards.
- (2025-01-19) The steppe hides burrowing predators (land sharks/bulette, ankheg, cruthic) and, near mountains, aerial ones (wyverns, griffins, manticore); they threaten only small groups, so the Khanates travel in large groups.
- (2025-02-02) The caravan crossed the steppe and turned south toward Sun Dragon rather than north toward Xeon.
- (2025-02-02) The Khanates' baseline position is that they joined the Imperium by agreeing to stop sacking it and not to join the Dawnrealm. Their political position in the capital is strong because they are a buffer against the Dawnrealm.
- (2025-02-02) Some in the civilized Imperium want the arable steppe turned to farmland, but this is slow going and not politically necessary.
- (2025-02-16) The Khanates respect power, wealth and freedom and ally with whoever offers them these; the Dawnrealm tries to co-opt or conquer clans, while Roma tries to cement alliance via noble marriages.
- (2025-02-16) Clan custom: politeness and hospitality are mandatory, but respect must be earned.
- (2025-02-16) Clans trade horses and yaks; the party traveled north through plains with Landshark activity, avoided via a group Perception check (middle roll 20).

chunks.title: Khanates (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Khanates (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-03-02) The Silk Road runs through the Khanates; silks and furs are status markers, with white furs, gold and gems signifying wealth, and sky blue common among the People of the Azure Sky; it is spring but still cold.
- (2025-03-02) People of the Khanates routinely wear weapons, while armor at dinner is considered odd.
- (2025-03-16) Native wildlife of the steppe around the Azure Sky grounds includes wild and tame horses, plains lions, hawks, falcons and eagles near the mountains, snakes and plains reptiles, rodents, and yak-like shaggy horned beasts.
- (2025-04-20) The wind constantly moves the steppe grass at the challenge field, which helps sneaking creatures stay unnoticed.
- (2025-04-20) The Stormgale clan is a neighboring clan: the People of the Azure Sky has mixed feelings about them, neither loving nor hating them.
- (2025-05-04) Khanate war is a common way to settle disputes: it establishes who has the upper hand and can dictate terms rather than conquering or destroying.
- (2025-11-02) House Mazaali's power in Roma comes from the Khanates being the first line of defense against the Dawnrealm.

chunks.title: Dawnrealm
chunks.text:
Location: Dawnrealm (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-02-16)
Type: realm
Description: Realm east beyond the Khanates; destination of a months-long caravan guard job.
- The Dawnrealm to the east, once a province of the Imperium, is now fully independent following the negotiated end to the war.
- (2024-11-17) A posted job sought 20 adventurers to guard a shipment on a months-long caravan through the Khanates to the Dawnrealm.
- (2025-01-05) The Khanates act as the buffer and deterrent against the Dawnrealm to the east.
- (2025-01-19) Dawnrealm left the empire when magic broke and is officially at war with the Imperium; it is known for spying and infiltration and speaks Common.
- (2025-02-02) The Red Wargs describe Dawnrealm forces as having many hobgoblins, fey, and ogres and trolls whose loyalty the Imperium's giants cannot break. Most Dawnrealmers have rudimentary magical training, and the realm is known for bribery and subversion.
- (2025-02-02) Imperial citizens entering the Dawnrealm risk arrest as spies. Harriet holds a license to trade there for the first time, which gives some protection, but political power can break the rules.
- (2025-02-16) The Dawnrealm was once part of the imperium and friendly to the Khanates; it is always at war with Roma and Greka, and its only recent military push was at Sundragon after months of quiet, money-flowing diplomacy.

chunks.title: Mercenary Coordination Hall
chunks.text:
Location: Mercenary Coordination Hall (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-19)
Also known as: mustering hall, the hall, hall of mercenaries, Mercenary Hall
Type: meeting hall
Parent: Sword Quarter
Description: Giant meeting hall where mercenaries and clients meet; managed by Colonel Kreetz, supported by House Kenegal.
- (2024-11-17) The hall has a job board and clients who walk in and pick mercenary groups; Colonel Kreetz records who hired whom, success and failure and non-payment, but not why, and handles no money.
- (2024-11-17) The party registered as the Fist of the Butterfly, led by Monarch, with the Golden Leaf as contact.
- (2024-12-01) Greka has its own hall of mercenaries, related to Colonel Kaelix's operation and run the same way, with job postings on the walls and an organizer who refers mercenaries.
- (2025-01-19) Posted jobs listed mostly Khanate trade loops from Roma. Two fit the party: Sir Saravar's small foot job to Xi'an Palace and Harriet's caravan to Sun Dragon.

chunks.title: Autumn Portal
chunks.text:
Location: Autumn Portal (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2024-11-17)
Type: portal
Parent: Roma
- One of Roma's seasonal portals (Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter) on the DM's map; it stands in Trimarket beside the Golden Leaf Tavern, on the city's south-west side.

chunks.title: Clockwork Tiger
chunks.text:
Location: Clockwork Tiger (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2024-12-01)
Also known as: Clockrack Tiger
Type: tavern
Parent: Greka
Description: Clockwork-themed establishment with unnecessary gears everywhere.
- (2024-12-01) Jimmy Slips sent a message telling the party to meet him at the Clockwork Tiger. Its sign is an animated clockwork tiger. It is two-thirds full and themed with unnecessary clockworks (self-opening doors, rotating lamps, a music-box tone).
- (2024-12-01) A red-braided-bearded dwarf waved Monarch over there and spoke as Jimmy Slips.

chunks.title: The Glass Door
chunks.text:
Location: The Glass Door (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2024-12-01)
Also known as: Glassdoor
Type: tavern
Parent: Greka
Description: Doorless, always-open tavern near the shipyards full of disgruntled Shimmerstone workers.
- (2024-12-01) It has no doors and never closes. Disgruntled Shimmerstone Shipworks employees drink there, and Monarch and Portia learned about the cloud giant partner and the workers' complaints there.

chunks.title: Bay 3 (the pit)
names: Prison Cavern of the Faceless Lord
chunks.text:
Location: Bay 3 (the pit) (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: the pit, Bay 3, the darkened dry dock, Prison Cavern of the Faceless Lord, chamber of the dragon statues
Type: cavern
Parent: Prison of the Faceless Lord
Description: Carved cavern with ten colossal dragon statues around a collapsed platform pit of ooze held by a web of glowing abjuration runes, with the blue dragon mask at the center
- (2024-12-15) Workers call the darkened dry dock either Bay 3 or the pit.
- (2024-12-15) Two voices give orders from within: Wizen, the grim work chief in the northeast corner, and the whiny 'great Zulk' speaking from a glass jar near the center of the ship.
- (2024-12-15) Duergar hammer Serge, in a power suit, does the heavy work; two sentry automata stand guard in the corners and track everything inside and outside the pit.
- (2024-12-15) The ship under construction is long, with a ring hovering vertically around the middle with no struts, unlike any airship the party has seen.
- (2024-12-15) Raf's bat Diego, with a perception roll of 15, observed Serge handling two crystalline shards in a box the size of the delivered box; the Great Zulk demanded the smaller, darker one.
- (2024-12-15) The duergar crew, Wizen and Serge leave before the day shift arrives, while the sentries stay.
- (2025-01-05) The party believes the darkened dry dock is building an elemental-bound airship needing a Saberus dragon shard, which Monarch reported to Azuriel.

chunks.title: Bay 3 (the pit) (part 2)
names: Prison Cavern of the Faceless Lord
chunks.text:
Location: Bay 3 (the pit) (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-10-19) The vast carved cavern is lit by prismatic light from ten colossal dragon statues encircling a pit, once a platform, now 60 feet across and filled with undulating ooze-flesh. It is barely contained by a strained net of glowing giant runes. A blue dragon scale mask floats on the ooze at the geometric center, 30 feet from the edge. The statues stand 30 feet beyond the pit's edge.
- (2025-10-19) The runes are abjuration. The Graven Lexus lets the party place an artifact in the web before removing the mask, and removing the mask first would make it burst. It takes three simultaneous Arcana checks twice, one person to open the hole and two to hold the edges. Raf made an Arcana check of 27 to understand the process.
- (2025-10-19) A gurgling voice told Monarch to surrender her face and gain ultimate power in chaos, and she mentally refused. A pebble thrown at the rune field vanished into the viscous surface. Eddie's augury found replacing the mask with Black Razor gave wheel, while adding Black Razor and leaving the mask gave wheel then woe.

chunks.title: Guard Workshop Cage Room
chunks.text:
Location: Guard Workshop Cage Room (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: locked storeroom, far-right workshop, cage room
Type: workshop room
Parent: Shimmerstone Shipworks
Description: Payroll room with a cage door, normally guarded by a detention sentry.
- (2024-12-15) Lucia heard heavy metallic movement in the locked room and saw through the bars a humanoid automaton detention sentry; a clockwork observer that never leaves the room hovers inside.
- (2024-12-15) A detention sentry can bubble one prisoner at a time in a force sphere; the bubble can only be broken by dispel magic or by destroying the drone.
- (2024-12-15) The building was filled with magical silence, centered about 10 feet inside the door; the silence blocks the Message spell.
- (2024-12-15) Jimmy Slips, disguised as an autognome, was trapped in a force bubble by the sentry; the observer inside was destroyed.
- (2025-01-05) Normally the paymaster stands behind the cage door handing out pay, and the sentry guards the room otherwise. The cage door swings outward, and the lock is on the right as you face the doors.
- (2025-01-05) The silence Jimmy cast filled the building and blocked sound and verbal spells; he held it up for the whole fight and dropped it afterward.
- (2025-01-05) Lucia picked the cage lock with sleight of hand after a rerolled inspiration check.
- (2025-01-05) The destroyed sentry's armor plates are worth 500 gp toward crafting plate mail, or 250 gp if sold.

chunks.title: Rocky bat island off Greka
chunks.text:
Location: Rocky bat island off Greka (first seen 2024-12-15, last seen 2024-12-15)
Also known as: bat cave island
Type: island cave
Parent: Greka
Description: Rocky island off the coast with a long-used cave full of bats and guano.
- (2024-12-15) A Greka druid told Portia of the island, reachable by rowing or swimming; Portia swam there in fish form and convinced bats to pass through the Shipworks.

chunks.title: Thundering Citadel
chunks.text:
Location: Thundering Citadel (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-01-19)
Type: fortress
Parent: Khanates
Description: Fortress on the eastern shore of the Mare Medietas
- (2025-01-19) A past great Khan built it after tiring of Roman armies landing on their shores; storm sorcerers there could sink ships at great distance.

chunks.title: Archafinalis
chunks.text:
Location: Archafinalis (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-01-19)
Also known as: Archaeophenalis, Arquefanalis, Archipelanes
Type: fortress
Parent: Imperium Titanicus
Description: Great fortress at the southern end of the Mare Medietas, north end of a defensive line against the Khanates
- (2025-01-19) It was Roma's eastern-most bastion. The party's caravan reached it after several days down the western coast; it is being strengthened with new fortifications and has a small town.

chunks.title: Sun Dragon
chunks.text:
Location: Sun Dragon (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-03-02)
Also known as: Sun Dragon Rising, Sundragon
Type: town
Parent: Imperium Titanicus
Description: Town at the foot of a mountain pass in the Eastern Mountains; it gets the first sunlight of the morning.
- (2025-01-19) Caravan rumor says it is under imperial control, with the pass fortress holding. It is a war zone and could fall to the Dawnrealm.
- (2025-02-02) The caravan found Sun Dragon under siege by thousands of humanoids, including ogre- and troll-sized ones, with the walls breached in several places so the siege was turning into a street battle.
- (2025-02-02) After a few days a thunderstorm gathered over it, and giants and imperial troops arrived. The attackers withdrew and imperial forces regained control; the party surmised the teleport circle was retaken first.
- (2025-02-02) After the siege the town is damaged and plundered, with little food, lodging or hospitality. Talk in town is of mustering a force to retake the pass seized by the enemy, and the army is hiring mercenary reinforcements at rising rates.
- (2025-02-02) The party stopped there, exchanged gems for cash, and Eddie had two platinum rings made for 50 gp.
- (2025-02-16) The party left the caravan there and split off toward Xi'an Palace.
- (2025-03-02) Sir Raf told the Khan's council that the Dawnrealm seized the pass and broke through to Sun Dragon Rising, and that the Imperium retook the city; the party brought eyewitness news ahead of other reports.

chunks.title: Corona Domini
chunks.text:
Location: Corona Domini (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Corona
Type: walled inner city
Parent: Roma
- On the DM's map Corona Domini is the walled inner city at the heart of Roma, ringed by the Canalis Ambiente; its spires and gates are Steelspire, Frostgate, Windspire, Seagate, Sunspire, Houndsgate, Spellspire, Godspire, Lionsgate and the Gate of the Bear.
- (2025-01-19) The Imperium's seat is on the central hill; its one public gate on the south is guarded by giants. Sir Saravar showed something in his hand there and was admitted.
- (2025-11-02) The Senate Building and the halls of political power are in Corona Domini, where senators like to live.
- (2025-11-16) Each of the six giant senators has a palace in Corona Domini, the main center of government, wealth and power in the city. Monarch, Raf and Eddie also took jobs and interviewed there, and the Senate archives are there.
- (2025-11-30) The party traveled through Corona Domini's streets, plazas and squares, where Eddie and Monarch met Senator Vaelthira's frost giant enforcers (Julia, Krug and Gillygully) and talked their way out of a beating.
- (2025-11-30) Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus's offices are in Corona Domini; she rarely uses her office and walks around directing staff.

chunks.title: Red Wargs' camp
chunks.text:
Location: Red Wargs' camp (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-02-02)
Also known as: Sokha Khan's camp, the Red Wargs
Type: nomadic encampment
Parent: Khanates
Description: Large tent city of the Red Wargs clan under Sokha Khan, near the Dawnrealm border, where the caravan traded for horses.
- (2025-02-02) The caravan reached a large nomadic encampment on day nine. Sokha Khan required proof of prowess via a single combat before dealing, and Sir Raf won it.
- (2025-02-02) The clan calls itself the Red Wargs, after wargs hunted out of the steppe. They resent outside control and only begrudgingly take allegiance with the Imperium.
- (2025-02-02) After the combat the caravan camped inside the protective perimeter, was welcomed to the campfires, and traded exhausted horses and manufactured goods for fresh horses.

chunks.title: Stormgale clan camp
chunks.text:
Location: Stormgale clan camp (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-05-04)
Type: clan camp
Parent: Khanates
Description: Large traveling tent city of thousands, banners gray and black with silver and a storm-cloud lightning emblem, led by Jargal Khan
- (2025-02-16) The party camped there after a persuasion check; they were brought before old Jargal Khan, who suspected they would not be given access to the Qul'drik ruins.
- (2025-02-16) The clan is wealthy with Dawnrealm-style goods, controls mountain trade routes, is allied with the people of the Azure Sky, and has members on Dawnrealm payroll; the Khan takes a cut.
- (2025-02-16) The camp trades by barter with only a 10% difference charged, and offered up to two scrolls of up to first level; Raf traded studded leather toward a Khanate-style breastplate.
- (2025-03-02) Setsen asked the party to sabotage the Stormgale clan's Dawnrealm alliance, which is seen as the clan's backing for challenging the Azure Sky.
- (2025-05-04) Dagha declared Stormgale must be punished for the attempt on Chimeg's life and the disruption of the rituals. The People of the Azure Sky's bulk force will go to Stormgale to remind them who runs Bartertown. Chimeg describes Stormgale as shrewd merchants, long friendly with the Dawnrealm.

chunks.title: Foothills campsite hilltop
chunks.text:
Location: Foothills campsite hilltop (first seen 2025-05-04, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: Chimeg's hilltop camp
Type: campsite
Parent: Khanates
Description: Raised rocky hilltop in the foothills on the route to the ruins, good visibility, hard to burrow under
- (2025-05-04) Chimeg had camped on this raised hilltop before. A previous group bringing something heavy back from the ruins lost its wagon and some people here, probably to a land shark.
- (2025-05-04) The party camped here on the first night, and a land shark attacked at midnight. It was killed by Chimeg's greatsword hits for 9 and 12, so the campsite no longer has a land shark problem.

chunks.title: Tower of Storms
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Storms (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-08-10)
Also known as: first tower
Type: ruined giant tower basement
Parent: Ruins of Qul'drik
Description: Giant-built basement with a circular corridor of rooms; the party dispelled and opened the study (with the knocking chest) and the orrery room.
- (2025-05-18) The tower was rubble above ground. Its basement is a circular, roughly 20-foot-wide corridor with 15-by-15-foot stone doors, each with a keyhole and a lever about seven and a half feet up. A mural of five panels runs along the outer wall.
- (2025-05-18) The mural shows giants fighting an amorphous Tarasque-sized monster and Tiamat, binding Tiamat in the hells and forging five masks as keys to her prison, and entombing the amorphous thing under the city with a mask. Lines of power link its binding to arcane towers around the city.
- (2025-05-18) Door 1 opens onto a room with five giant chests, four plain and one ornate in the far left corner, and a 10-foot lightning humanoid that watched the party but did not attack. The party closed the door.
- (2025-05-18) Door 2 hid its real lock under an illusion behind a false lock (Monarch rolled a critical success to find it). Lucia picked it at disadvantage with a 26. Inside are four abjuration circles glowing red, green, orange and blue, each under huge manacles, containing the bones of a winged horned fiend (probably a pit fiend), a celestial (probably a planetar), a huge giant, and a blue dragon.

chunks.title: Tower of Storms (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Storms (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-08-10)
- (2025-05-18) The manacles are an adamantine-mithril alloy carved with giant runes for power transfer, suggesting the prisoners were drained as power sources. The green circle on the giant's bones was a strong inward ward, and the celestial's circle was a protection-from-good circle perhaps made by a wish.
- (2025-05-18) Door 3 opened but did not budge. It bears abjuration sigils, and the party left it for later.
- (2025-05-18) Door 4 is unlocked and untrapped. Its room is a library overgrown by roots and vines, which stir and crawl toward the party, with something larger lurking at the back.
- (2025-06-01) The party fought twig blights, needle blights, vine blights and a shambling mound in the overgrown library; the shambling mound is resistant to fire and cold and immune to lightning, and Portia's fireball dealt 24 damage to it. Burning hands from Portia finished it, and the blights collapsed inert.
- (2025-06-01) The library holds giant-scale books, two to three feet tall and written in giant, on constructing permanently enchanted structures such as temples, summoning circles and teleportation circles. Eddie found a mostly intact book on the runic language giants used for teleportation circles; with a good knowledge of a location and the system, the sigil pattern could be worked out.

chunks.title: Tower of Storms (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Storms (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-08-10)
- (2025-06-01) Monarch pulled a giant-sized rune stone from the shambling mound; it is a cleverly designed container with a seam. It turned out to hold a giant-sized ring, and the crackling electricity came from the ring.
- (2025-06-01) Clairvoyance cast by Monarch showed a giant-scale private study behind one barred door, with an open multi-drawer chest of inks and papers, a desk, and a locked chest of layered stone and metal about 10x20 ft from which a rhythmic thumping comes. Another door's room holds a shattered magic circle, an alchemical desk, an orrery, and a 10x10x20 ft ornate chest in a double magic circle with three hovering glowing orbs (blue, yellow, green) humming a three-note chord.
- (2025-06-01) The two doors remain unopened: both seem held by an arcane lock or barrier, and the party plans to try dispel magic. Paper could not be slipped under them.
- (2025-06-01) The party camped in Tiny Hut at the top of the stairs with the horses corralled nearby. During watch Lucia heard and saw a 15-20 ft humanoid conglomerate of stones with glowing runes pushing through the forest. Chimeg called them stonewalkers: purely destructive, with no way to calm or defeat them, best outrun.

chunks.title: Tower of Storms (part 4)
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Storms (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-08-10)
- (2025-06-01) The lightning creature in the first room lunged when Raf stepped across the threshold. Its lightning bolt did 26 damage and it teleported with a lightning burst. It was resistant to rapier, thunder and lightning damage, immune to prone, and vulnerable to psychic, fire and radiant damage. Portia's burning hands destroyed it, after which it vanished with a thunderclap.
- (2025-06-01) Chimeg took a critical hit of 50 damage in that fight and was cured by Eddie.
- (2025-06-01) The ornate chest was trapped with a mechanical hinge-wire trap and a glyph of warding. Lucia disarmed the four hinge wires. Opening the lid set off the glyph, a 60-foot wave of black thunder and necrotic energy; Lucia took 32 and was deafened for ten minutes, and Raf made his save for 17 thunder and 15 necrotic and was deafened one round.
- (2025-06-01) Inside the ornate chest were four ceramic canisters with dispersal fittings, one under each hinge, whose contents did not release. A hidden sliding-block puzzle opened a secret compartment holding 400 giant gold coins worth 10 gp each, 200 giant platinum coins worth 10 pp each, and diamonds worth 100, 300, 500 and 1,000. The coins bear the ancient runes of Qul'drik. A cloth-wrapped flat 2x3 ft object lay on the bottom.
- (2025-06-01) The other large chest in the chest room was emptied and unlocked. The tower looks like a working tower with no bodies or sleeping quarters found.

chunks.title: Tower of Storms (part 5)
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Storms (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-08-10)
- (2025-06-01) Unwrapping the cloth-wrapped rectangle revealed a mirror; Lucia heard whispers from it that no one else heard and passed out.
- (2025-06-15) Eddie knocked on the abjuration-warded giant chest in the private study, setting off a blast of force: 17 force damage to Portia and Monarch who failed their saves, 8 to Eddie and Lucia who saved, with knockback of 20 feet; Portia was 32 feet away and unharmed. The thumping stopped.
- (2025-06-15) The study held a giant-sized desk, an open chest of wizard's writing and crafting materials in layers, a research monograph on the giant nation of Zendrick (mentioning Eberron) with no index, and a wizard's potted plant.
- (2025-06-15) Eddie's Dispel Magic (9, then a rolled 6 plus 3 with inspiration, dispelling up to a 7th-level spell) removed the magical seal from the second door; Lucia then ritually picked its large DC 30 lock with a 35 over several minutes.
- (2025-06-15) Inside the orrery room: a shattered permanent summoning circle that broke outward, as if something far more powerful than the circle was summoned (Sir Raf's assessment); a wagon-sized puzzle-box chest ringed by glowing red protective circles with three hovering metal spheres (green, blue, yellow-white); and a desk of wondrous-item crafting materials at giant scale.

chunks.title: Tower of Storms (part 6)
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Storms (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-08-10)
- (2025-06-15) The orrery models the world's sun, planet, moon and a wide-orbiting planetoid called Obsidius (also the newcomer, the orphan, the visitor). It was set about 700 years in the past; the next alignment of sun, moon, Obsidius and planet is a double eclipse, which was also the year of Monarch's birth (the black moon year). Its three spheres hum and act as bells.
- (2025-06-15) Portia playing the middle sphere's tone on her pan flute triggered a wash of thunder damage; she took half of 22 after a successful Constitution save (14) and was not thrown back. Eddie then shot arrows at the spheres: hitting the small blue one and the middle gold one caused only louder humming, but striking the large green one produced a chord that extinguished the red circle glow; the first shot at the moon sphere had wrecked the desk, cracked paving stones and shaken dust from the ceiling.
- (2025-06-15) The puzzle box was solved by Monarch with Lucia's help, revealing two keyhole blocks that Lucia picked (25 and 26). Inside were 40-50 books, scrolls and stone tablets on Tiamat, Bahamut, Kyber, Siberys, Duoblex and Zoriat. Monarch's wild surge gave her resistance to all damage for a minute. The party re-locked the chest and reset the orrery to a random point 500-650 years back, relighting the circles.
- (2025-06-15) A 10-foot-by-1.5-foot chest-bound devil was found in the study chest; Monarch talked to it by Message and the party left it behind.

chunks.title: Tower of Storms (part 7)
chunks.text:
Location: Tower of Storms (first seen 2025-05-18, last seen 2025-08-10)
- (2025-06-15) The basement towers are thought to have been power sources feeding a central binding location. The party loaded roughly five pack animals with the books and crafting materials.
- (2025-07-13) The Tower of Dreams stands closer to the Tower of Storms than the Tower of Runes stands to the Tower of Dreams. The party began this session at the Tower of Storms side, having left their horses and the trail south of it.
- (2025-08-10) Frescoes below the Tower of Storms showed the thorn betrayer handing the mask over to the giants.

chunks.title: Hall of Blades
chunks.text:
Location: Hall of Blades (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-08-10)
Also known as: hollow blades, Hollow Plates, Hall Of Plates
Type: underground hall
Parent: Ruins of Qul'drik
Description: Buried giant hall of floating blades, each held by a faint spirit keeper, around a rune-carved sacrificial pedestal.
- (2025-07-27) A giant-scale doorway is buried in the side of a low hill about 10 feet high and 50-60 feet across, at the center of a roughly 600-foot-wide circle of chopped-down forest. Chimeg suggested it as the likeliest place to find a legendary item.
- (2025-07-27) Outside lay the remains of about a dozen humanoids hacked to bits, including cult members, with smashed digging tools; footprints inside went in but not out.
- (2025-07-27) A recovered letter says the Hall of Blades guards the echoes of oaths tied to the mask's last bearer, the swords remember who took it, and the path to the blue dragon mask begins here.
- (2025-07-27) Inside are rows of swords and axes held in midair by spirits, 100 feet in, with a pedestal of living shifting runes 150 feet away. A voice in the mind says those who come must prove their honesty and unworthy answers will be punished; the blades glow when truths are offered. Truths judged worthy let one live, and a particularly worthy one earns a blade or boon.

chunks.title: Hall of Blades (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Hall of Blades (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-08-10)
- (2025-07-27) Eddie's truth about the Tiamat scar earned a rapier of blood iron and adamantine carrying necrotic energy; Monarch's truth about accepting the crown earned a warning that power from below pulls below. Chimeg walked to the pedestal and a smoking shadow-flame greatsword advanced while her own greatsword began smoking.
- (2025-08-10) Stepping into the room prompts the pedestal to demand a secret or truth of value in the mind; those who stay at the doorway are not asked. Replies are judged unworthy (punished), adequate (spared), or worthy (rewarded).
- (2025-08-10) Raf's truth about his oath to Lady Gracia and House Ventra was judged adequate, and no blade moved. Portia's truth about resenting her task of watching Monarch was also judged adequate.
- (2025-08-10) The blades attack those who become enemies, mainly after attacking a sword or the keeper; four swords at a time chased Monarch, while Chimeg and Raf were not targeted. The swords stopped when Chimeg picked up Black Razor and shouted 'stand down', and some fallen swords stayed on the floor.
- (2025-08-10) The party took a long rest inside the hall, surrounded by the swords. Every blade in the hall has something special, like a hall of fame.

chunks.title: Hall of Blades (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Hall of Blades (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-08-10)
- (2025-08-10) Eddie offered a plus one short sword on the pedestal, which a spirit carried off to join the ranks. The voice called it an acceptable offer, said where the blue dragon mask is lay beyond its knowledge, and that many saw the thorn betrayer carry it through the Gate of Dragons into the Hall of Scales.

chunks.title: Hall of Scales
chunks.text:
Location: Hall of Scales (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-10-05)
Also known as: hollow scales
Parent: Ruins of Qul'drik
Description: Hall deep in the center of the giant city, reached through the Gate of Dragons; where the thorn betrayer took the blue dragon mask.
Type: ruin hall
- (2025-08-10) The party decided to head to the Hall of Scales to follow the trail of the thorn betrayer, using the roads rather than going cross country.
- (2025-09-21) The party headed overland from the Hall of Feasts toward it, sneaking through overgrown forest by a crude map and finding a rocky outcropping with a cave.
- (2025-10-05) The party's last long rest was in the woods outside the Hall of Scales, after visions of the purple-clad Dreamcaster, and the GM described the cave outcropping near its spire as the dragon cultists' base.

chunks.title: Gate of Dragons
chunks.text:
Location: Gate of Dragons (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-11-02)
Type: gate
Parent: Ruins of Qul'drik
- (2025-08-10) The thorn betrayer carried the mask through the Gate of Dragons into the Hall of Scales.
- (2025-11-02) The portal can only be opened with the crystal chalice and the ritual from the ancient tablet, performed in honest, respectful spirit; the party takes both with them. Eddie wrote a warning in Common, Draconic and Giant: 'through this portal lies death'.

chunks.title: Hall of Feasts
chunks.text:
Location: Hall of Feasts (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: Hall Of Feast, Hall of Peace, feast hall
Type: buried giant feast hall
Parent: Ruins of Qul'drik
Description: Three-level banquet hall of giant tables, mosaics and a high table to the north, with kitchen, study, brewery and trial chamber off it.
- (2025-08-10) Three open chimneys, at least 60 feet deep, rise 5 to 10 feet above ground and are about 10 feet across; they lead to an oven, a smoker/grill and a roasting pit. The party sent familiars Dora and Diego down the roasting pit.
- (2025-08-10) The hall has tables like fishing boats, magically clean and constantly self-adjusting place settings, mosaics of political feasts with giants, devils and metallic dragons, and a strong roof; most other exits are blocked by rubble.
- (2025-08-10) Diego and Dora found a hidden door behind a mosaic, matching one specific table in the room.
- (2025-08-24) The party descended the roasting-pit chimney by rope; the hall is sunken in the middle, with raised balconies of tables and steps, and pillars about 15 feet wide at the base.
- (2025-08-24) The high table has three big rulers' chairs. Mosaics on both sides show it laid out for a feast (roast mammoth, river fish, floating purple sky fruit, jars of mead) with a reclining silver dragon along one side. The real table is cracked and sagging, and its settings slide back into place, moved by about six persistent unseen-servant-type effects.

chunks.title: Hall of Feasts (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Hall of Feasts (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-09-21)
- (2025-08-24) A seam in the mosaic next to the statue marks a secret door. Raf's Perception 20 and a long search found no catch. Detect magic showed abjuration on the seam. Eddie's dispel magic ended it, but a crowbar with Raf's athletics roll of 19 plus 7 moved nothing.
- (2025-08-24) Three statues stand by the seam. One is labeled in Giant as the Keeper of the Seal and a larger one as the Lord of Coolrick. They are offices, not individuals, and are not articulated or magical.
- (2025-08-24) The party's working theory is to recreate the mosaic feast on the table, which needs the table repaired (mending) and the food, which the oozes ate. They plan to wait a day for the pantry shelves to refill.
- (2025-09-21) The party camped in the kitchen for a long rest and nothing disturbed them. In the morning the pantries had refilled.
- (2025-09-21) Raf mended the broken banquet table in a couple of castings. The party prepared the mosaic's feast, and the spirits rearranged the place settings to match it as the dishes were set out.
- (2025-09-21) When the last mead jar and steak knife were in place, the mosaic glimmered and a stone panel slid aside, revealing a gemstone chalice. Spectral giants and metallic dragons then re-enacted a quarrel: the giants demanded the dragons submit, the dragons wanted a partnership.

chunks.title: Hall of Feasts (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Hall of Feasts (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-09-21)
- (2025-09-21) The silver dragon proclaimed that none shall pass the Gate of Dragons save by the chalice of accord raised in truth and proper form; the vision repeated, weakening, until the room fell silent.
- (2025-09-21) The hall lies about 30 feet below ground. It is buried, entered by chimneys, and haunted. The coal in the hoppers has not deteriorated.

chunks.title: Hall of Feasts Kitchen
chunks.text:
Location: Hall of Feasts Kitchen (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: kitchen
Type: kitchen
Parent: Hall of Feasts
Description: Giant kitchen reached through a stuck door that Eddie forced open; the pantry shelves and casks are enchanted.
- (2025-08-24) Eddie's good athletics roll shoved open the stuck door to the kitchen, which has stoves, ovens, prep tables, barrels and pantry shelves.
- (2025-08-24) The pantry shelves, three stacked casks (ale, wine, water) and the other shelving detect as conjuration magic and appear to be enchanted items that generate food. The shelves and casks were undamaged by the oozes.
- (2025-08-24) A hungry black pudding and gray oozes with psychic abilities lived here. They had eaten almost all the food and were destroyed in combat.
- (2025-09-21) Eddie's detect magic showed only the barrels and pantries are magical, conjuration producing ingredients rather than finished dishes. The party used it as a camp, with Raf casting alarm over the doors.
- (2025-09-21) The lower shelves hold cool iron boxes of mammoth meat. The kitchen has three kinds of mead, an ale and two wines (a rich red and a bright sparkling). All the cooking tools are giant-sized.

chunks.title: Hall of Feasts Guest Study
chunks.text:
Location: Hall of Feasts Guest Study (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-08-24)
Also known as: private study
Type: study
Parent: Hall of Feasts
Description: Private meeting room with two fireplaces and couches; most of the books were taken away.
- (2025-08-24) Raf and Eddie forced the stuck door open with a combined 25. The study has bookshelves mostly emptied by a purposeful exit, with only ancient common-language literature left behind.

chunks.title: Giant Sculptor's Workshop
chunks.text:
Location: Giant Sculptor's Workshop (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-08-24)
Also known as: sculpting room, room guardian workshop
Type: workshop
Parent: Hall of Feasts
Description: Stone-carved door with arcane lock and glyph; workstations for sculpting and gem cutting, with a nearly finished room guardian.
- (2025-08-24) The stone door had an arcane lock and a defensive glyph. Eddie's dispel magic removed the glyph, and Raf shattered the door with Shatterspike.
- (2025-08-24) Inside stands a finely crafted room guardian, protected by a moss-covered undead stone giant sculptor in a corner. Giant workstations hold sculpting materials, and the gem-cutting station had five 50 gp gem fragments.
- (2025-08-24) Monarch used the guardian-control ritual from the notes with a third-level slot and heightened it. The guardian rolled a 10 and failed, so Monarch controlled it for an hour.

chunks.title: Chamber of Trials
chunks.text:
Location: Chamber of Trials (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: trial chamber, fighting pit
Type: arena
Parent: Hall of Feasts
Description: Long arena below the workshop, reached by steps, with murals of giants and silver and gold dragons.
- (2025-08-24) Entering triggers spectral echoes of giant and dragon battles; at the end a voice says 'none survive' and 'the peace ended' and requires a challenge and a chalice, and a ghostly giant challenger appears. Its stairwells are collapsed.
- (2025-08-24) Raf fought the challenger, with the others joining in, and it surrendered at one knee and gave a bronze tablet of giant runes before vanishing.
- (2025-09-21) The spectral spectators faded after the challenger was defeated.

chunks.title: Giant Brewery
chunks.text:
Location: Giant Brewery (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: potion room, brewery, cask room
Type: brewery
Parent: Hall of Feasts
Description: Chamber with two enormous leaking casks and animate pools of magical drafts.
- (2025-08-24) The moisture-swollen door was opened by Raf and Eddie. The room holds two huge bronze-banded casks leaking magical drafts that congealed into about three animate ooze-like masses. Portia's owl was hit by a fire blast (13 fire, save for half) and the party left it.
- (2025-09-21) The party fought and destroyed the living potions here: giant ooze-like potions of healing, fire breath and poison. The casks had leaked as their sealant failed.
- (2025-09-21) The shelves hold empty bottles and withered reagents. Eddie siphoned six potions of fire breath and six greater healing potions from the barrels. The other barrels are empty transport barrels.
- (2025-09-21) Raf offered to mend the leaking casks.

chunks.title: Dragon Cultist Cavern
chunks.text:
Location: Dragon Cultist Cavern (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: cave under the rocky outcropping, the cave, cave mouth
Type: cave
Parent: Ruins of Qul'drik
Description: Cult of the Dragon base cave; its arcane-glowing dragon-decorated gate at the back is the portal to the Draconic depths
- (2025-09-21) Diego found about 20 Cult of the Dragon members camped inside, led by a blue and a white half dragon and the Dreamcaster from the Tower of Dreams. A saddled wyvern sleeps atop the outcropping.
- (2025-09-21) At the back is an ornate arch with six dragon heads (five metallics plus Bahamut), with burned, melted and frozen remains in front of it.
- (2025-09-21) The Mirror of the Past showed the cult has used this cavern as a base for sending out parties.
- (2025-10-05) The cave entrance is wider than 20 feet, which Monarch had asked about earlier so she could cast an illusion over it; Raf reasoned it is wide so older dragons can come and go.
- (2025-10-05) The cleared ground around the spire had been cut and pruned, with no lumber left lying about; the GM noted this could be for fuel or defense, and the party set up on the opposite side of the cave entrance, in thick brush that is difficult terrain.
- (2025-10-05) The cultists stabled their horses on a cleared side of the cave and let them out to graze in the open outside the entrance, minded by two cultists.
- (2025-10-05) Inside, a fire burns just left of the door, a dim arcane glow comes from the dragon-decorated gate at the back, and 12 to 20 people mill around a table, the fire and small groups.

chunks.title: Dragon Cultist Cavern (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Dragon Cultist Cavern (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-10-05) Portia's fireball at range 150 feet hit the back of the cave where the Dreamcaster, the half dragons and the fanatics sat; the cultists then rushed out after her.
- (2025-10-05) From the cave the con lies to the southeast, off the bottom right corner of the map.
- (2025-10-19) The party took a short rest and a long rest at and around the cave. Alarm was proposed to cover the entryway. The party piled rocks over the dead cultists, and Eddie planned to sever the Dreamcaster's head and keep his body apart for speak with dead.
- (2025-10-19) The Dreamcaster's notes showed the cult had no answer to the portal. Bedrolls outnumbered the dead cultists by about half a dozen, so more cultists may be out and may return.
- (2025-10-19) Monarch performed the Chalice of Accord ritual before the portal, offering giant wasp honeymead. The mead boiled into steam that split into six tendrils entering the six dragon heads, the swirling purple energy vanished, and a dark tunnel opened.

chunks.title: Dragon Tunnel and Scale Passage
chunks.text:
Location: Dragon Tunnel and Scale Passage (first seen 2025-10-19, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: scaled tunnel
Type: tunnel
Parent: Ruins of Qul'drik
Description: 30-foot-wide tunnel reached through the portal, deep underground, with walls of overlapping multi-hued dragon scales pulsing silver and cobalt blue
- (2025-10-19) The tunnel, 30 feet across, is walled with overlapping non-living scales of all draconic colors that pulse silver-white and cobalt blue light. It carries a low Draconic chant and whisper. It is not at the back of the rock formation, so the portal is magical traversal.
- (2025-10-19) The tunnel opens into the Draconic Amphitheater. After the dragon trial a second 30-foot passage opened, sloping steeply down. There the scales had fallen away, leaving slick, slimy stone and dimmer light, with a smell of decay and acid and something huge breathing below.

chunks.title: Draconic Amphitheater
chunks.text:
Location: Draconic Amphitheater (first seen 2025-10-19, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: amphitheater
Type: chamber
Parent: Ruins of Qul'drik
Description: Sound-focusing amphitheater where the silver and blue dragon shapes test visitors on wisdom versus power
- (2025-10-19) The stone is shaped to carry, project and focus sound, and its light pulses between bright and dim. Heard fragments told of the great debate between metallic and chromatic dragons over whether giants should wield draconic power. Whispers spoke for wisdom and a deep chant for dominance, and the dragons never settled it.
- (2025-10-19) A silver shape and a blue shape of crackling azure coalesced at the center. They asked which truth the party served, wisdom that binds or power that dominates. The blue dragon's roar dealt 6 thunder damage to all, then 15 thunder and 14 lightning after the party answered wisdom. The silver dragon then healed the party for 35 and a passageway opened in the far wall.

chunks.title: Ooze Crevasse
chunks.text:
Location: Ooze Crevasse (first seen 2025-10-19, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: slime pit, crack in the passage, crevice
Type: chasm
Parent: Ruins of Qul'drik
Description: 60-foot crack severing the descending passage, filled with seething ooze
- (2025-10-19) A 60-foot-wide crack severed the passage, filled with seething dark ooze about 5 feet below the passage floor, with pale humanoid bones drifting on its surface. The ooze is a connected colony that Portia sensed as in pain, hungry, trapped and desperate. It can only respond to simple emotions, and the party judged a slime bridge would dissolve them.
- (2025-10-19) The slime on the walls formed humanoid shapes mimicking the party. Portia's empathy kept the colony calm. The party crossed with Eddie, winged by Tiamat's name and enlarged by Monarch, carrying them over. The rope piton on the far side was corroded and the shapes later merged back into the ooze.
- (2025-11-02) On the way out Portia, in horse form, carried Lucia and Eddie across one at a time over three rounds; the crevasse had narrowed to about 15 feet and bones still floated in it.

chunks.title: Wreath & Lion
chunks.text:
Location: Wreath & Lion (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: Wreath and Lion, Rethin line
Type: tavern
Parent: Corona Domini
Description: Venerable dark-wood tavern just off the marble steps of the Senate Forum, catering to senators, scribes and schemers; faded campaign banners and a great bronze lion crowned with the emperor's wreath guard the hearth.
- The DM's map of Roma hangs the Wreath & Lion's sign in Corona Domini.
- (2025-11-02) Locals joke that if the Senate passes a law, it was written at the Wreath & Lion; Monarch (as Myla Brightfellow) landed a job with Senator Valeria there.

chunks.title: Senate Archives
chunks.text:
Location: Senate Archives (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: the archives
Type: archive
Parent: Corona Domini
Description: Records of senate debates filed by date; magical light only, no fire allowed; a clerk at the front desk fetches documents for visitors.
- (2025-11-16) A clerk at the archive door watched Monarch, who rolled a 12 on Deception, while Portia in spider form rolled a 20 on Stealth and slipped in unseen. The archives are full of spiders and cobwebs. The clerks leave at the end of the day and the place is dimly lit by magical light only.
- (2025-11-16) Portia found the senate debate records, including earlier drafts of the Groves annexation bill. The current clean bill just says the Groves of Belenus are part of the city of Roma, and she found samples of Magnus Marvad's writing and handwriting.

chunks.title: Palace of Fire
chunks.text:
Location: Palace of Fire (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: Senator Kaldrina's palace, House Ignis palace, Hall of Fire
Type: palace
Parent: Corona Domini
Description: Fire giant Senator Kaldrina's heavily secured palace of black volcanic rock.
- (2025-11-16) Sir Raf was hired as a perimeter guard there, but is barred from entering the palace.
- (2025-11-16) Raf learned Kaldrina views the Groves as a security risk to Roma, an avenue for attack or invasion, which is likely why she supports the bill.
- (2025-11-30) The Hall of Fire is built of huge blocks of black volcanic rock mortared with cooled lava, smoky and about 110 degrees inside, staffed almost entirely by fire giants.
- (2025-11-30) Visitors pass three doors: a heavy physical outer door, then two giant-rune enchanted doors that respond to the guard; at the last, a warding face asks their business in Giant.
- (2025-11-30) Sir Raf's pitch and persuasion roll of 16 got Portia an escorted audience at the gates; the fire giant senator agreed to vote against annexation in exchange for the oaths.
- (2025-12-14) Sir Raf and Eddie tried to see Kaldrina here, but Raf rolled 8 and 4 with advantage (plus 2) and was turned away as too busy.

chunks.title: Palace of Frost
chunks.text:
Location: Palace of Frost (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: Senator Vaelthira's palace, Hall of Frost, Senator Vaelthira's fortress
Type: fortress and palace
Parent: Corona Domini
Description: Ice-covered military fortress of the frost giant Senator Vaelthira on the grounds of a former manor, wrapped in cold mist.
- (2025-11-16) Eddie was hired there and attached to a squad that sabotages rival senators. Vaelthira wants senate backing for a petition to the emperor to make war on Norge, and Senator Magnus supports it, but the petition has been pending longer than the grove bill.
- (2025-11-30) The Hall of Frost is a military fortress with ice-covered walls built of enchanted stone and giant runes that keep it below freezing, with the air around it noticeably cooler and misty.
- (2025-11-30) Direct-fire siege weapons are mounted on its crenellations and towers.
- (2025-11-30) The gardens have been flattened into a military encampment of a few hundred troops; the staff includes ogres, frost giants, ettins, orcs, orogs and giant-descended Goliaths.
- (2025-11-30) Security is 'responsive': guards don't pre-vet visitors and kill everyone if something goes wrong.
- (2025-11-30) Inside, officers study sea charts of the Sea of Storms and terrain maps of Norge; the main hall has a frost giant honor guard.
- (2025-11-30) Later the encampment had fewer tents and the officers talked theoretically about general sea patterns and Cherek defense rather than concrete plans, showing Vaelthira's urgency had cooled.

chunks.title: Palace of Frost (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Palace of Frost (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-12-14)
- (2025-12-14) Eddie got past the guards with an Enhance Ability: Charisma persuasion against DC 10, then waited; the war camp was bustling again with planning tables showing the northern shore, White Crown, the Great Canal, the Great Forest and the Northwest Mountains.
- (2025-12-14) Vaelthira's planners are building only offensive plans: ambushes, naval battles, canal, forest, mountain and farmland hammer-and-anvil operations, no static defenses.

chunks.title: Palace of the Hills
chunks.text:
Location: Palace of the Hills (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: Senator Rogrun's palace
Type: palace
Parent: Corona Domini
Description: Hill giant Senator Rogrun's palace: a hole dug into the side of a hill topped by the rubble of the knocked-down palace; smoky, greasy tunnels with a feast hall.
- (2025-11-16) Ogres guard the entrance, and ogres, hill giants and even trolls live there loosely controlled. The escort is to keep visitors from being eaten. The great feast hall has two long bonfires with spits and seats two dozen large diners. There the party struck a deal with Rogrun.

chunks.title: Palace of Stone
chunks.text:
Location: Palace of Stone (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: Stone Palace, Senator Borluss Flintmantle Lapis's palace
Type: palace
Parent: Corona Domini
Description: Stone giant Senator Borluss Flintmantle Lapis's palace, rebuilt stone for stone at double scale; silent, lit by glowing gemstones in mosaics.
- (2025-11-16) A meditative rock garden out front is rebuilt at double scale, and a boulder with eyes challenges visitors. The doors are stone carved to mimic wood grain and open on their own. Inside it is silent, full of statue-still giants. The party entered on Simona Querid Ventre's introduction and nobody guides visitors out.

chunks.title: Citadel of the Giants
chunks.text:
Location: Citadel of the Giants (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Type: settlement
Parent: Harrowlands
Description: Giant-only settlement in canyons at the southern end of the Occident province; seat of Emperor Titanicus.
- (2025-11-30) Emperor Titanicus rules from the Citadel of the Giants, a settlement populated entirely by giants in canyons at the southern end of the Occident Province, reachable by teleport circles and portals from Roma.

chunks.title: Emperor's Bay
chunks.text:
Location: Emperor's Bay (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: Roma Bay, Perth Bay, Greater Bay
Type: bay
Description: Vast bay north of Roma, many miles across, with a large mouth that is not a choke point; overcast, misty and cold.
Parent: Imperium Titanicus
- House Querid's map marks Emperor's Bay on the Imperium's northern coast, east of the Dragonfjord.
- (2025-12-14) The mouth of Emperor's Bay is quite large and not a choke point; Northreach Citadel is the first point of defense and is more useful for keeping storms out than ships.
- (2025-12-14) Nord sails were reported in Emperor's Bay; the dredged bay beside White Crown leads into the Great Canal.
- (2025-12-14) The bay is about 100 miles wide at its narrowest, under 100% overcast, with about a quarter to half a mile of visibility, and shifting depths with barely submerged islands read from wave patterns.
- (2025-12-14) A bronze dragon attacked the Wave Mount in the bay at dawn.
- (2026-01-11) The bronze dragon attacked the Wave Mount in the bay's stormy waters near Najik, after Portia's call lightning was cast as a warning shot.
- (2026-02-22) Skirmishes had already occurred in Emperor's Bay. From the shore the party saw imperial ships forming a blockade across the narrowest part of the bay entrance, and a few Norge ships north of it probing as if to draw ships out. The Norge fleet was assessed as not yet in force.

chunks.title: Emperor's Bay (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Emperor's Bay (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-10-18) A Norge fleet blockades the mouth of Emperor's Bay to stop imperial ships from flanking the Norge ships besieging Northreach Citadel, with active battle, flashes and artillery visible from afar. The blockade faced south, so the party ran through from the north, and its command frigates exchanged signals with the Fenrir.
- (2026-10-18) Inside the bay, imperial spell jammers about 100 feet long intercepted the Fenrir.

chunks.title: Northreach Citadel
chunks.text:
Location: Northreach Citadel (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: Northreach
Type: fortress
Parent: Emperor's Bay
Description: First point of defense at the mouth of Emperor's Bay; sits on a tower and peninsula.
- (2025-12-14) Northreach Citadel is hard to see from White Crown, and Vaelthira's spymaster Rowan is troubled that Northreach is not supplying good information.
- (2026-10-18) Northreach Citadel is under siege by Norge ships. Imperial land-based artillery and spell fire fight the Northern fleet.

chunks.title: White Crown
chunks.text:
Location: White Crown (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-02-22)
Type: port city
Parent: Imperium Titanicus
Description: Martial port city at the head of the Great Canal on Emperor's Bay; pale stone and frost-rimed iron, ballista towers, ice-crusted seawalls, cold at high thirties to low forties and windy.
- (2025-12-14) White Crown is austere, angular and built to fight, with tiered walls, ballista-bristling towers, busy docks and imperial soldiers; trade still flows under watchful eyes, and the city moves with unusual urgency.
- (2025-12-14) House Ventre's manor there has a teleportation circle room on an upper tower floor near the docks, with transport wizards who can bring the party back.
- (2025-12-14) A cloud giant seems to be in charge of the port.
- (2025-12-14) The city sits on the coast of the Sea of Storms and is unnaturally cold, shown white on the map.
- (2026-02-22) Giant-built imperial dreadnoughts flying imperial colors lay in the harbor of White Crown, arrived a couple of days earlier. One has a representation of an astral dreadnought as its prow.
- (2026-02-22) White Crown's chief magistrate is Goliath Ahn, known as the pyre of justice, who favors burning for death sentences and dislikes delaying justice. The party chose not to hand their prisoner to him.
- (2026-02-22) The party traveled from White Crown back to Roma via the druids' tree teleport.

chunks.title: The Smiling Fish
chunks.text:
Location: The Smiling Fish (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: smiling fish
Type: tavern
Parent: White Crown
Description: Tavern owned by House Kellenor, with a huge carved smiling fish hanging on an iron arm over the street.
- (2025-12-14) Mirel Kellenor does business from an office on its mezzanine level, guarded by House Kellenor soldiers; the mezzanine holds five tables including scribes' work tables, and Mirel hosted the party with grilled fish and wine.
- (2026-02-22) The party met Mural at the Smiling Fish in White Crown, where a large banquet table was reserved and loaded with grilled fish and wine for the party and the rescued shipwreck survivors.
- (2026-02-22) Mural paid the agreed 2,500 gold in 100 gp platinum trade bars and 100 gp gems.

chunks.title: Great Canal
chunks.text:
Location: Great Canal (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: the canal
Type: canal
Description: Canal with locks running from White Crown to the Mare Medietas.
- (2025-12-14) If the Nord fleet gets through the canal and locks into Mare Medietas it could quickly land troops at Roma; Vaelthira's planners also study battles at the canal mouth.

chunks.title: Northern Forest
chunks.text:
Location: Northern Forest (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: the forest, ancient forest to the north
Type: forest
Description: Ancient evergreen forest between Emperor's Bay and the farmland around Roma, heavily defended.
- (2025-12-14) The forest is the Imperium's main defense route, where its northern army is stationed; trees there are cold-hardy spruce and pine.
- (2025-12-14) Tessa Oakmere agreed only to send scouts and small groups through plants, not pyrotechnics or large armies, and prefers fighting kept on the shore.

chunks.title: Najik
chunks.text:
Location: Najik (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: Najeeq, Najik island, Najika
Type: island
Parent: Emperor's Bay
Description: Island with a monastery above sea caves and a bronze dragon's lair; a small fishing boat is the only craft there
- (2025-12-14) Debbie, a priest of a star-and-wanderer god, survived a shipwreck by swimming here, and sheltered in a small monastery of about a dozen monks in a sea cave on the south side; the bronze dragon also lives in the cave and the monks know it.
- (2025-12-14) Eddie spotted the white cliffs of the island on a Perception roll with advantage (22) at about 11 o'clock off the bow; the crow's nest confirmed it as Najik.
- (2026-01-11) The GM described Najik as about six miles wide at its widest and ten miles long, clinging with fog, with a black pebble beach to the north and white cliffs to the south.
- (2026-01-11) A significant population of goats and sheep lives on the island, and many reefs around it hold lots of fish; the big ship would have had trouble navigating this close, but the lifeboats threaded the reefs.
- (2026-01-11) The bronze dragon forbade the party from landing on the island, telling Monarch 'this island is forbidden to you'. It fled before they rowed in.
- (2026-01-11) Two shipwrecks occurred at the island: first the noble Ronnom Kenegal and his bodyguards, then after the dragon became protective, the second wreck (including Debbie's ship).

chunks.title: Najik (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Najik (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-02-08)
- (2026-02-08) Ronnom and his bodyguards arrived by a small sailing boat about six months ago. It vanished soon after, and the island has only a fishing boat unfit for the ocean.
- (2026-02-08) The dragon Skalanthas came to the island about fifteen years ago and became territorial in the last six months, sinking ships that approach. It eats fish from the bay, sheep and goats.
- (2026-02-08) After negotiating with Skalanthas, the party left in the island's two jolly boats with the shipwreck survivors and Veen disguised as Ronnom to return to their ship.

chunks.title: Wave Mount
chunks.text:
Location: Wave Mount (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-01-11)
Also known as: Wave Mount ship
Type: ship
Parent: White Crown
Description: Fast House Kellenor merchant ship crewed by working sailors, captained by the tiefling Captain Orso.
- (2025-12-14) Mirel Kellenor readied the ship to carry the party to Najik; it carries a chest of gold to bribe the dragon, kept below decks, and the crew has a couple of ballistae.
- (2025-12-14) Captain Orso plans to sail at night and sneak up on the island in fog; the ship was attacked by the bronze dragon at dawn.
- (2026-01-11) The Wave Mount took about 120 points of damage from the bronze dragon: a 50-damage lightning bolt, a 24-damage claw hit and a 45-damage point-blank blast, with cracks and leaks. Temporary patches and Sir Raf's mending kept it seaworthy.
- (2026-01-11) The ship has two ballistae at the stern and four lifeboats stowed below decks, raised through cargo hatches. Captain Orso lent two boats, which hold four comfortably or six overloaded, and anchored in a fog bank a short way out.
- (2026-01-11) The anchor chain did not reach the bottom where Lucia dropped it to stop the ship.

chunks.title: Najik Monastery
chunks.text:
Location: Najik Monastery (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: the monastery
Type: lay monastery
Parent: Najik
Description: Monastery above a flooded sea cave; its lower level holds the bedrooms of Ronnom's party, a workroom, a cell, a wine cellar and a pantry
- (2026-01-11) The monastery is in a sea cave in Najik's south-side white cliffs, with a small dock and two entries: steps from the shoreline up to a door, and steps from the dock. Stained glass windows glow with flickering light from inside.
- (2026-01-11) Its main ceremonial room holds four large goat statues on stone pedestals in the corners; twelve monks in wool robes and wooden clogs (humans, a tiefling, dwarf, dragonborn, elf, orc) gather there, led by an elderly aasimar-looking monk with a snake-headed cane.
- (2026-01-11) The party judged it a lay monastic order, more philosophy than religion, devoted to contemplative wisdom with goats as totems of wisdom and agility.
- (2026-01-11) The monks grant sanctuary, meaning they will not throw a guest out while under threat, but will not protect or force anyone; they offered the party the key to one strengthened lockable cell downstairs, a one-person bedroom that could physically hold four.
- (2026-01-11) A guest quarters room with six beds holds the three survivors of the second shipwreck; Ronnom Kenegal and his bodyguards stay on the lower level.

chunks.title: Najik Monastery (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Najik Monastery (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-08)
- (2026-01-11) The lower level, reached through the dining hall and stairs, is at or near water level; it has a storeroom with crates, rainwater barrels, spare oars, fishing poles and a silvered barbed spear, with a north corridor of interior doors, and the locking cell lies to the west.
- (2026-01-25) Below the monastery, the party fought the two doppelganger bodyguards, Eko and Mok, after Monarch's Charm Person revealed their true forms. A jade-eyed Dawnrealm-clad woman monk attacked Eddie.
- (2026-01-25) The lower level opens through a back door into a flooded tidal cave with knee-deep water that halves movement unless a creature has a swim speed.
- (2026-01-25) A dragon's roar echoed from the south of the cave at the end of the round.
- (2026-02-08) The flooded tidal cave below deepens toward the south: ankle deep near the stairs, then knee, hip and chest deep, with swimming depth (5 to 10 feet) further on, and about 20 feet of open space above the water. The GM said the floor drops away; the water is not rising.
- (2026-02-08) The southern part of the cave does not connect to the outside; only the northern side carries the sound of surf, which only Sir Raf could hear.
- (2026-02-08) The party fought the jade-eyed woman Veen in the cave's bedroom area. Monarch shattered the barred door with an adamantine great club (17 damage) after Portia's Ray of Frost weakened it. Veen ransacked her dresser, then fled through the water toward the dragon's lair.

chunks.title: Najik Monastery (part 3)
chunks.text:
Location: Najik Monastery (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-08)
- (2026-02-08) Veen's room held glassblowing tools, four empty vials with residue, a satchel of 60 platinum coins, a satchel of pearls worth 100 gp each, and an empty velvet-lined box. The other bodyguard's room held only a three-dragon-ante card game.
- (2026-02-08) Stairs from the doppelganger's room lead up to a different part of the monastery than the party's original route. No secret doors were found.
- (2026-02-08) The unlocked door at the end of the lower hall opens onto a craft workroom with a cobbler's, mason's, painter's and woodcarver's benches; the monks will craft the replacement door there.
- (2026-02-08) A lockable, externally barred cell lies on the lower level, with a small barred window in its door. The bed was made and nobody was inside.
- (2026-02-08) The lower storerooms hold a wine cellar of full barrels to the south and a pantry above it stocked with rations, candles, brewer's supplies and stale bread and cheese.
- (2026-02-08) The party took long rests in the big room of beds, reached by the stairs the monks offered, and the monks fed them dinner and breakfast. Sir Raf cast alarm at the entry stairs. The monks said they feel safe because the dragon considers them under his charge.
- (2026-02-08) The monks' trained message falcons recently fell ill and died, not long before the shipwreck survivors arrived. Monarch's Investigation (natural 20) on the empty vials showed a weak poison meant to be eaten or drunk, makeable from island ingredients and enough to kill a falcon.

chunks.title: Feywild
chunks.text:
Location: Feywild (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Also known as: Fey Wild, Fay Wild
Type: plane
Description: Plane of the archfey; travel time depends on how much the traveler wants to arrive; small courts and domains owe allegiance to the Seelie or Unseelie court, and some stay independent.
- (2026-01-25) In the vignette, Mona (young Monarch) was exiled from the Feywild by Queen Titania and may return only on the court's invitation once the danger has passed or been cured.
- (2026-01-25) Travel in the Feywild is faster when the traveler wants to get there and slower when they do not. The party reached Whisperwood's court quickly once they all wanted to go.
- (2026-01-25) Fairy rings serve as Feywild crossings. The one near the Seelie court needs a song and dance. The circle of drunkards needs each mushroom to be given a shot of alcohol.
- (2026-01-25) Archfey are supreme within their own domains, more powerful there than the queens of the Seelie and Unseelie courts. Titania would lose out to Aurelia in Whisperwood. The Unseelie queen of air and darkness has no name, having lost it in her banishment to the Feydark.

chunks.title: Court of Queen Titania and King Oberon
names: Court of Queen Titania and King Oberon
chunks.text:
Location: Court of Queen Titania and King Oberon (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Also known as: Seelie Court, Sealy Court, Summer Court
Type: court
Parent: Feywild
Description: Court of the summer fey, ruled by Queen Titania and King Oberon; driven by strong passions and strict protocol.
