Significance: Left covered by the party; Monarch joked it might tell your future and pull you from it; party agreed to wait for safe harbor
Magic: divination + conjuration (Sir Raf's detect magic); the bearskin itself is not magical
- (2025-06-01) Monarch lifted it from the bottom of the chest and Lucia handed it to Sir Raf, who carried it out of the room.
- (2025-06-01) Lucia unwrapped it; she saw the mirror's face, heard whispers nobody else heard, her eyes rolled back and she passed out.
- (2025-06-15) Lucia's vision in the mirror showed a high-magic city of giants, with cloud and fire giants and dragons, both chromatic and metallic, visiting.
- (2025-06-15) The vision reinterpreted the Tiamat mural as a negotiation with an aspect of Tiamat, who permitted the removal of one scale of each color; a show of force may have been involved.
- (2025-06-15) The vision showed the shapeless mass destroying much of the city before it was bound; the towers were built for the binding, some beforehand from prophecy and some rapidly by magic.

chunks.title: Cloth-Wrapped Mirror (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Cloth-Wrapped Mirror (first seen 2025-06-01, last seen 2026-07-26)
- (2025-06-15) Lucia was out for three or four seconds but experienced it as hours; she rolled 18 on an Intelligence check and recalled a bilingual rhyme: 'The rhyme must never be spoken. Her minions must not find the token, lest both great prisons be broken and faceless lord reawoken.'
- (2025-06-15) Side effect: Lucia spoke with a slight giant accent and pronounced about every fifth word backwards; it faded as she kept talking and the GM judged it a hangover rather than permanent.
- (2025-06-15) Detect Magic after the long rest identified it as a mirror of the past, no attunement required, usable once per day. The GM said it was already used today and each use leaves an imprint on the viewer. It is described as a giant's hand mirror, a foot and a half by two feet of polished crystal and silver.
- (2025-06-15) The party folded it back into its cloth with the back facing out and did not look in it again that day.
- (2025-09-21) Lucia's player prompted using the mirror on the Dreamcaster; the GM described its effect and showed scenes: the Tower of Dreams, the cavern with many cultists, a hooded figure in Roma near the Wizards District, a ship sailing from sky to sea in the North, and him flying a wyvern beside a red dragonborn and a tiefling.

chunks.title: Cloth-Wrapped Mirror (part 3)
chunks.text:
Item: Cloth-Wrapped Mirror (first seen 2025-06-01, last seen 2026-07-26)
- (2025-11-02) Lucia used the mirror to scry on the Khan. It showed him meeting angrily with House Mazaali members in imperial dress, and fighting a woman from House Marvad in a single combat in the Colosseum at the Ludum Imperium. She backhanded him with great strength and then raised a dust whirlwind.
- (2025-11-02) Lucia noted she can only use the mirror for about a minute a day.
- (2026-05-17) Lucia used the mirror of the past on Rimescar and had been carrying and playing with it. The GM had her see Rimescar wounded and chased by Maulring dragon hunters, a Gargantuan silver dragon fighting a Gargantuan white dragon and Rimescar in the fjord while a white dragonborn drew an iron flask, and Rimescar meeting a huge yeti in caverns. She rolled 20 on history and 25 on insight.
- (2026-07-26) Lucia used the mirror on the ancient white dragon Icevein, who used to live on the Great White Mountain (Hvítfjall) in Norge. It showed four scenes: Icevein freezing the Fenrir's ship in ice and landing before Vigdis and the old rune master; a standoff with a frost giant wearing an icy crown; Icevein destroying seven of twelve giant-built ships with frost elementals; and Icevein instructing three young white dragons, one of them a young Rimescar.
- (2026-07-26) Lucia noted she would have to wait a day before mirroring the rune master.

chunks.title: Qul'drik Giant Coins and Diamonds
chunks.text:
Item: Qul'drik Giant Coins and Diamonds (first seen 2025-06-01, last seen 2025-07-27)
Also known as: giant coins, Qul'drik coins, giant gold and platinum coins
Type: coins and gems (loot)
Properties: Diamonds used as spell material for emergency resurrection.
Significance: Emergency fund from a hidden compartment of the ornate chest; minted with the ancient runes of Qul'drik, hard to spend
Holder: Eddie
- (2025-06-01) Raf and Monarch solved a sliding block puzzle (Investigation 26) in the chest's inlays to open a compartment holding stacks of giant-sized coins minted with Qul'drik runes.
- (2025-06-01) The count was 400 gold coins worth 10 gold each and 200 platinum coins worth 10 platinum each, plus diamonds of 100, 300, 500 and 1,000 gp.
- (2025-06-01) The party noted the coins could fund Revivify components but would be hard to turn into regular money.
- (2025-07-27) Portia gave Eddie the diamond she held in case it was needed, since most likely the use would be down at the bottom; Monarch noted the party had diamonds, and later said Eddie and Portia each held one.

chunks.title: Giant Chest Trap Canisters
chunks.text:
Item: Giant Chest Trap Canisters (first seen 2025-06-01, last seen 2025-06-01)
Also known as: four ceramic canisters, canisters
Type: trap mechanism (canisters)
Properties: Four hardened-ceramic canisters of a couple of gallons each, one under each hinge, with valves and dispersal fittings for a liquid or gas spray
Significance: Mechanical trap neutralized by Lucia; contents unknown; party wants to remove them safely
- (2025-06-01) Lucia tied off the four hinge wires with a Sleight of Hand check, so the canister valves did not open when the lid was lifted.

chunks.title: Giant's Library of Dragon Lore
chunks.text:
Item: Giant's Library of Dragon Lore (first seen 2025-06-15, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: library of books, the books, giant chest books
Type: collection of books, scrolls and stone tablets
Holder: Eddie
Properties: 40-50 volumes of mixed sizes and languages on Tiamat, Bahamut, Kyber, Siberys, Duoblex and Zoriat; only a couple fit in Lucia's bag of holding, the rest were loaded onto pack horses.
Significance: A major collection of lore on Tiamat and the dragon masks; the Cult of the Dragon would love it, so the party moved camp to keep it hidden.
- (2025-06-15) Lucia and Monarch picked two locks on the puzzle-box chest after Monarch solved the puzzle, with Lucia's Sleight of Hand rolls at 25 and 26. Inside was a well-preserved library of 40-50 books, scrolls and stone tablets.
- (2025-06-15) The topics include Tiamat, Kyber, Siberys, Bahamut, Duoblex and Zoriat; the party read Tiamat material during the long rest.
- (2025-06-15) The party took the library with them, loading five pack animals with books and crafting materials. Lucia's bag of holding holds only a couple of books.
- (2025-11-16) Portia wondered whether the ancient giant texts they found might interest a giant senator. Eddie noted they had left the books with the Khan; Monarch said she paid a hefty sum to have copies made and sent to Roma, which the GM said are coming but not yet scheduled. Monarch listed the library books as an offering for giants.

chunks.title: Giant Research Monograph on Zendrick
chunks.text:
Item: Giant Research Monograph on Zendrick (first seen 2025-06-15, last seen 2025-06-15)
Also known as: research book, history of Zendrick, Eberron book, doorstop book
Type: book
Holder: Sir Raf
Properties: Giant-language monograph with no index or table of contents, archaeological in tone, covering the history of Zendrick, a region or nation of ancient giants, and a place called Eberron; about three feet tall; has no magical content.
- (2025-06-15) It was found on the giant desk in the first room, open to a section on Eberron, and used to prop the door open.
- (2025-06-15) Raf judged it deliberately user-unfriendly, a show-off monograph with no index; it holds no spell or symbology information.

chunks.title: Giant Orrery and Resonant Spheres
chunks.text:
Item: Giant Orrery and Resonant Spheres (first seen 2025-06-15, last seen 2025-06-15)
Also known as: Orrery, three spheres, orbs
Type: magical orrery and combination-lock mechanism (fixture)
Significance: Its alignment and the three spheres were the combination to the warded puzzle-box chest.
- (2025-06-15) The Orrery models the sun, the planet, its moon, and the small planetoid Obsidius, whose roughly 90-year orbit passes between moon and planet in a double eclipse. When set to today's date, about 700 years after the setting at which it was found, the humming deepens to a subharmonic.
- (2025-06-15) Striking the three spheres with arrows in the right order (moon, Obsidius, planet) made a chord, and the red glow of the warding circles died; ringing a sphere out of alignment gave a thunder blast of 22 damage, halved for Portia's save.
- (2025-06-15) The party reset the Orrery to a different date, 500 to 650 years back, afterwards, which re-lit the circles.

chunks.title: Giants' Writing and Wizard Materials
chunks.text:
Item: Giants' Writing and Wizard Materials (first seen 2025-06-15, last seen 2025-06-15)
Also known as: giant inks and paper, giant crafting materials
Type: crafting materials
Properties: Giant-sized inks, papers, quills and spell components for scribing, plus a desk of materials for wondrous-item crafting, not suited to jewelry, armor or weapons.
- (2025-06-15) The first room's chest held layered inserts of inks, paper and components usable for scrolls or spellbook pages after trimming; the orrery room desk held wondrous-item materials, and the party hauled as much as it could.

chunks.title: Ring of Spell Storing
chunks.text:
Item: Ring of Spell Storing (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2026-09-20)
Also known as: ring of reactions
Type: magic ring
Holder: Sir Raf
Properties: Spells cast from it take their normal casting time; GM ruled it does not use a spell slot
Magic: Spell storing; contents as stated by Sir Raf
- (2025-07-13) Sir Raf activated a Shield stored in his Ring of Spell Storing to block the guardian's attack that would have hit.
- (2025-07-13) Sir Raf listed the ring's contents as two Shields, Absorb Elements and Feather Fall; the GM called it the ring of reactions.
- (2025-07-13) Monarch suggested reviewing which spells to take from the party, such as Misty Step, to put in the ring.
- (2025-07-27) Sir Raf suggested Monarch borrow the ring, which held Absorb Elements and Feather Fall, and noted it had two first-level slots or one second-level slot free.
- (2025-07-27) Monarch put Misty Step in the ring and planned two hours to attune to it and the ring of lightning resistance.
- (2025-07-27) Monarch said the ring was never re-attuned to Portia for the climb; Sir Raf cast his prepared Feather Fall instead, and the ring held only one Feather Fall.
- (2025-08-10) Monarch had stored Misty Step in it, which went unused.
- (2026-01-25) Portia cast Healing Word on Lucia for 8 while Lucia was unconscious in the water.
- (2026-02-22) Sir Raf checked his ring: two uses of shield, two of absorb elements and one of misty step. The GM ruled casting from it uses the spell's own casting time and no slot.

chunks.title: Ring of Spell Storing (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Ring of Spell Storing (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2026-09-20)
- (2026-06-14) Sir Raf expended two stored Shield spells from the ring against the living cold breaths.
- (2026-06-14) On the short rest, Raf used arcane recovery to put two shields back into the ring.
- (2026-09-20) Raf had expended all spells stored in his ring of spell storing, so he could un-attune it to free a slot for the Fenrir.

chunks.title: Rune Guardian Control Book
chunks.text:
Item: Rune Guardian Control Book (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2025-07-13)
Also known as: big book in Giant, oversized Giant book, manual of rune guardian control, runic formula book
Type: book (oversized, written in Giant)
Holder: Sir Raf
Properties: Introductory manual on runes and rune formulas with a bookmarked formula that links telepathically to rune guardians; the formula costs a third-level spell slot, takes an action, has 30 ft range, the guardian gets a saving throw, and on a failed save it is controlled for one hour (concentration). The creators' command phrases are not in the book. Eight hours of study teaches the basics of rune formulas.
Significance: Could allow the party to control or neutralize rune guardians like the one that attacked them; the cultists apparently used it to control the guardian as a lift.
- (2025-07-13) Lucia found an oversized book written in Giant on a cultist's body while searching it during combat.
- (2025-07-13) Lucia handed the book to Sir Raf, who read Giant; his Arcana check of 15 showed it is a book of rune magic with a bookmark at a spell-like sequence of runes.
- (2025-07-13) Sir Raf learned the formula controls rune guardians, costs a third-level slot, has a 30 ft range, and the guardian gets a save. The GM said translating the instructions from Giant to Common would take about two hours.
- (2025-07-13) Sir Raf has comprehend languages in his ritual book and could scribe a scroll of it for someone with third-level slots.

chunks.title: Rune Guardian Control Book (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Rune Guardian Control Book (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2025-07-13)
- (2025-07-13) The GM said it was the most valuable thing the cultists carried, and eight hours of study would teach the basics of rune formulas.

chunks.title: Crystal on the Tower of Runes' Last Stone
names: Crystal on the Tower of Runes' Last Stone
chunks.text:
Item: Crystal on the Tower of Runes' Last Stone (first seen 2025-07-13, last seen 2025-07-13)
Also known as: black crystal with adamant threads, crystal structure atop the spiral
Type: crystal structure on a floating stone
Properties: Black crystal threaded with adamant that appears to be runes; rests on the last stone of the spiral and stays attached even when the stone turns upside down.
Significance: Cracked rune-threaded crystal that may reveal the tower's purpose if studied with the book's knowledge; Sir Raf wanted it as a reference to find the center of the binding circle.
- (2025-07-13) During the long rest the party saw a cracked black crystal with adamant-like rune threads on the last stone of the Tower of Runes spiral.

chunks.title: Graven Lexus of Binding
chunks.text:
Item: Graven Lexus of Binding (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: Lexus, tablet, stone tablet, Lexus of binding, abjuration tablet, Graven Lexus
Type: stone tablet (rune library, 2 ft by 3 ft slab)
Holder: Sir Raf
Properties: +5 to Arcana checks to understand or manipulate the giant runes.
Significance: Gives the knowledge needed to alter the rune-based enchantment holding the Faceless Lord, in order to install Black Razor as the artifact power source and remove the Blue Dragon mask.
- (2025-07-27) A note fragment from a cultist's body said the Lexus was confirmed to be atop the Tower of Runes; the GM explained a lexus is a catalog of a language, valuable as a Rosetta Stone-like key.
- (2025-07-27) Inside the crystal at the tower's top was a three by two foot stone tablet with writing, suspended as if levitating.
- (2025-07-27) Monarch shrank through the crystal gap, returned to normal size, and slid the tablet into her bag of holding, where it dropped free of the levitation.
- (2025-07-27) On a short rest the party studied it: a graven Lexus focused on binding runes, one side giant runes and the other archaic elvish-like sigils, giving plus 5 to Arcana checks for those trained in Arcana; the GM added it to Monarch's sheet in her bag of holding.
- (2025-07-27) With the tablet the group judged it sharp enough with Arcana to alter the prison enchantment to accept a new power source in place of the Dragon Mask.

chunks.title: Graven Lexus of Binding (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Graven Lexus of Binding (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-08-24) A separate bronze tablet etched in giant runes was left at Sir Raf's feet by the defeated challenger; this appears to be a different object from the Graven Lexus of Binding.
- (2025-09-21) Monarch read out its description: a rune library on abjuration, +5 to Arcana checks on binding runes. Kyle clarified it came from the Tower of Runes.
- (2025-09-21) On closer study (Arcana check), the GM ruled it gives the party the knowledge to change the prison's rune enchantment and make the swap, installing Black Razor as the power source and removing the Blue Dragon mask.
- (2025-10-19) Raf reviewed the tablet to practice the chalice ritual before opening the portal.
- (2025-10-19) At the prison runes, the Lexus explained how to manipulate abjuration giant runes. Raf rolled 27 on Arcana (17/23, +d4 from Monarch's Bend Luck) to understand the process. It takes three simultaneous Arcana checks to open a gap for Black Razor, and three again to remove the mask: one to work the runes and two to hold the edges.
- (2025-11-02) The GM ruled the Lexus bonus can be handed back and forth but cannot be used by more than one person at the same time. Since the three Arcana checks were simultaneous, only one person could get the +5.
- (2025-11-02) The party gave the Lexus to Sir Raf, who strapped it to his forearm during the swap, because it raised his average roll the most.
- (2025-11-02) The party will take the tablet and the Chalice with them so nobody else can open the portal.

chunks.title: Flame Keeper Letter
chunks.text:
Item: Flame Keeper Letter (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-08-10)
Also known as: folded letter, sigil letter
Type: document (letter cut into pieces, reassembled)
Holder: Eddie
Properties: Written in Draconic, addressed to an esteemed flame keeper; says the Hall of Blades holds echoes of oaths tied to the mask's last bearer; with the right rites the swords will speak; the path to the blue dragon mask begins there.
Significance: Points to the Hall of Blades as the path to the blue dragon mask.
- (2025-07-27) Eddie found a symbol and a letter cut into a few pieces among the chopped-up cultist bodies; it was pieced together and read via a Comprehend Languages ritual from Sir Raf's spell book.
- (2025-07-27) The letter said the Hall of Blades guards the echoes of oaths tied to the mask's last bearer, the swords remember who took it and where they went, and the path to the blue dragon mask begins there.
- (2025-08-10) Note text recalled: the Hall of Blades guards echoes of oaths of the mask's last bearer, the thorn betrayer; signed in scale devotion, v.

chunks.title: Blood Iron and Adamantine Rapier
names: rapier from the Hall of Blades
chunks.text:
Item: Blood Iron and Adamantine Rapier (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2026-09-20)
Also known as: rapier from the Hall of Blades, the blade, rapier of wounding, rapier
Type: rapier (blood iron and adamantine alloy)
Holder: Eddie
Properties: Target must make a DC 15 Constitution save or be unable to regain hit points for an hour
Magic: Identified as a sword of wounding
Significance: Boon given to Eddie by a cloud giant spirit for a worthy truth in the Hall of Blades.
- (2025-07-27) After Eddie confessed the source of his scar from Tiamat's claw, the hall judged it worthy and offered a truth or a blade; Eddie chose a blade and picked the rapier.
- (2025-07-27) The rapier has some adamantine in an alloy of blood iron and adamantine; a cloud giant spirit handed it over, shrinking to human size along with the blade, and it carries substantial necrotic energy.
- (2025-07-27) Eddie thanked the spirit in Giant and bowed.
- (2025-08-10) Identified as a sword of wounding; Eddie planned to attune.
- (2025-08-10) Eddie held it out to the pedestal while asking; no answer.
- (2025-10-05) Eddie killed the Wyvern with a critical hit from his rapier for 33 total damage; the GM described it cutting through the scales to the heart.
- (2025-10-05) Eddie hit the Wyvern for 21 points (11 piercing, 5 necrotic, 5 sneak attack) with the rapier of wounding.
- (2025-10-05) Eddie used the rapier against the half blue and half white dragons, killing the half white dragon with a crit.

chunks.title: Blood Iron and Adamantine Rapier (part 2)
names: rapier from the Hall of Blades
chunks.text:
Item: Blood Iron and Adamantine Rapier (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2026-09-20)
- (2026-01-25) Eddie stabbed the jade-eyed woman with the rapier from the Hall of Blades, dealing 10 piercing and 11 necrotic damage; he called it a rapier of wounding.
- (2026-01-25) Eddie critically hit with it for 35 total damage including sneak attack.
- (2026-02-08) Eddie realized mid-fight that his rapier of wounding imposes a DC 15 Con save that stops hit point regain for an hour, with a repeat save at the end of each of the target's turns. He had not used it against the regenerating jade-eyed woman; the GM said he did not hit her many times with it and she kept making her saves.
- (2026-04-05) Eddie unequipped his rapier of wounding and put it in party inventory so he could attune to Shatterspike.
- (2026-04-19) Eddie attacked the second ice troll with the rapier of wounding with advantage, hitting with a 20 for 16 total damage, and the troll fell. Eddie said the target must save DC 15 Constitution or be unable to regain hit points for an hour.
- (2026-04-19) On the first troll, Eddie hit with the rapier for 6 piercing, 5 necrotic and 1 sneak attack (12 total) after an inspired reroll; the troll failed the Constitution save and stopped regenerating, and Kyle said the troll could not heal for the next hour.
- (2026-08-09) Eddie drew his rapier and extended it to Portia's rope pile so the spider could climb onto the blade; she cocooned herself on it with webs.

chunks.title: Blood Iron and Adamantine Rapier (part 3)
names: rapier from the Hall of Blades
chunks.text:
Item: Blood Iron and Adamantine Rapier (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2026-09-20)
- (2026-09-06) Eddie did not have his rapier of wounding with him when he attuned to the Guardian Emblem. Later in the fight he stabbed with a rapier in a sneak attack and missed.
- (2026-09-20) Eddie attacked the Goliath bearsark with his rapier and hit with a 19 for 5 piercing plus 2 sneak attack.

chunks.title: Black Razor
chunks.text:
Item: Black Razor (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: BlackRazor, Black Racer, black greatsword, Black Razr, Black-Flame blade
Type: legendary artifact greatsword
Holder: Nobody (installed in the Prison of the Faceless Lord's rune web)
Properties: Whispers to its wielder, can cast Haste, can try to charm a holder who acts against its purpose (Charisma save), eats souls per legend
Significance: Installed to replace the Blue Dragon Mask as the artifact powering the prison holding Jubilex, turning the prison into a warden with a will of its own
- (2025-08-10) Recognized by Raf, Eddie and Portia as Black Razor, a soul-eating greatsword thought entombed in a mountain stronghold; Monarch's Investigation noted it was incomplete and broken.
- (2025-08-10) The fire giant spirit keeper reforged the two halves (Chimeg's blade and its own) into a whole black blade with necrotic runes; its blade whispered Haste.
- (2025-08-10) After the keeper was defeated by Raf, the sword lay on the floor. Chimeg picked it up and shouted stand down, which stopped the swords, then dropped it after a natural 20 on her save; she does not want it.
- (2025-08-10) Monarch picked it up wrapped in a stone camouflage blanket; it said 'now we will slay'. Her Charisma save of 13 failed, but Raf's Protection from Good and Evil prevented the charm and she stowed it in her bag of holding.
- (2025-08-10) Monarch must hold it to attune or identify it; its full properties are unknown.

chunks.title: Black Razor (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Black Razor (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-08-10) Black Razor has a powerful will of its own and a history of taking control of those who wield it. The GM said the power the dragon mask gives the prison would need to be replaced by something of equal power, which it could match.
- (2025-08-10) The smith who made Chimeg's blade made it from the remains of a blade found on a previous expedition.
- (2025-09-21) Sir Raf noted the Black Razor greatsword was stuck in the shared inventory; Monarch had just moved it there.
- (2025-09-21) The GM said the Graven Lexus lets the party install Black Razor as the artifact power source and remove the Blue Dragon mask.
- (2025-10-05) Monarch joked that bringing back the horses might mean she gets to keep Black Razor.
- (2025-10-19) During the short rest Monarch took Black Razor out of the Bag of Holding and examined it; necrotic energy curled toward her, subsided as she began to attune, then slapped her for 6 necrotic damage when she put it away. She stayed conscious and it tumbled back into the bag.
- (2025-10-19) The Graven Lexus gave enough understanding to open a hole in the rune web for Black Razor (or another artifact), and only then remove the blue dragon mask; removing the mask first would make the prison burst. Augury said swapping Black Razor for the mask was 'wheel' (good), adding Black Razor and leaving the mask 'wheel then woe', and leaving Black Razor but taking the mask was also read as good.

chunks.title: Black Razor (part 3)
chunks.text:
Item: Black Razor (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-10-19) Plan: whoever handles Black Razor gets Protection from Evil and Good, cast by Raf; the party stopped the session before executing it.
- (2025-11-02) Monarch kept Black Razor in her Bag of Holding. Sir Raf, under Protection from Evil and Good, drew it out and carried it to the center of the rune web.
- (2025-11-02) Before the work began, a gold dragon spirit warned that the swap would make the unthinking prison into a warden with a will of its own, stronger but not passive.
- (2025-11-02) After an arcana check sequence, Raf installed Black Razor into the rune web. The glow turned to darkness, an inky binding web pressed the chaos back into the pit, and the party felt a sudden hunger.
- (2025-11-02) Because the web was holding, the group ended up with Black Razor installed and the blue dragon mask removed. Black Razor now sits in the prison and is no longer carried by the party.

chunks.title: Shatterspike
chunks.text:
Item: Shatterspike (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2026-10-04)
Also known as: shatter spike
Type: plus one adamantine longsword
Holder: Sir Raf
Properties: Automatically crits objects; has a sap effect
Magic: Requires attunement (Sir Raf stated)
- (2025-08-10) Taken from the Hall of Blades and identified as Shatterspike.
- (2025-08-10) Eddie held it, then moved it to Raf's inventory; Raf unattuned from his Bracers of Archery.
- (2025-08-24) Sir Raf switched to Shatterspike and hit the black pudding with Booming Blade for 14 slashing plus 6 thunder; the slashing split the pudding.
- (2025-08-24) Sir Raf used Shatterspike's sap effect against the pudding and the challenger to give them disadvantage on their next attack.
- (2025-08-24) Sir Raf shattered the stone-carved arcane-locked door after Eddie's Dispel Magic removed the glyph, bludgeoning it for 19 points, then more hits with Booming Blade until it broke.
- (2025-08-24) Sir Raf smashed the stuck door at the top of the stairs to the Chamber of Trials with Shatterspike.
- (2025-08-24) Sir Raf used Shatterspike against the challenger giant, hitting for 13 slashing plus 8 thunder, then 13 slashing and 4 thunder, then 11 slashing.
- (2026-02-08) Sir Raf drew Shatterspike and put away his rapier as the party prepared to break through the barred door.
- (2026-02-22) Sir Raf said he would set Shatterspike aside, unattuned, to free a slot for boots, and re-attune on a short rest when needed.

chunks.title: Shatterspike (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Shatterspike (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2026-10-04)
- (2026-04-05) Sir Raf offered to loan Shatterspike to the swimming team for sabotaging the Norge ship; he moved it to party inventory and Eddie attuned to it, putting away his rapier of wounding.
- (2026-04-19) Eddie moved Shatterspike back to party inventory so Sir Raf could attune to it.
- (2026-04-19) Sir Raf asked for an hour of attunement to Shatterspike on seeing the frozen falls, since it might be needed. He normally prefers his rapier and attunes to Shatterspike when objects need dealing with, and he forgot to attune at the long rest.
- (2026-04-19) Sir Raf cast booming blade and attacked an ice troll with Shatterspike with advantage, rolling 15, which missed.
- (2026-05-17) Sir Raf attuned to Shatterspike before the fight with the second ice troll and attacked with it instead of his usual rapier, hitting AC 17 for 8 slashing and 5 thunder.
- (2026-06-14) Sir Raf used Shatterspike to chop through the ice wall to the hoard, noting that a hit on an object is an automatic critical hit and he chose bludgeoning. Monarch cast enlarge on him, and it took 150 hit points of damage (about 20 per hit).
- (2026-06-14) Raf also attacked the living cold breaths with Shatterspike, including 12 damage on one hit and with booming blade.
- (2026-09-20) Raf hit the Goliath bearsark with Shatterspike using Booming Blade: 15 slashing and 6 thunder, 21 total, leaving it injured but not out.

chunks.title: Shatterspike (part 3)
chunks.text:
Item: Shatterspike (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2026-10-04)
- (2026-10-04) Raf gave up his Shatterspike attunement slot to attune to the air rune stone, then re-attuned to Shatterspike during the second hour.

chunks.title: Slumbering Blue Dragon's Wrath Scimitar
chunks.text:
Item: Slumbering Blue Dragon's Wrath Scimitar (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2026-01-25)
Also known as: dragon's wrath scimitar, blue dragon scimitar, blue dragon's rat scimitar
Type: scimitar
Holder: Portia
Properties: On a natural 20, creatures of choice within 5 feet of the target take 5 lightning damage in a burst of blue dragon breath
Magic: Requires attunement
- (2025-08-10) Portia picked up the scimitar, decorated with blue dragon heads and claws.
- (2025-11-02) Portia joked that the blue dragon mask would not go well with her blue dragon scimitar.
- (2026-01-25) Portia attacked the doppelganger with the blue dragon scimitar, hitting with about a 15 for 6 slashing damage, then attacked with her dagger for 3 piercing.

chunks.title: Plus One Greatsword (Hall of Blades)
chunks.text:
Item: Plus One Greatsword (Hall of Blades) (first seen 2025-08-10, last seen 2025-08-10)
Also known as: plus one greatsword
Type: plus one greatsword
Magic: Identified as plus one
- (2025-08-10) One of three swords left by defeated flying swords; identified as a plus one greatsword.

chunks.title: Bronze Challenger's Tablet
names: bronze tablet etched in giant runes
chunks.text:
Item: Bronze Challenger's Tablet (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: bronze tablet etched in giant runes, bronze tablet, brass tablet
Type: bronze tablet etched in giant runes
Holder: Sir Raf
Significance: Gives the proper form for raising the chalice of accord to pass the Gate of Dragons.
Properties: Details the chalice of accord ritual, a gesture of welcome and humility before dragons made through an offering in the chalice; the liquid does not matter, but a more valuable, important or unique liquid is better received, and plain water would work.
- (2025-08-24) After Sir Raf's final blow, the challenger knelt, pulled a bronze tablet etched in giant runes from his tunic, laid it at the party's feet and vanished; Sir Raf said he would pick it up and look at it.
- (2025-09-21) Sir Raf and Eddie examined the bronze tablet with an Investigation check; the GM revealed it describes the chalice of accord ritual, a gesture of welcome and humility before dragons.
- (2025-09-21) The ritual offering can be completed with plain water, but a more valuable or unique liquid gets better results. Sir Raf judged the problem solved.

chunks.title: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
chunks.text:
Item: Gauntlets of Ogre Power (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-08-24)
Also known as: gauntlets
Type: magic gauntlets
Holder: Sir Raf
Properties: Boost Sir Raf's strength for forcing stuck doors
- (2025-08-24) Sir Raf said he picked up gauntlets of ogre power and would use them to try to wedge or force the hidden door; Monarch later suggested he use them on a stuck door.

chunks.title: Bag of Holding
chunks.text:
Item: Bag of Holding (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2026-09-20)
Type: magic bag
Holder: Lucia
- (2025-08-24) Monarch suggested using the bag of holding on the giant kitchen casks, but Eddie said the casks were too big for it.
- (2025-09-21) Lucia joked about dismantling the Rune Guardian and hiding it in bags of holding.
- (2025-10-19) Monarch stored Black Razor in the Bag of Holding; the party joked about carrying the corpse or crossing the chasm inside it.
- (2025-11-02) Monarch drew Black Razor out of her bag of holding for Sir Raf, and the blue dragon mask went back in after it was removed.
- (2025-11-02) The party said the mask is safe in the bag because it sits on another plane. They also said they have more than one bag of holding and could move the mask between them.
- (2025-11-16) Portia said she has a bag of holding and can stash her gear and Wild Shape items in it for the spider infiltration.
- (2026-01-11) Lucia put the captain's tribute chest into her Bag of Holding because she lacks the strength to carry it.
- (2026-01-11) The GM stated the coin chest weighs 45 pounds and holds a thousand gold coins.
- (2026-02-08) Lucia joked that Eddie should have jumped into her Bag of Holding to escape the jade-eyed woman.
- (2026-04-05) Eddie tucked his shield into a bag of holding before the swim.
- (2026-05-17) Monarch suggested cutting out the ice troll hearts and sticking them in a bag of holding.
- (2026-06-14) The party stuffed treasure from Rimescar's hoard into bags of holding, so only the flask was in hand when Lunae returned.

chunks.title: Bag of Holding (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Bag of Holding (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2026-09-20)
- (2026-07-26) Monarch asked whether Rimescar's skull would fit in a bag of holding so it could be planted on the Fenrir's. Lucia joked that the Fenrir's might fall into her bag; Kyle said a 120-foot ship would not fit through a one-foot opening.
- (2026-09-06) Before the heist, Monarch moved everything she was not bringing into her bag of holding and left it behind. Eddie also left his bag of holding, with a lot in it, with Raf.
- (2026-09-20) Lucia noted she carries things in her bag of holding. It was ruled too small (two feet square, four deep) for Raf to fit; Raf also has a bag of holding.

chunks.title: Chalice of Accord
chunks.text:
Item: Chalice of Accord (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: crystal chalice, gray crystal chalice, gemstone chalice
Type: giant-sized crystal chalice
Holder: Monarch
Properties: Carved from a single gemstone, weighs about as much as a chest of gold; its base carries silhouettes of the five metallic dragons.
Significance: One of the items needed to open the Gate of Dragons portal
- (2025-09-21) Monarch's clairvoyance showed an enormous crystal chalice in a cubby behind the secret door.
- (2025-09-21) Once the feast was laid out matching the mosaic, the stone panel slid aside and revealed the chalice; Sir Raf grabbed it before the ghostly vision played.
- (2025-09-21) The base carries silhouettes of silver, gold, copper, bronze and brass dragons.
- (2025-10-19) Monarch performed the ritual at the portal with the chalice (Performance 22 with Tides of Chaos advantage and Guidance d4). Giant wasp mead offered in it boiled into honey-scented steam that split into six tendrils into the dragon heads, and the portal opened into a 20-foot-wide tunnel. The chalice is a small object about a yard tall.
- (2025-11-02) The GM said the crystal chalice plus a ritual learned from the ancient tablet are needed to pass the portal, and the ritual requires honest, respectful intent toward the dragons.
- (2025-11-02) Monarch suggested the chalice and the instructions not be kept in the same bag of holding. Eddie suggested leaving the chalice with the khan, but Lucia said it was theirs to guard, and the party kept it.

chunks.title: Chalice of Accord (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Chalice of Accord (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2025-11-16)
- (2025-11-16) Monarch raised the chalice, with Eddie agreeing, as a possible offering to giant senators, but only the chalice and not the ritual instructions.

chunks.title: Potions of Fire Breath
chunks.text:
Item: Potions of Fire Breath (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: fire breath draughts
Type: potions
Holder: party inventory
Properties: Each potion gives three charges of fire breath, a stream targeted on one creature. Mixed with the greater healing formulation it turns into poison.
Significance: Salvaged from the Giant Brewery left-hand barrel; the party discussed drinking them against the cultists.
- (2025-09-21) Eddie jury-rigged a squeeze-bulb siphon and recovered all six remaining draughts of fire breath from the left-hand barrel, bottling them individually.
- (2025-09-21) Monarch put all six in the party inventory.
- (2025-09-21) The GM ruled that drinking this fire breath together with one of these greater healing potions turns into poison.

chunks.title: Potions of Greater Healing
chunks.text:
Item: Potions of Greater Healing (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2026-09-06)
Also known as: greater healing potions
Type: potions
Holder: Monarch
Properties: Heals 4d4+4 per the GM's 44 variety; this formulation combined with fire breath makes poison.
Significance: Salvaged from the Giant Brewery healing barrel.
- (2025-09-21) Eddie recovered six greater healing potions from the healing barrel, cleaning the barrel carefully to avoid mixing with fire breath.
- (2025-10-19) The party inventory holds six greater healing potions; Monarch moved one onto her sheet.
- (2026-02-22) The party holds five greater healing potions in party inventory; Monarch warned they make poison if mixed with fire breath potions.
- (2026-09-06) Monarch drank a greater healing potion as a bonus action after standing up, healing 13 hit points.

chunks.title: Giant Wasp Mead and Hall of Feasts Drinks
names: Giant Wasp Mead and Hall of Feasts Drinks
chunks.text:
Item: Giant Wasp Mead and Hall of Feasts Drinks (first seen 2025-09-21, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: strong mead, giant wasp mead, giant wasp wine
Type: drink (mead and wine)
Holder: Portia
Significance: Taken from the Hall of Feasts kitchen barrels: three meads, an ale and two wines.
- (2025-09-21) The kitchen barrels held three meads, an ale, and two wines (a rich red and a bright sparkling).
- (2025-09-21) Eddie identified one honey note as rare giant wasp honey mead and filled a waterskin; he later took bottles of a stronger mead.
- (2025-10-19) Giant wasp mead was used as the offering in the Chalice of Accord ritual.
- (2025-11-16) Eddie suggested the giant wasp wine they brought back as a way to get in to talk to the gourmand hill giant senator Rogrun.
- (2025-11-16) At Senator Rogrun's feast hall, Portia stood up an empty goblet and poured out a toast of the wine from a water skin; Rogrun gave advantage on the persuasion check, let each party member sip first, then drank it all.
- (2025-11-30) Monarch listed the contracts delivered to Senators Rogrun and Borluss (the stone giant).

chunks.title: Dreamcaster's Obsidian Coins
chunks.text:
Item: Dreamcaster's Obsidian Coins (first seen 2025-10-19, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: obsidian coins, favor coins
Type: coins (three obsidian discs)
Holder: Portia
Properties: Three identical hand-carved obsidian discs with a five-headed dragon on each side; possibly markers of favors owed by the Cult of the Dragon
Significance: Possession indicates dealings with the cult, which owes the bearer a favor
- (2025-10-19) Found in a hidden inner belt pouch on the Dreamcaster: three obsidian coins, not cast, with five-headed dragons on both sides.
- (2025-10-19) Portia made a rubbing of the coins. Raf rolled History 16 and recognized the Tiamat image and that the Cult of the Dragon trades in favors, so the coins may be markers of favors owed. Monarch's Investigation was inconclusive but the coins were truly identical, so expertly tooled or magically made.

chunks.title: Dreamcaster's Trade Gems and Coin
chunks.text:
Item: Dreamcaster's Trade Gems and Coin (first seen 2025-10-19, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: Dreamcaster's loot, bribery pouch gems
Type: loot (gems and coins)
Holder: Portia
Properties: 14 trade gems of 500 gp caliber, plus 26 platinum, 15 gold and 38 silver
- (2025-10-19) The Dreamcaster's pouch held 14 gems worth about 500 gp each, plus 26 platinum, 15 gold and 38 silver; Portia took the loot but left his robes.

chunks.title: Dreamcaster's Pouch of Sand
chunks.text:
Item: Dreamcaster's Pouch of Sand (first seen 2025-10-19, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: pouch of sand, sleep sand
Type: magic pouch
Holder: Portia
Magic: enchantment (detect magic)
Significance: Possibly sleep sand; unopened, may carry a magical trap or curse
- (2025-10-19) Portia found the pouch of sand on the Dreamcaster's belt and declined to open it as possibly trapped. Lucia found it not physically rigged; detect magic showed enchantment. Monarch guessed sleep sand.

chunks.title: Rogrun's Conditional Promise Contract
chunks.text:
Item: Rogrun's Conditional Promise Contract (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: promise on paper
Type: document (contract)
Holder: Rogrun
Properties: Monarch wrote it with a calligraphy kit, in Giant (with Eddie's help) and Common; it promises a monthly meal of foods unique to the Groves of Belenus, for Senator Rogrun's exclusive consumption, only if he votes against the annexation.
Significance: Secures Rogrun's likely no vote while letting him claim he promised nothing.
- (2025-11-16) Rogrun demanded a promise on paper; Monarch wrote a conditional contract and the deal was toasted.
- (2025-11-16) The paper only promises the monthly tribute if Rogrun votes against, and does not commit him to vote.
- (2025-11-30) Monarch told the Green Apothecary the party had delivered contracts to Senators Rogrun and Borluss with minor concessions to win no votes.

chunks.title: Signed Henge Restoration Agreement
chunks.text:
Item: Signed Henge Restoration Agreement (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: Stone giant contract
Type: document (contract)
Holder: Portia
Properties: Written by Monarch in Giant and Common; Portia signed for the druids; Senator Lapis signed it in silence. It lets him supervise restoring the Great Henge if he votes against annexing the Groves.
Significance: Secures Senator Lapis's vote against the annexation measure.
- (2025-11-16) Monarch wrote the agreement in both Giant and Common, had Portia sign for the druids, and Senator Lapis signed with a quill from a stone writing desk.
- (2025-11-16) Monarch handed the contract to Portia after it was signed.

chunks.title: Simona's Letter of Introduction
chunks.text:
Item: Simona's Letter of Introduction (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: papers, paper
Type: document
Holder: Portia
Properties: Written by Simona Querid Ventre; it gets the party an audience with senators and carries her known sponsorship of the Green Apothecary.
- (2025-11-16) The GM said Simona can write a letter of introduction to get the party in front of any senator.
- (2025-11-16) Portia presented the papers at the ogres' entrance to Rogrun's palace and to the rock sentinel at the stone giant's palace; they became grease-stained after Rogrun handled them.

chunks.title: Druids' Binding Oaths
chunks.text:
Item: Druids' Binding Oaths (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: binding oath, oaths, the oath scroll
Type: document (magically binding oaths)
Holder: Portia
Properties: Binding oaths backed by magic: restrict teleport access to the Groves to guarded areas with comings and goings tracked; an open exchange area for city visitors; monthly reports to the consul's office of wild or druidic magic above the third rank (fourth-level or higher spells). They stay in force only while the Groves are not annexed, and lapse if annexed. A separate service oath offered to Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu: druids open plant doors to Norge for her spies in exchange for the Groves' continued independence.
Significance: Used to flip Senate votes against the Groves annexation bill: the frost giant senator Vaelthira, the fire giant senator Kaldrina, and Senator Octavia Calvad all agreed to vote against or switch.
- (2025-11-30) The Green Apothecary druids proposed binding oaths with magic behind them, restricted teleport access, an open exchange area, and monthly reporting of fourth-level-or-higher wild or druidic magic to the consul's office, so that oversight replaces control.
- (2025-11-30) The oaths were made conditional: binding only until and unless the Groves are annexed, at which point all restrictions are lifted.
- (2025-11-30) The druids declined to spy themselves but offered to open plant-to-plant doors into Norge for Vaelthira's agents in exchange for guaranteed independence; they would prepare a binding oath for it.

chunks.title: Druids' Binding Oaths (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Druids' Binding Oaths (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
- (2025-11-30) Portia presented the oath to the frost giant senator Vaelthira; after a persuasion check made with advantage from Eddie's Enhance Ability, she agreed to vote against annexation and said her agents would come three days after the vote.
- (2025-11-30) The fire giant senator Kaldrina checked the oath scroll through a gem, found it honest, and agreed to vote against annexation. She asked only that the Groves obey Roman law on incoming teleports, and said her people would visit the Groves from time to time.
- (2025-11-30) Portia's persuasion with Senator Octavia Calvad succeeded and Octavia switched her vote. Portia's persuasion with Senator Valeria Calvus also succeeded, and Valeria flipped her vote to spite Magnus.

chunks.title: Valeria's Handwritten To-Do Note
chunks.text:
Item: Valeria's Handwritten To-Do Note (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: note: Magnus to pull petition
Type: document (handwritten note)
Significance: Showed that Senator Valeria Calvus had completed her task of getting Magnus to pull the imperial war petition.
- (2025-11-30) Monarch, disguised as Senator Valeria Calvus's halfling assistant, rolled investigation and saw a handwritten note on her desk reading 'Magnus to pull petition', crossed through as completed.

chunks.title: Senator Valeria Calvus's Missives
chunks.text:
Item: Senator Valeria Calvus's Missives (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: sealed missives, letters for two senators
Type: documents (sealed letters)
Holder: Monarch
Significance: Concerned upcoming votes, not the Groves bill; they could not go by courier and had to reach two other senators that afternoon.
- (2025-11-30) Senator Valeria Calvus gave Monarch unopened missives about votes happening very soon, to be delivered that afternoon to two senators the party does not yet know. Monarch said she would deliver them and left the option of getting devious.
- (2025-11-30) Monarch left to deliver the letters.

chunks.title: Mariner's Armor
chunks.text:
Item: Mariner's Armor (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-09-20)
Also known as: mariner's breastplate, mariner's leather armor
Type: magic armor (uncommon)
Holder: Sir Raf
Properties: Gives a swim speed
Significance: Bought in Roma ahead of the sea trip to Emperor's Bay
- (2025-12-14) Lucia asked about finding mariner's leather armor in Roma, and Sir Raf said he would look for a mariner's breastplate since he has no plus magic armor. The price was base armor cost plus the magic item price.
- (2025-12-14) The GM settled the table's magic item prices: common 100, uncommon 400, rare 4,000, very rare 40,000, legendary 200,000. The GM noted a wartime economy might add inflation.
- (2026-01-11) After being blasted into the sea by the bronze dragon's roar, Sir Raf said he was in no danger of drowning because of his mariner's armor, which gives a swim speed equal to his speed.
- (2026-01-11) Sir Raf later swam down after the dragon, moving at his armor-granted swim speed.
- (2026-01-25) Sir Raf noted his mariner's armor gives him a swim speed, so he is not slowed by the knee-deep cave water; the GM confirmed a swim speed means no slowing.
- (2026-01-25) Not held at the end of the session: "Oh, right. I don't have ring of swimming, but I do have mariner's armor, which I think gives me a swim speed. Yep...." (Sir Raf)
- (2026-02-08) Sir Raf used the swim speed from his mariner's breastplate to move through the hip-deep cave water; Portia and Lucia have rings of swimming instead.

chunks.title: Mariner's Armor (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Mariner's Armor (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-09-20)
- (2026-07-26) Sir Raf's mariner's breastplate gives him a swim speed, which the party counted on for swimming to the Fenrir's.
- (2026-08-09) Sir Raf used the swim speed from his mariner's armor (30 ft) to swim through the cold water toward the Cherek camp; his stealth was not hindered by the breastplate.
- (2026-09-20) Raf's mariner's breastplate gave him the swim speed he used to reach the Fenrir.

chunks.title: Cold Weather Gear
chunks.text:
Item: Cold Weather Gear (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-04-19)
Also known as: winter clothing, parka, cold weather clothing
Type: clothing
Holder: Monarch
Properties: Winter clothing from the Player's Handbook, 10 gold; protects against the cold of White Crown
Significance: The party needed it for the unnaturally cold coast of the Sea of Storms
- (2025-12-14) The Roma house transport wizard told the party to wear more layers and offered a rack of weather gear at market rate (10 gold).
- (2025-12-14) Sir Raf, Eddie and Portia already had cold weather gear. Monarch put on a borrowed coat about 18 sizes too big and cut wing holes in it, so she cannot return it. Monarch's own dinner clothes and gear were in her saddlebags.
- (2026-04-19) Kyle ruled that extreme cold near the white dragon's lair requires cold resistance or immunity, or an hourly Constitution save against exhaustion; cold weather gear means a creature is not exposed. Monarch has only clothing and tucks her wings under it while not flying.

chunks.title: Tribute Chest of Gold
chunks.text:
Item: Tribute Chest of Gold (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: box of gold, coin box, tribute box, the box, chest of coins
Type: chest of coins
Holder: Captain Orso
Properties: Weighs 45 pounds; holds a thousand gold coins
Significance: Bribe meant for the bronze dragon; entrusted to Captain Orso by the party's employer
- (2026-01-11) Captain Orso had the box brought up on deck as an offering for the dragon; a sailor handed it to her.
- (2026-01-11) Monarch cast major image of the tribute box on the deck so the dragon could see treasure.
- (2026-01-11) The dragon was not placated by the gold and kept roaring 'be gone'.
- (2026-01-11) After the fight, the captain ordered the chest brought below, but the party argued they still needed it to bargain; Monarch's persuasion check succeeded and the captain reluctantly handed it over. Monarch passed it to Lucia, who put it in the Bag of Holding.
- (2026-02-22) The chest was never used on the dragon, which was not in a bribable mood. The party agreed to return it to Captain Orso and tell their employer they did so.
- (2026-02-22) Monarch floated an illusion-swap of the chest with major image, but the party did not do it.

chunks.title: Silvered Barbed Spear
chunks.text:
Item: Silvered Barbed Spear (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-01-11)
Also known as: silver tipped spear, silver spear
Type: silvered spear
Properties: Silvered weapon with a spear as the base type; barbed tip suited to fishing; no combat change
Significance: Found in the Najik Monastery lower-level storeroom; offered to anyone without a silver weapon
- (2026-01-11) A silver-tipped spear stood in the storeroom's northeast corner with oars and fishing poles; the GM said its head is carefully plated with silver, it is not displayed in a place of honor, and it is barbed for catching fish.
- (2026-01-11) Portia and Monarch suggested anyone lacking a silver weapon carry it; no one is shown taking it.

chunks.title: Najik Monastery Dungeon Cell Key
chunks.text:
Item: Najik Monastery Dungeon Cell Key (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-01-11)
Also known as: key to the cell, cell key
Type: key
Significance: Opens the monastery's single locking cell, which could hold Ronnom Kenegal and his bodyguards
- (2026-01-11) The monastery's hierarch offered Sir Raf the key to the downstairs cell, a bedroom reinforced with a lock, for imprisoning Ronnom Kenegal.
- (2026-01-11) The GM said the cell is meant as a bedroom for one but all four could physically fit; the door locks from the outside.

chunks.title: Debbie's Sending Stone
chunks.text:
Item: Debbie's Sending Stone (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-01-11)
Also known as: sending stone, stone
Type: sending stone
Holder: Debbie Talzar
Properties: Paired stone; touching it casts sending to the bearer of the other stone; once per day regardless of which stone is used; no spell use consumed if nobody holds the other stone
Significance: Used to verify the party's identity
- (2026-01-11) Debbie pulled a stone from her pocket and used it to ask whether the party had been sent and could be trusted, naming Monarch, Lucia, Portia, Raf and Eddie.
- (2026-01-11) The GM explained that the sending stone is how Mirel Kellenor knew Debbie was alive, working once a day.

chunks.title: Quill and Paper
chunks.text:
Item: Quill and Paper (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Type: writing supplies
Holder: Monarch
Significance: Used to write farewell letter to her family
- (2026-01-25) As Mona (Monarch's vignette self) she wrote a farewell letter, sealed it with wax, and gave it to Olifin to deliver to her family.

chunks.title: Ink Vial and Water Skin
chunks.text:
Item: Ink Vial and Water Skin (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Also known as: inkwell
Type: sample container
Holder: Lord Ballyhooligan
- (2026-01-25) Monarch emptied and washed her ink vial with her water skin and handed it over to collect blight samples; Lord Ballyhooligan was to hold it.

chunks.title: Pearls (Trade Gems)
chunks.text:
Item: Pearls (Trade Gems) (first seen 2026-02-08, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: pearls
Type: trade gems
Significance: Loot from the jade-eyed woman's room
- (2026-02-08) A satchel in the dresser held standard-sized pearls used as trade gems, worth 100 each; Monarch added them to the inventory.

chunks.title: Glassblowing Tools and Empty Vials
chunks.text:
Item: Glassblowing Tools and Empty Vials (first seen 2026-02-08, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: glass blower tools, vials
Type: crafting tools and containers
Properties: Small-scale glassblowing tools for making vials; four empty vials had residue
Significance: Residue was a weak ingestible poison that could kill falcons
- (2026-02-08) A satchel in the dresser held glassblowing tools and four empty vials with residue.
- (2026-02-08) After the long rest Monarch investigated the vials and rolled a natural 20; the GM said they held a weak poison, drunk or eaten rather than injected, made from simple ingredients available on the island. A vial could kill a falcon, and about a pint would be needed to kill a person.

chunks.title: Empty Velvet-Lined Jewelry Box
chunks.text:
Item: Empty Velvet-Lined Jewelry Box (first seen 2026-02-08, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: empty box
Type: box
Significance: Something circular was taken from it
- (2026-02-08) The dresser held an empty box with a velvet pad. Its contents were taken, probably a necklace or small tiara-like circle.

chunks.title: Jade-Eyed Woman's Clothing
chunks.text:
Item: Jade-Eyed Woman's Clothing (first seen 2026-02-08, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: Veen's clothes
Type: clothing
Holder: Lucia
Significance: Possible disguise
- (2026-02-08) Lucia said she would take a set of the jade-eyed woman's clothing in case the party needs to disguise itself as her or her group.

chunks.title: Three-Dragon Ante Cards
chunks.text:
Item: Three-Dragon Ante Cards (first seen 2026-02-08, last seen 2026-02-08)
Also known as: card game
Type: card game
- (2026-02-08) The doppelgangers' room held only the three-dragon ante cards they had been playing; Sir Raf said to grab them and the party added them to the inventory.

chunks.title: Ring of Warmth
chunks.text:
Item: Ring of Warmth (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-08-09)
Also known as: rings of warmth
Type: uncommon magic ring
Properties: Protects against cold damage
Significance: Bought in Roma for the cold north; 400 gp each
Holder: Eddie
- (2026-02-22) Party members priced rings of warmth at 400 gp, and Lucia said she would buy one. Monarch declined one for lack of attunement slots; Sir Raf chose boots instead.
- (2026-04-05) Lucia had a ring of warmth in her bag and then used it for the swim; Portia, who lacked one, wild shaped into a shark instead.
- (2026-04-19) Lucia holds the ring of warmth and was absent this session, so it was not available. Eddie noted a ring of warmth requires attunement.
- (2026-05-17) The GM said rings of warmth give cold resistance, useful against the white dragon's breath. Portia has a ring of reaction instead of one.
- (2026-07-26) The party used rings of warmth and magic to cross the cold river south of Drakholm without harm.
- (2026-08-09) Kyle said the swimmers' cold protection was things like rings of warmth; Eddie agreed and swam the freezing water protected.

chunks.title: Boots of the Winter Lands
chunks.text:
Item: Boots of the Winter Lands (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: Boots of the Winterlands, boots of the winter land
Type: magic boots
Holder: Eddie
Properties: Protect against cold weather
Magic: Requires attunement
- (2026-02-22) Eddie bought them for 400 gp. They can't be worn with boots of elvenkind.
- (2026-04-05) Eddie read the boots' text and relied on them (not a ring of warmth) as cold protection for the swim in the frigid fjord.
- (2026-04-19) On the ice floor of the troll hallway, Sir Raf named his Boots of the Winter Lands as what made the ice no problem; he read out that Winter Strider ignores difficult terrain from ice or snow.
- (2026-05-17) The GM noted that rings of warmth and Sir Raf's boots give cold resistance, which helps against the white dragon's cold breath.
- (2026-06-14) Eddie crossed the melted ice using boots that ignore difficult terrain from ice or snow; Raf also uses boots to walk around the melted area.
- (2026-08-09) Sir Raf said his Boots of the Winter Lands give the same cold protection as rings of warmth, so he could swim in the frigid water.
- (2026-09-20) Raf wore the Boots of the Winter Lands to survive swimming in the freezing fjord to the Fenrir, and noted they give him cold resistance against the frost breath.
- (2026-10-18) In the unnatural Norge-like freezing storm, Eddie said he was glad he got his boots, the Boots of the Winter Lands.

chunks.title: Rope of Climbing
chunks.text:
Item: Rope of Climbing (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-04-19)
Type: uncommon wondrous item
Holder: Sir Raf
Properties: Holds 3,000 lb; animates on command; gives advantage on climb checks with it
Significance: Bought for the mountain crossing toward Dragonfjord, 400 gp
- (2026-02-22) Eddie bought one rope of climbing, and Sir Raf bought a second for extra length.
- (2026-04-19) Sir Raf said he has a rope of climbing, which he could send snaking ahead to secure itself, plus 50 feet of silk rope. Eddie offered to climb ahead and lower a rope.

chunks.title: Climber's Kits
chunks.text:
Item: Climber's Kits (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-04-19)
Also known as: climber's kit
Type: adventuring gear
Properties: Anchor yourself so you can't fall more than 25 feet; 25 gp
Holder: Sir Raf
- (2026-02-22) Eddie and Portia bought climber's kits. Sir Raf already owned one.
- (2026-04-19) Sir Raf said he has a climber's kit; Eddie also has a climbing kit with some rope.

chunks.title: Scrolls of Misty Step
chunks.text:
Item: Scrolls of Misty Step (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-09-06)
Type: spell scrolls
Holder: Monarch
- (2026-02-22) Monarch bought two scrolls of Misty Step.
- (2026-06-14) Monarch took a scroll of misty step from her pack and used it as a bonus action during the Rimescar fight.
- (2026-09-06) Monarch considered using a scroll of misty step to get within range of Goliath C. Kyle noted that using a scroll is a use-item action, not a cast; she decided against it and stayed in place.

chunks.title: Writs of Passage
chunks.text:
Item: Writs of Passage (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: writ of passage
Type: documents
Properties: Show to any House Kellenor ship for free passage; cannot dictate destination
Significance: Thanks from Merrill; possible way to reach Dragonfjord
- (2026-02-22) Merrill gave each party member a writ of passage for free passage on House Kellenor ships.

- (2026-03-08) Eddie found a dented but sealed metal scroll tube holding a map annotated in different handwriting from its maker; the party counted five dragons on it.
- (2026-03-08) The map marks the Ruins of Drakholm, which is where the party is headed.
- (2026-04-05) The GM said the map came from an archive and shows an unknown ship; someone recently wrote 'beware of merrows' beside it, within the few seasons before the wagon wreck. It was logged in party inventory as the annotated Dragonfjord map.
- (2026-04-05) Portia made her own copy of the map on rice paper.

chunks.title: Ice Troll Hearts
chunks.text:
Item: Ice Troll Hearts (first seen 2026-05-17, last seen 2026-05-17)
Also known as: troll hearts
Type: magical organs / consumable
Holder: Eddie
Properties: Magic lasts 24 hours after death. Eating one grants troll-like regeneration for a day (5 hit points per round, interrupted by fire or acid). Burying one summons a day-long blizzard. A dark hag ritual makes brown mold. An alchemist with a kit can make a potion of cold resistance in about an hour.
Significance: Two hearts were cut from the dead ice trolls; the party lacked alchemy proficiency or a kit.
- (2026-05-17) Eddie cut the hearts out of the two dead ice trolls, rolling a natural 20 on the removal.
- (2026-05-17) The GM gave Monarch the lore on the hearts' uses.
- (2026-05-17) Monarch failed to build a makeshift alchemy kit to make potions.
- (2026-05-17) Eddie and Sir Raf ate the hearts before heading to fight the yeti; each regenerates 5 hit points per round for 24 hours unless hit by fire or acid.

chunks.title: Silver Dragon's Iron Flask
chunks.text:
Item: Silver Dragon's Iron Flask (first seen 2026-05-17, last seen 2026-07-26)
Also known as: iron flask, iron prison, legendary iron flask
Type: legendary iron flask (prison)
Properties: Imprisons the silver dragon Lunae; it only needs to be found and opened
Significance: Held the imprisoned silver dragon Lunae; she wants it to lock up dragons and reestablish control of the fjord
Holder: Lunae
- (2026-05-17) Portia was told in the astral library that the silver dragon is in an iron flask in Rimescar's hoard, buried behind thick ice.
- (2026-05-17) Lucia's mirror vision showed a white dragonborn among the ancient white dragon's followers pulling an iron flask during the dragon battle in the fjord.
- (2026-05-17) Eddie's augury (Hades) first came back woe, then well for Portia casting locate object. Portia's locate object showed the flask within 1,000 feet, up and to the east.
- (2026-06-14) Locate object, cast by Eddie, gave a direction line toward the flask's hoard chamber behind 15 feet of thick ice.
- (2026-06-14) The flask was found in Rimescar's hoard room, looking like a plain iron flask with a stopper. Portia took only the flask.
- (2026-06-14) The GM read the flask's rules: a magic action removes the stopper and the creature obeys commands for one hour; if given no commands or a command likely to cause death or imprisonment, it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions.
- (2026-06-14) Portia opened it at the lair and Lunae emerged as an enormous silver dragon, bound to obey for an hour.

chunks.title: Silver Dragon's Iron Flask (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Silver Dragon's Iron Flask (first seen 2026-05-17, last seen 2026-07-26)
- (2026-06-14) Lunae asked to keep the flask to lock up dragons and re-establish control of the fjord, and the party agreed.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae planned to use the flask on Rimescar when his resistances weakened, but the dwarves' crossbows killed him while paralyzed.
- (2026-07-12) Monarch asked where the iron flask was; Kyle confirmed the party gave it to Lunae.
- (2026-07-26) Lunae was pulled into the iron flask when she fought Icevein; Kyle noted a creature released from it must obey its releaser for the first hour, which Icevein probably relished. The whites then took over her domain.

chunks.title: Root of Whisperwood
chunks.text:
Item: Root of Whisperwood (first seen 2026-06-14, last seen 2026-08-09)
Also known as: living staff, bleeding root staff
Type: magic staff (quarterstaff)
Holder: Portia
Properties: Six charges, regains d6 at dawn; +2 to attack and damage as a quarterstaff, +2 to spell attack rolls while held; casts animal friendship, awaken, barkskin, locate animals or plants, pass without trace, speak with animals, speak with plants, wall of thorns (wall of thorns uses all six); plant it to become a 60-ft tree; mirror gaze (divination) and a once-per-dawn contact with Aurelia; if the last charge is spent, d20 on a 1 it becomes a nonmagical staff
Magic: by a druid; part of Whisperwood
Significance: Tied to Aurelia
- (2026-06-14) Found in Rimescar's hoard as a staff of living wood; Portia examined it on the short rest and learned it is a part of Whisperwood, the Feywild domain of Aurelia.
- (2026-06-14) Portia attuned, which raised her Shillelagh, Thorn Whip and Fire Bolt attack bonuses to +8 and left her save DC unchanged.
- (2026-08-09) Portia explained she asked whether she had met Aurelia because the Root of Whisperwood is tied to Aurelia and certain features depend on it; Kyle confirmed she has met Aurelia.

chunks.title: Scroll of Reincarnate

chunks.title: Jeweled Dragon-Finger Glove

Significance: Worth about 3,000 gp; Monarch wants to swap the gems for elemental gems
- (2026-06-14) Taken from the hoard; Raf did not wear it. Lucia estimated about 3,000 gp, and Monarch added it to the party inventory.

chunks.title: Rimescar's Hoard Treasure

- (2026-06-14) Behind the ice wall: coinage mostly silver with gold and some platinum, mithril bars, and a cracking dragon egg.
- (2026-06-14) The party grabbed bars and handfuls of the higher-value coins into bags of holding.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae noted her most valuable treasures were probably taken by Icevein and let the party keep what they took as fair compensation.

chunks.title: White Dragon Mask (Vigdis's)

Significance: Party wants it to prevent Tiamat's return and to hinder Cherek negotiations with the dragons
- (2026-07-12) Kyle said a holder of an artifact who negotiated with an ancient dragon may not be defeatable by the party yet; the party chose subterfuge over force.
- (2026-07-12) Portia's scouting saw the woman leader sit and set a white dragon mask on her lap; she later wore it while facing the illusion.
- (2026-07-26) Kyle confirmed Vigdis still has the white dragon mask. The party discussed taking it later or destroying it. Monarch noted the mask only gives advantage on checks against dragons and does not charm them. No mask was seen in the mirror visions of Icevein.

chunks.title: Cherek Tribute to Rimescar
chunks.text:
Item: Cherek Tribute to Rimescar (first seen 2026-07-12, last seen 2026-07-12)
Also known as: tribute wagons, Rimescar's tribute
Holder: party inventory
Properties: Three wagons: 50,000 silver, 10,000 gold, 24 gems (100-1,000 each); a wagon with a longsword, longbow, greataxe, shield, six arrows, a crown, necklace, five rings, chain mail; and two caged prisoners
Magic: Detect magic: sword, bow, axe, shield, one of five rings, chain mail and six arrows are magic
Significance: Obtained through the Weekend at Bernie's illusion ruse; Lunae may get a cut
- (2026-07-12) Monarch's major image illusion of Rimescar, with Performance 24, convinced Vigdis to hand over the tribute and leave.
- (2026-07-12) Wagon contents: 50,000 silver coins, 10,000 gold, 24 gems worth 100 to 1,000.
- (2026-07-12) Other wagon: long sword, longbow, great axe, shield, half dozen arrows in custom case, crown, necklace, five rings.
- (2026-07-12) Detect magic showed the sword, bow, axe, shield, one ring, chain mail and arrows are magic.
- (2026-07-12) Everything except the prisoners was added to party inventory by Monarch; the coin as an item since Lunae may take a cut.

- (2026-07-26) After Arcana checks, Sir Raf and Portia identified the icy crystal crown seen in Lucia's vision as the Yoke of Thrym. Monarch only recalled it as a legendary crown.

chunks.title: Runestones of the Fenrir
chunks.text:
Item: Runestones of the Fenrir (first seen 2026-09-06, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: rune stones, four elemental stones, elemental rune stone, elemental rune stones
Type: homebrew elemental rune stones
Properties: With a utilize action and a fourth-level spell slot a stone summons an elemental that stays until killed or dismissed (not one hour). It understands languages, obeys, acts right after its summoner, and is dismissed as a bonus action. Fire stone: fire elemental or fire elemental myrmidon (armored, contained, tougher). Air stone: air elemental or invisible stalker.
Magic: Attunement needed to summon; Kyle said he would flag it as requiring attunement. If someone else attunes to the stone, its elemental is dismissed; losing attunement does not remove the elemental. Eddie attuned to the fire stone, Monarch to the air stone, then the water stone.
Significance: Let Monarch summon elementals (water and air) to power the Fenrir
Holder: Monarch
- (2026-09-06) Portia opened a door in the Fenrir's lower deck and found huge rune stones glowing with elemental energy, a nice hammock and a fine chest; from one stone a tall figure in black plate with flame showing through the cracks rose, and she shut the door on it.
- (2026-09-20) Four enormous runestones sit in a cabin on the Fenrir. After the dispel, only two still glowed; opening the door made them brighten, and an armored fire figure rose from the rear stone and an air elemental appeared.

chunks.title: Runestones of the Fenrir (part 2)
chunks.text:
Item: Runestones of the Fenrir (first seen 2026-09-06, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-09-20) The rear stone summons an armored fire elemental, the stone forward of it an air elemental, the water stone a water elemental, and the forward lower-right stone an ice elemental.
- (2026-09-20) Eddie's dispel magic had put out two of the stones.
- (2026-09-20) A footlocker next to the stones was unlocked, unwarded and empty.
- (2026-10-04) The party's dispel magic across the boat removed the spells on some stones before the rest; only two elementals (air and fire) appeared, which the party took as the dispel working on two stones. Portia charmed one and Monarch the other.
- (2026-10-04) The charmed air elemental El Nino was sent north to disable Norge ships; the fire elemental in armor could not leave the ship because it cannot cross water, and only its master could dismiss it. Monarch charmed the fire elemental too (heightened, DC 19 Wisdom save at disadvantage); it stayed her friend after Portia's charm lapsed.
- (2026-10-04) Eddie attuned to the fire stone and Monarch to the air stone; Sir Raf attuned briefly to the air stone and Monarch swapped his attunement off. Both elementals vanished when attunement finished.
- (2026-10-04) Monarch named her air elemental El Nino. Elementals have no individual identities per Kyle.

chunks.title: Runestones of the Fenrir (part 3)
chunks.text:
Item: Runestones of the Fenrir (first seen 2026-09-06, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-10-04) Monarch regained a fourth-level slot, attuned to the air stone and summoned an air elemental on deck, then began attuning to the water stone; she planned to hold air and water attunement at the same time. The party had two stones of the four dispelled; the water stone can be reactivated by attuning and spending a fourth-level slot.
- (2026-10-18) Monarch kept the water elemental pushing the ship at speed 60 (up to 60 from current plus up to 60 from wind); with sails and the air elemental the ship reached 120, i.e. 12 miles an hour.
- (2026-10-18) Monarch chose to stay attuned to the stones instead of re-attuning to her defenses, in case she needs to resummon, and said she could regain one more fourth-level slot that day.
- (2026-10-18) Monarch sent the air elemental to follow Icevein and report; it returned bloodied with 37 hit points left of 90, reporting 'could not see. Too cold. Was going to die.' Monarch had told it not to die and the GM said it obeys any command. She declined healing for it.
- (2026-10-18) The GM ruled a summoned elemental understands commands but replies only in its own language; Portia cast comprehend languages to understand it, and it said it knows where its master is.
- (2026-10-18) Monarch had no fourth-level slot after summoning both elementals. She later burned two third-level slots for sorcery points, regained a fourth-level slot, and cast permanent major image on the sail so it flew the colors of Roma.

chunks.title: Runestones of the Fenrir (part 4)
chunks.text:
Item: Runestones of the Fenrir (first seen 2026-09-06, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-10-18) With 24 oarsmen and two elementals the Fenrir reached 24 miles an hour.

chunks.title: Glyphs of Warding on the Fenrir's hatches

chunks.text:
Item: Glyphs of Warding on the Fenrir's hatches (first seen 2026-09-20, last seen 2026-09-20)

Type: magical glyphs
Properties: Triggered if the hatches are closed again, so the party left them open
Significance: Eddie's dispel magic removed them
- (2026-09-20) The wards on the hatches were separate glyphs, not part of the ship; they would trigger if the hatches were closed.
- (2026-09-20) Eddie's dispel magic on the Fenrir ended the glyphs, as they were third level.

chunks.title: Vigdis's Letters and Logbooks
chunks.text:
Item: Vigdis's Letters and Logbooks (first seen 2026-10-04, last seen 2026-10-04)
Also known as: captain's letters, Fenrir logbooks
Type: documents (letters in Common and Giant, journals)
Holder: party
Properties: Letters addressed to Vigdis, undated, with rotating code phrases and duress protocols; tactical, treasure fleet and supply coordination. Logbooks in one hand, unsigned, mention 'the winter favored' giving orders and 'the terms' limiting contact with the clans.
Significance: Indicate invasion-scale force (armies of tens of thousands) from Norge aimed at Roma; no direct proof of giant involvement.
- (2026-10-04) Found in a watertight trunk in the formerly guarded cabin; Eddie and Portia read them.
- (2026-10-04) The letters indicate an invasion fleet headed for Roma from Norge, not a raiding fleet.
- (2026-10-04) The logbooks refer to 'the winter favored' as the one issuing orders, and to 'the terms' constraining contact with clans back home; Portia's insight was that the compartmentalization may suppress discontent.

chunks.title: Vigdis's Trunk
chunks.text:
Item: Vigdis's Trunk (first seen 2026-10-04, last seen 2026-10-04)
Also known as: captain's chest, burn box
Type: trapped watertight chest
Holder: Lucia
Properties: Lock opens by key without triggering the trap; picking or forcing it triggers a piston that crushes a gem between hammerheads. Wood trays infused with magnesium dust would burn fast and hot.
- (2026-10-04) Lucia, aided by Eddie's guidance, picked the lock with a total of 40 and pulled the gem before the hammerheads closed; the trap did not go off. Monarch's investigation (24) found the trap.
- (2026-10-04) The gem removed from the trap is warm to the touch and reads as evocation.

chunks.title: Fenrir Emergency Funds
chunks.text:
Item: Fenrir Emergency Funds (first seen 2026-10-04, last seen 2026-10-04)

- (2026-10-04) Found at the bottom of the trunk; Lucia put it into her bag of holding and said she would not skim it for herself.

chunks.title: Healing Teas

Item: Healing Teas (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-10-20)

- (2024-10-20) Harvey had trays of tea cakes and kettles of hot tea brought up about twenty minutes later; consumed over a short rest they heal 2d4+2 for everyone, including the unconscious once their poison wears off.

chunks.title: Drow Hand
chunks.text:
Item: Drow Hand (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-10-20)
Also known as: severed drow hand
Type: body part / trophy
Holder: Sir Raf
Significance: Taken from a dead drow assassin; Sir Raf carefully removed it and stitched up the wound
- (2024-10-20) Monarch asked Sir Raf if she wanted one of the drow's hands before leaving; Sir Raf pulled out a kit and carefully removed it, then stitched up the stump neatly.

chunks.title: Head Cartographer's Sending Stone
chunks.text:
Item: Head Cartographer's Sending Stone (first seen 2026-03-08, last seen 2026-04-05)
Type: sending stone
Properties: Paired stone; touching it casts sending to the bearer of the other stone; once per day regardless of which stone is used

- (2026-03-08) Found in the pocket of the head cartographer after Eddie's detect magic sweep; Monarch agreed to hang on to it.
- (2026-04-05) Monarch checked and found the sending stone does not require attunement; Matt explained that stones come in pairs and work once per day total.
- (2026-04-05) Eddie picked up the stone and sent: 'This is Eddie. Found the remains of your Dragonfjord expedition. Who should we speak with to debrief?' The GM ruled someone holds the other stone.
- (2026-04-05) Reply came back immediately in a precise tone: return all associated goods, maps and valuables to the closest seneschal of House Querid immediately, sharing none of the information with others or face extreme sanction. The party did not answer.

- (2026-02-22) A court sending stone was handed to Monarch to notify her of progress on the Ronnom case; it is to be returned when the case closes.

chunks.title: Covered Framed Object in the Captain's Cabin

chunks.text:

- (2026-10-04) In the formerly guarded captain's cabin a large flat framed object leaned against the back wall under a bearskin.

- (2026-10-04) The party left it covered and untouched.

chunks.title: Who Targets the Party and Why
names: Who Targets the Party and Why
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Who Targets the Party and Why (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: House Querid vendetta
Hook: House Querid and Zyra the Silent sent agents after the party over the package.
Status: open
Linked: House Querid, Simona Querid Ventre, Zyra the Silent
- (2024-11-03) Valkrath's death confirmed the Zyra glyph rumor: his tattoo exploded in acid. Zyra's top agents carry it, not every iron shadow.
- (2024-11-03) Drik's crew said word was that heavy hitters, possibly their old boss, were coming for the party.
