- (2024-11-17) Portia asked Simona Querid Ventre to inquire with her House Querid contacts about whether the party is still hunted and whether the matter can be resolved; Simona agreed to make inquiries and assurances.
- (2024-11-17) Monarch told Octavio Libram that the package carried a scrying sensor that exposed the party to House Querid, who then sent killers to clean up. Libram said the GM-side business with Zyra the Silent is still unsettled, so the party should not tip off Zyra's side.
- (2025-01-05) Simona offered to act as go-between if the party wishes to communicate with Zyra the Silent, who sent the iron hand to kill them.
- (2024-10-20) Monarch and the GM's NPC (Sir Raf's counterpart, speaking for House Telks) theorize that the package was damaged or that everyone who handled it could be found by divination, which would explain why House Querid targets them.

chunks.title: Who Targets the Party and Why (part 2)
names: Who Targets the Party and Why
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Who Targets the Party and Why (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2024-10-20) House Telks hired Sir Raf's team to intercept the package and House Ventre hired the party to deliver it and learn its contents. The package came off a spelljammer.
- (2024-10-20) Raf's team was told not to open the package, which was warded and booby-trapped. A rival courier, Nayak, did not make it, and Telks had agents on the ship's crew.
- (2024-10-20) The party considered reporting to House Ventre what the package contained, or meeting Zyra the Silent to ask how to make amends. Zyra reportedly puts acid-explosion glyphs on key agents, though the party has not seen this.
- (2024-10-20) Lucia noted it is unclear whether the party is really on the target list: they were told so by someone who would gain if they helped, and have not seen the list.

chunks.title: War of Emperors
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: War of Emperors (first seen ?, last seen ?)
Status: resolved
Hook: The war the giants won: their victory brought the Pax Titanicus and the integration of giants into the ruling houses of the Imperium.
- Emperor Galus Cirrus Marvad Titanicus was a general in the War of Emperors.

chunks.title: Contents of the Shipment
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Contents of the Shipment (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: the package, the box
Hook: Confirm what was in the sealed box delivered to Shimmerstone Shipworks and why a fast airship is being built.
Status: advanced
Linked: Azuriel, Jimmy Slips, Shimmerstone Shipworks
- (2024-11-17) Octavio Libram considers the shipment business done, but Azuriel, chief of staff at the Sultan Estate, is intrigued and learned the box was bound for a shipyard in Greka. She reasons it was opened and installed in a ship, so it can be identified by looking around the shipyard.
- (2024-11-17) The shipyard is run by the Shimmerstones, eccentric gnomes. Azuriel arranged for Jimmy Slips, skilled in disguises and forgeries, to help, and he agreed to consider it for gold.
- (2024-11-17) At the mercenary hall, a posted job from Jingle Shimmerstone sought extra guards for Shimmerstone Shipworks in Greka. The party took a copy and went to Brim's AutoKeg, where Jingle hired all five of them for the swing shift.
- (2024-11-17) Jingle's companion at the table turned out to be Jimmy Slips, whose eyes narrowed at seeing Monarch; the scene ended there.
- (2024-12-01) Monarch's group learned the box was about three feet long, a foot by two feet in cross-section, and heavy; Monarch theorizes it held a spelljammer component such as a magical spyglass or navigational orrery.

chunks.title: Contents of the Shipment (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Contents of the Shipment (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2024-12-01) Library research at the House Querid library in Greka found that Eberron dragon shards bind elementals to airships for very fast flight, and that exporting them from Eberron is forbidden. Monarch suspects this explains the darkened dry dock.
- (2024-12-01) The party deduced the contents are being used in the darkened dry dock, and that the dock is the sealed-off third dry dock.
- (2024-12-01) Monarch ruled that Jimmy Slips must never learn the party is still pursuing the item from the box.
- (2024-12-15) Monarch concluded from her research on Eberron airships and dragon shards that the box held a kyber dragon shard (the party's guess), which would bind elementals to the unusual ring-and-ship design.
- (2024-12-15) The GM described the ship in Bay 3 (the pit) as a long hull with a hovering ring around its middle, unlike any airship the party had seen.
- (2024-12-15) Eddie and Portia cast locate object on a kyber crystal from outside the property. It pointed into Shimmerstone Shipworks, and triangulation narrowed it to Bay 3, the pit.
- (2024-12-15) Through Diego the bat, Raf perceived two crystalline shapes in a container the size of the delivery box. The jar voice (the great Zulk) told Serge to bring the smaller, darker one and not the larger one.
- (2024-12-15) Raf's bat perception check came to 15 and was called essential to the mission's success.

chunks.title: Contents of the Shipment (part 3)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Contents of the Shipment (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2024-12-15) The GM gave 15% XP for the session, with a quest resolution bonus pending for next session. Monarch said the party is about 80% there and wants eyes on the target to confirm.
- (2025-01-05) Among the sentry's wreckage Raf and Eddie found shattered blue-violet crystal fragments, probably a Kyber dragon shard used to bind the fire spirit. They are unusable and unproven.
- (2025-01-05) Kyle clarified that the earlier locate-object target was a Siberys shard, the larger kind used to build eldritch machines, not Kyber.
- (2025-01-05) Monarch reported to Azuriel that the package was probably a dragon shard for an elemental-bound airship. Azuriel was puzzled why a fast airship is needed and asked, as a personal favor, to learn its purpose and where the shards came from, noting Eberron controls them and has sent no spelljammers in months.
- (2025-01-05) The shipment arrived on the independent spelljammer Starfallen; its captain, lore master Rilfael, was met by Monarch, and the port authority's Ronnom Kenegal records only what he is told.

chunks.title: Groves of Belenus Senate Measure
names: measure to bring the Groves under Roman control
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Groves of Belenus Senate Measure (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: measure to bring the Groves under Roman control
Hook: The Senate vote on placing the Groves under the consul is still a day and a half away while the party leaves Roma.
Status: advanced
Linked: Groves of Belenus, House Marvad, Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad, Senator Magnus Opulus Marvad, Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus, Simona Querid Ventre
- (2024-11-17) A measure before the Senate would place the Groves of Belenus under the direct oversight of the Roman consul, a member of House Marvad, effectively part of the city. It is sponsored by Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad, who is hard to damage politically, and is not expected before the full Senate for at least three moons.
- (2024-11-17) Simona asked the party to share any information or leverage that could weaken the sponsor; Portia promised to pass on anything found. The Groves earn well from healing potions, and the measure would also shift influence from House Ventre to House Marvad.
- (2025-01-05) Kyle reminded the party the motion will likely pass unless its proponents are weakened. Senator Magnus Opulus Marvad proposed it, and the Groves oppose it. Lucia dislikes him as the father of her former fiancé.
- (2025-01-19) Portia noted she would otherwise have tried to solve the druid problem; the party chose the eastern trip instead and worry the bill may pass while they are away.

chunks.title: Groves of Belenus Senate Measure (part 2)
names: measure to bring the Groves under Roman control
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Groves of Belenus Senate Measure (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-12-14)
- (2025-11-02) Simona traveled to the Azure Sky camp in person to ask Portia's help. The vote is about a month away, roughly three weeks left after the party's quick return trip.
- (2025-11-02) Simona's three avenues were identifying senators who are corrupt, pressuring the guilds that want poisons from the Grove, and discrediting Magnus Marvad. She suspects mining near the Grove, with a fragment of the world tree's root beneath it.
- (2025-11-02) The Grove's alchemists made a potion that turns a liar's tongue black, and it can be hidden in sweet wine. Someone still has to socially engineer the senators.
- (2025-11-02) The Senate has 50 members and the buzz is that Magnus has the votes. The consul is the city's mayor-like ruler and would have near-absolute power over the Grove. Mining concerns around Ursa and rumors of a valuable find under the Grove were cited.
- (2025-11-02) Monarch, disguised by Alter Self as Myla Brightfellow, got hired as an aide by Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus at the Wreath & Lion after rolling a 20 on persuasion and 15 on insight. She learned Calvus is orchestrating the Grove measure as part of a campaign for tighter regulation of magic, especially druidic and wild magic.
- (2025-11-02) Raf, Lucia and Portia plan to gather information on senators' sides, including by finding the senator for the Trimarket area, the area closest to the Grove.

chunks.title: Groves of Belenus Senate Measure (part 3)
names: measure to bring the Groves under Roman control
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Groves of Belenus Senate Measure (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-12-14)
- (2025-11-16) Monarch, working as junior assistant to Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus, learned the measure is winning by 25 votes. Eleven persuadable late-joining senators hold 22 votes. A flipped vote counts double and an abstention helps. Sponsors are not expected to change.
- (2025-11-16) The six giant senators carry 2 to 4 votes each by size, none sponsored the bill, and all lean yes. Senate seats are gifts of the emperor, not elected.
- (2025-11-16) The bill has been stripped to one line making the Groves part of Roma. That places them under the consul, a cloud giant and half-sister of the Cloud Giant senator, so the consul can decide everything else. Earlier drafts covered mineral rights, timber and access to the Groves' herbs and alchemical ingredients.
- (2025-11-16) Margin is unusually narrow for a Magnus-sponsored bill, implying real resistance. House Ventre is split against and House Kenegal split in favor.
- (2025-11-16) A vote is expected to be scheduled one to two weeks out; the party has at least a week or two.
- (2025-11-16) Party ideas: add a poison-pill rider via a senator, forge a missive from Magnus in illusory script, bribe giants with gifts, and offer an alternative oversight body or druidic academy so senators can vote no. Portia floated the academy and the Henge restoration to the druids, who raised no strong objection.

chunks.title: Groves of Belenus Senate Measure (part 4)
names: measure to bring the Groves under Roman control
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Groves of Belenus Senate Measure (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-12-14)
- (2025-11-16) Rogrun, the hill giant (2 votes), agreed in writing to a conditional deal: a monthly tribute of Grove foods if he votes against. He made no firm promise. The party's insight checks suggested he intends to vote no.
- (2025-11-16) Senator Borluss Flintmantle Lapis (Lapis), the stone giant, after a long silence agreed in writing that stone giants will restore the Great Henge, with the stipulation that he votes no. The party moved two giants over, closing four votes of the gap.
- (2025-11-30) The Green Apothecary, after an afternoon of hashing it out, offered a set of binding magical oaths: teleport access restricted to guarded areas, an open exchange area for city alchemists, and monthly reports of druidic or wild magic above 3rd rank to the consul's office. The oaths are conditional and lapse if the Groves are annexed.
- (2025-11-30) Portia, as Green Apothecary representative, won the fire giant senator Kaldrina's vote against annexation with the oaths; Kaldrina asked one extra oath, that the Groves obey Roman law on incoming teleports, and said her people will visit the Groves from time to time.
- (2025-11-30) Portia flipped Senator Octavia Calvad (delighted) and Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus (who flipped to poke Magnus in the eye); the party counts five flips from this push and expects to win by one, with Brontus (storm giant) and the cloud giant Azirah unresolved.

chunks.title: Groves of Belenus Senate Measure (part 5)
names: measure to bring the Groves under Roman control
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Groves of Belenus Senate Measure (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-12-14)
- (2025-11-30) Earlier, Eddie and Lucia's pitch to the frost giant senator Vaelthira failed to prove Magnus's double-dealing, but she lifted the thug threat and gave leave to visit senators, warning she would punish them if senators visited flipped their votes without proof.
- (2025-11-30) The vote is scheduled in two days and the city is abuzz.
- (2025-12-14) Monarch checked in and found business in Roma undisturbed by the Norge fleet. The vote date is unchanged, a day and a half away now, and the party will miss it by going north.

chunks.title: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask
names: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-05-17)
Also known as: Qul'drik letter, legendary blue dragon mask, blue dragon mask
Hook: Eddie holds the blue dragon mask, and the party must decide whether to destroy or hide it.
Status: advanced
Linked: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence, Dragon Masks, Hades, Hall of Blades, Ruins of Qul'drik, Tiamat, Tomar
- (2024-11-17) Father Georg gave Eddie a letter from a dead comrade, a half-elf priest of Hades, sent by a circuitous mundane route via Eyre so it would arrive months after his death. It contains an ink drawing of a stylized dragon and the notes 'Mythic Isles?' and Qul'drik.
- (2024-11-17) Qul'drik is Giant for 'great citadel' and is the ruins House Mazaali is exploring near the Xeon Palace. Sir Raf's roll of 20 identified the drawing as resembling the legendary blue dragon mask, one of a set of dragon masks that give influence over dragons; rumors say gathering several metallic or chromatic masks does something huge.
- (2024-11-17) Lucia suggested commissioning a replica of the mask. The handwriting is confirmed as the friend's, and Monarch memorized it.
- (2025-01-05) Kyle reminded Eddie of the drawing of the Dragon Mask he may want to investigate, tied to the ruins in the east.
- (2025-01-19) The party is heading east partly to reach the Ruins of Qul'drik near Xi'an Palace, though they have nothing specific to look for there and are keeping options open.

chunks.title: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (part 2)
names: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-05-17)
- (2025-02-16) Jim's Raf explained to the historian Tomar that Eddie's letter points toward the ruins. Tomar said documents held by the Khan's chief engineer from Qul'drik adventurers mention an artifact called the face of the dragon, possibly the same as the mask.
- (2025-02-16) Tomar advised raising this with the Khan, who values knowledge, and said entry to the ruins normally needs the Khan's permission.
- (2025-03-16) Eddie described the letter his friends sent out knowing they probably would not return, which includes a picture of a blue dragon mask.
- (2025-03-16) Monarch talked with Eddie to learn why they are going to the dungeon and how hard to try in the contest.
- (2025-05-04) Monarch told Sets'en of a dragon mask rumored in the ruins. Tomor said stories of the Cult of the Dragon involve masks, plural, that allow conversing with or controlling dragons.
- (2025-05-04) Chimeg has never seen anything like the mask and cannot say where to look, but can say which places were excavated.
- (2025-05-18) Eddie told Chimeg the party is looking for a mask, which they expect to be underground rather than near the surface; Chimeg had seen no masks. He planned to cast locate object (1,000 ft range) on the mask drawing, and the party decided to cast it once centrally inside the ruins.
- (2025-05-18) Eddie cast locate object on the cult symbol and found nothing within a thousand feet.

chunks.title: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (part 3)
names: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-05-17)
- (2025-05-18) The Dawnrealmer fanatic's hand-drawn map shows the way to the Tower of Storms. Her notes say the basement should hold a lead to the dragon mask's location, not the mask itself, because the tower was home to Cloud Giant and Storm Giant sorcerers and wizards.
- (2025-05-18) A mural in the basement corridor shows giants forging five masks as keys to Tiamat's prison and giving them to arch devils as her jailers. A common devil, apparently a succubus, later hands a mask back to the giants, who place it beside the imprisoned amorphous thing deep under the city.
- (2025-06-01) The Tower of Storms library and its chests were searched without finding a dragon mask; the GM said there was no Dragon Mask in the ornate chest. The basement's lead to the mask remains unresolved.
- (2025-06-15) The party hoped Eddie's mask was in the chest but it was not. The mask is believed to be near the binding site, part of the structure that held the shapeless creature, so the party needs to find the other towers.
- (2025-06-15) The books say the masks were part of the binding of Tiamat in the hells (Avernus) and are the keys to releasing her. Some sources say a couple of masks suffice and others say all five are needed. A blue mask grants influence over blue dragons. Scholars disagree on whether to seek the masks to secure them or to leave them buried.

chunks.title: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (part 4)
names: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-05-17)
- (2025-07-27) The party reasoned the Dragon Mask is a power source in the prison, so simply removing it would weaken the prison; with the Graven Lexus they think they could alter the enchantment to accept a replacement legendary item.
- (2025-07-27) At the Hall of Blades Eddie declared he seeks the path to the blue dragon mask. The voice said 'Of course you do, marked as you are by her,' referring to his Tiamat scar.
- (2025-07-27) The hall demands a worthy truth or punishes. Eddie confessed his scar's origin from the dream where Tiamat clawed him; it was deemed worthy, and he chose a blade, receiving a blood iron and adamantine rapier with necrotic energy requiring attunement.
- (2025-07-27) Monarch confessed that she took the faceless Summer Queen's crown out of desire for power and would again. It was judged worthy and she was told power from outside her lands will destroy her.
- (2025-08-10) Eddie offered a plus one short sword at the pedestal; a spirit took it and the voice accepted it as acceptable. Asked where the blue dragon mask is, the voice said that was beyond its knowledge, but many saw the thorn betrayer carry it deep into the city center through the Gate of Dragons into the Hall of Scales.
- (2025-08-10) Eddie got a natural 20 on Arcana and learned the pedestal is a sacrificial-style stone for offerings, not displays; the party decided to head to the Hall of Scales.

chunks.title: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (part 5)
names: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-05-17)
- (2025-08-10) The flame keeper letter, signed 'v' in scale devotion, said the swords remember who took the mask and where they went; the party expects the cultists to follow the same path.
- (2025-10-19) Tiamat's dream voice told Eddie 'speak my name marked and chosen and you shall be conveyed on my wings' while Hades' eyes watched him. Eddie said Tiamat, gaining dragon wings (fly 30, ten minutes) and a bluish shift, and felt disappointment and disconnection. His shoulder mark glowed faintly blue.
- (2025-10-19) Eddie dreamed of leading an army of skeletons in a damp subterranean place and is prepared to consider Animate Dead only with a nudge from Hades.
- (2025-10-19) The blue dragon mask is seen floating at the center of the rune web.
- (2025-11-02) Eddie had named Tiamat earlier and received chromatic wings. Kyle said Hades felt deep disappointment rather than abandonment, so some atonement may be in Eddie's future, and Eddie plans an atonement.
- (2025-11-02) Eddie prepared Remove Curse and Animate Dead. The GM said a cleric with real intent to make things right is usually given enough rope, but that wears thin.

chunks.title: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (part 6)
names: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Eddie's Letter and the Blue Dragon Mask (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-05-17)
- (2025-11-02) Sir Raf cast Identify on the mask. It is a legendary artifact giving lightning resistance, Draconic Majesty AC, recharge-6 breath weapon, extra darkvision, blindsight 30 ft once per day for 5 minutes, Draconic, advantage on Charisma checks with blue dragons, legendary resistance once per day and lingering shock. History says each mask is made from a single scale of Tiamat.
- (2025-11-02) The party decided not to wear the mask around town because nations would come after it, and to keep it in a bag of holding. Eddie's friend is dead and Eddie is unsure what to do with it.
- (2026-05-17) The blue mask stays in a bag of holding. Monarch noted a divination for it would point to the party.
- (2026-05-17) Eddie's augurings to Hades on casting locate object returned woe, seen by the GM as Hades marking him.

chunks.title: Lucia's Reinstated Engagement Offer
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Lucia's Reinstated Engagement Offer (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-03-02)
Hook: Lucia's past betrothal to Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan gave the party an invitation and a route to the ruins.
Status: advanced
Linked: Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan, House Mazaali
- Lucia's former fiancé is Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan of House Mazaali.
- (2024-11-17) Lucia's father secretly met her and said House Mazaali would reinstate her engagement if she publicly shamed and denounced Maximus. Lucia said she did not think she could denounce Maximus.
- (2025-01-05) House Mazaali, a house of the Khanates, controls partially explored ancient ruins east of Roma. Lucia has connections there and the party wants a paying job to go.
- (2025-01-19) The GM said House Mazaali controls and is actively scavenging the Ruins of Qul'drik near Xi'an Palace; Lucia knows her former fiance there, and the party considered House Mazaali for a guide or work.
- (2025-02-16) Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan had invited Lucia to visit him anytime after the marriage was called off, so he is honor bound to receive her. The next morning a rider delivered his written invitation to Lucia and her people to dine at Xi'an Palace that evening.
- (2025-02-16) Lucia declined to pose as a noble, announcing herself as Lucia Tertia of House Ventre only hesitantly.
- (2025-02-16) The party reached Xi'an Palace and its golden dome after staying with the Stormgale clan. They were met by an honor guard led by Chimeg, called the Storm, who gave a cold welcome and told them to camp where they liked.

chunks.title: Lucia's Reinstated Engagement Offer (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Lucia's Reinstated Engagement Offer (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-03-02)
- (2025-02-16) Tomar, historian to the Khan, offered a glade campsite and a warmer welcome.
- (2025-03-02) At the honor feast Dagha welcomed Lucia warmly and asked what brought her. Lucia said she needed to leave Roma and wanted to learn his culture. Dagha seemed slightly burdened by their past and made her earn the escort by arranging it with Chimeg rather than ordering it.
- (2025-03-02) His mother, the matriarch, was the one who spoke with Lucia's family about ending the engagement. Lucia remains unsure how to approach her.

chunks.title: Azuriel's Ambitions
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Azuriel's Ambitions (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: Azure, Ziria
Hook: Azuriel wants the shipment's secrets and revealed Monarch's wild magic stems from a thwarted reality-change convergence.
Status: advanced
Linked: Azuriel
- (2024-11-17) Lady Gracia asked Sir Raf to get close to Azuriel and report suspicious activity, though she does not think Azuriel is disloyal to the house. Azuriel told Monarch she is very interested in conjunctions and wants a longer conversation later.
- (2024-11-17) Lord Sarovar's mercenary-fixer contact Colonel Kreetz was the recommended source of work. Sarovar also asked Raf to watch Lady Gracia because she has not answered him.
- (2025-01-05) Azuriel explained that Monarch's birth coincided with a convergence from a thwarted attempt to change reality, so she holds the chaos of alternate timelines. She advised seeking dragonkind's counsel, and said she herself has draconic blood with a lightning affinity (bronze or blue).
- (2025-01-05) Portia sensed Azuriel was withholding information about her own lineage.
- (2025-01-05) Azuriel recommended Octavio as a spell mentor for Raf.

chunks.title: Mercenary work through Colonel Kaelix
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mercenary work through Colonel Kaelix (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2024-11-17)
Also known as: mercenary registration, Fist of the Butterfly Registration
Hook: The party seeks mercenary work through Colonel Kaelix to travel east toward the Ruins of Qul'drik.
Status: advanced
Linked: Colonel Kaelix, Golden Leaf Tavern
- (2024-11-17) Sir Raf and Lucia presented letters of recommendation to Colonel Kaelix, who burned Lucia's letter. The party registered as the Fist of the Butterfly, with Monarch Brightwing as leader and the Golden Leaf Tavern as contact.
- (2024-11-17) Two jobs fit the party: a months-long caravan guard to the Dawnrealm through the Khanates, and a Greka guard job at Shimmerstone Shipworks.

chunks.title: Shimmerstone Shipworks Security Contract
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Shimmerstone Shipworks Security Contract (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: Shimmerstone guard job
Hook: The party guarded the workshops as cover to learn what was in the secret Bay 3 dry dock.
Status: resolved
Linked: Cloud Giant (Shimmerstone Shipworks partner), Jingle Shimmerstone, Shimmerstone Shipworks
- (2024-12-01) Jingle Shimmerstone said the job needs a promise to kill any intruders, not capture them. Pay is 100 gp per day for a week (700 total) plus a 300 gp bonus if all intrusions are prevented. The party is posted to the three workshops and barred from the dry docks except in pursuit of intruders.
- (2024-12-01) Monarch accepted the lethal-force terms for the party. Jingle wants them on duty by tomorrow night.
- (2024-12-01) Jingle uses a clockwork beetle in his pocket to command the automata, and he acted on suggestions the party gave in the interviews: re-educating unhappy employees, tracking blindsight employees 24/7, and eradicating beasts on the premises.
- (2024-12-01) Jingle ordered the clockwork scouts' aggression raised after Portia mentioned shapeshifters.
- (2024-12-01) The cloud giant partner wears a two-sided mask. She joined the Shipworks within the last couple of months as a political shield and investor, and her name is unknown.
- (2024-12-01) Raf saw Jimmy blanch at the mandatory lethal-force clause.

chunks.title: Shimmerstone Shipworks Security Contract (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Shimmerstone Shipworks Security Contract (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2024-12-15) The party works the swing shift. Bay 3 (the pit) is run by two voices: Wizen, the grim work chief, and a whiny voice in a jar calling itself the great Zulk. A duergar hammer named Serge does the heavy work, and automaton sentries guard the bay. The night crew leave before the day shift arrives.
- (2024-12-15) The GM said the cloud giant is a masked smiling one, a diplomat-assassin type who stays within 20 feet of the darkened dock.
- (2024-12-15) Clockwork observers shriek and telepathically report to their creators, and the bronze scouts burrow and detect by tremor sense. Raf's bat Diego was tracked by observers but not alarmed on.
- (2024-12-15) Portia's druid friend directed her to a bat cave on a rocky island off Greka's coast, and Portia's Animal Handling check drew a steady flow of curious bats to the Shipworks.
- (2025-01-05) Jingle fired the party as incompetent guards after the payroll theft, withholding the back half of their pay (50 gp each up front was already divided).
- (2025-01-05) The party's mercenary reputation for reliability is tarnished, though their capability is not in doubt. Kyle advised simply doing better jobs, rather than scapegoating Jimmy, to rebuild it.

chunks.title: Jimmy Slips's Planned Break-in
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Jimmy Slips's Planned Break-in (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2025-01-05)
Also known as: Jimmy's side job
Hook: Jimmy Slips stole the Shipworks payroll on the party's shift and paid the party 30% of the take.
Status: resolved
Linked: Azuriel, Jimmy Slips, Jingle Shimmerstone
- (2024-12-01) Jimmy said he was hired as Jingle's private investigator and would be paid by Azuriel for helping the party. He asked that neither side reveal they know each other. He will pose as an investigator and hold up the thieves' cant sign for 'snake' when in disguise.
- (2024-12-01) Jimmy's workshop tour showed he was interested in the first workshop's locked storeroom and said he must get into a workshop on their shift. He holds proof the party works for House Ventre, which Monarch suspects is a dead-man trigger.
- (2024-12-01) The party is tempted to kill Jimmy but was not authorized.
- (2024-12-15) An armored payroll wagon guarded by short folk and automata arrived at the Shipworks. The party worked out that Jimmy is waiting for payroll day, when the month's pay is on site for about 24 hours.
- (2024-12-15) The GM said Jimmy's blackmail is to reveal that the party was sent by House Ventre to run an operation against the shipyards.
- (2024-12-15) Jimmy, disguised as an auto gnome, was trapped in a detention bubble by a sentry automaton in the locked room. The silence field cast on the room blocked message.
- (2024-12-15) Lucia, via psychic whisper, negotiated with Jimmy. After her rerolled persuasion check he offered the party 30% of the take for freeing him.

chunks.title: Jimmy Slips's Planned Break-in (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Jimmy Slips's Planned Break-in (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2025-01-05)
- (2024-12-15) Monarch began casting Vortex Warp (with Subtle Spell) to teleport the sentry and free Jimmy. The sentry deployed blades and a tower shield and faced Monarch, so initiative begins next session.
- (2025-01-05) Monarch's Vortex Warp failed against the detention sentry (it rolled 17 vs DC 13); her second casting with Heightened Spell gave it disadvantage but also failed.
- (2025-01-05) Lucia picked the cage-room lock but the sentry stabbed her for 12 as she retreated; the party fought it with Jimmy trapped in the bubble and the silence kept up.
- (2025-01-05) The sentry was a fire spirit bound in armor; when Eddie dealt the final blow it exploded (DC 14 Dex save, 8 fire damage to Raf and Eddie), and the bubble dropped.
- (2025-01-05) Jimmy took the cache box, shoved it into a bag of holding and left disguised as an autognome.
- (2025-01-05) The party hid the evidence and told Jingle they were incompetent. A group Deception check gave 18 and Jingle, who rolled a natural 1 on Insight, fired them and docked their back-end pay.
- (2025-01-05) Jimmy was chewed out by Jingle for recommending the party, but winked at them. A few days later he delivered laundered trade bars worth 30% of the 8,000 gp take, 2,400 gp, split five ways at 480 gp each.

chunks.title: Eryndra Kalastov's Tentacle Quest
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Eryndra Kalastov's Tentacle Quest (first seen 2024-12-01, last seen 2024-12-15)
Also known as: Eryndra
Hook: A Great Old One warlock in the dark dry dock wants a petrified tentacle relic and could be an inside source.
Status: open
Linked: Shimmerstone Shipworks
- (2024-12-01) Lucia, with Portia aiding, befriended a tiefling warlock named Eryndra Kalastov. Her patron is a Great Old One, and she is saving gold for a piece of petrified tentacle from one of its original temples, found in the deeps.
- (2024-12-01) Eryndra works in darkness on the secret project and is well paid for confidentiality. She would not give details, and the party considers bribing her to confirm what is built there.
- (2024-12-15) The party discussed charming or bargaining with Eryndra, the Great Old One warlock who works on the darkness, to confirm the contents of Bay 3. They don't know where the temple with the tentacle is.

chunks.title: Sir Saravar Antosi's Foot Caravan Job
names: Sir Saravar Antosi's Foot Caravan Job
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Sir Saravar Antosi's Foot Caravan Job (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-01-19)
Also known as: Xi'an Palace job, Sir Saravar job
Hook: A client hired the party to travel to Xi'an Palace.
Status: resolved
Linked: Corona Domini, Sir Saravar, Xeon Palace, Xi'an Palace
- (2025-01-19) The job posting: a small shipment to Xi'an Palace, boat across the Mare Medietas to the Thundering Citadel then on foot, 5,000 gp, about three weeks, half a dozen highly trained guards; stealth recommended.
- (2025-01-19) Sir Saravar met the party at Popinjay's Tea Shoppe, quizzed them on war ogres and their deadliest opponent (the iron shadow), and noticed what they omitted without being upset; he warned they would be followed, robbed and ambushed, and said he would decide in seven days.
- (2025-01-19) Lucia followed him while invisible and saw him enter the Corona Domini's public southern gate, showing something small in his hand to a stone giant and a cloud giant guard; she could not tell what it was.
- (2025-01-19) Azuriel knew the name Sir Saravar Antasi only as a philosopher dead some 300 years, so the name is likely a pseudonym; she called the foot route dangerous and noted 5,000 gp could buy a teleport circle trip.
- (2025-01-19) Monarch wrote him a letter with questions and mentioned other offers; he replied by Sending that the party was released, that they had potential, and that he would keep them in mind. Monarch's Insight 11 suggested the Sending was a statement of how powerful people communicate.

chunks.title: Sir Saravar Antosi's Foot Caravan Job (part 2)
names: Sir Saravar Antosi's Foot Caravan Job
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Sir Saravar Antosi's Foot Caravan Job (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-01-19)
- (2025-01-19) Before the release, Raf got a letter from Sir Saravar vouching for him to imperial military units.

chunks.title: Harriet's Caravan to Sun Dragon
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Harriet's Caravan to Sun Dragon (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-02-02)
Also known as: Harriet's job, caravan to the Eastern Mountains
Hook: The party guarded Harriet's caravan east to Sun Dragon, and after the siege ended they took their pay and left her contract.
Status: advanced
Linked: Dawnrealm, Harriet, Khanates, Sun Dragon
- (2025-01-19) Harriet's job pays 10 gp a day per mercenary for about two weeks, with food, travel and horses covered and possible bonuses; the party joined as five of about 50 mercenaries, assigned to wagon four of six.
- (2025-01-19) Harriet trades clockwork and forged metal goods for horses and hopes to trade magic items for Dawnrealm silks, using special trade permits from both the Imperium and the Dawnrealm; the party must stay with her if Sun Dragon has fallen to the Dawnrealm.
- (2025-01-19) The caravan left Roma by the Via Lupo, reached the fortress Archafinalis (being reinforced) and then sprinted east on the Imperial Road, changing horses with Khan clans.
- (2025-01-19) On day six a land shark breached under wagon two and an ankheg charged from the south; the wagon master ordered the party to stop it, and the session ended as they rode out to meet it.
- (2025-02-02) The party was sent out as the caravan's designated expendables to intercept an ankheg while the rest of the caravan dealt with a land shark. They killed two ankhegs; Sir Raf was bitten for 12 slashing plus 5 acid and grappled, then killed his ankheg with a rapier hit for 10.

chunks.title: Harriet's Caravan to Sun Dragon (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Harriet's Caravan to Sun Dragon (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-02-02)
- (2025-02-02) The party harvested both ankheg carcasses over an hour. The unspent carcass yielded one vial of acid and enough plates for one set of heavy nonmetal armor or two nonmetal shields, saving 750 of the 1,500 gp cost.
- (2025-02-02) After the harvest, Sir Raf and Monarch found ankheg lairs that held 180 silver, 170 gold and 2 platinum coins, nine gems worth about 50 gp each, and a vial holding a flickering flame in liquid. Monarch tasted the liquid, felt strong, and an Arcana check suggested a potion of fire giant strength. It was given to Sir Raf.
- (2025-02-02) Harriet needed fresh horses from Sokha Khan's red warg clan. Sokha Khan required a single combat, with hazard pay of 100 gold. Harriet picked Sir Raf over a proven rival champion after Monarch's persuasion pitch.
- (2025-02-02) Sir Raf beat the orc Grock using blade ward, shield, false life and enlarge. He landed a crit for 16 and Grock yielded. Harriet paid him 10 platinum, and the caravan got a fair horse trade for forged goods.
- (2025-02-02) Sun Dragon was found under a siege of thousands, with its walls breached. Harriet offered to keep paying the party if they stayed and went in with her whatever the outcome. The party instead took payout for 14 days, 140 gold each, and said they would wait about three days and join her if the siege broke. It broke on the third day with giants and imperial troops back in control.

chunks.title: Harriet's Caravan to Sun Dragon (part 3)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Harriet's Caravan to Sun Dragon (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-02-02)
- (2025-02-02) The party was paid out and left her contract. Some mercenaries stayed on for the Dawnrealm leg. Monarch split the party's take at 408 gold, one 50 gp gem and 140 gold contract pay each, and the party headed north from Sun Dragon.

chunks.title: Khanates Unrest and Dawnrealm Infiltration
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Khanates Unrest and Dawnrealm Infiltration (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-03-02)
Also known as: Khan loyalty rumors
Hook: Rumors suggest Khanate clans and Dawnrealm infiltration are shifting loyalties.
Status: advanced
Linked: Dawnrealm, House Mazaali, Khanates
- (2025-01-19) Mercenaries gossiped that some Khans quietly support the Dawnrealm and that the Dawnrealm could win by turning the Khanates through bribery, politics or magic, and by sneaking infiltrators in on caravans.
- (2025-01-19) Khan Torg's clan is disgruntled that the giants keep them out of the war; Eddie corroborated this by listening in.
- (2025-01-19) Anya Redwind, the clan's diplomat and chief merchant, welcomed Monarch as an ally; the Khanates have very few spellcasters.
- (2025-01-19) Predators on the steppe have become less active for unknown reasons, with speculation of something in the Underdark.
- (2025-02-02) The red wargs resent outside control and keep only a minimal allegiance to the Imperium. They said the Dawnrealm fields hobgoblins, fey, ogres and trolls, all with some magical training, and works by bribery and corruption. They said the last big push came four years ago and that the current calm probably means subterfuge.

chunks.title: Khanates Unrest and Dawnrealm Infiltration (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Khanates Unrest and Dawnrealm Infiltration (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-03-02)
- (2025-02-02) The Khanate that Lucia nearly married into (Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan's) is said to be taking Dawnrealm payola, to be a lapdog of Roma, and to have found a secret cache of loot in its ruins. House Mazaali has also had more giant visits than usual, including a cloud giant to the red wargs a couple of months ago described as purely ceremonial.
- (2025-02-02) A cloud giant dropped from the clouds north of the caravan, followed by deep booms and low lightning. Lucia and Eddie read it as a sign of Dawnrealm activity, with experienced caravanners hiding their unease.
- (2025-02-02) Sun Dragon fell to a Dawnrealm-style siege and was retaken within days, apparently after giants secured its teleport circle. The attackers withdrew in order, and the town is now mustering a force to retake the pass.
- (2025-02-16) The Stormgale clan, wealthy and trading with the Dawnrealm, showed Dawnrealm-style goods. Members openly take Dawnrealm bribes and the Khan gets a cut. The clan has no political preference between the Imperium and the Dawnrealm and wants freedom and wealth.
- (2025-02-16) The Dawnrealm is quiet militarily when its money flows. Sun Dragon was its first military push in months.
- (2025-03-02) Sir Raf gave the Khan's council a first-hand report of the Dawnrealm assault on Sun Dragon (performance check 17); their rumors had not been backed by eyewitnesses. The Imperium retook the city, and the party killed a troll. The Azure Sky now expect more Dawnrealm incursions.

chunks.title: Troll in the Gully
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Troll in the Gully (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-02-16)
Also known as: war troll, wounded giant-sized survivor
Hook: The party followed a blood trail from the cloud giant's battlefield to a gully where a starving troll with a spiked chain attacked them.
Status: resolved
Linked: Sun Dragon, Wounded troll
- (2025-02-02) The cloud giant landing site north of Sun Dragon held about half a dozen well-equipped, probably ogre, dead with lightning damage and large footprints. A heavy, apparently regenerating creature crawled away leaving a blood trail that Portia followed with a critical Survival success.
- (2025-02-02) The trail led to a 15-foot gully with a rock blocking a cave. A starving troll with new legs and a spiked chain weapon climbed out and charged the party, who had backed off 60 feet and set up a mind link; the session ended there.
- (2025-02-16) The troll charged the party swinging a spiked chain about 20 feet long; its chain grappled Portia twice (10 damage, then 5 damage) and it reeled her in.
- (2025-02-16) Sir Raf stabbed it for 12 and 8 and Eddie's guiding bolt did 22 radiant; fire (Portia's fire bolt and burning hands, Monarch's wild sorcerer burst for 4) was used against it.
- (2025-02-16) Sir Raf killed it with a natural 20 and cut off its head. Monarch's fire burst cauterized the stump so it did not regenerate.
- (2025-02-16) The troll had no loot. The GM judged it a straggler from the Dawnrealm force that was wiped out earlier. The party took its spiked chain as a trophy.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
Also known as: Ruins of Qul'drik, Ghost Roads
Hook: The party seeks the entrance to the Prison of the Faceless Lord via the Hall of Scales.
Status: advanced
Linked: Chimeg, Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan, Hall of Feasts, Hall of Scales, Jubilex, Prison of the Faceless Lord, Ruins of Qul'drik, Tomar, Tower of Dreams, Tower of Runes, Tower of Storms
- (2025-02-16) The ruins are thought to be giant-built and controlled by the people of the Azure Sky. Giants who leave them forget they exist, and past Imperial attempts to seize them failed amid vanishing units and curses.
- (2025-02-16) Tomar found writings about Ghost Roads beneath the ruins, a network leading into the ethereal realm and other worlds, along which the people of Qul'drik walked away.
- (2025-02-16) Lucia, Raf and Monarch failed wisdom saves and shared a dream of shadows gathering while something enormous stirred beneath the earth. The dream persisted like a memory and Monarch recorded details. Portia and Eddie slept well.
- (2025-02-16) The GM said the ruins could shape the next levels of the campaign.
- (2025-03-02) Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan said anyone may enter the ruins to explore, see and learn, but nothing may be taken out. He will provide an escort, and the party must arrange it with Chimeg. He recommended the upper ruins as low risk and warned that deeper levels are far more dangerous.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 2)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-03-02) Oyun's deciphered writings point to a device deep in the ruins that connects to the elemental plane of air, a ladder to the sky for commanding sky creatures, possibly air elementals. The People of the Azure Sky wants it found before anyone else finds it.
- (2025-03-02) Tomor says the writings describe a passage inside the ruins that lets one walk to the ethereal plane without spells or items. He theorizes giants built the ruins, possibly in the time of Anam, the Allfather and father of giants. Visiting giants forget the ruins, which suggests a spell or curse keeps them away.
- (2025-03-02) Urag Bayarmaa recited a saga about a sleeping colossus that awakens and destroys the world. She believes something sentient and enormously powerful slumbers within or beneath the ruins and that disturbing them could awaken it. It matches the party's earlier shared dream. She warned them to be careful what they awaken.
- (2025-03-02) Oyun told Monarch by message that the party should talk with him before going into the ruins, because he does not want a curse to take hold.
- (2025-03-02) Tomor wants the party to check in with him before entering the ruins so they do not go in blind.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 3)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-05-04) The party, guided by Chimeg, set out for the ruins, a two-day ride. Briefings: ethereal spirits there ignore the living unless noticed, so stay quiet and avoid staring; the giants of old stored power in runes and writing; the ruins are a buried city to be excavated like archaeology.
- (2025-05-04) Sets'en's group, the shaman Urag, Oyun and Tomor each gave warnings: something old stirs beneath the city, a sky-power artifact, and passages leading to the Underdark.
- (2025-05-04) The Khan believes the attack was cover for an incursion into the ruins by a small party with a lightning-throwing mage.
- (2025-05-04) On the first night in the foothills a land shark attacked the camp; Chimeg and the party killed it.
- (2025-05-18) The party rode in under pass without trace and entered the grand entry area, an old caravan campground built of 10 ft by 5 ft stone blocks. Group stealth came to 27.
- (2025-05-18) The Tower of Storms basement is a circular corridor about 20 ft wide with 15 ft stone doors, locked with a lever handle about 7.5 ft up. One door opens on five giant chests and a 10 ft tall humanoid of lightning that watched the party but did not attack; the party closed the door. The mural there tells of a vast amorphous creature the giants bound beneath the city, using lines of power running to arcane towers.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 4)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-05-18) A second door had a false lock over a hidden real lock concealed by an illusion; Monarch found it and Lucia picked it by touch at disadvantage with a 26. Inside were four large manacle stations over inward-facing abjuration circles (red, green, orange, blue) holding the bones of a horned winged fiend (probably a pit fiend), a feathered-winged celestial (probably a planetar), a huge giant (stone, frost, cloud or storm) and a blue dragon. The manacles are an adamantine-mithril alloy covered in giant runes that look related to power transfer, so the prisoners were probably being drained to power something. Raf thinks the green circle may have been made by a wish and protects against good only.
- (2025-05-18) A third door would not move at all; Raf's investigation revealed faint abjuration sigils on it, so the party left it for later and Monarch holds a detect magic scroll. A fourth door was unlocked and untrapped, opening on an overgrown library whose roots and vines stir and crawl toward the party, with something larger lurking in the back. The session ended there.
- (2025-06-01) The library was overgrown with vines. Twig, needle and vine blights and a shambling mound, charged with arcane energy from giant rune stones and book pages, attacked. The party killed them all; the mound resisted fire and cold and was immune to lightning.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 5)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-06-01) Eddie found the library shelves cover constructing permanently enchanted structures. Raf found a giant-language book on the runic system for giant teleportation circles; with enough study and knowledge of a location, one could teleport there unseen. Most books are rotted and written in giant, and the library would take days to search.
- (2025-06-01) Monarch pulled a giant rune stone marked for the room of storms from the shambling mound. It is unusually light and crackling with electricity, and Monarch's Investigation showed it is a container with a seam.
- (2025-06-01) Monarch's clairvoyance behind the sealed upper-right door showed a giant-scale private study with an open drawered chest, a desk and a huge locked stone-and-metal chest. Rhythmic thumping came from the chest, which is about 10x20 feet, and the door seems magically barred.
- (2025-06-01) Clairvoyance behind the other sealed door showed a shattered magic circle, an alchemical desk, an orrery, and a 10x10x20 sarcophagus-like chest ringed by a double circle with three hovering crystalline orbs (blue, yellow, green) that hum a three-note chord. Eddie's Dispel Magic was not available that day.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 6)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-06-01) The party long-rested in Leomund's Tiny Hut upstairs. During Lucia's watch a roughly 15-20 ft stone construct with glowing runes crashed through the forest and glanced her way without attacking. Chimeg named them stonewalkers: implacable, destructive, hostile to everyone, one speed, best outrun on horses.
- (2025-06-01) The lightning creature in the first room attacked when Raf crossed the threshold, using lightning bolt, teleport and slams. It resists physical and rapier damage and is immune to prone, thunder and lightning, but takes psychic, fire and radiant damage. Portia's burning hands at upgraded level made it vanish with a thunderclap, apparently destroyed or driven off.
- (2025-06-01) In the room, Lucia's checks found one chest empty. The ornate chest had a glyph of warding (identified by Monarch, Arcana 22) plus a hinge-wire mechanical trap; Lucia tied off four hinge wires in about 15 minutes. Prying the lid open with a crowbar while enlarged still set off the glyph: thunder and necrotic damage in a 60 ft burst. Lucia took 32 and was deafened for ten minutes; Raf took half (17 thunder and 15 necrotic) and was deafened one round.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 7)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-06-01) The ornate chest held four ceramic canisters with spray valves under the hinges, whose contents never released. Its thick walls hid a sliding-block puzzle that Raf and Monarch solved (Investigation 26). Inside were 400 giant gold coins worth 10 gp each, 200 giant platinum coins worth 10 pp each, and diamonds worth 100, 300, 500 and 1,000, all minted with ancient Qul'drik runes.
- (2025-06-01) The ornate chest also held a giant-sized ring wrapped in velvet, which Lucia unboxed with a Sleight of Hand 30. It crackles with lightning and is the source of the electricity Monarch had thought came from the rune-stone box.
- (2025-06-01) Lucia unwrapped a cloth-wrapped rectangular mirror found in the chest. She heard whispers from it that nobody else heard, her eyes rolled back and she passed out. The session ended there.
- (2025-06-01) Raf's potions of giant strength were considered for forcing the sealed doors, but he reasoned that doors built by giants to keep out other giants would likely resist them. The party planned to try the thumping-chest door next, and to deal with the other door and the remaining lightning-room chests later.
- (2025-06-15) Lucia's vision in the mirror showed the giant city in its glory, with cloud and fire giants and visiting chromatic and metallic dragons. A scene resembling the mural looked like a negotiation with an aspect of Tiamat, who permitted one scale of each color to be removed, rather than a battle.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 8)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-06-15) The vision showed the shapeless creature (changing between liquid, gel and solid, using acid, lightning and fire) destroying much of the city before it was bound. The towers were built for the binding, some beforehand on prophecy and some rapidly by magic from preplanned diagrams.
- (2025-06-15) Lucia, on leaving the vision, memorized a rhyme and recited it after an Intelligence check of 18: 'The rhyme must never be spoken. Her minions must not find the token, lest both great prisons be broken and faceless lord reawoken.' The GM said it rhymes in both Giant and Common.
- (2025-06-15) Monarch and Sir Raf recognized 'faceless lord' as another name for the demon lord Jubilex, a shapeless ooze lord of the Abyss. The GM said the shapeless thing in the murals could be an aspect of him.
- (2025-06-15) The party dispelled the magical seal on the second door, and Lucia picked its giant-scale lock with a Sleight of Hand check of 35. It opened onto a wizard's work room containing a shattered permanent summoning circle, an orrery and a puzzle-box chest ringed by protective circles with three floating spheres.
- (2025-06-15) Eddie knocked on the abjured chest. It released a force blast: Portia and Monarch failed the Dexterity save and took 17 force damage, and Lucia and Eddie took 8. Portia was out of range at 32 feet.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 9)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-06-15) Monarch's clairvoyance showed a thorned, spiked, tailed devil crouched in the chest holding a ball of fire. By message it said it was betrayed and wanted only to return home, that fire was its nature and not a spell, and that the missing masks were stolen perhaps by one like it, but not by it. The party left it sealed.
- (2025-06-15) The orrery shows the world's sun, planet, moon and a planetoid called Obsidius, on a roughly ninety-year orbit. Moving it showed about 700 years since it was set. Obsidius passes between moon and planet in a double eclipse today, which matches Monarch's birth year, the year of the black moon.
- (2025-06-15) Portia's pan flute matched the gold sphere's tone and triggered a thunder blast. She made a Constitution save and took half of 22 damage. Eddie then shot the spheres with a blunted longbow in the order moon, Obsidius, planet. This produced a chord, and the circles stopped glowing and the puzzle chest could be worked. Shooting the wrong sphere first shattered the desk.
- (2025-06-15) Monarch and Lucia, enlarged by Monarch's spell, solved the puzzle box and picked its two locks (Sleight of Hand 25 and 26). It held 40-50 preserved books on Tiamat, Bahamut, Kyber, Siberys, Jubilex and Zoriat in many languages. The party loaded them on pack horses and a bag of holding, and Portia reset the orrery to a wrong date to relock the circles.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 10)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-06-15) The Tower of Storms was one of several towers feeding the binding. Finding two more towers would let the party triangulate the binding site. Monarch's aerial scouting (Perception 24) could not see the collapsed towers under the canopy, but showed an oblong city running northwest to southeast with the tower circle in its middle section and this tower at its southern edge. The size of the circle is still unknown.
- (2025-06-15) The party camped off the trail at a random campsite (Survival 11 for Eddie, rolling two ones with advantage). The long rest was undisturbed. Identify showed the giant ring is a ring of lightning resistance needing no attunement, and the mirror is a mirror of the past usable once per day, whose visions leave a lingering imprint such as Lucia's backwards words and giant accent.
- (2025-07-13) From the top of the Tower of Dreams, Portia's reading of the tree canopy showed likely fallen-stone building sites. The Tower of Dreams only dreams itself into the astral plane, so the rest of the city is not visible there.
- (2025-07-13) The Tower of Runes lies about a mile from the Tower of Dreams, farther than the Tower of Dreams is from the Tower of Storms. The GM said this suggests the ring of towers may be oblong rather than a perfect circle, which makes finding the center trickier.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 11)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-07-13) The Tower of Runes is a spiral of massive floating rune-covered stones that shift, rotate and change orientation. Some stones' gravity turns 90 degrees, and the lowest stone hangs 10 feet off the ground. The stones are cracked and scorched yet still crackle with magic, animated glyphs crawl across them, and a chant-like vibration can be felt but not heard.
- (2025-07-13) A circle of glowing runes hovers just above the ground and marks the tower's circumference. The GM said anyone inside it is underneath the tower.
- (2025-07-13) Near the last stone of the spiral sits a cracked black crystal threaded with adamant-like runes that stays on the stone as gravity flips. Raf, Eddie and the others think that studying its runes with the new book's knowledge could reveal its purpose. Raf thinks the tower may serve just as a reference point to find the center.
- (2025-07-13) The Tower of Runes guardians are stone constructs. Chimeg said they are unstoppable and kill whatever they see, and she has never heard of one being killed or reasoned with. Raf's Giant plea to the guardian did nothing. The party fought a Runestone Guardian with ranged force blasts and a slow effect, and learned that it is immune to psychic damage but can be knocked prone. Portia's Land's Aid necrotic damage cracked it, and it had been struck by thunder, fire, piercing and radiant damage. Its attacks dealt 34, 26 and 22 force.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 12)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-07-13) The party finished the guardian fight with it cracking. The party then took a long rest in rocks to the southeast with the tower in view.
- (2025-07-27) A cultist note fragment said the Lexus was atop the Tower of Runes; a lexis is a catalog of a language, useful as a Rosetta-stone key.
- (2025-07-27) The tower's crystal houses a 3x2 foot stone tablet. The party climbed the Tower of Runes through a skill challenge (4 successes per tier, concentration check first); Monarch shrank, went inside, and bagged the tablet in her bag of holding, escaping by Misty Step while Portia's countersong (16 with Monarch's aid) held the crystal open.
- (2025-07-27) Once the tablet is out, the tower's defenses went off (tiers locked, suppression gone). The tablet is a Graven Lexus of binding runes linking giant runes to early elven sigils, giving +5 to Arcana checks on binding runes.
- (2025-07-27) Portia, touching a living vine rune, learned the Rune of Grasping, a bonus-action cantrip adding +2 to save DC and attack of restraining or incapacitating spells.
- (2025-07-27) Lucia recognized a simplified form of her house sigil as an ancient giant rune on the tower. She had seen it woven in a cloth in the secure room called the well at a family estate. The GM said the rune predates her house.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 13)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-07-27) Using the Tower of Storms, Tower of Dreams and Tower of Runes, Portia (natural 20 survival) triangulated the prison's location, slightly off-center from the central building. The party chose to head for the Hall of Blades.
- (2025-07-27) Within about a mile of the tower the party found a 600-foot circle of hacked-down forest around a low hill, with a dozen humanoids dead for over a week, chopped to bits, including cultists. A giant-scale doorway into the hill was dug out to 5 feet and no one had come out. Eddie's locate object found a cult symbol among the bodies. The cult is sending poorly equipped fanatic squads, expecting many to fail.
- (2025-07-27) The party entered the Hall of Blades, a 200-foot-wide hall with 30-foot ceilings holding about 200 floating blades held by spirits, and a runed pedestal at its center.
- (2025-08-10) The Hall of Blades holds roughly 200 floating swords; the room's blades attack those who become enemies, which comes from attacking swords or the keeper, and stop when someone holds Black Razor and orders stand down. Chimeg did so, then dropped it after a natural 20 Charisma save.
- (2025-08-10) The party took a long rest in the Hall of Blades; Raf detected magic and found a plus one greatsword, Shatterspike (plus one adamantine longsword, slashing or bludgeoning), and a slumbering blue dragon's wrath scimitar that Portia took; Eddie's rapier is a sword of wounding (extra 2d6 necrotic, DC 15 Con). Raf took Shatterspike.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 14)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-08-10) They traveled the old road south; Portia's familiar spotted a rune guardian on the Hall of Blades to Tower of Ruins road. They found chimney tops of the buried Hall of Feasts, a giant city hall, banquet hall and battle arena.
- (2025-08-10) Familiars Dora and Diego scouted the feast hall via a roasting-pit chimney: giant-sized tables, mosaics of political feasts including devils and metallic dragons, mostly rubble-blocked exits, a hidden door under a mosaic matching one table, and tables that constantly tidy themselves magically.
- (2025-08-10) The party believes the Prison of the Faceless Lord is north of the Hall of Feasts, under the city; the GM said they know its location but not how to reach it.
- (2025-08-24) Monarch said the party believes the Prison of the Faceless Lord lies below ground north of the Hall of Feasts with no entrance there; the entrance is through the Hall of Scales.
- (2025-08-24) The party went down the roasting-pit chimney into the Hall of Feasts: a three-level banquet hall with a sunken center, pillars, a high table with three big chairs to the north, and mosaics of giant feasts including a reclining silver dragon along the table.
- (2025-08-24) Statues by the high table are labeled in Giant as the office 'keeper of the seal'; the biggest statue is labeled for the office 'Lord of Coolrick'; neither is a specific individual and the biggest is not articulated.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 15)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-08-24) Behind the Hall of Feasts lie a kitchen with enchanted pantry shelves and magical casks, a guest study with books of ancient common literature, a sculptor's workshop, a brewery of magical drafts, and a Chamber of Trials. The giants appear to have deliberately left the city, taking their good books.
- (2025-09-21) After the Hall of Feasts, the party headed cross-country toward the Hall of Scales, navigating by a crude map (Eddie's survival check), and found the rocky outcropping and cave.
- (2025-10-19) Monarch performed the Chalice of Accord ritual (Performance 22 with guidance and tides of chaos), offering giant wasp mead; the portal's purple energy vanished, opening a 30-foot-wide tunnel.
- (2025-10-19) Beyond the portal is a deep scaled tunnel and amphitheater where silver and blue dragon spirits asked 'wisdom that binds or power that dominates?'. Raf and Monarch answered power, Eddie and Portia wisdom; the blue dragon thundered. After the party all answered wisdom, the silver dragon healed them for 35 and a passage opened.
- (2025-10-19) Eddie learned the great debate: metallic and chromatic dragons argued whether giants should wield draconic power, whether by wisdom or dominance; it was never settled, and the dragons stayed to help against the Faceless Lord.

chunks.title: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (part 16)
names: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Mystery of the Ruins of Qul'drik and the Ghost Roads (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-10-19)
- (2025-10-19) The passage descends into slime; a 60-foot crevasse filled with ooze and bones, where Portia calmed the psychic ooze colony with empathy. Eddie, winged and enlarged by Monarch, flew the party across.
- (2025-10-19) The cavern holds ten colossal dragon statues around a shattered platform now a pit of ooze, 60 feet across, under a web of strained glowing abjuration runes. The blue dragon mask floats at its center, 30 feet from the edge.

chunks.title: Warrior's Challenge
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Warrior's Challenge (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: Storm's Challenge, warriors contest, honor feast contest
Hook: The three-day Warrior's Challenge concluded with Sir Raf as ultimate champion and the party honored by the People of the Azure Sky.
Status: resolved
Linked: Ardeg, Chimeg, Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan
- (2025-03-02) Chimeg announced a three-day warriors contest. Events are riding, shooting, battle magic, close fighting and siege, plus an all-events overall. Day one is riding and shooting, day two battle magic and close fighting, day three siege. Everything is solo, in best-of-three rounds except siege, and weapons are not blunted.
- (2025-03-02) Competitors either qualify, becoming actual or honorary clan members, or win, which brings a gift from the Khan. No one has won every event in many years. The party concluded they need honorary membership so they can take things from the ruins, so each member should enter events.
- (2025-03-16) Kyle laid out the rules: five events over three days (riding and shooting on day one, battle magic and close combat on day two, siege on day three). Contestants can enter any event; the overall champion must succeed at all five and win more events than other all-five entrants. Duels are fought to quarter, scored by percentage of hit points remaining.
- (2025-03-16) Renown with the Azure Sky is on offer: one for each event win, one for beating a challenger as a volunteer opponent, and a sixth for the overall champion.

chunks.title: Warrior's Challenge (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Warrior's Challenge (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
- (2025-03-16) Riding: Lucia scored 62, Portia 51, Eddie 57, Sir Raf 55 and Monarch 68. Monarch won the riding event, earning one Renown with the Azure Sky; all five PCs succeeded and became honorary clan members.
- (2025-03-16) Lucia's riding score reached 43 after two heats, passing the event; Dagha was seen watching her ride with surprise and appreciation.
- (2025-03-16) Shooting: Lucia won with 67 and gained one Renown; Sir Raf was runner-up with 64. Because Lucia skipped the battle magic duel, her win cannot count toward the overall championship.
- (2025-03-16) After day one, Monarch led the all-five entrants with one win, while Sir Raf had the highest overall score.
- (2025-03-16) Battle magic, day two: Eddie chose the heats, scoring 22 on the save and 60 total with a 23-to-hit Guiding Bolt for 18 damage. Sir Raf, Monarch and Portia chose duels. Sir Raf beat a hedge wizard (who used Hold Person three times) and ended at 100% hit points. Monarch lost to a Dawnrealm-robed mage's lightning bolt (27 damage against Monarch's 26 hit points) and failed the event. Portia beat a priest of Tyr and finished at 100%.
- (2025-03-16) Sir Raf and the Tyr priest tied at 100%. In the tiebreaker duel Sir Raf won when the priest asked for quarter, so Sir Raf wins the battle magic event. With Lucia out, Sir Raf has a strong shot at the overall championship if he wins one of the two remaining events.

chunks.title: Warrior's Challenge (part 3)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Warrior's Challenge (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
- (2025-03-16) Aid at 5 hit points was cast on the competitors by Eddie; a contest mystic (Urag) cast dispel magic on Sir Raf ten minutes before his duel, removing spells of third level or lower. The GM also reminded the party that other people may not buff competitors in that window.
- (2025-03-16) Chimeg intends to fight at least one PC in the next day's battles to quarter and promised to make sure they earn it.
- (2025-03-16) The party earned 15% XP for three of five events; they are now level 4.4, with a bigger reward promised when the full event is finished.
- (2025-04-20) In the final event, the defender had to ask for quarter and the attacker had to breach the gate or a wall. Scoring is mainly health at the end, with speed as the tiebreaker. Entrants were Eddie, Ardeg, Monarch and Sir Raf, in that order.
- (2025-04-20) Eddie beat his archer with moonbeam and guiding bolt, breaching the gate on round five and finishing at 30 of 35 HP. Ardeg took about eight rounds and ended at about half HP, so Eddie ranks ahead of her.
- (2025-04-20) Monarch fought a Khanate warrior for about 15 rounds. She used vortex warp, charm person (the warrior stayed friendly and offered to fake a fight so it looked legitimate) and chill touch. He surrendered once bloodied, and she finished at 22 of 26 HP after secretly sipping a healing potion.

chunks.title: Warrior's Challenge (part 4)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Warrior's Challenge (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
- (2025-04-20) Sir Raf's match against Chimeg was disrupted by an invisible stalker before it concluded. Chimeg called a halt and told Raf they would need to redo it tomorrow, giving him a second bite at the apple.
- (2025-04-20) The clan judged that the party was not cheating: Monarch's faerie fire made the stalker visible, Raf attacked it at once, and the shaman said it does not normally glow.
- (2025-05-04) Sir Raf's rescheduled final bout against Chimeg was held with VIP seating built overnight. Raf beat her with blade ward, shield, a Diego distraction and rapier hits (11, 8, 9, 13) and she asked quarter once bloodied; Raf was at 32 of 43 HP.
- (2025-05-04) Every PC won one event (Portia close quarters, Raf battle magic, Lucia shooting, Monarch riding, Eddie siege). Raf was the only one to qualify in all events, making him ultimate champion.
- (2025-05-04) Event winners got 1 renown with the clan, 500 gp each; Raf got a second renown, 1,000 gp, a war horse (Redhoof) and two potions of hill giant strength from the Khan. The party are honorary clan members known by sight.

chunks.title: Assassination Plot Against Chimeg
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Assassination Plot Against Chimeg (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: attempt on Chimeg's life
Hook: Tsetsen warned an attempt will be made on Chimeg's life under cover of the Warrior's Challenge.
Status: advanced
Linked: Chimeg, Sets'en, Tsetsen
- (2025-03-02) Tsetsen, disguised as an old woman, visited the camp and told Monarch and Lucia that infiltrators in the contest will try to kill Chimeg, who runs the contest and could step into events. The plot is within their own clan, so he asked the outsiders to keep watch. Monarch relayed it to the group.
- (2025-03-16) During the battle magic event a solo wanderer contestant refused to give quarter when asked. Chimeg ran onto the field and tackled him; he surrendered at once and was dragged off and ejected, and nobody knows where he went.
- (2025-03-16) Afterwards Chimeg looked under the weather, tired and sitting down, with no obvious diagnosis. Eddie's medicine check could find no cause; Lucia's check (15) suggested at most a low dose of poison, perhaps meant to leave her in bad shape for something later.
- (2025-03-16) Monarch tried to canvass witnesses for where the wanderer went with a Persuasion roll using heroic inspiration; it failed. Monarch blames the party for dropping the ball after being warned of the plot.
- (2025-03-16) Lucia warned Chimeg that this was no accident and suggested she cut back her duties, but Chimeg laughed it off and said she would personally fight in the duels to quarter.

chunks.title: Assassination Plot Against Chimeg (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Assassination Plot Against Chimeg (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
- (2025-04-20) During Raf's match an invisible air creature crossed the fence into the fort and attacked Chimeg. The vortex slashed her for 19 and grappled her and Raf. Chimeg took 10 thunder damage and became bloodied; Raf made his save after rerolling with heroic inspiration.
- (2025-04-20) Sir Raf and Chimeg fought the creature side by side. The clan's arrows and the shaman's spells then destroyed it.
- (2025-04-20) The shaman Urag identified it as an invisible stalker, an air elemental summoned for assassination, which does not normally glow. Someone else brought it, and who did is still unknown.
- (2025-04-20) Earlier, the Easterling mage cast a spell that Lucia and Portia read as sending, and a Stormgale clan member whispered to him. After that, a Stormgale clan member left a 10-foot swirl of flattened grass in a field and walked casually toward the crowd. This was a suspected summoner.
- (2025-04-20) Eddie hit the Stormgale member with a guiding bolt for 16, and he kept concentration on a natural 20. Eddie later critted him for 23 and broke his concentration. The member fought with a greataxe, hit Eddie for 7, and was defeated with the crowd's help.
- (2025-04-20) Lucia hit the unseen stalker with a psychic blade for 9. Raf shot it twice with arrows, and Monarch's faerie fire lit it up.
- (2025-04-20) The Easterling mage looked vexed at a failed plan and made no move to get involved. Lucia kept a readied attack on him.

chunks.title: Assassination Plot Against Chimeg (part 3)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Assassination Plot Against Chimeg (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
- (2025-04-20) Portia sent Chimeg a message warning of an invisible creature in the tower. Chimeg did not reply but glanced around.
- (2025-04-20) Eddie would like to hand the captured Stormgale member to the party's spymaster friend, and the GM said the clan would let them capture him. The clan treats the fight as one between outsiders.
- (2025-05-04) Chimeg was ready and vigilant in the final bout, and the crowd, armed and armored, deterred any interference. The Khan said the attempt on Chimeg's life and the disruption of the rituals cannot go unanswered.

chunks.title: Sabotage the Stormgale-Dawnrealm Alliance
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Sabotage the Stormgale-Dawnrealm Alliance (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: Tsetsen's mercenary job
Hook: Tsetsen's mercenary job to sabotage the Stormgale clan's alliance with the Dawnrealm.
Status: advanced
Linked: Stormgale clan camp, Tsetsen
- (2025-03-02) Tsetsen quietly asked Monarch whether the party is a mercenary band for hire. He said a nearby clan seeks the ruins, and Tomor relayed by message that Stormgale is backed by the Dawnrealm and could control the ruins by year's end unless the alliance is sabotaged.
- (2025-03-02) Tsetsen glanced around the room, suggesting others in the Azure Sky might be on the Dawnrealm payroll. The job is a small-team infiltration, not an attack on the clan.
- (2025-04-20) A Stormgale clan member, in clan colors, was tied to the stalker attack on Chimeg. Eddie fought and helped defeat him.
- (2025-04-20) The Easterling mage has Dawnrealm links in the table's reading, and he is still unresolved.
- (2025-05-04) The Khan decided the clan's main forces will go to war against Stormgale to remind them who has the upper hand, while a small group goes to the ruins. Chimeg noted Stormgale are shrewd merchants friendly with the Dawnrealm and the Easterling may have been playing them.
- (2025-05-04) The clan began preparing for war; the Khan's people were mounting up and preparations take a couple of days.

chunks.title: Interlopers in the Upper Ruins
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Interlopers in the Upper Ruins (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-18)
Also known as: falcon sightings, Jochi's falcon reports
Hook: A Dawnrealm-linked cult group is operating in the ruins ahead of the party.
Status: advanced
