Linked: Chimeg, Cult of the Dragon Resurgence, Erden Batu, Jochi
- (2025-03-02) Jochi reports groups of four to six humanoids skulking in the upper ruins, but no one finds them. The clan can see anyone leaving across the open ground. General Batu needs solid scouting before he deploys a force, and he offered spot bounties to mercenaries who bring interlopers out.
- (2025-03-02) Portia offered to wild shape and scout to corroborate the falcon reports, and Jochi welcomed it. Sir Raf urged General Batu to use the falcons as another surveillance layer.
- (2025-03-16) Portia asked about local wildlife for wild shape so she can do the lookout mission; Kyle listed horses, plains lions, hawks, falcons (eagles near the mountains), snakes, rodents and yak-like beasts. She cannot fly yet, so birds are not available.
- (2025-05-18) Tracks of horses shod like Khanate mounts, no more than a week old, along with the clawed prints of a running bipedal reptile, led around the ruins' perimeter along a hacked trail. The path had two trip lines, likely alarms, that Lucia disarmed.

chunks.title: Interlopers in the Upper Ruins (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Interlopers in the Upper Ruins (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-05-18)
- (2025-05-18) Five riding horses were found hidden under trees north of the trail. Four cultists with fire-forged wavy daggers and a fanatic spellcaster came up out of a stairwell, led by a red half-dragon with a 30 ft fire cone breath that did 26 on a failed save. Chimeg joined the fight and was held by the fanatic's hold person until Lucia broke the fanatic's concentration. The party killed the half-dragon and the cultists, and the daggers stopped flaming when their owners died.
- (2025-05-18) The cultists looked like Dawnrealmers in disguise: their writing was in a Dawnrealm script and some coins had holes in the middle, though their gear was acquired in the Imperium. The fanatic wore purple splashes as rank and carried a cult symbol like the one already found; she was the only one with it.

chunks.title: Dawnrealm Noble Prisoner
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Dawnrealm Noble Prisoner (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-03-02)
Also known as: captured Dawnrealm noble
Hook: The Azure Sky hold a captured Dawnrealm noble who won't talk, and the party may help interrogate or learn from her.
Status: open
Linked: Tsetsen
- (2025-03-02) The Azure Sky captured a Dawnrealm noble who tried to extract items from the ruins; her entourage was killed. They plan to trade her at the right time. They suspect the Dawnrealm's seizure of Sun Dragon gave cover for teams to enter the Imperium.
- (2025-03-02) Tsetsen handles interrogations. The party plans to ask him during the tournament about the prisoner and more Dawnrealm information.

chunks.title: Chimeg's Whispering Blade
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Chimeg's Whispering Blade (first seen 2025-03-02, last seen 2025-08-10)
Also known as: Oyun's cursed blade
Hook: Chimeg's blade was one half of Black Razor and is gone, which may explain the whispering.
Status: advanced
Linked: Chimeg, Oyun Temur
- (2025-03-02) Oyun told Monarch that the blade, made from enchanted true steel brought up from below, whispers to Chimeg at night and he thinks something lives in it. She won't let him near it, and he fears it has a hold on her. Monarch promised to see what she could do, possibly getting it away from Chimeg, while Chimeg guides them.
- (2025-05-04) The GM recalled that Chimeg's enchanted greatsword, made from materials from Qul'drik, has started whispering to her; the party may learn about the materials or how to lift the curse.
- (2025-08-10) Her blade was made from steel of a broken blade found earlier, which the party now understands to be a piece of Black Razor; the keeper took it and fused the halves.
- (2025-08-10) Raf chose to wait and see rather than intervene, noting Chimeg had not gone berserk.

chunks.title: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence (first seen 2025-05-04, last seen 2026-07-12)
Also known as: Cult of the Dragon
Hook: The dragon masks, used to free Tiamat, are sought by many groups.
Status: advanced
Linked: Cult of the Dragon Amulet, Dragon Cultist Cavern, Dragon Masks, Gate of Dragons, Ruins of Qul'drik, Sets'en, The Dreamcaster, Tiamat
- (2025-05-04) Sets'en showed Monarch a flat brass amulet with four inward-curling fangs, staring eyes and flames, found at the Easterling mage's abandoned camp. Monarch's history check identified it as the symbol of the Cult of the Dragon, linked to Tiamat and chromatic dragons, long thought extinct.
- (2025-05-04) The amulet is unenchanted, untarnished and recently made. The camp held evidence of up to 10 occupants, though only a couple were seen.
- (2025-05-04) Monarch practiced Prestidigitation to forge a copy that could pass at a distance; Eddie sketched it and Portia saw it. Tomor said the cult sought to free Tiamat from the Hells.
- (2025-05-18) The GM explained that chromatic dragons make half-dragon servants by a rite that binds them to the creating dragon. Followers aspire to it, and half-dragons keep pace with horses; Portia and Monarch recalled the rite.
- (2025-05-18) The cult group's leader was a fanatic carrying a second cult symbol, in the party's possession now; her notes show she was hunting the mask's location in the Tower of Storms basement.

chunks.title: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence (first seen 2025-05-04, last seen 2026-07-12)
- (2025-06-15) The GM recapped that the Cult of the Dragon wants to free Tiamat from her prison in the hells and believes the Dragon Masks are the keys. The party reasons that taking the mask first denies it to them. The Cult would value the dragon-lore books, so the party camped away from the trail to keep them safe.
- (2025-06-15) Chimeg says Khanate people would never clear a wide road as the cultists did, and the path they cut leaves them exposed to nearby griffins.
- (2025-07-27) A letter on a cultist addressed 'esteemed flame keeper' said the Hall of Blades guards echoes of oaths tied to the mask's last bearer, the thorn betrayer; the swords remember who took it, and the path to the blue dragon mask begins there.
- (2025-07-27) The party found multiple groups of cultists, all poorly equipped; some ran afoul of something at the Hall of Blades.
- (2025-09-21) Diego scouted the cave: about 20 dragon cultists led by a blue and a white half dragon and the Dreamcaster from the Tower of Dreams, with horses and an ornate archway with six dragon heads (five metallics plus Bahamut) at the back. Remains of humanoids killed by fire, acid and frost lie in front of it.
- (2025-09-21) A saddled wyvern sleeps camouflaged on top of the outcropping, spotted by Dora with a 19.
- (2025-09-21) The cultists seem to be brute-forcing the archway. Raf suggested attacking from behind while they're occupied. Because spell slots were low, the party agreed to long rest and plan next session.

chunks.title: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence (part 3)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence (first seen 2025-05-04, last seen 2026-07-12)
- (2025-09-21) Monarch used the Mirror of the Past on the Dreamcaster. It showed him organizing parties from this cave, meeting a hooded figure in Roma near the Wizards District, on a sky-landing ship at sea, and flying on a wyvern with a red dragonborn man and a tiefling woman.
- (2025-10-05) The party lured out and killed the cult's saddled wyvern: Monarch's Earthbind, Eddie's Silence, Portia's fireballs, Eddie's crit rapier stab for 33.
- (2025-10-05) Eddie and Lucia shot down two cultist minders with longbows; Monarch hid the corpse with Major Image; Portia's fireball hit the cave's back table.
- (2025-10-05) Half blue and half white dragons, two fanatics and cultists fought; the party killed the half blue, half white, fanatics and cultists, leaving the Dreamcaster.
- (2025-10-05) A fanatic tried Hold Person on Raf and Eddie; both saved, Raf with a 20.
- (2025-10-05) The cult's wyvern was likely trained not to attack horses; the cultists keep horses stabled in the cave.
- (2025-10-05) The Dreamcaster pulled Lucia into a wedding dream, then cast mass suggestion to leave and return to the con. Monarch, Chimeg and Raf failed; Eddie and Portia saved.
- (2025-10-19) The Dreamcaster was killed. He carried a Cult of the Dragon amulet, 14 gems of 500 gp, 26 platinum, 15 gold, 38 silver, three identical obsidian coins with a five-headed dragon and a magical pouch of sand (enchantment).

chunks.title: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence (part 4)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence (first seen 2025-05-04, last seen 2026-07-12)
- (2025-10-19) Raf's History check (16) suggested the coins are Tiamat markers of favors owed by the cult; Monarch could not tell if they were tooled or magically made.
- (2025-10-19) His notes showed he did not know how to open the portal or that the mask was part of anything else, only that it lay beneath Qul'drik. There are about six more bedrolls than cultists, so others may remain.
- (2026-05-17) In the Astral library the dragon masks were revealed as the key to a ritual freeing Tiamat from her planar prison; only two are needed. Four groups were seeking them, and Cult members wandered the library.
- (2026-05-17) A mask is destroyed when an ancient white dragon willingly casts wish to destroy it, true of all the masks.
- (2026-05-17) The party shared that they know where the white mask is, and no other group knew where the blue mask is.
- (2026-06-14) Monarch told Lunae the masks free Tiamat and can be destroyed only if an ancient dragon of that type willingly casts wish. Lunae warned that most dragons would benefit from Tiamat's return, so a chromatic dragon is unlikely to make the wish, though a selfish ancient might. She suggested a dragon from another time.
- (2026-06-14) The Norge hold the white dragon mask.
- (2026-07-12) Monarch said the party's personal goal is to obtain the Cherek's white dragon mask to keep Tiamat from returning.

chunks.title: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence (part 5)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Cult of the Dragon Resurgence (first seen 2025-05-04, last seen 2026-07-12)
- (2026-07-12) Eddie attuned to the blue dragon mask and then passed it to Monarch, who attuned to it. The GM said it gives Draconic, charisma-based credibility with chromatic dragons, a legendary resistance, and an AC boost to Monarch of plus five.
- (2026-07-12) Monarch recalled the Tiamat-sworn exchange, in which both sides swear to Tiamat to keep the bargain on penalty of her wrath.

chunks.title: Replacement Legendary Item for the Prison
names: Replacement Legendary Item for the Prison
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Replacement Legendary Item for the Prison (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: replace the mask
Hook: The party swapped Black Razor into the Faceless Lord's prison runes and removed the blue dragon mask, creating a darker, hungrier warden.
Status: resolved
Linked: Black Razor, Chimeg, Graven Lexus of Binding, Hall of Blades, Prison of the Faceless Lord
- (2025-07-27) Chimeg said no legendary item has been retrieved from the surface ruins, deeper areas are dangerous, and her inclination was the Hall of Blades.
- (2025-07-27) Monarch's Insight check (11) found no deception in Chimeg, though she keeps her greatsword close.
- (2025-08-10) Monarch and Portia reasoned that the mask's power must be replaced with something of equal power, and Black Razor, an unbroken artifact now reformed, could serve as the swap if it does not kill them first.
- (2025-08-10) Monarch said earlier that they need the mask plus an artifact to put in its place, and that Chimeg's blade might count.
- (2025-09-21) Studying the Graven Lexus, the party concluded the abjuration runes it covers are the kind holding the Faceless Lord. It gives the knowledge to alter the prison enchantment, installing Black Razor as power source and removing the Blue Dragon mask.
- (2025-09-21) The GM said the mask may be the keystone sustaining the prison, so taking it without a replacement could collapse it.

chunks.title: Replacement Legendary Item for the Prison (part 2)
names: Replacement Legendary Item for the Prison
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Replacement Legendary Item for the Prison (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-10-19) Raf's Arcana (27) on the Graven Lexus showed the swap needs three people at once: one opens a hole for Black Razor while two strengthen the runes, and the same again to remove the mask. If the mask is pulled first it bursts.
- (2025-10-19) Eddie's augury: swapping Black Razor for the mask gave 'wheel'; adding Black Razor and leaving the mask gave 'wheel then woe'; taking the mask and leaving Black Razor was also judged good. The entity answering was the one who gave Eddie wings.
- (2025-10-19) Protection from Evil and Good is mandatory for whoever handles Black Razor. Plan: Raf casts it on that person and Eddie casts guidance on Portia. The party ended the session executing the plan next time, wanting Lucia present.
- (2025-10-19) Monarch took 6 necrotic damage when she tried to put Black Razor away.
- (2025-11-02) Monarch learned the Graven Lexus bonus (+5 Arcana) cannot be used by two people at once, so Sir Raf did the swap; Portia received guidance from Eddie, and Raf and Eddie cast Protection from Evil and Good beforehand.
- (2025-11-02) A gold dragon spirit warned that Black Razor would turn the unthinking prison into a warden with a will of its own, stronger but not passive. It said the party chose a path that does not violate their pact, that it could not intervene, and that the great dragon should help them.

chunks.title: Replacement Legendary Item for the Prison (part 3)
names: Replacement Legendary Item for the Prison
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Replacement Legendary Item for the Prison (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-11-02) Black Razor was installed first, and Portia's check reached 14 with heroic inspiration and Monarch's bend luck. After many rounds of Arcana checks the web held. The mask was then extracted and the web re-stabilized with two natural 20s, and Raf dropped the mask into Monarch's Bag of Holding.
- (2025-11-02) The rune web turned to black, ink-like binding magic that pressed the chaos back into the pit. The prison walls and caves darkened and began to sweat black ooze, and the party felt sudden hunger.
- (2025-11-02) Around the Ruins of Qul'drik, trees draw darkness into their roots and the ground softens into dark bog. The effect is localized to the valley, and the party's hunger faded as they traveled away.
- (2025-11-02) Chimeg, who witnessed everything, said she will send scouts back to the ruins to see what is happening there.
- (2025-11-02) The party chose to tell the Khan and clan everything. The chalice and the ritual instructions are the only way into the prison and stay with the party, and Monarch said they must not be kept in the same bag of holding.
- (2025-11-02) Monarch noted a standing option that if the party finds another artifact, it can be added to or replace Black Razor in the prison.

chunks.title: Chimeg's Shadow-Flaming Greatsword at the Hall of Blades
names: Chimeg's Shadow-Flaming Greatsword at the Hall of Blades
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Chimeg's Shadow-Flaming Greatsword at the Hall of Blades (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-08-10)
Also known as: Chimeg's greatsword
Hook: The shadow-flame blade answering Chimeg's greatsword proved to be Black Razor, a soul-eating artifact now in Monarch's bag of holding.
Status: advanced
Linked: Chimeg, Hall of Blades
- (2025-07-27) Chimeg walked to the pedestal; a longsword-looking greatsword held by a smoking black fire-giant spirit approached, the other blades parting for it, and Chimeg's greatsword began smoking with shadow flames. The session ended there.
- (2025-08-10) The ghostly fire giant keeper's blade was identified by history checks (Raf 18, Portia 15, Eddie 8) as Black Razor, a deeply evil soul-eating greatsword that has toppled and made empires and controls its wielders; it was thought to be entombed in a mountain stronghold, not here.
- (2025-08-10) Monarch's Investigation study found it was no illusion but looked wrong and incomplete; the Smith who made Chimeg's blade had used steel from a blade found on a previous expedition, so Chimeg's blade was the missing half.
- (2025-08-10) The keeper attacked Chimeg, who fell unconscious; it took her blade and reforged Black Razor whole, then cast haste via the blade's whispers. Chimeg's blade had been giving her advantage in the fight.
- (2025-08-10) The party killed the keeper: Monarch's heightened Lightning Bolt (DC 16 Dex, 32 base damage) hit it, Raf finished it with Booming Blade. Black Razor dropped to the floor.

chunks.title: Chimeg's Shadow-Flaming Greatsword at the Hall of Blades (part 2)
names: Chimeg's Shadow-Flaming Greatsword at the Hall of Blades
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Chimeg's Shadow-Flaming Greatsword at the Hall of Blades (first seen 2025-07-27, last seen 2025-08-10)
- (2025-08-10) Chimeg said her mind felt clearer, the sword had grown on her, and she did not want it but would watch whoever carried it.
- (2025-08-10) Monarch picked it up wrapped in a stone camouflage blanket; it spoke 'now we will slay' to her and tried to charm her into not stowing it. She failed her Charisma save (13, then rerolled with heroic inspiration), but protection from evil and good prevented the charm and she bagged it. Monarch plans to attune to it after a long rest.

chunks.title: Secret Door in the Hall of Feasts Mosaic
names: Secret Door in the Hall of Feasts Mosaic
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Secret Door in the Hall of Feasts Mosaic (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: secret door, hidden door, seam in the mosaic
Hook: The seam in the Hall of Feasts mosaic hid a door that opened once the feast was laid out as the mosaic shows.
Status: resolved
Linked: Hall of Feasts
- (2025-08-24) Raf rolled a 20 on perception and found no catch or trigger on the seam; the GM said the means of opening is probably elsewhere, and the mosaic edges seem slightly separate from the walls.
- (2025-08-24) Detect magic showed abjuration magic glowing around the seam. Eddie's dispel magic (wisdom check 18) ended the abjuration effect, but the wall still did not move.
- (2025-08-24) Raf's crowbar attempt (19 plus 7) snapped some edge tiles but moved nothing.
- (2025-08-24) Monarch's working theory is that setting the broken table to match the mosaic, with roast mammoth, river fish, floating purple fruit and mead jars, triggers the abjuration and opens the door. The table is cracked and sagging, and the oozes ate the food, so the party considers waiting a day to see whether the pantries refill.
- (2025-08-24) The party learned the floating purple fruit may be cloud giant sky fruit (Monarch's nature check 13). The room guardian, ordered to open the mosaic door, instead helped the unseen servants set the table and held it up.
- (2025-08-24) Mending could fix the table, but nobody in the party prepared it.

chunks.title: Secret Door in the Hall of Feasts Mosaic (part 2)
names: Secret Door in the Hall of Feasts Mosaic
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Secret Door in the Hall of Feasts Mosaic (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
- (2025-09-21) Monarch's clairvoyance behind the secret door showed a small cabinet-like enclosure holding an enormous crystal chalice, not a passage to the prison.
- (2025-09-21) Raf mended the broken banquet table with a couple of castings of Mending. The party then laid out the feast in the mosaic (mammoth, river fish, floating sky fruit, jars of mead). The spirits rearranged the settings to match as the dishes went out.
- (2025-09-21) With the last jar of mead and steak knife in place, the mosaic glimmered and a stone panel slid aside, revealing a towering gemstone chalice. Raf grabbed it.

chunks.title: The Challenger and the Chalice
names: Challenger of the Chamber of Trials
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: The Challenger and the Chalice (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: Challenger of the Chamber of Trials, challenge and chalice
Hook: The chalice of accord is now in hand, and the bronze tablet explains the ritual needed to pass the Gate of Dragons.
Status: advanced
Linked: Chamber of Trials, Gate of Dragons
- (2025-08-24) A voice said in Giant 'none survive' and 'the peace ended; there remains a chance, but it requires victory and the chalice'. A ghostly armored giant then appeared at parade rest.
- (2025-08-24) Raf fought the challenger alone in the pit, then the party joined. It howls a cold wind (16 cold, halved on a save) and hits for 26 force. It resists weapon damage and takes psychic damage.
- (2025-08-24) Monarch's controlled room guardian hit it for 61 total, and Raf finished it. It knelt, left a bronze tablet etched in giant runes at Raf's feet and vanished. The tablet is unexamined.
- (2025-08-24) The party never found a chalice. The GM confirmed the chalice would drop when the giant was defeated, but none appeared before the session ended.
- (2025-09-21) The bronze tablet details the chalice of accord ritual: a gesture of welcome and humility before dragons, made by an offering in the chalice. The liquid doesn't matter but better or rarer offerings go over better; plain water would work.

chunks.title: The Challenger and the Chalice (part 2)
names: Challenger of the Chamber of Trials
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: The Challenger and the Chalice (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
- (2025-09-21) The spectral feast vision showed giants demanding dragon submission and dragons wanting partnership. A silver dragon raised the chalice and declared none shall pass the Gate of Dragons save by the chalice of accord raised in truth and proper form. The chalice base bears silhouettes of the five metallic dragons.

chunks.title: Room Guardian Sculptor and Giant Crafting Workshop
names: Room Guardian Sculptor and Giant Crafting Workshop
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Room Guardian Sculptor and Giant Crafting Workshop (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-08-24)
Also known as: rune guardian workshop, Andy Rooney
Hook: A sculptor's workshop behind a warded stone door holds an undead stone giant guarding a fine rune guardian, plus crafting materials the party wants.
Status: open
Linked: Hall of Feasts
- (2025-08-24) The stone door had an arcane lock and a defensive glyph; Eddie dispelled the glyph and Raf smashed the door with Shatterspike.
- (2025-08-24) Monarch cast the control ritual from the party's notes using a third-level slot and heightened it. The guardian failed its save with a 10 and was controlled for an hour; Monarch named it Andy Rooney.
- (2025-08-24) A mossy undead stone giant sits in the corner and nodded when Eddie asked in Giant whether he made the guardian and was protecting it; it did not respond to requests for materials. Eddie found five 50 gp gem fragments, which Monarch noted.

chunks.title: Hall of Feasts Brewery of Magical Drafts
names: Hall of Feasts Brewery of Magical Drafts
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Hall of Feasts Brewery of Magical Drafts (first seen 2025-08-24, last seen 2025-09-21)
Also known as: potion room, brewery
Hook: The brewery's leaking casks had spawned living potion oozes; the party fought them and salvaged the remaining potions.
Status: resolved
Linked: Giant Brewery, Hall of Feasts
- (2025-08-24) Portia's owl was blasted with fire (13 damage, saved for half) by one of at least three centers of autonomous goo.
- (2025-08-24) Diego scouted the room but found no chalice. The party decided to fight the challenger first and return to the brewery later.
- (2025-09-21) The pooling goo were living potions: giant-sized oozes of healing, fire breath and poison. Poison looked like healing and fire breath mixed. The Poison one was the party's main foe alongside two fire breath ones.
- (2025-09-21) Monarch's lightning bolt split the oozes. The fire breath ones breathe a targeted fire stream, explode in 10-foot fire when killed, and blindsight 60 ft. Chimeg, Lucia and Portia's ray of frost and Eddie's moonbeam wore them down. All were defeated.
- (2025-09-21) The casks had seeped out through failed sealant. Eddie cut a stave section and siphoned out six fire breath potions and six greater healing potions, all put in the party inventory. Raf started mending the casks.
- (2025-09-21) Greater healing mixed with fire breath turns to poison; a potion of poison must be drunk to harm.

chunks.title: Dreamcaster's Mass Suggestion and Lucia's Dream
names: Dreamcaster's Mass Suggestion and Lucia's Dream
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Dreamcaster's Mass Suggestion and Lucia's Dream (first seen 2025-10-05, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: mass suggestion, wedding dream
Hook: Lucia's visions of the Khan and the question of her bond with him remain unresolved.
Status: advanced
Linked: Chimeg, The Dreamcaster
- (2025-10-05) Lucia must make an Investigation/Intelligence check each turn to see through the dream; she rolled poorly and stayed enjoying the cake.
- (2025-10-05) The suggestion lasts 24 hours unless the Dreamcaster or his allies damage the target. Monarch fled 90 feet and jumped on a horse; Raf and Chimeg were also affected. Left to continue next session.
- (2025-10-19) Eddie cast Dispel Magic on Chimeg to end the suggestion, rolled poorly, used heroic inspiration, and the dispel worked (up to eighth level); Chimeg acknowledged it.
- (2025-10-19) Lucia returned from her dream when the Dreamcaster cast fly, which takes concentration, and flew off.
- (2025-10-19) Monarch's Earthbind (DC 16) grounded the flying Dreamcaster; he blasted the party with psychic energy, leaving Eddie with muddled thoughts, killing horses, then fled into the trees.
- (2025-10-19) The Dreamcaster was killed by Chimeg's crossbow bolts after Portia's firebolt; the suggestion's 24-hour duration did not end with his death.
- (2025-10-19) Eddie's Twilight Sanctuary can end the charmed condition; the GM ruled suggestion imposes charmed, so Eddie used it on Monarch during her short rest, freeing her.

chunks.title: Dreamcaster's Mass Suggestion and Lucia's Dream (part 2)
names: Dreamcaster's Mass Suggestion and Lucia's Dream
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Dreamcaster's Mass Suggestion and Lucia's Dream (first seen 2025-10-05, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-11-02) Lucia scried the Khan with a mirror (one minute per day) and saw him in an argument with House Mazaali members from Roma at the encampment. She also saw him in a duel at the Colosseum in the Ludum Imperium against a woman of House Marvad who backhanded him with unbelievable strength and then raised a whirlwind of dust.
- (2025-11-02) Lucia said so many of her visions involve the Khan that it may be fate. She said farewell to the Khan, warned him about Roma, and worried he is too lawful and could be manipulated.

chunks.title: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization
names: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2026-07-26)
Also known as: Norge raid threat
Hook: A Norge force is gathering to land in the bay and war on the Imperium.
Status: advanced
Linked: Dragonfjord, Emperor's Bay, House Kenegal, Northreach Citadel, Roma, Rowan
- (2025-11-02) The Senate approved greater military spending over a credible but untimed threat that Norge raiders will sail from the north bay through the Great Canal and Mare Medietas to raid Roma. Those who told Raf think it would take about a year.
- (2025-11-02) Raf wondered whether the claimed threat is a pretext, or tied to the Grove vote.
- (2025-11-02) On return to Roma, soldiers are about double the usual and giants about three times the usual, mostly mercenaries or overseers. House Kenegal supplies much of the military presence and gains power from it.
- (2025-11-30) The Hall of Frost is a huge military camp with siege weapons, charts of the Sea of Storms, and a forcible conscription plan outside the city, which Eddie passed on over the psychic network.
- (2025-11-30) Runners announced Northern sails sighted in the Northern Harbor, ending the session.
- (2025-12-14) The GM laid out the threat: Nord sails seen in Emperor's Bay. Norge could take the dredged bay by White Crown through the Great Canal and locks to Mare Medietas and reach Roma quickly, or land and march through the forest, where the Imperium's northern army is stationed.

chunks.title: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization (part 2)
names: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2026-07-26)
- (2025-12-14) The Frost Giant Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu's war planners are mapping only offensive plans: ambushes, naval battles, mountain and canal actions, and hammer-and-anvil attacks in the farmlands. Sir Raf got a natural 20 on the check that revealed this.
- (2025-12-14) The party offered to scout for Vaelthira as freelance volunteers. She accepted without giving orders, and Lucia's persuasion rolled 22. They were told to send sendings to her human spy master Rowan, who will not connect them to any other spies.
- (2025-12-14) Rowan wants to know how many ships are in the bay, what types, what landings Norge has already made, and what inroads they have. He has little information from Northreach, which he finds troubling.
- (2025-12-14) Sir Raf was turned away at Senator Kaldrina's Palace of Fire because she was too busy for them. Monarch's research gave three Norge ship types: the longship, the knarr and the shore boats. At the White Crown docks, a ship captain reported roughly 20 to 40 fast, lightly loaded longships, possibly a vanguard.
- (2026-02-22) Giant-built imperial dreadnoughts arrived in White Crown harbor; skirmishes had already occurred in Emperor's Bay.
- (2026-02-22) In the map room, the imperial planners' landing models omitted Dragonfjord; the party's 16 group investigation saw that ships there could bypass the forest and reach the plains outside Roma.

chunks.title: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization (part 3)
names: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2026-07-26)
- (2026-02-22) Northreach Citadel is contested, having changed hands several times, after northern forces landed outside Emperor's Bay.
- (2026-02-22) Portia's owl saw an imperial blockade across the narrowest part of the bay and a few northern scout ships beyond it; the main northern fleet is not yet there.
- (2026-02-22) The party agreed to scout Dragonfjord first, ideally keeping the fight out of the forest per their druid deal.
- (2026-04-05) Kyle said the Imperium's generals had written Dragonfjord off in their tactical assessments, even though the party judged it a good landing point.
- (2026-04-05) The party suspects the Cherek are making deals with Dragonfjord's dragons, bringing tribute so the dragons will not attack their ships.
- (2026-06-14) Monarch told Lunae the Norge are likely landing a massive troop force. Lunae said some Norge have fallen under white dragons and frost giants and need stopping, though she is no friend of the Imperium. Her theory is that frost giant Jarls direct the invasion, and the frost giants in Roma may be in league with them.
- (2026-07-12) The party recapped that they have strong suspicions the frost giants they report to are tied to the Norge invasion force, but that does not change the fact that Norge is invading; Portia said they could report to someone else.

chunks.title: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization (part 4)
names: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Norge Raid Rumor and Roman Militarization (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2026-07-26)
- (2026-07-12) The party wants to make the fjord a bad place to land by showing the Norge they cannot bargain with the dragons, since Monarch would rather they land at a more defensible position near Roma than this backdoor.
- (2026-07-12) The captured prisoners, Sorcha and Ashvale, said Rimescar was hunted by Maulring dragon slayers and will join any dragon slaying; they were handed off through other groups and know nothing of their own gear.
- (2026-07-26) Sorcha and Ashvale reported that the Norge fleet seems very large, hundreds of ships carrying tens of thousands. The GM said this is about five times larger than even the most generous scenario modeled on the planning boards in the frost giants' manor.
- (2026-07-26) The party reasoned this is more than a raid, possibly a mobilization to stay, and that Norge raids on the Imperium increased after the Great Jarl consolidated power about thirty years ago.
- (2026-07-26) Eddie sent Sendings to Rowan reporting the fleet size, Lunae's neutrality, Icevein accepting tribute and the freed Maulring captives. Rowan replied that they should extract soonest, that Icevein is extremely dangerous and generationally vengeful, and that Icevein must not discover Rimescar's fall or he will aid the invasion.

chunks.title: Senators' Motives for Supporting the Groves Annexation
names: Senators' Motives for Supporting the Groves Annexation
why the senators support the bill
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Senators' Motives for Supporting the Groves Annexation (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: why the senators support the bill
Hook: Each senator backs the annexation bill for different reasons the party can address.
Status: advanced
Linked: Groves of Belenus, Senator Magnus Opulus Marvad, Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus
- (2025-11-16) Sir Raf was hired as a perimeter guard at the Palace of Fire. Senator Kaldrina, the fire giant, sees the Groves as a security risk, an open avenue of attack or invasion, likely her reason for voting yes. Raf's investigation was weak.
- (2025-11-16) Eddie was hired by the frost giant senator, Vaelthira of the Palace of Frost. She is competitive, cheats and is expansionist, and has no stake in the Groves. She wants Senate backing for a petition for a preemptive war on Norge, which Magnus supports but has not brought to a vote. Her squads disrupt rival senators.
- (2025-11-16) Portia, as a spider in the Senate archives, confirmed Valeria Calvus fears unregulated wild and druidic magic. Culdrick Cerro is nostalgic for imperial control. Calvad Volpus, a former priestess of Apollo, wants sacred places under divine order. Darius Calvus asks about timber rights. Octavia Calvad wants school access to Grove knowledge. Brontus wants giant leadership. Kaldrina fears druids stepping out of trees as invasion. Borluss wants the Great Henge rebuilt. Rogrun wants Grove foods. Azaira wants a walled garden for elites.

chunks.title: Senators' Motives for Supporting the Groves Annexation (part 2)
names: Senators' Motives for Supporting the Groves Annexation
why the senators support the bill
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Senators' Motives for Supporting the Groves Annexation (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
- (2025-11-16) Raf's History 18 gave reputations: Brontus (storm giant) is strict and distrusts small folk. Kaldrina (fire) is a siege engineer with a security-obsessed palace. Borluss (stone) is silent and loves restoration. Vaelthira (frost) is belligerent. Rogrun (hill) is a gourmand. Azaira (cloud) loves spectacle and rules through gossip.
- (2025-11-30) Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu (the frost giant) supports the bill only because Magnus promised to bring her war petition to the floor.
- (2025-11-30) Kaldrina sees the Groves as a security risk rather than wanting annexation per se; Brontus (storm giant) wants giant oversight; Cerro is driven by nostalgia; Valerius, the former sun priestess, wants the Groves under the Temple of Apollo; Darius Calvus wants timber rights; Octavia Calvad wants alchemical access for students.
- (2025-11-30) Cloud giant Azirah wants a walled garden for the elite and was one the party could not counter.

chunks.title: Forged Missive from Magnus Marvad
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Forged Missive from Magnus Marvad (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: Operation Draw Library, spider in the library trick
Hook: The party plans to forge a message in Magnus Marvad's voice, possibly in illusory script, to turn senators against his bloc.
Status: open
Linked: Senator Magnus Opulus Marvad
- (2025-11-16) Monarch carried Portia, in spider form, near the Senate archives. Monarch's deception roll was 12 and the clerk grew suspicious of her. Portia rolled a 20 on stealth, entered unseen, and found examples of Magnus's writing style and handwriting.
- (2025-11-16) The GM ruled a forgery needs the right style and a scribe's hand. Nobles dictate to scribes, so the sender's own handwriting need not match. A wax seal forgery needs a real seal to copy, and Lucia may have a Marvad seal. The idea is to convince the frost giant that Magnus will never bring the Norge invasion petition to a vote.
- (2025-11-16) Magnus is Lucia's trouble: his son was in the carriage with her, so he or his people would recognize her.

chunks.title: Frost Giant Muscle Squad Approaches Eddie
names: Frost Giant Muscle Squad Approaches Eddie
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Frost Giant Muscle Squad Approaches Eddie (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-16)
Also known as: Vaelthira's muscle group
Hook: As the party leaves the stone giant's palace, a squad from the frost giant senator's patrol groups heads straight for Eddie.
Status: open
Linked: Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus
- (2025-11-16) Eddie recognized one of the frost giant's muscle groups making a beeline toward the party in the street; the session ended there.

chunks.title: Frost Giant Petition for War on Norge
names: Frost Giant Petition for War on Norge
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Frost Giant Petition for War on Norge (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Vaelthira's petition, imperial petition against Norge
Hook: Senator Vaelthira, the frost giant, wants the Senate to bring her petition for an offensive against Norge to the emperor, and Magnus is the gatekeeper.
Status: advanced
Linked: Senator Magnus Opulus Marvad, Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu
- (2025-11-30) Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus is dead set against even bringing the petition to the floor, fearing it could lead to the empire's fall; the party concluded Magnus is playing both sides.
- (2025-11-30) After Eddie told her of Magnus's promise, Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus said she would make Magnus pull the petition; her note reads 'Magnus to pull petition', crossed off.
- (2025-11-30) The frost giant senator's Hall of Frost cooled its war planning, tents shrank and conscription contracts were recalled; she abstains rather than voting for annexation.
- (2025-11-30) Her tactical information on Norge is poor; Eddie realized druid tree-travel could supply spies, and the Grove druids offered to open tree-doors for her agents in exchange for independence, with a binding oath; she accepted and will send agents three days after the vote.

chunks.title: Frost Giant Muscle Squad Threat
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Frost Giant Muscle Squad Threat (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Julia's thugs, encouragement squad
Hook: The frost giant senator's thugs warned the party to stop talking to senators.
Status: advanced
Linked: Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu
- (2025-11-30) Julia the glacier's squad (Krug and Gillygully, shiver the frost wizard, Hanak and Bolak orogs) confronted Eddie; Monarch charmed Julia with Charm Person (Wisdom save DC 17) and bought off the thugs with a gold piece, but the charm lasts only an hour.
- (2025-11-30) Senator Vaelthira later called the thugs off and gave leave to visit senators; Julia remarked Monarch's charm was good.

chunks.title: Tessa Oakmere's Forest Transport Terms
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Tessa Oakmere's Forest Transport Terms (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: transport through plants, Tessa
Hook: The visiting druid Tessa Oakmere will transport only scouts through the trees, not armies, and only if the fighting stays on the shore.
Status: advanced
Linked: Groves of Belenus, Tessa Oakmere
- (2025-12-14) Tessa Oakmere, a visiting druid from a grove in Eyre, is the only druid in the Groves who knows the plant-transport spell. She would not take sides between nations or hasten warfare in the old forest.
- (2025-12-14) Tessa will transport small groups of scouts and forward observers, but no pyrotechnics, powerful arcane casters or large military forces. She wants the fight kept on the shores before giants are sent in.

chunks.title: Debbie's Rescue from Najik and the Bronze Dragon
names: Debbie's Rescue from Najik and the Bronze Dragon
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Debbie's Rescue from Najik and the Bronze Dragon (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-01-11)
Also known as: Mirel Kellenor's job, Najik rescue, bronze dragon
Hook: The party must rescue Debbie and the other shipwreck survivors from Najik past a hostile bronze dragon.
Status: advanced
Linked: Captain Orso, Debbie, Mirel Kellenor, Najik, Skalanthas, The Smiling Fish
- (2025-12-14) Rowan told the party that a bronze dragon was reportedly living in the bay and that House Kellenor's shipping agent had been seeking help in a story involving one. He judged it a low-odds, high-payoff lead that would help delay the Norge fleet.
- (2025-12-14) Azuriel arranged a House Ventre teleport to White Crown and a return trip, but could not vouch for Kellenor. A transport wizard told the party Kellenor works from the Smiling Fish tavern.
- (2025-12-14) Mirel Kellenor, head of shipping for House Kellenor, offered 2,000 gp to bring back her friend Debbie, a priest of a god of stars and wanderers, plus 250 gp per rescued sailor. A bronze dragon sank Debbie's ship; she and at least two crew swam to Najik, which has a hidden sea-cave monastery where the dragon lives and a dozen friendly monks.
- (2025-12-14) Mirel gave the captain of the Wave Mount, Captain Orso, a chest of gold to bribe the dragon. She offered a 10 percent finder's fee on recovered cargo, about 100,000 gp of goods and coin. Debbie has a sending stone, and Eddie can contact Mirel through it.

chunks.title: Debbie's Rescue from Najik and the Bronze Dragon (part 2)
names: Debbie's Rescue from Najik and the Bronze Dragon
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Debbie's Rescue from Najik and the Bronze Dragon (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-01-11)
- (2025-12-14) After a night at sea the Wave Mount sighted Najik's white cliffs, spotted by Eddie with a perception roll of 22 against DC 20. A bronze dragon then burst from the water and dived at the ship, ending the session on a cliffhanger.
- (2026-01-11) The bronze dragon exploded out of the water and blasted the Wave Mount with lightning (50 and 45 damage); the ship took about 120 damage in total but stayed seaworthy.
- (2026-01-11) Lucia and Portia (21) tried to persuade the dragon but it kept shouting 'be gone'; it shoved everyone overboard with a force roar (DC 15 Strength save, only Lucia and Portia saved).
- (2026-01-11) Monarch cast earth bind and mind whip on the dragon; Lucia, Portia, and Raf hurt it. It said 'I do not fear your kind' at first, then fled into the depths and left the area.
- (2026-01-11) Captain Orso refused to bring the ship closer. She lent two lifeboats and handed over the chest of coins (45 lb, 1,000 gp), which Lucia put in the bag of holding, so the party rowed to Najik.
- (2026-01-11) Debbie Talzar, a middle-aged human priest of a god of stars and wanderers, Ashlyn Moranta (an elf), and the teenager Treif Lemir are in the monastery. Debbie verified the party through her sending stone.
- (2026-01-11) The party told the survivors they would leave in the morning after resting, since they are in no condition to face the dragon again.

chunks.title: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation
names: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: Arrest Ronnom Kenegal
Hook: The party must deliver the captured Ronnom Kenegal to Roman justice to keep their word to the bronze dragon, while the trial is set to draw many noble complainants.
Status: advanced
Linked: Colonel Lara, Debbie, Eko and Mok, Magistrate Falora, Najik, Najik Monastery, Ronnom Kenegal, Skalanthas, Veen
- (2026-01-11) The monk Anish says Ronnom, a noble with three bodyguards, arrived first, then the dragon turned protective and sank ships. The dragon appears beholden to him, as it was to his mother Ehlischelia, a late knight of valor.
- (2026-01-11) The monks granted Ronnom sanctuary, which only means they will not throw him out. They have asked him to leave, but he refuses and will not let anyone else leave.
- (2026-01-11) The party's history checks showed he is the black sheep of a noble family, wanted for several counts of murder on an arrest warrant (not a kill warrant) with a 2,500 gp bounty. Sir Raf, who is from the same house, feels responsible for bringing him to justice.
- (2026-01-11) His bodyguards are the twins Eko and Mok and their leader Veen, the sharpest and most dangerous, who advises him. They are lightly armored but armed.
- (2026-01-11) Treif and Ashlyn want revenge on him and fear him. The monks will not lie but will not volunteer the party's presence. Anish offered a locking cell downstairs for holding prisoners.

chunks.title: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation (part 2)
names: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2026-01-11) The party decided to serve the warrant that night. Monarch cast charm person at third level (DC 17 Wisdom save) on two bodyguards in a lower-level room, and Lucia heard voices in another room.
- (2026-01-25) In the monastery cellar, Monarch's Charm Person on Ronnom's twin bodyguards revealed them as doppelgangers in claws-out combat mode. Monarch's Wild Magic Surge gave her resistance to all damage for a minute.
- (2026-01-25) A jade-eyed woman in Dawnrealm-style clothing appeared mid-strike behind Eddie, shouting 'get out of here, they look dangerous'. She is a fast monk with regeneration and invisibility who hit Eddie for 12 and 17 and Portia for 16 and 14, forcing Constitution saves against stunning. She vanished and turned to mist, escaping.
- (2026-01-25) One bodyguard fled out the back door into a flooded sea cave. A doppelganger posing as Raf was burned up by Raf's chromatic orb, which bounced onto the jade-eyed woman for 11 fire.
- (2026-01-25) Lucia pursued the fleeing 'sketchy guy', who took her to 0 HP with a short sword for 5 piercing and 21 poison; she fell unconscious in knee-deep water. Portia healed her with Healing Word. Lucia then killed a shapeshifted shark-form doppelganger with a crit sneak attack for 33.
- (2026-01-25) At the end of the round a dragon's roar echoed from the south of the cave. The party has no ballistae and few spell slots, and the dragon has not had a long rest either. The fight ends in a cliffhanger.

chunks.title: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation (part 3)
names: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2026-02-08) The party failed to find the jade-eyed woman in the flooded cave. She looted the dresser in the room she and the sketchy guy had used, then fought the party, stunned Eddie and Lucia, took Eddie to unconscious, and escaped swimming toward the dragon's lair.
- (2026-02-08) Sir Raf spent inspiration on a history check (27): the jade-eyed woman is Veen, called the jade Tigris, a freelance spy with Dawnrealm connections who works for the Imperium and is believed to be a shapeshifter. Nothing has been heard of her in ten years.
- (2026-02-08) The monks said Ronnom arrived six months ago with three bodyguards (Eko, Mok and Veen) and is wanted for paid assassinations. He is the son of the knight Ehlonna Kenegal, who died about fifteen years ago. The dragon Skalanthas, raised from an egg by Ehlonna, became more territorial and began sinking ships after Ronnom arrived.
- (2026-02-08) The party searched Veen's and the sketchy guy's room and took the satchels: glassblowing tools, four empty vials with residue, 60 platinum coins, pearls worth 100 each, and an empty velvet-lined jewelry box. Monarch's investigation (natural 20) showed the vials held a weak ingestible poison, enough to kill a falcon. The monks' message falcons all died recently.
- (2026-02-08) Eddie cast locate object on Veen's bandolier. It lay to the southeast and below, near the dragon's lair.

chunks.title: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation (part 4)
names: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2026-02-08) Skalanthas said Ronnom is his half brother and is protected. He demanded evidence, would not accept the party's word, and said the party must stop coming or he will sink more ships. The party concluded Ronnom would simply discredit any evidence.
- (2026-02-08) Monarch proposed faking Ronnom's capture. Veen appeared, transformed into the sketchy guy, and offered to stand trial in his place. Skalanthas, who never liked her, loved the plan and let the party leave with the shipwreck survivors and the disguised Veen as a prisoner in manacles.
- (2026-02-08) Skalanthas said that once Ronnom is safe and no more ships come he would think kindly of the party and might discuss other needs. Monarch promised to tell him by sending once Ronnom's fate is secured on the mainland. The GM called this a milestone: the dragon is not recruited but is willing to help.
- (2026-02-08) The dragon agreed to meet the party at the goats tomorrow. Portia took a Lightning Bolt save (40 damage, half) while messaging it to ask for a time and place.
- (2026-02-22) The party brought the prisoner by ship to White Crown and kept the ruse up to the rescued shipwreck survivors, who believe the prisoner is Roma's wanted man.
- (2026-02-22) The party decided to avoid Magistrate Goliath Ahn of White Crown, known as the pyre of justice, and deliver the prisoner to Roma instead to keep their word to the dragon.

chunks.title: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation (part 5)
names: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Ronnom Kenegal and the Dragon's Obligation (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-22)
- (2026-02-22) The prisoner, who is acting as Ronnom, privately asked for a death sentence by hanging, saying it would get her off everyone's radar; the party's pitch is poetic justice for Lucia's strangulation.
- (2026-02-22) Colonel Lara sent a city watch detachment to escort the party to Magistrate Falora's office in the Sword Quarter, where the bounty of 5,000 gold (2,500 dead, 5,000 alive) was paid.
- (2026-02-22) The prisoner is wanted for more than a dozen murders, some of nobles, plus unsanctioned assassination; representatives of several noble houses will present evidence at trial.
- (2026-02-22) Monarch filed a complaint of attempted murder as representative for Lucia's death and received a sending stone; the clerk expects a first hearing in about a week and several weeks of process.
- (2026-02-22) The party spent time with the prisoner and concluded she is physically shapeshifting rather than using illusion.

chunks.title: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing
names: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-04-19)
Also known as: Dragonfjord expedition
Hook: The party is scouting Dragonfjord to find where a Norge fleet might land and to report to the army.
Status: advanced
Linked: Dragonfjord, Fenrir's Longship, Forked Peak Pass, Rowan
- (2026-02-22) Kyle said Dragonfjord is dominated by white dragons; Norge's Cherek are Goliaths who once served a white dragon and now resist dragons.
- (2026-02-22) The druids can drop the party at the forest edge near the mountains but know no tree inside Dragonfjord.
- (2026-02-22) The hermit said at least five dragons live there: Sven, Vorrel (Snow Mother), Rhymes Scar, Sheerkess and Isildrax, and warned of yeti and a crevasse; take the forked peak pass.
- (2026-02-22) Five winter wolves are stalking the party's trail; combat began with Eddie's shot missing at 12 and Sir Raf's fire bolt hitting for 11.
- (2026-03-08) The party crossed the forked-peak pass, killing five winter wolves (horse-sized, speed 50, cold breath) in the afternoon and camping that night.
- (2026-03-08) On the Dragonfjord side the party saw a frozen blue fjord with no boats, a rocky island not on their empire map, and the ruins of a settlement on the eastern shore.
- (2026-03-08) Portia judged the ruined settlement's gently sloping natural bay a good landing place for ships, so it may be where the Norge land.

chunks.title: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing (part 2)
names: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-04-19)
- (2026-03-08) Sir Raf wants to inspect the ruined settlement and bay later because the mission is to find whether the Norge are landing there. Monarch says the objective is to find them and tell the army, who may order harassment. Portia noted the high ground gives a better vantage.
- (2026-04-05) Monarch and Eddie spotted a Norge longship at anchor north of the rocky island, about 15 miles away. Closer in, Lucia, Raf and Portia saw three to six cargo ships tied up near the longship, about eight miles off.
- (2026-04-05) The party found the Drakholm ruins: collapsed stone foundations in a target-like ring layout around a central plaza, with Draconic markings and dragon-themed stonework. Monarch judged them centuries old, and Kyle said nobody has lived there in recent history.
- (2026-04-05) Eddie cast Sending to Rowan the spymaster. Rowan replied to determine the origin and mission of the ships and to report immediately if engaged by a dragon.
- (2026-04-05) Eddie, Lucia and Portia swam about seven miles to the island with water breathing and aid; Portia wild-shaped into a reef shark. The water near the island was frigid, with a chilly fog bank around it, and Kyle said these are hallmarks of an adult or ancient white dragon's lair.

chunks.title: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing (part 3)
names: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-04-19)
- (2026-04-05) The longship has about 30 oars, is manned by Goliath Cherek warriors, and is painted white and pale blue with a Fenrir prow figure. A dark fog and a magical fear aura surround it. Portia and Lucia failed the Wisdom save and were frightened, while Eddie made it. Only the longship was at the island; circling it turned up no other ships, people or entrances.
- (2026-04-05) Eddie's Clairvoyance on the ship failed, so the party concluded it has some protection from scrying. Eddie then put the sensor on the island landing trail.
- (2026-04-05) Through the sensor, Eddie saw an old Goliath with a staff and a necklace of stone tablets. A tattooed Goliath woman wearing a white dragon mask came ashore, boarded the ship and ordered it east.
- (2026-04-05) Rowan's second Sending reply said it was probably a second tribute: prevent its arrival if possible, determine the Cherek force composition, and do not engage until a last-minute report is ready. The party withheld the mask detail from the Imperium.
- (2026-04-05) The party landed together and watched about 32 Cherek beach the ship and make camp in the mist about a mile and a half away. Monarch cast a fourth-level major image of boulders to hide the party and Eddie ritually cast Tiny Hut inside it. At night a dragon roared overhead and dived toward the Cherek camp.

chunks.title: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing (part 4)
names: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Scouting Dragonfjord for a Norge Landing (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-04-19)
- (2026-04-19) A white dragon dived into the Cherek camp and left trailing smoke after a few minutes; Monarch scouted the camp invisibly and found no damage, no injured and no collapsed tents.
- (2026-04-19) Monarch overheard Foe Shatter and a woman in the command tent: without treasure the Cherek have nothing, so they will wait for the treasure ship and 'let him come again'.
- (2026-04-19) The camp holds about 30-32 older elite Cherek warriors in six small tents and one large command tent beside the ship; a Private Sanctum-like fog (upcast, about 500 feet across) surrounds it, and the rune-carved ship may be its source.
- (2026-04-19) The party moved to the coast to watch for the treasure ship but saw no ships over a day and a night, only the dragon diving at a distant target.
- (2026-04-19) Rowan's Sending reply ordered the party to locate and co-opt the silver dragon if possible, and said the Mithril Peaks clan and the silver dragon patron Lunae had been silent for years.
- (2026-04-19) Eddie's Sending was answered by Rowan; Eddie sent: prisoners from the Mithril Peaks clan escaped from the White Dragon Lair, the dragon is to be paid treasure by Norge soon, and the party is watching for the treasure ship.

chunks.title: The Hermit's Hidden Side
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: The Hermit's Hidden Side (first seen 2026-02-22, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: hermit of Dragonfjord
Hook: A hermit with a winter wolf companion hides part of his personality and bears scarification on his forearm.
Status: open
Linked: Useless
- (2026-02-22) Lucia and Portia sensed there is more to the hermit than he shows.
- (2026-02-22) Eddie spotted old intricate scarification on the hermit's forearm, a cultural, membership or ritual mark.
- (2026-02-22) His winter wolf Useless is unusually kind to him, hinting at past events.

chunks.title: Yeti Territory and Abominable Yeti in the Pass
names: Yeti Territory and Abominable Yeti in the Pass
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Yeti Territory and Abominable Yeti in the Pass (first seen 2026-03-08, last seen 2026-06-14)
Also known as: yetis
Hook: Yetis serve Rimescar and guard his lair; the party must get past them.
Status: resolved
Linked: Forked Peak Pass, Rimescar, Yeti
- (2026-03-08) Howls ahead and above the camp that did not sound like wolves were identified as yetis; the party must pass through their territory.
- (2026-03-08) The GM described yetis as intelligent pack hunters with a freezing gaze (Con save or paralyzed), ice-throwing and avalanches, dominated only by stronger beings; abominable yetis serve a demon lord of ice and challenge frost giants.
- (2026-03-08) Tracks of four long-striding creatures led uphill toward a possible old iron mine; the party chose to avoid it.
- (2026-03-08) Two stealthy yetis tracked the camp at night and both died, one to Portia's wall of fire (20 damage) and Lucia's 19 psychic, the other to Eddie's guiding bolt (21 radiant), Monarch's 18 fire and Raf's 11 fire. Eddie saved a Con save with 13 against its gaze.
- (2026-03-08) Portia reasoned other yetis may follow the trail since yetis track well, so she used elementalism and pass without trace to break the trail.
- (2026-05-17) Yetis in Rimescar's cavern feed on carcasses; four ran past Monarch's scrying sensor with fresh blood on teeth and claws.
- (2026-05-17) The mirror showed a vast yeti and Rimescar posturing to negotiate from strength.
- (2026-05-17) As the party flew toward the lair, yetis charged them roaring; the session ended on that note.

chunks.title: Yeti Territory and Abominable Yeti in the Pass (part 2)
names: Yeti Territory and Abominable Yeti in the Pass
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Yeti Territory and Abominable Yeti in the Pass (first seen 2026-03-08, last seen 2026-06-14)
- (2026-06-14) The party killed the four yeti in the first fight. Portia's fireball dealt 31 fire damage and bloodied them; Monarch's lightning bolt dealt 29; Lucia and Sir Raf finished them. Fire makes yeti disadvantaged.

chunks.title: Wagon Wreck of House Querid Cartographers
names: Wagon Wreck of House Querid Cartographers
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Wagon Wreck of House Querid Cartographers (first seen 2026-03-08, last seen 2026-04-19)
Also known as: cartographic expedition wagon
Hook: A buried House Querid expedition wagon holds an annotated map and a sending stone, raising questions about why they were here.
Status: advanced
Linked: Dragonfjord, House Querid
- (2026-03-08) A wagon crushed by an old rockfall in the debris field held about ten long-dead people. Raf spotted House Querid's compass-and-quill symbol on fabric.
- (2026-03-08) The party excavated it. They found a gold idol worth 750 gp, jewelry worth 250 gp each, six copper chalices with bone charms at 25 gp each, a silk court outfit worth 500 gp, a cartography kit and a signet ring of office.
- (2026-03-08) A sealed metal scroll tube held a map annotated by someone other than its maker, showing five dragons, the Ruins of Drakholm, restless dead and merrows. Monarch holds the sending stone from the head cartographer's pocket, which the party considered using.
- (2026-03-08) Monarch's 25 investigation suggested the expedition was returning from a trip when the rockslide hit.
- (2026-04-05) Kyle said the map's ship image is old, while the handwritten notes such as 'beware of merrows' are recent, from within the last few seasons. The wreck is a few seasons old, not decades.

chunks.title: Wagon Wreck of House Querid Cartographers (part 2)
names: Wagon Wreck of House Querid Cartographers
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Wagon Wreck of House Querid Cartographers (first seen 2026-03-08, last seen 2026-04-19)
- (2026-04-05) Eddie used the wreck's sending stone and the other end answered at once. The reply ordered all goods, maps and valuables returned to the closest seneschal of House Querid immediately, sharing nothing with others on pain of extreme sanction. The party decided to delay answering.
- (2026-04-05) The stone works once per day no matter which side activates it, and does not require attunement.
- (2026-04-19) The party agreed not to mark illusory campsites on the map copy that House Querid would get, after the demanding reply to their report.
- (2026-04-19) The GM reminded them House Querid began as cartographers and became an intelligence trader, and was behind the mystery box hijacking.

chunks.title: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer
names: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: white dragon mask Goliath, second tribute
Hook: The Cherek made a deal with the ancient white dragon.
Status: advanced
Linked: Cherek longship crew, Cherek rune-elder, Dragonfjord, Fenrir's Longship, Foe Shatter, Icevein, Rimescar, Rowan
- (2026-04-05) Kyle said the Goliath woman's mask is a stylized white dragon, similar to the party's blue dragon mask. Kyle also said such masks give advantage on negotiating with dragons rather than commanding them.
- (2026-04-05) Lucia proposed taking the mask from her; the party agreed to ambush the mask-wearer and the old Goliath who does the sending. The mask is the priority and the party is keeping it from the Imperium.
- (2026-04-05) Eddie's Sending to Rowan said the Cherek made a deal with the ancient white dragon and will do the same with another dragon, and that the Goliaths left and are sending more ships.
- (2026-04-19) The party's ambush plan was shelved: the Cherek are waiting for the treasure ship rather than going to the dragon, and the Cherek were not unsettled by the dragon's attack.
- (2026-04-19) The GM said the blue dragon mask only gives advantage on Charisma checks with blue dragons and Draconic speech, with no forced compliance; white dragons likely respect only strength.
- (2026-05-17) The GM said killing the adult dragon denies Norge a dragon ally against the Imperium. Rowan's last orders were to prevent arrival of the galleons and the bribe and to assess the Cherek force without engaging.

chunks.title: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer (part 2)
names: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-05-17) The party noted the Cherek are waiting for ships with a bribe, which might draw the adult dragon out.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae said the Fenrir's ship is an old, probably sentient magic ship. The wolf pelts and symbols the party saw mark a Sundered Sky subclan (Odin's Blind Eye), which has a long relationship with frost giants. She wants to learn which clans are involved.
- (2026-06-14) A second ship, a troop transport or cargo galleon, now sits beside Fenrir's at the camp. The party scouted it with perimeter riders and pickets about.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae named the other white dragons as Icevein (patriarch), Voorhl, Rimescar and Isildrax. Isildrax is new to her, and Voorhl is probably Icevein's new partner, so Isildrax is younger.
- (2026-07-12) The GM warned that the holder of an artifact who has reached speaking terms with an ancient dragon may not be defeatable by the party today, so taking the white dragon mask by force is not recommended.
- (2026-07-12) Portia scouted the Cherek convoy: three heavy wagons pulled by draft horses and about a dozen Goliaths, including two ogre-sized frost-giant-like figures, a scarred old Goliath giving orders, a tattooed rune caster and a woman who sat on a blanket looking up at the falls.

chunks.title: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer (part 3)
names: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-07-12) The rune caster walked the camp perimeter casting with rune stones and a runed staff, and when the group marched off he stayed at the center of a moving invisible circular barrier. Pickets saw Portia's wolf form but did not react.
- (2026-07-12) The woman sitting apart set a white dragon mask on her lap while contemplating. She is identified as Vigdis Foe Shatter of the North.
- (2026-07-12) Monarch, in an illusory Rimescar, met the Cherek party. She sold the performance with a 24 and the Cherek knelt. Vigdis said she had treated with Rimescar's father, the great Icevein, and that the tribute was tailored to his needs. She asked only that Rimescar keep to his lair while her people passed through to destroy and pillage the dragon's eastern foes.
- (2026-07-12) Vigdis offered the Dread Mother exchange 'in the name of the dread mother'. Monarch passed a Religion check, answered 'by the blood of the dread mother', and Vigdis was satisfied.
- (2026-07-12) Monarch told the Cherek to seek Rimescar behind the waterfall when their army arrives, with a possible offer to lead their armies, then ordered them away. They left, and the party never saw them question the illusion.
- (2026-07-26) A second treasure delivery arrived by galleon from the north, smaller than Rimescar's: one wagon with dense crates and no living captives. Foe Shatter (Vigdis) still has the white dragon mask.

chunks.title: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer (part 4)
names: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Cherek Deal with the White Dragon and the Mask-Wearer (first seen 2026-04-05, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-07-26) The party overheard Foe Shatter snarl at a frost giant-kin Goliath that he need not return alive for success. The rune master then warned her to be careful with those who have Hundar's favor, saying she knows what he will do. Hundar is the Great Jarl of the Frost Giants in Norge, also called winter favorite.
- (2026-07-26) Foe Shatter often fidgets with a locket and looks north. Monarch speculated it is a keepsake from a loved one who could be held over her.
- (2026-07-26) The Fenrir camp keeps a skeleton crew aboard the ship, with pickets watching in all directions but everyone mostly watching the sky. The Cherek struck camp and rowed south toward the next dragon. Foe Shatter, the rune master and six others left with a wagon for the dragon's lair, expected to be gone all day.
- (2026-10-18) Raf mused that Icevein may want a toll from passing ships; Lunae replied that he has only greed and hate.

chunks.title: The Escaped Mithril Peaks Dwarves and Rimescar's Lair
names: The Escaped Mithril Peaks Dwarves and Rimescar's Lair
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: The Escaped Mithril Peaks Dwarves and Rimescar's Lair (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-06-14)
Also known as: Rimescar prisoners, Rhymescarr
Hook: The party seeks Rimescar's lair, where Mithril Peaks dwarves remain enslaved, as a lead to Lunae.
Status: resolved
Linked: Bodgel Deepdelver, Lunae, Rimescar, Mithril Peaks clan
- (2026-04-19) The white dragon killed a group of about five dwarves escaping toward the shore; one frozen dwarf was found whole, wearing makeshift scavenged gear.
- (2026-04-19) Speak with Dead: the dwarf answered 'Escape Rimescar'; 25 others remain there; they dug tunnels out and the dragon cannot fit through some of them.
- (2026-04-19) Raf's history check (18) identified the belt-buckle silver mountain symbol as the Mithril Peaks clan, a mithril supplier to Roma with draconic ties to a silver dragon, not a white one.
- (2026-04-19) The party followed the dwarves' trail to a natural crevice by a frozen waterfall, climbed a mined tunnel and vertical shaft, and met two ice trolls.
- (2026-04-19) The fight began with an ice troll (cold aura; acid or fire stops its regeneration; Eddie's rapier of wounding also stops healing) and a second troll arrived; a dragon roar then forced Wisdom saves.
- (2026-05-17) Dwarves in boot spikes, bearing Mithril Peaks markings, approached after the second ice troll died and urged the party to flee; Lucia linked Portia, Sir Raf, Monarch's group and a dwarf in a one-hour telepathic bond.

chunks.title: The Escaped Mithril Peaks Dwarves and Rimescar's Lair (part 2)
names: The Escaped Mithril Peaks Dwarves and Rimescar's Lair
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: The Escaped Mithril Peaks Dwarves and Rimescar's Lair (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-06-14)
- (2026-05-17) The dwarves are survivors and descendants of the Mithril Peaks clan, forced by Rimescar to mine mithril. Their speaker's brother Bodgel tried to escape and died, as the party knew. The dragon catches escapees in the open but does not know how they get out.
- (2026-05-17) The two ice trolls were left to keep the dwarves in line and eat escapees or intruders; the dwarves know of no other guardians.
- (2026-05-17) The party hid in dwarf-height mithril mining tunnels reached by crawlways off the shaft, which the dragon cannot enter. Monarch cast an illusion hiding the hole, and they took a short and then long rest.
- (2026-05-17) Eddie's Sending to the dwarf speaker got a reply: he fetches Skullrender's tribe in twos, four are here, and the party should listen for his exit at the falls, giving them an hour.
- (2026-05-17) Scrying with clairvoyance showed Rimescar swim under the ice and exit through the waterfall, with no hoard visible.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae called out to the dwarves of the Mithril Peaks that she had returned and they cheered and ran out. About twenty dwarves with crossbows took part in the ambush.

chunks.title: The Escaped Mithril Peaks Dwarves and Rimescar's Lair (part 3)
names: The Escaped Mithril Peaks Dwarves and Rimescar's Lair
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: The Escaped Mithril Peaks Dwarves and Rimescar's Lair (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-06-14)
- (2026-06-14) Rimescar returned carrying yeti, breathed on Lunae in dwarf form (the party's Sir Raf made his Dexterity save with a 21, taking 13 of 53 cold damage). Lunae burned two of Rimescar's legendary resistances against her paralyzing breath, Monarch's earthbind burned another, and hold monster (Wisdom DC 19) paralyzed him; the dwarf crossbows then killed Rimescar.
- (2026-06-14) Lunae's lair is liberated. The party and dwarves ate Rimescar's flesh in a ceremony conferring advantage on saves against dragon abilities and resistances to damage types the dragon was immune to, a Heroes' Feast-like effect lasting a week.

chunks.title: Locating the Silver Dragon Lunae
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Locating the Silver Dragon Lunae (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: silver dragon patron, Lunae
Hook: The party and the silver dragon Lunae are coordinating a ferry of her dwarf clan onto the Fenrir.
Status: resolved
Linked: Lunae, Rimescar, Rowan, Silver Dragon's Iron Flask
- Party Sending to Lunae: "OK, the Longship can hold the 40. We are heading north about 4 miles offshore. The sail is down." Lunae replied: "Won't overfly fjord in natural form. Icevein too dangerous. Will move clan to river mouth at northeast side of fjord mouth."
- Eddie's Sending to Lunae (4:57 PM): "We will pass the river mouth in 15 minutes. Pick up those present. Icevein about 45 minutes behind. Hide. We can double back for more." Lunae replied: "Will observe as eagle. Consider why Icevein is following. He has no curiosity. Only greed and hate. You may be able to use him."
- (2026-04-19) A Sending delivered the divination: 'Falls become rise, wall becomes water, an iron prison in hand, a moon rises in the east.'
- (2026-04-19) Dragons are hard to locate because they spend much time in humanoid form; the party followed the dwarves' trail toward a dragon marked on their map.
- (2026-04-19) Portia, Monarch and Lucia were pulled to the astral plane where a silver dragon said 'I am only somewhat trapped. There is more you need to know to find me' and opened a door to a library of spirits.

chunks.title: Locating the Silver Dragon Lunae (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Locating the Silver Dragon Lunae (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-05-17) Portia's question in the Astral library was answered: Lunae languishes in a legendary iron flask buried behind thick ice in Rimescar's hoard, needing only to be found and opened.
- (2026-05-17) The dwarves are allies of Lunae from before she vanished and do not know where the hoard is. Rimescar rests in a cavern 50 or 60 feet past where the party met them, reached by following the left-hand wall and crossing the frozen river.
- (2026-05-17) Portia and Monarch worked out that the 'iron prison in hand' of Rowan's divination is the flask.
- (2026-05-17) Locate object cast by Portia gave a direction up and to the east, within 1,000 feet. Eddie's augury on casting it first came back woe, and later weal after the party waited.
- (2026-05-17) Lucia's mirror of the past showed a white dragonborn in the white dragon's entourage drawing an iron flask during a battle between a gargantuan silver dragon and a gargantuan white dragon, with Rimescar also fighting in the fjord.
- (2026-06-14) Eddie cast locate object on the iron flask; the GM showed the line pointing to thick blue ice. Sir Raf, enlarged by Monarch, smashed through about 15 feet of ice with Shatterspike (about 150 hit points of wall) and revealed Rimescar's hoard chamber.
- (2026-06-14) Portia took the iron flask, unstoppered it at the party's position and freed the silver dragon, who calls herself Lunae (GM-spoken as Lunae). She obeys commands for one hour, then acts on her own disposition.

chunks.title: Locating the Silver Dragon Lunae (part 3)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Locating the Silver Dragon Lunae (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-06-14) Lunae asked to keep the flask to help reestablish control of the fjord and lock up other dragons; the party agreed.
- (2026-10-18) Eddie sent Lunae a sending that the longship can hold 40; she replied she will not overfly the fjord in natural form because Icevein is too dangerous, and will move the clan to the river mouth on the fjord mouth's northeast side.
- (2026-10-18) Eddie's second sending told her they would pass the river mouth in fifteen minutes, pick up those present, and Icevein was about forty-five minutes behind. Lunae replied she will observe as an eagle and that Icevein has only greed and hate and may be usable.
- (2026-10-18) The party picked up the dwarves at the river mouth at night. Lunae, who flies at 80, landed on the ship as an elven woman after the blockade run and said 'that was interesting'. She needs another trip to her lair for her valuables, and her lair is compromised by proximity to Icevein.
- (2026-10-18) Monarch told Lunae that the lake illusion of the dead white dragon cannot be dismissed, only dispelled; Lunae said it doesn't matter, she won't return to Dragonfjord for decades.

chunks.title: Frost Salamander Hunting Heat in the Ice
names: Frost Salamander Hunting Heat in the Ice
creature that lives in the ice
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Frost Salamander Hunting Heat in the Ice (first seen 2026-06-14, last seen 2026-06-14)
Also known as: creature that lives in the ice, remorhaz
Hook: A heat-hunting ice beast stirred by Portia's fireball may come if the party uses fire near the lair.
Status: open
- (2026-06-14) After Portia's fireball the party felt a tremor in the ice and the dwarves shouted 'no fire, you fools, you'll summon it, and we don't mean the dragon'.
- (2026-06-14) The dwarves told Eddie of a creature in the ice that hunts on heat, almost as dangerous as the dragon.
- (2026-06-14) Portia's nature check narrowed it to a frost salamander or a remorhaz, probably the salamander. Lunae agreed it is a frost salamander, which can be bargained with, and said it is still distant, so only fireball-level heat would draw it.

chunks.title: Hatchling White Dragon Warmling and the Mother Dragon
names: Hatchling White Dragon Warmling and the Mother Dragon
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Hatchling White Dragon Warmling and the Mother Dragon (first seen 2026-06-14, last seen 2026-06-14)
Also known as: baby white dragon, white dragon egg
Hook: The white dragon's offspring was left alive and the mother may notice her stolen hoard.
Status: open
- (2026-06-14) Portia's call lightning cracked the dragon egg in the hoard; the hatchling's breath healed a living cold breath for 31.
- (2026-06-14) Eddie put the warmling to sleep (Wisdom DC 14). The party looted part of the hoard (the GM estimated about 100,000 coins) and left it alive; Lunae then ate it.

chunks.title: Lunae's Plan to Restock Her Hoard and Ambush the Tribute
names: Lunae's Plan to Restock Her Hoard and Ambush the Tribute
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Lunae's Plan to Restock Her Hoard and Ambush the Tribute (first seen 2026-06-14, last seen 2026-07-26)
Hook: Lunae wants to restock her hoard and reclaim Dragonfjord using the Cherek tribute.
Status: advanced
Linked: Lunae
- (2026-06-14) The GM ended the session with Lunae noting her hoard is about to be replenished by the incoming tribute and proposing to discuss how.
