- (2026-07-12) The party's Operation Weekend at Bernie's succeeded: the illusory Rimescar accepted the tribute and the Cherek left without a fight. The party took all three wagons.
- (2026-07-12) The tribute included about 50,000 silver, 10,000 gold and 24 gems worth 100 to 1,000 each. It also included a longsword, longbow, greataxe, shield, chain mail, a crown, a necklace, five rings (one magic) and arrows crafted to slay silver dragons.
- (2026-07-12) Monarch put the coin into the party inventory as an item because Lunae might get a cut.
- (2026-07-12) Lunae said she does not want to reveal herself to the many white dragons since she could be overwhelmed, though she could beat any one except the ancient. She is willing to reveal herself if it would prevent the invasion.
- (2026-07-12) The party decided not to reveal Lunae yet and to go with plan A, keeping her hidden until they have to.
- (2026-07-26) Lunae said she has limited time before Icevein learns what happened to Rimescar and comes for them, unless the way he finds out points him elsewhere. She intends to move her charges to safety and find a new home. She learned from the dwarves that a remorhaz lives near her old lair.

chunks.title: Lunae's Plan to Restock Her Hoard and Ambush the Tribute (part 2)
names: Lunae's Plan to Restock Her Hoard and Ambush the Tribute
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Lunae's Plan to Restock Her Hoard and Ambush the Tribute (first seen 2026-06-14, last seen 2026-07-26)
- (2026-07-26) The party dropped the plan to kill the other white dragons, since it might provoke Icevein. They agreed to frame the Norge for Rimescar's death or to get evidence tying the Norge to the frost giants.

chunks.title: Maulring Prisoners Sorcha and Ashvale
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Maulring Prisoners Sorcha and Ashvale (first seen 2026-07-12, last seen 2026-07-12)
Also known as: Sorcha, Ashvale
Hook: Two freed Maulring dragon slayers, Sorcha and the warforged Ashvale, will assist the party against the white dragons.
Status: open
Linked: Lunae, Maulring dragon hunters
- (2026-07-12) The Cherek wagon held two caged prisoners, a human woman and a warforged man, both Maulring dragon slayers captured while hunting dragons. Portia gave them each a Good Berry.
- (2026-07-12) The envelope notes name her as Sorcha, who helped slay Rimescar's mate, and him as Ashvale, who was among those who slew Rimescar's young. They were presented for Rimescar's vengeance.
- (2026-07-12) Portia told Sorcha they are working with Lunae, whom Sorcha had thought dead. Portia freed both prisoners, and they accept the enemy-of-my-enemy arrangement with Lunae for now.
- (2026-07-12) The party plans to bring the two dragon slayers along next session and to have them witness Rimescar's remains so the party can claim Maulring credit.

chunks.title: Icevein's Past and the Yoke of Thrym
names: Icevein's Past and the Yoke of Thrym
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Icevein's Past and the Yoke of Thrym (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: Icevein, Icevein's history
Hook: The ancient white dragon Icevein is tailing the party's stolen ship.
Status: advanced
Linked: Icevein
- (2026-07-26) Sorcha said Icevein is lord of Hvítfjall, the Great White Mountain in Norge, and that ancients do not move. Lunae confirmed the dragon is Icevein and that he moved here about thirty years ago, around the time of the Great Jarl's and the frost giants' consolidations of power.
- (2026-07-26) Lucia's Mirror of the Past showed Icevein freezing the Fenrir in ice and staring down the rune master with Vigdis beside him. It also showed him facing a crowned frost giant with Goliaths, destroying seven of twelve giant-built ships, and teaching three young white dragons including a young Rimescar. None of his dealings with frost giants were friendly.
- (2026-07-26) Raf and Portia knew the crown is the Yoke of Thrym, a legendary artifact bestowed by the frost giant god Thrym on a once-in-a-generation talent. It gives control over other frost giants, vanishes at its bearer's death and often leads to frost giant empires. Monarch only remembered it as a legendary crown.
- (2026-07-26) The GM said Icevein would turn on a dime and punish the Cherek if given hard evidence, since ancient dragons do not take orders but act on new information. Such a large fleet requires documentation, likely aboard the Fenrir, so the party plans a heist there.

chunks.title: Icevein's Past and the Yoke of Thrym (part 2)
names: Icevein's Past and the Yoke of Thrym
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Icevein's Past and the Yoke of Thrym (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-10-18) The GM said the ancient dragon is male ('a he'). Icevein flew from his island and shadowed the Fenrir at about 8 mph, not dashing; Lucia and Eddie judged it behaved like a tail or scout following to see what the party was doing.
- (2026-10-18) Near sunset Icevein dashed past the ship, and a cold unnatural storm rose in the north, which the party took as not natural.

chunks.title: Fenrir Heist for Evidence
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: Fenrir's heist, steal from the Fenrir's
Hook: The party stole the Fenrir to find documents proving who directs the Cherek tribute run and the Norge invasion.
Status: advanced
Linked: Azuriel, Cherek longship crew, Cherek rune-elder, Fenrir, Foe Shatter, Portia
- (2026-07-26) Eddie proposed swimming near the ship and casting Twilight Sanctuary underwater to end fear effects from the ship's protective magic; the party also has advantage on Wisdom saves for about five days.
- (2026-07-26) The party traveled south, crossed the icy river past Drakholm and camped, then observed from a hollow about a mile from the Fenrir's camp using Monarch's clairvoyance. At dusk the party crept toward the Fenrir; the session ended there.
- (2026-08-09) Eddie's clairvoyance into the Cherek camp's central pavilion failed because no sensor appeared; Raf judged it a fourth-level Private Sanctum ward (Arcana check 15, accepted by the GM) and detected abjuration inside the tent.
- (2026-08-09) The party used invisibility, Pass without Trace and Portia's spider form to search the commander's bedroll and pack in the pavilion; they found only soldier's kit and no documents. Portia's stealth check was 34.
- (2026-08-09) The documents likely left with the tribute wagon group, or are on the Fenrir, since the other bedrolls had been packed and removed.

chunks.title: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-08-09) Touching the Fenrir's deck triggered a lightning bolt; Portia made her Dex save and took 16 of 33 lightning damage. The wolf figurehead came alive and the whole camp was alerted.
- (2026-08-09) The Fenrir's wolf-head breathed a 60-foot cold cone; Monarch failed her Dex save and took 30 cold damage, and Portia took 7 inside a coil of rope. Monarch lost concentration on invisibility and Pass without Trace.
- (2026-08-09) Monarch charmed the bearsark (rolled 7 with disadvantage) and the hunter (rolled 11) with Charm Person (DC 19). They asked for 'documents' and 'logbooks' but did not understand the request; they urged her to get off the ship and said the ship does not know her.
- (2026-08-09) The GM said Cherek raiders keep no logbooks; the orders would be in the captain's or rune master's diary or in letters, and the rune master's quarters are in the stern with elementals reportedly nearby.
- (2026-08-09) Monarch cast Major Image to make an illusory white dragon; the berserkers who attacked it found it was an illusion. Eddie flew Portia out, Raf swam off, and the party escaped without pursuit.
- (2026-08-09) The party concluded the ship acts like a magic item with hatches warded by an on-open glyph of warding. The GM said it responds to touch but not proximity, and may see invisible creatures.

chunks.title: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (part 3)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-08-09) Raf's natural 20 on Arcana convinced the GM the Fenrir is an ancient artifact that obeys whoever attunes to it; attuning takes an hour undisturbed, with everyone in contact supportive.
- (2026-08-09) The party planned to return after a rest. Monarch would charm the guards with a higher-level Charm Person, Eddie would cast Silence, Portia would charm the elementals, flyers would enter, and Monarch might attune to the ship. The party agreed to wait for Andy before trying.
- (2026-09-06) The plan: charm the guards and crew so they sail the Fenrir away. Kyle ruled it can be sailed as a longship without attunement, but attuning needs sole possession with everyone aboard agreeing, and takes about an hour.
- (2026-09-06) Eddie's clairvoyance (10 minutes) showed camp still on alert: three guards on shore and four on deck. About 20-30 northern warriors total, roughly half on the perimeter. Guards check in about twice in ten minutes.
- (2026-09-06) Monarch cast fourth-level charm person (DC 19) on the four deck guards and all failed; Eddie cast silence on the figurehead. Portia's charm monster (DC 14) took one bearsark but the guard at the front spotted her, so initiative began.
- (2026-09-06) Below decks are three compartments with four doors, a Goliath bearsark, a bearsark and a Goliath. Portia found rune stones in one room and a flaming armored figure rose from them; she shut the door.

chunks.title: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (part 4)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-09-06) Charmed crew got the sail up and four oarsmen dragged the ship off shore, but arguments with uncharmed crew stalled it, and the figurehead howled once the ship left the silence. The Cherek commander (rage, great axe with thunder) came aboard and fought the party. Monarch knocked him unconscious at 03:28:10. Raf and Lucia then arrived.
- (2026-09-20) Sir Raf and Lucia swam out to the Fenrir as it pulled away from shore; the Cherek crew were brawling on deck. Sir Raf took chain lightning on boarding (39, halved to 19 by the borrowed ring of lightning resistance) and misty-stepped through the open hatch; Lucia dropped in unseen with a stealth check of 26.
- (2026-09-20) Below decks the party fought charmed and uncharmed Goliaths and bearsarks. Charmed crew were persuaded to row the ship about four and a half miles north, then to disembark with the unconscious, while Portia attuned to the Fenrir over the hour.
- (2026-09-20) Portia is now the attuned owner of the Fenrir (Monarch's persuasion with advantage, a 15 after heroic inspiration, kept the charmed crew consenting). She decided who counts as crew and turned off the lightning and howl; the party sailed it into the dark fjord using one steersman and two sail hands (group check middle roll 18).
- (2026-09-20) The party searched the two unguarded crew cabins and found them stripped of personal effects and rations, so no incriminating evidence turned up. The GM said all provisions and effects had been moved to the camp ashore.

chunks.title: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (part 5)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-09-20) The forward cabin with the fourth door remains unexplored and will be handled next session.
- (2026-10-04) Lucia picked the lock of the last cabin, which Kyle judged a DC 20-style lock with no traps. Inside were a small meeting table, a locked trunk, a hammock and a bearskin-covered object leaning against the back wall.
- (2026-10-04) The trunk's lock was trapped: a picked lock would trigger a piston that smashes two hammerheads together on a gem. Lucia, aided by Eddie's guidance and Monarch's check, got a 40 on sleight of hand, opened it like a key and removed the gem. It stayed inert and was warm to the touch.
- (2026-10-04) Raf's detect magic showed the gem reads evocation. The bearskin is not magical but hides something that reads divination and conjuration.
- (2026-10-04) The trunk is watertight, and its trays are infused with magnesium dust, so a spark from the gem would burn the contents to ash. The chest itself would probably survive.
- (2026-10-04) The trunk held undated letters addressed to Vigdis in Common and Giant, and a set of journals in one hand. One is partly filled in and is probably the latest logbook. The letters carry rotating code phrases and duress protocols. The party found no direct proof implicating a named patron.
- (2026-10-04) The trunk's emergency funds were 1,000 platinum, 5,000 gold and 20 trade gems worth 100 gp each (17,000 gp in total). Lucia put them in her bag of holding for the party inventory.

chunks.title: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (part 6)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-10-04) The party left the contents of the bearskin-covered object alone for now, and Raf wants it left until the ship is in safe harbor.
- (2026-10-04) Azuriel replied to Eddie's sending that the Fenrir is a critical asset: return it to Roma or destroy it at all costs. She personally guaranteed a revival attempt for any fallen party member.
- (2026-10-18) The persistent fear effect on the Fenrir is an antipathy/sympathy-type spell (eighth level, ritual-like, lasts over a week); it is modified to affect a whole ship, possibly via a wish, rune work or group casting. Raf (22) and Monarch (18) identified it.
- (2026-10-18) Eddie's dispel magic (guidance, Wisdom check total 10 plus d4) and Portia's attempt both failed; the spell persists. The hull is covered in thousands of weathered runes that would take days to decipher.
- (2026-10-18) The Fenrir's fear helped drive off merrow (ogre-sized shark-like merfolk) in the fjord; three kept pace and lost interest. The party moves at 60 ft/round under the water elemental and 120 under sail plus elemental, 24 mph with 24 oarsmen and two elementals.
- (2026-10-18) Whatever is under the bearskin was left untouched; Raf's detect magic showed divination and conjuration, and the GM said it was positioned like furniture, not a trap.

chunks.title: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (part 7)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Fenrir Heist for Evidence (first seen 2026-07-26, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-10-18) The Fenrir's signal codes were in the captain's cabin papers. Monarch decoded the Northern fleet command frigate's challenge (authentication, mission, request for orders), answered with the Fenrir code and 'bribery' as mission, and ordered the ships northeast to protect the treasure fleet; the blockade turned away.
- (2026-10-18) Monarch cast permanent major image to make the Fenrir's sails show imperial colors when two imperial spelljammers approached Emperor's Bay; their ballistas aimed at the ship and the session ended on that standoff.

chunks.title: Curse of Lycanthropy on Monarch
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Curse of Lycanthropy on Monarch (first seen 2026-09-06, last seen 2026-09-20)
Also known as: weretbear curse, werebear curse
Hook: The Goliath bearsark's bites may have spread lycanthropy; the infected drop into a berserk beast form at zero hit points.
Status: advanced
Linked: Goliath bearsark, Monarch, Portia
- (2026-09-06) Goliath bearsark bit Monarch for 12 and 11 damage, each requiring a Constitution save; Kyle said they would deal with it later, and the second was a failure.
- (2026-09-06) When Monarch dropped to 0 and Eddie healed her, she resisted the change into a bear, spending heroic inspiration; fur and rage began to rise. She may not resist next time.
- (2026-09-20) Monarch took repeated bites from the Goliath bearsark and a lethal-looking 39 damage in one round, and was told no Constitution save was needed since her status was already known.
- (2026-09-20) Portia was bitten for 10 and made a Constitution save; the GM said the bite was deep enough that she might need magical treatment and that she could feel it affecting her.
- (2026-09-20) Eddie was bitten for 11 and made a Constitution save, with no stated harm beyond the biting.
- (2026-09-20) Eddie will prepare remove curse for the morning; the GM said the moon is a waning eighth and tomorrow is the dark of the moon.
- (2026-09-20) The GM described lycanthropy: early on transformation is largely involuntary, control grows with practice, and the infected automatically transform at zero hit points, usually into a berserk state.

chunks.title: Norge Invasion Fleet Targeting Roma
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Norge Invasion Fleet Targeting Roma (first seen 2026-10-04, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: Norge invasion, invasion fleet from Norge
Hook: Norge's invasion fleet is moving on Roma.
Status: advanced
Linked: Norge, Roma
- (2026-10-04) The letters coordinate fleet engagements and supply deliveries on a scale to support an army of tens of thousands. Kyle described it as invasion scale, not raid scale. The focus is clearly Roma, and every location mentioned is in or around it.
- (2026-10-04) The letters give positions of the treasure fleet and requests for the Fenrir to support operations.
- (2026-10-04) Eddie sent Azuriel the news that Norge sends hundreds of ships and tens of thousands of troops, and that the Cherek made a deal with the ancient white dragon. Her reply was that this is serious news if verified, and she asked for the source of the intel, the dragon's name, the nature of the deal and what aid is needed.
- (2026-10-04) Eddie's second sending to Azuriel reported the stolen longship, the letters and logbooks, the tribute accepted by Icevein, Norge approaching two named dragons, the Maulring captives' fleet information and Rimescar's defeat.
- (2026-10-18) The Northern fleet is engaged in active battle at the siege of Northreach Citadel against imperial land artillery and spell fire, while a flanking blockade keeps imperial ships from leaving Emperor's Bay. First contact was about nine or ten days ago.
- (2026-10-18) The party saw the Northern fleet's ships and noted the Norge treasure fleet is somewhere out in the Sea of Storms.

chunks.title: The Winter Favored and the Terms
names: The Winter Favored and the Terms
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: The Winter Favored and the Terms (first seen 2026-10-04, last seen 2026-10-04)
Also known as: winter favored, winter favorite
Hook: The logbooks name an unnamed leader, the winter favored, who issues the orders, and refer to binding terms that limit contact with the clans back home.
Status: open
Linked: Fenrir, Foe Shatter
- (2026-10-04) The logbooks call a person the winter favored, deliberately written around their name. This person issues the orders, and their orders override earlier ones.
- (2026-10-04) The logs refer to a set of terms that guide behavior and forbid some options, especially direct communication with the clans back home. Portia's insight check suggested compartmentalized information is used to suppress discontent among those following orders.
- (2026-10-04) Eddie guessed the winter favored is a giant. Monarch said that tracks.

chunks.title: Elemental Rune Stones and Taking the Fenrir to White Crown
names: Elemental Rune Stones and Taking the Fenrir to White Crown
what to do with the Fenrir
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Elemental Rune Stones and Taking the Fenrir to White Crown (first seen 2026-10-04, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: elemental rune stones, Fenrir to White Crown, what to do with the Fenrir
Hook: The party must decide what to do with the stolen Fenrir, using its elemental stones and sailing toward White Crown.
Status: advanced
Linked: Azuriel, Fenrir, Runestones of the Fenrir, White Crown
- (2026-10-04) Monarch charmed the fire elemental in armor on top of Portia's charm, spending two sorcery points to give the save disadvantage. It saved against a DC 19 Wisdom save. Kyle ruled it stayed Monarch's friend when Portia's charm lapsed, and it vanished once attunement finished.
- (2026-10-04) Monarch sent the air elemental north, naming it El Nino, to disable Norge ships. Kyle ruled the armored fire elemental could not leave the ship and that only its master could dismiss it. Both elementals vanished after the charm hour ended.
- (2026-10-04) Kyle's homebrew: attuned to a stone, a user spends a fourth-level slot to summon an elemental that stays until killed or dismissed. If someone else attunes to the stone, it is dismissed. The fire stone gives a fire elemental or a fire myrmidon, and the air stone an air elemental or an invisible stalker.
- (2026-10-04) Eddie attuned to the fire stone and Monarch to the air stone. Monarch then summoned an air elemental, ordered it to guard the deck, and began attuning to the water stone. Raf and Eddie sorted the sails, planning to use the air and water elementals for speed.

chunks.title: Elemental Rune Stones and Taking the Fenrir to White Crown (part 2)
names: Elemental Rune Stones and Taking the Fenrir to White Crown
what to do with the Fenrir
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Elemental Rune Stones and Taking the Fenrir to White Crown (first seen 2026-10-04, last seen 2026-10-18)
- (2026-10-04) Navigation is a Survival check and steering is a Strength check. The sail-rigging roll is a two-person Strength and Dexterity job, and Eddie's passable roll left it in a workable position. Kyle's ruling is that guaranteed favorable wind and current from elementals give up to 60 ft each of movement.
- (2026-10-04) Raf wants to take the Fenrir to White Crown first, then decide whether it goes to Roma. The party is sailing north-northwest and will keep the Norge markings until they reach Emperor's Bay.
- (2026-10-04) Eddie's sending to Lunae said they swiped the Fenrir and are heading to White Crown, and invited her. She replied she will come to see if the ship can carry 40, to ferry her clan, who need a temporary home until she can secure Dragonfjord. Kyle noted the mountain dwarves cannot handle a ship but can row.
- (2026-10-18) Azuriel's instruction was to bring the Fenrir to Roma or destroy it; Raf said destruction is not yet needed and Portia said they may destroy it depending on politics. Raf was unsure how much to tell Lunae about their plans for the ship.
- (2026-10-18) Monarch's water elemental propelled the ship; the air elemental was sent to follow Icevein and returned heavily damaged (37 hit points left of 90), reporting it was too cold and was going to die. Monarch kept her attunement to the stones to resummon.
- (2026-10-18) Heading for White Crown, the party ran the Northern fleet blockade off Northreach Citadel.

chunks.title: Hunt for Valkrath
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Hunt for Valkrath (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-11-03)
Hook: The party wanted to find and remove Valkrath, the House Querid operative and Iron Shadow who kept sending assassins after them.
Status: resolved
Linked: Colonel Kaelix, Colonel Kreetz, Colonel Lara, Golden Leaf Tavern, Zyra the Silent
- (2024-10-20) Valkrath is a House Querid operative who works for spymaster Zyra the Silent and is part of the hobgoblin Iron Shadows; he has a big bounty and a house offering a favor for him.
- (2024-10-20) Another attack came at Harvey's tea shop: two skulks and four drow assassins, two disguised as patrons with disguise self and hidden among the crowd. All were killed. Portia and Lucia were put to sleep by drow poison; Eddie dropped to 0 HP but later healed himself.
- (2024-10-20) The four assassins carried 20 platinum each (80 pp total) and four vials of drow poison but no clues or travel gear. The coins were split, 13 pp each, with the remainder paid to Harvey for cleanup.
- (2024-10-20) Colonel Lara says the Valkrath bounty is for murder, including highly connected House Mazaali nobles killed in the Sword Quarter. He favors unarmed close combat, surprise attacks and multiple lethal strikes, and does hard jobs himself.
- (2024-10-20) Colonel Lara had thought he had fled and was surprised he was back. She has no leads on his location, timing or next steps.

chunks.title: Hunt for Valkrath (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Hunt for Valkrath (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-11-03)
- (2024-10-20) The party chose a 'bait' plan: wait at the Golden Leaf while publicly advertising who is after them, and defeat each wave of assassins until Valkrath comes himself. They will drink non-alcoholic drinks to stay sharp and may badmouth Valkrath but not the Iron Shadows.
- (2024-10-20) Monarch told Colonel Kreetz, a corrupt watch commander, where the party would be, intending the leak as bait. Kreetz promptly cited the bounty as 6,500 and promised guards for a fee. The party suspects he is on Valkrath's payroll.
- (2024-10-20) Monarch will disguise herself as a tiefling girl and Portia wild shapes into a chestnut horse, so that only three capable-looking people leave the Groves.
- (2024-10-20) Speak with Dead would cost the low four digits in gold, which the party cannot afford yet.
- (2024-11-03) The party waited all day at the Golden Leaf Tavern as bait. Watchmen set up there, and the former hired killers led by Drik guarded the doors and windows as a favor, having been rescued by the party.
- (2024-11-03) At about nine or ten at night Valkrath attacked with two darkling skulks and invisible allies. He opened with a hobgoblin troll-mask fist strike on Sir Raf for 7 bludgeoning, then dropped Lucia to 0 and teleported in shadow, and later hurled darts and downed Monarch and Portia.
- (2024-11-03) Valkrath disguised himself as a Trimarket watchman and shadow-stepped away. Eddie shot him in the back with an arrow for 6 damage, and he collapsed dead.

chunks.title: Hunt for Valkrath (part 3)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Hunt for Valkrath (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-11-03)
- (2024-11-03) His glyph exploded in a 30 foot acid burst on death, dealing 38 acid damage. It destroyed his body and killed about a dozen civilians, plus Fickle the fairy dragon, who was following him invisibly.
- (2024-11-03) The GM ruled the acid did not destroy his equipment; his iron shadow mask survives as proof of death. The party collects a 6,500 gold bounty, 170 platinum he carried, and one favor from House Mazaali (spelled Mazaali), usable by the first who asks.
- (2024-11-03) The GM stated that top agents of Zyra the Silent carry the glyph tattoo, and Valkrath was both an iron shadow and a Zyra agent.

chunks.title: Drow Poison Investigation
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Drow Poison Investigation (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-10-20)
Hook: Portia has asked the Green Apothecary about drow sleep poison and whether the assassins meant to capture rather than kill.
Status: advanced
Linked: Simona Querid Ventre
- (2024-10-20) Drow poison is a DC 13 Constitution save: failure means poisoned for an hour, and failing by 5 or more means unconscious for the hour. A vial coats six projectiles or one melee weapon and evaporates within a minute.
- (2024-10-20) The Green Apothecary says it must be brewed in total darkness with Underdark fungi, spider venom and a sleep spell, and it only works through a wound. It costs about 200 gp and the authorities treat sleep poison as relatively harmless.
- (2024-10-20) The Green Apothecary's patron is House Ventre, whose contact is Simona Querid Ventre, daughter of a marriage between Houses Querid and Ventre.

chunks.title: Corrupt Watch Colonel Kreetz
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Corrupt Watch Colonel Kreetz (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-10-20)
Status: advanced
Hook: Colonel Kreetz, the legendarily corrupt watch colonel of the Trimarket district, took the party's bribe to post guards at the Golden Leaf while the party used itself as bait for Valkrath.
Linked: Colonel Kreetz, Colonel Lara, Golden Leaf Tavern, Valkrath

chunks.title: Hades's Divination: Nine Hundred Mortals and the Wyrm's Mouth
names: Hades's Divination: Nine Hundred Mortals and the Wyrm's Mouth
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Hades's Divination: Nine Hundred Mortals and the Wyrm's Mouth (first seen 2026-10-18, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: Hades divination, bear star divination
Hook: Eddie's divination asked how to exploit Icevein's greed against the Norge fleet; Hades demands nine hundred mortals be guided home.
Status: advanced
Linked: Hades
- Eddie's Divination question to Hades: "What course of action can we take to take advantage of Icevein's greed and to the detriment of the Norge fleet"
- Hades' answer to Eddie's Divination: "Nine hundred mortals are due me / and you will guide them home // Ride wind and wave to the bear star / Before the dawn star falls // By night return to the wyrm's mouth / You sail by wave alone"
- (2026-10-18) Eddie cast divination as a ritual asking what course of action takes advantage of Icevein's greed to the detriment of the fleet. Hades replied: nine hundred mortals are due him; ride wind and wave to the bear star before the dawn star falls; by night return to the wyrm's mouth; sail by wave alone.
- (2026-10-18) The bear star is Arcturus, a navigation star slightly east of north. Eddie rolled a 24 on survival (with Portia's assistance) and the party headed north-northeast.
- (2026-10-18) The party took the wyrm's mouth to be the river mouth; they sailed back by wave alone at night and sent the Northern fleet toward the treasure fleet, which Eddie took as fulfilling the mortals due Hades.

chunks.title: House Ventre
chunks.text:
Faction: House Ventre (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-12-14)
Also known as: House Ventra
Overview: House Ventre is a noble house (also written House Ventra) whose banner Simona Querid Ventre's imperial entourage carried to the Azure Sky camp. Simona, a fae noble who married in from House Querid, is patron of the Green Apothecary, and the house also includes the spymaster Octavio Libram, the gossip Lady Antress of Greka and the powerful Lady Gracia, Raf's patron. Azuriel vouches for the party's work with the house, and Jimmy Slips holds blackmail that could reveal the party was sent by House Ventre against the shipyards.
Type: noble house

chunks.title: House Querid
chunks.text:
Faction: House Querid (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2026-04-19)
Overview: House Querid is a noble house of Roma, known chiefly for cartography, exploration and information brokering, and its symbol is a compass with a quill. It drew the DM's world map "Known Lands of the Fourth Imperium". The party found one of its wrecked wagons holding a long-dead cartographic expedition, and learned that spymaster Zyra the Silent leads its spying and that the Iron Shadow Valkrath worked for her. Simona Querid Ventre, originally of the house, still has contacts there and offered to carry the party's messages.
Type: noble house
Role: noble house of Roma
- House Querid of Roma drew the DM's world map, "Known Lands of the Fourth Imperium".
- (2026-03-08) The party found a wrecked wagon of House Querid, whose symbol is a compass with a quill. Kyle said the house is chiefly known for cartography and information, and earlier party dealings with it were non-cartographic.
- (2026-03-08) The wagon held about ten long-dead people, a cartographic expedition returning from a trip. Finds: a signet ring marking an office, a cartography kit in a House Querid case, an annotated map of Dragonfjord and a sending stone from the head cartographer.

chunks.title: Iron Shadows
chunks.text:
Faction: Iron Shadows (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2024-11-03)
Overview: The Iron Shadows are a mercenary company that the GM describes as more a training program than a political body, run by the fey courts. Members are entirely loyal to whoever employs them, drop prior loyalties when they change jobs, and owe each other no loyalty. The party knows of Valkrath, a hobgoblin Iron Shadow hired by House Querid and working for spymaster Zyra the Silent, whose mask survived as proof of his death and whose bounty the party collected.
Type: mercenary company
- (2024-10-20) The GM explained that Iron Shadows are entirely loyal to whoever they work for and drop prior loyalties when they change jobs; they are trained in programs run by the fey courts, are acquired as a favor, owe each other no loyalty, and are more a training program than a political body.

chunks.title: House Marvad
chunks.text:
Faction: House Marvad (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-11-30)
Overview: House Marvad is a noble house described as the former imperial house of the Imperium and as specialists in politics and espionage. Its members include Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad, a gatekeeper who can bring items to the Senate floor and who the party deduced plays both sides, and Emperor Galus Cirrus Marvad Titanicus, said to be a storm giant though rumors say he is a titan. The Roman consul belongs to the house, and a Senate measure sponsored by Magnus would place the Groves of Belenus under the consul's oversight, shifting influence from House Ventre to House Marvad. Lucia's mirror also showed a House Marvad woman backhanding the Khan in a Colosseum duel and then raising a whirlwind of dust.
Type: noble house
Role: ruling house of the Imperium: politics and espionage specialists; former imperial house
- House Marvad: politics and espionage specialists. Former imperial house.

chunks.title: House Mazaali
chunks.text:
Faction: House Mazaali (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-11-02)
Overview: House Mazaali is a confederation of warrior clans, mystics and merchant families based largely in the Khanates, serving as the Imperium's chief control over the eastern steppe and its front line against the Dawnrealm. It draws political weight from that defensive role, and the current great Khan belongs to it; Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan is a significant figure. It controls the Ruins of Qul'drik near Xi'an Palace, owes the party a favor for killing Valkrath, and is Lucia's former fiancé's family, who would reinstate the engagement if she denounced Maximus.
Type: confederation
Parent: Khanate clans
Role: noble house of the Khanates
- A confederation of warrior clans, mystics, and merchant families based largely in the Khanates.
- The Imperium's chief means of control over the eastern steppe and the front line against the Dawnrealm.
- Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan is a significant figure in the house.
- (2024-11-03) House Mazaali is Lucia's former fiancé's family. It owes the party one favor for killing Valkrath, and the first to ask uses it up.
- (2024-11-17) Lucia's former fiancé rules from the Xeon Palace in the North and is exploring the Ruins of Qul'drik, a giant name meaning 'great citadel'. The house will reinstate the engagement if Lucia denounces Maximus.

chunks.title: House Mazaali (part 2)
chunks.text:
Faction: House Mazaali (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-11-02)
- (2025-01-05) The GM described them as the house of the Khans in the eastern Khanates, a buffer between the Imperium and the Dawnrealm, with great political power because they guarantee the Imperium's defense. The Khanates would be a danger if they flipped to the Dawnrealm.
- (2025-01-05) They control an incompletely explored ancient ruin with dangers in it, which the party may seek a job to explore. Lucia has ties through her broken engagement.
- (2025-01-19) The current great Khan is of House Mazaali. Its ruins at Qul'drik near Xi'an Palace are being scavenged, which is dangerous. The house keeps people in Roma, and Lucia knows someone there.
- (2025-02-02) House Mazaali's Khans have had more visits from giants than usual, representatives of the Imperium.
- (2025-02-16) All Khanate clans belong to House Mazaali. The People of the Azure Sky controls the Ruins of Qul'drik and lets no one in; Imperial attempts to seize them failed long ago against massed clans and the ruins' dangers.
- (2025-11-02) House Mazaali represents the Khanates in imperial politics and draws its political weight from being the first line of defense against the Dawnrealm; without it Roma would likely fall.

chunks.title: Khanate clans
chunks.text:
Faction: Khanate clans (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-02-16)
Also known as: Imperial Khanates
Overview: The Khanate clans, also called the Imperial Khanates, are clans on the steppe that rallied against past imperial attempts to seize the Ruins of Qul'drik. The Imperial Khanates are shown within the Imperium Titanicus on House Querid's map. Torg Khan's clan is itching to fight the Dawnrealm and resents being kept out of the war by the giants running the Imperium.
Type: clan / tribe

chunks.title: People of the Azure Sky
chunks.text:
Faction: People of the Azure Sky (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-11-02)
Also known as: Tengrue Ovaag
Overview: The People of the Azure Sky (Tengrue Ovaag) is a clan within House Mazaali that controls access to the ruins of Qul'drik and relies on them for wealth and power. They built Xi'an Palace, their seat of power, and are led by Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan, with Erden Batu as warleader and Urag Bayarmaa as shamanic priestess and seer. Other known members include Chimeg, Tomar, Sets'en, Oyun Temur, Jochi and Khan Sir Saravio. They have not mapped the ruins' towers, and Urag Bayarmaa has warned that something old is stirring beneath the city.
Type: clan / tribe
Parent: House Mazaali
- The clan that controls access to the ruins of Qul'drik.

chunks.title: Stormgale Clan
chunks.text:
Faction: Stormgale Clan (first seen 2025-02-16, last seen 2025-05-04)
Also known as: Stormgale
Overview: The Stormgale Clan is a fully nomadic Khanate clan led by Jargal Khan, with a symbol of dark clouds and lightning. It is a mercantile and military powerhouse that controls mountain trade routes into and out of the Dawnrealm, takes Dawnrealm bribes openly, and allies with the People of the Azure Sky. It offered the party hospitality and barter, but Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan declared war on it over the attempt on Chimeg's life, and the party suspects it may be after the ruins of Qul'drik, backed by the Dawnrealm. A Stormgale clansman who apparently summoned a stalker was defeated by Eddie.
Type: clan / tribe
Parent: Khanate clans
Role: fully nomadic Khanate clan
- A mercantile and military powerhouse that controls key trade routes through the mountains to the Dawnrealm.
- (2025-02-16) The Stormgale clan's symbol is dark clouds with lightning. They control mountain trade routes into and out of the Dawnrealm, take Dawnrealm bribes openly with the Khan taking a cut, are opportunistic, and ally with the People of the Azure Sky. They offered the party hospitality and barter at a 10% difference.

chunks.title: Red Wargs clan
chunks.text:
Faction: Red Wargs clan (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2025-02-02)
Also known as: Redborg
Overview: The Red Wargs (Redborg) are a Khanate clan near the Dawnrealm border who resent outside control. Their loyalty to the Imperium amounts to not sacking imperial cities and not taking orders from the Dawnrealm, and they have fought many battles against Dawnrealmers. Their Khan, Sokha, let the caravan camp within her perimeter after Raf beat their champion Grock in single combat. The clan says a cloud giant visited a couple of months ago on a purely ceremonial visit, and they don't know why.
Type: clan / tribe
Parent: Khanate clans
Role: Khanate clan near the Dawnrealm border
- (2025-02-02) The Red Wargs resent outside control, and their loyalty to the Imperium consists of not sacking imperial cities and not taking orders from the Dawnrealm. They have fought many battles against Dawnrealmers.
- (2025-02-02) A cloud giant visited the Red Wargs a couple of months ago on a purely ceremonial visit, and they don't know why.

chunks.title: Torg Khan's clan
chunks.text:
Faction: Torg Khan's clan (first seen 2025-01-19, last seen 2025-01-19)
Overview: Torg Khan's clan is a Khanate clan camped on the steppe. Its Khan is itching to fight the Dawnrealm and resents that the Imperium's giants keep them out of the war. Its diplomat and chief merchant, Anya Redwind, told Monarch that magic is rare, with very few spellcasters in the clan.
Type: clan / tribe
Parent: Khanate clans

chunks.title: House Kenegal
chunks.text:
Faction: House Kenegal (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-02-22)
Overview: House Kenegal is a noble house to which Sir Raf belongs. Its notable members are Ronnom Kenegal, a wanted murderer and black sheep, and his late mother Ehlonna, the dragon knight. House Kenegal pays Colonel Kaelix's salary and supplies much of the military presence in Roma, gaining power from it, and it is split in favor of the Groves Senate measure.
Type: noble house

chunks.title: House Kellenor
chunks.text:
Faction: House Kellenor (first seen 2025-12-14, last seen 2026-02-22)
Overview: House Kellenor is an agricultural noble house that ships goods; Mirel Kellenor is its master and Merrill heads its shipping. Mirel sent the party to rescue Debbie from Najik and the bronze dragon, supplying the ship Wave Mount and a bribe chest. Merrill gave each party member a writ of passage for free passage on House Kellenor ships, though the party cannot choose the destination.
Type: noble house

chunks.title: House Calvus
chunks.text:
Faction: House Calvus (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2025-11-30)
Overview: House Calvus is a noble house with two known senators. Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus employs Monarch, wants wild and druidic magic regulated, and has a Groves bill with a 20-vote cushion. Senator Darius Calvus repeatedly asks about timber rights and might be satisfied by a sustainable harvest deal.
Type: noble house

chunks.title: Imperial Senate
chunks.text:
Faction: Imperial Senate (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: Senate, Roman Senate
Overview: The Imperial Senate is the governing body of Roma, whose senators include several giants, and the DM states that the storm giant Senator Brontus Aurumbrand Tempesta holds tremendous power over it. Its main concern in the material is a measure sponsored by Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad to place the Groves of Belenus under the direct oversight of the Roman consul. The Groves bill is likely to pass unless its proponents are weakened, and the party has been courting individual senators to vote against annexation. Senators are motivated by differing interests: Vaelthira wants backing for a Norge war petition to the emperor, Valeria Dalmia Calvus wants wild magic regulated, and others want timber, herbs, a restored henge or meals. The party has won over some senators through oaths and deals, while Brontus remains unspoken to.
Type: government
- The storm giant Senator Brontus Aurumbrand Tempesta holds tremendous power over the Imperial Senate.

chunks.title: Julia the Glacier's squad
chunks.text:
Faction: Julia the Glacier's squad (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Julia's squad
Overview: Julia the Glacier's squad is an enforcer group working for Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu and part of the Imperial frost giants. It consists of Julia, a goliath with frost giant heritage, Krug the ogre, Gillygully the ettin, Shiver Grundy the frost sorcerer, and orog mercenaries Hanak and Bolak. They warned Eddie not to talk to senators, and Monarch charmed Julia and bought off the thugs with a gold piece.
Type: enforcer squad
Parent: Imperial frost giants

chunks.title: Imperial frost giants
chunks.text:
Faction: Imperial frost giants (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2026-07-26)
Also known as: Roman frost giants, House of Frost
Overview: The Imperial frost giants, also called the Roman frost giants or House of Frost, are a nation and military force. The party knows of two members: Rowan, a spy master in the frost giant camp who answers Eddie's reports and warns about Icevein, and Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu, a frost giant senator of Roma whose Hall of Frost camp plans the war against Norge. The party was given time in a planning map room showing Emperor's Bay landing points that omitted Dragonfjord.
Type: nation / military

chunks.title: Norge
chunks.text:
Faction: Norge (first seen 2025-11-02, last seen 2026-10-18)
Also known as: Norge clans
Overview: Norge, also called the Norge clans, is a nation and military power ruled by a Great Jarl, who about thirty years ago gained king-like power over the clans. Since then there have been fewer internal raids and more raids on the Imperium and elsewhere. The party suspects the Great Jarl is Hundar, a frost giant also called winter favorite, and possibly the crowned figure from the mirror vision who wore the Yoke of Thrym and faced Icevein. Norge's northern fleet blockades the mouth of Emperor's Bay to protect its ships sieging Northreach Citadel. The logbooks mention a Winter Favored whose orders supersede other plans, and Eddie guessed this leader is a giant. Eddie reported to Azuriel that Norge was sending hundreds of ships carrying tens of thousands. In the senate, Vaelthira petitions the emperor to make war on Norge, Magnus supports it on paper but is thought to play both sides, and Vaelthira opposes it.
Type: nation / military

chunks.title: Cherek
chunks.text:
Faction: Cherek (first seen 2025-11-30, last seen 2026-10-18)
Overview: The Cherek are a clan of Norge. The party has encountered a Cherek longship crew of mostly Goliath raiders and warriors aboard the Fenrir-prowed longship, and a camp of about 30 to 32 elite, older warriors near the shore, wrapped in a dark fog. The party believes the Cherek are negotiating with dragons, having made a deal with an ancient white dragon, and are waiting for a treasure ship and a possible second tribute fleet of galleons. Known members include the war leader Vigdis Foe Shatter, to whom the letters were addressed, a rune master who is not at the camp, and a commander of the camp guard who was found unconscious.
Type: clan / tribe
Parent: Norge

chunks.title: Cult of the Dragon
chunks.text:
Faction: Cult of the Dragon (first seen 2025-05-04, last seen 2026-07-12)
Also known as: Dragon cult
Overview: The Cult of the Dragon was formed to return Tiamat from the Hells and hinges on masks; its members seal deals with 'in the name of the dread mother'. The GM said it is not exclusively a Dawnrealm operation, since some cultists come from the Dawnrealm and others look like imperials. The party has fought and killed many of its members, including the Dreamcaster, half dragons, fanatics, a wyvern and the Speaker of Storms, and found a letter pointing to the blue dragon mask via the Hall of Blades.
Type: cult

chunks.title: Dawnrealm forces
chunks.text:
Faction: Dawnrealm forces (first seen 2025-02-02, last seen 2026-02-22)
Overview: The Dawnrealm forces are a nation and military power. The Red Wargs describe them as fielding many hobgoblins, fey, and ogres and trolls whose loyalty the Imperium's giants cannot break; most Dawnrealmers have rudimentary magical training, and the realm is known for bribery and subversion. Two members are known to the party: Veen, a Monk-style fighter who warned the doppelgangers' people to flee and ambushed the party, and an Easterling mage who fled in a hurry. The Khan said the mage was from the Dawnrealm and may have been playing the Stormgale clan for his own ends, and a Cult of the Dragon amulet was found at his abandoned camp.
Type: nation / military

chunks.title: Maulring dragon slayers
chunks.text:
Faction: Maulring dragon slayers (first seen 2026-05-17, last seen 2026-07-26)
Also known as: Maulringers
Overview: The Maulring dragon slayers (Maulringers) come from the Duchy of Maulring, a small dragon-hunting principality west of the fjord that opposes all dragonkind, earns skull marks for kills and pioneered warforged creation. They are unreasonable about dragons only within the Duchy and pragmatic elsewhere. The party freed two captives, Sorcha and Ashvale, who reported that the Norge fleet numbers hundreds of ships.
Type: nation / military

chunks.title: Mithril Peaks clan
chunks.text:
Faction: Mithril Peaks clan (first seen 2026-04-19, last seen 2026-06-14)
Also known as: Mithril clan
Overview: The Mithril Peaks clan is a dwarven mithril supplier to Roma with ties to the silver dragon Lunae, and Rowan reports it has been silent for years. The party met its survivors and descendants, forced by the dragon Rimescar to mine mithril and confined to their part of the cavern, and found the dead Bodgel Deepdelver, whose brother Grodel remains in the mine. The dwarves, about 20 and formerly the silver dragon's entourage, cheered Lunae's return and ambushed and killed Rimescar with crossbows.
Type: clan / tribe

chunks.title: Hades priesthood
chunks.text:
Faction: Hades priesthood (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2024-11-17)
Overview: The Hades priesthood is a religious order whose Temple of Hades in Roma is headed by Father Georg, a man sparing with words. Eddie joined the temple and took his vows from Georg, who later gave him a letter from a dead friend bearing a dragon drawing marked 'Mythic Isles?' and Qul'drik.
Type: religious / druidic order

chunks.title: Najik lay monastic order
chunks.text:
Faction: Najik lay monastic order (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-02-08)
Overview: The Najik lay monastic order is a religious order led by Anish, an elder aasimar monk and hierarch, on Najik. The monks feel safe because the dragon protects them and they cannot compel Ronnom to leave. Their messenger falcons recently fell ill and died of a weak poison.
Type: religious / druidic order

chunks.title: Unseelie Court
chunks.text:
Faction: Unseelie Court (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Overview: The Unseelie Court is a fey court whose nameless queen, the Queen of Air and Darkness, was banished to the Feydark and keeps only her office. Aurelia suggested she is behind the blight after Aurelia refused to join her court.
Type: fey court

chunks.title: Seelie Court
chunks.text:
Faction: Seelie Court (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-01-25)
Overview: The Seelie Court is a fey court ruled nominally by King Oberon, with Queen Titania holding the real power. Olifin, a ranger from Titania's court, escorted Mona and opened a fairy ring near the court. Titania would lose out to the archfey Aurelia within the Whisperwood.
Type: fey court

chunks.title: Whisperwood court
chunks.text:
Faction: Whisperwood court (first seen 2026-01-25, last seen 2026-06-14)
Overview: The Whisperwood court is ruled by the archfey Aurelia, who is independent of both the Seelie and Unseelie courts. Portia holds a Root of Whisperwood that can send a message to Aurelia.
Type: fey court

chunks.title: Golden Leaf staff
chunks.text:
Faction: Golden Leaf staff (first seen 2024-11-03, last seen 2024-12-01)
Overview: The Golden Leaf staff are the people of the Golden Leaf Tavern in Roma: owner Thor, a former performer, sous chef and bouncer Morton, and bartender and comedian Raylana. Thor was devastated by Fickle's death, and Monarch named him as a reference for the party.
Type: family / business

chunks.title: Fist of the Butterfly
chunks.text:
Faction: Fist of the Butterfly (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-19)
Overview: The Fist of the Butterfly is the mercenary company the party registered with Colonel Kaelix, with Monarch as leader and the Golden Leaf as contact. Its members are Eddie, Lucia, Monarch, Portia and Sir Raf, and Lucia named herself a scout.
Type: mercenary company

chunks.title: Shimmerstone family
chunks.text:
Faction: Shimmerstone family (first seen 2024-11-17, last seen 2025-01-05)
Overview: The Shimmerstone family is a gnome family running Shimmerstone Shipworks in Greka, founded by Papa Shimmerstone, a retired former player character, and now run by his great-grandson Jingle. Longtime engineers say the shipworks has drifted from clockwork and gas-bag airships toward enchantments and automation, blaming a masked cloud giant investor who is not family. The party found a warlock, Eryndra Kalastov, and clockwork guards at a darkened dry dock where a secret project is under way.
Type: family / business
Role: gnome family running Shimmerstone Shipworks in Greka
Location: Greka
- (2024-11-17) Azuriel said they run the Greka shipyard (Shimmerstone Shipworks) where the package went.
- (2024-12-01) Longtime gnome engineers say the shipworks has drifted from the Shimmerstone legacy of clockwork and gas-bag airships built in the days of Papa Shimmerstone. They say recent management uses enchantments and automation and blame the cloud giant.

chunks.title: Roman city watch
chunks.text:
Faction: Roman city watch (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2026-02-22)
Also known as: city watch
Overview: The Roman city watch is a government force commanded district by district by colonels. Colonel Lara oversees the Sword Quarter and sent a detachment to escort the party to the Magistrate's Office. Colonel Kreetz oversees the Trimarket and is described as corrupt.
Type: government

chunks.title: Green Apothecary
chunks.text:
Faction: Green Apothecary (first seen 2024-10-20, last seen 2025-11-30)
Also known as: Groves of Belenus druids
Overview: The Green Apothecary is a druidic order of druids, rangers, alchemists and naturalists, with significant fey influence, that manages the Groves of Belenus and makes potions and medicines. House Ventre sponsors it, with Simona Querid Ventre as patron, and Portia is a member. The party gathered it at the standing stones to hash out binding oaths in the Groves fight, and its members explained how drow poison is brewed.
Type: religious / druidic order
Role: Druidic group that makes potions and medicines; Portia is a member. It is sponsored by House Ventre.
Location: Groves of Belenus
- (2024-10-20) House Ventre sponsors and backs the Green Apothecary, with Simona Querid Ventre as point person. She is the daughter of a marriage between Houses Querid and Ventre.
- (2024-10-20) Its members said drow poison is brewed in total darkness from Underdark fungi, spider venom and at least one sleep spell. Authorities care little about toxins without lasting effects.
- (2024-11-17) The Green Apothecary is an assembly of druids, rangers and like-minded creatures that manages the Groves; House Ventre is its major sponsor and political backer, with Simona as patron.
- (2025-11-30) The Green Apothecary is a loose association of alchemists, naturalists and druids with significant fey influence that watches over the Groves; its patron is Simona Ventre and Portia is a member.

chunks.title: Lemir banking family
chunks.text:
Faction: Lemir banking family (first seen 2026-01-11, last seen 2026-01-11)
Overview: The Lemir banking family is a successful but not major family known for betting on overseas shipping ventures. It funded the Nayad, whose captain was a family member. Its teenage noble Treif Lemir survived the shipwreck and hinted that Ronnom should be properly dealt with.
Type: family / business

chunks.title: House Cerro
chunks.text:
Faction: House Cerro (first seen 2025-11-16, last seen 2025-11-30)
Overview: House Cerro is a noble house. Its known member is Senator Culdrick Cerro (called Quintus by the GM), who gave a long speech arguing that places of power should be controlled by the Imperium. He is nostalgic for the old Imperium and swayable by nostalgia-based arguments rather than a deal.
Type: noble house

chunks.title: Eddie
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
Character sheet: Lizardfolk; Cleric 7 (Twilight Domain (TCoE)) / Rogue 1; level 8; background Faction Agent
- Sent Lunae (4:57 PM): "We will pass the river mouth in 15 minutes. Pick up those present. Icevein about 45 minutes behind. Hide. We can double back for more."
- Eddie's Divination question to Hades: "What course of action can we take to take advantage of Icevein's greed and to the detriment of the Norge fleet". Hades' answer to Eddie's Divination: "Nine hundred mortals are due me / and you will guide them home // Ride wind and wave to the bear star / Before the dawn star falls // By night return to the wyrm's mouth / You sail by wave alone"
- (2024-10-20) Healed himself or an ally with Cure Wounds for 9 and snapped with Hungry Jaws, which missed.
- (2024-10-20) Hit a skulk with his silver scimitar, bloodying it, and took 7 slashing and 1 necrotic damage from claws at AC 18.
- (2024-10-20) Dropped to 0 hit points from a skulk's 8 slashing damage and fell unconscious, then returned to 1 HP.
- (2024-10-20) Cast Toll the Dead (DC 13 Wisdom save, the skulk rolled 11) and healed himself for 6, going up to 7 hit points.
- (2024-10-20) Cast Guiding Bolt twice as red and black flames, hitting for 16 and knocking out one assassin, then burning another to ash.
- (2024-10-20) Played a drum beat to give out heroic inspiration and gave it to Sir Raf.
- (2024-10-20) Rolled a natural 20 on a History check, recalling that Colonel Kreetz of Trimarket is legendarily corrupt.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 2)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2024-11-03) Heard faint snapping wood during lunch, cast Shield of Faith and crept toward the closed side door and window, then pointed out trouble at the door and window to Sir Raf.
- (2024-11-03) Opened the door on one of Drik's former hired killers (insight: the man believed he was only guarding the door) and apologized, sheathing his scimitar.
- (2024-11-03) Prepared drow sleep poison and arrows for the ambush, asking about dunking them one at a time.
- (2024-11-03) Opened the fight with Guiding Bolt (using inspiration) on the troll-masked Valkrath: 23 to hit, 15 radiant damage.
- (2024-11-03) Used Channel Divinity to heal the downed Lucia for d8+3 = 10, and bit a skulk with Hungry Jaws for 2 temporary hit points.
- (2024-11-03) Drank a healing potion for 5, then readied an action and spotted the watchman-disguised Valkrath fleeing.
- (2024-11-03) Shot the fleeing disguised Valkrath in the back with a drow-poisoned arrow (15 to hit, 6 damage), killing him and triggering the acid glyph.
- (2024-11-17) Took his share of the split, 1,500 gold pieces, as 150 platinum.
- (2024-11-17) Chose to buy a guardian emblem (400 gold) and a cloak of Elvenkind, and decided on a +1 short sword instead of a needle of mending.
- (2024-11-17) Was called to the Temple of Hades by Father Georg, who gave him a letter from a dead friend and fellow Hades priest. It held an ink drawing of a dragon representation with 'Mythic Isles?' and Qul'drik written on it; his nature and arcana checks told him nothing.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 3)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2024-11-17) Shared the letter with the party at the Golden Leaf and explained the friend sent it by a very slow route and died soon after. The friend's calm in death was what led Eddie to the priesthood.
- (2024-11-17) Suggested the party buy earrings of message for coordination. He picked up a pair at 100 gold, but they turned out not to be a common item as he thought.
- (2024-11-17) Used an insight check on the Greka local and read her 'you'll have a great time there' as a dig at both the party and the tavern.
- (2024-11-17) Ordered the rich dark beer at Brim's AutoKeg.
- (2024-12-01) Succeeded on an insight check against Jimmy at Brim's AutoKeg thanks to his plus five. He quietly moved the party to another table and urged them not to intervene in Jimmy's con.
- (2024-12-01) Spelled out his full lizardfolk name as the reason he goes by Eddie, and gave his background as a citizen who earned it in military service and is a priest of Hades.
- (2024-12-01) Scouted the Greka Mercenary Hall with investigation 14. He learned it runs like Colonel Kaelix's, has a Shimmerstone security posting, and that Shimmerstone rarely hires mercenaries and relies on automata.
- (2024-12-01) Succeeded on an intelligence check watching the shift change and deduced the lone workers were recently hired for the secret project.
- (2024-12-01) In his interview he suggested clockwork sharks for the water, said he was not curious about Dock 3, and backed up that claim with deception after rerolling with inspiration (a 14). Jingle then decided to hire the party.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 4)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2024-12-01) Chose twilight cleric at level-up and kept a 5 for hit points.
- (2024-12-15) Patrolled the perimeter stealthily with Raf, and kept up guidance on Diego's flights.
- (2024-12-15) Offered to prepare locate object, then with Portia triangulated the kyber crystal to Bay 3 (with Raf's help advantage).
- (2024-12-15) Entered the silenced building to help Jimmy, learned the sentry bubble can be dropped only by persuading it, destroying it, or making it bubble something worse, and proposed beating it with a longbow.
- (2025-01-05) Stabbed the detention sentry with his magic short sword (Plus One Short Sword) for 9 damage (d6 rolled 5, +4); magical fire burst out around the wound.
- (2025-01-05) Hit the sentry again for 10 damage (d6 rolled 6, +4) with the short sword, leaving it bloodied.
- (2025-01-05) Hit the sentry again for 7 with the short sword (3+4) and glimpsed what looked like a fire elemental animating it.
- (2025-01-05) Failed to hit the sentry with 16 and with Hungry Jaws bites, and some of his rolls did not register in the VTT.
- (2025-01-05) Delivered the final blow with 5 damage (1+4), causing the sentry to explode; took 8 fire damage from the burst.
- (2025-01-05) Healed Lucia with 16 points of healing and Raf with 12, then healed himself for 11.
- (2025-01-05) Slipped out of the building stealthily to patrol the perimeter afterward.
- (2025-01-05) Rolled low on the group Deception check (an 8 among the rolls); the group's middle roll was 18.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 5)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-01-05) Considering a Quiver of Ehlonna for the long wilderness trip; deferred purchases to later.
- (2025-01-19) Bought a Quiver of Ehlonna (uncommon, 400 gp) and weapons to fill it in preparation for the caravan job.
- (2025-01-19) Told Sir Saravar that he is a Twilight cleric who can see a great distance in the dark, so it would be hard to surprise the party at night.
- (2025-01-19) Told Sir Saravar the party had beaten an iron shadow, a challenging battle.
- (2025-01-19) Suggested hiring a ranger to join the party for a slice of the pay and asked Colonel Kaelix about rangers; the pay would be split six ways from the 5,000 gp. Kaelix agreed to send interested rangers to the Golden Leaf.
- (2025-01-19) Argued that Sir Saravar might be using the party as bait while the real goods travel a safer route, and that the party should not trick him into a job he doubts they can do.
- (2025-01-19) Asked the GM whether riding a horse needs a skill; the GM said anyone can ride, with Animal Handling checks only for tricky things.
- (2025-01-19) Group Perception on day five was 19, spotting more underground trouble and a Khan's encampment.
- (2025-01-19) Listened in at the Khan's camp and corroborated Lucia's rumor that the clan is disgruntled at being kept out of the war.
- (2025-02-02) Rolled a 20 initiative, then opened the ankheg fight with guiding bolt, which hit on a 14 and dealt 16 radiant damage and bloodied the first ankheg.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 6)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-02-02) Readied guiding bolt against the second ankheg and hit it when it burst up, giving the next attacker advantage.
- (2025-02-02) Cured Raf's wounds after the fight for 8 points of healing, then gave Raf a vigilant blessing (advantage on his next initiative roll).
- (2025-02-02) Helped harvest the ankheg carcasses by taking turns with Portia, and worked each night at curing the plates.
- (2025-02-02) Blessed Raf just before his single combat with Grock and gave Monarch a vigilant blessing afterward.
- (2025-02-02) Argued that going into the Dawnrealm under a contract would protect the party from conscription.
- (2025-02-02) Had platinum made into two rings costing 50 gp as a matched set, a component for warding bond, at Sun Dragon.
- (2025-02-16) Cast second-level Bless on Monarch, Lucia, Rafael and Portia before the troll fight.
- (2025-02-16) Used Twilight Sanctuary (30-foot sphere of dim light) and granted d6+3 temporary hit points to allies and their horses at end of turns (4, 5, 8, 9 and 7 rolled for various recipients; 9 for Lucia).
- (2025-02-16) Cast Healing Word as a bonus action for 10 points of healing on an ally in bad shape.
- (2025-02-16) Hit the troll with a 16 guiding bolt for 22 radiant damage (5d6).
- (2025-02-16) Passed an Animal Handling check (target 10) to keep his spooked horse from bolting, then backed up a little.
- (2025-02-16) After the fight healed Portia for 12 with Cure Wounds; had not prepared Prayer of Healing and planned to prepare it later.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 7)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-02-16) Asked Tomar how to prove themselves to the Khan, and was told the Khan prizes knowledge. His letter and dragon mask drawing were the reason the party sought the ruins.
- (2025-02-16) Succeeded on the night's wisdom save and slept well, unlike Lucia, Raf and Monarch.
- (2025-03-02) Chose a new set of clean traveling clothes for the feast and kept going without magical enhancements.
- (2025-03-02) Sat farthest from the Khan; spoke Elvish with Urag Bayarmaa, who joined him and Portia; he said he might have a token of a blue dragon and asked where to gain knowledge in the ruins. She warned him to be careful what he awakens.
- (2025-03-02) Covered for Monarch's flirtation by chatting politely with Urag Bayarmaa about swamp stories; she murmured 'trifles for the storm'.
- (2025-03-02) Plans to enter several Warrior's Challenge events, at least riding, shooting and battle magic, perhaps close fighting, helped by his Guardian Emblem.
- (2025-03-16) Cast Enhance Ability on Lucia and on himself before the riding heats, and later on Sir Raf, giving advantage on their animal handling checks; he could sustain only one at a time because of concentration.
- (2025-03-16) Gave Monarch Guidance before her riding heat, and used heroic inspiration to reroll his own ranged attack, ending on 18 for a riding total of 57.
- (2025-03-16) In the riding melee heat he rolled below 10 on animal handling, scored 17 for a total of 39 and took 5 slashing damage from a dummy's sword, then healed himself with Healing Word.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 8)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-03-16) In the shooting event he scored 20 at short range and 18 at long range with disadvantage, and used inspiration on the rapid-fire round.
- (2025-03-16) Chose the battle magic heats: spell attack 20, DC 13 wisdom save that the volunteer failed by nine (a 4) for a score of 22, then Guiding Bolt at second level for 23 to hit and 18 damage, 60 points total.
- (2025-03-16) Cast Aid on all competing party members (max and current HP up by 5) and Warding Bond on competitors using 50 gp platinum rings; the Aid was dispelled for Sir Raf by the mystic ten minutes before his duel.
- (2025-03-16) Gave Monarch advantage on initiative with Vigilant Blessing (initiative 15 for her) and offered Sir Raf heroic inspiration via his music before the tiebreak.
- (2025-03-16) Made a medicine check on Chimeg and found no obvious diagnosis; it did not look life threatening.
- (2025-04-20) Offered Sir Raf and the others his vigilant blessing (advantage on initiative) before the final event.
- (2025-04-20) Beat his archer defender: hid in the tall grass with a Stealth 24 (advantage from his cloak of Elvenkind), then cast Moonbeam (4 damage on a failed Con save) and Guiding Bolt (11 damage) that cracked the gate.
- (2025-04-20) Used Moonbeam through the palisade gap: the archer made a Con save of 13 and took half damage (7), leaving her bloodied. He kept concentration with a 14 on the Con check, with advantage from War Caster.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 9)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-04-20) Cast second-level Healing Word for 10 HP after the archer surrendered, then burned the gate with Moonbeam. He won on round five at 30 of 35 HP.
- (2025-04-20) Cast See Invisibility and spotted the invisible air creature crossing the fence into the field; he relayed it over the mind link. He rolled initiative 22 with advantage.
- (2025-04-20) Used heroic inspiration on an Insight check (23) to confirm the casual Stormgale clansman was the culprit, then hit him with Guiding Bolt for 16; the clansman held concentration with a natural 20.
- (2025-04-20) Later crit the Stormgale clansman for 23, breaking his concentration and bloodying him. He cast Twilight Sanctuary for 6 temporary HP and took 7 slashing from the clansman's axe. The crowd joined his side and the clansman was defeated.
- (2025-05-04) Won the siege event with the fastest victory and best hit point ratio: 30 of 35 HP after a five-round victory.
- (2025-05-04) Asked the shaman's permission before casting see invisibility, then used it to watch for trouble; he scanned the crowd with Insight and found everyone attentive and none upset.
- (2025-05-04) Sketched the Cult of the Dragon amulet in pencil and ink to gain familiarity for locate object and knew lizardfolk lore about the cult; took a stone camouflage blanket and bought tools, crowbar and rope.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 10)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-05-04) Stood first watch with Chimeg at twilight and, as the land shark attacked, used Channel Divinity to make a 30-foot twilight sphere, giving himself 6 temporary hit points and granting others temp HP (10, 9, 7, 8) each round.
- (2025-05-04) Hit the land shark with a spell attack (21) for 13 radiant, cast a Wisdom-save spell that did 12 damage, and healed the downed Sir Raf for 18 with second-level healing word.
- (2025-05-04) Rerolled the group Survival with heroic inspiration to raise the middle result to 17 when finding the campsite.
- (2025-05-18) Told Chimeg the party is looking for a mask, likely underground, and planned Locate Object from his drawing of it (range 1,000 feet); cast Locate Object on the cult symbol and found nothing within a thousand feet.
- (2025-05-18) Hid with a stealth move before the half dragon fight; the cultist ran into his space and its disadvantaged stabs missed.
- (2025-05-18) Cast a second-level moonbeam (16 damage, DC 14 Constitution save) on two cultists: one saved, the other failed and fell. On his next turn he moved it for 10 damage to two more, killing one.
- (2025-05-18) Cast Hungry Jaws as a bonus action, but the jaws remained hungry; it used one of his three uses.
- (2025-05-18) Hit the half dragon with a short sword (15 to hit, 10 damage) and dropped the moonbeam. His bite attempt of 14 missed against the half dragon's good AC.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 11)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-05-18) After the fight he cast aura of vitality, healing Raf, Monarch and Chimeg in rounds (about 10 then 8 per round, 12 for Chimeg) over 10 rounds of concentration.
- (2025-05-18) Sensed that the green circle holding the giant's bones was an inward-focused abjuration meant to contain or injure.
- (2025-05-18) Slid parchment under the sealed third door; it stopped about a quarter inch in.
- (2025-05-18) Offered heroic inspiration with an encouraging song during the short rest.
- (2025-06-01) Cast Moonbeam on blights and the shambling mound (9 damage to a needle blight, then 14 radiant, DC 14 save failed by the mound).
- (2025-06-01) Found a mostly intact giant-language book on the runic system for teleportation circles, and noted the library covers permanently enchanted structures (check of 25).
- (2025-06-01) Cast Aid on himself, Chimeg and Monarch for plus 5 hit points, and gave allies temporary hit points through his Twilight Sanctuary (6 to 9 per use).
- (2025-06-01) Healed himself with Healing Word for 8, hit the lightning guardian with Guiding Bolt for 18 radiant (17 to hit), and Cure Wounds on Chimeg for 24 after her 50-damage crit.
- (2025-06-01) Boosted Lucia onto the ornate chest, gave Guidance plus 3 to Raf's Investigation, healed Lucia for 13 after the glyph, and searched the chest's inside.
- (2025-06-15) Knocked 'shave and a haircut' on the warded giant chest, setting off a force blast; Eddie saved with an 18 and took 8 damage.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 12)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-06-15) Cast Detect Magic ritually (ten minutes) to check the doors and chest, and said hello to the chest's occupant in Giant and Common.
- (2025-06-15) Cast Dispel Magic on the second door: first roll 9, then with inspiration 6 plus 3, enough to dispel up to a 7th-level spell, and removed the seal.
- (2025-06-15) Cast Cure Wounds on himself, healing 9.
- (2025-06-15) Tapped the middle sphere with a drumstick, which only clinked. Later shot arrows at the orrery spheres, hitting for 2 damage on the big one; the gold and blue shots only made it hum, but the big green shot made the chord that extinguished the red circles.
- (2025-06-15) Volunteered to find a campsite with a Survival roll, rolling two ones with advantage for an 11 result, a passable campsite.
- (2025-06-15) Gave heroic inspiration to himself and Sir Raf with a song at the short rest.
- (2025-07-13) Offered Vitality healing for the party before the investigation.
- (2025-07-13) Readied an action to fire a Guiding Bolt when Raf shot: an 18 to hit for 14 radiant damage on the fanatic, who kept concentration.
- (2025-07-13) Cast Moonbeam at the cultists and later on the runestone guardian, forcing a Con save (DC 14) for 2d10 radiant.
- (2025-07-13) Was shot by a hidden scout and later knocked unconscious by the guardian, who hit for 32 then 13.
- (2025-07-13) Healed Raf with Healing Word (nine at second level), and after the fight spent Vitality-style healing to restore the party.
- (2025-07-13) Failed to shake the guardian's slow with a wisdom save of 14.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 13)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-07-27) Offered Guidance (a d4 on one skill check) and healed the party: cast Cure Wounds for 29 hit points on the fallen Portia after her fall from the Tower of Runes, and offered her a Good Berry.
- (2025-07-27) Stayed on the ground as the catcher and healer during the climb, then joined Monarch to climb the final tier. His Survival check (18 after a heroic inspiration reroll, plus a d4 from Guidance) found the one unmarked stable stone and locked the final tier in place.
- (2025-07-27) Cast locate object (at a higher slot level) at the Hall of Blades clearing to look for cultists and found a cult symbol among the chopped-up bodies; he found a letter there too.
- (2025-07-27) At the Hall of Blades told the voice in Giant, 'I seek the path to the blue dragon mask', and confessed the origin of his Tiamat claw scar from the dream, in which he chose Hades over Tiamat. The hall judged the truth worthy and he chose a blade over a further truth.
- (2025-07-27) Picked a rapier, which a cloud giant spirit handed over, shrinking to human size along with it. It is a blood iron and adamantine blade with strong necrotic energy that would need attunement. Eddie thanked the spirit in Giant and bowed.
- (2025-08-10) Used Channel Divinity for a 30-foot Twilight Sanctuary at the start of the Black Razor fight, granting himself 8 temporary hit points; Raf and others later got 10 and 9 from it.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 14)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-08-10) Spent one of three Guardian Emblem charges as a reaction to turn a critical hit on Chimeg into a normal hit; the keeper still did 28 plus 18 for 46 total, leaving her bloodied.
- (2025-08-10) Cast Protection from Evil and Good on Chimeg, giving enemies disadvantage on attacks against her; he kept concentration and the keeper's later attack on her missed.
- (2025-08-10) Tried Channel Divinity Turn Undead on the keeper (DC 14 Wisdom save); it saved, so nothing happened.
- (2025-08-10) Kept Chimeg up with Healing Word (7 hit points), Cure Wounds for 12 and later Cure Wounds for 15, and a healing potion held ready for her.
- (2025-08-10) Handed Chimeg a two-handed sword from his Quiver of Ehlonna when she lost hers, and she hit twice for another 14 damage.
- (2025-08-10) Cast Protection from Evil and Good on Monarch before she picked up Black Razor and healed her for 17 with a lay on hands-type heal, which kept the sword from charming her.
- (2025-08-10) Cast Aura of Vitality, healing everyone in 2d6 pulses (5, 11, 4, 8, 10 and more) so the party was topped off before the long rest.
- (2025-08-10) Rolled a natural 20 on Arcana at the pedestal and learned it is a sacrificial stone for offerings.
- (2025-08-10) Offered his plus one short sword at the pedestal, kept Shatterspike for the party after Monarch noted adamantine's value for breaking objects, and asked where the blue dragon mask is; learned it was carried through the Gate of Dragons into the Hall of Scales.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 15)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-08-10) Planned to attune to the sword of wounding (blood iron rapier: extra 2d6 necrotic, DC 15 Constitution save or no healing for an hour) and moved Shatterspike to Raf's inventory.
- (2025-08-10) Cast Pass without Trace so the party would leave no trail toward the Hall of Scales.
- (2025-08-24) Cast Aid-like Eyes of Night to grant darkvision to Portia, Monarch and Lucia, and used his 300 ft twilight cleric darkvision to scout the hall.
- (2025-08-24) Read Giant on the statue and learned it represented the Keeper of the Seal.
- (2025-08-24) Shoved open the stuck kitchen door with a strong athletics roll.
- (2025-08-24) In the pudding and ooze fights cast Toll the Dead (8, then 18 necrotic on a failed DC 14 Wisdom save killing ooze c), Guiding Bolt for 7 radiant, and Healing Word for 8 on Raf.
- (2025-08-24) Cast Dispel Magic (wisdom check 18) to end the abjuration on the mosaic seam, and again removed the glyph from the sculptor's stone door.
- (2025-08-24) Spoke Giant with the undead stone giant sculptor; history/religion 13 suggested it clings to undeath for its stonework, and it nodded that it made and protects the guardian.
- (2025-08-24) Spotted five 50 gp gem fragments in the workshop for Monarch to record.
- (2025-08-24) Used Twilight Sanctuary for 10 temp HP before the challenger fight, gave the rune guardian 10 temp HP, shot the challenger with a bow (22 hit, 10 piercing; later a crit for 16) and healed Raf for 8 with Healing Word.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 16)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-09-21) Cast second-level Cure Wounds on the bloodied Sir Raf for 25 hit points, bringing him to 45 of 53.
- (2025-09-21) Cast Detect Magic as a ritual in the kitchen; it showed only the barrels and pantries are magical, conjuration producing ingredients.
- (2025-09-21) Helped Sir Raf examine the bronze tablet, then identified a honey note in the mead as rare giant wasp honey and filled a waterskin with it.
- (2025-09-21) In the potion ooze fight he cast Toll the Dead (save DC 14) on the injured ooze for 15 damage, and repeatedly placed and moved Moonbeam (Con DC 14), dealing 5 radiant, 13, 7, 14 and 3 damage on various saves.
- (2025-09-21) Wearing the giant's ring of lightning resistance, he took 10 from Monarch's lightning bolt (40 of 45 resisted) and passed his concentration Con save with a 22.
- (2025-09-21) Cast second-level Healing Word on Sir Raf for 11.
- (2025-09-21) Cut a section out of a barrel stave with carpentry tools and, with an Intelligence check of 14, jury-rigged a squeeze-bulb siphon, recovering six fire breath potions and six greater healing potions, and took bottles of a stronger mead.
- (2025-09-21) Made the navigation Survival check overland toward the Hall of Scales and scouted ahead sneaking on all fours, spotting the cave with Lucia.
