- (2025-10-05) Readied an attack against the Wyvern and hit with the longbow (16 to hit) for 9 total sneak attack damage, slowing it by 10 feet with weapon mastery.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 17)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-10-05) Cast Silence (20-foot radius) on the Wyvern so it could not roar a warning; its silent roar did nothing, and it also muted Raf's booming blade thunder.
- (2025-10-05) Stabbed the grounded Wyvern with the rapier of wounding (23 to hit) for 21 total (11 piercing, 5 necrotic, 5 sneak attack) and cast Healing Word on Portia for 11 as a bonus action.
- (2025-10-05) Killed the Wyvern with a critical rapier hit (26 to hit) for 33 total damage, opening a fountain of blood.
- (2025-10-05) Shot a cultist minder with a longbow (24 to hit, 13 damage), dropping him with one shot.
- (2025-10-05) Healed the downed Monarch with second-level Cure Wounds for 24 points.
- (2025-10-05) Resisted the fanatic's Hold Person by spending heroic inspiration on his Wisdom save.
- (2025-10-05) Took 9 from the half blue dragon's lightning breath thanks to lightning resistance, and took another 13 from the half white dragon's claws.
- (2025-10-05) Hit the half blue dragon with the rapier (17 to hit) for 15, and healed himself with Healing Word for 7.
- (2025-10-05) Used his Guardian Emblem, spending a charge as a reaction to turn a spiritual weapon critical on Raf into a normal hit.
- (2025-10-05) Killed the half white dragon with a critical rapier hit (10 plus 16 for 26 to hit), later healed Raf for 17 with a third-level Healing Word, and saved against the Dreamcaster's mass suggestion.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 18)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-10-19) Cast Dispel Magic (third level) to free Chimeg from the Dreamcaster's mass suggestion; his first ability check failed, he spent heroic inspiration to reroll, and the dispel worked (up to eighth level). Chimeg nodded in acknowledgment.
- (2025-10-19) Failed the Intelligence save against the Dreamcaster's psychic blast (rolled 7) and was left with muddled thoughts: -d6 to attacks and ability checks, with a save at the end of each turn; he was still muddled on his next turn.
- (2025-10-19) Cast Faerie Fire (DC 14) on the fleeing Dreamcaster, who failed the save, giving the party advantage; his earlier second-level Guiding Bolt (14) missed.
- (2025-10-19) Used Twilight Sanctuary to end the charmed condition from the mass suggestion (the GM ruled suggestion imposes charmed), and gave temporary hit points: 9 temporary hit points to Monarch on his second use.
- (2025-10-19) Planned to sever the Dreamcaster's head to hinder raise dead and held the body back for a possible Speak with Dead; helped pile rocks over the cultist corpses.
- (2025-10-19) Dreamed of leading an army of skeletons in a damp subterranean place; shared the dream and chose not to prepare Animate Dead unless Hades gave a nudge.
- (2025-10-19) Spoke and translated Draconic for the party at the portal and the amphitheater, saved against the dragons' fear, and stuck with wisdom as his answer; cast Twilight Sanctuary to remove the frightened condition from Portia and Monarch.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 19)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-10-19) Spoke the name Tiamat after her dream-voice offered to convey him on her wings, and sprouted dragon wings (fly 30, ten minutes), felt disappointment and disconnection, and carried Raf, Chimeg, Lucia and Portia across the 60-foot ooze crevasse, enlarged by Monarch.
- (2025-10-19) Cast augury on swapping Black Razor for the blue dragon mask (reading: wheel), burning heroic inspiration on a reroll; sensed the entity answering was the same one who gave him wings.
- (2025-10-19) Planned to cast guidance on Portia for the rune work while Raf casts Protection from Evil and Good on the Black Razor handler.
- (2025-11-02) Cast guidance on Portia before the swap.
- (2025-11-02) Used Twilight Cleric Eyes of Night to give 300 feet of darkvision to Portia, Monarch, Raf and Chimeg.
- (2025-11-02) Cast cure wounds on the wounded Monarch, who was not fully healed.
- (2025-11-02) Healed the party and a horse with cure wounds, one for 8 on the horse.
- (2025-11-02) Wrote a warning in Common, Draconic and Giant that through the portal lies death.
- (2025-11-02) Felt disappointment from Hades, planned an atonement, prepared Remove Curse and Animate Dead, and cast Remove Curse on Monarch with no change to her mark.
- (2025-11-16) Eddie suggested bringing the giant wasp wine to win over the gourmand hill giant, and asked whether House Ventre and House Kenegal had a position on the bill.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 20)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-11-16) Eddie interviewed at the Palace of Frost with help over the telepathic link, rolling well on persuasion. For the capability test he landed a bow shot (18) with 11 damage, cast Guiding Bolt (19), and used Cure Wounds to heal the damage. He was hired onto a patrol squad.
- (2025-11-16) Eddie learned Senator Vaelthira Frostgleam Gelu is competitive and cheats, wants Senate backing for a petition to the emperor for a preemptive war on Norge, and that Senator Magnus supports it but has not brought it to a vote. He used heroic inspiration on a weak investigation roll to learn it.
- (2025-11-16) Eddie offered to help put Monarch's contract into Giant, and as the party left the Palace of Stone he recognized one of Vaelthira's muscle squads heading straight for them.
- (2025-11-30) Walked up to Julia's frost giant enforcer squad, recognized Julia, Krug and Gillygully by face, and was not recognized by Krug.
- (2025-11-30) Learned from the GM that Senator Vaelthira, the frost giant, only backs the Groves bill because Magnus promised to bring her Norge petition to the floor, and passed this on to the party.
- (2025-11-30) Cast Enhance Ability (Charisma) on Lucia before the Hall of Frost visit, and apologized in Giant to the frost giant senator for stepping on her toes.
- (2025-11-30) Overheard Frost Giant officers in Giant discussing forcible conscription outside the city and relayed it over the psychic network.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 21)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-11-30) Told Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus, who had him brought in, that the frost giant believes Magnus will bring the Norge petition to the floor; she resolved to make Magnus pull it.
- (2025-11-30) Scouted the Hall of Frost by stealth and perception and saw the war preparations had cooled; the frost giant senator told him she would abstain.
- (2025-11-30) Realized druid tree-travel could supply the frost giant senator with spies in Norge, and cast Enhance Ability on Portia's Charisma before her audience.
- (2025-11-30) Krug did not recognize Eddie, and Gillygully's roll of 11 gave no sign of recognition or extra aggression.
- (2025-12-14) Cast Enhance Ability: Charisma before the Palace of Frost visit and persuaded the guards (DC 10, since he works for Vaelthira); admitted but made to wait.
- (2025-12-14) Rolled an 11 on an Intelligence check studying Vaelthira's war tables, and later 24 on an Insight check during the audience.
- (2025-12-14) Became acquainted with Rowan well enough to cast Sending, and proposed passing intel to Giants and to their own house.
- (2025-12-14) Recast Enhance Ability with a third-level slot on Lucia and Raf at the Palace of Fire, though Raf was still turned away.
- (2025-12-14) Bought healing potions, was offered Lucia's Bracers of Archery (no slot, held off), and was advised to take Water Walk as a ritual.
- (2025-12-14) Asked about a ring of warmth in White Crown but none was available, and rolled 18 on history about the Sea of Storms.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 22)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2025-12-14) Spotted Najik's white cliffs with a Perception roll of 22 (advantage with a spyglass, DC 20) and pointed them out to Captain Orso.
- (2026-01-11) Swam back to the boat after the roar and checked that the sailors in the water were not drowning.
- (2026-01-11) Cast Twilight Sanctuary and took a d6 plus 4 temporary hit points, rolling a 1 for five points.
- (2026-01-11) Cast Guiding Bolt at second level at the submerged dragon and missed (11 to hit); later cast third-level Guiding Bolt underwater and missed with a 15.
- (2026-01-11) Cast Faerie Fire (DC 14) and the dragon made the save.
- (2026-01-11) Failed the Strength save against the dragon's breath and was launched up out of the water; readied a Toll the Dead in case it attacked.
- (2026-01-11) Applied 10 temporary hit points from Twilight Sanctuary before the confrontation and gave heroic inspiration with an encouraging song; recommended hitting all bodyguards with spells.
- (2026-01-11) Stealth roll with advantage was 29 (including the plus 10 from Passed without a Trace); checked the storeroom for traps with perception.
- (2026-01-25) In the vignette he played Grimblytoes the boggle, who sneaked up with Lord Ballyhooligan on Mona and Portia at the fairy ring, and sensed something big and wrong when the Whisperwood fell quiet.
- (2026-01-25) Rolled 21 initiative and opened the cellar fight by casting Moonbeam on the two doppelganger bodyguards; one failed the Constitution save and one succeeded, each taking 7 or 3 radiant damage.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 23)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2026-01-25) Was ambushed by the jade-eyed woman, taking 12 and then 17 damage; he passed the Constitution save against stunning with a 17 after spending heroic inspiration, kept Moonbeam concentration with War Caster advantage (7 and 6), and healed himself 10 with first-level Healing Word.
- (2026-01-25) Stabbed the jade-eyed woman with his rapier of wounding for 10 piercing and 11 necrotic (a 19 to hit), then critted on a later stab for 35 total damage including sneak attack, and healed himself 15 with second-level Healing Word to reach 42 of 49 HP.
- (2026-01-25) Took 9 more damage from her and saved against stunning with Monarch's bonus d4 not needed; later his attack on the invisible woman (13) and his Hungry Jaws bonus attack (13) missed, so he left to help Portia and cast third-level Guiding Bolt at the fake Raf.
- (2026-02-08) Fed a potion of healing to Lucia as a bonus action after dash-swimming to her side.
- (2026-02-08) Used Twilight Sanctuary to give allies temporary hit points: 9 for Monarch's group early, 6 to Raf and Monarch, and 7 for Portia.
- (2026-02-08) Cast Moonbeam to search for the invisible gaseous jade-eyed woman; the GM rolled for her and she was not found. He swept it across the cave on a later turn (9 damage rolled) and nothing reacted. Monarch took damage from it entering the beam.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 24)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2026-02-08) Was kicked by the jade-eyed woman for 14 force (9 absorbed by temporary hit points, 5 taken) and made a Constitution save with heroic inspiration to keep concentration; he used his Guardian Emblem reaction to turn a critical hit into a normal 17-force hit, and was stunned. Later a 12-force hit dropped him unconscious, again after using the Guardian Emblem reaction.
- (2026-02-08) After Portia's Lands Aid healed him for 9, he rolled north, stood and stabbed with advantage: 17 to hit, bite and sneak attack for 6 points, gained 3 temporary hit points.
- (2026-02-08) Hit with a 21 for 13 total (piercing, necrotic, sneak) and drank a healing potion for 5; later realized his rapier of wounding forces a DC 15 Con save to block healing for an hour.
- (2026-02-08) Cast locate object on the jade-eyed woman's bandolier; it pointed southeast and down toward the dragon's lair.
- (2026-02-08) Offered Eagle's Splendor for Monarch's talk with the dragon and considered a sending to Rowan, spymaster of Valtira.
- (2026-02-22) Contacted Colonel Lara by sending after the party agreed she was the guard contact, so a city watch detachment could escort the party and prisoner to the Magistrate's Office.
- (2026-02-22) Argued against lying to a magistrate who is a giant, saying he would not say anything untrue if representing the case.
- (2026-02-22) Bought boots of the winter lands for 400 gp, a rope of climbing, a climber's kit and three or four common potions of healing.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 25)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2026-02-22) Sought an audience with the generals of Vaelthira's forces, who put the party in a planning map room.
- (2026-02-22) Rolled survival with advantage for 23 as lead scout of the pair, keeping the party on the easiest route through the pass.
- (2026-02-22) Noticed old intricate scarification on the hermit's forearm with a passive perception of 16.
- (2026-02-22) Opened combat with a longbow shot at the lead winter wolf 150 feet away; the 12 missed.
- (2026-03-08) In the winter wolf fight he used Twilight Sanctuary to hand out temporary hit points each round (12 to Portia, 7 to others, 10 to Raf, 11 and 9 on later turns). The breath of one wolf dealt him 21 cold after a failed Constitution save.
- (2026-03-08) Cast second-level guiding bolt at wolf c (16 to hit, 24 radiant damage) and again at wolf b (14 to hit, 13 radiant), leaving the wolf bloodied but not down.
- (2026-03-08) On the night watch he cast Tiny Hut and flew up to 30 feet using Steps of Night. He hid and then hit a yeti with second-level guiding bolt (rerolled with heroic inspiration to 22, dealing 21 radiant), giving the next attacker advantage.
- (2026-03-08) The enraged yeti's gaze forced a Constitution save; Eddie rolled 13, enough to avoid paralysis. It then hit him with thrown ice, including a critical hit, for 6 bludgeoning and 2 cold after his cold resistance.
- (2026-03-08) After the fight he took the study action from 50 feet (perception 20) and saw no more yetis coming.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 26)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2026-03-08) Spotted worked timber in the rubble field and urged the party to dig it out; his perception roll of 24 found six copper chalices with carved bone charms and a dented sealed scroll tube holding an annotated map.
- (2026-03-08) Cast detect magic as a ritual over the wreck, which found a single sending stone in the head cartographer's pocket.
- (2026-04-05) Drafted the 25-word Sending to Rowan the spymaster (one longship, three to six galleons, no troops on the eastern shore, a huge white dragon) and sent it before sleeping.
- (2026-04-05) Picked up the wreck's sending stone and sent 'This is Eddie. Found the remains of your Dragonfjord expedition. Who should we speak with to debrief?'; the answer was an immediate order to return everything to House Querid on pain of extreme sanction.
- (2026-04-05) Spotted the Norge longship at 15 miles with Monarch on a critical perception success.
- (2026-04-05) Ritually cast Tiny Hut for the night in the Drakholm ruins and again inside Monarch's major image.
- (2026-04-05) Attuned to Shatterspike and put his rapier of wounding in party inventory; stowed his shield in the Bag of Holding for the swim. He relied on his Boots of the Winter Lands for cold.
- (2026-04-05) Swam with Portia and Lucia to the white dragon's island; succeeded on the Wisdom save against the longship's fear aura while Portia and Lucia failed, then crept to the ship's stern and listened to the crew swap war stories.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 27)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2026-04-05) Cast Clairvoyance on the longship's mast, which failed; then placed the sensor on the island landing trail and saw the old rune-staff Goliath and the masked Goliath woman board the ship.
- (2026-04-05) Sent Rowan a second Sending (the Cherek made a deal with the ancient white dragon, about to do so with another, Goliaths left, more ships coming), omitting the mask; Rowan replied: probably a second tribute, prevent its arrival, do not engage until ready for a last-minute report.
- (2026-04-19) Proposed getting within a mile of the Cherek camp to scout, and later proposed intercepting the treasure ship before it reached shore.
- (2026-04-19) Gave Eyes of Night (300-foot darkvision) to three party members for the approach to the camp.
- (2026-04-19) Used Sending to report to Rowan: Mithril Peaks prisoners escaped the white dragon's lair, the dragon is to be paid treasure by Norge soon, and the party is watching for the treasure ship.
- (2026-04-19) Cast Speak with Dead on the frozen dwarf, learning the group escaped Rimescar and that 25 others remain; used four of the five questions.
- (2026-04-19) Climbed the shaft stealthily, with Monarch shrunk and holding on to him; the group stealth check was 21.
- (2026-04-19) Opened the ice troll fight with Guiding Bolt, a 21 to hit for 21 radiant, with advantage because the troll had not noticed him.
- (2026-04-19) Cast Toll the Dead (DC 14 Wisdom save) for 14 necrotic damage, then Spiritual Weapon and Twilight Sanctuary, which gave temp HP (9, 8, 12) to the party.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 28)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2026-04-19) Was hit by the troll's claws for 17 and 19 damage with cold reduced by his resistance, and took cold damage from the aura each turn.
- (2026-04-19) Used heroic inspiration to reroll an attack, then hit the first troll with the rapier of wounding for 12 total; it failed the DC 15 Con save and could not heal.
- (2026-04-19) Hit the second troll with the rapier of wounding, a 20 to hit for 16 total, and it fell. Cast Healing Word on himself for 6.
- (2026-05-17) Cast Twilight Sanctuary and gave temporary hit points to allies during the second ice troll fight (rolled 2 plus 6 for 8; also 10 and 11 to others, 7 later), and forced the troll to make a Wisdom DC 14 save with his hold-the-dead attack, which it passed with a natural 20 for 19.
- (2026-05-17) Eddie's spiritual weapon missed the troll; his 2d8 hit dealt 12 damage and left the troll bloodied.
- (2026-05-17) Rolled a natural 20 cutting out the ice troll hearts.
- (2026-05-17) Cast Sending to the dwarf he had spoken with, saying they were alive and waiting for an opportunity; the dwarf replied that he fetches Skullrender's tribe in twos, four are here, and the party should listen for his exit at the falls, giving them an hour.
- (2026-05-17) Cast augury to Hades before casting locate object on the iron flask: the result was woe, so he declined to cast it; a later augury came back weal for Portia casting it, and a third with Eddie's insight 20 (14 plus 6) read as a generous interpretation of his question.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 29)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2026-05-17) Ate an ice troll heart for regeneration of 5 hit points per round for 24 hours (interrupted by fire or acid), after offering it to Lucia first.
- (2026-05-17) Used Steps of Night to fly Sir Raf up the shaft; rolled two 5s with advantage on stealth.
- (2026-05-17) Declared the party should wait longer, and that the blue dragon mask should be kept from the dragon cult.
- (2026-06-14) Rolled 23 on initiative, then opened the first fight with a second-level Guiding Bolt that missed (rolled a 1 on the d20 after a 19 tumbled); used heroic inspiration on the opening roll and set up Twilight Sanctuary each fight.
- (2026-06-14) Cast Spiritual Weapon (12 hit AC 12 for 10 force damage) and gave temporary hit points each round from Twilight Sanctuary (10, 9, 7, 11, 12) to Sir Raf, Monarch and Portia.
- (2026-06-14) Cast locate object on the iron flask to find the thick ice wall in Rimescar's lair.
- (2026-06-14) Used Toll the Dead (Wis DC 14) on the living cold breaths, dealing 7, 8, 15 and 8 damage; cast Healing Word on Sir Raf for 8, 14 and 7.
- (2026-06-14) Cast sleep (Wis DC 14) on the white dragon warmling, putting it to sleep, and recast it later; the second cast almost failed to hold.
- (2026-06-14) Identified the scroll in the hoard as a scroll of reincarnate.
- (2026-06-14) During the Rimescar ambush shot his longbow at the paralyzed dragon, hitting with an 18 for 10 damage.
- (2026-06-14) Cast Sending to cuckoo before the long rest, and listed the white dragon names from his notes (Icevein, Voorhl, Rimescar, Isildrax).

chunks.title: Eddie (part 30)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2026-06-14) Took a tooth and scales from the dead dragon, and asked to have the blue dragon mask marked as his in the party inventory.
- (2026-07-12) Suggested taking smaller white dragons off the board so a reveal of Lunae would deter the Norge.
- (2026-07-12) Attuned to the blue dragon mask to learn how it works and learned it grants Draconic, then unequipped it so Monarch could attune.
- (2026-07-12) Suggested Tongues for the negotiation and meeting spot placement; History check of about 20 helped identify the Maulring marks.
- (2026-07-26) Cast two Sendings to Rowan, 25 words each. The first reported Lunae freed, Rimescar defeated and the Norge fleet inbound. The second reported Lunae neutral, Icevein accepting tribute and the freed Maulringer captives Sorcha and Ashvale. Rowan replied 'extract soonest', warning that Icevein is generationally vengeful.
- (2026-07-26) Proposed the Fenrir heist: swim near the ship and cast Twilight Sanctuary underwater to end fear effects from its protective magic. Also offered the Leomund's Tiny Hut for resting.
- (2026-08-09) Cast Clairvoyance centered in the Cherek pavilion, but the sensor did not appear because of the ward.
- (2026-08-09) Gave the group 300 feet of darkvision and cast see invisibility on himself; he swam underwater toward the camp.
- (2026-08-09) Used Steps of Night to fly above the Fenrir, climbing to 35 feet to avoid its breath.

chunks.title: Eddie (part 31)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie
- (2026-08-09) Extended his rapier into Portia's rope pile so she could climb on, then flew her out, taking a 16-damage longbow hit (a 25 hit and a 15 miss) from the Cherek hunter.

chunks.title: Eddie - Backstory
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie - backstory (written by the player)
The Kecualas (Lizardfolk to the mammalian races) often have names the mammalian races find difficult to pronounce. With a name like Shislikrinkthroshisrak, they just go by ‘Eddie’.
Eddie is considered ’small’ by Kecualas standards, and positively scrawny by blackscale standards. Traveling north from his home waters along the shores of the Mare Medietas, he found more acceptance in Roma.
Eddie earned citizenship via military service (not uncommon for those from his homeland), where they met Rafael. Fighting for one’s life tends to make strong bonds. Raf is probably Eddie’s closest friend.
The half elf, Frilfaelor, was Eddie’s de facto mentor.  It was Frilfaelor who saved Eddie in a harrowing combat. He later recruited Eddie into service with House Ventre. A Twilight Cleric of Hades, Frilfaelor was the ‘combat medic’ associated with Eddie and Rafael’s unit. Frilfaelor’s death, and the grace with which he met it, was the reason Eddie became a devotee of Hades.
Frilfaelor's last words still linger with Eddie. "I kept her claws off you as long as I could. Listen to the King Below, he's your only hope now."
Notes on Lizardfolk:
Society

chunks.title: Eddie - Backstory (part 2)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie - backstory (written by the player)
Lizardfolk are social and communal in nature, sharing space, food, and items is common. Individual ownership exists but is weakly defined and sharing is based on need and relative social strength in the tribe. While technically democratic Lizardfolk would likely have a might-makes-right bent to their politics and society. They would mostly be non-hierarchical but each interaction could be influenced by the relative strength of the individual within the tribe. Individuals that are more powerful warriors or hunters, or those that can use magic would have much larger influence in the tribe through a combination of dominance and respect. The result is something of a flattened and constantly shifting hierarchy based one each interaction and not on titles or positions. Lizardfolk are sexually non-dimorphic, the males and females are nearly identical (except to lizardfolk). Gender is an almost completely unknown concept to Lizardfolk, all individuals perform all functions within the tribe. Gestation of eggs is much faster than gestation for live birth, females that become pregnant need only a few weeks of rest to lay their eggs and recuperate. Laying eggs is a highly respected feat within the tribe, akin to providing something of great value or risking one's life on behalf of the tribe. Lizardfolk would likely be confused by gendered expectations of other species. Lizardfolk would tend to value objects for their practical value or personal meaning and tend to not to covet shiny objects or normal valuables.
Activity

chunks.title: Eddie - Backstory (part 3)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie - backstory (written by the player)
Lizardfolk are anything but lazy, but they are efficient to a fault. They prefer to take the shortest route, the safest option, and the strategy that requires the least fighting. Once a goal is set though they are tireless in their pursuit. They prefer crepuscular activity at dawn and dusk, with a midday rest in the heat. Depending on the individual or group they may be active well into the night. They will gladly spend long periods, days at a time, resting if conditions are suitable.
Environment
Extremely adaptable in their preferred environments ranging from the seashore, to mountains, to deep swamps, and arid deserts. Lizardfolk can thrive almost anywhere there is water and prey. Lizardfolk communities that don’t develop more permanent structures and advance in agriculture would be tethered to water sources and be forced to either migrate or change diets seasonally. Most tribes would likely be semi-nomadic, creating temporary villages until prey become scarce in an area. If a tribe were to master livestock rearing and other agriculture they would likely build a more permanent settlement to increase their comfort and security.
Temperature

chunks.title: Eddie - Backstory (part 4)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie - backstory (written by the player)
Lizardfolk tolerate and prefer very high temperatures when resting but will overheat if active for long in the heat, even more quickly than mammals. Unlike mammals they don't sweat, but pant heavily (buccal pumping) they would also splay out in cool water, mud or shade to cool down. They prefer cool temperatures for sleeping, and are very groggy and slow moving until warm. They need high heat after eating, especially after gorging. If sick, they will heat themselves up by a fire or in hot sunlight to create a fever since their body is unable on it’s own.
Hunger
Lizardfolk would regularly go 3-5 days without food. After 5-7 days they become hungry and restless. After 7-10 days, they start getting grumpy, aggressive, becoming food obsessed. After 10-14 days with no food, they would be food obsessed, aggressive, reckless and irrational. 14+ days without food would cause them to become increasingly feral until fed. Starvation could take 60-90 days or longer. Eats much more than a mammal in a single large meal, but will not need to eat again for several days. Extremely efficient hunters/soldiers because they can remain active for weeks with a diet of only insects and small game with minimal weight loss. Small meals stave off hunger but this sort of “snacking” is unusual and would probably result in a lot of complaining. Lizardfolk eat less often than other races, but when they do it’s a big event, eating a third of their body weight in one sitting and then being lethargic, and cranky until they digest over 24-48 hours.

chunks.title: Eddie - Backstory (part 5)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie - backstory (written by the player)
Diet
Consummate opportunists, carrion and insects may be preferable for low effort energy. Large game is preferred for a full meal roughly weekly. There’s usually no preference between fish, mammals, other reptiles or humanoids. They are much more resistant to food poisoning from rotted meat than mammals, fresh meat is preferred when available, but not necessary. Cannibalism is common and is not taboo, Lizardfolk would very rarely bury their dead, more likely recycling them as food. Eating relatives or companions may be simply practical or it may even have become a sign of respect or a desire to embody the deceased.
Senses
Lizardfolk have excellent eyesight and sense of smell, but relatively poor hearing and cannot hear many high pitched noises. Much more aware of light than mammals. Lizardfolk will constantly be using light around them, bright light for warmth/attention, dappled for camouflage, dim to hide/sleep or seem more passive. They can see partially into the UV spectrum and may prefer colors only visible in that spectrum. Lizardfolk may also have patterns on their skin, or inside their mouths that reflect UV light only visible to other Lizardfolk. They are relatively blind to certain colors of red and purple light. Their skin is rough and not as sensitive as a typical human’s. They enjoy rough surfaces, and may accidentally burn or scrape themselves without realizing it.
Intelligence

chunks.title: Eddie - Backstory (part 6)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie - backstory (written by the player)
Lizardfolk are very clever, cunning, and intelligent but not necessarily wise. Good problem solvers, and cunning predators, but abstract thought (hypotheticals, hyperbole, far future or past scenarios, complex causality) would be difficult for them to understand. They are rooted in the here and now, though they are very capable of planning for the relatively near future, they'd be frustrated and bored with hypothetical situations or excessive discussion.
Relationships

chunks.title: Eddie - Backstory (part 7)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie - backstory (written by the player)
Social bonds between Lizardfolk would likely be fairly similar to other humanoids. Family relationships on the other hand are different. Lizardfolk hatchlings are born with a complete set of instincts to make them perfectly competent predators, with no intervention necessary from parents. Eggs would be laid and cared for communally and the hatchlings would essentially raise themselves in a group of broodmates. Broodmates would practice hunting and teamwork skills together stalking whatever small insects or game was abundant nearby. While the parents would not directly raise and teach their children, young lizardfolk would learn social skills, form bonds, and develop specialties by observing and helping older members of the tribe. For this reason, Lizardfolk would likely not understand the differences between different types of family relationships like mother/daughter or brother/sister. All members of the tribe are singularly “family”, this would likely extend to include close companions of other races. Lizardfolk are likely to be wary of outsiders or new people and may be xenophobic or may embrace newcomers as a practiciality for their additional skills.
Emotions

chunks.title: Eddie - Backstory (part 8)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie - backstory (written by the player)
Lizardfolk are fully emotional beings, but not very emotionally intelligent. Stoic and not very expressive to small stimuli they can seem emotionless even while they feel quite strongly. They tend to have oversized reactions to strong stimuli, the line between an annoyed Lizardfolk who appears emotionless and a raging one can be sudden and severe. The same is true for positive emotions. Less intense emotions can be coaxed out but are likely to be muted and subdued. Depending on their status in the group and personality they may be at times, stoic, supportive, proud and aggressive, or shy and unsure.
Combat
Lizardfolk are likely to fight to the death if cornered and cannot escape. The more damage a Lizardfolk has taken or the more pain it’s in the less likely it is to comprehend surrender. However, if faced with apparent danger or clearly overwhelming odds Lizardfolk feel no shame retreating to fight another day. Lizardfolk are predators more than warriors, they prefer to use camouflage, speed, and aggression to overcome prey or enemies, but will fight with discipline against an organized foe.
Language and communication
Lizardfolk are visual communicators but not great orators. They talk with their hands, as well as their tail, throat, torso, and spines or frills. They are very expressive but prefer direct speech without metaphors or idioms.
Other Mannerisms

chunks.title: Eddie - Backstory (part 9)
chunks.text:
Player character: Eddie - backstory (written by the player)
Rarely make eyes contact, looking sideways with only one eye is common. Never apologizes without prompting, subtle physical shifts, like darting eyes, would convey apology to other lizardfolk. Talks with a lot of hand gestures and few words Uses terms like group, party, and family interchangeably. Also uses terms like friend, brother/sister, and husband/wife interchangeable, all are words for close companion to a Lizardfolk. Doesn’t understand gender pronouns and uses them interchangeably.

chunks.title: Lucia - Backstory
chunks.text:
Player character: Lucia - backstory (written by the player)
Lucia Tertia filia wasn't your typical elf. Sure, she had the pointed ears and the ageless look, but there was a flint to her that set her apart from the misty-eyed archers of Elven lore. Her skin, while fair, was tanned from years spent under the relentless desert sun, etched with the lines of a life carved out of danger. Her eyes, a piercing grey, held the glint of a hawk sizing up prey.
Lucia preferred things a bit more up close. She carried twin daggers strapped to her thighs, hilts worn smooth from countless scrapes, and a heavy crossbow slung across her back for when discretion was the better part of valor. Her clothes weren't the flowing robes favored by Elven society, but sturdy leather armor that had seen its fair share of scrapes and the occasional splash of monster ichor.
Lucia wasn't interested in Roma politics or gossiping in moonlit glades. She was driven by a restless curiosity, a need to delve into forgotten tombs and uncover secrets best left buried. There were whispers of ancient artifacts and lost civilizations in the stars, and Lucia Tertia was the one who itched to chase those whispers down. She wasn't afraid of danger, or death for that matter. Hell, she probably would have welcomed a good brawl after a particularly tedious Elven banquet. Give her a crumbling temple, a cryptic inscription, and a puzzle to unravel, and Lucia Tertia was in her element. She was a survivor, a scavenger of history, and an elf who thrived in the dirt, not the starlight.

chunks.title: Lucia - Backstory (part 2)
chunks.text:
Player character: Lucia - backstory (written by the player)
But she wasn’t always like this. Just a few years ago, Lucia Tertia was belle of House Ventre’s satrap under the leadership of Lady Tertia Stella Ventre, leading a faction of Astral elves “coerced” through marriage, orchestrated by House Ventre during the discovery of Wildspace and the Astral Seas. Tertia took charge of her opportunities and established a foothold within House Ventre and now commands many business and information brokerage within the house. But Lucia Tertia filia has never had any interest in any of the dealing of her mother, or her less capable father, the high elf Lord Lucius Quitus Ventre.
And thus, she spent her youth dallying in the court affairs of other children of prestigious lords and ladies of Roma. She was known for her lavish and extravagant parties, mostly funded by her parents. Seeing no real hunger for politics, Lucia’s mom resorted to the most beneficial way Lucia can support the family, as a pawn in a political marriage. After going through years of rituals eventually, Lady Tertia secured a proposal worthy of her machinations: she was to marry Dagha Durok Mazaali Khan, leader of a small Khanate, and thereby give House Ventre access to some valuable ancient ruins within the khanate's control. From the courtship, which included a visit to the khanate to see the ruins, Lucia gained an appreciation for the wonders and mysteries of such places far from the bustle of Roma.

chunks.title: Lucia - Backstory (part 3)
chunks.text:
Player character: Lucia - backstory (written by the player)
But unfortunately, Lucia’s party antics caused a salacious rumor involving her and Maximus Magnus Marvad, the son of Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad, in a carriage ride through Solarium park in The Hills. Normally, Lucia would shrug off such a social incident, but the political leanings of Senator Magnus Marvad were directly opposed to the interests of House Mazaali. And thus, it led to a pretty public retraction of the engagement. The compounded public shaming and and the loss of the engagement, drove Lady Tertia to publicly denounce Lucia, and thus banished her to the lower rungs of the house’s infrastructure, stripping her of the Ventre name until such time as she earns it back.
For the last few years, without much parental guidance or any direction, Lucia had few actual interests from her schooling, one of which was her insatiable urge to discover forgotten history. The other was a curiosity for her ancestry, which her mom refuses to go into the details of their “arrival”. So now, she volunteers for the business side of House Ventre and takes on adventurous jobs that no one would want. As long as it allows her to sate her curiosity and maybe it her closer to learning about elves in the stars.

- (2024-12-01) Introduced herself to Jingle Shimmerstone as part of a newly formed mercenary company, and she gave references including Colonel Lara, Thor of the Golden Leaf, Serafine and Azuriel for House Ventre. She handed Jingle a slip of paper listing the party's names and identities.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 3)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2024-12-01) Met Jimmy Slips at the Clockwork Tiger. Confirmed Azuriel sent her, agreed that neither would reveal they know each other, and said the box was heavily and deadly trapped and the interested parties had been settled.
- (2024-12-01) Told Jimmy to push for all-access for the party. She told him that the exiled-from-the-Feywild story could go in his report.
- (2024-12-01) At the Glass Door she gathered information from disgruntled Shimmerstone workers. She learned the cloud giant partner is a recent addition who wears a two-sided mask, and she connected the darkened dry dock to the new enchanted airship work.
- (2024-12-01) Researched spelljammer components at the Greka library with Raf assisting. She rolled well, learned about helms, orreries, spyglasses and Eberron dragon shard airships, and theorized the box held a spelljammer component such as a spyglass or orrery.
- (2024-12-01) Ruled that the party must never tip off Jimmy Slips that they are still pursuing the item from the box.
- (2024-12-01) In her interview she used heroic inspiration on a deception check to claim the party had no House Ventre business at the shipyard. She suggested Jingle retrain employees displaced by automation, which led him to order re-education.
- (2024-12-01) Accepted the lethal-force workshop security contract on the party's behalf.
- (2024-12-01) Chose wild magic sorcerer at level-up.
- (2024-12-15) Rolled hit points at level-up, got a 4, used the DM reroll and took the resulting 3 instead of keeping the four; Kyle said the other result is never known.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 4)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2024-12-15) Deduced from her Eberron research that the ring-shaped ship matches airships powered by elementals bound by a kyber dragon shard, and judged the party 80% of the way to confirming the box's contents.
- (2024-12-15) Bought a scroll of daylight as a backup plan for Bay 3's magical darkness; Kyle ruled the price 300 gp and Monarch agreed to pay it herself.
- (2024-12-15) Bought a hooded lantern and cast mage armor for the shift because she has no darkvision.
- (2024-12-15) Used help action on Portia's locate object triangulation, and spent heroic inspiration on an insight check.
- (2024-12-15) Began casting Vortex Warp with Subtle Spell (1 sorcery point) at the detention sentry to teleport it away from Jimmy; the sentry deployed blades and a tower shield and turned on her, to be continued.
- (2025-01-05) Cast Vortex Warp on the sentry; it saved with 17 vs DC 13 and the spell failed. A second casting with Heightened Spell (disadvantage on the save) also failed.
- (2025-01-05) Cast a Wild Magic Sorcerer's Burst (meant as fire bolt) that came out as cold for 2 damage, hitting AC 20.
- (2025-01-05) Cast Faerie Fire from outside the silence, forcing a DC 13 Dex save; the sentry failed and the party got advantage.
- (2025-01-05) Hit the sentry with a light crossbow for 6 piercing damage and later cast a burst for 5 poison damage that missed.
- (2025-01-05) Acted casual and used Tides of Chaos on the Performance check to leave the building.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 5)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-01-05) Reported to Azuriel that the box held a Saberus dragon shard for an elemental-bound airship; History 20 recalled Lady Antress; Insight 11 on Azuriel but suspected she was withholding.
- (2025-01-05) Learned from Azuriel the origin of her wild magic in a convergence; plans to buy goggles of night (400 gp) and craft seven mage armor scrolls.
- (2025-01-19) Cast invisibility on Lucia before she left the tea house to follow Sir Saravar, and concentrated on it.
- (2025-01-19) Met Azuriel and told her about Sir Saravar; learned he is a long-dead philosopher's name, that the foot route is very dangerous, and that 5,000 gp could pay for a teleport circle. Azuriel declined to invent a commendation.
- (2025-01-19) Wrote Sir Saravar a letter of questions mentioning other offers; he answered with a Sending releasing the party. Her Insight with Tides of Chaos was 11, concluding the Sending showed how the powerful communicate; she plans to take Sending at fifth level.
- (2025-01-19) Asked Harriet who is second in command and whether pay depends on guards surviving; learned wagon masters speak with Harriet's authority.
- (2025-01-19) Overheard wagon masters worry about invisible or tiny Dawnrealm stowaways.
- (2025-01-19) Spent Tides of Chaos on Persuasion to befriend Anya Redwind, Torg Khan's diplomat and chief merchant, and gave her a druidcraft blossom and a 24-hour forecast of rain and wind.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 6)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-02-02) Cast mage armor with a wild magic surge, rolling a 23, so for a minute her action spells became bonus actions. She then cast invisibility on Lucia as a bonus action.
- (2025-02-02) Scanned the area with perception, using heroic inspiration and tides of chaos for the reroll, got a 17, and found that both ankhegs came from the same area.
- (2025-02-02) Found a vial with a flickering flame in an ankheg lair and pried it out. Examining it at night, she tasted it, felt strong, and concluded it was a potion of fire giant strength.
- (2025-02-02) Pried coins and gems out of the ankheg lair walls, taking gold and clumps of silver but leaving copper behind.
- (2025-02-02) Represented the unit as commander at Harriet's meeting and pitched Raf as champion with a persuasion check at advantage, convincing Harriet to gamble on him.
- (2025-02-02) Offered to cast fairy fire on Grock from the sidelines for Raf, and made an arcana check of 16 that revealed Grock was blessed.
- (2025-02-02) Negotiated with Harriet at Sun Dragon to be paid out and wait as friends, then split the party's take at 408 gold, one 50 gp gem and 140 gold each.
- (2025-02-02) Cast invisibility, then a wild magic surge turned her into a potted plant, which broke the concentration and ended the invisibility.
- (2025-02-16) Used Staff of Shield as a reaction to raise her AC to 19 against the troll's claw, but a later opportunity attack at AC 20 hit her for 13.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 7)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-02-16) Cast Vortex Warp to teleport Portia away from the troll's chain and rolled wild magic surge 42, giving her a 20-foot bonus-action teleport for a minute.
- (2025-02-16) Cast fairy fire (Dex 13 save) on the troll, then dropped it after the horse was hit; later hit AC 19 with a wild sorcerer burst for 4 fire, which cauterized the troll's stump.
- (2025-02-16) Her horse Charlie fled the fight, taking an opportunity attack (12 damage) survived thanks to temporary hit points.
- (2025-02-16) Persuaded the Stormgale outriders using Tides of Chaos, winning shelter in camp, and spoke for the party before Jargal Khan.
- (2025-02-16) Offered the Scroll of Daylight in barter for scrolls of Comprehend Languages and Detect Magic.
- (2025-02-16) Failed the wisdom save and shared the dream; kept heroic inspiration and recorded dream details.
- (2025-02-16) Used heroic inspiration and a GM reroll on level-up hit points, getting a 6.
- (2025-03-02) Took the psychic lash spell after Kyle ruled the target always knows the caster, and prepared for dinner with a scroll of mage armor (eight hours), bringing only her staff and leaving her goggles of night behind.
- (2025-03-02) Spent 15 gp on a respectful outfit blending Khanate accoutrements.
- (2025-03-02) Walked over to sit beside Oyun Temur and asked him to guide the party into the ruins; he declines to travel. He told her of a sky artifact connecting to the elemental plane of air.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 8)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-03-02) Stopped Oyun from speaking aloud and replied by message; he said they should talk before the ruins as he does not want a curse to take hold.
- (2025-03-02) Was asked quietly by Tsetsen whether the party is a mercenary band; Monarch nodded, used a sorcery point on subtle message to Tomor, who relayed that the Stormgale clan is backed by the Dawnrealm and the alliance can be sabotaged.
- (2025-03-02) Asked Tomor whether giants ever served anyone, learning the ruins may date to Anam, the Allfather.
- (2025-03-02) Feigned amorous interest in Oyun as cover, using a subtle message, wings spread to block Chimeg and prestidigitation on his drink, spending tides of chaos on the performance check.
- (2025-03-02) Left the feast with Oyun, who confided that the blade he forged for Chimeg whispers to her at night; Monarch promised to see what she could do and waited a couple of hours before returning to camp.
- (2025-03-02) Declared she is entering every event of the Warrior's Challenge.
- (2025-03-02) Relayed Tsetsen's warning to the group at camp.
- (2025-03-16) Used Tides of Chaos on her riding heat with Eddie's Guidance (17 plus a d4), scoring 21; Portia gave her animal handling advantage and she hit the melee dummy with chill touch for 29 (50 total).
- (2025-03-16) A wild magic surge (table 78) poisoned a random creature within 60 feet, which turned out to be an innocent bystander's horse.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 9)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-03-16) Won the riding event with 68 (18 animal handling and a psychic sorcerer's burst for 18), beating Gogo's 63, and earned one Renown with the Azure Sky.
- (2025-03-16) Wild surges later: lightning on up to three creatures (she chose none) and a fire surge that burned a patch of grass; she subtly cast Faerie Fire on a target, and the judges noticed the spell and suspected interference.
- (2025-03-16) Shooting: scored 9 at short range with disadvantage, 20 at long range using Tides of Chaos, and 44 total after a rapid-fire average of 15 with heroic inspiration, passing the event but losing the overall.
- (2025-03-16) Chose the battle magic duel and drew a Dawnrealm-robed mage; her charm person (DC 15 wisdom, heightened) was out of range, Tasha's mind whip hit for half of 8, and she Shielded scorching ray rolls using staff charges.
- (2025-03-16) Lost the duel: failed a Dexterity save against lightning bolt even with Tides of Chaos, took 27 damage against her 26 hit points and was downed; she failed the event but was healed before any death saves.
- (2025-03-16) Tried to canvass witnesses for where the wanderer who refused quarter went; her Persuasion with heroic inspiration failed, and she blamed the party for dropping the ball after the warning about the plot.
- (2025-03-16) Monarch's Dawnrealm-robed opponent drops her with a lightning bolt, winning by about four hit points.
- (2025-04-20) Declined to reroll her opponent with heroic inspiration and drew a Khanate warrior. She borrowed three healing potions from Portia.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 10)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-04-20) Cast Invisibility, hid with Tides of Chaos advantage and flew up 25 feet. She then cast heightened Vortex Warp (DC 15 Con save at disadvantage, failed with a 10) to teleport the warrior 90 feet onto the horse fields. She used the staff's Shield reaction against his attack.
- (2025-04-20) Charmed the warrior with a heightened Charm Person (Wisdom 15 at disadvantage; he rolled a 3) and he agreed to fake a fight. She hit him with Sorcerer's Burst (5 acid), then Tasha's Mind Whip (DC 15 Int save; he failed with a 0, taking 8 psychic after a heroic inspiration reroll), then repeated Chill Touch hits.
- (2025-04-20) Chill Touch bloodied the warrior with 5 more damage. After a grapple dragged her down, she escaped with Acrobatics and flew back up. He surrendered after one last swing; she took 4 slashing and finished at 22 of 26 HP.
- (2025-04-20) Secretly drank a healing potion with a Sleight of Hand check, using Tides of Chaos. The judges noticed, so she confessed to having drunk it after the surrender.
- (2025-04-20) During Raf's match she flew into the arena to cast Faerie Fire on the unseen air creature, a DC 14 Dex save. The first cast missed it. She then converted two first-level slots into sorcery points and cast a heightened Faerie Fire (disadvantage on the Dex save, which it failed with a 12), making it visible. She hid with a natural 20 stealth and held concentration, so no one could find her.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 11)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-05-04) Sat next to the Khan in the VIP section, smoked her Pipe of Smoke Monsters to make smoke commentary, and with a natural 20 Performance drew a crowd by slashing a smoke Diego with a tiny conjured greatsword.
- (2025-05-04) Was shown the Cult of the Dragon amulet by Setsen; her History check identified it as the symbol of the old Cult of the Dragon tied to Tiamat and chromatic dragons, noting it was recently made.
- (2025-05-04) Deceived Setsen partly, then offered the theory that the cult is after a dragon mask rumored in the ruins; Setsen saw she was dancing around something but did not press.
- (2025-05-04) Had Eddie and Portia study the amulet for locate object familiarity and practiced Prestidigitation to forge a facsimile that would pass at a distance.
- (2025-05-04) Briefed the Khan's council on the Kingdom of the West and the Cult of the Dragon in great detail when Setsen put her on the spot.
- (2025-05-04) On the middle watch with Lucia, during the land shark attack she cast fairy fire with heightened spell (2 sorcery points) so it had disadvantage on the Dex save and lit up, giving everyone advantage; then disengaged and flew up 30 feet above Eddie to stay in his twilight sphere.
- (2025-05-04) Wanted to shop for scrolls and spell components, including clairvoyance components costing 100 gp each.
- (2025-05-18) Cast invisibility and flew 30 feet up to scout, using Tides of Chaos for advantage; rolled a 20 and spotted the cult's horses under trees to the north.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 12)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-05-18) Succeeded on the Dexterity save against the half dragon's breath that caught the edge of the cone, which dealt 26 fire damage.
- (2025-05-18) Cast a subtle major image of a displacer beast to draw the cultists' attacks; the two cultists who attacked it revealed the illusion (DC 16 Intelligence to disbelieve).
- (2025-05-18) Forgot a wild magic surge check on the illusion cast.
- (2025-05-18) Her first wild sorcerer's burst (22 to hit) rolled fire and did no damage against the half dragon; her second burst rolled poison for 9 damage and killed it.
- (2025-05-18) Rolled a critical success investigating the second door and found a real lock hidden by an illusion behind a false lock.
- (2025-05-18) Examined the prison circles with Arcana, confirming they were inward-facing abjuration circles, and found no hidden lock on the third door.
- (2025-05-18) Converted spell slots to sorcery points and carried the torch in the basement.
- (2025-06-01) Cast Enlarge on Chimeg, rolling a wild magic surge that made her shout when speaking. Chimeg became Large and gained an extra d4 weapon damage.
- (2025-06-01) Wild Sorcerer's Fist burned a twig blight for 12 (vulnerable to fire), and a psychic blast did 13 to a vine blight.
- (2025-06-01) Pulled a giant rune stone from the shambling mound's vines (Arcana 20); Investigation showed it is a container with a seam, and she kept it unopened until later.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 13)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-06-01) Cast Clairvoyance twice, each with a ten-minute casting time, and described two sealed rooms: a giant study with a thumping chest, and a room with a shattered circle, an orrery and a chest ringed by three glowing orbs. She needed a short rest and sorcery points to recover the slot.
- (2025-06-01) Used Tasha's Mind Whip on the lightning guardian twice (the guardian saved with 17 for half, then took full damage of 11), removing its reactions, and flew up the stairs so it could not line the party up.
- (2025-06-01) Identified the glyph of warding on the ornate chest with Arcana 22, and swapped Vortex Warp for Misty Step during spell preparation.
- (2025-06-01) Cast Enlarge on Lucia to help pry the chest open, then found the Cloth-Wrapped Mirror at the bottom of the chest and helped Portia cut the lining and search.
- (2025-06-01) Helped Raf with Investigation to solve the sliding block puzzle that exposed the giant coin stash.
- (2025-06-15) Failed the Dexterity save against the chest's force blast and took 17 force damage, but passed the concentration check to keep casting clairvoyance.
- (2025-06-15) Used Clairvoyance on the chest and saw a thorned, tailed devil holding a ball of fire; with Message she learned it said it was betrayed, seeks only to return home, and did not steal the missing masks.
- (2025-06-15) Chose not to speak to the devil again and let it believe she died in the orb explosion, to avoid earning its enmity.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 14)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-06-15) Studied the permanent protective circles and deduced the smaller circles are a means of suppressing the protection; later reasoned the spheres are a combination lock and designed the alignment plan.
- (2025-06-15) Asked Portia to back the orrery up to the year of her birth, which showed a double eclipse, the year of the black moon.
- (2025-06-15) Enlarged Lucia to work the giant-scale puzzle box; Monarch's wild surge gave her resistance to all damage for a minute, and she solved the puzzle box with Lucia's help.
- (2025-06-15) Flew up to scout the ruins and rolled 24 on Perception; she could not see the collapsed towers under the canopy but worked out the oblong shape of the city and where the ring of towers lies.
- (2025-06-15) Cast Identify using a second-level slot on the giant's ring, finding a ring of lightning resistance.
- (2025-07-13) Cast Invisibility on Lucia so she could scout the Tower of Runes group; Lucia rolled a 17 stealth and counted about ten enemies.
- (2025-07-13) Enlarged Sir Raf with her action before the fight and activated innate sorcery as a bonus action.
- (2025-07-13) Wild Magic psychic hit crit on cultist A for 24 damage, killing the cultist instantly with an exploding head.
- (2025-07-13) Crit the fanatic with a wild sorcerer's firebolt for 18 psychic damage, then surged to regain five hit points each turn for a minute and later gained 20-foot bonus teleports.
- (2025-07-13) Cast Faerie Fire on a 4x4 area to find a hidden scout; the scout made the save (DC 15) and stayed hidden.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 15)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-07-13) Cast Charm Person twice with Empowered Spell on the fanatic (wisdom DC 16 straight rolls); both failed and the fanatic refused, saying she would join Tiamat's army.
- (2025-07-13) Used the Staff of Shield to block a scout's 16 attack, and hit the guardian with a thunder cantrip crit for 21 and later 12.
- (2025-07-13) Told the party the second scout got away because he resisted charm, a story the table doubted.
- (2025-07-27) Used Tides of Chaos and flew up to scout the Tower of Runes. Her Misty Step across the barrier hit a wild surge (d8 roll of 5, illusory butterflies) and landed her at the tower's base. She could hover and move laterally but not climb.
- (2025-07-27) Checked the dead climbers for the kinds of damage: falling, force, thunder and electrical. Planned to attune to the rings of lightning resistance and spell storing over two hours, and put Misty Step into the ring of spell storing.
- (2025-07-27) Climbed the second tier with Eddie. Her investigation was a critical success for 10 feet, and her Arcana check was 21. A wild surge from Mage Armor turned her into a potted plant for a few seconds and broke her concentration.
- (2025-07-27) Reduced to tiny, entered the crystal through the gap and returned to normal size, then slid the stone tablet into her bag of holding. Portia's countersong (a 16, with Monarch aiding from inside) held the crystal open, and Monarch Misty Stepped out. The tablet is the Graven Lexus of binding.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 16)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-07-27) Asked Chimeg about legendary items and rolled 11 on Insight, finding no deception in her.
- (2025-07-27) At the Hall of Blades confessed at the pedestal that in the Tower of Dreams she took the summer queen's crown out of desire for power, and would not choose differently. The hall judged it worthy and told her that power from below pulls below and power from outside her lands will destroy her.
- (2025-08-10) Used Study with an Investigation check on the keeper and decided it was not an illusion but looked wrong and incomplete; she recalled the smith who made Chimeg's blade from steel of a broken blade, and relayed this over the psychic network.
- (2025-08-10) Cast a heightened Lightning Bolt (DC 16 Dexterity save, 32 base damage) on the keeper with Innate Sorcery, hitting two swords too; it rolled 18 and took the damage. Later she converted two first-level slots to sorcery points to cast it again for 32.
- (2025-08-10) Hit the keeper (AC 21) with a Sorcerer's Burst for 5 lightning, then 7 psychic with advantage; cast Misty Step to escape, and was stabbed by four swords for 3 damage, while shielding with her staff of shield (AC 19).
- (2025-08-10) Cast Two Strike with the staff of shield and hit AC 18 for 12 radiant, destroying a flying sword spirit; she then drew four swords for 10 damage and became bloodied.
- (2025-08-10) Suggested someone pick up the dropped black sword to stop the swords attacking, and told Portia to run.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 17)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-08-10) Picked up Black Razor wrapped in a stone camouflage blanket; it said 'now we will slay'. She failed the Charisma save with 13 (heroic inspiration reroll still failed), but Eddie's Protection from Evil and Good prevented the charm, so she stowed it in her bag of holding.
- (2025-08-24) Pushed for the Hall of Scales route, then agreed to explore the Hall of Feasts and playfully shoved Raf toward the chimney.
- (2025-08-24) Nature check 13 identified the floating purple fruit as cloud giant sky fruit; proposed recreating the mosaic feast on the table as the way to open the secret door.
- (2025-08-24) Warned the party that black puddings split from lightning and slashing; cast Mind Whip for 8 damage and a Wild Magic surge gave everyone within 30 ft vulnerability to piercing.
- (2025-08-24) Nature check 24 identified the oozes as old gray oozes with psychic abilities; hit them with Two Strike radiant attacks (12 radiant each) against AC 19.
- (2025-08-24) Cast the guardian-control ritual from the giant notes with a third-level slot, spending two sorcery points to heighten it (DC 16); the rune guardian rolled 10 and failed, so she controlled it for an hour and named it Andy Rooney.
- (2025-08-24) Marched the guardian toward the mosaic door; it instead helped the unseen servants hold up the table.
- (2025-08-24) In the challenger fight cast Mind Whip (DC 16, 6 psychic) and a heightened Faerie Fire; the guardian then hit the challenger for 61 total.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 18)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-09-21) Cast Clairvoyance on the far side of the secret door and saw an enormous crystal chalice in a small cabinet, not a passage.
- (2025-09-21) Rolled two natural 20s on the disadvantage Insight roll while watching the giant-dragon vision.
- (2025-09-21) Decided against re-controlling the rune guardian, since the spell costs a third-level slot and 2 sorcery points.
- (2025-09-21) Cast Faerie Fire with 2 sorcery points to impose disadvantage on the Dex save (DC 15) of the healing ooze, then cast lightning bolt for 40 that split two oozes, hitting Eddie for 10.
- (2025-09-21) Hit the poison ooze with the staff of shield for 3 bludgeoning, and a wild magic cold burst did 6 cold damage.
- (2025-09-21) Took the explosion of the dying fire breath ooze for 12 fire after failing the Dex save.
- (2025-09-21) Natural 26 on a Nature check (Tides of Chaos) revealed that wyverns prefer unaware medium prey and have a deadly poison stinger.
- (2025-09-21) Used the Mirror of the Past on the Dreamcaster.
- (2025-09-21) Monarch opens fire for 24 damage and kills the last fire breath ooze, and it explodes, burning her.
- (2025-10-05) Cast heightened Earthbind (DC 16 Strength save, disadvantage) on the Wyvern; it rolled 12 and failed, grounding it (fly speed zero).
- (2025-10-05) Hit the Wyvern with Sorcerer's Fury fire for a crit and then 5 damage, bloodying it.
- (2025-10-05) Used Bend Luck to subtract 2 from the Wyvern's save for a 14.
- (2025-10-05) Cast Major Image to make a 20-foot mound over the Wyvern corpse so the cave would not see it.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 19)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-10-05) Cast lightning bolt at cultists in the cave for 24 damage; the horse beyond saved.
- (2025-10-05) Took 31 damage from the half white dragon's two hits (5 slashing + 9 cold, 7 slashing + 10 cold) and went down; drank a healing potion from Portia for 7 (2d4+2).
- (2025-10-05) Misty Stepped, cast Faerie Fire and spent two sorcery points for disadvantage on the cultist fanatic, then took 18 lightning from the half blue dragon's breath.
- (2025-10-05) Cast lightning bolt (heightened, DC 16) for 26 damage, killing a fanatic and wounding the half white dragon.
- (2025-10-05) Failed the Wisdom save against the Dreamcaster's mass suggestion (a 14), was charmed for 24 hours and fled 90 feet to jump on a horse.
- (2025-10-05) Monarch's lightning bolt hit three cultists and a horse, and the horse survived by saving.
- (2025-10-19) Cast Earthbind (DC 16 Strength save) on the flying Dreamcaster from above the tree canopy; he failed and descended safely, ending his flight.
- (2025-10-19) Tried to leave for the con under the suggestion and took a short rest; Eddie's Twilight Sanctuary freed her during it.
- (2025-10-19) Took Black Razor out of the Bag of Holding to examine it; necrotic energy curled toward her, then slapped her for 6 necrotic damage when she put it away, but she stayed conscious.
- (2025-10-19) Performed the Chalice of Accord ritual before the portal: Performance 22 using Tides of Chaos for advantage and Eddie's Guidance d4; the giant wasp mead boiled to steam and the portal opened.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 20)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-10-19) Answered 'power that dominates' to the dragons' question, but joined the party in answering wisdom; was frightened and had to retreat.
- (2025-10-19) Cast Enlarge on Eddie so he could carry the party across the crevasse.
- (2025-10-19) Heard the ooze's gurgling voice say 'surrender your face and gain ultimate power in chaos' and mentally refused; offered to be the Black Razor swapper (Charisma save +7).
- (2025-10-19) Used Bend Luck for +d4 on Raf's Arcana roll and a luck bonus for Portia's persuasion check.
- (2025-11-02) Got the GM's ruling that the Graven Lexus bonus cannot be shared simultaneously, and proposed installing Black Razor first, then extracting the mask.
- (2025-11-02) Spent sorcery points on bend luck to add a d4 to Portia's Arcana check, which reached 14 total.
- (2025-11-02) Rolled a natural 20 in the mask extraction round; opened her Bag of Holding so Raf could drop in the mask.
- (2025-11-02) A pseudopod struck her for 19 acid damage, leaving a festering mark on her leg that cure wounds and Remove Curse did not change.
- (2025-11-02) Stayed hungry (eating four times normal), dreamed of a featureless face and the words 'Chaos is power', read by the GM as an offer of patronage.
- (2025-11-02) Disguised herself with Alter Self as Myla Brightfellow, rolled 20 on persuasion and 15 on insight, and was hired as an aide by Senator Valeria at the Wreath & Lion.
- (2025-11-02) Learned Valeria is orchestrating the Grove measure within a campaign to tighten regulation of druidic and wild magic.

chunks.title: Monarch (part 21)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch
- (2025-11-16) Working in disguise as a halfling junior assistant to Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus, Monarch rolled Insight 17 (the VTT showed 18 minus 1) and compiled the vote picture: the measure leads by 25 votes and 11 persuadable senators hold 22 votes.

chunks.title: Monarch - Backstory
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch - backstory (written by the player)
Monarch Brightwing was born 18 years ago under an astral convergence that no one predicted. Due to its unexpected nature, it was assumed the convergence would have no influence over her, and she was encouraged to pursue any profession she desired.
Her thirst for knowledge led her to the sylvan libraries day in and day out, where she attracted the attention of some of the more powerful Fey Wizards. She was offered an apprenticeship under the esteemed Archmage Eldric Thistlethorn, one of the most recognized Wizards in the Feywild.
Monarch's knack for magic was immediate. She had a natural talent for casting spells and quickly outpaced her classmates in both studies and magical prowess. She was then asked to inscribe her first "real" leveled spell into her spellbook: Mage Armor.
She discovered that she didn't need to memorize the spell every day; she just knew it inherently. During classes, when instructed to cast Mage Armor, she simply recalled the spell to the front of her mind and performed the necessary motions to cast it.
Several months into her studies, disaster struck. Monarch went to cast Mage Armor as usual, but after the eldritch armor was summoned, tendrils of dark magic snaked from her to every student and instructor within 30 feet. Necrotic forces drained the students, killing three of them and injuring everyone else. Monarch was incarcerated and forbidden from casting any spells until an investigation could take place.

chunks.title: Monarch - Backstory (part 2)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch - backstory (written by the player)
The investigation was led by the Feywild's foremost expert on magical anomalies, Investigator Lysandra Silverglade. It became apparent that the unpredicted astral convergence had instilled a taint of Wild Magic in Monarch's blood. Eventually, it was discovered that anyone born on that same day under the convergence had Wild Magic in their blood.
During her time in confinement, Monarch's investigative nature came to the forefront. She began to uncover subtle signs of infiltration within the magical academy, noticing strange behavior and suspicious activities among the staff. With her keen intellect and determination, she deduced that a cabal of dark fey led by Sorcerer Malakar Nightshade had been manipulating events, attempting to destabilize the Feywild's magical institutions. Of course, being held prisoner, she had no way of gathering the proof needed to expose the conspiracy
Despite her discoveries, the fact remained that her uncontrolled Wild Magic had caused the deaths of other fey. As a result, Queen Titania, the ruler of the Feywild, decreed that Monarch was to be exiled to the Prime Material plane with the directive to "get her shit together" and forbidden to return to the Feywild until she could demonstrate some control over her Wild Magic.

chunks.title: Monarch - Backstory (part 3)
chunks.text:
Player character: Monarch - backstory (written by the player)
On the Prime Material plane, Monarch arrived in the great city of Roma, the heart of the Imperium. She was told to seek out Portia Fara, a satyr who was rumored to be in Roma. Portia introduced me to House Ventre where I was put to work as an investigator working for Archivist Octavio Libram.
Officially I research the locations of magic items for recovery by the house and use my research to build provenance for items already in possession of House Ventre. Unofficially, I use my position as a sort of internal affairs/internal security/counter-intelligence agent within the house. A recurring code name in many of my investigations is Cultella, an elusive spy and thief whose true appearance is still unknown. She uses female pronouns, but that doesn't prove anything. She does leave a calling card when she wants to make a point: an image of a dagger piercing a coin.
Monarch continues to hone her magical abilities and investigative skills. She seeks knowledge and guidance from various arcane scholars, hoping to master her Wild Magic and uncover the full extent of the conspiracy she had only begun to expose. Determined to redeem herself and return home, Monarch navigates the mortal world with a blend of faerie charm and fierce resolve, always on the lookout for clues that might lead her back to the Feywild and the truth behind her birth under the astral convergence.
