chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
Character sheet: Satyr; Druid 8 (Circle of the Land); level 8; background Guide; Lawful Neutral
- (2024-11-03) Silently warned Raylana of trouble at the doors and window, then crouched by the front door and opened it at Raf's signal.
- (2024-11-03) Sculpted the fireplace fire into a watching eye with Elementalism and signaled someone was in Thor's room.
- (2024-11-03) Attacked blindly by an invisible skulk for 11; cast Healing Word on herself for 8, and stabbed it blindly for 6 on a 15.
- (2024-11-03) Cast Entangle on the two darklings (DC 13 Strength save, both restrained).
- (2024-11-03) Dragged the downed Lucia out of reach and gave her a healing potion for 6.
- (2024-11-03) Wild-shaped into a jackal, dashed out the window and chased the disguised Valkrath; he knocked her down, and she reverted to Portia and failed a death save.
- (2024-11-17) Bought a weapon of warning (dagger) and nature's mantle. Its warning grants advantage on initiative within 30 feet of her, and she only needs to be attuned.
- (2024-11-17) Visited the Groves of Belenus and asked Simona Querid Ventre what the Green Apothecary needed. She asked her to inquire with House Querid about whether the party is still hunted and promised to pass on information about the Senate measure.
- (2024-11-17) Learned from Simona of a Senate measure to put the Groves under the Roman consul, sponsored by Senator Magnus Opulos Marvad, with the vote at least three moons away, and relayed it to the party.

chunks.title: Portia (part 2)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2024-11-17) Urged the party to be cautious about others greasing wheels on their behalf, and pushed for using the Golden Leaf as contact because it is not tied to a house.
- (2024-12-01) Went with Monarch to the Glass Door tavern to talk to Shimmerstone workers. She rolled persuasion while Monarch rolled investigation, and they learned about the workers' grievances.
- (2024-12-01) Aided Lucia with advantage when she approached the warlock Eryndra, helping on the persuasion check that came to 22.
- (2024-12-01) In her interview she said she is committed to the Green Apothecary. She believed Monarch's claim that the job was only freelance. She suggested illusionists, shapeshifters or a mouse in wild shape as security risks, so Jingle ordered all beasts on the premises eradicated daily and the scouts' aggression raised.
- (2024-12-01) Chose Circle of the Land druid at level-up and kept her roll of 8 for hit points.
- (2024-12-15) Persuaded a Greka-born druid at the Groves of Belenus to reveal a bat island, swam there as a fish, and made an Animal Handling check that drew a steady flow of curious bats to the Shipworks.
- (2024-12-15) Cast locate object for a kyber crystal from outside the property and sensed one inside the Shimmerstone Shipworks; her triangulation (rerolled heroic inspiration, took the 11) with Eddie narrowed it to Bay 3.
- (2024-12-15) Read the payday crowd and the city's predators following them.
- (2024-12-15) Tried to Message Raf about the trapped Jimmy but silence blocked the spell.

chunks.title: Portia (part 3)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-01-05) Her dagger of warning gave the party advantage on initiative; she rolled 23.
- (2025-01-05) Used speak with animals on the bats for a distraction; it barely worked. Her bat familiar Dora tried to deliver Shocking Grasp: attack 18, missed, and Dora was stabbed but fled.
- (2025-01-05) Scuffed away the blood trail outside with sleight of hand and kept up the pretense of patrolling.
- (2025-01-05) Used Druidcraft to make woodchuck noises in the woodpile, drawing a clockwork observer and a bronze scout away.
- (2025-01-05) Admitted truthfully she never entered the building; helped with the group Deception check.
- (2025-01-05) Joined Monarch's meeting with Azuriel, where her Insight told her Azuriel was withholding her lineage.
- (2025-01-05) Will brew seven healing potions at 25 gp each (175 gp) during downtime.
- (2025-01-19) Bought paper, pen and ink to map the Ruins of Qul'drik, using her cartographer's tools proficiency.
- (2025-01-19) Researched routes to Xi'an with the Grove druids; Nature check of 8 gave little beyond routes, the Imperial Road from Archafinalis, and steppe predators.
- (2025-01-19) Suggested asking the merchants' guild about Sir Saravar's reputation.
- (2025-01-19) Made a successful Animal Handling check inspecting the horses and helped negotiate a fair price for good ones.
- (2025-01-19) Learned from the caravan's rangers and druids that steppe predators have become less active, possibly because of something in the Underdark.

chunks.title: Portia (part 4)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-02-02) Gave the party advantage on initiative by keeping them within 30 feet of her.
- (2025-02-02) Cast sleep on the grappling ankheg, which was incapacitated.
- (2025-02-02) Helped harvest the ankheg carcasses and carried the plates.
- (2025-02-02) Cast speak with animals to calm the horses, with advantage on animal handling, while the party searched the ankheg lair.
- (2025-02-02) Changed her circle terrain after a long rest and enlarged Raf before his single combat, concentrating on the spell.
- (2025-02-02) Fed Good Berries to the caravan horses while the party waited outside Sun Dragon.
- (2025-02-02) Navigated north from Sun Dragon with a roll of 20 with Eddie's help, then rolled a critical success on survival tracking the blood trail and found the creature was heavy and getting heavier.
- (2025-02-16) Hit the troll with fire bolt for 4 damage, which stopped its regeneration that round; later missed with it.
- (2025-02-16) Was struck by the troll's chain for 10 damage and grappled; Monarch teleported her free. Grappled again for 5 damage and reeled 15 feet closer.
- (2025-02-16) Gathered the party's horses out of the troll's reach and cast Burning Hands (Dex 13 save, troll failed) for 10 fire damage.
- (2025-02-16) Rolled a natural 20 with advantage on Animal Handling to recover the bolted horses with Lucia.
- (2025-02-16) Was healed for 12 by Eddie and cast healing on her horse.
- (2025-02-16) Succeeded on the night's wisdom save and slept well.

chunks.title: Portia (part 5)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-03-02) Dressed for the feast in muted silk without fur, with a floor-length skirt hiding her legs.
- (2025-03-02) Cast comprehend languages to follow Urag Bayarmaa's Sylvan and Elvish, then used message to ask how she gathers knowledge from the sky; the shamaness replied briefly.
- (2025-03-02) Offered Jochi to wild shape into local creatures and scout to corroborate his falcons' sightings in the ruins; he welcomed it.
- (2025-03-02) Heard Urag Bayarmaa's saga of a sleeping colossus, matching the party's earlier shared dream, with a strong insight roll.
- (2025-03-02) Planned to enter some events, saying riding is her category, and offered Raf her map of where the troll fight happened.
- (2025-03-16) Asked what wildlife is available for wild shape for her lookout role and learned horses, lions, raptors, snakes, rodents and yak-like beasts; she cannot fly yet so birds are not an option.
- (2025-03-16) Spoke with her horse using speak with animals for advantage on riding: animal handling 23, 15 on the melee heat (total 38), and a ranged 13 to finish with 51 in the riding event.
- (2025-03-16) Shooting: scored 15 at short range, 13 at long range (28), then a rapid-fire average of 15 for 43 total, passing the event.
- (2025-03-16) Chose the battle magic duel and drew a priest of Tyr, whom she identified from his religion check as a Norse law god priest from the North; she cast Entangle (strength save) but he beat her down to 1 HP with radiant flame (7 then 17), and after she asked quarter he healed her for 25.

chunks.title: Portia (part 6)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-04-20) Sat out the final event and watched the Easterling mage. She stayed within 60 feet of him and cast Comprehend Languages to follow the crowd.
- (2025-04-20) Lent Monarch three healing potions and offered Raf three more.
- (2025-04-20) Noticed the mage's eyes sliding toward the invisible creature. She sent Chimeg a Message: someone has violated your trust and there is an invisible creature in the tower. Chimeg did not answer but glanced around.
- (2025-04-20) Used Misty Step and then ran as a riding horse to warn the clan leaders near the gate, arriving in the doorway as the clan charged. Her faerie fire plan for Monarch earned her a heroic inspiration she gave to Sir Raf.
- (2025-05-04) Sat near the matriarch and Tomor, druidcrafted flowers and gave them to the matriarch, who tucked them into her chair; she also read the crowd's mood with Insight.
- (2025-05-04) Noticed Setsen had slipped away from the stands during the match.
- (2025-05-04) Helped study the Cult of the Dragon amulet for locate object, recalling only the Kingdom of the West's dragon pact via her History check.
- (2025-05-04) Her Weapon of Warning gave allies within 30 feet advantage on initiative and woke the sleepers when the land shark attacked; she cast speak with animals to calm the horses and made animal handling checks (16) to stop two panicked horses from fleeing.
- (2025-05-04) With Monarch, used druidcraft to predict the weather, finding it would stay hazy; she mounted her horse as the shark neared.

chunks.title: Portia (part 7)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-05-18) Cast pass without trace so the group stealth result of 27 kept the party hidden from the sky.
- (2025-05-18) Tracked the clawed biped prints with advantage from Monarch's help, concluding a single running reptilian drake- or dragon-kin creature.
- (2025-05-18) Spotted the first trip line with Eddie.
- (2025-05-18) Cast blur and used Nature's Mantle to Hide as a bonus action in the bushes.
- (2025-05-18) Cast Aid at third level on Eddie, Raf and Monarch for 10 hit points each.
- (2025-05-18) Used Land's Aid with two d six necrotic on a failed Constitution save (DC 14); the half dragon succeeded and took half, and she healed Sir Raf for 3.
- (2025-05-18) Thorn Whip-style thorny vines lashed the half dragon but failed to hurt it much.
- (2025-05-18) Searched the half dragon and cultists, took the explorer's pack and map, and planned to copy it for Chimeg.
- (2025-05-18) Carried a torch lit by Prestidigitation in the basement.
- (2025-06-01) Cast Fireball on the shambling mound for 24 damage, which it largely resisted; her Nature check identified it as a shambling mound.
- (2025-06-01) Used Misty Step to reposition, hit a blight with a fire attack that bloodied it, and finished the shambling mound with Burning Hands.
- (2025-06-01) Used absorb elements against the lightning guardian's slam, taking 22 total (14 bludgeoning plus 8 lightning).
- (2025-06-01) Blasted the lightning guardian with Burning Hands twice, DC 14: 7 on its first save, and the upcast second casting made it vanish.

chunks.title: Portia (part 8)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-06-01) Helped search the ornate chest for hidden catches with Monarch, using Inspiration, and tried to summon a fey spirit but lacked the 300 gp gilded flower component.
- (2025-06-15) Stood 32 feet from the chest and avoided its force blast entirely.
- (2025-06-15) Used a Nature check to read the orrery: it models this world's sun, planet and moon plus the planetoid Obsidius, also called the newcomer or the orphan, a spelljammer destination.
- (2025-06-15) Moved the orrery to learn that each position matches a moment in history; spinning it forward about 700 years showed Obsidius would pass between moon and planet in a double eclipse, and deduced the spheres are bells.
- (2025-06-15) Played the middle sphere's tone on her pan flute, triggering a thunder wave; she saved with 14 and took half of 22 damage, not thrown back.
- (2025-06-15) Proposed a safer test shot at the largest sphere, and later reset the orrery to a random point 500-650 years back after the group left the room.
- (2025-06-15) Planned to build a map of the ruins with her cartographer tools after a long rest.
- (2025-07-13) Read the tree canopy from the top of the Tower of Dreams to find likely building sites and pointed the party toward the Tower of Runes; the GM noted Monarch and Rafael could also spot it.
- (2025-07-13) Sent her owl familiar to scout the noise; the owl rolled a 20 on stealth and reported many people and a large rocky thing, some falling or burned while climbing.

chunks.title: Portia (part 9)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-07-13) Her Pass without Trace kept the group stealthy within 30 feet (the party rolled 40, 36, 30, 28 and 17); she used an auto-succeed from her dream bonus to spot the purple-clad fanatic and Speaker of Storms, and relayed it over the mind link to Eddie, Lucia and Raf.
- (2025-07-13) Cast Fireball (DC 14) centered above Cultist D, dealing 30 total; three of four cultists died, and the Speaker of Storms made his save and took half.
- (2025-07-13) Cast Aid at second level, giving five extra hit points to Raf, Eddie and Chimeg for eight hours.
- (2025-07-13) Healed Raf for six with Healing Word, then healed Eddie with Healing Word for eleven and later for seven after he went down.
- (2025-07-13) Used Land's Aid (Con save DC 14, 2d6 necrotic) which healed one ally for 12 and whose necrotic damage tipped the guardian into structural failure.
- (2025-07-13) Hid as a bonus action using Nature's Mantle with a stealth of 28, and later hit the guardian with Firebolt.
- (2025-07-27) Cast protection from energy for thunder at second level on herself, Raf and Eddie before the Tower of Runes climb.
- (2025-07-27) Climbed the Tower of Runes. Her Survival (19) found the old climbers' tracks and her help let Raf succeed. A concentration roll of 16 held. She was knocked off by a force blast, taking 7 force plus fall damage, and went down; Eddie healed her with 29 hit points.

chunks.title: Portia (part 10)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-07-27) Touching a living vine rune on the lower stones, she received visions of ancient forest giants and learned the Rune of Grasping, a bonus-action cantrip that adds +2 to save DC and attack for restraining or incapacitating spells.
- (2025-07-27) Failed a performance countersong at the final tier, causing an 8 thunder blast (halved) that deafened the group. Later rolled 10 and then 16 with advantage from Monarch and held the crystal open for six seconds.
- (2025-07-27) Rolled a natural 20 on Survival to triangulate the prison's location from the three towers, and used pass without trace. Cast speak with plants, learning that trees to the front had felt axe and machete strikes.
- (2025-07-27) Wild shaped into a panther for darkvision and led the way into the Hall of Blades. She did not feel inclined to offer a truth.
- (2025-08-10) Answered the pedestal's demand for a truth by admitting she left the Feywild to escape the courts' control and resents being tasked with watching Monarch; the voice judged it adequate.
- (2025-08-10) Reverted from panther form to cast spells, then hit two swords with Burning Hands for 9 fire damage (one failed its save, one saved for half), and again hit with a second Burning Hands.
- (2025-08-10) Cast Blur on herself and drank a potion of healing; swords hit her for 11 total and 5 in later rounds.
- (2025-08-10) Picked up the scimitar of slumbering blue dragon's wrath, an uncommon attunement weapon (natural 20 sparks 5 lightning damage to chosen creatures within 5 feet).

chunks.title: Portia (part 11)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-08-10) Rolled 8 and 16 on History, learning that giant feast halls double as city hall and battle arena; her owl Dora scouted the Hall of Feasts (perception 14), matching a table to a mosaic covering a hidden door.
- (2025-08-24) Drew a map of the hall for historical purposes while hiding behind a pillar and later collected some rubble to take with her.
- (2025-08-24) Killed black pudding fragments with Firebolt and burned an ooze with Burning Hands (14 damage, resisted).
- (2025-08-24) Sent her owl Dora into the brewery room; it saw about three centers of motion and was hit by a fire blast (13 fire, Dex save made for half).
- (2025-08-24) Cast Call Lightning against the challenger, placing the strike point so Raf was not caught, and dealt 13 saved-for-half lightning.
- (2025-09-21) Led the cooking of the giant feast with Cook's utensils (Dex and Wisdom) beside Eddie, and the GM credited the work.
- (2025-09-21) Cast Aid on three party members for 5 extra hit points before the day.
- (2025-09-21) Used Ray of Frost on the potion oozes (5 cold, later 7, 9, 12) slowing them by 10 feet, and cast Sleet Storm over the oozes.
- (2025-09-21) Sent her owl Dora to survey outside the cave, spotting the wyvern, and proposed using Protection from Poison and a wild shape into medium prey to lure it away.
- (2025-10-05) Wild shaped into a wounded riding horse, then a jackal, to lure the Wyvern; it ignored the horse but attacked the jackal.

chunks.title: Portia (part 12)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-10-05) Survived the Wyvern's critical sting (13 piercing and 25 poison) thanks to wild shape temporary hit points, and was poisoned until its next turn.
- (2025-10-05) Cast a silent fireball (14 to hit DC, dex save failed, 25 damage) on the Wyvern, a second at DC 14 for 9 on its save, and quaffed a healing potion for 5.
- (2025-10-05) Hurled a fireball 150 feet into the cave at the Dreamcaster's table, then Misty Stepped away.
- (2025-10-05) Hit the half blue dragon with Fire Bolt, a critical for 25, bloodying it.
- (2025-10-05) Cast Burning Hands (DC 14) on the half white dragon for 10, bloodying it, and healed Eddie for 18.
- (2025-10-05) Handed Monarch a healing potion.
- (2025-10-05) Saved against mass suggestion.
- (2025-10-19) Saved against the Dreamcaster's psychic blast (21, with advantage on saves against spells) and took 11 psychic damage.
- (2025-10-19) Hit the Dreamcaster with Fire Bolt for 4 damage and followed Chimeg's shots, helping bring him down; blasted for 21 psychic, she was at 3 hit points.
- (2025-10-19) Used her last regular healing potion after the short rest, reaching 31 of 38 hit points.
- (2025-10-19) Answered wisdom to the dragons, was frightened and retreated, and cast Protection from Energy (thunder).
- (2025-10-19) Used empathy to calm the psychic ooze colony, threw a Good Berry in (consumed with no effect), and held it calm while crossing; a persuasion check with Monarch's luck showed the colony cannot understand specific requests.

chunks.title: Portia (part 13)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-11-02) Rerolled with heroic inspiration; with Eddie's guidance and Monarch's bend luck her Arcana check came to 14, enough to install Black Razor.
- (2025-11-02) Wild-shaped into a horse and carried Lucia and Eddie across the chasm one at a time, taking three rounds.
- (2025-11-02) As a horse she led the herd of captured horses out of the ruins as scout.
- (2025-11-02) Met Simona in her tent and heard her three avenues to save the Groves; told her she would consult her party.
- (2025-11-02) Drew a tracing of the cult coin for the Khan and was shown the Grove alchemists' nectar that turns a liar's tongue black.
- (2025-11-16) Portia, as a Wild Shape spider, rolled a 20 on Stealth and slipped into the Senate archives unseen, waiting until clerks left at night. She found the senate debate records, earlier drafts of the Groves bill and samples of Magnus Marvad's handwriting.
- (2025-11-16) Portia reported each senator's stated motives for backing the annexation, including Brontus, Kaldrina, Borluss, Rogrun and Azirah.
- (2025-11-16) Portia proposed a Great Henge restoration and a druidic academy as an alternative oversight body, and took the idea to the Groves, where everyone agreed to the henge idea.
- (2025-11-16) Portia presented Simona's papers at the ogres' entrance to Rogrun's palace, and poured a toast of giant wasp wine into an upturned goblet for Rogrun. At the Palace of Stone she showed the papers to the rock sentinel and signed the henge agreement for the druids.

chunks.title: Portia (part 14)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2025-11-30) In spider form on Monarch's shoulder, rolled a 19 on Insight and read that Calvus was sincere in rejecting the Norge petition.
- (2025-11-30) As the Green Apothecary's representative, presented the druids' oath to the frost giant senator Vaelthira with advantage on Persuasion; she agreed to vote against annexation.
- (2025-11-30) Won the fire giant senator Kaldrina's vote against annexation with the binding oaths; Persuasion with advantage.
- (2025-11-30) Persuaded Senator Octavia Calvad and Senator Valeria Dalmia Calvus to flip their votes, with a small bonus for her rare silks.
- (2025-11-30) Gathered the Green Apothecary at the standing stones to get binding oaths drafted.
- (2025-12-14) Negotiated with the visiting druid Tessa Oakmere, who agreed to move scouts but not pyrotechnics or armies.
- (2025-12-14) Prepared Water Breathing as a ritual spell and cast it for up to ten on the Wave Mount, good for 24 hours.
- (2025-12-14) Chose the polar land option for her spells and kept healing and pass without trace.
- (2025-12-14) Tried to find a way to disguise the ship in fog, but the GM ruled a stationary fog cloud wouldn't follow the moving ship.
- (2026-01-11) Considered Tidal Wave to push the ship but found it only affects creatures and does nothing to objects, so she dropped it.
- (2026-01-11) Cast Call Lightning and called a warning-shot bolt into the water between the ship and the bronze dragon; it was later noted that bronze dragons like lightning.

chunks.title: Portia (part 15)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2026-01-11) Made the Strength save against the dragon's force roar (target 15) and stayed on deck.
- (2026-01-11) Shouted an offering to the dragon and used persuasion, rolling 21 total with a d4 from Monarch's Bend Luck; the dragon answered 'leave your ship, I shall destroy it' and was clearly warning, not killing.
- (2026-01-11) Cast Water Breathing on Raf, Lucia, herself, the captain and six sailors; Monarch was too high up to be included.
- (2026-01-11) Hit the submerged dragon with Ray of Frost for 10 cold damage, then used inspiration to reroll a missed second Ray of Frost, dealing another 10 and slowing it by 10 feet.
- (2026-01-11) Worked the anchor winch and raised the anchor, which had not reached the seabed.
- (2026-01-11) Transformed into a constrictor snake and jumped overboard to join the underwater scene, speaking to the party in snake form.
- (2026-01-11) Passed without a trace was cast for the sneak down to the lower level.
- (2026-01-25) In the vignette she was a reflection of Aurelia posing as a satyr escort, led Mona to a fairy ring, shared her flask, and was reabsorbed by Aurelia, who said the original Portia awaits on the Prime Material.
- (2026-01-25) Cast Detect Poison and Disease on the blight and learned it is a spreading magical contagion at its leading edge.
- (2026-01-25) In the cellar fight her Hold Person (DC 14) did not affect the jade-eyed woman, and her Ray of Frost missed; she was hit by a fake Raf for 16 and 14.

chunks.title: Portia (part 16)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2026-01-25) Hit a doppelganger with the blue dragon scimitar for 6 slashing (about a 15) and the dagger for 3 piercing, then later healed unconscious Lucia with Healing Word for 8 and hit the shape-shifted sketchy guy with Ray of Frost for 11 cold, bloodying him.
- (2026-02-08) Used her ring of swimming (40 feet) to scout the flooded cave and cast Healing Word on herself.
- (2026-02-08) Messaged the dragon asking for a time and place; it struck her with a lightning bolt for 40, halved by a successful Dexterity save, then said to meet tomorrow by the goats.
- (2026-02-08) Weakened the barred door with Ray of Frost.
- (2026-02-08) Used Lands Aid: necrotic damage to the jade-eyed woman (2 points after a heroic inspiration reroll, halved to 2 with her save) and healed Eddie for 9.
- (2026-02-08) Took a seat on the steps with no resources and learned a new spell list at level seven after the long rest.
- (2026-02-22) Her group investigation of the map room scored 16, showing planners had ignored Dragonfjord as a landing route.
- (2026-02-22) Arranged druid transport to the northern edge of the forest and scouted Emperor's Bay through her owl's eyes, spotting the imperial blockade and northern scout ships.
- (2026-02-22) Rolled survival 17 as co-scout to find a pass through the mountains.
- (2026-02-22) Spoke to the hermit and, via speak with animals, to his winter wolf Useless, learning to avoid yeti by stealth and low altitude.
- (2026-02-22) Her owl Dora spotted five winter wolves tracking the party; she cast conjure animals at 60 feet in the fight.

chunks.title: Portia (part 17)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2026-03-08) Used Conjure Animals wolf spirits and cast fireball twice against the winter wolves; the first hit all three targets for 25 fire to those who failed saves, the second hit two wolves who made their saves (half of base 27, so 13 each).
- (2026-03-08) Cast healing word on Raf for 13, cleared two 40-foot snowless campsites, and made cook's-tool wolf steaks.
- (2026-03-08) Her Nature check of 27 gave the lore on yetis (freezing gaze, ice-throwing, avalanches, abominable yetis serving a demon lord of ice).
- (2026-03-08) Cast aid at second level for 5 extra hit points on herself, Monarch and Eddie, and the unicorn Lamorna gave her 11 temporary hit points and +2 AC.
- (2026-03-08) Cast wall of fire (DC 14 Dexterity save) that burned the yeti for 20 damage, and then dismissed it.
- (2026-03-08) Spoke with the unicorn, explaining the wild magic and the yeti.
- (2026-03-08) Reasoned that more yeti could follow the trail and used elementalism and pass without trace to break it; transformed into a spider to scout the wagon wreck and found no survivors, ten long-dead people and a map-making expedition.
- (2026-04-05) Cast Pass without Trace, her last of three casts, for group stealth, giving the group +10 (medians 34, 28 and 32).
- (2026-04-05) Rolled 23 on the survival check to find the ruins' shelter.
- (2026-04-05) Made a map of the area on rice paper and kept a rock from the ruins.

chunks.title: Portia (part 18)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2026-04-05) Cast water breathing on all and aid on the three swimmers (+5 max hit points for eight hours), then wild shaped into a reef shark for the seven-mile swim.
- (2026-04-05) Failed the Wisdom save against the longship's fear aura and was frightened; later saved with a 21.
- (2026-04-05) Dashed ahead of the longship so she could revert from shark form and regroup with the party.
- (2026-04-19) Gave long strider and offered to cast Pass without Trace; shapeshifted into a horse and galloped to the dragon's strike site, finding the frozen dwarf remains.
- (2026-04-19) Tracked the dwarves' trail as a horse and cast Comprehend Languages for the Speak with Dead.
- (2026-04-19) Hit the ice troll with fire bolt, 18 fire damage and later 4 and 9 fire damage; handed Eddie a potion of healing.
- (2026-04-19) Failed her Wisdom save against the roar, dropped her quarterstaff and became frightened, then was pulled to the astral plane.
- (2026-05-17) Threw fire bolt (12 damage) and then cast blight on the second ice troll; it succeeded its Constitution save (17, reduced to 15 by Monarch's effect) and took half, and it collapsed desiccated.
- (2026-05-17) Asked in the astral library where the silver dragon is and learned Lunae languishes in an iron flask buried behind ice in Rimescar's hoard.
- (2026-05-17) Rolled nature 24 and recalled that Rimescar is at least an adult, huge and CR 13, immune to cold and with legendary resistance but weak in Intelligence and Charisma.

chunks.title: Portia (part 19)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2026-05-17) Cast locate object for the iron flask, which sensed it within 1,000 feet, up and to the east.
- (2026-05-17) Cast Aid at third level for 10 hit points and kept walking, the only one not flying, using her ring of reaction.
- (2026-05-17) Reminded the party of Rowan's instructions: prevent the galleons and the bribe, determine the Cherek force, do not engage.
- (2026-06-14) Cast fireball at the yeti, dealing 31 fire damage and bloodying them (14 Dex save to halve for one). The fire melted the ice in a 20-foot-radius circle and caused a tremor, drawing a warning from the dwarves.
- (2026-06-14) Finished a yeti with a firebolt (11 plus a d4 from Monarch's Bend Luck, 9 damage).
- (2026-06-14) Made a nature check that narrowed the heat-hunting creature to a frost salamander or a remorhaz.
- (2026-06-14) Cast call lightning; her bolt on a living cold breath (15 Dex save halved 17) cracked the dragon egg, and a later bolt dealt 3d10 to a target that failed (Dex 14 vs 18).
- (2026-06-14) Took the iron flask and unstoppered it, freeing the silver dragon Lunae; told her where the dwarves and the white dragon's offspring were.
- (2026-06-14) Attuned to the Root of Whisperwood (dropping attunement to Nature's Mantle), raising Shillelagh, Thorn Whip and Fire Bolt to +8.
- (2026-06-14) Fired a firebolt at the last yeti, which gains disadvantage from fire.

chunks.title: Portia (part 20)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2026-07-12) Scouted the Cherek convoy in wolf form with passive perception 16 (wolf plus three on rolls), seeing three heavy wagons, about a dozen Goliaths, the tattooed rune caster and the woman who sat looking up at the falls.
- (2026-07-12) Scouted the Cherek camp as a wolf, with stealth 16; pickets saw her but ignored her. Perception 17 showed the rune caster's tattoos were runes. She saw the woman set a white dragon mask on her lap.
- (2026-07-12) Helped Monarch choose the hidden waterfall pool for the illusion.
- (2026-07-12) Medicine check 9 on the prisoners found no torture; gave Sorcha and Ashvale each a Good Berry and ungagged Sorcha.
- (2026-07-12) Told Sorcha the dragon above was an illusion and that the party works with Lunae; her persuasion made the Maulring slayers accept Lunae for now. Freed both prisoners.
- (2026-07-26) Scouted ahead as a wolf with speed 40. Rolled a survival 22 with advantage, then added Monarch's bonus for 28, to find a hidden hollow camp about a mile from the Fenrir camp.
- (2026-07-26) Suggested dropping Rimescar's skull on the Fenrir to frame the Cherek. Took an eagle form with eyes of the eagle and saw eight people, including Vigdis and the rune master, leave with the tribute wagon.
- (2026-07-26) On an Arcana check, recognized the icy crown from the vision as the Yoke of Thrym. Read the tension between the rune master and Vigdis as uneasy coworkers.

chunks.title: Portia (part 21)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2026-08-09) Asked the GM whether she had met Aurelia, because the Root of Whisperwood is tied to Aurelia and certain features depend on it; the GM confirmed she has met Aurelia.
- (2026-08-09) Cast Pass without Trace and took spider form, carried by Monarch toward the Cherek camp; the group stealth check came to 22 (her 12 plus 10).
- (2026-08-09) Crawled as a spider through the gap Raf opened under the pavilion edge, searched the commander's pack and then his bedroll (stealth 34) and found only soldier's kit and no documents.
- (2026-08-09) Set down on the Fenrir's deck, she was struck by lightning for 33 damage, took 16 on her Dexterity save, and hid in a pile of rope.
- (2026-08-09) Took 7 cold damage from the Fenrir's frost breath while hiding inside the rope coil.
- (2026-08-09) Climbed onto Eddie's extended rapier and cocooned herself on it with webs to be flown out, then rode on Eddie's shoulder away from the camp.
- (2026-08-09) Proposed charming the elementals with charm monster, having first-level, second-level and fourth-level slots left, as part of the new heist plan.
- (2026-09-06) Cast charm monster (Wisdom save DC 14) on a bearsark; the guard at the front saw her and started combat.
- (2026-09-06) Flew in as an eagle through the open hatch and perched on the ladder, then hit a bearsark with a fire bolt for 8.
- (2026-09-06) Opened a door in the lower deck and found glowing rune stones; a flaming armored figure rose from them and she shut the door.

chunks.title: Portia (part 22)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2026-09-06) Cast burning hands (Dex save DC 14): the big bear took double for 18 and the commander and a bearsark took 9 each, 36 total.
- (2026-09-06) Healed Monarch with Healing Word for 19.
- (2026-09-06) Pulled the barbed javelin from Monarch and later shouted persuasion orders as an eagle (persuasion 16) to sail north.
- (2026-09-06) Said she carries a scroll of reincarnate and would tell Raf and Lucia.
- (2026-09-20) Had charmed two Goliath bearsarks with charm monster and, earlier, flown into the ship as a bird.
- (2026-09-20) Cast burning hands on the Goliath bearsark and another foe with a Dex save DC 14, dealing 21 fire damage, and used a bonus action to cast shillelagh.
- (2026-09-20) Was bitten by the Goliath bearsark for 10, made a Constitution save, and felt the bite was deep enough that she may need magical treatment against lycanthropy.
- (2026-09-20) Healed Monarch for 18 with a third-level spell.
- (2026-09-20) Became the attuned owner of the Fenrir after an hour. Her persuasion bonus is plus 5, and she rolled a 27 to persuade the charmed crew to get off. She then named the whole party as crew and turned off the lightning and howl.
- (2026-09-20) Said she had shut the rune-stone door earlier when a flame-armored being rose.
- (2026-09-20) Charmed the armored fire elemental with charm monster (DC 14 Wisdom save) and persuaded it to stop attacking Sir Raf.
- (2026-09-20) Took 15 thunder from the air elemental, halved to 7 with absorb elements, failed to charm it with a DC 14 save, then misty-stepped away.

chunks.title: Portia (part 23)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2026-10-04) Had charmed the armored fire elemental and sent it off; her charm lapsed within the hour, but Monarch's charm held it.
- (2026-10-04) Read the captain's journals (one hand, unsigned) and learned they refer to 'the winter favored' giving orders and to the 'terms' limiting clan contact; her insight suggested information is compartmentalized to suppress discontent.
- (2026-10-04) Read the boarding ward description and had switched off only the lightning and howling, leaving the head on; suggested turning on the howl as an alarm.
- (2024-10-20) Sent a message to Harvey warning of unexpected visitors upstairs and suggesting he send up security; he was disoriented by it.
- (2024-10-20) Stood between Sir Raf and the others, then cast Entangle on an assassin (Strength DC 13); it missed its save by one and was restrained.
- (2024-10-20) Was shot by a hand crossbow for 6 piercing damage and failed her Constitution save, then failed again with an 8; poisoned and unconscious.
- (2024-10-20) Questioned the Green Apothecary about drow poison, learning it is brewed in darkness with Underdark fungi, spider venom and Sleep, and that authorities care little about it.
- (2024-10-20) Wild shaped into a chestnut horse to hide the party's numbers as they left the Groves, and tipped the desk soldier at the Trimarket watch office.
- (2026-10-18) Tried to dispel the Fenrir's persistent fear effect with a wisdom check aided by guidance and failed; it persisted.

chunks.title: Portia (part 24)
chunks.text:
Player character: Portia
- (2026-10-18) As the Fenrir's attuned authority she decided to switch on the defenses (lightning boarding ward, howl) during the dragon chase; later turned off winter's blast and the terrifying howl, keeping only the lightning boarding ward before the imperial spell jammers.
- (2026-10-18) Cast comprehend languages to understand the summoned air elemental's reply.
- (2026-10-18) Aided Eddie's navigation survival check and then navigated the group due east toward the Northern fleet blockade.
- (2026-10-18) Argued the party shouldn't presume to hand the Fenrir over to Roma and might destroy it depending on politics.
- Loot (2025-05-18): Fanatic's Tower of Storms Map and Notes
- Loot (2025-08-10): Slumbering Blue Dragon's Wrath Scimitar
- Loot (2025-10-19): Cult of the Dragon Amulet, 14 trade gems of 500 gp, 26 platinum, 15 gold, 38 silver, three obsidian coins (made a rubbing of them) and a pouch of sand, leaving the robes.
- Loot (2026-06-14): Root of Whisperwood
- Loot (2026-06-14): Scroll of Reincarnate

chunks.title: Sir Raf
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
Character sheet: Human; Fighter 4 (Eldritch Knight) / Wizard 4 (War Magic (XGtE)); level 8; background Noble (custom stats)
- (2024-11-03) Went inside to order a pitcher of mead and five mugs, and asked Raylana to keep it filled.
- (2024-11-03) Readied his shield and bow when Eddie signaled trouble, then opened the bedroom door at the stage of the ambush and took a hobgoblin fist for 7 bludgeoning.
- (2024-11-03) Was stabbed by a darkling for 5 piercing and 3 necrotic, used Second Wind, and disengaged to stay close to Lucia.
- (2024-11-03) Shot two restrained darklings, killing both; the first hit for 5 and the second, with Action Surge, for 7, and both burst into blinding light.
- (2024-11-03) Drank a healing potion for 7 and fed Monarch a Good Berry after she was dropped outside the window.
- (2024-11-03) Warned the party to step away so they would not be caught in a darkling's explosion, and later reminded them that Valkrath's acid glyph would have killed anyone adjacent.
- (2024-11-17) Bought a sentinel shield (no attunement), bracers of archery and a mundane short sword.
- (2024-11-17) Had an audience with Lady Gracia, who asked him to get closer to chief of staff Azuriel and report suspicious activity, and referred him to Sir Sarovar.
- (2024-11-17) Visited Sir Sarovar at the Sarovar Estate in the Sword Quarter and received a sealed letter of recommendation to Colonel Kaelix. He agreed to watch Lady Gracia, since Sarovar is being ghosted by her.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 2)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2024-11-17) With an arcana/nature roll of 20, recognized the drawing in Eddie's letter as resembling the legendary blue dragon mask and explained the dragon mask legends.
- (2024-11-17) Reported to the party about Gracia's concerns and advice on choosing employers carefully, and presented his letter to Colonel Kaelix.
- (2024-12-01) Rolled perception with advantage from his Sentinel Shield, getting 15, on the exterior inspection of Shimmerstone Shipworks. He saw the 10-foot wall, a cloud giant supervisor, the gas-bag superstructure and the darkened dry dock.
- (2024-12-01) Assisted Monarch's library research in Greka.
- (2024-12-01) In his interview he asked Jingle why a firm that kept security in-house now hires mercenaries. He cited House Kenegal's view on initiative and said he would mask himself from the sensors to breach the site.
- (2024-12-01) Rolled a 20 on insight during Jingle's lethal-force announcement and saw Jimmy Slips blanch before he recovered.
- (2024-12-01) At level-up he took a level of wizard, rerolled his hit points after a 4 and then a 3, and ended with a 5.
- (2024-12-15) Summoned a bat familiar named Diego for 10 gp of incense, using his wizard find familiar, and sent it on patrol circuits to scout the Shipworks.
- (2024-12-15) Used his Sentinel Shield and a natural 20 perception on arrival to notice a winking auto gnome with an unusual gait heading to the eastern Bay 1 crane.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 3)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2024-12-15) Through Diego (insight with advantage, 15 and 15), noticed an unusual number of bats, blended Diego in with them, and with a perception roll of 15 learned the whiny voice comes from a glass jar calling itself the great Zulk, and saw two crystal shards in a box.
- (2024-12-15) Pantomimed taking the autonome into custody to persuade the sentry; the roll was poor and the sentry did not react.
- (2025-01-05) Held the cage door and fought the sentry, taking hits of 2 and 3 early on; rerolled with inspiration and hit for 9 damage.
- (2025-01-05) Hit AC 24 for 12 damage and used Second Wind repeatedly; took a deep stab for 10 from the sentry.
- (2025-01-05) Noticed the crystal fragments among the wreckage with passive perception 18 and proposed gathering them as evidence.
- (2025-01-05) Tagged along when Jingle questioned the guards; admitted he has poor deception.
- (2025-01-05) Plans to buy a magic rapier as his primary melee weapon (400 gp plus item cost); has heavy armor proficiency.
- (2025-01-19) Rerolled a poor History check with inspiration on war ogres and recalled that his house has deployed them.
- (2025-01-19) Raf's Persuasion roll was strong; he told Sir Saravar the party's spell-like abilities could be turned into a surprise advantage. Kyle sensed Saravar's question was a chance to redeem themselves.
- (2025-01-19) Asked his House Kenegal contacts about Sir Saravar; nobody knew the name and Insight showed they were not hiding it.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 4)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2025-01-19) Decided to buy Goggles of Night since he lacks darkvision, and bought cold-weather clothing.
- (2025-01-19) Obtained a letter from Sir Saravar vouching for him to imperial military units; wants to keep it quiet.
- (2025-01-19) Recognized old comrades among the caravan's soldiers; they were glad he came.
- (2025-01-19) Learned imperial commanders may conscript mercenaries unless their contract is bought out.
- (2025-01-19) Used Insight on the Khan's clan and judged them roughly trained-soldier level, tougher than most.
- (2025-01-19) Raf succeeded on a Persuasion check, and Saravar said he would decide in seven days.
- (2025-02-02) Rolled 22 initiative and shot the first ankheg for 7 with his longbow, slowing it by 10 feet.
- (2025-02-02) Was sprayed with acid but made his Dex save with an 18, taking half of 13.
- (2025-02-02) Was bitten by the second ankheg for 12 slashing plus 5 acid and grappled, then killed it with a rapier hit for 10 points.
- (2025-02-02) Was given the potion of fire giant strength to carry, but chose not to drink it for the single combat.
- (2025-02-02) Volunteered as champion for the single combat with Grock, accepting buffs including false life, enlarge, blade ward and bless.
- (2025-02-02) Cast mind sliver on Grock for 1 psychic damage after Grock saved with a 7, then cast shield to turn aside a great axe blow that would have hit.
- (2025-02-02) Hit Grock for 10 plus d4, then landed a critical hit for 16 that bloodied him. Blade ward and false life absorbed Grock's blows, and Grock yielded.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 5)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2025-02-02) Won the combat and received 10 platinum from Harriet as hazard pay.
- (2025-02-16) Drew the troll's attention, was bitten at and slashed (AC 22, 11 damage), and poked it for 12 damage.
- (2025-02-16) Hit the troll again with an 18 for 8 damage, took Second Wind, then used Vex advantage and hit for 12.
- (2025-02-16) Was lit by Monarch's fairy fire; took 10 slashing damage absorbed by temporary hit points.
- (2025-02-16) Killed the troll with a natural 20, cutting off its head, then checked that it did not regenerate.
- (2025-02-16) Bartered his studded leather toward a Khanate-style breastplate at the Stormgale camp.
- (2025-02-16) Rolled a natural 20 on history and recalled House Kenegal's military journals about failed imperial attempts to seize the Ruins of Qul'drik.
- (2025-02-16) Had the party dismount to mirror the honor guard and pushed Lucia forward as the group's face; found Shimmerstone's welcome cold and liked Tomar.
- (2025-02-16) Spent heroic inspiration on the insight check, then failed the night's wisdom save (a 6) and shared the dream.
- (2025-03-02) Planned to buy silks cheaper in the Khanates (fine clothes at 15 gp) to supplement the fine clothes he already carries, suited to a warrior.
- (2025-03-02) Was introduced as a knight of House Kenegal; sat by Jochi and talked horses and falconry, complimenting the horse breeds.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 6)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2025-03-02) Gave the Khan's council a full eyewitness report of the Dawnrealm seizure of Sun Dragon Rising, the retaking by the Imperium, and the troll fight, with a performance check of 17; the report raised the party's standing.
- (2025-03-02) Asked how recently the Dawnrealm noble was captured, and suggested the Dawnrealm used the Sun Dragon assault as cover for infiltration.
- (2025-03-02) Urged General Batu to use Jochi's falcons as another surveillance layer; Batu replied he needs solid scouting before deploying forces but offered spot bounties for extracting interlopers.
- (2025-03-02) Asked what distinguishes honorary clan members from true members, and showed interest in the competition.
- (2025-03-16) Riding: rolled a 6 on animal handling with Guidance, used Tactical Mind (d10, 7) plus the d4 (3) for a 10; he then scored 22 on the melee heat, took the 13 straight animal handling roll, and finished with 55 after a ranged 23, beating four rivals in the first heat.
- (2025-03-16) Shooting: 22 at short range, 22 at long range with disadvantage (44 total), and rapid-fire rolls 22, 12, 14 and 20 using inspiration for an average of 20, ending with 64 as runner-up.
- (2025-03-16) Chose the battle magic duel against a hedge wizard; he cast false life for 11 temporary HP, but the mystic dispelled his Aid, and he rolled low initiative.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 7)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2025-03-16) In the duel Raf was held by Hold Person repeatedly and shocked for critical hits (10 and 6), failing several wisdom saves; he finally broke free with inspiration, then used Second Wind (12), Booming Blade (12 damage) and Blade Ward, and granted quarter, ending at 100% HP.
- (2025-03-16) Won the tiebreak duel against the Tyr priest (initiative 18): Booming Blade for 13 and 9, Shield against an attack, took 8 radiant from Valkyries and was held once, then used mind sliver (DC 12 intelligence save, 5 psychic damage) and the priest asked quarter, giving Raf first place in battle magic.
- (2025-04-20) Was the final contender against Chimeg. He rolled initiative 18, edging her out, cast Blade Ward, hid with a 15 against her DC 16, and crept through the grass. She never spotted him at first.
- (2025-04-20) Cast Shield with his shield on, so her two crossbow shots were turned aside, and kept the shield out while climbing the palisade.
- (2025-04-20) Used his tattoo of see invisible, spotting the creature of air and claws in the fortress corner. He climbed the wall and warned Chimeg he was coming for her.
- (2025-04-20) Told Chimeg the creature was not theirs to summon, though the faerie fire looked like his friend's. He shot it twice (8 and 13). He then stabbed it twice (15 on a crit, then 13), and used booming blade for 13.
- (2025-04-20) Used heroic inspiration to reroll his Con save against the vortex's grapple, and made it. Chimeg failed hers and took 10 thunder.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 8)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2025-04-20) Offered the bloodied Chimeg a healing potion as goodwill; she accepted it as a gift but did not drink it. She said they must redo the match tomorrow.
- (2025-05-04) Cast blade ward, hid with a Stealth roll good enough that only a Perception of 17 could spot him, and snuck through the grass; his familiar Diego rode on his shoulder.
- (2025-05-04) Ran to the palisade, cast shield against Chimeg's crossbow shot, then climbed the tower to the top of the palisade (athletics 13) but could not enter it because Chimeg stood in the single square.
- (2025-05-04) Sent Diego to distract Chimeg; she spent both attacks on him and killed him with 7 damage. Kyle said Raf can summon Diego again the next day.
- (2025-05-04) Fought from the ladder, keeping his footing with acrobatics checks (one 19), and hit Chimeg with rapier attacks for 11, 8, 9 (booming blade) and 13, bloodying her with the last; she was not hit by him until the first stab at AC 21.
- (2025-05-04) Cast false life for 8 temporary hit points, so Chimeg's blood-rage hits did not bloody him; she yielded and Raf ended at 32 of 43 HP after a nine-round victory.
- (2025-05-04) Became ultimate champion of the Warrior's Challenge as the only one to qualify in all events, having won the battle magic event, and earned 2 renown with the clan.
- (2025-05-04) Asked Chimeg for advice on gear for the ruins, bought carpenter's and mason's tools and two vials of holy water, and had the GM's Arcana read that the spirits are border ethereal creatures.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 9)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2025-05-04) Woken by Portia's dagger when the land shark attacked, he engaged it to protect the horses; he missed with 11 and AC 14 attacks, then was bitten for 20 and 14 and 15 and dropped, healed by Eddie's healing word to 18 and later shot it with a bow.
- (2025-05-04) Hit the land shark with a crit-range rapier attack for 16 and booming blade thunder for 8, used Second Wind (rolled 2), and the shark was left bloodied.
- (2025-05-18) Suggested sharing that the mask is a dragon mask, noted that a dragon cult would avoid giant-type creatures, and recognized the tracks as suspected Dawnrealm infiltration; his investigation roll was an 11.
- (2025-05-18) Moved up with his bow and readied an action; shot the half dragon (21 to hit, 8 damage) as it landed, drawing its breath.
- (2025-05-18) Used inspiration on his Dexterity save against the fire breath, and took second wind and blade ward.
- (2025-05-18) Drew his rapier to engage; a 25 hit did 11 damage, bloodying the half dragon; used Shield to turn aside a 21 attack; Booming Blade missed with a 13.
- (2025-05-18) Took 5 slashing and 9 fire from the half dragon's claws and was healed by Portia's 3 and Eddie's aura of vitality.
- (2025-05-18) Hailed the lightning guardian, then had the party close the door.
- (2025-05-18) Tiptoed between the circles with a 20 Acrobatics check to study the manacles; Arcana showed giant runes for power transfer, with the circle a protection from good only, possibly from a wish (24).

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 10)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2025-05-18) Identified the celestial bones as a planetar (Arcana 23), the fiend as a pit fiend (16) and the dragon as blue (Nature 16).
- (2025-05-18) Aided Monarch's investigation of the third door, which showed abjuration sigils.
- (2025-06-01) Shot a needle blight with his longbow for 11 piercing, killing it. He was hit in the doorway by thorns for 13 on a crit, absorbed by temporary hit points.
- (2025-06-01) Cast Shield against the shambling mound but its attack still hit at 24 for 9 bludgeoning and 5 lightning.
- (2025-06-01) Stepped across the threshold of the lightning guardian's room first, triggering its lunge. He used absorb elements against its lightning bolt, then Booming Blade (hit 22, 7 sword damage plus 4 thunder and 1 lightning) and a bonus-action second attack, regaining 9 hit points.
- (2025-06-01) Cast Mind Sliver on the lightning guardian (DC 14): 8 psychic damage and a d4 penalty on its next save.
- (2025-06-01) Investigated the chest's hinge trap with advantage and Eddie's guidance, reaching 28, which showed the hinge wires were the trigger.
- (2025-06-01) Was caught in the glyph's 60-foot burst at 52 feet away; he made his Constitution save with 16, taking 17 thunder and 15 necrotic and deafened for one round.
- (2025-06-01) Worked with Monarch on the sliding block puzzle (26), opening the compartment holding the giant coins and diamonds, and carried the cloth-wrapped mirror out. Offered Lucia a potion of giant strength.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 11)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2025-06-15) Climbed up with Eddie's boost to search the giant chest of writing materials and found the layered inks, paper and components.
- (2025-06-15) Found the giant-language research monograph on Zendrick and Eberron on the desk, judged it deliberately user-unfriendly with no index, and carried it.
- (2025-06-15) Gave Lucia a boost and the aid action to pick the giant lock, and urged checking for mechanical traps first.
- (2025-06-15) Assessed the shattered summoning circle as built for devils, broken outward by something far more powerful than it could control.
- (2025-06-15) Sketched the orrery's starting positions before it was touched, and kept notes on each experiment.
- (2025-06-15) Argued for a more systematic approach to the spheres rather than rushing, and stood out in the hallway for the arrow test.
- (2025-06-15) Reasoned that the towers all fed power to the binding site, so two more towers would let the party triangulate it.
- (2025-06-15) Read the Tiamat books during the long rest hoping for insight into the masks.
- (2025-07-13) Heard faint humanoid shouts during the short rest and warned the party.
- (2025-07-13) Opened the fight with Magic Missile on the fanatic for 11, and she kept her concentration.
- (2025-07-13) Cast Shield (AC 23) to repel the Speaker of Storms' thunder blast, but later took 14 and 22 force from the runestone guardian.
- (2025-07-13) Told the guardian in Giant to hunt the dragon worshipers; it did nothing.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 12)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2025-07-13) Drank his Potion of Fire Giant Strength and attacked the guardian with Booming Blade, dealing 14 plus thunder.
- (2025-07-13) Took 34 and 26 from the guardian in one round and dropped; he rolled a natural 20 on his death save and got back up.
- (2025-07-13) Hit the guardian with an attack for 18 piercing and 4 thunder, and blocked another with a Shield stored in his Ring of Spell Storing.
- (2025-07-13) Read the Giant book (Arcana 15): it holds a rune formula to control rune guardians for a third-level slot; offered to scribe comprehend languages scrolls.
- (2025-07-27) Suggested Monarch use the ring of spell storing, and led the plan to climb the Tower of Runes as the other cultists had, probing ahead since some stones are not real.
- (2025-07-27) Studied the tower with Arcana and learned its sigils can be used to dampen fields and lock stones. On the climb his investigation roll of 10 failed and dropped everyone 10 feet, taking 5 damage. His 21 on a second investigation with advantage worked, his acrobatics 15 succeeded, and a later Arcana check succeeded.
- (2025-07-27) Rolled 26 on investigation near the top and learned the final tier's DC is 18. Failed Arcana on the final tier, causing a 7 force blast. Used his own prepared Feather Fall to avoid a fall after another failure.
- (2025-07-27) Failed a Constitution save against the thunder blast with a roll of 5 and was deafened.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 13)
chunks.text:
Player character: Sir Raf
- (2025-07-27) Used his spellbook ritual to read the Draconic letter with Comprehend Languages. Translated the Hall of Blades voice from Giant for the party and explained to it that they seek a replacement to keep Tiamat and the Faceless Lord imprisoned.
- (2025-07-27) Did not have a worthy truth ready for the hall by the end of the session.
- (2025-08-10) Answered the pedestal by swearing he serves Lady Gracia of House Ventra and her ascendancy though he is of House Kenegal; his first offering was ruled not valuable, his Insight check was 20, and the oath was judged adequate.
- (2025-08-10) Rolled 18 on History to recognize the blade as Black Razor and chose to wait and see on Chimeg rather than intervene.
- (2025-08-10) Cast Blade Ward and kept Chimeg alive with potions of healing (rolled 5+2 = 7 on one), and used Help so Monarch's attack had advantage (18 hit).
- (2025-08-10) Struck the killing blow on the keeper with Booming Blade (24 to hit after a heroic inspiration reroll) for 14 piercing plus 2 thunder, then kicked the dropped black sword toward Chimeg.
- (2025-08-10) Ritually cast Detect Magic on the swords and planned Identify; took Shatterspike (plus one adamantine longsword) and unattuned from his Bracers of Archery.
- (2025-08-10) Sent his bat familiar Diego into the Hall of Feasts, where Diego spotted a hidden seam of a door behind a mosaic; Raf read the mosaics as political feasts with giants, devils and metallic dragons.

chunks.title: Sir Raf (part 14)

chunks.title: Lore: Roma: City, nation, empire
chunks.text:
Lore primer - Roma: City, nation, empire
The city of Roma is also the capital city of the province of Roma, which is one of the original two provinces (along with Greka) that formed the First Imperium.
Roma is paired with Greka (the capital city of that province) through many scores of magical portals which make the cities effectively one. The Tigresses, as they are called, together were the capital of the Imperium through the First, Second, and Third Imperiums.
Recently, a third Tigress was added: Colossea, the great city of the giants in the south. This cemented the rise of the Pax Titanicus and the integration of giants into the ruling houses of the Imperium following their victory in the War of Emperors.
The Dawnrealm to the east, once a province of the Imperium, is now fully independent following the negotiated end to the war. The Harrowlands, once known as the Occident province, is now a collection of loyal city-states under the rule of the Imperium. No provincial government has been successfully established due to the power and influence of these individual city-states.
The eastern portion of the Roma province is inhabited by the nomadic peoples of the Khanates, who owe allegiance to the Imperium but refuse to establish cities. They also serve as a powerful deterrent to Dawnrealm incursions.

The fjord running south from the Sea of Storms between mountain ranges: the Ruins of Drakholm on its eastern shore, an unknown ship (“Unknown ship — beware of merrows”), Belurath’s Fall (“beware of restless dead”) to the west, and the dragons’ lairs in the mountains, Lunae’s among them.

The binding circle of the ancient giant city: the Towers of Storms, Crowns, Stars, Chains, Wells, Runes and Dreams around the Halls of Blades, Songs, Feasts, Scales and Cradles, with the prison at its heart.
